jobs.title: Senior Director Product Management
jobs.text:
Overview
The Senior Director Product Management is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, strategy, and execution of a Cotiviti’s Consumer Engagement product portfolio. This position leads and mentors product managers and analysts, collaborating cross-functionally to deliver innovative solutions that meet market demands and business objectives.
The Senior Director Product Management will ideally have experience with health care quality measurement and reporting (NCQA HEDIS, Star Ratings, etc.), Risk Adjustment, and closing gaps within these domains via member engagement. The successful Senior Director Product Management will be comfortable using AI to develop product features in an accelerated development model.
Responsibilities
Define and communicate the overall product vision, strategy, and roadmap in alignment with company objectives.
Lead, mentor, and scale a product management team, fostering a high-performing and collaborative culture.
Analyze market trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape to drive product innovation and differentiation.
Oversee the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and development through launch and continuous improvements.
Set and measure key product metrics to evaluate success and inform future decisions.
Collaborate with engineering, UX/UI, sales, marketing, and customer success teams.
Serve as the voice of the customer and industry thought leader.
Influence executive leadership and present business cases.
Manage product budgets and timelines.
Identify and mitigate risks.
Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent.
Complete all responsibilities outlined in performance reviews and goals.
Complete special projects and duties as assigned.
Perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and the requirements of the job change.
Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field; MBA preferred.
12+ years of progressive product management experience, including 5+ years in leadership.
Deep understanding of the Consumer Engagement market.
Subject matter expertise related to closing quality measure and risk related gaps.
Proven success launching software products.
Experience building and mentoring high-performing product teams.
Deep understanding of agile methodologies.
Strong analytical, communication, and presentation skills.
Experience managing cross-functional teams and complex projects.
Strategic thinker with customer-focused mindset.
Able to thrive in fast-paced environments.
Cognitive / Mental Requirements
Communicating with others to exchange information.
Problem-solving and critical thinking.
Completing tasks independently.
Interpreting data.
Making timely decisions.
Assessing accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness.
Applying established protocols in a timely manner.
Physical Requirements and Working Conditions
Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work environment.
Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
No adverse environmental conditions are expected.
Base compensation ranges from $191,000 to $230,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.
Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.
Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.
Date of posting: 09/29/2026
Applications are assessed on a rolling basis. We anticipate that the application window will close on 10/29/2026, but the application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data
jobs.text:
Who is Boulevard?
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.
Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.
We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.
Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.
Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.
We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Data to build and lead the technical foundation that powers Boulevard's data ecosystem and products. This role is responsible for our data infrastructure, data governance, ML capabilities and the underlying systems that enable data-driven products and decision-making across the company.
Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll play a critical leadership role in establishing Boulevard's data platform as a strategic competitive advantage. Your work will shape how data is collected, processed, and leveraged across the company - driving insights, powering product innovation, and ensuring operational excellence. You will ensure that data is reliable, secure, performant, and accessible to support our growing customer base and internal teams. You'll lead a high-impact team of data engineers, with a mandate to grow and scale the organization. This is a foundational role where you'll architect and build systems that will support Boulevard's growth for years to come.
Domains of Ownership
Data Infrastructure & Platform Engineering - Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and infrastructure
Data Products - Partner with the insights team, product management and product engineering to power reporting dashboards, analytics features, and data-driven customer experiences
Data Governance & Quality - Establish frameworks for data integrity, lineage, and compliance
Data Security & Privacy - Ensure data protection, access controls, and regulatory compliance (including HIPAA)
ML/AI Platform Operations - Provide the foundation and standards for machine learning and AI capabilities
Real-time & Batch Processing - Design and optimize data processing systems for various use cases
Data Integration & APIs - Enable seamless data flow between systems and external partners
Key Projects & Initiatives
Modern Data Infrastructure: Continue building out scalable data infrastructure using tools like dbt, Airflow, and real-time streaming platforms
Customer Data Products: Collaborate with Product Management and Product Engineering to deliver customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features
Data Platform for Insights: Build robust data pipelines that enable the Data Insights team to deliver external benchmarking and internal business intelligence
Data Governance Framework: Establish comprehensive data quality monitoring, lineage tracking, and governance policies
Platform Self-Service: Build tools and frameworks that enable other teams to safely and efficiently work with data
Security & Compliance: Strengthen data protection, access controls, and ensure HIPAA compliance across all data systems
Performance Optimization: Continuously improve cost, speed, and reliability of data processing systems
ML/AI Infrastructure: Provide robust foundation for training, deployment, and monitoring of machine learning models and LLMs
What You'll Do Here
Technical Leadership: Define and execute the long-term technical strategy for Boulevard's data platform, ensuring scalability and reliability as we grow
Team Building: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data platform engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of excellence
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, and the Data Insights team to understand requirements and deliver platform capabilities that enable customer-facing data products and internal insights
Architecture & Design: Drive architectural decisions for data systems, balancing current needs with future flexibility and scalability
Operational Excellence: Establish monitoring, alerting, and operational practices that ensure high availability and performance of data systems
Standards & Governance: Define and implement data governance policies, security standards, and quality frameworks across the organization
Strategic Planning: Work with leadership to align data platform roadmap with business objectives and technical strategy
What You'll Need to Thrive
10+ years of experience in data platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure engineering, with deep expertise in building scalable data processing systems
5+ years of people management experience, including managing senior engineers and technical leads
Proven track record of building data platforms and ML systems that support both internal analytics and customer-facing data products
Experience delivering customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features in collaboration with Product teams
Strong experience with modern data stack technologies (dbt, Airflow, Snowflake, Kafka, etc.)
Deep understanding of data governance, quality frameworks, and security best practices
A strategic mindset with the ability to translate business goals into technical roadmaps, balancing short-term execution with long-term vision.
How We'll Take Care of You
At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $220,000 - $270,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.
In addition to the wonderful people you'll get to work with and challenging projects that'll push you:
✨ We've got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance
Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy
Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You'll receive a work from home stipend every month
Family planning resources and specialized support programs
Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard
Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve

jobs.title: VP, Data Strategy & Governance
jobs.text:
Become a part of our caring community
The Vice President, Data Strategy & Governance is a senior executive accountable for defining, advancing, and operationalizing the enterprise data strategy. This leader drives the full lifecycle of data governance — from policy design and sensitive data management to technology enablement, data quality, and regulatory compliance. Serving as a strategic advisor to executive stakeholders across all business units and technology functions, the VP partners closely with Cybersecurity,
Enterprise Architecture, and line-of-business leaders cultivate a data-rich, AI-ready environment grounded in trust, quality, and accountability.
The VP is a visionary organizational builder who attracts and develops world-class talent, shapes data culture, and influences enterprise-wide change. This individual would need to partner across business and technology leaders to drive a product mindset and promote adoption to realize business outcomes. This leader will promote a data product operating model by embedding accountability for data quality, metadata, lineage, access, and data lifecycle management across the enterprise. This leader brings deep command of applied data governance practices, data protection strategies, emerging ML/AI-based governance tools, and the legislative landscape governing personal and sensitive data. Their work directly enables the organization's digital and analytics ambitions while fortifying its cyber-breach resistance posture.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Initiatives & Program Outcomes
Establish and own the enterprise data strategy, translating organizational goals into a continuously evolving roadmap of data capabilities spanning people, process, technology, and budget.
Lead portfolio governance of enterprise data programs, ensuring initiatives are prioritized, resourced, and delivering measurable business outcomes aligned to financial and strategic objectives.
Partner with the Chief Data & Analytics Officer and executive peers to articulate the value of data assets, influence investment decisions, and embed data thinking into enterprise planning cycles.
Drive enterprise-scale data science and AI readiness by ensuring foundational data infrastructure, lineage, quality, and accessibility meet the demands of advanced analytics and generative AI use cases.
Develop and maintain a data product mindset across the organization — enabling reusable, trusted, and well-documented data assets that accelerate time-to-insight across business units.
Team Building & Organizational Development
Build, lead, and continuously develop a high-performing, world-class team of experts spanning sensitive data governance, data lineage and mapping, data enrichment, data quality, data democratization, and program management.
Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous learning; champion data literacy initiatives that upskill the broader organization and democratize access to trusted data.
Act as a Culture Shaper and Talent Builder — recruiting diverse, senior talent, establishing clear career pathways, and mentoring future data leaders across the enterprise.
Operate as a cross-functional influencer and collaborator, building strong relationships across Technology, Cybersecurity, Legal, Compliance, Finance, and business unit stakeholders to drive data governance adoption at scale.
Define team operating models, performance metrics, and OKRs that demonstrate the strategic and financial impact of the data governance function.
Technology Implementations & Tools
Lead evaluation, selection, and implementation of enterprise data governance platforms, data catalog and marketplace solutions, data quality tooling, and metadata management systems.
Modernize data scanning, automated tagging, and labeling capabilities to improve governance efficiency, enable proactive data classification, and strengthen data loss prevention (DLP) outcomes.
Partner with Security Architecture and Enterprise Architecture to design and deploy solutions that deliver integrated data governance and data security at scale — on-premises and across cloud environments.
Invest in and operationalize innovative ML/AI-based approaches for data governance, including automated lineage discovery, anomaly detection, synthetic data generation, and differential privacy techniques.
Maintain awareness of the evolving data governance technology landscape; drive a buy/build/partner strategy that balances innovation with cost discipline and commercial accountability.
Data Governance Process Improvements
Operate and continuously enhance enterprise data governance capabilities — including metadata management, data lineage, data quality standards, master data management, and access governance — through a structured and measurable capability roadmap.
Define, publish, and enforce enterprise data policies, standards, and controls ensuring consistent, compliant, and high-quality data usage across all business domains.
Champion data democratization by enabling self-service data access models backed by robust governance guardrails, role-based access controls, and data marketplace infrastructure.
Establish data stewardship programs and data domain ownership models that distribute accountability for data quality and governance across the enterprise.
Drive continuous improvement of data anonymization, de-identification, and synthetic data capabilities to enable broader analytics use while protecting sensitive information.
Risk Management & Compliance
Lead the enterprise Data Risk Assessment program, identifying, measuring, and managing data security risks across applications, platforms, and business and technology initiatives.
Ensure the organization's data practices comply with applicable data privacy regulations and industry standards, including HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and other relevant legislation governing personal and sensitive data.
Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, and Cybersecurity to proactively identify regulatory changes, assess their data governance implications, and implement controls before compliance deadlines.
Strengthen data protection strategy and execution — including encryption, tokenization, data masking, data loss prevention, and access control frameworks — to improve cyber-breach resistance.
Provide executive reporting and Board-level transparency on data governance risk posture, compliance status, and program maturity metrics on a recurring basis.
Use your skills to make an impact
Key Requirements
Experience
10+ years of senior leadership experience in data governance, data management, or data strategy roles within large, complex, matrixed corporate environments.
10+ years of hands-on data governance experience, including both on-premises and cloud-native environments (AWS, Azure, GCP or equivalent).
Demonstrated track record of building and scaling data governance programs from concept through enterprise adoption, with measurable improvements in data quality, compliance, and business outcomes.
Proven experience managing and delivering large, multi-workstream programs — including strategic initiatives, technology implementations, and organizational transformation — on time and within budget.
Prior hands-on experience and/or leadership responsibility for technical data governance tools, including data catalogs, data lineage platforms, data marketplace systems, and data quality frameworks.
Relevant experience in consumer goods, healthcare, financial services, or technology industries strongly preferred.
Technical & Domain Knowledge
Deep expertise in data architecture, data warehousing, data quality processes, and enterprise data modeling.
Relevant experience with data protection strategies, including encryption, tokenization, data masking, data loss prevention, and role-based access control design.
Working knowledge of cybersecurity assessment methodologies and data security controls, with experience partnering with CISO and Security/Enterprise Architecture functions.
Familiarity with ML/AI-based data governance approaches, including automated metadata tagging, anomaly detection, synthetic data generation, and differential privacy.
Strong command of data privacy regulations including HIPAA, CCPA/CPRA, GDPR, and related legislative frameworks.
Champion and drive a product mindset across the enterprise data and analytics, treat data as a strategic asset and managing data products through their full lifecycle to maximize business value, adoption, quality and reuse.
Leadership & Influence
A visionary Culture Shaper, Talent Builder, Results Driver, Systems Thinker, and Accountability Partner who engages and aligns the broad enterprise toward common data goals.
Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; able to translate complex data concepts into clear, compelling narratives for C-suite, Board, and business stakeholders.
Strong evidence of the ability to introduce emerging technologies and develop analytics-based capabilities while maintaining cost awareness and commercial strategy.
Proven ability to drive enterprise-wide change in matrixed organizations through influence, coalition-building, and stakeholder management without direct authority.
Leadership Competencies
Culture Shaper
Actively builds an inclusive, high-trust data culture. Champions data literacy, promotes ethical data use, and sets behavioral expectations that reinforce accountability and transparency.
Talent Builder
Recruits, develops, and retains diverse, world-class talent. Creates clear career pathways, coaches emerging leaders, and builds bench strength across the data governance organization.
Results Driver
Sets ambitious goals and holds self and team accountable. Translates strategy into executable plans, tracks progress with rigor, and delivers measurable financial and operational impact.
Systems Thinker
Understands interconnections across data, technology, process, and people. Designs holistic governance frameworks that scale and anticipate second-order effects on the enterprise.
Influential Collaborator
Builds trust and credibility across business and technology functions. Uses data to persuade, aligns diverse stakeholders around shared priorities, and navigates complex political dynamics with integrity.
Strategic Innovator
Brings intellectual curiosity and market awareness. Proactively identifies emerging technologies and governance practices, translating external trends into competitive organizational advantage.
Education
Advanced degree (Master's or higher) in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Management, Statistics, Mathematics, Law, Cybersecurity, or a related field required.
Ph.D. in a relevant discipline or an MBA is a significant additional asset.
Dual degrees combining technical and business or legal disciplines are highly valued.
Relevant professional certifications (e.g., CDMP, CIPP, CISM, CISSP, or cloud data platform certifications) are a plus.

jobs.title: Director, Electrical Engineering
jobs.text:
Overview
Gray AES is looking to add a Director, Electrical Engineering-MEP to our office in Atlanta,GA, Birmingham,AL, Charlotte,NC, Cincinnati,OH, Dallas,TX, Lexington, KY, or Remote
Responsibilities
Why Gray AES?
Gray is a family-owned, fully integrated global service provider specializing in engineering, design, construction, digital, equipment manufacturing, and real estate services. Deeply rooted in EAC services, Gray serves both domestic and international customers across our core markets: Food & Beverage, Manufacturing, Automotive, Distribution, Mission Critical, and Commercial. At Gray, our purpose is to make a positive difference in people's lives and build a better future.
Gray AES, the design arm of Gray, is a top-ranked firm offering architecture and engineering services across the globe. Made up of multidisciplinary teams of architects, engineers, and project managers, these collaborative teams work every day to provide unique, customized solutions for our customers.
It’s the spirit of our people – the passion, commitment, and a great team environment – that makes our company a great place to work.
Who we want…
Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or mechanical engineering technology
Professional Engineering (PE) License required.
15+ years of progressive engineering experience, including 5+ years in a senior leadership role.
Advanced proficiency in Revit, AutoCAD, BIM, and other relevant design and modeling software.
Advanced proficiency with electrical design tools (e.g., SKM Power Tools, ETAP, or similar).
Proven track record of mentoring, coaching, and developing high-performing engineering teams.
Demonstrated success in leading complex, multidisciplinary projects and managing client relationships.
Strong business acumen with experience in budgeting, proposal development, client engagement, and strategic planning.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills; able to foster collaboration across departments.
Strategic thinker with a growth mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement.
Self-directed leader capable of driving initiatives from concept through execution.
Ability to travel up to 25% of the time
Qualifications
What we expect… (Essential Functions)
Provide strategic leadership for the electrical engineering discipline, aligning team capabilities with business goals and market demands.
Oversee the technical execution, quality assurance, and delivery of electrical engineering services across all project phases.
Lead and mentor engineering managers, senior engineers, and design staff, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to deliver integrated design solutions, coordinating with architectural, structural, mechanical, and automation teams.
Drive process optimization, including QA/QC standards, technology adoption, and documentation workflows.Support business development efforts, including proposal strategy, client presentations, and relationship management.
Lead resource planning, hiring strategy, and succession planning for the electrical engineering team.
Ensure compliance with safety, regulatory, and quality standards across all engineering activities.
Other strategic duties as assigned.
Physical Demands & Work EnvironmentThe physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.Periodic overnight travel to visit jobsites where the ability to traverse undeveloped terrain may be required.
While performing the duties of this position, the team member is frequently required to stand, walk, sit, use hands, reach with hands or arms and talk or hear. They may occasionally be required to climb or balance, stoop, kneel, or crouch. Must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.
Specific vision abilities required include close vision.
Generally, normal office environment where noise level is moderate and temperature/humidity is controlled. Overtime may be required.
Supervisory ResponsibilitiesThis position may supervise the roles of Manager, Electrical Engineering, Principal Engineer, or Senior Engineers.
EEO DisclaimerGray is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcomes everyone to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

jobs.title: Director, Data Quality & Integrity (Provider Network Operations)
jobs.text:
Become a part of our caring community
The Director, Data Quality/Integrity understands end-to-end master data processes and flows and uses that knowledge to design and implement master data management solutions. The Director, Data Quality/Integrity requires an in-depth understanding of how organization capabilities interrelate across the function or segment.
This is a remote position.
The Director, Provider Data Quality & Directory Governance is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise strategy for provider data quality, governance, directory accuracy, and innovation. This leader will establish the operating model, standards, controls, and continuous improvement practices that ensure provider data is accurate, complete, timely, compliant, and trusted across provider directories, network operations, credentialing, contracting, and digital experiences.
Reporting to the VP of Provider Network Operations, this role partners across Operations, Technology, Analytics, Compliance, Provider Services, and market leadership to improve provider data integrity, strengthen governance, reduce defects, and enhance provider and member experiences. The Director is expected to champion innovation, challenge traditional approaches, and actively collaborate both within the organization and across the healthcare industry to advance provider data management practices.
Key Responsibilities
Data Quality Strategy & Leadership
Develop and execute a multi-year data quality and integrity strategy aligned with organizational priorities.
Establish enterprise standards, policies, and operating models that support sustainable data quality practices.
Lead strategic initiatives focused on improving data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness.
Serve as a thought leader in data quality management, governance, and stewardship.
Data Governance & Data Mastering
Lead data governance programs that define ownership, accountability, business rules, and quality standards for critical data assets.
Partner with business and technology leaders to establish data stewardship responsibilities and governance processes.
Oversee data mastering initiatives, including the identification, definition, and management of key enterprise data assets.
Drive alignment across stakeholders on data definitions, standards, and quality expectations.
Data Integrity, Auditing & Controls
Design and implement data-driven auditing programs to proactively identify data anomalies, risks, and process weaknesses.
Establish monitoring frameworks and controls that improve visibility into data quality performance.
Lead reconciliation and validation processes to ensure alignment across multiple data sources.
Develop feedback mechanisms and continuous improvement processes that address root causes of data quality issues.
Operational Excellence & Process Improvement
Conduct end-to-end assessments of business processes impacting data quality and integrity.
Lead provider directory data quality and integrity efforts to ensure compliance with CMS requirements, including accuracy, completeness, timely updates, and audit readiness.
Identify rework drivers, inefficiencies, and recurring quality issues and implement sustainable solutions.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational effectiveness and reduce data-related defects.
Develop executive dashboards and reporting that provide actionable insights into quality performance.
Technology, Vendor & Solution Management
Evaluate current and emerging data quality technologies and governance solutions.
Lead vendor assessments, RFP processes, and business case development for new capabilities.
Partner with Technology teams to implement tools that enhance automation, monitoring, and data governance.
Assess market-leading practices and identify opportunities to improve quality management capabilities.
Stakeholder Partnership & Influence
Build strong relationships with operational leaders, technology teams, analytics partners, and external vendors.
Facilitate cross-functional alignment on data quality priorities and governance decisions.
Present findings, recommendations, and strategic roadmaps to executive leadership.
Lead organizational change efforts that promote enterprise ownership of data quality.
Use your skills to make an impact
This role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.
8+ years of leadership experience in provider data management, provider directory operations, data governance, data quality, network operations, or related healthcare functions.
Deep understanding of provider data domains, including directory data, demographics, affiliations, specialties, credentialing, contracting, and regulatory requirements.
Experience designing and implementing enterprise data governance frameworks, stewardship models, quality controls, and auditing programs.
Proven success leading large-scale cross-functional transformation initiatives across business and technology organizations.
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence stakeholders and translate complex data issues into business outcomes.
Preferred Qualifications
Master's degree in a related field.
Experience with provider directory accuracy programs, regulatory audits, accreditation requirements, and provider network operations.
Experience with master data management, data governance platforms, and data quality tools.
Lean, Six Sigma, Data Governance, or Data Management certifications.
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.

40

Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. The Director, Data Quality/Integrity understands end-to-end master data processes and flows and uses that knowledge to design and implement master data management solutions. The Director, Data Quality/Integrity requires an in-depth understanding of how organization capabilities interrelate across the function or segment.
This is a remote position.

The Director, Provider Data Quality & Directory Governance is responsible for defining and executing the enterprise strategy for provider data quality, governance, directory accuracy, and innovation. This leader will establish the operating model, standards, controls, and continuous improvement practices that ensure provider data is accurate, complete, timely, compliant, and trusted across provider directories, network operations, credentialing, contracting, and digital experiences.

Reporting to the VP of Provider Network Operations, this role partners across Operations, Technology, Analytics, Compliance, Provider Services, and market leadership to improve provider data integrity, strengthen governance, reduce defects, and enhance provider and member experiences. The Director is expected to champion innovation, challenge traditional approaches, and actively collaborate both within the organization and across the healthcare industry to advance provider data management practices.
Key Responsibilities
Data Quality Strategy & Leadership

items: Develop and execute a multi-year data quality and integrity strategy aligned with organizational priorities.
Establish enterprise standards, policies, and operating models that support sustainable data quality practices.
Lead strategic initiatives focused on improving data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness.
Serve as a thought leader in data quality management, governance, and stewardship.

blocks.text: Data Governance & Data Mastering

items: Lead data governance programs that define ownership, accountability, business rules, and quality standards for critical data assets.
Partner with business and technology leaders to establish data stewardship responsibilities and governance processes.
Oversee data mastering initiatives, including the identification, definition, and management of key enterprise data assets.
Drive alignment across stakeholders on data definitions, standards, and quality expectations.

blocks.text: Data Integrity, Auditing & Controls

items: Design and implement data-driven auditing programs to proactively identify data anomalies, risks, and process weaknesses.
Establish monitoring frameworks and controls that improve visibility into data quality performance.
Lead reconciliation and validation processes to ensure alignment across multiple data sources.
Develop feedback mechanisms and continuous improvement processes that address root causes of data quality issues.

blocks.text: Operational Excellence & Process Improvement

items: Conduct end-to-end assessments of business processes impacting data quality and integrity.
Lead provider directory data quality and integrity efforts to ensure compliance with CMS requirements, including accuracy, completeness, timely updates, and audit readiness.
Identify rework drivers, inefficiencies, and recurring quality issues and implement sustainable solutions.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives that improve operational effectiveness and reduce data-related defects.
Develop executive dashboards and reporting that provide actionable insights into quality performance.

blocks.text: Technology, Vendor & Solution Management

items: Evaluate current and emerging data quality technologies and governance solutions.
Lead vendor assessments, RFP processes, and business case development for new capabilities.
Partner with Technology teams to implement tools that enhance automation, monitoring, and data governance.
Assess market-leading practices and identify opportunities to improve quality management capabilities.

blocks.text: Stakeholder Partnership & Influence

items: Build strong relationships with operational leaders, technology teams, analytics partners, and external vendors.
Facilitate cross-functional alignment on data quality priorities and governance decisions.
Present findings, recommendations, and strategic roadmaps to executive leadership.
Lead organizational change efforts that promote enterprise ownership of data quality.

jobs.title: Director, Real World Data Strategy
jobs.text:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
Position Summary:
At BMS, the Director, Real-World Data Strategy sits at the intersection of business strategy, data intelligence, and AI-driven innovation, serving as a key member of the enterprise Real-World Data (RWD) Strategy team. This is a business-first role powered by data and accelerated by artificial intelligence. The Director is responsible for translating BMS's most pressing business and R&D priorities into sharp, actionable RWD strategies, and for leading the team's adoption and application of AI to reshape how the organization identifies, evaluates, acquires, and deploys real-world data assets to drive evidence generation, competitive differentiation, and patient impact.
This role is expected to be the AI innovation driver on the enterprise RWD Strategy team, someone who brings a high AI IQ, actively identifies where AI unlocks new strategic value, and sets the standard for how AI thinking is embedded in the team's work and in service of BMS customers and partners.
As part of an enterprise-wide team, this Director will serve as a connector between the external RWD and AI landscape and BMS's internal needs, ensuring that every data and technology investment is grounded in clear business value and strategic alignment. Success in this role requires deep domain expertise, AI fluency and curiosity, executive presence, rigorous analytical thinking, and a relentless focus on outcomes for the business.
Key Responsibilities:
AI Leadership & Innovation:
Serve as the team's AI innovation lead, setting direction for how artificial intelligence and advanced analytics are integrated into RWD strategy, data evaluation, market intelligence, and evidence generation.
Proactively identify, evaluate, and champion AI-enabled data opportunities and emerging technologies that enhance RWD exploration, dataset assessment, and strategic decision-making at scale.
Translate the rapidly evolving AI and data science landscape into practical, high-impact applications aligned with BMS R&D priorities and pipeline needs.
Model AI-forward thinking across the team and for customers, building shared literacy, frameworks, and best practices that elevate the team's collective AI capability.
Align novel AI-driven research ideas with available RWD assets to accelerate exploratory use cases, enabling faster, smarter data-driven decisions across the enterprise.
Business-Driven Strategy & Prioritization:
Champion and communicate a forward-looking RWD exploration strategy that is anchored in BMS business priorities, translating R&D needs, pipeline goals, and evidence gaps into targeted data investment and exploration decisions.
Synthesize inputs from RWD users, senior leaders, and cross-functional partners to define and evolve strategic priorities, ensuring every data initiative is tied to measurable business value.
Develop and present clear, executive-ready business cases for RWD investments, acquisitions, and licensing decisions, balancing strategic ambition with budget realities and portfolio needs.
Data Landscaping & Opportunity Identification:
Monitor and interpret the global RWD ecosystem, including emerging datasets, vendors, technologies, AI platforms, partnerships, and market trends, through a business lens, connecting evolving research questions and R&D needs with differentiated data sources and novel use cases.
Lead rigorous evaluation and piloting of priority RWD sources, assessing fitness, quality, coverage, differentiation, and applicability, and translating findings into clear investment or adoption recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Establish scalable assessment frameworks, dashboards, and methodologies that enable consistent, repeatable evaluation and prioritization of RWD opportunities across the enterprise portfolio.
Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Collaboration:
Drive high-visibility engagement with senior leaders and cross-functional teams through a hub model of ongoing consultations, ensuring transparent, interactive strategy development processes that build trust and alignment.
Collaborate across Strategy, Acquisition, Data Product, Governance, Customer Success, and R&D stakeholder groups to convert exploration insights into actionable data, investment, partnership, and portfolio decisions.
Serve as a thought leader across the enterprise RWD Strategy team, contributing to shared capabilities, best practices, and strategic frameworks, with particular emphasis on AI integration, that elevate the team's collective impact.
Partner & Vendor Development:
Identify, assess, and engage RWD data providers and external partners to evaluate differentiated partnership opportunities that address emerging or unmet data needs, including AI-powered data and analytics platforms.
Lead assessment of RWD partners for comprehensive data development capabilities, ensuring partnerships create clear, lasting strategic advantage for BMS.
Qualifications:
Education:
Advanced degree in health research, life sciences, data science, quantitative sciences, or a related field. PhD preferred but not required.
Experience:
10+ years of relevant experience in real-world healthcare data, data strategy, market intelligence, life sciences, or consulting, with a demonstrated track record of translating complex business and scientific problems into data-driven strategies and outcomes.
Demonstrated experience applying AI and advanced analytics in an RWD, life sciences, or data strategy context, including familiarity with generative AI, machine learning, or AI-enabled data tools.
Proven ability to operate as a strategic advisor to senior leaders in a complex, matrixed life sciences organization.
Deep expertise in RWD sources, data evaluation approaches, research and analytic applications, and the evolving external RWD ecosystem.
Significant experience engaging with RWD vendors and data partners, including negotiating and shaping strategic relationships.
Skills & Competencies:
AI fluency and innovation mindset: Ability to identify, evaluate, and operationalize AI-driven opportunities that create tangible value for RWD strategy and enterprise customers. Expected to be a visible AI champion within the team.
Business acumen: Strong ability to frame data and AI opportunities in terms of business value, pipeline impact, and investment return.
Strategic thinking and executive communication: Ability to synthesize complex data, AI, and market intelligence into concise, compelling recommendations that influence senior decision-making.
Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with experience building evaluation frameworks and investment cases.
Familiarity with analytic platforms, federated environments, and AI/data science approaches relevant to RWD access and exploration.
Knowledge of RWD compliance requirements (HIPAA, GDPR, etc.), including emerging considerations for AI use in healthcare data contexts.
Exceptional oral and written communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences.
Collaborative, team-oriented mindset with comfort operating in a fast-changing, cross-functional enterprise environment.
We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
Compensation Overview:
Remote - United States - US: $197,800 - $239,681
The starting pay range(s) listed above is for full-time employees (FTE). You may also be eligible for additional discretionary incentive cash and stock opportunities. We determine starting pay thoughtfully – carefully considering the nature of the role, required skills, work location, schedule and the knowledge and experience you bring. Final compensation is guided by pay equity principles and applicable employment laws. Compensation programs are reviewed on an ongoing basis and may be adjusted over time to reflect evolving market factors, and individual, team or Company performance.
Benefits:
Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, you may be eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefit plans – including wellbeing support, retirement and financial protection benefits, and insurance offerings (medical, dental, vision, life and disability).
U.S.-based exempt employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off (FTO), which provides paid time off without a set accrual limit, subject to manager approval, along with 11 paid company holidays each year.
Non-exempt employees, RayzeBio employees, and employees located in Puerto Rico receive 160 hours of paid vacation annually for new hires (subject to manager approval), 11 paid company holidays, and 3 optional holidays.
Depending on eligibility, employees may also have access to additional time-off benefits, including paid sick leave, up to two paid volunteer days per year, summer hours flexibility, and leaves of absence for medical, personal, parental, caregiver, bereavement, or military needs. Eligible employees also enjoy an annual Global Shutdown between Christmas Day and New Year's Day.
U.S.-based job seekers can explore full benefit offerings at

Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Any data processed in connection with role applications will be treated in accordance with applicable data privacy policies and regulations.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product Management, Outbound (Remote, US)
jobs.text:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
The Role
The Senior Director of Product Management, Outbound translates Lumen’s product strategy into market-ready offerings that scale revenue, improve adoption, and differentiate Lumen in the enterprise and wholesale markets. This leader owns the outbound motion for a portfolio of network, cloud connectivity, and digital platform services, ensuring products are clearly positioned, launch-ready, and operationally executable for Sales, Partners, and Customers.
This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and commercial outcomes. You will work backward from customer and market requirements, shape portfolio direction with Product Management and Engineering, and drive alignment across Marketing, Sales, Finance, Operations, and Partners.
Effectiveness in this role requires strong product instincts, commercial judgment, and executive presence paired with the ability to operate in a complex, scaled enterprise environment. This role ensures Lumen doesn’t just build great products but wins in the market by bringing clarity, focus, and commercial intensity to how our offerings reach customers and sellers. It is a critical lever in turning strategy into long-term growth.
Location
This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.
The Main Responsibilities
Own the Outbound Product Strategy
Define and lead the outbound product strategy for assigned domains, from positioning through launch and lifecycle optimization.
Translate product capabilities into clear value propositions, differentiated messaging, and market‑ready offers.
Create and maintain product launch frameworks, including target segments, pricing logic, packaging, sales plays, and success metrics.
Drive Go‑to‑Market Execution
Lead multifunctional launch teams to bring new products and features to market quickly, with quality and discipline.
Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, and Marketing to ensure readiness across training, tools, content, and field execution.
Develop and sustain strategic sales motions, including executive selling scenarios, competitive strategy, and customer proof points.
Shape the Product Roadmap from the Market Back
Represent market, customer, and revenue insights concerning Product Management and Engineering planning cycles.
Size customer and market opportunities and develop business cases that target roadmap investments based on growth, profitability, and strategic fit.
Manage short‑term revenue opportunities with long‑term platform and portfolio evolution.
Operate as a Cross‑Functional Leader
Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Partners to ensure offers are technically sound, operationally viable, and financially solid.
Build alignment at the executive level by communicating tradeoffs, risks, and outcomes clearly.
Anticipate and resolve issues that could impair launch success, customer experience, or commercial performance.
Measure, Learn, and Optimize
Define success metrics for launches and ongoing performance such as adoption, attach, churn, margin, and revenue.
Use market data, customer feedback, and performance analytics to improve positioning, packaging, and sales execution.
Continuously improve how Lumen brings products to market—simplifying where possible, innovating where needed.
Leadership Scope
Senior leadership role with significant influence across Product, GTM, and Sales.
High visibility with executive stakeholders.
Expected to mentor and develop product leaders and outbound talent.
What We Look For in a Candidate
10+ years of experience in product management, product marketing, or go‑to‑market leadership roles.

jobs.title: Head of Design
jobs.text:
About Doit
We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.
We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.
In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
About the Role
The Head of Design will own product design quality across the group's consumer products and brands. This is a hands-on design leadership role with direct involvement in our most important products and user experiences.
What you will be doing
Set the design direction and quality bar across group products.
Work directly on or review critical user journeys, product concepts and interfaces.
Turn complex financial and AI workflows into simple consumer experiences.
Set standards across product design, interaction, visual design and design systems.
Review shipped products and identify specific usability and design problems.
Work with product and engineering from early concepts through production.
Recruit and assess senior product, UI and brand designers.
What you will need
Strong portfolio of shipped consumer technology products with meaningful usage.
Deep product and interaction design capability, not primarily people management.
Strong visual judgement and attention to interface details.
Ability to prototype and communicate product interactions directly.
Experience working closely with product and engineering on shipped products.
Hands-on design style - able to create, critique and materially improve design work directly.
Portfolio Submission (Mandatory)
Applicants are required to submit a portfolio as part of their application. The portfolio should showcase relevant design work, projects, and achievements that demonstrate your experience, creative capabilities, and suitability for the Chief Design Officer role.
Please provide a link to your portfolio in the application form. Portfolio submission is mandatory for this role.

jobs.title: Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product​
jobs.text:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!
Why this role matters:
BSS Engineering and Product is a critical enabler of Vonage's commercial platform, ensuring our business support systems are scalable, reliable, commercially aligned, and able to support growth across products, regions, and customer segments. As Senior Director, BSS Engineering & Product, you will lead the global BSS function across engineering ownership, product direction, platform strategy, and delivery for billing, rating, provisioning, ordering, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations.
Your key responsibilities:
BSS Engineering Leadership
Lead the global BSS engineering organization, owning architecture, delivery, quality, resilience, technical standards, and platform performance across core BSS systems
Define engineering practices across solution design, integration, release management, test automation, observability, and technical debt management
Ensure BSS platforms support scale, availability, security, compliance, and the needs of a multi-product, multi-region commercial model.
BSS Product Ownership & Roadmap
Own the BSS product strategy and roadmap, prioritizing capabilities against commercial, customer, operational, regulatory, and finance needs
Translate business requirements into a clear product backlog across billing, rating, mediation, ordering, CPQ, revenue management, customer lifecycle management, and related integrations
Establish governance, prioritization forums, success measures, and communication rhythms, including the use of AI-enabled insight and automation to improve delivery, decision-making, and platform optimisation.
Team Leadership & Operating Cadence
Lead and develop a global BSS Engineering and Product team, including engineering managers, product owners, platform leads, architects, and delivery specialists
Run an effective operating cadence across roadmap planning, delivery governance, platform health, stakeholder prioritisation, risk management, and product delivery progress
Build organisational capability through hiring, succession planning, team structure design, globally distributed delivery, and practical AI enablement across engineering and product ways of working.
What you'll bring:
Required:
Senior BSS engineering and product leadership experience in global telecommunications, CPaaS, cloud communications, or enterprise SaaS
Deep BSS domain expertise, including platforms such as Amdocs, Oracle Communications, CSGi, NetCracker, Zuora, Optiva, Salesforce CPQ, or equivalent
Experience leading BSS platform delivery, including migrations, integrations, data improvement, release planning, and API-led or cloud-native architectures where appropriate
Strong product ownership capability, with experience translating commercial, finance, regulatory, operational, and customer needs into a clear roadmap and measurable outcomes
Experience leading geographically distributed engineering, product, architecture, and delivery teams in a matrixed environment, with a track record of using AI, automation, or data-driven tooling to improve productivity, quality, and platform outcomes.
Experience we consider a plus:
Experience in CPaaS, UCaaS, CCaaS, or Tier 1/Tier 2 telecommunications
Experience with API monetisation, partner billing, usage-based charging, subscription management, or digital self-service.
How you'll benefit
Private Medical Insurance: Adeslas
Group Pension Plan: Generali
Life Insurance and Group Personal Accident: VidaCaixa
Ericsson Care Line
Discretionary Time Off (DTO)/Hourly Paid Time Off (PTO)
Volunteer Time (VTO)
Additional benefits and perks will be shared and discussed with you by the recruiter during the interview process.

There’s no perfect candidate. You don't need all the preferred qualifications to make a valuable impact on our team. Our employees and customers come from diverse backgrounds, so if you're passionate about what you could achieve at Vonage, we'd love to hear from you.
To learn how we process your personal data during the recruitment process, please refer to our Privacy Notice.
Who we are:
Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. And your talent will further help brands - such as Airbnb, Viber, WhatsApp, and Snapchat - accelerate their digital transformation through our fully programmable-based unified communications, contact center solutions, and communications APIs. Ready to innovate? Then join us today.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - Applied AI
jobs.text:
About Flow
Flow Engineering is an AI-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor.
About the role
Flow is seeking a senior engineering manager to lead a team building the core of our platform. This is our first dedicated engineering management hire, and you will own delivery for a team of engineers while staying hands on with coding.
You will report to our head of engineering and work closely with product, design, and our forward deployed engineers.
What you'll do
Manage and grow a team of engineers, owning onboarding, feedback, and career development.
Own product execution end to end, from scoping with customers through ship, measure, and iterate.
Stay technical. Review code, make architecture calls, and pick up meaningful work when a project needs it.
Help establish engineering best practices
Work directly with customers. Our users are systems and requirements engineers at hardware companies with a high bar
Partner with recruiting to build the team
Help set direction on how AI shows up in the product, working with engineers building agentic workflows and LLM-powered features.
About you
8+ years developing production software, including designing, testing, and operating services at scale in a cloud environment.
2+ years managing engineers, ideally at an early-stage company or somewhere with little existing process scaffolding.
Track record shipping software that enterprise customers depend on, with a clear understanding of what that changes about how you build.
Still hands on with coding
Direct communicator who is able to give difficult feedback
Comfortable working in a high-ownership, fast-paced environment where experiments and iteration are the norm.
Nice to have
Background in aerospace, defense, automotive, or another regulated hardware domain.
Experience with requirements, ALM, PLM, or systems engineering tooling.
Experience managing teams building LLM-powered or agentic features in production.
Our stack
TypeScript/Node.js and Python for backend and AI services.
Modern LLM APIs and orchestration libraries for building agentic workflows.
Postgres and other managed cloud services for data and state.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Analytics and Data Science, Core Product & Growth
jobs.text:
About Life360
Life360's mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.
Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).
Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.
Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.
We are AI Native
We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.
Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.
About The Team
The Data & Analytics Team (DnA) is a 60+ person organization spanning data engineering, analytics engineering, analytics/decision science, and data science/ML. The science teams are organized into two sub teams, focusing on MAU and Revenue. This role leads decision science and data science within MAU.
You and your team will be responsible for understanding the drivers behind MAU: why members come, why they stay, and why they return. The team partners with product, marketing, and engineering to put those learnings into everyday work, and that work shapes our roadmaps.
Our data is unusual for a consumer company. Life360 measures families and circles rather than individuals, so one member's behavior affects another's, which makes measurement a different problem than a standard funnel. With billions of location events, driving behavior, crash detection, and Tile and Pet GPS trackers, we get a rich picture of physical behavior that few consumer companies can build.
About the Job
This Senior Director leads MAU Analytics and Data Science.
You and your team will work across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention on the analysis, models, and experiments behind each. A lot of what this role owns needs to be built rather than maintained: the measurement, the standards, and how the team uses AI. The team is also raising its craft, and coaching people through that is an important part of the job. Within a year, your team members will be operating at an elevated skill level, proactively bringing key questions to light, and serving as trusted advisors whom stakeholders consult for strategic guidance rather than simple task execution.
You will report to the Head of Data and work closely with counterparts leading Revenue Analytics and Data Science, and with the leaders of Data Engineering.
For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $247,000 to $366,000 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is $286,000 to $339,000 CAD. We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.
Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.
What You'll Do
Lead and develop the decision scientists and data scientists on the team, and set the quality bar for both disciplines.
Own the MAU driver model and the forecast.
Own the exploratory work that drives the strategy to grow MAU.
Establish how an analysis gets scoped, run, reviewed, and written up, so its quality does not depend on who picked up the request.
Partner with your Revenue counterpart and Data Engineering leadership to define common metrics, align on experimentation standards, and introduce unified operating practices across teams.
Build the operating model that gets the team into the roadmap conversation early, with a view on what to build and what to test.
Use agents and automated analysis daily, and expect the same of the team.
Shape how the team works AI-native: what gets delegated to agents, what gets automated, and what stays human judgment.
What We're Looking For
Required Experience & Qualifications
10+ years in analytics, data science, or decision science, including 5+ years in people management in a senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in inferential and causal analytics. Able to lead ML practitioners.
Expert knowledge of engagement, retention, churn, and cohort metrics.
Experience forecasting a company-level metric and being held to it.
SQL, plus Python or R.
Experience with Databricks, third party experimentation tools (e.g. Statsig), Tableau or similar BI tools, and AI native BI tools (e.g. Hex, AI/BI).
Hands-on with coding agents (Claude Code or equivalent) in your own analytical work.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent.
Nice to Have
Familiarity with experiment design to identify and control for network effects.
Master’s degree or PhD with an emphasis in social science, psychology or other behavioral science.
Experience leading a team that reports to you but sits embedded with product and engineering teams.
Experience in a B2C subscription business.
Core Expectations
You have moved an analytics team from reactive to embedded.
You coach and develop people, and you have grown analysts into leaders.
On your teams, analysis starts from a hypothesis rather than a data request.
You have built the standards a team works from, and got people to use them.
You are curious about why people behave the way they do, not just what they did.
You decide what the team does not work on, and you can defend it.
Our Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns
Learning & Development programs
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.
Life360 Values
Our company's mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference
Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it's hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Our Commitment to Diversity
We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.
We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don't meet 100% of the below qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!
#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Head of Data Engineering
jobs.text:
Role: Head of Data Engineering
Location: We operate a hybrid schedule, meaning 2-3 days a week in the office based at Thorpe Park, Leeds.
Salary: DOE plus extensive benefits
Contract type: Permanent
Employment type: Full time
Working hours: We work on a core hours principle. Our core hours are 09:30 - 16:00; you can work around these to suit you!
Do you want to work for the nation’s largest online pharmacy ensuring excellence for all our patients? We’re a market leader in the pharmacy world, with 25 years’ experience, helping over 1.8 million patients in England manage their NHS prescriptions from request through to delivery. We are Great Place to Work certified as we consider colleague experience a top priority every day, and as a certified B Corp we also meet high standards of social and environmental responsibility. Our people are fundamental to our success and ensuring we achieve our vision to be a world leading, patient-centric digital healthcare provider. We are committed to continuing to develop a positive, open and honest working environment for all.
As Head of Data Engineering, you will lead and shape Pharmacy2U’s data engineering capability, ensuring data is seamlessly ingested, transformed, and managed within Microsoft Fabric to deliver trusted, business-ready insights. Working at the heart of a major transformation programme, you will provide strategic and technical leadership across data platforms, guiding engineering decisions, championing best practice, and ensuring the delivery of measurable commercial value.
Leading a team of Data Engineers and specialist delivery partners, you will collaborate closely with senior stakeholders across technology, data, marketing, and architecture to develop a scalable, future-focused data engineering function. Acting as the bridge between business priorities and technical delivery, you will drive the successful migration to Microsoft Fabric while establishing the vision, standards, and capabilities needed to support long-term growth and innovation.
Our tech teams keep us running 24/7 to make sure all our patients get world class service. To support that, this role may include participation in an out-of-hours rota as required by the business. We operate fair scheduling process as well as additional compensation for all on call periods.
Why you’ll love working with us
We believe great people deserve great support. That’s why we offer a benefits package designed to look after your health, finances, career and life outside work.
Financial security & rewards
· Competitive contributory pension
· Occupational sick pay
· Long-service awards and refer-a-friend bonuses
· Professional registration fees covered (GPhC, NMC, CIPD and more)
· Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (subject to eligibility)
Family-friendly
· Enhanced maternity and paternity pay
· Flexible hybrid working to help balance work and home life
Health & wellbeing
· Private healthcare insurance at discounted rates (Aviva)
· Employee Assistance Programme and in-house mental health support
· Access to discounted gym memberships via Blue Light Card and benefits schemes
· Regular health and wellbeing initiatives
Career growth
· Strong commitment to CPD, training and professional development
Time off & flexibility
· 25 days’ annual leave, increasing with service
· Buy and sell holiday scheme
Everyday perks & exclusive discounts
· Blue Light Card and employee discount platform
· Exclusive discounts at The Springs, Leeds
· 25% off health & beauty purchases
· 25% off Pharmacy2U Private Online Doctor services
Culture & community
· Regular social events throughout the year
What you’ll be doing?
· Lead the delivery, performance, and continuous improvement of Pharmacy2U’s Microsoft Fabric platform, ensuring it remains scalable, secure, cost-effective, and aligned with business objectives.
· Oversee data ingestion, transformation, lakehouse architecture, data pipelines, engineering standards, CI/CD processes, platform observability, and overall performance.
· Drive the successful completion of the Microsoft Fabric migration, including the transition of legacy data platforms, reporting solutions, and data pipelines.
· Develop and maintain high-quality data products that support analytics, operational systems, and external data consumers, with accountability for technical delivery, service levels, and production support.
· Translate business priorities into a clear and actionable data engineering roadmap, delivering value at pace while proactively managing risks, dependencies, and obstacles.
· Establish and promote best practices across data modelling, testing, automation, DataOps, platform monitoring, and service management.
· Build and evolve a sustainable operating model that supports long-term platform ownership, reliability, governance, and continuous improvement.
· Provide leadership, coaching, and development opportunities for the Data Engineering team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
· Collaborate closely with Data & Analytics, Architecture, Data Governance, and wider business stakeholders to deliver data solutions aligned with organisational goals and architectural standards.
· Manage and guide third-party delivery partners, ensuring the delivery of high-quality outcomes, adherence to agreed standards, and effective knowledge transfer to internal teams.
· Ensure data platform services operate in compliance with regulatory, governance, and security requirements, including UK GDPR, NHS DSPT, information security standards, and data governance policies.
· Support the implementation of Microsoft Purview and champion strong data management practices, including data cataloguing, lineage, classification, and quality management.
Who are we looking for?
· Proven experience leading and developing high-performing Data Engineering teams.
· Experience delivering data platform migration or modernisation programmes, ideally using lakehouse or medallion architectures.
· Strong background operating data platforms in production environments, including CI/CD, monitoring, support, and engineering standards.
· Experience handling sensitive data in line with UK GDPR and governance requirements.
· Strong SQL, data modelling, and Python/PySpark skills.
· Expertise in Microsoft Fabric or a strong Azure data background, including Synapse, Data Factory, and Databricks.
· Commercially minded, with the ability to translate data engineering initiatives into measurable business value.
· Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the confidence to influence, challenge constructively, and drive decisions.
· Experience managing third-party suppliers and delivery partners alongside internal teams.
· Strategic and forward-thinking, with a focus on delivering practical business outcomes.
· Collaborative and relationship-focused, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
· Passionate about developing people and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning.
· Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
· Quality-driven, with a commitment to excellence, innovation, and operational effectiveness.
What happens next?
Please click apply and if we think you are a good match, we will be in touch to arrange an interview.
Applicants must prove they have the right to live in the UK.
All successful applicants will be required to undergo a DBS check.
Unsolicited agency applications will be treated as a gift.
#LI-OW1
