jobs.title: Director, Growth Engineering
jobs.text:
About the role
Growth is how millions of people find Chime, set up direct deposit, transact every day, unlock all the features and benefits Chime offers, and keep coming back. The Growth Platform is the engine behind it: Web, Paid, Notifications, Incentives, Targeting, Experimentation and Personalization, all used by every Growth team at Chime. We're looking for a Director to lead this org and build what comes next, a platform where AI and ML decide what each member sees, when, and on which channel, and where AI agents design, run and learn from experiments on their own, so Chime learns faster every week. If you've built growth platforms at scale and want to define how they power Chime's hypergrowth in 2027 and beyond, we'd love to talk.
In this role, you can expect to
Lead the Growth Platform org, a team of tech lead managers (TLMs) and senior engineers across Web, Paid, Notifications, Incentives, Targeting, Experimentation and Personalization. You'll report to the VP of Growth Engineering.
Set the multi-year vision and roadmap. Turn seven separate systems into one connected growth platform with shared member data, decisioning and measurement.
Make the platform AI-native and agentic. Put ML and GenAI to work in targeting, bidding, content, incentives and send-time optimization. Invest in agentic flows across the platform, starting with self-learning experiment agents that generate hypotheses, launch and monitor tests, read results, and feed what they learn into the next round. Build in the evaluation, guardrails and human oversight to make this safe.
Help Growth teams ship faster. Make it easy for squads, marketers and partners to launch, target, personalize and measure changes on their own, in days rather than weeks.
Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Data Science/ML and Analytics leaders. You'll co-own the plan, make trade-offs openly, and tie platform bets to the metrics that matter: new direct depositors, retention and acquisition efficiency.
Hire, coach and grow strong tech lead managers who stay hands-on technically while leading their teams. Build an inclusive, high-ownership team people want to join and stay on.
Keep the platforms reliable, cost-efficient and compliant. Work with Risk, Compliance and Privacy so consent, fairness and member trust are built in from day one.
To thrive in this role, you have
10+ years in software engineering, including 5+ years leading teams and at least 2 years leading tech lead managers or other leaders. You know how to help TLMs balance technical ownership with people leadership.
A track record of building growth or marketing platforms that many teams rely on, such as experimentation, targeting, messaging, incentives/rewards, paid attribution or personalization.
Hands-on experience shipping ML-powered systems that make real-time product decisions (ranking, propensity/uplift models, bandits or similar), plus experience building LLM-based agents or agentic workflows in production, with a practical view of how to evaluate, govern and scale them.
Deep experimentation and measurement chops. You know how to prove a lift is real, and how to build platforms that keep tests trustworthy at high volume.
Strong distributed systems and data architecture judgment: real-time event pipelines, feature stores, low-latency decisioning and high-volume messaging.
Clear executive communication and a history of earning buy-in across Product, Marketing and Data Science.
Bonus: experience in fintech or another regulated industry, paid acquisition/mobile measurement, or leading a large platform migration.
#LI-Onsite #LI-AC2

A little about us
At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.
We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.
We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.
We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.
Because if we don't—who will?
*Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.
What we offer for our full-time, regular employees
🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress
We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.
Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.
To learn more about how Chime collects and uses your personal information during the application process, please see the Chime Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Associate Director Engineering - Enterprise Performance Engineering
jobs.text:
Become a part of our caring community
Humana is committed to helping people achieve their best health by delivering innovative technology solutions that power exceptional member and provider experiences.
The Associate Director, Software Engineering (Enterprise Performance Engineering) is a senior technology leader responsible for advancing Humana's enterprise performance engineering capabilities. This role leads a centralized team of performance engineers that provides performance testing, analysis, workload modeling, capacity planning, resilience testing, and performance consulting services across a broad portfolio of business and technology solutions.
This leader will help establish performance engineering as a strategic capability that enables application teams to deliver scalable, resilient, highly available, and high-performing solutions that meet business and customer expectations. The Associate Director combines strong people leadership with deep technical expertise and serves as a key leader in shaping performance engineering standards, tools, methodologies, and best practices.
The position requires significant experience in enterprise application performance testing, cloud performance engineering, observability platforms, AI application performance validation, and modern distributed architectures.
This role partners closely with Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, Quality Engineering, Data Engineering, AI Engineering, and Product teams to ensure systems are designed, tested, monitored, and optimized for performance at scale.
The successful candidate will help drive the evolution from traditional performance testing to a modern performance engineering operating model that embeds scalability, resiliency, observability, and performance excellence throughout the software development lifecycle.
Use your skills to make an impact
Performance Engineering Strategy and Leadership
Lead execution of Humana's enterprise performance engineering strategy, roadmap, and operating model in alignment with broader engineering objectives.
Establish and mature performance engineering standards, methodologies, frameworks, and governance practices.
Lead a centralized performance engineering team supporting multiple business segments and technology portfolios.
Drive adoption of performance engineering best practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
Serve as a trusted advisor for application scalability, reliability, and system performance.
Establish standards for load testing, stress testing, endurance testing, capacity planning, failover validation, and resilience engineering.
Partner with technology leaders to proactively identify and address performance risks and scalability challenges.
Enterprise Performance Testing Services
Lead performance engineering services supporting customer-facing, internal, digital, cloud-native, AI-enabled, and mission-critical applications.
Establish service offerings that support application teams across design, development, testing, deployment, and production readiness.
Define performance test strategies, workload models, and testing approaches for enterprise-scale applications.
Oversee the planning and execution of performance validation activities, including:
performance testing
load testing
stress testing
volume testing
spike testing
endurance testing
scalability testing
capacity testing
reliability testing
disaster recovery performance validation
Ensure performance testing is integrated into Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD delivery pipelines.
Establish repeatable, measurable, and increasingly automated performance validation practices.
Performance Architecture, Analysis, and Optimization
Partner with Architecture and Engineering teams to embed performance considerations into application and platform design.
Lead performance analysis and tuning efforts across complex enterprise applications and platforms.
Conduct root cause analysis of performance issues involving applications, databases, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud services.
Provide recommendations to optimize:
application architecture
database performance
API response times
cloud resource utilization
distributed systems performance
caching strategies
messaging systems
network performance
Guide teams in designing scalable, resilient, and performance-optimized solutions.
Establish performance engineering reviews and architecture assessments for critical initiatives.
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Product, Quality Engineering, SRE, Infrastructure, and Security teams to embed performance engineering into delivery processes.
AI Application and Intelligent Agent Performance Engineering
Establish performance engineering practices for AI-powered applications, Generative AI platforms, and autonomous agents.
Define performance testing methodologies for Large Language Model (LLM) applications and AI workflows.
Lead validation of:
AI model response times
agent execution performance
prompt processing latency
throughput scalability
multi-agent orchestration performance
resource utilization
cost-performance optimization
Develop performance testing frameworks, benchmarks, and validation approaches for AI-enabled solutions.
Performance Engineering Tools and Automation
Lead strategy and adoption for performance testing tools, frameworks, and automation capabilities.
Drive automation of performance testing and performance validation within CI/CD pipelines.
Establish reusable performance testing frameworks, scripts, templates, and accelerators.
Improve testing efficiency through automation, analytics, AI-assisted performance engineering, and continuous performance testing.
Partner with enterprise engineering enablement teams to align performance practices with the broader software delivery toolchain.
Cloud Performance Engineering and Reliability
Lead performance engineering efforts across AWS and Azure cloud environments.
Establish cloud performance testing models supporting microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and containerized platforms.
Collaborate with Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, and SRE teams to optimize cloud resource utilization and application performance.
Support performance validation for enterprise cloud modernization initiatives.
Ensure systems meet enterprise expectations for scalability, availability, resiliency, and reliability.
People Leadership and Team Development
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of performance engineers, architects, and technical specialists.
Set clear priorities, goals, and expectations aligned with business and technology objectives.
Foster a culture of technical excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
Mentor engineers on advanced performance engineering practices, tools, and technologies.
Support workforce planning, succession planning, and career development.
Promote strong collaboration across engineering, platform, and operations organizations.
Use your skills to make an impact
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
10+ years of experience in software engineering, performance engineering, quality engineering, or related disciplines.
3+ years of leadership experience managing engineering or performance engineering teams.
Proven experience leading performance testing engagements for large-scale enterprise applications.
Hands-on experience with enterprise performance testing tools such as:
LoadRunner Enterprise
BlazeMeter
Apache JMeter
Performance Center
Strong expertise in performance analysis, capacity planning, workload modeling, and application tuning.
Experience optimizing performance across:
web applications
APIs
microservices
distributed systems
cloud-native platforms
databases
Strong understanding of Java, REST APIs, cloud-native applications, and enterprise architecture patterns.
Hands-on experience with performance monitoring and observability platforms such as:
Datadog
Splunk
Dynatrace
New Relic
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, partner across organizations, and remain hands-on in technical problem solving.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in healthcare, insurance, financial services, or other highly regulated industries.
Experience testing Generative AI applications, AI platforms, intelligent agents, and LLM-based solutions.
Experience with AWS and Azure cloud architectures.
Knowledge of Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, Terraform, and Site Reliability Engineering practices.
Familiarity with chaos engineering, resilience testing, and fault injection techniques.
Experience helping establish or mature enterprise-wide performance engineering practices or centers of excellence.
Experience supporting digital transformation and cloud modernization initiatives.
Relevant certifications in cloud, performance engineering, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering.
Work at Home Requirements: To ensure Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees’ ability to work effectively, the self-provided internet service of Home or Hybrid Home/Office employees must meet the following criteria: At minimum, a download speed of 25 Mbps and an upload speed of 10 Mbps is required; wireless, wired cable or DSL connection is suggested. In certain roles, the minimum recommended internet speed required by Humana may not be sufficient for business needs. Humana reserves the right to require associates to upgrade their internet service if necessary. Work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information.Travel: While this is a remote position, occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.
Scheduled Weekly Hours
40
Pay Range
The compensation range below reflects a good faith estimate of starting base pay for full time (40 hours per week) employment at the time of posting. The pay range may be higher or lower based on geographic location and individual pay will vary based on demonstrated job related skills, knowledge, experience, education, certifications, etc.$142,300 - $195,700 per yearThis job is eligible for a bonus incentive plan. This incentive opportunity is based upon company and/or individual performance.
Description of Benefits
Humana, Inc. and its affiliated subsidiaries (collectively, “Humana”) offers competitive benefits that support whole-person well-being. Associate benefits are designed to encourage personal wellness and smart healthcare decisions for you and your family while also knowing your life extends outside of work. Among our benefits, Humana provides medical, dental and vision benefits, 401(k) retirement savings plan, time off (including paid time off, company and personal holidays, paid parental and caregiver leave), short-term and long-term disability, life insurance and many other opportunities.
About us
About Humana: Humana Inc. (NYSE: HUM) is a leading U.S. healthcare company. Through our Humana insurance services and our CenterWell healthcare services, we make it easier for the millions of people we serve to achieve their best health – delivering the care and service they need, when they need it. These efforts are leading to a better quality of life for people with Medicare and Medicaid, families, individuals, military service personnel, and communities at large. Learn more about what we offer at Humana.com and at CenterWell.com.

This policy shall apply to all employment actions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, upgrading, promotion, transfer, demotion, layoff, recall, termination, rates of pay or other forms of compensation and selection for training, including apprenticeship, at all levels of employment.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (Data & Artificial Intelligence)
jobs.text:
The Senior Director, Product Management (Data & AI) is responsible for defining, driving, and delivering Fortrea's enterprise Data & AI product strategy, product portfolio, and multi-year product roadmap. This role serves as the senior product leader for Data & AI, accountable for ensuring that enterprise data products, analytics products, AI solutions, and emerging digital capabilities align with Fortrea's strategic objectives and long-term technology vision. The position owns the end-to-end product lifecycle, including product vision, roadmap development, investment prioritization, delivery oversight, adoption, value realization, and continuous improvement.
The Senior Director, Product Management will lead a team of Product Managers and work closely with Engineering, Data, AI, Enterprise Architecture, Business Stakeholders, Program Management, Security, and Operations teams to ensure products are delivered successfully and produce measurable business outcomes. As a member of the Data & AI leadership team, this role is accountable for translating Fortrea's three-year Data & AI strategy into an executable and measurable product portfolio that delivers enterprise value, operational efficiency, innovation, and competitive advantage.
Summary of Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Vision
Develop and maintain the enterprise Data & AI product strategy aligned to Fortrea's business objectives and three-year technology roadmap.
Establish a clear product vision for enterprise data, analytics, artificial intelligence, automation, and emerging digital capabilities.
Define and maintain multi-year product roadmaps that balance business priorities, technical investments, innovation opportunities, and organizational capacity.
Partner with executive stakeholders to identify future product opportunities and strategic business needs.
Translate enterprise strategy into actionable product objectives, priorities, and measurable outcomes.
Drive product innovation and identify opportunities to maximize the value of enterprise data and AI investments.
Data & AI Product Portfolio Leadership
Own the enterprise Data & AI product portfolio, including product lifecycle management, prioritization, governance, and performance management.
Establish portfolio management processes supporting product intake, evaluation, funding, prioritization, and roadmap planning.
Ensure alignment and integration across data, analytics, AI, reporting, governance, and platform-related products.
Balance short-term business needs with long-term strategic product investments.
Define product success metrics and value realization frameworks across the portfolio.
Continuously evaluate portfolio performance and optimize investment decisions based on business outcomes and strategic priorities.
Product Delivery & Execution
Own successful delivery of enterprise data and AI products from concept through deployment and ongoing enhancement.
Partner with Engineering, Architecture, Data, and Program Management leaders to ensure successful delivery of product roadmaps.
Drive prioritization of product backlogs and delivery plans to maximize business value.
Remove obstacles impacting product execution and serve as an escalation point for strategic product issues.
Ensure products are delivered within approved scope, timelines, budget, and quality expectations.
Oversee adoption, usage, performance, and ongoing evolution of deployed products.
Establish product governance and operating models supporting sustainable delivery and continuous improvement.
Business Partnership & Value Realization
Serve as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and Data & AI delivery teams.
Establish strong relationships with functional leaders to understand business objectives, challenges, and opportunities.
Ensure product investments align with measurable business outcomes and enterprise priorities.
Develop business cases supporting product investments and strategic initiatives.
Lead value realization reviews to demonstrate business impact and return on investment.
Drive customer-centric and business-driven product development practices.
People Leadership
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of Product Managers, Product Owners, and product leadership professionals.
Establish the product management operating model and organizational structure for the Data & AI organization.
Provide coaching, mentoring, performance management, and career development opportunities for team members.
Drive talent acquisition, succession planning, workforce planning, and organizational capability development.
Foster a culture of ownership, innovation, accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
Develop product management capabilities and best practices across the broader Data & AI organization.
Financial & Investment Management
Develop and manage Data & AI product investment plans and strategic funding priorities.
Partner with Finance and Technology leadership on annual budget planning and investment governance.
Evaluate product investment opportunities and prioritize initiatives based on business value, risk, cost, and strategic alignment.
Support build-versus-buy decisions and product investment recommendations.
Monitor product portfolio investment performance and value realization.
Ensure effective stewardship of product-related technology investments.
Stakeholder & Executive Leadership
Serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership regarding Data & AI product strategy, performance, and future investments.
Prepare and deliver executive-level product roadmaps, business reviews, investment recommendations, and performance updates.
Lead product governance forums, roadmap reviews, and strategic planning sessions.
Communicate product strategy and business value across technical and non-technical stakeholder groups.
Partner with Enterprise Architecture, Security, Compliance, Program Management, and Technology leaders to ensure alignment across all product initiatives.
Qualifications (Minimum Required):
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Analytics, or related field.
Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience and successful project outcomes in lieu of educational requirements.
Experience (Minimum Required):
12+ years of progressive leadership experience in Product Management, Technology Leadership, Data & Analytics, Digital Products, or related disciplines.
7+ years of experience leading enterprise product portfolios, product organizations, or large-scale digital transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated success developing and delivering multi-year product strategies and roadmaps.
Experience managing enterprise technology, data, analytics, or AI-related products.
Proven people leadership experience, including hiring, mentoring, developing, and leading Product Managers.
Experience managing investment portfolios, business cases, budgeting, and strategic planning activities.
Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
Preferred Qualifications Include:
Master's Degree in Business Administration, Technology Management, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, or related discipline.
Experience leading Data, Analytics, AI, Machine Learning, Digital, or Platform Product organizations.
Familiarity with Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform, AI platforms, and enterprise analytics environments.
Experience operating within life sciences, healthcare, CRO, or other regulated industries.
Product Management certifications or Agile Product Management experience preferred.
Physical Demands / Work Environment:
Office/Home-Based:
Work Environment:
Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.
Physical Requirements:
Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
Light to moderate lifting and carrying, or moving of objects, including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
Regular and consistent attendance.
Varied hours may be required.
#FUTUREOFTECH

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
About Dune
Dune's mission is to make onchain finance observable. We're the industry standard for onchain data: a blockchain data and intelligence provider that institutions, protocols, and analysts trust to understand the onchain world and the frontiers of finance. We deliver structured datasets, spanning stablecoins, RWAs, tokens, lending, trading, and more, from 130+ chains and counting, to 1,000+ industry leaders including Visa, WisdomTree, FINRA, the IMF, Bloomberg, Standard Chartered, Coinbase, Forbes, and the Financial Times.
We're a tight knit team of ~50 hard working people, spread across Europe and eastern US timezones ️, having an outsized impact on the industry. We take pride in being ambitious and doing world class work while staying humble and lighthearted. We believe in building open, verifiable data that lets individuals and institutions do deep research into ecosystems like Ethereum, Solana, Robinhood and many more.
We're backed by some of the world's best investors. In February 2022, we announced our Series B funding round led by Coatue and Union Square Ventures, an important milestone that let us double down on our mission.
If you like being challenged and want to work together with a brilliant team on an important mission, come join us.
Learn more about us:
About Dune
https://dune.com/about
Values and working at Dune
https://dune.com/careers
About the role
Dune’s mission is to make onchain finance observable. Since 2018, we have made blockchain data accessible and useful. Our next opportunity is to build products that financial institutions depend on to commit capital, assess risk, and enter new onchain markets.
As these institutions expand their activity on blockchains, they will need reliable, trustworthy and timely data to power decision making across more markets than ever before. They will need to compare opportunities, monitor changes, and integrate data into their existing systems. For Dune these recurring needs will become a substantial and core part of our business.
We are looking for a Head of Product to help transition Dune into this new era. We will build on top of Dune’s existing data foundation, which already powers thousands of companies. You will decide which customers and use cases to serve first, which problems matter most, and which needs can become scalable products for institutional usage.
You will identify valuable customer problems and guide the company to deliver a reliable product and grow its usage.
What we are looking for
You care about markets and have a background in either traditional or onchain markets. You navigate fluently financial jargon and know how market participants use and leverage data.
You can set a clear direction, make difficult choices, and work hard through the details required to deliver. The job’s not finished with a PRD, a hire or a ticket. The job’s finished when the product is creating value in the hands of our customers, being recursively improved by tight knit relationships.
You will work closely with Dune’s engineering, data, and commercial teams while being an integral part of the leadership team. You will report to the president. Your responsibility extends from understanding a customer’s problem to delivering a product that solves it, while navigating the requirements from a large customer base.
You should be equally comfortable discussing an institution’s data requirements and deciding what the team must deliver this week.
In this role you will
Define the product strategy for market data and institutional customers. Decide which customers, problems, and products deserve our attention.
Own the product experience from data creation to delivery. Set clear requirements for coverage, accuracy, consistency, and timeliness.
Understand how financial institutions consume data. Turn their research, investment, trading, and operational needs into clear product priorities.
Work with engineering and data teams to deliver reliable datasets, data feeds, and integrations that fit customer systems.
Make explicit decisions about scope, quality, and delivery dates. Resolve dependencies and keep important work moving.
Partner with Product Marketing, Sales and other teams on customer evaluations, pricing, and adoption. Convert repeated customer needs into products we can serve at scale.
Define how we measure success of our products. Use the results to decide what to improve or stop.
Define and improve on our operational practices.
Leverage AI to improve our customer research, operations and feedback loops.
Lead and develop a product team that takes responsibility for customer results.
Say no and prioritize.
You might be a great fit if
You're excited to spend real time with customers: on calls, in their offices, learning from them.
You have delivered technically complex data products that customers (ideally institutional) depend on.
You understand market data and how financial institutions evaluate, purchase, integrate, and use it.
You have good knowledge of onchain markets, tokenized equities and RWAs
You can connect customer needs with technical requirements and a sound business case.
You have strong product judgment. You can make decisions with incomplete information and change them when the evidence changes.
You stay close to the work. You investigate problems, challenge assumptions, and help teams resolve difficult details.
You are known to be an excellent communicator.
You have startup experience, ideally a former founder or operator.
Perks & Benefits
A competitive salary and equity package . Both salary and equity is top 25% of companies in the space
Our employee equity scheme has world-class employee-friendly terms with a heavily discounted strike price (~90%) and a 10-year exercise window
5 weeks PTO + local public holidays (that can be swapped to suit you)
A fully remote-first approach ‍ within a distributed team with flexible working hours; you structure your own day
Say goodbye to meeting overload! We believe in a healthy mix of async and sync work, so you can focus on what truly matters—no more wasted time on endless meetings!
Good health is important, so we offer private medical insurance, dental & vision as standard
We believe in paid parental leave to help you celebrate this important milestone, transition to your new life, and bond with your new baby. We offer 16 weeks to primary and 6 weeks to secondary caregivers, fully paid. Plus a 2-week part-time phased return at full pay to help you get used to your new (and slightly more complex!) schedule
Quarterly offsites in various exciting locations as a company or team to connect, work together and have fun (so far in Tuscany Berlin Austria and Athens ).
On top of this each person gets a yearly travel allowance to connect and co-work with someone or a team of people for a few days.
An allowance for your at-home setup, to ensure you are happy, comfortable and productive. If you prefer a local co-working space, we’ll pay for your desk.
An annual allowance for your Learning and Development needs.
Work with some of the best people you’ll ever get to meet!
And of course, you get some awesome Dune swag! ✌️
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Fractional Director of Product Strategy & Design
jobs.text:
Join Us in Building the Future of Human Performance
At Viction, we're not building another health app — we're building a new category of human performance technology.
Our mission is to empower people to better understand themselves and continuously improve every aspect of their health and performance through scientifically grounded insights, intelligent coaching, and beautifully designed technology.
We believe sophisticated health science should feel simple, actionable, and inspiring. By combining biomarkers, wearable technologies, nutrition, recovery, behavioral science, and artificial intelligence into a unified platform, Viction will help individuals make better daily performance-based decisions, ultimately allowing them to realize their full potential.
We're seeking an experienced product leader who is energized by the opportunity to help define an entirely new category of human performance technology. This is a rare opportunity to shape not only a product, but the direction of a company.
The Opportunity
Product Strategy and Design are inseparable at Viction. As our Fractional Director of Product Strategy & Design, you will serve as the steward of our product vision, translating strategy into execution while ensuring every feature contributes to a cohesive, differentiated, and compelling member experience.
This is a founding product leadership opportunity. You'll work directly with our founders, advisory board, UX/UI designers, engineers, AI specialists, and domain experts to determine what we build, why we build it, and how we deliver an experience that members genuinely love.
Key Tasks & Responsibilities
What You'll Own
What problems deserve solving
Which features matter most
Which features should wait
How features reinforce one another
What creates lasting competitive differentiation
What gets built, and why it gets built
Feature priorities, technical and business dependencies, and product sequencing
Release planning
Protection of MVP discipline while guiding long-term platform evolution
Core Responsibilities
Lead product strategy and evolve the long-term product vision
Translate strategy into product roadmaps, epics, user stories, and development plans
Lead product discovery, customer research, and journey mapping
Guide UX/UI direction to create a premium consumer-grade experience
Own the end-to-end member experience across onboarding, AI coaching, scoring, education, engagement, and retention
Partner across engineering, design, AI, clinical, marketing, and leadership teams
Champion a scalable design system and exceptional product quality
Continuously validate assumptions through customer feedback and analytics
Monitor emerging trends in AI, digital health, wearables, and human performance
Education & Experience
Who You Are
An experienced product leader with a passion for building consumer products
Equally comfortable discussing customer psychology, UX, AI, engineering trade-offs, and business strategy
A systems thinker who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys creating clarity
A collaborative leader who inspires teams without relying on formal authority
Someone who believes every feature should have a purpose and every interaction should build trust
Preferred Experience
Consumer mobile applications
Digital health, wellness, or human performance
AI-enabled products
Wearables and connected devices
Subscription platforms
Behavior-change or coaching products
Startup or early-stage company experience
Certifications
Industry related certifications are a plus
Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote, fractional engagement (~20 hours per week)
What Success Looks Like
Build the right product, not simply adding more features
Create a product experience that feels premium, intuitive, and motivating
Translate vision into disciplined execution
Help position Viction as a category leader in human performance
Why Join Viction?
This is an opportunity to influence the direction of a company from its earliest stages. You'll have meaningful experiences, direct access to founders, the ability to shape product strategy and experience, and the satisfaction of helping build technology that can genuinely improve people's lives.
If you're energized by creating products that blend science, design, technology, and human behavior, and want to leave your fingerprint on something extraordinary, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.title: Director of Technology - Quantum
jobs.text:
Digital Catapult is a technology innovation organisation. We accelerate the practical application of deep technologies to equip the UK to be future ready.
We partner with businesses, investors and academia to identify valuable opportunities and create market pathways, ensuring the UK is future ready, supporting economic growth. Digital Catapult helps deep tech businesses grow by showing what is possible, positive and productive with advanced technology including AI, Quantum, Advanced Connectivity Technologies, IoT, Immersive and distributed ledger technologies.
The UK has invested through the National Quantum Technology Programme, and it is a critical moment to support the quantum technologies, innovations and research outcomes to benefit the UK economy through growth of leading companies and adoption across the wider economy. Quantum Technology is a key part of the Digital Catapult Strategy. and a key opportunity for the UK, prioritised within the government Industrial Strategy as one of the Frontier Technologies within the Digital & Technologies sector.
Reporting to the CTO, the Director of Technology Quantum will play a critical role in leading the Quantum and photonics portfolio of work, defining and driving the technology roadmap for Quantum, photonics and related areas, creating and delivering collaborative research, development and technology translation programmes with university and industry partners and innovators. Our focus is on software, application, algorithm, design, architecture and use cases, and not on hardware development.
The role provides an opportunity to both investigate new and emerging quantum technologies with academia and innovators and also experiment with more practical adoption with end users and industry. To both experiment with new capabilities and understand the practical implications and limitations of quantum technology and feed that back to the UK ecosystem, and policy makers.
WHAT YOU'LL DO (Duties)
Be a collaborative and ambitious leader and expert in Quantum and photonics across Digital Catapult.
Direct and enable a high quality programme of research and development in Quantum and photonics, securing funding via R&D projects and supporting commercial opportunities.
Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including innovators, startups and scaleups, government, academic institutions, industry partners, building a productive network in support of our research ambitions and goals. Represent Digital Catapult at industry events, conferences, and public engagements.
Be part of the Technology Research, Development and Innovation leadership team, overseeing the execution and evaluation of activities in programmes, projects and technology exploitation
Lead and mentor a diverse team, coach and guide immediate reports, and the Quantum, photonics and related team members across the wider organisation, building capability in Quantum and photonics
Supervise and deliver horizon scanning, developing the technology roadmap and plans in Quantum, photonics and related areas, supporting other teams to enable their areas to be similarly well defined in relation to Quantum and photonics.

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.text:
About Anovium
Anovium is a technology consultancy that transforms operations through intelligent innovation. We specialize in helping logistics, transportation, and distribution companies modernize their operations while building foundations for future growth. By combining deep industry expertise with technical innovation, we deliver practical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
» Our Approach
We believe in the power of practical innovation. We focus on real results - helping traditional industries embrace modern technology without disrupting what makes them successful. Our approach is rooted in understanding your business first, then applying technology to solve real challenges.
» Our Culture
At Anovium, we're building a team of experts who understand both technology and industry. We value:
- Deep expertise paired with continuous learning
- Practical innovation over theoretical possibilities
- Long-term partnerships built on measurable results
- Balance of technical excellence and human understanding
» Who We're Looking For
We seek professionals who combine technical expertise with industry understanding. The ideal Anovium team member:
- Thrives on transforming complex business challenges into elegant solutions
- Values both technical excellence and practical business outcomes
- Brings a partnership mentality to client relationships
- Has a genuine interest in logistics, transportation, or healthcare technology
- Embraces our philosophy of sophisticated innovation with practical impact
Our team members don't just implement technology – they help traditional industries embrace the future while understanding their foundations. If you're excited about bringing meaningful technological transformation to established industries, we want to talk to you.
Engineering Director
TL/DR: You will report directly to the CTO at a well-funded early-stage startup logistics company. You'll be responsible for executing tasks and company-wide technology initiatives. You will oversee and lead teams that ship amazing products quickly.
The Opportunity
Are you a proactive and highly organized individual capable of taking on a director of engineering role?
Anovium is seeking a Director of Engineering, to assist in executing overarching company goals allowing the Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to focus on strategic initiatives.
The Director of Engineering will be responsible for providing top-level support and streamlining day-to-day engineering management.
What You'll Do
Top-Level Support: prioritize and manage tasks to reduce the day-to-day engineering management burden on the CTO. Efficiently organize and structure information, allowing the CTO to focus on strategic and CTO-level responsibilities.
Engineering Pod Management: facilitate and oversee the management of engineering teams or "pods," ensuring effective collaboration and productivity.
Triaging Issues: assess and categorize engineering and technical issues, ensuring they are addressed promptly and effectively.
Leading Solutions Architecture: provide guidance and support in developing robust solutions architecture, aligning with business goals and technical requirements.
Advocate for Technical Debt and Backlog: represent the engineering team's perspective and requirements in product meetings, ensuring technical considerations are well-voiced and integrated into product decisions.
Requirements
Deep understanding and experience in logistics or related fields.

blocks.text: About Anovium

Anovium is a technology consultancy that transforms operations through intelligent innovation. We specialize in helping logistics, transportation, and distribution companies modernize their operations while building foundations for future growth. By combining deep industry expertise with technical innovation, we deliver practical solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
» Our Approach

We believe in the power of practical innovation. We focus on real results - helping traditional industries embrace modern technology without disrupting what makes them successful. Our approach is rooted in understanding your business first, then applying technology to solve real challenges.
» Our Culture
At Anovium, we're building a team of experts who understand both technology and industry. We value:
- Deep expertise paired with continuous learning
- Practical innovation over theoretical possibilities
- Long-term partnerships built on measurable results
- Balance of technical excellence and human understanding
» Who We're Looking For
We seek professionals who combine technical expertise with industry understanding. The ideal Anovium team member:
- Thrives on transforming complex business challenges into elegant solutions
- Values both technical excellence and practical business outcomes
- Brings a partnership mentality to client relationships
- Has a genuine interest in logistics, transportation, or healthcare technology
- Embraces our philosophy of sophisticated innovation with practical impact

Our team members don't just implement technology – they help traditional industries embrace the future while understanding their foundations. If you're excited about bringing meaningful technological transformation to established industries, we want to talk to you.

jobs.title: Vice President of Technology
jobs.text:
We are the global fitness powerhouse behind F45 Training, FS8, and VAURA Pilates. Spanning over 1,500 locations in more than 55 countries, we are on a mission to redefine the wellness industry by delivering high-energy, results-driven studio experiences to communities worldwide.
At FIT House of Brands, we live our brand. We are a collective of natural team players with big ideas, united by a passion for creating the world’s greatest workouts. Whether we are supporting our massive global franchise network or innovating on the studio floor, our commitment to community is at the core of everything we do. If you’re ready to crush your goals, elevate the member experience, and build a career that moves the world, you’ve found your fit.
As our VP of Technology, you will lead technology, product, engineering, data, and IT/security across all brands and markets. You will set the technology strategy and roadmap while staying close to execution, including architecture and vendor decisions, budget, and delivery of priority initiatives. Your north star is technology that makes franchisees more profitable and members more engaged.
What You’ll Do
Strategy and Leadership
Define and execute the technology, product, data, and IT strategy in alignment with corporate objectives and franchisee success
Own the technology budget (operating and capital) and report on return on investment
Set the company’s AI strategy, governance, and responsible-use standards, and prioritize high-impact uses across corporate, franchisee, and member-facing operations
Advise executive leadership on technology investments, risks, and opportunities
Franchisee Enablement and Scale
Partner with franchise operations and franchisees to turn operational challenges into prioritized technology solutions
Deliver scalable, integrated platforms that standardize workflows, reduce administrative burden, and provide actionable insights
Drive a coherent multi-brand architecture across F45 Training, FS8, and VAURA Pilates, using shared platforms where they create scale
Lead technology onboarding, training, and adoption for new systems and new studio openings
Support international operations, including localization, multi-currency payments, and regional data privacy requirements
Product, Engineering, and Data
Provide strategic direction and executive sponsorship to Engineering and Product leaders, who own day-to-day delivery and product roadmaps
Own the vision for the member digital experience (mobile apps, booking, payments, in-studio technology)
Own data and business intelligence strategy and governance, including a single source of truth for network performance metrics (revenue, membership, lead conversion, retention)
IT, Security, and Risk
Lead the Head of IT and Security and hold executive accountability for cybersecurity, system reliability, disaster recovery, and compliance (including PCI-DSS, GDPR, and CCPA)
Oversee the technology vendor portfolio and major contracts, including build-versus-buy decisions

jobs.title: Head of CMC Data Management
jobs.text:
Join Excelya, where Audacity, Care and Energy define who we are and how we work. We believe in creating ambitious solutions and fostering an inclusive environment where collaboration and individual growth go hand in hand.
This role offers an exciting opportunity to lead and shape the Data Management strategy within a global CMC environment. As Head of CMC Data Management, you will drive data governance, lead a team of Data Managers, and prepare CMC data foundations to support future Data Science and Artificial Intelligence initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Define and lead the CMC Data Management roadmap.
Establish and maintain Data Governance frameworks, standards, and processes.
Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Managers.
Define and manage data standards, reference data, and master data practices.
Ensure data quality, consistency, reliability, and compliance across CMC activities.
Oversee the Data Lifecycle Management process.
Prepare and structure data to enable future Data Science and AI use cases.
Collaborate closely with CMC, R&D, Data, Digital, and IT teams.
Drive Data Transformation initiatives and promote a data-driven culture.
Support strategic projects related to data management, governance, and digital transformation.
Requirements
Master's degree in Engineering, Data, Life Sciences, Computer Science, or a related field.
Strong experience in Data Management.
Strong experience in Data Governance, Data Quality, and Data Lifecycle Management.
Proven experience managing and developing teams.
Experience within the pharmaceutical industry, ideally in a CMC environment.
Knowledge of Master Data Management (MDM), data standards, and information governance.
Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Fluent English (written and spoken).
Benefits
Why join us?
At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare.
Here's what makes us unique:
We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience.
Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey.
Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission.

jobs.title: Chief Technology and Product Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.
ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.
Profile Overview
We recently acquired Traject Data, home of SerpWow and Rainforest API, and now run an end-to-end data pipeline: from proxy and scraping infrastructure through to structured, ready-to-use data APIs. The next chapter is turning that into one coherent, AI-native platform and we're looking for a CTPO to lead the combined 25-person product and engineering org through it. You'll report directly to the CEO, sit at the leadership table, and be the person who understands the stack down to the proxy layer while also setting where the product goes next.
Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:
Get hands-on with the heart of the product: proxy dynamics and anti-bot evasion, working directly with our Head of Ops to optimise vendor relationships and build up capacity.
Build real fluency in the product and the backend so you can operate as a genuine technical sparring partner to the CEO, not just receive direction.
Start bringing the ScraperAPI and Traject Data infrastructure together on a coherent technical roadmap
Your responsibilities
Own end-to-end product and technology strategy across our scraping infrastructure, proxy networks, and structured data API products (ScraperAPI, SerpWow, Rainforest API).
Lead, scale, and develop a 25+ person product and engineering organisation spanning multiple countries and time zones, building the management structure it needs as it grows.
Set technical architecture direction for high-scale, high-reliability infrastructure, including proxy management, anti-bot evasion, and large-scale scraping systems.
Drive AI and modern ML tooling into both the product itself and how the team builds and ships it.
Define and execute one product roadmap across the merged ScraperAPI and Traject Data lines.
Represent product and technology to the board, and work closely with the CEO and commercial leadership to keep product direction and business strategy aligned.
Stay close enough to the code and infrastructure to go in and troubleshoot, fix, or challenge a technical decision yourself when it matters.
What You bring to the table
Experience leading product and/or engineering at a highly technical company (CTO, CPO, VP Engineering or similar), at a 25+ person org or larger
Real hands-on depth in web scraping, proxies, or closely adjacent infrastructure. You understand the operational reality of this space and you don't rattle when a source breaks overnight and it's suddenly all hands on deck
A genuine track record with AI/ML, both shaping AI-powered product capability and pushing AI-native ways of working through an engineering team
Experience owning product vision and technical architecture together, not just one side of that line
Comfort operating at board level: a clear communicator who can hold their own with an ambitious, hands-on CEO and knows when to push back
Bonus: experience integrating product lines after a merger or acquisition
What’s in it for You
Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.
ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.
What is saas.group?
Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.
Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.
We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.
Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!
—
saas.group is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply.
We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

jobs.title: Client Director - UK and Europe Airline Industry  - Digital and Data Services
jobs.text:
We are seeking to expand our Go-To-Market team in RCTT (short for Retail, Consumer, Travel and Transportation) in Europe with a special focus on the Retail sector in the UK&I.
Specifically, we are looking for a leader who is experienced with selling and delivering digital transformations encompassing our core offerings of Customer Experience, Product Innovation, Enterprise Platform Modernization, Data Modernization, AI Readiness, Engineering Excellence and Digital Application and Maintenance Operations (DAMO).
You will be inheriting one large portfolio in the Retail space based on which you will grow the existing account, and acquire new accounts based on your network, your industry expertise and our marketing activities and in close collaboration with your account team, our industry and service line specialists and the RCTT market organization.
As a Client Principals, you are responsible for the entire sales cycle (lead generation through proposal, contract negotiation and closure) as well as client relationship management, account strategy and planning, joint delivery governance and project reviews.
This includes e.g.
● Understand the industry context, the customer problem and define mutual value ● Develop and execute on key account plans and overall go-to-market
● Acquire and nurture senior client relationships on strategic accounts
● Achieve established revenue and profitability targets
● Work closely with the account leadership team (consisting e.g. of the account tech director and account delivery director)
● Actively participate in the go-to-market plan creation/refinement for your account as well as for the industry vertical (RCTT), and
● Report account activity, opportunity status and other details to the RCTT leadership (portfolio director)
Job responsibilities
Establish, build, and maintain long-term, value-based relationships with a growing number of senior client stakeholders.
Farm and manage between one and three accounts at a time (including 1-2 prospect accounts).
Drive $20 million to $50 million in revenue per year from accounts to meet or exceed profitability targets.
Ensure the creation and execution of existing account strategies, and build “win-win” value propositions at the company and individual levels.
Help develop a range of IP and best practices around client and portfolio development in order to build the client base into a significant strategic asset.
Approach client executives as true business partners versus software delivery partners, expanding the company’s breadth and depth to its full potential.
Work on continuous margin improvement in sold and delivered margin.
Job qualifications
Technical Skills
A deep understanding of the retail (and ideally also the consumer goods) industry, familiarity with the main industry trends and drivers as well as relevant players (e.g. eco-system partners).
A strong network in the industry.
Experience working in many different executive revenue-generating roles requiring strong business acumen.
Success managing and developing sophisticated senior client relationships and strategic business partnerships across the C-suite.
Experience contributing to a clients’ business using a highly consultative and solution-oriented approach.
Ability to drive thought leadership and innovation experience for clients.
Ability to influence decisions by bringing in relevant industry trends and client stories on innovation and digital disruption.
Experience in agile (custom) software development project delivery with the ability to understand the momentum of technical projects and the challenges a highly technical team will face in project execution.
Professional Skills
A strategic thinker, with the ability to translate concepts and ideas into practical and tactical action and the skills to create value propositions for clients.
A goal-oriented self-starter, with strong consultative instincts and skills who quickly and easily establishes rapport and credibility.
Comfortable seeking out and interfacing with external constituents, and has the personal and social attributes to create and then manage effective long-lasting relationships.
Skilled at negotiation and working in an ecosystem with external partners.
Must be able to craft visions and adopt progressive points of view regarding the future, and rally people around the agendas that drive change.
Thinks strategically, but also is highly skilled at execution in a complex environment with multiple stakeholders.
A leader who inspires and grows a team who understands what it means to “put the team over self” .
The ability to lead and motivate account and software development teams with creativity,imagination, energy, and enthusiasm.
Important things to know
Projects are almost exclusively on customer site, so candidates should be flexible and open to travel.
Not quite ready to apply? Or maybe this isn’t the right role for you? That’s OK, you can stay in touch with our digital leaders by joining Perspectives, our network for business insights in technology

jobs.text:
Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI
Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI · Director level · London preferred
We are looking for a Director-level Market Lead to head our Data & AI practice in the UK & Ireland. This is a hybrid leadership role. You combine deep technical solutioning with real commercial skill, and you are credible both in an architecture debate and across the table from a CDO, CIO or CFO.
Our delivery model is shifting from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first pods working against a business outcome. As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. We are developing these ways of working together.
Main focus and responsibilities:
Commercial and solutioning
Drive commercial success on complex Data & AI deals across UKI, from shaping the opportunity through to a signed deal. This includes structuring fixed-price and outcome-linked commercial models, and understanding delivery cost, margin and risk.
Partner with tech advisory and industry domain leads from pre-sale through delivery, so the commercial story, the architecture and the sector insight reinforce one another.
Frame and test business-outcome hypotheses with executives, and define thin slices of delivery that prove value quickly.
You stay close enough to delivery to know what is realistic, and you share accountability for outcomes on the deals you sell.
Practice leadership
Spearhead growth of the UKI Data & AI practice: build, lead, scale and mentor a high-performing team.
Work with delivery and talent leads to match demand with capacity, so the right people and pods are available when deals land. Keep specialist skills sourced and bench waste low.
Shift the practice's capability mix towards production AI engineering and agentic delivery, through hiring, reskilling and role-based onboarding.
Client engagement
Manage executive-level relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CISOs and other CXOs. Act as a sparring partner on AI strategy: challenge assumptions, size the opportunity, and help clients decide where agentic automation and AI can move the P&L.
Build and manage robust sales pipelines and lead strategic client workshops.
Advise clients on responsible AI, covering risk, governance and regulatory expectations in the UK and wider markets.
Expected to lead and drive P&L with TCV of 50 -75 M GBP and ACV of 45-50 M GBP/
Expected experience and capabilities in driving all P&L criterias including sales, margin, utilization, bench management, training, learning, partnership based sales etc.
Ideal candidate profile
The successful candidate is a true dual-threat practitioner, equally at home in a complex architecture discussion and in closing a large commercial deal.
Criterion
Requirement
Experience
Significant senior experience in data and AI consulting, typically 15+ years, with a track record in leadership roles. You are neither a pure solution architect nor a pure sales profile.
Commercial track record
History of selling multiple large-scale data and AI deals, ideally including recent GenAI or agentic engagements, and able to discuss deal shape, pricing structure, trade-offs and delivery and business value delivery in concrete terms.
Technical expertise
Strong solutioning background in complex ecosystems: data platforms and data products, data governance, and AI systems in production, including agentic and LLM-based systems. You understand failure modes, evaluation, cost and risk, not just architecture diagrams.
Data/AI balance
Roughly 70/30, with demonstrable recent depth in AI (last 2–4 years), for example AI agents, AI advisory or AI foundations with large UK clients. Data depth is the foundation, but hand on AI credibility is required.
Tech stack
Strong cloud proficiency in at least one major platform (GCP, AWS or Azure). Snowflake or Databricks experience is a strong plus. Familiarity with the AI tooling and model platforms available on those clouds is expected. Experience on NVIDIA and other modern tech stacks will be great addition.
Commercial acumen
Comfortable with P&L, business cases and ROI conversations, and able to negotiate with CFO-level stakeholders.
Leadership
Experience leading and scaling teams of this size, in a matrix, through change.
Location and travel
UK-wide remit. London-based candidates (or within about a two-hour commute) are preferred, with 1–2 days a week in the London office for collaboration and leadership visibility.
Weekly once or twice travel to customer location in UKI.
Soft skills and cultural fit
You bring drive and resilience, and you build momentum in a fast-changing environment.
Executive presence: exceptional communication, with real C-level exposure and comfort presenting and negotiating with CDOs and CXOs.
Facilitation of strategic workshops and consultative client conversations.
Comfort leading through ambiguity while the delivery model and competency frameworks are still maturing.
A coaching mindset: you grow other leaders and raise AI fluency across the team.

But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture.
This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow.

jobs.title: Product Director - Billing & Payments
jobs.text:
Job title: Product Director - Energy Retail (Billing & Payments)
Location: London OR Bristol (Hybrid working model)
Salary: £150,000 - £190,000
Team: Billing & Payments
Reporting To: VP Product
This role is based in London or Bristol and requires existing right to work in the UK. At this time, we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. We are committed to building a diverse, global team and our sponsorship policy is evaluated on a role-by-role basis. We encourage you to keep an eye on our careers site to stay informed about future opportunities where we are able to offer visa sponsorship.
Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.
Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.
With teams across Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.
As Product Director for Billing & Payments, you will own the strategic heart of Kaluza's Energy Intelligence Platform — the meter-to-cash capabilities that drive revenue, compliance, and customer trust for energy retailers around the world. Reporting directly to the VP of Product, you will lead a team of Product Managers and Business Analysts, shape product architecture, and represent Kaluza's billing and payments capabilities to prospective clients and senior stakeholders globally. This is a role of genuine consequence: your decisions will influence the operations of some of the world's most ambitious energy companies, and the millions of end consumers who depend on accurate, transparent billing.
Define and champion a clear, ambitious product vision for the Billing & Payments domain — technically feasible, commercially compelling, and aligned with Kaluza's global platform strategy.
Lead the definition of product functional architecture in close partnership with Engineering leadership, ensuring billing and payments modules are scalable, compliant, and built to last across multiple geographies and regulatory frameworks.
Drive the full product delivery lifecycle, implementing ways of working that remove blockers, accelerate throughput, and empower cross-functional teams to ship high-quality outcomes at pace.
Collaborate deeply with Engineering, Architecture, Finance, Pre-Sales, and Commercial teams to align priorities and turn complex domain challenges into elegant product solutions.
Represent Kaluza's billing and payments capability externally — engaging prospective clients, participating in commercial conversations, and building confidence in our platform's ability to deliver at scale.
Coach, develop, and inspire a team of Product Managers and Business Analysts, actively growing the next generation of product leaders within Kaluza.
Contribute as a key voice in Kaluza's senior product leadership community, helping to shape how the entire Product organisation operates and evolves.
About You
Ideally you'll have/be:
Significant experience in senior product leadership — ideally at Director level or equivalent — with a track record of owning complex, commercially critical product domains end-to-end.
Deep expertise in billing, payments, or meter-to-cash processes within the energy, utilities, or a similarly regulated industry, with a confident grasp of compliance requirements and operational complexity.
Proven ability to define and execute product strategy across multiple geographies and regulatory environments, balancing global platform thinking with local market needs.
Strong experience leading and developing high-performing product teams, with a genuine commitment to people leadership and building capability over time.
Demonstrated ability to influence and engage senior stakeholders — including C-suite, Engineering leadership, and external clients — with clarity, credibility, and commercial acumen.
Experience working at the intersection of product and architecture, with the confidence to engage meaningfully in high-level solution design conversations with Engineering counterparts.
What will set you apart:
Hands-on experience with AI-driven or data-intensive platforms, and an understanding of how machine learning or real-time decision-making can be applied to billing, pricing, or payments challenges.
Prior exposure to SaaS or platform business models — particularly in an energy retail or utilities context — where you have navigated the balance between partner customisation and scalable platform design.
A network within the global energy sector and experience representing product capability in commercial or pre-sales settings with enterprise clients.
Kaluza Values
Here at Kaluza we have five core values that guide us as a business:
Play to win, Solve the real problem, Build trust every day, Own the outcome, Go further together
From us you’ll get
● Pension Scheme
● Discretionary Bonus Scheme
● Private Medical Insurance + Virtual GP
● Life Assurance
● Access to Furthr - a Climate Action app
● Free Mortgage Advice and Eye Tests
● Perks at Work - access to thousands of retail discounts
● 5% Flex Fund to spend on the benefits you want most
● 26 days holiday
● Flexible bank holidays, giving you an additional 8 days which you can choose to take whenever you like
● Progressive leave policies with no qualifying service periods, including 26 weeks full pay if you have a new addition to your family
● Dedicated personal learning and home office budgets
● And more…
We want the best people
We’re keen to meet people from all walks of life — our view is that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We want to build teams which represent a variety of experiences, perspectives and skills, and we recognise talent on the basis of merit and potential.
We understand some people may not apply for jobs unless they tick every box. But if you're excited about joining us and think you have some of what we're looking for, even if you're not 100% sure, we'd still love to hear from you.
Find out more about working at Kaluza on our careers page and LinkedIn.
You can also find our Applicant Data Protection Policy here.
