jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
StrideUp is leading a new era of values-driven finance. Ranked the 5th fastest growing fintech in the UK and Ireland in 2025, we have already deployed hundreds of millions in property finance, supporting people in achieving their financial goals.
What makes us different is how we combine purpose with performance. We began with home finance, creating an alternative trusted by the Muslim community and welcomed by anyone seeking fairer, more transparent products. This product-market fit has powered our growth, and is only the beginning. Our vision is bigger; to expand our offering and build a financial institution that opens doors for communities often left behind.
Joining StrideUp means being part of a high-performing, values-driven team at the most exciting point in our journey. We have proven success behind us and huge opportunity ahead, and now we are ready to build beyond. Are you?
StrideUp is backed by leading VC and private equity investors, having raised over £40m in corporate funding, and over £600m in institutional funding lines.
The Role
We are looking for a Head of Engineering to lead StrideUp’s engineering function as we enter our next phase of growth. You will be our most senior technology leader, reporting to the CEO and sitting on the Executive Committee (ExCo).
This is a technical leadership role. You will lead and coach our engineers, own technical strategy, and stay close to the detail: architecture and design, engineering standards and best practices, tooling choices and code review. Above all, you will treat technology as a tool for solving business problems, keeping the team focused on what moves the business forward.
You will also own IT, cyber and information security, and represent technology to stakeholders including investors and regulators. These responsibilities may be reallocated over time as we scale.
You will champion smarter use of AI and automation to raise quality and speed, rather than simply adding headcount, and work closely with our Product Manager and Product Team.
What You'll Do
Engineering Ownership
Own platform architecture and strategic technical decisions, including build vs buy and technical debt
Set and uphold standards for code quality, testing and QA, CI/CD and incident management
Review code and designs, and choose the tools, patterns and best practices the team works to
Team Leadership
Line manage and coach our engineers, with regular 1:1s, clear objectives and a visible path for growth
Set the team structure and operating model, and lead hiring and retention as we scale
Develop future technical leaders, so the function does not depend on one person
Business Alignment & Delivery
Start with the business problem, and work with the CEO and Product Manager to turn commercial objectives into deliverable plans
Own the budget and annual OKRs, and deliver predictably so technology drives growth
Champion AI, automation and agentic tooling where they clearly raise quality and speed
Technology, Security & Risk
Own IT infrastructure, workplace technology, cybersecurity and information security, including vendors
Own technology risk, working with Compliance & Risk to meet regulatory obligations
ExCo Leadership
Sit on ExCo and contribute to company-wide strategy beyond technology
Explain technical decisions in plain language, linked to commercial outcomes
Be the senior voice on technology with senior stakeholders including investors, funders, auditors and regulators, including technical due diligence for fundraising
You Are
An exceptional engineer: you set a high technical bar through architecture, design, tooling choices and code review
A leader and coach who develops engineers and gets the best out of them
Commercially minded: you start with the business problem and treat engineering as the tool to solve it
An ExCo-level operator who can present ideas and explain trade-offs without jargon
Pragmatic and accountable: you make sound decisions under uncertainty, own outcomes and never compromise on security or compliance
Open to challenge and feedback, and comfortable building structure in a scale-up

jobs.title: Director, Data Solutions & Engineering
jobs.text:
Must be located and authorized to work in the US
Role Overview
Statara is seeking a Data Solutions & Engineering leader to guide the design and evolution of client-facing data and analytics solutions while serving as the department head for Data Products & Engineering. This dual mandate combines solution architecture with organizational leadership, bridging business needs with Statara’s Data, Insights, and Activation capabilities.
As department head, this person will assume direct leadership of the Data Products & Engineering team—setting technical direction, managing priorities, and ensuring the reliability and continued evolution of Statara’s core data infrastructure, with particular emphasis on Snowflake and modern cloud data architecture.
On the solutions side, this role partners closely with Business Development, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to shape scalable solution approaches, support pre-sales technical strategy, and help ensure complex opportunities are well-defined and feasible.
This role is ideal for a strong technologist with leadership instincts—someone who can own a technical function, contribute meaningfully to client conversations, and bring structure to how Statara designs and delivers solutions. You don’t need to have done all of this before, but you should be ready to grow into the full scope.
Key Responsibilities
Department Leadership: Data Products & Engineering
Serve as the head of the Data Products & Engineering department, setting vision, priorities, and technical direction
Lead, manage, and develop team members, including coaching, mentorship, performance oversight, and capacity planning
Own the operational health of Statara’s data infrastructure, including pipeline reliability, platform stability, and data product quality
Drive continued evolution of Snowflake-based architecture and modern data workflows across the organization
Align engineering and data product priorities with commercial objectives and the broader product roadmap
Solution Architecture & Strategy
Lead the technical shaping of client solutions, from initial concept or test through high-level design and delivery planning
Translate business objectives into clear data, analytics, and activation approaches that align with Statara’s capabilities
Serve as a key technical voice on complex or novel solution designs
Identify opportunities to standardize and scale solutions across clients and use cases
Client & Pre-Sales Support
Partner with Business Development to scope opportunities, clarify technical requirements, and assess feasibility
Participate in client conversations as a technical resource, translating capabilities into clear business value
Support the development of technical demonstrations, solution walkthroughs, and related materials for key opportunities
Feasibility & Validation
Guide data and analytical validation efforts to confirm solution viability, scalability, and expected outcomes
Review data structures, assumptions, and analytical outputs to ensure technical soundness
Support proof points (e.g., pilots, prototypes, demonstrations) where they strengthen solution confidence
Cross-Functional Alignment
Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Engineering to align solution designs with platform capabilities and delivery realities
Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early to maintain momentum and clarity
Bridge commercial intent and technical execution across teams
What Success Looks Like
The Data Products & Engineering team operates with clear direction, strong execution, and alignment to company priorities
Snowflake-based data infrastructure is reliable, well-maintained, and evolving to meet growing demands
Client opportunities are scoped accurately and efficiently, with strong technical grounding
Technical solutions are feasible, scalable, and clearly aligned to business value
Cross-functional teams are aligned on requirements, risks, and delivery plans
The solutions function becomes more repeatable, effective, and scalable over time
Requirements
We’re looking for demonstrated technical depth and sound judgment—earned through real exposure to complex problems—more than a specific career path or title history.
Snowflake working experience required. You should have hands-on working knowledge of Snowflake. You don’t need to be a certified architect, but you need to be able to contribute to technical decisions confidently in a Snowflake-centric environment.
Experience in solutions engineering, data engineering, analytics, data products, or a related technical role
Familiarity with data integration, pipelines, data modeling, and solution architecture concepts
Experience with modern cloud data platforms and analytics workflows; AWS environment experience is a plus, as is Alteryx
Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements and executable solution plans
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with complex datasets
Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
Team leadership experience required—whether through direct management, tech-lead roles, or running cross-functional workstreams. Formal people-management experience is preferred but not the only path.
Experience working across Sales, Product, Engineering, or analytics functions is a strong plus
Plus: Background in data onboarding, identity resolution, audience strategy, martech/adtech, or measurement partnerships. Experience in activation, programmatic, or audience deployment.
Benefits
We believe that a diverse, inclusive staff is a fundamental strength. We’re committed to hiring people of all races, ethnicities, religions, ages, sex, genders, sexual orientations, and gender identities. Women, people of color, LGBTQ+ individuals, and members of untapped groups are strongly encouraged to apply and are welcome on our teams.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process and employment. If you require an accommodation to apply for or interview for this position, please let us know (email Gideon at ).
We encourage candidates to apply even if their experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.
COMPETITIVE COMPENSATION
Including a 401(k) with generous company matching.
100% REMOTE WORKING OPPORTUNITY
Always have been and always will be.
TOP-NOTCH MEDICAL COVERAGE
Domestic-partner inclusive, health, dental, vision, life, cancer coverage, and long-term disability insurance for you and your dependents.
GENEROUS PAID TIME OFF
23 days of PTO per year. We believe in work-life balance and encourage you to use your time off.
PAID PARENTAL LEAVE
10 weeks of fully paid time off. All genders qualify equally, and the policy includes adoptions.

jobs.title: Sr Director Product Management
jobs.text:
AtEZCORPwe are a growing team focused on creating and changing the pawn industry as we know it today. We believe that our platform enabled lending and e-commerce solutions will revolutionize our ability to attract, engage and service our customers across the United States, Mexico and Latin America.
Join us now for an opportunity to be a part of a team that wants to provide access to short-term cash for every person – everywhere!
The Company:
Founded in Austin in 1989, EZCORP has grown into a leading provider of pawn loans in the United States, Mexico and Latin America. We are dedicated to satisfying the short-term cash needs of consumers who are both cash and credit constrained and providing an industry-leading customer experience.
What’s in it for you:
Ground Floor opportunity with EZCORP, a company with a start-up, purpose-driven mentality where innovative and agile problem solving are part of our DNA along with competitive compensation and benefits.
Address:
Ontario
The Sr. Director, Product Manager is a senior leadership role reporting to the Head of Product Management, responsible for leading strategic product initiatives and driving product excellence across the Digital Product organization. This role provides deep product leadership for critical customer-facing products and platforms while building product management capabilities, establishing best practices, and mentoring product teams throughout the organization.
The Sr. Director serves as a key strategic partner to executive leadership, translating business strategy into product vision and roadmaps that deliver measurable customer and business value. This position requires balancing hands-on product ownership with organizational leadership, coaching product managers, and driving consistent product discipline across teams.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:
Product Strategy & Leadership
Define and own multi-year product strategy aligned with EZCORP’s business and operating objectives.
Translate executive priorities into structured product roadmaps and investment plans.
Ensure consistent prioritization across platforms based on customer impact, revenue, risk, and operational efficiency.
Customer & Business Outcomes
Champion a customer-centric approach grounded in measurable business outcomes.
Drive improvements in customer satisfaction, digital adoption, and revenue performance.
Improve operational efficiency across store and corporate workflows.
Ensure product performance is measured, reviewed, and continuously improved.
Team Leadership & Development
Lead and develop senior product leaders, including Directors and Group Product Managers.
Establish consistent product management standards, governance, and accountability.
Build leadership depth and succession readiness within the product organization.
Foster a culture of ownership, transparency, and execution discipline.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Operations, IT and Design teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule and on budget
Collaborate with Marketing to drive product adoption, positioning, and go-to-market strategies
Work with Operations and Store Experience teams to ensure products meet field team needs and drive operational efficiency
Engage with Compliance and Legal to ensure regulatory adherence in financial services products
Build strong relationships with business stakeholders across functions to understand needs, gather requirements, and align priorities
Lead cross-functional product planning sessions, roadmap reviews, and stakeholder alignment meetings
Product Excellence & Standards
Establish and drive consistent product management practices, standards, and operating rhythms across the Digital Product organization
Define and implement product frameworks for discovery, prioritization, roadmapping, and delivery
Create templates, tools, and resources that enable product teams to work more effectively
Drive adoption of product analytics, user research, and experimentation capabilities
Advocate for technical excellence, platform thinking, and reduced technical debt in product decisions
Champion customer-centric design and accessibility in all Digital products
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:
15+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Strategy, or Platform Leadership roles.
8-10+ years in senior leadership positions (Director / Senior Director or equivalent).
Demonstrated experience delivering complex products in regulated industries, preferably financial services, lending, payments, or retail finance.
Proven ability to scale and modernize large, mission-critical platforms.
Strong cross-functional leadership experience with Engineering, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Finance.
Track record of driving execution predictability and measurable business outcomes.
Exceptional communication and decision-making skills at the executive level.
Experience with AI-assisted prototyping (Claude Code, Cursor, Figma AI) to create stateful, interactive prototype
Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Design, or related field required
MBA or Master's degree strongly preferred
EZCORP is an Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.title: Managing Director, Technology Officers Practice - Retained Search
jobs.text:
About Modern Executive Solutions
Modern Executive Solutions is a fully integrated talent management consultancy with a specific focus on developing diverse, modern leadership teams. We provide services that include talent and organization strategy, culture and change management, leadership assessment and development and executive search. Everything we do is forward-looking and focused on creating modern organizations, leadership team and leaders. We are headquartered out of Atlanta, Georgia but work on a remote-first basis with employees across the United States and a team also in the United Kingdom. As a part of our embedded purpose to change lives for the better we donate 10% of our annual profits to charities that support youth and education in order to develop the diverse talent of tomorrow.
The Opportunity
Modern Executive Solutions is seeking a high-impact Managing Director to lead the execution of retained executive search engagements with rigor, judgment, and credibility. This role is central to the success of each search, owning the day-to-day execution of the engagement and helping clients navigate to the right leadership decision through a thoughtful, consultative approach.
Working under the guidance of a Senior Partner, the Managing Director is accountable for running a successful search process from kickoff through close. This person will shape the search strategy, lead and motivate the research team, build trust with the client’s hiring stakeholders, and ensure the engagement remains on track even when conditions become complex or challenging.
The right person brings strong executive search execution skills, commercial judgment, and the emotional intelligence to know when to support, when to challenge, and when to elevate issues in a client’s process that may be limiting the outcome.
Key Responsibilities

jobs.title: CTO (Chief Technology Officer)
jobs.text:
We are hiring a CTO for one of our UK software businesses: an established company with a long track record and a leading share of its market.
The business has deep customer loyalty and a hard technology problem. It runs a large, mission-critical on-premises estate and is developing a new cloud platform, and it now has the backing to rebuild for the next 20 years. This CTO will lead that rebuild.
This role has two modes. With the established team running the existing products, you lead through managers and team leads; daily production coding is not expected, but you must be able to review architecture and step in to steer major incidents. In the small, elite squad rebuilding the platform, you will be more hands-on.
You will own all technology in the business: product engineering, QA, DevOps and cloud, data, and infrastructure.
ABOUT TAG SOFTWARE GROUP:
TAG Software Group is a team of experienced investors and operators dedicated to acquiring, enhancing, and growing mission-critical software companies serving SMB, enterprise, and public sector customers.
Founded as part of a permanent home for software companies, we don’t buy to sell. Our focus is on long-term partnerships that protect your legacy, employees, and customers.
Our in-house team delivers an efficient, transparent, and seller-friendly process, ensuring speed and certainty of close. Once part of TAG, your company gains access to proven best practices, dedicated value-creation resources, and the extended ecosystem of our sister companies, including proprietary in-house technology including and — helping your business reach the next level.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Run and stabilize the current estate
Lead a production team of 20+ engineers, testers, product and platform staff.
Set priorities, delivery cadence and metrics: velocity, quality, release predictability, cost per product line.
Keep a mission-critical on-premises estate secure, supported and compliant.
Run clear programme governance: every initiative has an owner, plan, budget and honest monthly reporting to the MD.
Own reliability: incident response, postmortems and support escalation, building a team that handles incidents without you.
Build the next-generation platform with a lean, AI-first team
Build a small, senior, AI-native engineering team using AI-assisted development.
Rebuild the core product as a best-in-class cloud platform that aims to be number one in the UK market.
Work hands-on inside the new-platform squad: set the architecture, write and review code if needed, and set the engineering standard.
Make AI development tools part of every engineer's daily work, across both the legacy and new teams.
Lead the move from on premises to cloud
Own the migration strategy for a large installed customer base, including sequencing, integration and data migration.
Keep NHS integrations, accreditations and clinical-safety obligations intact throughout.
Consolidate hosting and infrastructure and reduce the hardware and network footprint our customers carry.
Technical environment
On-premises platform: Mainly C++ , C# and Java; .NET Framework; Microsoft SQL Server; Windows Server; installed at each customer site
Cloud platform: multi-tenant SaaS on Microsoft Azure; C#, ASP.NET Core, React; Kubernetes (AKS); PostgreSQL,
Hardware: company-supplied terminals, handheld scanners and printers; dispensing-robot integrations; NHS HSCN network connectivity; field engineering and workshop

jobs.title: VP of Product Design
jobs.text:
🚀 Why Midnite?
Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.
We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.
Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.
We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.
Not your grandad’s bookie.
👀 The Role
Title: VP of Product Design
Team: Design
Location: Remote, UK
Experience quality is one of the clearest ways Midnite differentiates in a category that too often settles for functional and familiar. As our VP of Product Design, you'll own the creative vision and experience direction for Midnite, shaping how our products look, feel and evolve as we scale. You'll bring exceptional design taste, bold creative thinking and the ambition to build experiences that stand out in our industry. Working alongside our senior leadership team, you'll influence product strategy, champion design excellence and ensure creativity is at the heart of our biggest decisions. This is an opportunity to shape the future of Midnite's products, build a world-class design function and set a new standard for what great looks like.
You will:
Own and define the creative vision and long-term design direction for Midnite, ensuring our products deliver distinctive, beautifully crafted experiences.
Set an exceptional standard for visual and interaction design, championing creativity, innovation and attention to detail across everything we build.
Shape the end-to-end customer experience across native apps, web and internal platforms, creating a cohesive and recognisable Midnite experience.
Partner with our executive leadership, Product and Engineering teams to influence company strategy, challenge thinking and shape our most important product decisions.
Provide creative direction on our most ambitious and high-impact initiatives, pushing boundaries and ensuring exceptional execution from concept through to delivery.
Lead, inspire and develop our Product Design function, building a culture of outstanding craft, creative ambition and ownership.
Drive the evolution of our design systems and principles, creating the foundations for exceptional design quality as our products and teams scale.
Work closely with Brand, Creative, Growth, CRM and Games to ensure a joined-up creative vision across the entire customer journey.
Champion emerging technologies, including AI, exploring how they can unlock new creative possibilities and transform how we design and build.
Shape the future of design at Midnite, influencing how we work, invest in talent and continuously raise the bar for product experiences.
The next Midniter:
Is an exceptional design leader with a proven track record of shaping creative vision and product experiences at a senior or executive level.
Has outstanding design taste, strong creative instincts and a portfolio that demonstrates truly exceptional visual and interaction design.
Has experience owning design direction across complex, multi-platform products, ideally within fast-moving, consumer-focused technology businesses.
Thinks beyond individual features, bringing the vision and creativity to shape distinctive, cohesive product experiences at scale.
Combines creative ambition with strong commercial and product judgement, understanding how exceptional design drives engagement, retention and business growth.
Has a track record of influencing product strategy and driving meaningful change through design, working closely with executive leadership.
Is passionate about the craft of design, with the ability to challenge, inspire and elevate work from early concepts through to the finest details.
Has built and developed high-performing design teams, creating an environment where creativity, ownership and exceptional standards thrive.
Brings strong creative direction and the ability to get close to the work, guiding complex design challenges and leading by example.
Has experience shaping design systems, principles and practices that enable creativity, consistency and quality at scale.
Is a confident communicator who can articulate an ambitious creative vision, influence senior stakeholders and bring teams together around shared goals.
Is curious about emerging technologies, including AI, and how they can push the boundaries of digital product experiences.
Thrives in a high-growth environment, bringing bold thinking, ambition and the drive to create something genuinely different.
💰 Winnings
Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.
Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.
Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.
Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.
Nursery salary sacrifice scheme helping parents save thousands each year on nursery fees.
Salary sacrifice schemes for tech and holidays so you can spread the cost of the things you want.
Retail discounts and subscription perks across a wide range of brands.
Quarterly team socials to connect, celebrate and have fun together.
At Midnite, we’re committed to creating equal opportunities for everyone. We actively strive to build balanced teams that reflect the diversity of our communities, including ethnic minorities, people with disabilities, the LGBTQIA+ community, and all genders.
We aim to provide an inclusive and supportive interview experience for all candidates. If you require any reasonable adjustments, please let us know in advance so we can ensure you feel comfortable and set up for success.

jobs.title: AVP, Tech - Change Management & Service Transition.MGN Egypt - Technology Servic
jobs.text:
As a Senior Manager in Service Management, you will lead the governance, optimization, and continuous improvement of ITIL processes, with a strong focus on Change Management and Service Transition. You will be responsible for driving process excellence by identifying improvement opportunities, overseeing technology change governance, and ensuring the successful delivery of production implementations.
Key responsibilities include monitoring change performance, analyzing change failures and service incidents, identifying root causes, and implementing preventive and corrective actions to reduce operational risk. You will collaborate closely with technology, operations, and business teams to ensure that all non-functional, operational readiness, and compliance requirements are met prior to production go-live.
The role also requires establishing meaningful process metrics, defining KPIs in partnership with the MIS team, and developing dashboards that provide actionable insights into service performance, change effectiveness, risk trends, and operational efficiency. Through strong stakeholder engagement and data-driven decision-making, you will contribute to enhancing service resilience, governance, and overall technology delivery outcomes.

jobs.text:
About Us
YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy. We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights across sectors, including e-commerce, ridesharing, payments, and marketplaces.
Our proprietary technology identifies, licenses, cleans, and analyzes third-party data that many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on. We are backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners and have been recognized multiple times as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. Our culture is focused on ownership, mastery, transparency, and impact.
About the Role
YipitData’s product portfolio is underpinned by a growing set of strategic data partnerships. Each partnership acts as a growth driver for the business, unlocking new product development opportunities and expanding our sector coverage.
We currently have ~40 active data partnerships and are looking to hire a senior, Director-level individual contributor to scale this motion. This role sits at the intersection of corporate development, strategy, and product.
The Director, Strategic Data Partnerships, will identify, evaluate, and execute exclusive, long-cycle data partnerships that meaningfully shape our future product direction. This is not a procurement or channel partnerships role. Instead, it requires strong strategic judgment, executive presence, and deep curiosity about how data creates competitive advantage.
In This Role, You Will
Identify and evaluate potential data partners with high strategic and product value
Engage directly with CEOs and senior executives — many of whom have not previously monetized their data — to assess opportunity and build alignment
Lead discovery and diligence processes to understand data quality, defensibility, and long-term product applicability
Develop strategic and economic business cases for partnership opportunities
Negotiate and execute complex, enterprise-level agreements, including exclusive arrangements
Coordinate cross-functionally with legal, product, compliance, engineering, and executive leadership
Exercise strong judgment in prioritizing opportunities and determining when to pursue, pause, or walk away
This role owns partnerships through signature. Ongoing relationship management and renewals are handled by a separate team.
What Success Looks Like
Signing one flagship, exclusive partnership within the first 12–18 months
Building a repeatable executive-level pipeline of high-quality partnership opportunities
Establishing clear internal conviction around which opportunities merit investment
You Are Likely to Succeed If
You have Director-level (or equivalent) experience in enterprise sales, strategic partnerships, corporate development, investment banking, or strategy consulting with operating exposure
IC focused, ideal for enterprise sellers looking to transition into a non-traditional sales role and quota attainment.
You have experience evaluating and executing complex, multi-stakeholder transactions
You are comfortable engaging and influencing C-suite executives
You demonstrate strong judgment when evaluating ambiguous, high-stakes opportunities
You thrive in environments with less structure and enjoy carving new paths
You have grit and resilience to sustain momentum through long-cycle negotiations
You are genuinely curious about the data ecosystem and how data enables competitive advantage and new product innovation
What We Offer
Our compensation package includes a competitive base salary, performance incentives (OTE $350k), and equity.
We also offer:
Flexible work hours and an open vacation policy
Generous 401(k) match and parental leave
Wellness and work-from-home benefits
Learning and professional development support
Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact you make — not tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to self-improve and master their skills in an environment built on trust and accountability.
YipitData is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.
This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. We also have office hubs in Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, and Seattle. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.
Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.
We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Platform/Services
jobs.text:
About Life360
Life360’s mission is to keep people close to the ones they love. Our category-leading mobile app, Tile tracking devices, and Pet GPS tracker empower members to protect the people, pets, and things they care about most with a range of services, including location sharing, safe driver reports, and crash detection with emergency dispatch. Life360 serves approximately 102.4 million monthly active users (MAU), as of June 30, 2026, across more than 180 countries.
Life360 delivers peace of mind and enhances everyday family life with seamless coordination for all the moments that matter, big and small. By continuing to innovate and deliver for our customers, we have become a household name and the must-have mobile-based membership for families (and those friends who are basically family).
Life360 has more than 500 (and growing!) remote-first employees. For more information, please visit life360.com.
Life360 is a Remote First company, which means a remote work environment will be the primary experience for all employees. All positions, unless otherwise specified, can be performed remotely (within the US and Canada) regardless of any specified location above.
We are AI Native
We are building an AI native company where AI is an integral part of how we build and operate. AI tool usage during interviews varies by role. You may be asked to demonstrate proficiency with AI tools, discuss how you leverage AI, or complete interview exercises without AI assistance. Your Recruiter will provide clear guidance as you move through the interview process.
Undisclosed use of AI not previously discussed with or approved by your Recruiter may impact your candidacy.
About The Team
Our Services engineering teams, part of our Quality and Scale Pillar, build and run the systems every Life360 member relies on but never sees. We carry location data between members’ phones and our servers, deliver the push and SMS notifications that families depend on, verify who members are and what they can access, build and scale our business critical services and give partners a safe way to build on Life360. When we do our jobs well, product teams ship faster and families trust the app in the moments that matter most.
We are a group of backend, cloud, and mobile engineers who care about reliability, security, and scale, and who treat member trust as the foundation of everything we build.
About the Job
As a Director of Engineering, you will lead the teams building and operating Life360’s critical platforms, including location and messaging, cloud infrastructure and identity, and partner ecosystems. These systems are the foundation of the experiences millions of families rely on every day. You are a player coach who will set technical direction, develop strong engineering managers and technical leaders, and ensure our platforms are reliable, secure, and built to scale as Life360 grows to hundreds of millions of members worldwide.
This is a leadership role that combines deep technical judgment with business impact. You will anticipate scaling challenges before they become problems, modernize critical systems, and make thoughtful tradeoffs across reliability, performance, cost, and speed. You will partner closely with Product, Security, Data, and engineering leaders to connect technology investments to business outcomes, accelerate product innovation, and build an engineering organization that can deliver at scale.
For candidates based in the US, the salary range for this position is $216,500 to $318,500 USD. For candidates based out of Canada, the salary range for this position is 251,000 to 295,000 CAD. Note: Please be aware that the job title for positions in Canada will be "Developer" in lieu of "Engineer." We take into consideration an individual's background, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience in determining final salary. Base pay may also vary based on geographic location, with US work locations falling into one of three geographic tiers.
Total compensation is inclusive of equity compensation in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), as well as a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, financial, and other benefits.
What You’ll Do
Build the foundation for scale. Lead the engineering teams behind Life360’s critical services, including location and messaging, cloud and identity, and partner platforms. Build reliable, secure, and scalable systems that can support hundreds of millions of members around the world.
See around corners. Anticipate architectural bottlenecks, reliability risks, and scaling challenges before they impact members. Set technical direction, modernize legacy systems, and balance near-term business needs with long-term platform investments.
Make reliability a competitive advantage. Establish high standards for availability, performance, observability, security, and incident response. Build resilient systems that proactively detect and prevent failures, ensuring members can trust Life360 in the moments that matter most.
Build a culture of ownership and accountability. Create an engineering organization where teams proactively identify problems, take responsibility for outcomes, and drive solutions without waiting for direction. Empower leaders to make decisions, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the bar for engineering excellence across organizational boundaries.
Make the invisible visible. Establish meaningful engineering metrics across reliability, performance, cost, security, and developer productivity. Use data to identify risks, prioritize investments, and communicate platform health and business impact to senior leadership.
Grow leaders who grow teams. Hire, coach, and develop engineering managers, staff engineers, and technical leaders. Build a high-performing organization with clear accountability, strong technical judgment, and leaders who can make decisions and deliver outcomes independently.
Accelerate the entire engineering organization. Build reusable services, APIs, and platforms that reduce duplication and enable product teams to ship faster. Expand our partner ecosystem through secure, scalable integrations that make it easier to build on Life360.
Turn engineering investments into business outcomes. Connect technical strategy to member experience, product velocity, and business performance. Make deliberate tradeoffs across reliability, scalability, cost, and speed, and use meaningful metrics to demonstrate impact and inform investment decisions.
Lead through influence. Partner across Product, Security, Data, and Engineering to align priorities, resolve ambiguity, and drive cross-functional decisions. Translate company strategy into actionable engineering roadmaps while bringing technical risks and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
Stay close to the technology and embrace what’s next. Engage in architectural reviews and critical technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and empower teams to make pragmatic tradeoffs. Champion AI-assisted development, automation, and modern engineering practices to improve productivity, quality, and speed.
What We’re Looking For
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams, with experience managing managers.
Track record of leading backend or platform engineering at high scale, with distributed systems serving millions of users. B2B or B2C platform experience is welcome.
Demonstrated success developing and coaching managers, including former individual contributors who grew into leadership.
Experience translating company strategy into technical plans, and representing your teams’ needs back to senior leaders.
Experience modernizing legacy systems with respect for the history behind them, and the judgment to change what needs changing rather than everything.
Strong cross-functional partnership skills, with a record of resolving ownership and priority conflicts directly.
Hands-on technical credibility in cloud infrastructure and distributed systems (AWS experience preferred).
Excellent written and verbal communication.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
Our Benefits
Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance plans (100% paid for US employees). We offer life and disability as well as supplemental plans for medical and dental for Canadian employees.
401(k) plan with company matching program in the US and RRSP with DPSP plan for Canadian employees.
Paid parental leave.
Mental Wellness Program & Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for mental well-being.
Generous time off: flexible PTO, companywide holidays throughout the year plus summer and winter shutdowns.
Learning & Development programs.
Equipment, tools, and reimbursement support for a productive remote environment.
Free Life360 Platinum Membership and Tile trackers.
Life360 Values
Our company’s mission-driven culture is guided by our shared values to create a trusted work environment where you can bring your authentic self to work and make a positive difference
Be a Good Person - We have a team of high integrity people you can trust.
Be Direct With Respect - We communicate directly, even when it’s hard.
Members Before Metrics - We focus on building an exceptional experience for families.
High Intensity, High Impact - We do whatever it takes to get the job done.
Our Commitment to Diversity
We believe that different ideas, perspectives and backgrounds create a stronger and more creative work environment that delivers better results. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us closer to our customers and the communities we serve. We strive to create a workplace that reflects the communities we serve and where everyone feels empowered to bring their authentic best selves to work.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Life360. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any legally protected status.
We encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that a diversity of perspectives and experiences create a foundation for the best ideas. Come join us in building something meaningful. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying!
#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Sr. Director, eDiscovery Technology & AI
jobs.text:
KLDiscovery brings clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide. The eDiscovery Technology practice is where those clients meet advanced analytics and AI: technology-assisted review, generative AI classification for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and the non-standard workflows that turn a hard matter into a defensible, efficient one. Clients across the US, UK, Europe, and Asia Pacific are asking how to use AI in discovery and how to defend it, each under their own rules. This practice answers them everywhere KLD operates.
The Senior Director, eDiscovery Technology leads that practice globally. You will lead a team of technologists and consultants across time zones, own the methodology and defensibility of every AI-assisted workflow we deliver, partner with Advisory to package and price the consulting offerings they sell, and sit at the table with Product and Engineering as we build AI review into our own platform. This is applied legal technology leadership rather than a software engineering role, and a legal background is preferred.
We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $156,000 to $195,000.
What you will do
Lead the eDiscovery Technology practice
Lead a team of eDiscovery technologists and consultants who design and run advanced analytics and AI-assisted workflows on client matters, including technology-assisted review and continuous active learning, generative AI review for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and custom workflow design for non-standard tools and data.
Run the practice on a billable model: request intake, scoping, staffing, utilization, quality, and turnaround, against a demand curve that is growing fast.
Run it as one global practice, with one intake, one standard, and one set of playbooks across the US, EMEA, and APAC. Build follow-the-sun handoffs so a matter started in London or Hong Kong is picked up cleanly in the US, and partner with regional Operations leaders on staffing, skills, and coverage.
Grow the practice. Hire, onboard, and develop a manager, consultants, and technologists as demand expands, and build a career path from technologist to consultant to lead.
Build the operating rhythm: intake standards, capacity forecasting, coverage for second-shift, weekend, and deadline-driven work, quality standards, and playbooks so every matter gets the same standard regardless of who staffs it.
Own the methodology and its defensibility
Own how KLD applies analytics and AI to review: TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, generative AI classifiers for relevance and privilege, prompt design and iteration, validation statistics (recall, precision, elusion), and the documentation that makes the result defensible.
Serve as the senior subject matter expert for clients and counsel on AI-assisted review: scoping, protocol support, validation design, and explaining results in plain language to lawyers who have to sign their name to them.
Build reusable playbooks, prompt libraries, validation templates, and reporting so quality lives in the practice rather than in any one person.
Own AI governance for client matters with Legal and InfoSec: client data boundaries, client-specific AI restrictions, privilege protections, and audit trail, applied consistently across every tool the practice uses.
Adapt the methodology to the jurisdiction without lowering the standard: US TAR and GenAI case law and protocols, UK disclosure practice, GDPR and UK data protection, cross-border transfer and data residency limits, and APAC requirements, so the same playbook is defensible in every region where we run it.
Co-own the consulting offerings with Advisory
Partner with Advisory and Sales to define, package, and price the AI and analytics consulting offerings they sell: what we offer, how it is scoped, what it costs to deliver, and what margin it carries.
Supply the technical authority in pursuits Advisory leads across regions: pre-sales calls, RFP responses, pilots, and client education sessions for US, UK, European, and APAC clients and law firms.
Move the practice from reactive technical support toward productized consulting with clear deliverables, pricing, and outcomes.
Track offering revenue, attach rate, billable utilization, revenue per consultant per week, and margin, and report them into the weekly and monthly business reviews.
Partner with Product and Engineering
Serve as the practice’s voice into KLD’s own AI review capabilities: requirements, pilot design, operational readiness, adoption, and the feedback loop from client matters back to the roadmap.
Evaluate and adopt third-party analytics and AI tools, run structured comparisons, and own the practice’s vendor relationships and licensing.
Work with Process Engineering to encode repeatable workflows into automation and AI skills so the team’s time goes to judgment rather than mechanics.
Lead clients and cross-functional partners
Act as the senior technical voice for Client Success, Sales, and clients in every region on complex matters, escalations, and methodology questions, including cross-border matters that span more than one jurisdiction.
Represent the practice externally with a clear point of view on AI in discovery, thought leadership, and industry presence.
Lead with KLD’s values: Client is Always in the Room, Better Every Day, Own the Outcome, and Deliver Results Together.
What you bring
Required:
10+ years in eDiscovery or litigation technology, including 5+ years applying advanced analytics and AI-assisted review on client matters and 3+ years leading a team.
Deep hands-on expertise in TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, and generative AI review (Relativity aiR, eDiscovery AI, or equivalent), including prompt design, validation statistics, and defensibility documentation. Working command of Relativity and RelativityOne.
A client-facing record: you have scoped, defended, and explained AI-assisted review to counsel and clients, supported protocol negotiations, and handled the hard questions.
Multi-jurisdiction experience: you have delivered analytics or AI-assisted review on matters outside the US or for non-US clients, and you understand GDPR, cross-border data transfer constraints, and how disclosure practice in the UK, EU, or APAC differs from US discovery.
Commercial fluency: you have packaged or priced consulting work, partnered with sales on pursuits, and can explain utilization and margin to a CFO.
Product partnership experience as the operational or practitioner voice on AI feature design, pilots, or adoption.
A record of building and developing a technical consulting team, including growing leads into managers and leading people across time zones.
A direct, clear communication style. You can explain recall and elusion to a general counsel and to a first-year technologist in the same afternoon.
Experience in PE-backed or high-growth environments where pace and accountability are the norm.
Preferred:
Legal degree (JD or equivalent); bar admission a plus.
Structured analytics experience (Brainspace, Reveal, or similar).
Declaration or testimony experience on review methodology.
Relativity certifications, CEDS, or equivalent.
Our mission and core values:
We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.
Client is Always in the Room. We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.
Better Every Day. We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.
Own the Outcome. We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients and each other.
Deliver Results Together. We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.
Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.
Originally posted on Himalayas

We offer competitive total compensation that includes base pay, bonus potential, inclusive benefits, wellness programs, and perks. We use market and industry data to inform pay decisions while considering geography and labor markets, individual experience, and business needs. Individual compensation will vary, although a reasonable estimate of the current annualized base pay range for this position is $156,000 to $195,000.
What you will do
Lead the eDiscovery Technology practice

items: Lead a team of eDiscovery technologists and consultants who design and run advanced analytics and AI-assisted workflows on client matters, including technology-assisted review and continuous active learning, generative AI review for relevance and privilege, search and analytics strategy, and custom workflow design for non-standard tools and data.
Run the practice on a billable model: request intake, scoping, staffing, utilization, quality, and turnaround, against a demand curve that is growing fast.

Run it as one global practice, with one intake, one standard, and one set of playbooks across the US, EMEA, and APAC. Build follow-the-sun handoffs so a matter started in London or Hong Kong is picked up cleanly in the US, and partner with regional Operations leaders on staffing, skills, and coverage.
Grow the practice. Hire, onboard, and develop a manager, consultants, and technologists as demand expands, and build a career path from technologist to consultant to lead.

Build the operating rhythm: intake standards, capacity forecasting, coverage for second-shift, weekend, and deadline-driven work, quality standards, and playbooks so every matter gets the same standard regardless of who staffs it.

blocks.text: Own the methodology and its defensibility

items: Own how KLD applies analytics and AI to review: TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, generative AI classifiers for relevance and privilege, prompt design and iteration, validation statistics (recall, precision, elusion), and the documentation that makes the result defensible.

Serve as the senior subject matter expert for clients and counsel on AI-assisted review: scoping, protocol support, validation design, and explaining results in plain language to lawyers who have to sign their name to them.
Build reusable playbooks, prompt libraries, validation templates, and reporting so quality lives in the practice rather than in any one person.

Own AI governance for client matters with Legal and InfoSec: client data boundaries, client-specific AI restrictions, privilege protections, and audit trail, applied consistently across every tool the practice uses.

Adapt the methodology to the jurisdiction without lowering the standard: US TAR and GenAI case law and protocols, UK disclosure practice, GDPR and UK data protection, cross-border transfer and data residency limits, and APAC requirements, so the same playbook is defensible in every region where we run it.

blocks.text: Co-own the consulting offerings with Advisory

items: Partner with Advisory and Sales to define, package, and price the AI and analytics consulting offerings they sell: what we offer, how it is scoped, what it costs to deliver, and what margin it carries.
Supply the technical authority in pursuits Advisory leads across regions: pre-sales calls, RFP responses, pilots, and client education sessions for US, UK, European, and APAC clients and law firms.
Move the practice from reactive technical support toward productized consulting with clear deliverables, pricing, and outcomes.
Track offering revenue, attach rate, billable utilization, revenue per consultant per week, and margin, and report them into the weekly and monthly business reviews.

blocks.text: Partner with Product and Engineering

items: Serve as the practice’s voice into KLD’s own AI review capabilities: requirements, pilot design, operational readiness, adoption, and the feedback loop from client matters back to the roadmap.
Evaluate and adopt third-party analytics and AI tools, run structured comparisons, and own the practice’s vendor relationships and licensing.
Work with Process Engineering to encode repeatable workflows into automation and AI skills so the team’s time goes to judgment rather than mechanics.

blocks.text: Lead clients and cross-functional partners

items: Act as the senior technical voice for Client Success, Sales, and clients in every region on complex matters, escalations, and methodology questions, including cross-border matters that span more than one jurisdiction.
Represent the practice externally with a clear point of view on AI in discovery, thought leadership, and industry presence.
Lead with KLD’s values: Client is Always in the Room, Better Every Day, Own the Outcome, and Deliver Results Together.

blocks.text: What you bring
Required:

items: 10+ years in eDiscovery or litigation technology, including 5+ years applying advanced analytics and AI-assisted review on client matters and 3+ years leading a team.

Deep hands-on expertise in TAR 1.0 and 2.0, continuous active learning, and generative AI review (Relativity aiR, eDiscovery AI, or equivalent), including prompt design, validation statistics, and defensibility documentation. Working command of Relativity and RelativityOne.
A client-facing record: you have scoped, defended, and explained AI-assisted review to counsel and clients, supported protocol negotiations, and handled the hard questions.

Multi-jurisdiction experience: you have delivered analytics or AI-assisted review on matters outside the US or for non-US clients, and you understand GDPR, cross-border data transfer constraints, and how disclosure practice in the UK, EU, or APAC differs from US discovery.
Commercial fluency: you have packaged or priced consulting work, partnered with sales on pursuits, and can explain utilization and margin to a CFO.
Product partnership experience as the operational or practitioner voice on AI feature design, pilots, or adoption.
A record of building and developing a technical consulting team, including growing leads into managers and leading people across time zones.
A direct, clear communication style. You can explain recall and elusion to a general counsel and to a first-year technologist in the same afternoon.
Experience in PE-backed or high-growth environments where pace and accountability are the norm.

blocks.text: Preferred:

items: Legal degree (JD or equivalent); bar admission a plus.
Structured analytics experience (Brainspace, Reveal, or similar).
Declaration or testimony experience on review methodology.
Relativity certifications, CEDS, or equivalent.

blocks.text: Our mission and core values:
We bring clarity, trust, and meaning to data for clients navigating legal matters worldwide.
Client is Always in the Room. We operate and make decisions as if the client is in the room. We anticipate their needs, consider their perspective, and prioritize their best interests.
Better Every Day. We improve our tomorrow by always striving to be better than today. We embrace curiosity, question assumptions, and raise the bar constantly.
Own the Outcome. We bring an unwavering bias for action, act with urgency, and hold ourselves accountable to our clients and each other.

Deliver Results Together. We collaborate obsessively to achieve shared success. We assume good intentions, debate ideas thoughtfully, treat each other with respect, and fully commit once decisions are made.
Our culture shapes our actions, our products, and the relationships we forge with our customers.

Who are we?
StoryToys, an independent subsidiary of Team17 Group plc, is a premier, award-winning developer and publisher of interactive educational apps designed to help children learn, play, and grow. We collaborate with the world’s most recognizable entertainment giants—including The LEGO Group, The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Entertainment, Mattel, and BBC Studios—to bring beloved characters like Bluey, Peppa Pig, and Barbie into engaging digital worlds.
Our global success spans all major distribution networks, amassing over 300 million app downloads and reaching millions of active families worldwide in up to 28 different languages. While headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, our internal team of over 130 professionals operates alongside a vast, highly agile global network of creators.
About the role
StoryToys is looking for an interim Head of Engineering to lead the engineering department behind our portfolio of award-winning children's mobile games.
This role is responsible for the performance and growth of our engineering function, ensuring teams can consistently deliver high-quality and engaging mobile experiences for children and families around the world. This is a product-focused role requiring deep experience in Unity, building and maintaining mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a senior engineering leader with a passion for mobile app development and an interest in children's play to join our dynamic and growing team.

jobs.text:
About WPP Media
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
3014 - Director, Media Solutions - Engineering, UK
Role Summary and Impact
What you’ll do
Technical leadership for the Media Solutions engineering team; sets standards, designs patterns, and delivery practices; ensures solutions are supportable, observable, and secure; mentors engineers; owns technical risk and quality gates.
Aligns solution design with agreed architecture patterns set by the global team. Aligns work to the strategic initiatives and roadmap set by the platforms operations lead
Lead the software engineering team best practices, leadership and people management.
Design, build, and evolve modern digital products using C#, TypeScript, and React (as applied to Next.js and Remix).
Develop APIs and backend services using .NET Core and relational databases, supporting composable and data-driven architectures.
Build cloud infrastructure in AWS or Azure using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code.
Manage CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps to automate build and deployment processes.
Work closely with Product, UX, Strategy, and DevOps specialists to co-create high-quality, outcome-focused solutions.
Integrate with headless SaaS tools like Contentful, DatoCMS, Prismic, Algolia, and others in the composable ecosystem.
Apply DevOps and performance engineering practices — including caching, observability, and scalability — to deliver resilient products.
Contribute to our Software Engineering discipline, sharing knowledge and helping shape how we build and deliver technology at Code.
Skills and Experience
At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. It’s what elevates us to deliver exceptional experiences for both our clients and each other. In this role it will be critical to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:
Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.
You’ll likely have experience developing web applications in a modern technology stack and a strong foundation in both back-end and front-end development.
We’d love you to have:
Experience with C# / .NET Core, TypeScript, and React (Next.js / Remix).
A good grasp of relational database design and API development.
Practical experience deploying to Azure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Familiarity with headless CMS and composable architectures.
A passion for building products that are accessible, performant, secure, and user-centred.
A collaborative mindset — you value working as part of a multi-disciplinary team and learning from others.
Life at WPP Media & Benefits
Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.
We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.
Please note this is a UK based role and requires individuals to have the right to work in this location

jobs.title: Head of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.
We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.
About the Role
You'll be a player-coach — someone who still ships code but also owns the engineering roadmap, team structure, and technical direction. You'll translate company strategy into engineering priorities, make sure the right things get built in the right order, and help a small, high-output team scale without losing speed.
You'll lead a small, technical engineering team that leverages AI to build the software infrastructure for running our automated lab. Your job is to make it the best small engineering team in biotech, and grow it thoughtfully as we scale.
This is not a management-track role where you stop building. You'll stay hands-on, especially as AI agents reshape what a small engineering team can accomplish. We expect you to be deeply technical, opinionated about architecture, and actively shipping — while also being the person who ensures the whole engineering org is pointed in the right direction and moving fast.
Day-to-day, that can mean:
Owning the engineering roadmap — deciding what to build, what to defer, and what to kill
Setting technical direction and architecture across frontend, backend, data pipelines, and lab-hardware integration
Shipping code yourself on the highest-leverage problems, not just reviewing it
Hiring, growing, and setting the bar for a team that ships fast and holds quality high — our lab runs on this software, so when things break, real experiments fail and real customers are affected
Building the team's AI-assisted development practices into a genuine speed advantage
What we're looking for
Still building. You've shipped production software for years and you're not looking to leave the code behind — you want a role where you build and lead at the same time.
You've built teams. You've hired, managed, and developed engineers, and built a team that ships fast and holds a high bar — at least once before, in a startup or high-growth environment.
Roadmap ownership. You've owned or significantly shaped an engineering roadmap. You've made the call on what to build, defer, and kill — and you make pragmatic tradeoffs that keep things shipping and stop projects from growing out of scope.
Technical breadth. You make good architectural decisions across frontend, backend, data, and infrastructure, and you know when to go deep versus when to delegate.
AI-native. It's 2026 — you already build with AI agents and coding tools as a force multiplier, and you have a real point of view on how they change team structure, tooling, and workflow.
A genuine interest in biology. No background required, but our product is running biology experiments in the physical world and that should excite you.
High-autonomy, founder mindset. We share context and vision openly. You figure out what matters most and go work on it.
Application deadline
We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Product
jobs.text:
Atria is a membership-based preventive health care practice delivering cutting-edge primary and specialty care in New York, South Florida, Los Angeles (2026), and through 24/7 telemedicine globally.
Our multi-specialty team of 60+ top in-house physicians provides proactive, preventive, and precision-based care for Atria members and their families. We aim to optimize lifespan and healthspan through meticulous screening, leading-edge therapeutics, and tailored interventions designed to prevent disease and detect it at the earliest possible stages.
Each member's care is led by a dedicated Chief Medical Officer who collaborates with specialists in cardiology, neurology, pediatrics, women's health, endocrinology, integrative health, performance and movement, nutrition, and more.
Through our nonprofit Atria Research Institute and Public Health Institute, we also work to accelerate the translation of medical breakthroughs and expand access to preventive care for as many people as possible.
About this role:
You will lead Product Engineering, the three teams that build everything our members, clinicians and care teams use:
Member Experience: registration, the member portal and the mobile app
Clinical Experience: the patient dashboard, results and clinical AI
Care Delivery: scheduling, the care calendar and clinician task management
The role is hands-on: you will work fluently in the AI-assisted workflows our engineers use every day to generate, review, and deploy code.
Tech Stack
Languages: TypeScript
Backend: Node, Express
