jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering (AI Workflows & Ecosystem)
jobs.text:
Are you driven to bring people, technology, and strategy together to build impactful software?
Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber, they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!
THE PROBLEM YOU’D OWN
Jobber has AI in production, but not yet at its full potential.
We already have AI answering calls, drafting responses, and powering parts of our product. But today, those systems are still fragmented. Some teams are ahead. Others aren’t. Some workflows are intelligent. Others are still manual. And most importantly, the system doesn’t yet think across the product.
A service pro still has to:
Manually follow up on jobs
Piece together context across workflows
Decide what to do next
The platform doesn’t proactively help them run their business. That’s the gap.
The opportunity is to evolve Jobber from: AI-powered features → AI-powered workflows → AI-powered business operations
This role owns that shift. Not a team. Not a feature. The system.
THE CUSTOMER
You’re building for people who don’t have time to think about software.
A plumber finishing their last job at 6 pm
A cleaner managing 30 clients and 5 employees
A landscaper juggling scheduling, payments, and follow-ups
They’re not asking for “AI.” They’re asking:
“What should I do next?”
“Why didn’t this job convert?”
“Who should I follow up with today?”
And eventually:
They shouldn’t have to ask at all.
The Director who succeeds here will understand:
This isn’t about building clever systems; it’s about building systems that remove thinking from already overwhelmed people.
WHAT YOU’D OWN
End-to-end ownership of Jobber’s AI system layer. You’re not owning a single team. You’re owning how intelligence flows across the entire product.
Product + Platform Scope
AI Foundations (models, orchestration, evals, guardrails)
Copilot (user-facing intelligence layer)
Automations (workflow execution layer)
Platform Experience / Marketplace (integration + ecosystem surface)
Emerging surfaces (voice, messaging, cross-product intelligence)
What this actually means
You are responsible for:
How decisions get made inside the system
How context moves across workflows
How actions get triggered (and when they shouldn’t)
How we evaluate whether AI is actually working
This includes:
Agentic workflows (reason → decide → act → evaluate)
Cross-product context (jobs, customers, payments, communication)
Reliability, safety, and failure modes
Developer experience for building on top of AI systems
Team Structure
~30 engineers across 4–6 teams
4–6 EMs / Sr EMs reporting into you
Close partnership with Product, Design, Data
WHAT “GOOD” LOOKS LIKE
Not “we shipped AI features.”
Instead:
The system proactively recommends and takes actions
Teams build on shared AI primitives, not reinventing them
AI output is reliable, measurable, and improving over time
Engineers trust the system, and move faster because of it
Customers feel like the product is working for them, not just responding
THE AI BAR (THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT)
We are not looking for:
Someone who rolled out Copilot internally
Someone who used LLM APIs for features
Someone adjacent to AI
We are looking for someone who has:
Built real systems where AI makes decisions and takes actions in production.
That means experience with:
Agent orchestration (not just prompts)
Tool use and workflow execution
Evaluation (offline + online)
Observability and failure handling
Guardrails and safety in real systems
Tradeoffs between autonomy vs. control
You don’t need to code daily, but you must be able to reason at the system level.
WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO
Define how AI should work across Jobber, not just within a team
Build and evolve a multi-team org to execute on that vision
Make tradeoffs between speed, quality, and safety
Push teams beyond feature thinking into system thinking
Challenge assumptions, including leadership’s
Drive adoption across engineering, product, and the company
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
Leadership
You’ve led orgs through complexity, not just growth.
Managed managers across multiple teams
Built organizations that scale (not just teams that ship)
Driven cross-org alignment in ambiguous spaces
Product + Systems Thinking
You think in systems, not features.
You understand how user workflows connect end-to-end
You’ve partnered deeply with Product and Design
You care about customer outcomes, not just technical output
AI Depth (non-negotiable)
You’ve built or led production LLM/agentic systems.
You understand what actually works (and what doesn’t)
You’ve seen systems fail and improved them
You have opinions about evaluation, reliability, and safety
Execution
You can move fast without breaking everything.
You’ve balanced shipping vs infrastructure vs tech debt
You know when to iterate and when to redesign
WHY JOBBER · WHY NOW?
This is not “AI theatre.”
We already have:
AI Receptionist (live, handling real customer calls)
AI features embedded across the product
250,000+ businesses using the platform
What we don’t have yet is: A unified, intelligent system across the product.
That’s what this role builds.
TLDR:
Most Director roles optimize delivery. This one defines: How an entire product becomes intelligent.
What you can expect from Jobber:
A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.
A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.
A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.
To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.
We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.
A bit more about us:
Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

jobs.title: Senior Director Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.text:
About Volta
Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.
The Role
We are looking for a Senior Director, Infrastructure Engineering to lead engineering across Volta's global portfolio of AI factories. You will report directly to the VP, Development and Design within the Delivery organisation and lead a team of subject matter experts spanning every infrastructure architecture and engineering discipline, from power and cooling to structures, controls and network infrastructure.
You will own Volta's engineering design standards, developing and deploying them across our projects in EMEA and AMER. You will work day to day with your peers in the Design organisation to support live projects and shape Volta's Reference Design for AI factory infrastructure, and partner with the CTO and CPO organisations so that every site turns up compute consistently. You will build the engineering function, its standards and its ways of working as Volta scales.
What You Will Do
› Lead, develop and grow a team of infrastructure engineering SMEs across architecture, electrical, mechanical, cooling, structural, civil, controls and network infrastructure disciplines, building the capability to support a fast growing global pipeline
› Develop and deploy Volta's engineering design standards and specifications for AI factories, making sure they are applied consistently across every project and region
› Work with peers in the Design organisation to provide engineering input into Volta's Reference Design for AI factory infrastructure, balancing performance, cost, speed of delivery and scalability
› Support live projects with engineering expertise from concept through detailed design, construction and commissioning, resolving technical issues quickly so delivery is never held up
› Partner with the CTO and CPO organisations to align facility design with compute, rack and network requirements, enabling consistent turn up of compute across the portfolio
› Track the evolution of AI hardware, including rack densities, liquid cooling and power architectures, and translate it into design standards that keep Volta's AI factories ready for next generation compute
› Own engineering governance, including design reviews, technical assurance and design authority for any departure from standard
› Work with Procurement to standardise specifications for long lead equipment, enabling framework agreements, prefabrication and modular delivery at scale
› Champion safety in design, reliability, maintainability and energy and water efficiency, working with Operations to design for how our facilities will be run
› Embed lessons learned from delivery and operations back into the standards, so every AI factory builds faster, safer and more efficiently than the last
› Provide engineering status, risk and decision reporting to the VP, Development and Design and the executive team
What You Will Bring
› A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil or building services engineering, with chartered or professional engineer status (for example CEng or PE) preferred
› Significant experience in data centre or mission critical infrastructure engineering, including senior leadership of multidisciplinary engineering teams
› Deep technical expertise in at least one core discipline, such as power distribution or cooling, and a strong working knowledge across all infrastructure disciplines
› A track record developing and deploying design standards, reference designs or basis of design documents for a hyperscale, colocation or large scale data centre developer
› Hands on experience with high density and liquid cooled environments for AI and HPC workloads, and an understanding of how GPU cluster requirements drive facility design
› Strong commercial judgement, balancing capex, schedule, reliability and operability in design decisions
› Confident executive level communication, able to explain complex technical trade offs clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
› A collaborative leadership style that builds trust with peers across partner teams, and the conviction to hold the line on standards
› Exposure to both North American and European projects, or to utility scale power, onsite generation or energy storage, would be an advantage
What We Offer
At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.
Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary
Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success
Retirement/pension contributions
Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits
Generous number of vacation days each year
Additional Information
Background Checks
All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.
Equal Opportunity
Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.
Accessibility
Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at
Candidate Privacy Notice
By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.
Note to Recruitment Agencies
Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.

As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.
Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary
Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success
Retirement/pension contributions
Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits
Generous number of vacation days each year
Additional Information
Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.
Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.
Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at
Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. jobs.title: Technology Operations Director
jobs.text:
ABOUT Resources Legacy Fund (RLF):
Resources Legacy Fund builds the architecture behind lasting environmental progress. From climate resilience to land and water conservation to community well-being, we help visionary ideas take shape—offering the steady support and strategic know-how to turn complex challenges into collective victories.
We deliver transformative outcomes for our planet and its people through trusted partnerships and creative campaigns. Rooted in California and expanding across Western North America and beyond, we have a 25-year track record of supporting initiatives at every scale. We also host fiscally sponsored projects that reach across the globe, reinforcing the efforts of change makers worldwide.
Addressing three interconnected crises — climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental injustice — requires creativity, collaboration, and fast reflexes. With deep operational expertise and the confidence of donors and partners, we enable lasting solutions to rise.
Position Summary:
The Technology Operations Director is responsible for ensuring RLF, FBF, and SAF have the technology, operations, and systems needed to support their missions.
Reporting to the Chief of Staff and Operations and serving as a member of the leadership team, the Technology Operations Director provides strategic leadership over information technology and cybersecurity, with a particular focus on building a vision for and moving large-scale technology and systems projects from concept to completion. The Director serves as a trusted advisor to the organization and its fiscally sponsored projects, bringing an operational and technology lens to organizational decision-making. They balance innovation, flexibility, and speed with security, discipline, and care, helping RLF grow and deliver complex grantmaking and fiscal sponsorship services, support a “remote-first” staff, and achieve programmatic outcomes.
This is a full-time, exempt position that can be performed remotely within the U.S. Travel is required quarterly for meetings, conferences, and staff retreats.
Duties Include:
Technology & Systems Leadership
• Serve as the organization's lead on major technology and systems initiatives.
• Develop and align long-term technology and operational goals and projects with organizational objectives and strategy; build the roadmaps, timelines, and change-management plans needed to deliver them.
• Serve as a cross-functional partner to other directors and fiscally sponsored project staff in selecting and utilizing tech platforms.
• Manage technology to support evolving business needs; maintain knowledge of emerging trends and tools to enhance productivity.
• Identify new operational system needs, including systems and processes to support connectivity in a remote-first workplace.
• Manage information technology contractors and support services.
• Oversee CRM/database (Salesforce) design, maintenance, and management, in partnership with the Director of Grants Management and the Director of Development.
• Advance the technological fluency of staff.
Cybersecurity and Risk Management
• Devise security policies, procedures, hardware, and software solutions to mitigate cybersecurity and other enterprise risks.
• Drive data privacy compliance and business continuity/disaster recovery planning.
• Advise organizational leadership on technology strategy, operational risk, and resource allocation.
• In compliance with RLF policies and procedures, perform technological tasks necessary for the protection of data.
Facilities Oversight
• Oversee staff managing the RLF satellite office in Sacramento and approximately five additional leases.
• Oversee staff managing co-working locations.
• Play a supportive role on staff retreats and other in-person connections.
• In collaboration with Human Resources, oversee RLF's health and safety programs.
Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Provide oversight and management of RLF's technology and operations budget.
• Serve as a member of the organizational Leadership Team.
• Build strong working relationships across the organization to ensure technology and operational solutions serve the varied needs of each team.
• Act as a trusted advisor and translator between technical/operational teams and non-technical staff and leadership.
Qualifications:
Note: These qualifications are guidelines, not hard and fast rules, so if you have 75% of the qualifications listed, we encourage you to apply. Experience can include paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work and lived experiences that helped you to build the competencies, knowledge, and skills needed for this position. Applying gives you the opportunity to be considered.
• 10+ years leading and managing technology and/or operations teams, with at least 5 years in a director-level or above role; nonprofit or mission-driven sector experience preferred.
• Demonstrated ability to move complex technology and systems projects from planning through implementation and adoption (e.g., ERP, CRM/Salesforce, financial systems, infrastructure migrations) at organizations of comparable size (50–200 staff) or larger.
• Experience leading the development and implementation of an organization-wide cybersecurity/data protection policy, with direct experience managing security incidents, vendor risk assessments, and compliance with relevant data protection standards.
• Hands-on experience evaluating and implementing enterprise software platforms, including grants management systems or other CRMs; Salesforce experience strongly preferred.
• 3+ years experience preferred working with a fiscal sponsor organization or comparable multi-entity structure, with direct exposure to how technology, operations, and facilities needs vary across sponsored projects with distinct programs, funding sources, and compliance requirements.
• Experience managing vendor relationships/contracts (IT, real estate, professional services) with demonstrated negotiation outcomes.
• Experience directly supervising staff and teams.
• Ability to handle sensitive personnel or organizational matters.
• Experience presenting to or advising senior leadership/board-level audiences.
• Experience operating in a remote-first or hybrid and growth-stage organization.
• A commitment to a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel welcomed, valued, and respected.
• Positive attitude and a commitment to being part of and building a positive work environment.
Commitment to Nondiscrimination:
We are committed to providing a work environment free from discrimination, where all team members feel valued, respected, and included. We know that our work is enriched by the varied voices and perspectives of every staff and board member, so we are committed to making an earnest effort to recruit, welcome, train, develop, and retain talented individuals from all backgrounds. We believe that a welcoming culture expands our creative capacity to do our work and achieve greater outcomes for people and the natural world.
Compensation and Benefits:
The anticipated salary range for the Technology Operations Director is $180,000 - $210,000 annually. The final offer will depend on work location, experience, and job-related qualifications.
We have an alternate Fridays off work schedule and offer a comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k plan with a 5% match, and generous paid time off. RLF also offers a technology allowance, student loan repayment assistance, the Calm app, mental health benefits and approximately 16 paid holidays per year.
To Apply:
Please provide a resume and cover letter explaining how your skills fit this position.
Recruitment Schedule
October 19th – Recruitment launches
November 2nd – Priority application deadline (applications received after this date may still be considered)
November 9th – Screening Interviews

jobs.title: Field CTO
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
About the role
We are currently hiring a Field CTO to join our Strategic Field Organization at a Principal Solutions Architect level to be based in Australia or Singapore. This role reports into our Global Head, Field CTOs. The Strategic Field Organization is a team of Principal Solutions Architects that supports global strategic prospects and customers. This team collaborates with the regional account teams to work together on large engagements that require a high degree of strategic planning - such as DevSecOps transformation, solution recommendations, and advisory for our customer's senior technical leadership.
Field Solutions Architects (SA) are the trusted advisors to GitLab prospects and customers during the presales motion. We demonstrate how the GitLab platform and GitLab Professional Services address common and unique business requirements. Our Solution Architect team adds value to GitLab's customers by providing subject matter expertise and industry experience throughout the sales process and collaborating internally with the product.
Our Field SA's also engage proactively with existing GitLab customers to provide thought-leadership, engage in innovative solutions, collaborate around evangelism activities around unique customer requirements (i.e. meetups and presentations) and continuously seek market feedback to improve the GitLab platform.
What you'll do
Create and maintain relationships with customer executives that contribute to large Net ARR deals and customer success
Provide executive-level, thought leadership on strategic opportunities (i.e., new logo and growth)
Curate and manage field feedback, while collaborating with the product team on roadmap and issue prioritization
Scale and grow regional-level expertise within the field (SAE/AE,SA,CSM) through contributions to enablement and content
Act as a prospect / customer advocate on DevSecOps transformation initiatives
Build and maintain select subject matter expertise related to GitLab targeted technology sectors through industry monitoring and participation in external working groups, committees and development projects
Keep up to date on GitLab-relevant emerging methodologies and technologies and leverage that knowledge to drive solution strategy and influence product strategy
What you'll bring
Significant experience as a CTO/ Principal Solution Architect with architecture of enterprise software development workflow
Experience delivering information/Cyber Security and compliance related solutions and assessments
Experience with software development tools, practices, and methodologies
Strong verbal and written skills with a strong ability to articulate and communicate strategies to all levels in an organization (i.e., executive to staff engineer)
Ability and willingness to learn and use GitLab as an integral part of the role
Ability to travel and comply with the company’s travel policy
How GitLab will support you
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental leave
Home office support
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave

jobs.title: Head of Product Management & Transformation (Risk, Finance & Compliance)
jobs.text:
We are looking for an experienced and visionary professional to join as Head of Product Management (Risk, Finance & Compliance), taking strategic responsibility for a newly established Product Management division within a leading Swiss banking environment.
In this key leadership position, you will be responsible for the strategic direction, development and management of the product portfolio across Risk, Finance and Compliance. You will act as a central interface between business functions, IT and Senior Management, ensuring that business requirements are translated into effective, sustainable and customer-oriented solutions.
The position combines strategic product management, leadership, digital transformation and stakeholder management, with a clear focus on measurable business value and the continuous development of end-to-end processes across the organisation.
Workload: 80–100%
Your Responsibilities
Take end-to-end responsibility for the Product Management division covering Risk, Finance & Compliance
Define and implement the strategic vision, product portfolio and roadmap for the relevant business areas
Develop customer-oriented solutions aligned with the needs of Business Owners and specialist departments
Manage the implementation and continuous development of products within the Agile Release Train
Lead and develop the Product Management team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus
Act as the central interface between Risk, Finance, Compliance, IT, Business Owners and other relevant stakeholders
Ensure that business requirements are translated into effective and sustainable IT solutions
Further develop and digitalise end-to-end business processes across applications, processes and channels
Ensure a measurable contribution of the product division to the organisation's strategic objectives, particularly in the areas of growth, efficiency and customer satisfaction
Lead and support transformation initiatives across Risk, Finance and Compliance
Manage complex stakeholder environments and align strategic priorities with implementation and IT delivery
Ensure that processes and solutions comply with regulatory and compliance requirements
Work closely with Senior Management and relevant internal and external stakeholders
Monitor performance, priorities and value contribution across the product portfolio
Identify opportunities for innovation, process optimisation and further development of the product landscape
Your Profile
Several years of professional experience in a leadership position within the financial services or banking industry
Strong understanding of Risk, Finance and Compliance processes within a banking environment
Proven experience in product management, product strategy and/or business transformation
Excellent understanding of end-to-end processes and value creation within the financial services sector
Experience leading and developing teams and managing complex organisational structures
Proven track record in transformation projects, as well as experience with agile methodologies and modern organisational structures
Strong understanding of IT and technological interdependencies, with the ability to bridge the gap between business and IT
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly when working with Senior Management
Entrepreneurial mindset combined with a pragmatic, decisive and results-oriented approach
Ability to set clear priorities and successfully drive strategic initiatives through to implementation
Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a hands-on execution mindset
University degree in Business Administration, Banking, Business Information Systems or a comparable field
Very good written and spoken German and English
What We Offer
A strategic leadership position with comprehensive responsibility for an entire Product Management division
The opportunity to actively shape a newly established Product Management organisation covering Risk, Finance & Compliance
Significant influence on the bank's digital transformation and future product landscape
A high degree of autonomy and entrepreneurial responsibility
Close collaboration with Senior Management, business functions and IT
A modern, agile and customer-oriented working environment
A flexible hybrid working model with home-office options
Attractive opportunities for professional development and career progression into leadership roles
A stable and future-oriented environment within an established Swiss financial institution

You will act as a central interface between business functions, IT and Senior Management, ensuring that business requirements are translated into effective, sustainable and customer-oriented solutions.

The position combines strategic product management, leadership, digital transformation and stakeholder management, with a clear focus on measurable business value and the continuous development of end-to-end processes across the organisation.
Workload: 80–100%
Your Responsibilities
Take end-to-end responsibility for the Product Management division covering Risk, Finance & Compliance
Define and implement the strategic vision, product portfolio and roadmap for the relevant business areas
Develop customer-oriented solutions aligned with the needs of Business Owners and specialist departments
Manage the implementation and continuous development of products within the Agile Release Train
Lead and develop the Product Management team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and customer focus
Act as the central interface between Risk, Finance, Compliance, IT, Business Owners and other relevant stakeholders
Ensure that business requirements are translated into effective and sustainable IT solutions
Further develop and digitalise end-to-end business processes across applications, processes and channels
Ensure a measurable contribution of the product division to the organisation's strategic objectives, particularly in the areas of growth, efficiency and customer satisfaction
Lead and support transformation initiatives across Risk, Finance and Compliance
Manage complex stakeholder environments and align strategic priorities with implementation and IT delivery
Ensure that processes and solutions comply with regulatory and compliance requirements
Work closely with Senior Management and relevant internal and external stakeholders
Monitor performance, priorities and value contribution across the product portfolio
Identify opportunities for innovation, process optimisation and further development of the product landscape
Your Profile
Several years of professional experience in a leadership position within the financial services or banking industry
Strong understanding of Risk, Finance and Compliance processes within a banking environment
Proven experience in product management, product strategy and/or business transformation
Excellent understanding of end-to-end processes and value creation within the financial services sector
Experience leading and developing teams and managing complex organisational structures
Proven track record in transformation projects, as well as experience with agile methodologies and modern organisational structures
Strong understanding of IT and technological interdependencies, with the ability to bridge the gap between business and IT
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, particularly when working with Senior Management
Entrepreneurial mindset combined with a pragmatic, decisive and results-oriented approach
Ability to set clear priorities and successfully drive strategic initiatives through to implementation
Strong analytical and conceptual skills combined with a hands-on execution mindset
University degree in Business Administration, Banking, Business Information Systems or a comparable field
Very good written and spoken German and English
What We Offer
A strategic leadership position with comprehensive responsibility for an entire Product Management division
The opportunity to actively shape a newly established Product Management organisation covering Risk, Finance & Compliance
Significant influence on the bank's digital transformation and future product landscape
A high degree of autonomy and entrepreneurial responsibility
Close collaboration with Senior Management, business functions and IT
A modern, agile and customer-oriented working environment
A flexible hybrid working model with home-office options
Attractive opportunities for professional development and career progression into leadership roles
A stable and future-oriented environment within an established Swiss financial institution

jobs.title: Senior Director of Product
jobs.text:
About Tekmetric
Tekmetric is the all-in-one, cloud-based software helping auto repair shops run smarter, grow faster, and serve customers better.
Built by a shop owner and shaped by the needs of the industry, Tekmetric brings together innovation, real-world experience, and a thriving community to help shops thrive - not just survive. From running a shop, to securing payments to engaging customers, our platform simplifies operations so shop owners can focus on what really matters: delivering exceptional service, earning trust, and growing sustainably.
Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.
But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.
Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.
Working the Tekmetric Way
At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.
We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.
We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.
Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.
At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.
What You’ll Do
The Senior Director of Product Management will be a thought leader who can drive strategy, innovation, and execution.We’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit, a creative problem-solver, and a strategic thinker who can take a bold approach to product development
Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Vision
Define and communicate a compelling product vision and multi-year strategy aligned to company goals.
Identify new opportunities across customer segments, markets, and workflows—balancing innovation with strong business fundamentals.
Lead annual and semi-annual product planning cycles, ensuring clear prioritization and resource alignment.
Leadership & Team Development
Directly lead multiple Directors/Group PMs and indirectly oversee the entire PM organization.
Recruit, coach, and mentor a high-performing PM team with a strong emphasis on accountability, customer insight, and product excellence.
Establish consistent product management standards, operating rhythms, rituals, and evaluation frameworks across teams.
Execution & Delivery
Ensure teams deliver high-quality product outcomes that measurably improve customer experience, operational efficiency, retention, and revenue.
Partner closely with Engineering and Design leadership to drive predictable delivery and continuous improvement in product development processes.
Remove obstacles, provide clarity, and reinforce a culture of data-driven decision-making.
Customer & Market Insight
Ability to deeply learn the auto repair domain with a focus on spending time in shops observing and subsequently building job maps for what is seen in a shop.
Stay deeply connected to customer needs, market dynamics, competitive forces, and emerging technologies.
Drive customer-centric discovery practices and ensure PM teams maintain a continuous understanding of user jobs, pain points, and opportunities.
Translate insights into clear product bets, hypotheses, and strategic investments.
Cross-Functional Alignment
Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to align product strategy with GTM execution.
Partner with Finance and RevOps on product forecasting, packaging, pricing, and KPI analytics.
Ensure entire organization has clear visibility into product priorities and progress.
Business Impact & Measurement
Define and own product KPIs that tie product outcomes to business outcomes (growth, retention, profitability).
Drive accountability for measurable results—ensuring teams understand what success looks like and how to achieve it.
Regularly present product strategy, roadmap, performance, and insights to executive leadership and the board.
Why You'll Love Working With Us
Health & Wellness That Have You Covered:
Enjoy the flexibility of remote work
Competitive base salaries that reflect your value.
Generous Paid Time Off, because we know you do your best work when you're well-rested.
Support for every stage of life—with paid maternity, parental bonding, and medical leave for you or your loved ones.
Comprehensive health benefits, including Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage. For employee only, we offer plans that cover 100% of premiums and we cover 50% of costs for families.
Prioritizing your mental health: get free, confidential counseling through our partnership with BetterHelp.
Investing in Your Future (and Present):
401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with 100% employer match on contributions up to 6% - so your future self will thank you.
Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Health Savings Accounts (HSA) to make your money go further.
Life and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) Insurance for added peace of mind.
Wellness on your terms: get up to $60/month toward fitness, mental health, or almost anything that helps you feel your best.
After one year of employment, enjoy a $300 home office setup bonus to help make your space work for you.
Keep growing with support for continuing education - we’re invested in your development.
Most importantly, we have a stellar team of coworkers, a really cool office, and lots of fun activities!
Tekmetric is an equal opportunity employer. We hire hard-working individuals, regardless of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative and successful.
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
Tekmetric will never ask for your personal financial or banking information or require any financial commitment as part of our candidate search or application process. No job offers will be made without a formal interview process. All legitimate Tekmetric job postings are listed at . Recruiter communications come from @tekmetric.com email addresses. jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
VP, Product
Role Overview
Ad Results Media (ARM) is building the next-generation operating platform that powers how the agency plans, buys, measures, and reports across audio and emerging channels. Internally known as the ARM Suite, this platform unifies order management, finance connectivity, and — over time — planning, buying, communications, and measurement into a single environment used by ARM, our clients, and our network partners.
We are seeking a Vice President, Product to serve as the internal product owner of the ARM Suite. This role is responsible for product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and governance. The VP, Product will partner closely with Analytics, Engineering, Strategy, Operations, Finance, and Client Services to translate agency and client needs into a durable, scalable product.
This role is both strategic and hands-on. The VP, Product will set long-term product direction while operating in the day-to-day decisions that shape how ARM Suite is built, governed, and adopted.
Platform Ownership & Impact
ARM Suite is transitioning from a vendor-led build to an internally owned product. This role mitigates vendor dependency risk, restores institutional knowledge, and ensures the platform evolves in alignment with how ARM actually wins, retains, and grows business.
The VP, Product will be accountable for ARM Suite as a product — not as a collection of features, dashboards, or vendor deliverables. That means owning the charter, defining what the platform is (and is not), establishing a prioritization framework, and making the trade-offs required to ship a durable system rather than a set of bespoke responses to internal requests.
ARM Suite is, at its core, an API-driven platform. It depends on durable pipelines to media buying systems, measurement partners, finance, network partners, and client-side data sources to keep users in ARM’s environment rather than dependent on parallel tools. The VP, Product owns the API and integration strategy that makes this possible.
Key Responsibilities
Product Vision & Roadmap
Be accountable for the end-to-end product vision and multi-year roadmap for the ARM Suite, including order management, finance connectivity, planning, buying, communications, and measurement workflows.
Translate ARM’s commercial strategy, client needs, and partner relationships into a clear product narrative and sequenced roadmap.
Define what ARM Suite is, what it is not, and what “done” looks like at each phase, with explicit trade-offs documented for leadership.
Own ARM Suite’s API and integration strategy, including API pipelines into media platforms, measurement partners, finance and billing systems, network partners, and third-party enrichment sources that keep users inside ARM Suite.
Vendor Reduction & Internal Capability Building
Lead the structured reduction of third-party dependency by extracting institutional knowledge, documenting business rules, and transitioning ownership of roadmap and prioritization in-house.
Review and approve product designs, scope, and delivery plans proposed by vendors; ensure work aligns to ARM’s long-term roadmap
Partner with the Senior Data Engineer to ensure clean separation between platform design (Product) and data correctness and pipeline ownership (Engineering / Analytics).
Governance, Prioritization & Intake
Establish and operate a product-governed intake and prioritization framework that replaces ad hoc requests with a defensible, transparent process — while preserving fast paths for revenue-critical work.
Define and enforce the authority split between Product (system design and prioritization) and Analytics (metric definitions, QA, and interpretation).
Document and socialize standards for product decisions, business rules, and platform constraints so they persist beyond individual contributors.
Partner with Analytics to operationalize a formal QA delegation model within ARM Suite intake and delivery workflows.
Cross-Functional Leadership
Serve as a trusted partner to Analytics & Insights, Reporting, Data Science, Strategy, Planning, Operations, Finance, and Client Services.
Bridge the gap between platform capability and agency workflows, ensuring product decisions reflect how ARM teams actually plan, buy, and report.
Influence and align senior leaders on roadmap sequencing, trade-offs, and investment cases without relying on positional authority alone.
Build a product practice over time — starting solo, with a clear path to scale through hires and contributors as the platform matures.
Client & Partner Orientation
Ground product decisions in real client and network-partner needs through structured exposure to top-revenue accounts, partner conversations, and pitch motions.
Ensure ARM Suite produces standardized, credible artifacts for sales, planning, and renewal motions rather than bespoke, one-off deliverables.
Position ARM Suite as a durable differentiator that creates switching costs and supports long-term client retention and expansion.
Ideal Candidate Profile
Required Experience
10+ years of product management experience, including senior product leadership (Director, Sr. Director, or VP) at a SaaS, agency-tech, ad-tech, mar-tech, or analytics platform company.
Demonstrated experience owning a B2B platform or product line end-to-end — vision, roadmap, prioritization, governance, and stakeholder management.
Track record of leading internal product ownership through transitions away from third-party engineering vendors, contractors, or outsourced build partners.
Experience operating in environments that combine internal teams with external engineering partners, with a clear philosophy on what should be owned in-house vs. outsourced.
Deep, hands-on capability with API-driven product design — including standing up API pipelines, integrating third-party data sources for user-facing enrichment, and shipping products built on APIs from scratch.
Preferred Experience
Prior experience in media, advertising, agency, ad-tech, or mar-tech environments, with an understanding of planning, buying, measurement, and client reporting.
Familiarity with order management, finance/billing connectivity, and workflow tools that span multiple internal stakeholders.
Broad working knowledge of APIs across the advertising, media, and ad-tech ecosystem (e.g., DSPs, programmatic platforms, measurement and attribution partners, audio and CTV systems), with a track record of using them to extend product capability.
Comfort working closely with Analytics, Data Engineering, and Data Science functions; able to engage substantively on data models, BI tooling, and measurement frameworks without owning them.
Experience standing up product governance, intake frameworks, and prioritization processes in organizations transitioning from ad hoc to durable operating models.
Personal Attributes
Strong communicator and executive-level storyteller; can move comfortably between vendor architecture reviews, leadership strategy discussions, and client-facing conversations.
Pragmatic and business-oriented, with an appreciation for balancing ideal product strategy with real-world commercial and operational constraints.
High ownership mindset; comfortable being the only product leader in the room and building the function from the ground up.
Collaborative, curious, and motivated by building durable systems that compound the value of every team they touch.
Ad Results Media is an equal opportunity employer. We value diverse perspectives and believe strong product organizations are built at the intersection of operational excellence, business judgment, and a deep understanding of how teams and clients actually work.

jobs.text:
Brief info about Vinted
Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:
Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.
Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.
Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.
Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.
About the Role
We are looking for a Director of Engineering to lead the Frontend Technologies domain within Marketplace. In this role, your mission will be two-fold:
Pivot our frontend setup for bigger efficiency: we have been operating in mostly the same frontend setup for at least 6 years, and recognize that change is imminent.
Drive strategic engineering initiatives: architect and implement platform-specific changes that enhance modularity, autonomy, resilience, and performance across Android, iOS, and Web.
You will have to balance and prioritize foundational capabilities - such as Design Systems, CI/CD, Modularization, App Releases, Performance, and Global UI quality - to optimize both frontend developer velocity and user satisfaction.
You will lead 4 Engineering Managers and 3 Staff Engineers and set and implement the FE strategy, which will impact the roadmaps of 9 Product domains within the Marketplace.
In this position, you will
Strategically:

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
About DemandBridge
DemandBridge builds the ERP and e-commerce software that print, promotional products, and marketing-services distributors run their businesses on, from order entry and inventory to procurement and online storefronts. Hundreds of distributors across North America rely on our platform to serve their clients faster, keep costs under control, and grow.
DemandBridge is part of Fluent Software Group (a Valsoft Corporation operating group), a global acquirer and operator of vertical market software businesses. We focus on specialized industries where expertise creates lasting advantages.
The Opportunity
We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to take our team through its most important chapter in years: building our next-generation ERP. This is a player-coach role — you'll manage and develop the team, raise the bar on how we build and ship software, and still get into the code and architecture yourself. You'll work hand-in-hand with a newly strengthened Product team to turn the roadmap into reliable, predictable delivery.
Location: Canada or US (remote)
The salary range for this role is $170,000 CAD– $200,000 CAD per year. Final compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, and location.
What You'll Own
Lead and Grow the Team
Manage, coach, and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, clear expectations, and consistent feedback
Assess the current team's strengths and gaps, and make recommendations on hiring, development, and structure
Hire and onboard engineers, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement
Build the Next-Generation ERP
Set technical direction and lead architecture decisions for the new ERP, including finalizing the technology stack (Java-based direction)
Stay hands-on: code reviews, design, prototyping, and contributing directly to critical components
Balance modernization with supporting existing product lines and current customers, and manage technical debt proactively
Raise the Bar on Engineering Practices and Delivery
Own the software development lifecycle: a shared sprint cadence, daily standups, retrospectives, and release schedules across all teams
Shorten and stabilize release cycles by strengthening automated testing, CI/CD, and Engineering's ownership of release quality
Set clear standards for code review, testing, and observability
Drive team adoption of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent)
Partner with Product
Engage early in epic kickoffs and discovery to provide sizing estimates and technical feasibility input
Own engineering capacity planning by quarter and sprint so roadmap commitments are realistic — and met
Communicate trade-offs, risks, and progress clearly to Product, Support, and leadership
Own Infrastructure, Reliability, and Compliance
Oversee IT/Infrastructure and Site Reliability Engineering alongside the software engineering team
Own production incidents and the on-call model, and act as the escalation point for outages and critical issues
Own the PCI compliance process end to end, from controls and audits through remediation
Own Azure cost optimization: track spend, right-size environments, and hold the team accountable for cloud costs
Keep the legacy platform (Linux, Perl, Spring Boot, Oracle, SQL) stable and secure while the next-generation ERP is built
What We're Looking For
8+ years in software development, including 3+ years managing engineering teams
Strong hands-on Java experience (back-end, enterprise applications) and genuine comfort still working in the code
Experience building or modernizing an ERP or complex transactional B2B systems (order management, inventory, accounting)
A track record of implementing agile practices, CI/CD, and test automation that made releases faster and more reliable
Strong relational database design and performance optimization skills
The ability to assess talent, give direct feedback, and make tough people decisions
Hands-on experience with Azure (AWS or GCP also considered), including managing and optimizing cloud spend
Experience building or leading a QA function and a test automation strategy
Experience owning production operations: on-call rotations, incident management, and Site Reliability Engineering practices
Experience with PCI DSS compliance, or a comparable security and compliance framework, in a production environment
Comfort supporting and modernizing legacy systems, including Linux, Perl, Spring Boot, Oracle, and SQL
Active, hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate technical issues into business impact
Strongly Preferred
Experience in distribution or supply chain software, or in the print and promotional products industry
Experience in an acquisitive, growth-stage vertical software business
Experience managing teams distributed across Canada and the U.S.
Join Us
Your next big build starts here. Join us to lead the team behind DemandBridge’s next-generation ERP.
We use AI-powered tools (including transcription and automated note-taking) during portions of our interview process to support a consistent and thorough candidate experience. Candidates who require alternative accommodation may request it at any stage of the recruitment process.
Fluent Software Group is committed to building diverse, equitable, and inclusive teams. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences, and all qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, gender, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.text:
The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.
Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.
At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!
Your Mission
The Agentic Engineering Director serves as a senior technical leader and authority responsible for advancing agentic software engineering and establishing Agentic Delivery Lifecycle (ADLC) capabilities as a core engineering discipline. The role will define standards, governance models, platforms, evaluation frameworks and reusable capabilities required to scale agentic-native software development. You will be partnering with Engineering, Product, Enterprise Architecture, Platform Engineering, Information Security, Data, DevOps, and AI teams. You will also be managing an Agentic engineering group as part of your day-to-day.
Key Responsibilities
Agentic and Technical Leadership and Management
Define engineering standards and best practices for agentic delivery.
Lead a group of Agentic Engineers.
Lead lighthouse implementations and mentor engineers from other teams.
Evaluate emerging models, frameworks and agentic platforms.
Create engineering accelerators and implementation playbooks.
ADLC Ownership and Evolution
Define and continuously improve ADLC standards.
Establish delivery patterns, control gates and certification requirements.
Own enterprise evaluation frameworks and agentic engineering harnesses.
Define benchmarking, regression testing and security evaluation standards.
Establish auditability, traceability, observability and rollback requirements.
Embed ADLC controls into CI/CD and operational platforms.
Agentic Platforms and Developer Experience
Define requirements for enterprise agentic platforms.
Guide the adoption of Code Agents.
Define model routing, context management, memory services and AI gateways.
Establish platform security, observability and resiliency requirements.
Agents, Skills and MCP Ecosystem
Define standards for approved agents, approved skills, workflows and MCP services.
Establish enterprise registries and certification frameworks.
Define prompt governance and lifecycle management.
Guide onboarding, monitoring, optimisation and retirement processes.
Governance, Security and Responsible AI
Define controls for hallucinations, prompt injection and insecure code generation.
Protect intellectual property, data and regulated workloads.
Define responsible AI requirements and risk acceptance processes.
Lead incident reviews and corrective actions.
Engineering Transformation and Adoption
Create adoption playbooks, academies and communities of practice.
Define capability models and career frameworks.
Measure adoption and maturity outcomes.
Value Realisation and Cost Management
Track productivity, quality, release frequency and developer experience.
Measure effectiveness of agents, skills and workflows.
Optimise token usage, model routing and platform efficiency.
Requirements
10+ years of software engineering experience.
5+ years in SW management roles.
Strong technical leadership and people management skills
Deep expertise in ADLC, cloud native architecture, CI/CD, and observability.
Expert proficiency with Code Agents and Agents Frameworks.
Experience building evaluation harnesses, benchmarking systems, and governance frameworks.
Pragmatic, data-driven, and outcomes-focused.
Champion of engineering excellence and responsible AI.
Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity, collaboration, and innovation. We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment and look forward to welcoming passionate professionals to our team. Join us on this exciting journey!
Benefits:
Private Medical Insurance.
Hybrid working model (office and home).
Global bonus plan.
Volunteering programs.
Prime office location near the Tel Aviv train station.

jobs.title: VP of Technology
jobs.text:
VP of Technical Delivery
Strong CRM
Location: Remote (US/Canada), with a distributed LATAM delivery team
Reports to: Founder/CEO
Team: ~45 delivery professionals across Salesforce clouds
About Strong CRM
Strong CRM is a bootstrapped, profitable Salesforce systems integrator that has grown from under $300K to roughly $5M in revenue in five years. We specialize in the high-complexity end of the ecosystem — Field Service Lightning, Revenue Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, MuleSoft, and Spiff — delivered by a talented, certification-heavy nearshore team. We serve roughly 80 active clients with a strong existing-client expansion engine and a reputation for doing the hard work that generalist shops can't.
We're at an inflection point. The founder currently carries both senior architecture and delivery leadership personally, and we're hiring a technical leader to own delivery end to end — so the practice can scale beyond any single person.
The Role
You will own the delivery organization: its quality, its margin, its people, and its technical standards. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a figurehead one. You'll be close enough to the work to make the hard architectural calls on complex engagements, and senior enough to build the systems, standards, and leaders that let delivery run without the founder in the loop. Success means that within 12 months, the founder is no longer the bottleneck or the senior technical escalation point for delivery — you are.
What You'll Own
Delivery leadership & client outcomes
Own end-to-end technical executiondelivery across all active and prospect engagements, including — scoping, staffing, sequencing, timelines, and client satisfaction
Serve as the senior delivery escalation point for at-risk projects, stepping in to recover timelines, scope, or client relationships when needed
Establish and run a delivery governance cadence — project health reviews, risk flagging, and status reporting — so problems surface early rather than at the deadline
Partner with clients as a trusted senior technical voice, especially on the largest and most complex accounts
Own delivery-driven client expansion — ensuring quality and proactive guidance turn engagements into repeat and expansion work
Margin, utilization & delivery economics
Own delivery gross margin and protect the margin profile that makes the business work
Manage team utilization, bench, and staffing efficiency across concurrent engagements
Improve estimation accuracy and scoping discipline so projects are priced and staffed to land profitably
Identify and reduce margin leakage — scope creep, over-servicing, rework, and mis-staffing
Provide the founder with clear, regular visibility into delivery metrics, capacity, and forecast
Technical authority & standards
Set architecture patterns, standards, and best practices across FSL, Revenue Cloud, FSC, Health Cloud, MuleSoft, and Spiff
Serve as the final technical decision-maker and escalation point on hard architectural problems
Establish and enforce code and configuration review practices, quality gates, and delivery standards
Drive reusable-asset and accelerator development so the team stops rebuilding the same solutions from scratch
Stay current on the Salesforce platform roadmap and guide how new capabilities are adopted into delivery
Team leadership & organizational scaling
Lead, mentor, and develop a ~45-person nearshore delivery team
Build the management layer beneath you — team leads, senior architects, and practice owners — so delivery scales beyond any single person
Own hiring, onboarding, and ramp for delivery roles, including workforce planning against pipeline
Set and drive the certification strategy across the specialized clouds
Own performance management — clear expectations, feedback, development paths, and accountability
Build and protect a culture of quality, ownership, and accountability across a distributed, cross-border team
Delivery operations & repeatability
Turn hard-won project patterns into documented, repeatable methodologies and delivery playbooks
Develop productized and accelerator-based delivery approaches that improve margin and shorten sales cycles
Own the delivery tooling and systems that support quality, visibility, and efficiency
Partner with sales on scoping, solutioning, and technical pre-sales for complex opportunities
Systematically reduce founder- and hero-dependency by building process where there is currently tribal knowledge
What We're Looking For
Senior technical consulting leadership in the Salesforce ecosystem — someone clients trust in the room, who can hold executive-level conversations, shape solutions, and be the credible senior voice on complex, high-stakes engagements
A track record of leading and scaling a sizable delivery organization — you've run delivery at meaningful scale and know how to bring structure, standards, and leadership to a growing team
The ability to provide technical leadership across our specialized clouds without being the hands-on builder — setting direction, making the hard architectural calls, and elevating the team's technical bar
A systems-builder who designs how an entire delivery org operates — methodologies, standards, quality, and repeatability — rather than solving problems one project at a time
Proven success leading distributed and/or nearshore teams, ideally LATAM — building quality, culture, and accountability across a remote, cross-border organization
The presence and judgment to operate as a true peer to the founder, and the credibility to own delivery and client relationships end to end
Nice to Have
Salesforce certifications across our specialized clouds
Experience climbing the Salesforce partner tier and working with Salesforce AEs and co-sell motions
Roofing, field-service, or other vertical experience
Experience in a bootstrapped or founder-led environment
Spanish or Portuguese
Why This Role
You'll take a profitable, respected, technically excellent practice and make it scalable — with real ownership over how delivery is built, and a founder who genuinely wants to hand you the keys rather than look over your shoulder. This is a rare chance to shape the technical and delivery backbone of a growing company at exactly the moment it's ready to scale.
Compensation & Benefits
Base salary range: $250,000–$300,000 per year. Actual base offered will depend on experience, depth of Salesforce delivery leadership, and demonstrated ability to lead at scale.
In addition to base salary, this role includes:
Performance-based incentive compensation tied to delivery margin, utilization, client outcomes, and organizational milestones (target and structure discussed during the process)
Health benefits (medical, dental, and vision)
Retirement plan with 4% company matchcontribution
Paid time off and company holidays
Additional benefits and perquisites discussed during the interview process
