jobs.text:
Compensation Range:
$ 175-$250K
Job Title: Senior Director, Strategic Technology Partnerships
Location: US REMOTE
Industry: Data Center Cooling / Thermal Management / Digital Infrastructure
Company: Munters Corporation
About US: Munters is a global leader in climate solutions for mission-critical processes. We offer innovative, efficient and sustainable solutions for customers in industries where controlling indoor humidity, temperature and energy efficiency is mission critical. Climate control systems often account for a large percentage of energy consumption in many of our customers’ operations. With an optimal climate system, we can help them to more efficiently use energy or water resources and thereby reduce their climate and environmental impact. Sustainability is an important part of Munters’ business strategy and value creation. We pride ourselves on fostering a dynamic and inclusive work environment where interns are valued members of the team and are given meaningful projects to work on.
Job Summary:
We are seeking a senior leader to help shape the future of our company’s growth by building strategic relationships across the upstream data center technology ecosystem – including chip manufacturers, server manufacturers, OEMs, ODMs & Hyperscale’s who are developing the next generation of computing.
The purpose of this role is to give the company early visibility into where compute, server and rack-level architecture are headed, translate those shifts into future cooling and thermal-management requirements, and help position our product roadmap and partnerships ahead of market demand. The ideal candidate will bring deep industry knowledge, strong executive-level relationships, and a proven ability to connect technology roadmaps across semiconductor, server, OEM, ODM, and hyperscale ecosystems.
This person will serve as a bridge between external technology leaders and our internal commercial and engineering teams, helping us anticipate future cooling and thermal-management needs and position our products and partnerships ahead of market demand.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and lead an ecosystem strategy for upstream data center technology players, including chip manufacturers, server OEMs/ODMs, rack/system designers, hyperscale’s, and other key partners.
Build and maintain senior commercial and technical relationships that provide early visibility into computing, server, rack, power, and cooling technology roadmaps.
Monitor technology trends in processors, accelerators, server architecture, rack density, power consumption, liquid cooling, and thermal management.
Translate external technology trends and partner roadmaps into actionable insights for internal product strategy, engineering priorities, and innovation planning.
Connect our engineering and technical teams with counterpart technical teams at strategic partner organizations.
Identify and develop opportunities for early design involvement, joint development, co-development, and long-term strategic partnerships.
Help position the company to develop products and solutions that are market-ready as next-generation technologies are commercialized.
Influence internal planning by providing forward-looking market intelligence rather than relying solely on direct customer requests.
Represent the company at key industry events, consortiums, standards groups, and executive meetings.
Education/Desired Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree required; technical or business advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of senior-level business development, strategic partnerships, or market development experience in one or more of the following:
Data center infrastructure/Thermal management / cooling/ Server hardware/Semiconductor / chip ecosystem/Digital infrastructure
Strong existing network of contacts within chip manufacturers, server manufacturers, OEMs, ODMs, and related technology providers.
Demonstrated success building relationships that lead to strategic partnerships, co-development opportunities, or early access to product/technology roadmaps.
Strong understanding of how semiconductors and server technology impact data center infrastructure requirements, especially cooling and thermal design.
Experience working across technical and commercial teams and translating market direction into product strategy.
Executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with senior leaders, engineers, and product teams across multiple organizations.
Strong communication, influence, and relationship-building skills.
Experience in international business environments and cross-cultural collaboration preferred.
Experience working with or selling into hyperscale’s, colocation providers, server manufacturers, or semiconductor companies.
Familiarity with emerging cooling technologies, including liquid cooling, direct-to-chip, immersion, high-density rack cooling, and related thermal solutions.
Participation in industry associations, standards bodies, or technical forums relevant to data centers, servers, or advanced computing.
Proven ability to identify future market requirements before formal customer demand is established.
Benefits:
Competitive Salary
Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans
Flexible work schedule
Generous vacation and paid time off
401K retirement savings plan with employer matching
Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement, and conference attendance
Company-sponsored social events and team-building activities
Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
All offers are contingent on a pre-employment drug test and background check, as applicable for the position.

We are seeking a senior leader to help shape the future of our company’s growth by building strategic relationships across the upstream data center technology ecosystem – including chip manufacturers, server manufacturers, OEMs, ODMs & Hyperscale’s who are developing the next generation of computing.

The purpose of this role is to give the company early visibility into where compute, server and rack-level architecture are headed, translate those shifts into future cooling and thermal-management requirements, and help position our product roadmap and partnerships ahead of market demand. The ideal candidate will bring deep industry knowledge, strong executive-level relationships, and a proven ability to connect technology roadmaps across semiconductor, server, OEM, ODM, and hyperscale ecosystems.

This person will serve as a bridge between external technology leaders and our internal commercial and engineering teams, helping us anticipate future cooling and thermal-management needs and position our products and partnerships ahead of market demand.
Key Responsibilities:

items: Develop and lead an ecosystem strategy for upstream data center technology players, including chip manufacturers, server OEMs/ODMs, rack/system designers, hyperscale’s, and other key partners.
Build and maintain senior commercial and technical relationships that provide early visibility into computing, server, rack, power, and cooling technology roadmaps.
Monitor technology trends in processors, accelerators, server architecture, rack density, power consumption, liquid cooling, and thermal management.
Translate external technology trends and partner roadmaps into actionable insights for internal product strategy, engineering priorities, and innovation planning.
Connect our engineering and technical teams with counterpart technical teams at strategic partner organizations.
Identify and develop opportunities for early design involvement, joint development, co-development, and long-term strategic partnerships.
Help position the company to develop products and solutions that are market-ready as next-generation technologies are commercialized.
Influence internal planning by providing forward-looking market intelligence rather than relying solely on direct customer requests.
Represent the company at key industry events, consortiums, standards groups, and executive meetings.

blocks.text: Education/Desired Qualifications:

items: Bachelor’s degree required; technical or business advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of senior-level business development, strategic partnerships, or market development experience in one or more of the following:
Data center infrastructure/Thermal management / cooling/ Server hardware/Semiconductor / chip ecosystem/Digital infrastructure
Strong existing network of contacts within chip manufacturers, server manufacturers, OEMs, ODMs, and related technology providers.
Demonstrated success building relationships that lead to strategic partnerships, co-development opportunities, or early access to product/technology roadmaps.
Strong understanding of how semiconductors and server technology impact data center infrastructure requirements, especially cooling and thermal design.
Experience working across technical and commercial teams and translating market direction into product strategy.
Executive presence and the ability to engage credibly with senior leaders, engineers, and product teams across multiple organizations.
Strong communication, influence, and relationship-building skills.
Experience in international business environments and cross-cultural collaboration preferred.
Experience working with or selling into hyperscale’s, colocation providers, server manufacturers, or semiconductor companies.
Familiarity with emerging cooling technologies, including liquid cooling, direct-to-chip, immersion, high-density rack cooling, and related thermal solutions.
Participation in industry associations, standards bodies, or technical forums relevant to data centers, servers, or advanced computing.
Proven ability to identify future market requirements before formal customer demand is established.

jobs.title: Director, Data Engineering & Analytics
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Relation Insurance is a leading, innovative company with a strong commitment to excellence and a passion for delivering cutting-edge solutions to our clients. As a key player in the insurance market, we pride ourselves on our dynamic culture, collaborative environment, and continuous drive for success. With a rich history and a bright future ahead, we are looking for exceptional individuals to join our team and contribute to our ongoing growth and success.
WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
The Director, Data Engineering and Analytics leads the strategy, architecture, delivery, and continuous improvement of Relation’s enterprise data engineering and analytics capabilities. The individual in this role owns the data platform and analytics function end to end, ensuring scalable, reliable, secure, and trusted data solutions that support business priorities and measurable outcomes. The Director provides hands-on technical leadership, advances the responsible use of automation and proprietary AI, and leads and develops data engineering and analytics professionals.
The Director partners with executive, business, and technology leaders to translate priorities into a practical data roadmap and drive execution. The individual in this role establishes standards for data architecture, integration, quality, governance, security, reporting, and analytics while remaining sufficiently hands-on to guide complex technical work, resolve issues, and clearly communicate data, tradeoffs, and risk to non-technical stakeholders.
A GLIMPSE INTO YOUR DAY
Ownership and Accountability
Owns Relation’s data engineering and analytics function end to end, with full responsibility and accountability for execution and outcomes.
Translates business priorities, as set by executive and business leadership, into the data and analytics roadmap, sequences the work within those priorities, and drives it to completion, owning the outcome regardless of team size.
Serves as the primary point of contact and accountable authority for executives, business leaders, auditors, and carrier partners on data, reporting, and analytics matters.
Provides executive-ready reporting on platform health, delivery progress, data quality, and data risk, and walks executives through the numbers in plain language.
Partners with IT, Information Security, Finance, Operations, and business leadership to obtain source access, implement controls, and drive adoption, while retaining accountability for data interpretation and outcomes.
Personally designs, builds, and maintains production data pipelines from core brokerage and enterprise systems.
Owns data processes end to end: understanding the business need, profiling source data, modeling, transforming, validating, delivering, and supporting the result in production.
Writes production-quality SQL, Python, and PySpark as a regular part of the job; troubleshoots failed loads, data discrepancies, and performance issues down to the root cause.
Builds and maintains curated, reusable datasets and data models for core domains (e.g., Client, Policy, Submission, Carrier, Producer, Revenue, Commission).
Defines and standardizes KPI logic and Power BI semantic models (e.g., premium, revenue, retention, hit ratio, pipeline, cross-sell, service metrics) so the business works from one version of the truth.
Builds and delivers executive dashboards and self-service reporting, and works directly with business stakeholders to drive adoption.
Makes practical architecture decisions for the lakehouse platform (medallion bronze/silver/gold layers, ELT patterns, orchestration) with a focus on reliability, simplicity, and cost.
Directs AI coding agents as the function’s primary delivery capacity: decomposes initiatives into well-specified tasks, delegates implementation, testing, documentation, and source-data analysis to agents, reviews the output, and ships the result.
Builds AI-driven validation into every data process, including automated reconciliation, anomaly detection, and agent-based review of code and outputs, while remaining personally accountable for the accuracy of anything AI produces.
Sets and enforces the standards for secure, effective use of AI, and coaches any team members on working AI-first, including keeping sensitive client and employee data within approved tools and environments, maintaining human review of AI output before it reaches production or the business, and partnering with Information Security on AI governance.
Identifies and delivers opportunities to apply AI and automation to manual reporting, reconciliation, and data-entry work across the business.
Builds and operates production LLM-powered data workflows, such as document and data extraction from carrier and client documents, classification, and automated validation, with the same engineering rigor as any other pipeline.
Keeps the platform AI-maintainable: well-structured, documented, tested, and reproducible, so that any pipeline or report can be understood, modified, and recovered by an agent or another engineer without tribal knowledge.
Continuously evaluates new AI capabilities and adopts the ones that measurably improve speed, quality, or coverage. Leads, coaches, and develops data engineering and analytics professionals through hands-on work alongside the team, establishing clear expectations, accountability, technical standards, and opportunities for career growth. Reviews code and data models, whether produced by team members or AI agents, pairs on difficult problems, and raises the technical bar through practical coaching.
Manages intake of data requests, aligns prioritization with business leadership, sets realistic timelines, and keeps business partners informed.
Establishes lightweight engineering standards: Git-based workflows in GitHub, pull request review, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), testing, documentation, and production support, and applies them equally to the team’s work and to the output of AI agents.
Sets clear goals, provides ongoing feedback and performance management, and supports succession and development planning.
Defines and enforces data quality controls, testing, monitoring, and incident response (data SLAs).
Maintains practical governance: documentation, data definitions, lineage, and certified datasets, and supplies the data-flow and system inventory that Information Security relies on for enterprise data mapping.
Ensures access controls and privacy-by-design for sensitive data (client PII, financial data), including retention and auditability aligned to company risk/compliance standards.
Performs other projects, duties, and tasks, as assigned.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN THIS ROLE
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, data architecture, data analytics or related technology roles.
Demonstrated ability to operate as the accountable owner of a data platform or analytics function, delivering outcomes against priorities set by the business.
Previous leadership experience, including responsibility for leading and developing technical teams, people leaders, projects, or complex cross-functional initiatives.
Currently hands-on: writes production SQL, Python, and PySpark as a regular part of the job, not only reviews it.
Demonstrated track record of owning data processes end to end and delivering measurable business outcomes.
Deep, daily, hands-on use of AI across the full engineering lifecycle, including agentic coding tools, LLM APIs, and automated validation, with concrete examples of delegating substantial multi-step work to AI agents, catching their mistakes, and owning the result.
Expertise in:
­ Data modeling (dimensional + operational/normalized patterns), MDM concepts, and entity resolution across systems and acquired agencies
SQL, Python, and Spark (PySpark)
Lakehouse and medallion architecture, ELT, orchestration, and pipeline reliability patterns
Data quality testing, reconciliation, observability, and production support
Role-based access controls, secure data handling, and audit-ready processes
Specifying, orchestrating, and reviewing the work of AI coding agents, including evaluation of AI-generated code, data, and analysis
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; comfortable presenting to and advising executives, and able to explain data, tradeoffs, and risk clearly to non-technical partners.
Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and competing executive priorities and to prioritize calmly in a fast-paced environment.
Detail-oriented while maintaining a strategic, enterprise-level perspective.
WHY CHOOSE RELATION?
Competitive pay.
A safe and healthy work environment provided by our robust benefit program including family health and wellness programs, 401K, employee assistance programs, paid time off, paid holidays and more.
Career advancement and development opportunities.
.
Note: The above is not all encompassing of the full position description.
Relation Insurance Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Relation, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is presented within this posting.
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
.
$178,000.00 - $294,000.00

jobs.title: Digital Product Strategy & Delivery Director
jobs.text:
At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone. We put people first, and work hand in hand with employees and customers to create a diverse and inclusive environment. Passionate about building insurance and financial services solutions, we push the boundaries of what’s possible. We need you to help us shape what’s next. You’ll be encouraged to share your experiences, ideas and skills to help others take control of their financial future.
Join a team that has received numerous awards for being a top place to work: TruStage awards and recognition
Job Purpose:
Leads the strategy, performance, and long-term direction of a portfolio of digital products and experiences. Guides Digital Product Owners in shaping product visions and roadmaps, participating directly in business strategy and performance discussions, and leading cross-functional product teams to deliver digital experiences that drive measurable business, customer, operational, and enterprise results.
Leverages and strengthens a product-centric operating model that brings Product, Design, Technology, Analytics, and business partners together around shared outcomes. Uses this model to enable Digital Product Owners to lead with clear accountability, build effective cross-functional teams, and move work from strategy through delivery, measurement, and continuous improvement.
Job Responsibilities:
Portfolio Strategy & Outcomes
Set the portfolio vision, strategy, measures, and long-term capability direction in line with enterprise and business priorities.
Take responsibility for overall portfolio performance and ensure product strategies and roadmaps add up to the expected results.
Turn enterprise goals, business opportunities, customer needs, operating challenges, compliance requirements, and platform needs into a coherent set of digital capabilities and experiences.
Balance immediate outcomes with modernization, maintenance, stability, compliance, accessibility, technical health, and long-term sustainability.
Recommend portfolio investments and resolve tradeoffs among cross-functional product teams when demand exceeds capacity.
Business Engagement & Digital Direction
Develop and direct Digital Product Owners to serve as active leaders in business strategy and planning, accountable for translating desired outcomes into the right product and experience direction.
Guide business leaders in understanding how digital experiences, data, customer insight, and emerging capabilities can expand what the business is trying to achieve.
Position Digital Product Owners as the primary point of engagement for capability and experience decisions within their cross-functional product teams.
Portfolio Governance
Organize each cross-functional product team around clear outcomes and provide the recurring capabilities it needs to carry work from opportunity through sustained performance.
Give Digital Product Owners room to lead while maintaining clear escalation points, portfolio alignment, and accountability for results.
Build effective cross-functional teams by assembling the skills and capacity needed from across the organization and establishing shared accountability for operating as a single, autonomous delivery team.
Resolve dependencies and decisions across cross-functional product teams at the lowest practical level without sacrificing shared capabilities or long-term commitments to short-term priorities.
Product Management & Talent Leadership
Lead, coach, and develop Digital Product Owners and other managers and professional staff, building leadership depth and succession readiness across the portfolio.
Develop Digital Product Owners who act as trusted business partners, lead across functions, make sound product decisions, and remain accountable for results and long-term value.
Establish clear Product Owner accountability for product vision, strategy, roadmaps, priorities, sequencing, backlog decisions, and results across the full product lifecycle.
Set consistent expectations for discovery, research, experimentation, analytics, prioritization, value realization, and ongoing product health without limiting Product Owner autonomy.
Strengthen the Product Management competency and build needed organizational capabilities through shared practices, coaching, talent development, succession planning, and continuous improvement.
Innovation & Future Capability Development
Monitor emerging technologies, customer expectations, market shifts, and digital practices and identify where they create practical opportunities for the portfolio.
Bring forward ideas that can improve results, raise business ambition, or create new value.
Test and adopt new capabilities through the appropriate cross-functional product teams, with clear ownership from concept through measurement.
Move successful ideas into durable product roadmaps and operating ownership.
The above statement of duties is not intended to be all inclusive and other duties will be assigned from time to time.
Job Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent combination of education and/or related professional work experience.
12+ years of progressive experience in digital strategy, product management, customer experience, marketing, servicing, analytics, technology-enabled transformation, or a related field.
7+ years of leadership experience, including developing leaders, leading cross-functional teams, and building organizational capabilities.
A record of leading a portfolio of digital products or capabilities and delivering measurable business, customer, operational, strategic, or enterprise results.
Experience making Product Owners and cross-functional product teams active participants in business strategy, planning, and performance management.
Experience establishing product-centered operating models, cross-functional product teams, product roadmaps, decision rights, and lifecycle practices.
Ability to lead through influence and align senior leaders across business, Product, Design, Marketing, Analytics, Architecture, Engineering, Creative, and other functions.
Strong business and digital judgment, with the ability to shape strategy, challenge assumptions, prioritize investment, manage competing needs, and make decisions that advance enterprise objectives.
Strong communication, relationship management, organizational leadership, and executive presentation skills.
Preferred
Experience in a financial services organization or heavily regulated industry.
At this time, we're not considering applicants that need any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS
NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc.
If you’re ready to help make a difference, apply today.A resume is required to apply. TruStage may process applicant information using an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool.This tool automatically generates a screening score based on how well applicant information matches the requirements and qualifications for the position. TruStage recruiters use the screening score as a guide to further evaluate candidates; the score is one component of an application review and does not automatically determine whether a candidate moves forward.Candidates may choose to opt out of this process.
Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan and exemption status.
Base Salary Range:
$154,100.00 - $286,600.00
At TruStage, we believe a sound, inclusive benefits program is of vital importance, along with a flexible workplace that allows for work-life balance, career growth and retirement assistance. In addition to your base pay, your position may be eligible for an annual incentive (bonus) plan. Additional benefits available to eligible employees include medical, dental, vision, employee assistance program, life insurance, disability plans, parental leave, paid time off, 401k, and tuition reimbursement, just to name a few. Beyond pay and benefits, we also recognize that flexibility, including working in a place you prefer, is essential to caring for our employees. We will continue to strive to offer flexibility and invest in technology and other tools that will make hybrid working normal rather than an exception, so that when “life happens,” you can focus on what’s most important.
Accommodation request
TruStage is a place where everyone can bring their best self and thrive. If you need application or interview process accommodations, please contact the accessibility department.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Energy Engineering Management
jobs.text:
COMPANY OVERVIEW
Moss is a national privately held construction firm providing innovative solutions resulting in award-winning projects. With regional offices across the United States, Moss focuses on construction management, PV Solar & BESS EPC, design-build, and public-private partnerships. The company's diverse portfolio encompasses a wide range of sectors, including luxury high-rise residential, landmark mixed-use developments, hospitality, K-12 and higher education, justice, solar energy and battery storage, and sports. Moss is ranked by Engineering News-Record as one of the nation's top 65 general contractors, and the 3rd ranked solar EPC nationwide. Moss prides itself on a strong entrepreneurial culture that honors safety, quality, client engagement, and employee development.
POSITION SCOPE AND ORGANIZATIONAL IMPACT
The Senior Director, Engineering Management is a strategic leader responsible for aligning departmental execution with the broader business objectives of Moss'sEnergy Division. This role provides leadership and direction for the Engineering Management team within Moss's solar and renewable energy EPC business, translating organizational goals into portfolio strategy, resource planning, and partner engagement frameworks.
The Senior Director is accountable for the engineering portfolio's overall success, including client satisfaction, Engineer of Record (EOR) strategy, talent planning, and cross-functional stakeholder alignment. Serving as a key partner to executive leadership, this individual drives portfolio performance, delivery predictability, and commercial outcomes while ensuring the organization is positioned to scale effectively.
Working through Directors and Senior Managers, the Senior Director empowers leaders to oversee day-to-day portfolio execution, EOR performance, and the standardization of engineering processes and best practices. While operational responsibilities are delegated, this role retains ultimate accountability for departmental performance and serves as a trusted advisor to the Vice President on strategic priorities, organizational effectiveness, and portfolio health.
ESSENTIAL JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Define team portfolios, regional assignments, and resource strategy.
Coordinate with Preconstruction Management and Business Development on future project pipeline strategy.
Own hiring strategy and execution, including 6-month and 1-year workforce plans.
Define and track OKRs and 90/180-day plans for the organization.
Own the EOR strategic relationship, including MSA review and contract standardization.
Define roles, responsibilities, and governance frameworks across the Engineering Management organization.
Drive stakeholder services strategy and build trust with Owners, Trade Partners, EORs, and internal teams.
Resolve major commercial, multi-stakeholder, and project-level escalations with sound judgment and a bias for action.
Perform other duties as assigned.
EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related technical field required.
Master's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or Business Administration is preferred.
Professional Engineer (PE) license or comparable technical credential is preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience in engineering, design management, or construction, including significant experience in the solar or renewable energy EPC sector.
10+ years leading engineering or project teams, with proven accountability for portfolio-level commercial and delivery outcomes.
Demonstrated experience managing external design partners or Engineers of Record, including contract negotiation, MSA governance, and performance management.
Track record of building and scaling teams to match pipeline growth across multiple regions and owners.
Strategic leadership: ability to set direction, define governance frameworks, and translate enterprise goals into executable portfolio strategy.
Commercial acumen: manages contracts, budgets, and value engineering with discipline and price competitiveness in view.
Stakeholder alignment: builds trust with Owners, Trade Partners, EORs, and internal teams across Preconstruction, Procurement, and Construction.
Talent development: owns hiring strategy, coaches Directors and Senior Managers, and builds bench strength for the function.
Decision quality: resolves complex, multi-stakeholder escalations with sound judgment and a bias for action.
Fort Lauderdale-based: Willingness to travel as required to support portfolio oversight and stakeholder engagement.
Remote-based: Ability to travel 50% to Fort Lauderdale to visit the office for team building, company and client meetings, and to support portfolio oversight and stakeholder engagement.
JOB TITLE: SENIOR DIRECTOR, ENGINEERING MANAGEMENT
JOB LOCATION: FORT LAUDERDALE, FL OR REMOTE with 50% TRAVEL
CLASSIFICATION: FULL-TIME – EXEMPT – SALARIED
REPORTS TO: VICE PRESIDENT, ENGINEERING
Moss is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Details
Kemper is one of the nation’s leading specialized insurers. Our success is a direct reflection of the talented and diverse people who make a positive difference in the lives of our customers every day. We believe a high-performing culture, valuable opportunities for personal development and professional challenge, and a healthy work-life balance can be highly motivating and productive. Kemper’s products and services are making a real difference to our customers, who have unique and evolving needs. By joining our team, you are helping to provide an experience to our stakeholders that delivers on our promises.
Position Summary
Responsible for leading the enterprise strategy, development, and delivery of data, analytics, artificial intelligence, and intelligent automation solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. Oversee enterprise data engineering, data products, governance, analytics enablement, and AI capabilities to improve operational efficiency, decision-making, customer experience, and business growth.
Position Responsibilities
Enterprise Data & AI Strategy: Develop and execute enterprise data, analytics, and AI strategies aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and technology priorities. Establish strategic roadmaps, investment priorities, and performance measures that deliver measurable business value.
Data Engineering & Data Products: Lead enterprise data engineering, modern cloud data platforms, data architecture, and reusable data products. Drive scalable, secure, and integrated data solutions that support business operations, analytics, digital capabilities, and AI adoption.
Data Governance & Quality: Establish enterprise data governance frameworks, standards, and accountability for data quality, security, privacy, metadata, lineage, and master data management. Partner with business and risk leaders to ensure regulatory compliance and trusted enterprise data.
Artificial Intelligence & Intelligent Automation: Partner with application teams on the development, implementation, and adoption of enterprise AI, machine learning, generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions. Establish responsible AI practices, governance, and operational controls while driving measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, and business performance.
Analytics & Business Enablement: Partner with business leaders to advance enterprise analytics, self-service reporting, predictive insights, and data-driven decision-making. Promote consistent performance measures, reusable analytics capabilities, and solutions that improve business outcomes.
Position Qualifications
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, or a related field required.
Master's degree, MBA, or advanced technical degree preferred.
Experience
At least 10 years’ experience in technology, data, analytics, or artificial intelligence, including significant executive leadership experience
At least 8 years’ experience leading and developing teams
Demonstrated experience leading enterprise data engineering, cloud data platforms, data architecture, governance, and data product development.
Proven success developing and implementing enterprise AI strategies, including generative AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, and responsible AI governance.
Extensive experience translating data and AI investments into scalable business solutions, production adoption, and measurable operational or financial outcomes.
Strong understanding of data security, privacy, regulatory compliance, and technology risk management, preferably within insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry.
Demonstrated ability to develop enterprise technology strategies, manage complex portfolios and budgets, and lead cross-functional transformation initiatives
This position is a remote role and can work from a US based home. The qualified candidate will need to be able to travel occasionally.
The range for this position is $225,000 to $275,000. When determining candidate offers, we consider experience, skills, education, certifications, and geographic location among other factors. This job is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, equity and Kemper benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision, PTO, 401k, etc.).
Kemper is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, disability status or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We are committed to supporting diversity and equality across our organization and we work diligently to maintain a workplace free from discrimination. Kemper is focused on expanding our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion efforts to align with our vision, mission, and guiding principles.
Kemper does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of Kemper and Kemper will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.
Kemper will never request personal information, such as your social security number or banking information, via text or email. Additionally, Kemper does not use external messaging applications like WireApp or Skype to communicate with candidates. If you receive such a message, delete it.

jobs.title: Product Director - B2C
jobs.text:
Company Overview
Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 500+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity. Having sold 15+ million eSIMs and generated in excess of $500m revenue, Holafly is a company that is rapidly scaling. We’re not just connecting people - we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them.
The Product Director B2C, is the most important role in the Product team, you will shape and drive the strategic vision across web and apps for millions of current and future customers.
Key Responsibilities
Set the Product Vision: Own the end-to-end B2C product vision across Acquisition, Activation & Support, Checkout & Payments, and Recurrence, with the Exec team and Senior Leadership following and buying into the strategy and roadmap.
Deliver Business Outcomes: You will live and breathe data and insights, balancing instinct alongside objective measures to drive conversion, activation, recurrence rate, engagement and revenue growth against ambitious commercial targets.
Lead by Example: Maintain hands-on ownership over a key product area to set high delivery standards while steering the broader B2C Product team.
Define the Value Proposition: As the leader of Product Marketing, your team in partnership with the Marketing team will be instrumental in defining the Holafly B2C value proposition.
Nurture Product Culture: Scale and mentor a high-performing product team, deeply embedding design, data, and engineering alongside Product.
Maximize Strategic Assets: Treat Holafly’s ownership of its core network as a strategic asset and source of durable competitive advantage. Turn that advantage into clear customer outcomes, ensuring network capabilities, service quality, and roadmap decisions continue to strengthen Holafly’s differentiation.
Qualifications
Proven B2C Scale:Track record leading multi team B2C product organisations across web and app, ideally within travel, subscriptions, or high-frequency e-commerce.
Commercial Fluency: Strong mastery of data, commercial metrics, and setting explicit trade-offs between growth, quality, and unit economics.
Hands-on Execution: Demonstrated ability to dive deep into details while managing high-level organisational structure and cross-functional dependencies.
Focus on Retention: Proven success building long-term recurring value and customer loyalty, backed by rigorous analytical rigor.
Team Building: Experienced in hiring, coaching, and building a strong Product function.
AI Implementation: Practical experience using AI to enhance internal product workflows and to step change the customer experience.
Nice to have
Network/Telco Insights: Knowledge of carrier systems or connectivity assets to convert technical capabilities into compelling consumer features.
Benefits & Perks
Fully Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with trust-based flexibility and a focus on work-life balance.
Global Impact: Join an international, high-growth scale-up disrupting global connectivity.
Competitive Package: Enjoy comprehensive benefits, continuous learning, and real opportunities for career growth.

Your role will be pivotal in building and managing a competitive technical team that aligns with our business goals.## Responsibilities* Define the company's technological vision and strategy.* Lead the research, development, and deployment of new technologies.* Build and manage a high-performing technical team.* Collaborate with other departments to align technology with business goals.* Ensure the company's technological processes and service comply with all requirements, laws, and regulations.## Required Skills and Qualifications* Proven experience as a software engineer.* Strong leadership skills with experience building and managing technical teams.* Excellent knowledge of software development and infrastructure.* Ability to conduct technological analyses and research.* Strategic thinking and strong business acumen.## ExperienceCandidates should have between 4 to 11 years of experience in the technology field, with a significant portion of that time spent in leadership roles overseeing software engineering projects and teams.## LocationThis is an international position, and the successful candidate will have the opportunity to work with teams from around the globe.## Join Our TeamIf you are a seasoned software engineer with a passion for technology and leadership, and you're looking for an exciting new challenge at an international level, we invite you to apply for the Chief Technology Officer position at Brainlyne.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
As Head of Product, your mission is to lead the product organization that builds what our users bank with every day, ensuring they get the safe, smart and effortless banking they expect.
Why this matters:
At bunq, our mission is to Make Life Easy, for our users, our teams, and the world around us.
Every team plays a unique role in making this mission a reality. The Product team does this by building and improving the products our users bank with, while keeping them safe and compliant.
As Head of Product, you contribute by setting product direction and leading the product leaders who deliver it, helping us grow as the bank of The Free.
Take ownership:
As Head of Product, you’ll take charge of key responsibilities that directly impact bunq’s growth and our users’ seamless experience:
Grow our users’ use of bunq’s products by leading product strategy and delivery for your area.
Keep growth and safety moving together, so that fraud, compliance and quality are built into the products rather than bolted on.
Build a strong, AI-first product organization by leading Product Owners and Team Leads, and redesigning how the function works around AI agents instead of adding headcount by default.
Be bunq’s product voice with the management board, regulators, auditors and partners.
You’ve led a technical product organization and can get hands-on when needed. Size of organization isn’t the bar.
You have product leadership experience in a regulated financial services setting.
You understand payments and fraud, and you have data analysis skills and engineering depth.
You have experience working with regulators and across multiple markets.
You’re skilled at stakeholder management at management-board level.
You have AI fluency at the AI Architect level: you design AI-native systems, not only use AI tools.

jobs.title: Director of Security Operations and Engineering
jobs.text:
A Little About Us
EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com
The Role:
You'll lead Security Operations and Security Engineering at EDB, reporting to the CISO as a trusted member of the security leadership team. You own how we detect, respond, and (increasingly) prevent. That means the people, the platforms, and the playbooks behind threat detection, incident response, and the engineering that makes them scale.
You'll be a peer to the leaders across security, including Governance, Risk & Compliance and Application Security & Vulnerability Management, and you'll help shape the direction of the broader InfoSec organization. You'll also partner closely with peer leaders in IT and Product, because most of the controls we define live in their systems, pipelines, and roadmaps. This is a scaling role. The business is growing fast, and so is everything security has to cover: more products, more cloud, more acquired companies and environments to bring up to a common standard. You'll decide what to build, what to automate, and where to add people, so the program grows ahead of the risk instead of behind it. As EDB grows, so will the scope and opportunity of the role.
One leader owns both Security Operations and Security Engineering on purpose: the best incident is the one that never happens. What we learn from detection and response feeds directly into the engineering of preventive controls, so we move from detecting bad things to making them impossible, and from manual triage to automation and agents that give analysts leverage. If you want to build that, and grow a program and a team as the company grows, this is the seat.
What your impact will be:
Incident response end to end, from intake and severity model through after-action and improvement, including partnership with Legal on investigations
Detection engineering, threat hunting, and the SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and cloud security platforms that support them
Security Engineering strategy and delivery, with the goal of preventing incidents rather than responding to them: preventive controls, least privilege, and identity assurance across employees, contractors, and build systems
The insider threat program, built with HR, Legal, and IT
Automation and agentic AI that extends analyst capacity (the analyst always owns the decision)
Security integration of acquired companies and new environments into EDB's standards
Close partnership with IT and Product leadership to build preventive controls into the platforms, pipelines, and products they own, plus security input to third-party risk and device posture with GRC
Scaling the program: the org design, operating rhythms, roadmap, budget, and vendor strategy that let coverage grow with the business without growing linearly with headcount
What you will bring:
5+ years of management experience leading security teams
7+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, detection, or security engineering
A track record of scaling a security function through rapid growth (hiring, automation, and operating discipline), not just running one
Strategic thinking that goes beyond the immediate scope of the role
The ability to translate technical risk into business impact for executives, legal, customers, and your IT and Product counterparts
Comfort in a global, remote-first environment with flexible schedules and on-call responsibilities
What will give you an edge:
Hands-on scripting or automation experience (Python, Go, etc.)
Experience applying AI or agent-based automation to security workflows
Cloud security experience and background in M&A security integration
Experience building an insider threat or identity assurance program
EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.
We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!
EDB is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. EDB was built on a commitment to trust and respect each other and to embrace an array of people and ideas. These values remain at the center of our culture and are key to our company’s integrity.
EDB does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. EDB and its affiliates are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other similar payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written signed agreement between EDB and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.
#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Technology Director, Search and Recommendations
jobs.text:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.
Position Purpose:
The Technology Director is responsible for leading the technical strategy, roadmap, architecture, and delivery of the company’s .com and Mobile App products. Partner with functional and technical leaders to identify and plan capabilities necessary to meet short and long-term business needs. Develop and execute strategic plans in support of key objectives in a timely and fiscally responsible manner. Informs and drives strategic alignment and partnerships with functional and technical peers and leaders. Connect the dots across multiple levels and related functions to understand the business holistically. Evaluate research and market analysis, meet with third party vendors, and maintain knowledge of industry innovations and technology platforms to inform strategy. Establish and nurture strategic vendor relationships; influences vendors to align to domain, portfolio, and enterprise strategic objectives. Drive growth for the business by applying technical and domain expertise to provide thought leadership and translate vision into action. Define and communicate value propositions, success metrics, and outcomes. Document, review and ensure that all quality and change control standards are met. Develop, plan, and implement sustainable, repeatable, and reliable processes; oversees process improvement. Drive operational excellence to create internal customer satisfaction and meet operational metrics while prioritizing external customer needs. Understand and articulate the value creation and business proposition to teams and functional partners. Manage and coordinate strategic direction for staff. Attract, retain, develop, and motivate top talent. Conduct annual and mid-year reviews, reviewing individual development plans and providing performance feedback.
Key Responsibilities:
40% Strategy & Planning:
Partners with functional and technical leaders to identify and plan capabilities necessary to meet short and long-term business needs
Develops and executes strategic plans in support of key objectives in a timely and fiscally responsible manner
Informs and drives strategic alignment and partnerships with functional and technical peers and leaders
Connects the dots across multiple levels and related functions to understand the business holistically
Evaluates research and market analysis, meets with third party vendors, and maintains knowledge of industry innovations and technology platforms to inform strategy
Establishes and nurtures strategic vendor relationships; influences vendors to align to domain, portfolio, and enterprise strategic objectives
Drives growth for the business by applying technical and domain expertise to provide thought leadership and translate vision into action
40% Delivery & Execution:
Defines and communicates value propositions, success metrics, and outcomes
Documents, reviews and ensures that all quality and change control standards are met
Develops, plans, and implements sustainable, repeatable, and reliable processes; oversees process improvement
Drives operational excellence to create internal customer satisfaction and meet operational metrics while prioritizing external customer needs
Understands and articulates the value creation and business proposition to teams and functional partners
20% People:
Provides leadership, mentoring, and coaching to direct reports
Manages and coordinates strategic direction for staff
Attracts, retains, develops, and motivates top talent
Conducts annual and mid-year reviews, reviewing individual development plans and providing performance feedback
Direct Manager/Direct Reports:
Typically reports to Sr. Director or Vice President.
Travel Requirements:
Typically requires overnight travel 5% to 20% of the time.
Physical Requirements:
Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.
Working Conditions:
Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.
Minimum Qualifications:
Must be eighteen years of age or older.
Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.
Must be legally permitted to work in the United States
Preferred Qualifications:
End‑to‑end ownership of Search, Personalization & Recommendations platforms — leads high‑traffic e‑commerce systems spanning relevance and ranking, query understanding, personalization logic, and large‑scale experimentation, with direct accountability for conversion, engagement, revenue lift, and customer satisfaction across Pro and DIY journeys.
Business‑aligned technical strategy and roadmap execution — defines and drives multi‑year platform strategies tightly coupled to product and enterprise outcomes across merchandising, marketing/CRM, retail media, supply chain, and finance, continuously re‑prioritizing based on growth, efficiency, and customer impact.
Experimentation, data, and ML at production scale — establishes experiment‑first operating models (A/B testing, incrementality measurement, multi‑armed bandits) and oversees ML‑powered ranking and recommendation systems, including unified behavioral data pipelines, real‑time inference, feature stores, latency optimization, and resilience guardrails.
Builder and scaler of senior engineering organizations — recruits, develops, and retains senior managers and staff/principal engineers; builds inclusive, high‑trust teams; and institutionalizes modern engineering and SRE practices (CI/CD, trunk‑based development, test automation, DevOps) to improve delivery speed, quality, and reliability.
Executive influencer with strong governance and financial ownership — partners with VP+ leaders across Product, UX, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Risk, and InfoSec; owns platform budgets and vendor strategy; and ensures strong data privacy, security, compliance, and responsible experimentation and ML governance.
Leading at a Sr. Manager level or above within a fast-paced, multi-division, national company
Defining, communicating, and driving value propositions, success metrics, and outcomes
Shaping, aligning, and guiding execution of strategic direction for a domain or significant portfolio segment
Communicating, building influence, and developing relationships with functional and technical leaders, with high-level vendor partners, and across all levels in the organization
Selecting and leading strategic vendor relationships or acting as the primary point of contact for strategic partnerships
Managing and developing direct reports with their own span of control
Utilizing deep market and industry knowledge for a related portfolio segment or domain to achieve strategic objectives
Minimum Education:
The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.
Preferred Education:
No additional education
Minimum Years of Work Experience:
8
Preferred Years of Work Experience:
No additional years of experience
Minimum Leadership Experience:
None
Preferred Leadership Experience:
None
Certifications:
None
Competencies:
Attracts Top Talent: Attracting and selecting the best talent to meet current and future business needs
Builds Effective Teams: Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals
Business Insight: Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals
Collaborates: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives
Courage: Stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said
Cultivates Innovation: Creates new and better ways for the organization to be successful
Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions
Decision Quality: Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward
Develops Talent: Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization's goals
Drives Engagement: Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives
Drives Results: Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances
Drives Vision and Purpose: Painting a compelling picture of the vision and strategy that motivates others to action
Financial Acumen: Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions
Organizational Savvy: Maneuvering comfortably through complex policy, process, and people-related organizational dynamics
Persuades: Using compelling arguments to gain the support and commitment of others
Plans and Aligns: Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals
Situational Adaptability: Adapting approach and demeanor in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations
Strategic Mindset: Seeing ahead to future possibilities and translating them into breakthrough strategies
Tech Savvy: Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications
For California, Colorado, Connecticut, Rhode Island, Nevada, New York City, Ithaca (NY), Westchester County (NY), and Washington residents:
The pay range for this position is between $190,000.00 - $300,000.00

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
Job Description
The Opportunity
FIS is one of the world’s largest financial technology companies, a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company serving banks, financial institutions, and businesses across six continents. We manage approximately 190 million deposit and wealth management accounts, power 1.1 billion payments accounts, and process more than 70 billion transactions annually. Our fraud and financial crimes capabilities sit at the foundation of that infrastructure, protecting consumers, institutions, and the financial system at a scale that few companies in the world can match.
The fraud and financial crimes product role drives the protection of millions of customer accounts world- wide every day. Preventing fraud here means protecting generational wealth, life savings, company assets as well as preventing financial crime, identity theft, and regulatory exposure globally.
We are in the middle of a significant transformation. FIS is investing heavily in building proprietary fraud signals, next-generation machine learning models, and AI-driven detection capabilities — not simply integrating third-party tools, but constructing a differentiated, data-rich fraud intelligence platform from the ground up. This role is central to that work, and the person who fills it will have an outsized impact on how FIS competes and serves its clients for years to come.
The Role
The VP, Product will own the product roadmap and strategy for FIS’s Enterprise Fraud & Financial Crimes portfolio. The position will report to the SVP of Fraud & Financial Crimes and lead a team of product managers, each leading their own PM teams across the portfolio.
This is a role for someone who has built and run product at a fraud or financial crimes company — someone who knows what a modern, technically differentiated fraud roadmap looks like, has shipped it, and is ready to bring that standard to one of the largest financial technology platforms in the world.
What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end product roadmap for the Enterprise Fraud & Financial Crimes portfolio
Set product strategy that reflects the full breadth of the portfolio. Your depth in transaction monitoring will raise the bar across the platform, but this role is not transaction monitoring alone, it spans the entire fraud and financial crimes stack.
Partner directly with FIS’s Data & AI product leads to define and drive the roadmap for proprietary fraud models, signals, and intelligence capabilities — a central pillar of FIS’s platform transformation.
Lead a senior product management organization spanning multiple product lines, providing clear ownership, strategic direction, and career development across the team.
Drive enterprise architecture and product strategy to ensure the platform scales to support financial institutions of every size, configurable to diverse client needs while maintaining a coherent long-term vision.
Engage directly with clients — from the largest global banks to community institutions — to validate priorities, understand needs, and surface outside-in perspective into the roadmap.
Align cross-functional teams across engineering, data science, compliance, operations, and commercial to deliver coordinated product outcomes.
Connect product decisions to business results — client adoption, revenue growth, fraud detection effectiveness, false-positive reduction, and measurable client outcomes.
What We’re Looking For
A product leader who has built fraud products. You have owned a roadmap at a fraud technology company, a fintech, or a financial institution where product was the core discipline. You know what modern fraud product looks like because you have shipped it. A background leading fraud product strategy at a cutting-edge fraud or financial crimes company is highly valued, as is experience leading fraud product at a financial institution or payments company — provided you owned the roadmap, not solely operations.
Deep transaction monitoring expertise. You understand the mechanics of rules engines, behavioral signals, and ML-based detection across cards and money movement. This is your strongest domain, and it shows — but you think in terms of the full portfolio, not just one capability.
Experience building proprietary fraud models and signals. You have led the product side of building proprietary fraud detection models and signals: defining which data and signals matter, partnering with data science to develop and productionize models, and turning them into differentiated capabilities clients rely on. You treat models and signals as products, with their own roadmaps, performance metrics, and feedback loops.
Breadth across the fraud and financial crimes stack. You understand end-customer authentication, identity, AML and financial crimes, and how these capabilities fit together into a coherent, enterprise-grade platform.
Technical fluency. You do not need to write code, but you need to be the kind of product leader who gets into architecture conversations, challenges technical tradeoffs, and drives roadmaps alongside engineering and data science. You have managed technical teams and held them accountable to delivery.
Commercial and enterprise orientation. You understand how to build products that serve large, complex enterprise clients and how product decisions translate to revenue, adoption, and client value.
Executive presence and stakeholder credibility. You can operate at the client C-suite level and internally across a large, matrixed organization.
Nice to Have
Experience as a head of product or equivalent at a fraud technology company or fraud-focused fintech.
Background leading fraud product at a financial institution or large payments company, with direct ownership of the product roadmap.
Familiarity with integrated fraud and AML transaction monitoring platforms.
Experience building or scaling AI, ML, or rules-based fraud detection products.
FIS is committed to providing its employees with an exciting career opportunity and competitive compensation. The pay range for this full-time position is $202,260.00 - $343,840.00 and reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for this position based on the posted role, level, and location. Within the range, actual individual starting pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Any changes in work location will also impact actual individual starting pay. Please consult with your recruiter about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
Privacy Statement
FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.
EEOC Statement
FIS is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, genetic information, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. The EEO is the Law poster is available here supplement document available here
For positions located in the US, the following conditions apply. If you are made a conditional offer of employment, you will be required to undergo a drug test. ADA Disclaimer: In developing this job description care was taken to include all competencies needed to successfully perform in this position. However, for Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) purposes, the essential functions of the job may or may not have been described for purposes of ADA reasonable accommodation. All reasonable accommodation requests will be reviewed and evaluated on a case-by-case basis.
Sourcing Model
Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

jobs.title: Director, Product
jobs.text:
Director, Product
At Livefront, we help companies design and build intelligent products and platforms that command attention and inspire joy. We’ve helped household names like CVS, Samsung, General Mills, and Optum create experiences that have reached millions of people, and startups like HomeSpotter and Credly build entirely new businesses that challenge their industries’ status quo.
We’re looking for a Director, Productto join our team.
Who you are
You are a seasoned product leader who blends sharp strategic instincts with a genuine love of the craft. You lead by example, hold exceptionally high standards, and have a track record of inspiring teams to do their best work. You manage competing priorities with clarity and calm, and you know how to rally a team around a shared goal without losing sight of the details that matter. You understand your team's motivations, strengths, and blind spots, and you actively cultivate an environment of learning, growth, and meaningful career development. You go out of your way to serve your team.
You embrace working in a client services environment and are capable and eager to support sales motions with your subject-matter expertise and earned wisdom. You help set the direction of a product practice, inspire collaboration across disciplines, and drive initiatives to completion. You stay current on industry trends—including the rapidly evolving role of AI in product development—and you share what you learn through publications, presentations, and conversations with your team and peers. You are empathetic, curious, and always improving. You are not constrained by product management dogma. Your principles are mature yet fluid, continually evolving with your experiences and advances in the field.
What you will be doing
Lead, mentor, and develop product managers and product strategists on the team; conduct performance reviews, support career growth, and foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and transparency.
Champion AI-augmented product development practices across the team: from using AI tools to accelerate discovery and synthesis, to embedding AI-assisted workflows into the product development lifecycle and client delivery.
Support Livefront’s growth team in new client pursuits by contributing to pitches, scoping efforts, and providing subject matter expertise.
Define and uphold standards for product strategy, project execution, and client experience, ensuring those standards are applied consistently across all engagements.
Partner with engineering and design to integrate AI capabilities thoughtfully into both the products we build and the process through which we build them.
Foster a culture of experimentation across the product practice, instilling in the team a mindset of continuous learning and equipping them with the tools and methods to put it into practice.
Help Livefront mature and evolve its product-related offerings, including product leadership consulting.
Serve as a product manager, strategist, or consultant in an individual contributor capacity as needed.
Work with the broader product team to continuously refine processes and facilitate adoption of those improvements across the team and client projects.
Actively participate in recruiting: interview candidates, evaluate technical and strategic abilities, and help build a team with the skills to thrive in an AI-accelerated product environment.
Collaborate with the VP of Product Management and other senior leaders on all of the above.
Why you should apply
You want to work on products and accounts that have outsized impact and reach and, most importantly, have meaningful business impact for our client partners.
You believe in sweating the details, committing to quality, and taking pride in going the extra mile.
You are energized by the current moment in AI. Not just the hype, but the genuine opportunity to reimagine how products are built, how insights are surfaced, and how users are served.
You want to work with and lead passionate and talented people who are always looking for ways to make things better.
You place equal importance on both personally creating incredible product designs and empowering the team to do the same.
You desire and strive to foster a work environment where respect, mutual trust, and egoless collaboration are paramount.
You want colleagues who take their work seriously but not themselves, and who know how to bring fun into the work.
You like being part of and building a team with a reputation for excellence that gives back to the community by educating, mentoring, and sponsoring.
What you bring to the table
At least 10-15 years of product management experience in a consulting environment or on an in-house, cross-functional product team.
Demonstrated experience leading product teams - teaching, mentoring, and creating conditions for people to do their best work.
Familiarity with AI's role in modern product development: from AI-assisted research and synthesis, to building AI-powered features and evaluating model outputs for real-world reliability.
Hunger to integrate AI tools into team workflows—whether for accelerating discovery, automating repetitive PM tasks, improving prototyping speed, or generating insight from data.
Experience building consumer-facing native mobile and web applications, with a fluent command of product management processes and tools.
Proven ability to lead clients to creative, impactful solutions and to articulate complex tradeoffs clearly.
Strong strategic planning skills: the ability to see what the team has done, what remains, and how to motivate delivery on time and on budget.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, an ability to defend strategic choices persuasively, including to skeptical or non-technical audiences.
Renowned problem-solving skills, above-average personal discipline and organization, and a demonstrated hunger for growth.
A self-evident love and care for the craft of building products.
What to expect
When applying, please include a short note about yourself, a summary of your work experience, and a link to any public profiles you actively maintain (e.g., GitHub, LinkedIn, etc).
Our hiring process moves quickly and consists of several stages for candidates who capture our attention with their initial submission, sometimes including but not limited to a short preliminary phone interview, a series of video interviews, and a short take-home exercise, which you'll have up to a week to complete.
$160,000 - $200,000 annual base salary plus a target bonus range between 10-20%.
Additional information
We go out of our way to evaluate all employees and job applicants equally based on merit, competence, and qualifications. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply and consider all qualified applicants. Don't worry, every application will be reviewed by a human.
Originally posted on Himalayas
