jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Head of Product
Location: Remote
About This Opportunity
Purple Squirrel Enterprises has been supporting startups and global firms through growth, change, and expansion for 19+ years. We provide flexible HR and recruiting solutions that allow leaders to focus on strategy while we handle people operations — and this search is no exception.
We are exclusively engaged by a high-growth health technology company to help them identify and hire exceptional product leadership talent for this role. We are embedded directly with their leadership team, have deep knowledge of the company, the culture, and what it takes to succeed here — and we will be your dedicated recruiting partner from first conversation through offer.
This is not a blind submission. When you apply, you are working with a team that knows this opportunity inside and out and will advocate for you every step of the way.
💜 If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply. We will be in touch promptly.
Applications submitted directly to our client will be redirected back to Purple Squirrel Enterprises. To be considered for this role, all candidates must apply through this posting.
About Our Client
Our client builds software and connected hardware that makes medication management safer for vulnerable populations in group homes, supported living, assisted living, behavioral health, and long-term care. In these settings, a large share of medication administration is handled by non-clinical staff working from paper, spreadsheets, and memory.
Their platform combines eMAR+ software, Smart Medboxes, emergency kits, and gamified self-medication tools into one connected system that prevents errors before they happen rather than documenting them after. They support providers, state agencies, and pharmacy partners across 20+ states, and recently won the first statewide medication management contract of its kind in the United States.
Their results so far:
48% reduction in medication errors
39% increase in compliance
69% improvement in audit-ready documentation
💜 This company was built around a cause that is both personal and urgent. That authenticity shows in how they operate, who they hire, and what they build. If you are looking for work that matters — this is it.
A Note on Title, Reporting Line & Scope
Our client is posting this role as Head of Product, but the final title, reporting structure, and scope will be shaped by the experience and leadership level of the person they hire. Depending on your background, this could ultimately be structured as VP of Product or other. Reporting line will most likely be directly to the CEO, though for a more foundational-level hire it could sit under Engineering leadership instead. These specifics — along with compensation — will be part of the conversation as we get to know your experience and how it maps to what they need.
This is intentional flexibility, not indecision: our client is committed to bringing in the right level of leadership for where they are today and where they're headed.
About the Role
Our client is looking for a Head of Product to own product strategy and execution and to build the Product function from the ground up. You will lead a team of two today — a Product Lead and a Product Specialist — with real influence over the type, number, and pace of hires as the team grows.
This is a startup, and this function is being built rather than maintained. You will have real ownership, very little inherited process, and a direct line to executive leadership. Product has been driven by the leadership team to date, and they are committed to a deliberate, unhurried handoff of that ownership to you — including knowledge transfer, context on customers and commitments, and hands-on support while you take the reins. You will not be handed a backlog and left to guess.
They are building toward empowered product teams, where leadership sets priorities and outcomes and teams have real autonomy to discover how to achieve them. You and engineering leadership will define how Product and Engineering work together — engineers here are product-minded and deeply involved in how the product takes shape, and the handoff model is intentionally not prescriptive.
Their product operates in a regulated, high-stakes environment. A missed dose is a patient safety event, not a support ticket, and their customers are audited by state agencies whose requirements differ state by state. Product judgment here means understanding what actually happens in a group home at 7am during a shift change, not what looks good in a spec.
As with all leaders at this company, you'll need to be both hands-on and strategic — that combination is core to their culture. Priorities, travel, and schedules shift with the pace of a growing company and its leadership team, so you'll need to bring your own ideas, act autonomously when needed, and stay a strong team player at the same time. Communication — proactive, reactive, and yes, sometimes over-communication — is essential in an environment like this.
What You'll Do
Own the Roadmap
Own product strategy and the roadmap across the full surface area: software, connected hardware, and pharmacy/EHR integrations. Publish it so the company can see what is coming and why
Bring a point of view on where the platform should go over the next 12–24 months, and make the case for it
Weigh patient safety, HIPAA, and state-by-state regulatory requirements from the start rather than retrofitting them
Treat reporting, audit trails, and business intelligence as first-class product — audit-ready documentation is a primary reason customers choose this platform
Lead Discovery
Spend real time with caregivers, house managers, administrators, nurses, and state agency stakeholders — observing workflows rather than consuming feedback secondhand
Distinguish recurring needs from individual feature requests, and explain the difference to Sales and Customer Success
Design for three very different users: administrators (oversight/audit), caregivers (speed/clarity mid-shift), and the individuals receiving care
Design into existing routines rather than around them — usability is a safety requirement here, not a preference
Set the bar for product definition: clear problem statements, acceptance criteria, and edge-case thinking Engineering can build from without guesswork
Build the Function
Establish how product gets practiced: how problems get framed, how discovery happens, how decisions get made, how outcomes get measured
Lead, coach, and develop the Product team, and shape the hiring plan — including roles that don't exist yet — as scope expands
Keep Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Operations aligned on priorities and support strategic accounts and state-level opportunities where product credibility matters
Work With AI
Set the standard on AI rather than delegate it — use tools like Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic environments to explore the codebase, work with data, and build functional prototypes
Establish these practices across the Product team and coach your people into them
The goal is better-informed decisions about scope and value — not handing engineering a flashy prototype to productionize
You do not need to be a software engineer, and you will have strong engineering partnership. You do need to be willing and able to build.
What This Role Is Not
This is not a purely strategic or advisory position, and it is not a roadmap-maintenance or backlog-management role. You will be the most senior product person in the company, with no layer between you and the problem. If you're looking to set direction and hand execution to a team of PMs, this isn't the right fit today. If being close to customers, requirements, and shipped software is what you've been missing, it likely is.
What Success Looks Like
Ownership Established: You've taken clear, visible ownership of the roadmap and the leadership team trusts your judgment on what's next and why
Discovery in Motion: You are spending real time with caregivers, administrators, and state stakeholders — and using what you learn to shape decisions, not just validate them
Function Taking Shape: Product process, definition standards, and team rhythms exist where little or none did before
Team Growing With Intention: You have a clear point of view on team structure and hiring, and the team feels coached, not just managed
Trusted Cross-Functionally: Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success see you as the person who keeps priorities clear and aligned across the company
What We're Looking For
Required
6 - 8+ years in product management, including end-to-end ownership of a roadmap covering discovery, definition, and delivery — not solely execution of a roadmap someone else set
Experience leading product people, including hiring and onboarding rather than only managing an inherited team
A track record of shipping B2B SaaS in close partnership with Engineering
Experience building product process where little or none existed
Strong discovery skills: customer interviewing, problem validation, prototyping, and experimentation
Experience with products where the buyer and the user are different people
Practical, frequent use of LLMs in day-to-day work
Comfort working with data directly, strong written communication, and judgment to decide with incomplete information
Willingness to travel occasionally, up to roughly 15%, for customer/facility visits, team meetings, and industry events
Nice to Have
Experience in healthcare technology, IDD services, assisted living, behavioral health, long-term care, or medication management, or another regulated environment
Experience with enterprise, government, or state agency customers, including procurement and reporting requirements
Experience shipping products that combine software and connected hardware
Experience with integration-dependent products (HL7, JSON, REST APIs, pharmacy management systems, EHRs)
Experience scaling a Product function from a small team, or shipping products/internal tools personally prototyped using AI-assisted development
Personal Attributes
A builder — your instinct when you have an idea is to make something and test it
Low ego, strong point of view — you advocate hard and change your mind when the evidence changes
Comfortable with ambiguity
Intellectually curious about why, not just what was requested
Energized by the mission — many affected by this product cannot advocate for themselves
Compensation & Benefits
Base salary: $183,000 – $225,000, depending on experience, skill set, and the ultimate scope/level of the role (Head of Product, VP of Product, or other) — final title and comp will be calibrated to the candidate
Potential Equity participation
100% company-paid medical coverage (base plan)
Dental & vision available
401(k) retirement plan
Company-paid life, AD&D, STD & LTD insurance
Lifestyle Spending Account (wellness, personal use, and company swag)
Flexible PTO + company holidays
Flexible, remote-friendly work environment
💜 Mission-driven work with real impact on vulnerable populations
Why This Role — And Why Now
Real problems, real stakes — your work directly affects patient safety for a population that often cannot advocate for itself
True ownership — you'll build the Product function, not inherit one
Direct access to leadership — a real seat at the table, with influence over team structure and roadmap
High-growth trajectory — recent statewide contract win signals significant expansion ahead
Authentic mission — 💜 this company was built around a cause that matters
Working With Purple Squirrel Enterprises
We are exclusively engaged by this client — meaning we are not one of many agencies submitting resumes. We are their dedicated recruiting partner, embedded in their process, and we know this role inside and out.
Here's what that means for you as a candidate:
A dedicated PSE point of contact throughout the entire process
Advocacy with the hiring team to make sure the role is mutually beneficial
Preparation for each interview stage so you can put your best foot forward
Honest, timely feedback at every step
Support through offer negotiation to ensure the outcome is right for you and the company
Deep experience navigating complex hiring processes to get great candidates across the finish line
Our client is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. They welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
This role is on-site, 5 days a week, working from our Flatiron office in NYC.
About Seated
Seated exists to help restaurants thrive in an industry defined by thin margins and underutilized capacity. We connect thousands of restaurants with millions of high-intent diners through demand-driven pricing and rewards, helping restaurants fill empty tables, reach new guests, increase visit frequency, and drive profitable incremental revenue.
Since launching, billions of dollars in restaurant spend have flowed through Seated, and hundreds of millions of dollars in rewards have been paid to Seated consumers. Today, Seated operates across 20+ U.S. markets and continues to expand nationally.
Our core marketplace is thriving. Now, we’re focused on expanding the value Seated creates for restaurants and consumers and building the company’s next major growth engine.
See it for yourself: seatedapp.io (restaurant side) · getseated.seatedapp.io (diner side) · Seated on iOS · Seated on Android
Role Overview
Seated is hiring a Director of Product to serve as our first dedicated Product leader, owning product strategy and execution across our consumer and restaurant businesses.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this person will play a key role in shaping Seated’s product direction, identifying and validating new growth opportunities, and translating business priorities into products that create meaningful value for restaurants and consumers.
This is a highly hands-on role. You’ll work directly with our SVP of Engineering and a lean engineering team to drive the full product lifecycle, from customer discovery and data analysis to requirements, prioritization, testing, and launch.
We’re looking for someone who thrives in an environment without established product processes or a large team. You’ll bring structure to how we make product decisions, build a focused roadmap, and help establish the foundation for a scalable Product function as Seated grows.
Responsibilities
Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Seated’s consumer and restaurant products in partnership with the CEO and Engineering
Identify, evaluate, and validate new product opportunities that can drive Seated’s next stage of growth
Lead product discovery, customer research, experimentation, and business-case development to inform product decisions
Explore opportunities across consumer marketplace expansion, restaurant software, AI, and adjacent products
Drive improvements to critical product infrastructure, including merchant identification and transaction recognition
Partner directly with the SVP of Engineering and engineering team to define requirements, evaluate technical tradeoffs, prioritize initiatives, and deliver high-quality products
Serve as the primary Product owner, driving initiatives from discovery and definition through development, launch, and iteration
Identify and execute product-led growth opportunities across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization
Establish lightweight product processes, including roadmap planning, requirements documentation, prioritization frameworks, and success metrics
Translate business objectives, customer insights, and data into clear product priorities and measurable outcomes
Develop a deep understanding of consumer behavior, restaurant operator needs, unit economics, and marketplace dynamics
Help shape the future Product function as Seated grows, including identifying opportunities to expand product and design capabilities

jobs.title: Director of Information Technology
jobs.text:
About Redesign Group
The Redesign Group is a global technology and cybersecurity Solution Provider leveraging design thinking, interdependent subject matter expertise, and emerging technology solutions to help organizations achieve meaningful transformation. Our globally diverse team members, partnerships with strategic technology manufacturers, and cybersecurity services position us to be a business partner that’s ready for what’s next.
We live by our core values of operating in the service of others, being problem solvers, and focusing on long term partnerships. You’ll excel at Redesign if you thrive in a rewarding environment that moves quickly, challenges you to grow and fosters collaboration. We seek candidates with a hands-on customer-first approach, robust interpersonal and communication skills, strong work ethic and excellent time management. While teamwork is expected, the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment is crucial.
Job Description
The Redesign Group is seeking a Director of Information Technology to own our internal technology estate end to end and lead the team that runs it. This role reports directly to the Chief Information Officer and covers identity, endpoints, networking, collaboration, service management, and our internal AI platform across a remote-first organization.
Our clients hold us to a high standard for the infrastructure we design and secure on their behalf. This role exists to hold our own environment to that same standard. You will set the internal technology strategy, build and develop the team that executes it, and own the internal adoption and governance of AI so that our own practice sharpens what our AI and security teams deliver to clients.
Technical Responsibilities
Strategy, Team & Operating Model
Build and run a multi-year internal technology roadmap, with IT governance, standards, and architecture review behind it
Tie every investment to a business outcome, with defined success measures rather than product categories
Design the internal IT function, build the business case for headcount, hire against it, and develop the team
Define what is run internally versus delivered through partners and managed service providers, and hold those partners to defined service levels
Own the internal IT budget, forecast, and software license position, rationalizing the SaaS estate and managing renewals, negotiations, and contract terms
Service Management & Employee Experience
Stand up and mature IT service management across intake, incident, problem, request, and change
Build the internal service catalog and the service levels behind it, with clear ownership, on-call, and escalation models
Publish operational metrics and remove the largest sources of employee friction each quarter
Own the onboarding and offboarding technology experience in partnership with HR
Infrastructure, Identity & Workplace Technology
Own enterprise identity, including Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, single sign-on, conditional access, and periodic access reviews
Own endpoint management, configuration baselines, patching, and device lifecycle (Intune or equivalent)
Manage the Microsoft 365 collaboration estate, including Teams, SharePoint, and Exchange governance
Own internal network architecture, remote access, and secure connectivity for a distributed workforce
Manage the internal cloud and hosting footprint, and own backup, recovery, and business continuity with tested recovery objectives
Internal AI Enablement & Economics
Own internal AI tool use case development, rollout, training, and adoption measurement
Partner with the Redesign AI practice so internal use informs client-facing delivery
Apply financial engineering to the internal AI estate: build the unit-cost model, forecast consumption, negotiate commitments and reserved capacity, and hold AI spend accountable to measured productivity gains
Security, Risk & Compliance
Partner with security leadership and own the IT execution half of the security program
Support SOC 2 and ISO audit readiness, including evidence collection and control operation
Own vulnerability management and remediation for internal systems and endpoints
Define and enforce device posture and access requirements across the estate
Required Experience
10+ years of information technology experience, including years leading teams or owning a technology function
Proven experience building and scaling internal IT in a distributed or remote-first company through a period of fast growth
Experience presenting technology strategy, investment recommendations, risks, and operating metrics to executive leadership
Deep hands-on experience with Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, endpoint management (Intune or equivalent), and SaaS administration at scale
Demonstrated ownership of internal AI adoption and governance, including policy, data handling, and change management
Strong security fluency — able to partner credibly with a CISO and translate risk into business terms for executive stakeholders
Experience operating in a solutions provider, MSP, or consulting environment strongly preferred
Experience supporting audit, SOC 2, or other regulated compliance requirements
Vendor, MSP, and contract negotiation experience with budget ownership
Ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and executive audiences, in writing and in person
Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL, Microsoft, CISSP/CISM, PMP, or equivalent are valued but not required
Benefits
We offer a comprehensive benefits package which may include:
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance
401(k) retirement plan with company match (annual dollar cap applied)
Flexible time off plan
15 paid holidays
Sick leave (amount varies by state requirements and is at least the minimum required by any state)
Short-term and long-term disability
Life insurance
Paid parental leave
Additional Compensation: This position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation and/or bonus opportunities based on individual and company performance.
We’re an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We consider qualified candidates without regard to any legally protected status. This role is subject to applicable employment laws based on work location. In compliance with pay transparency laws, the compensation range for this role is included, with final pay based on experience, skills, and location. We participate in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility and are happy to provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process—just let us know how we can help.

jobs.title: Director Procurement - Technology Tower Lead (Remote, Texas, US)
jobs.text:
About Foundever
Foundever® is a global leader in the customer experience (CX) industry. With 150,000 associates across the globe, we’re the team behind the best experiences for +750 of the world’s leading and digital-first brands. Our innovative CX solutions, technology and expertise are designed to support operational needs for our clients and deliver a seamless experience to customers in the moments that matter.
Job Summary
The Global Tech/IT Tower Lead is responsible for leading the global category management strategy across the organization's Technology/IT spend portfolio, including software, infrastructure, hardware, cloud, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and IT services.
This role serves as the strategic procurement partner to Technology and business leadership, and is accountable for category strategy development, supplier selection, commercial negotiations, supplier relationship management, and delivery of savings and broader procurement value objectives across the assigned portfolio.
The Tower Lead manages a globally distributed team and partners closely with executive and cross-functional teams to support enterprise priorities, procurement transformation initiatives, and operational scalability within a complex global environment. This role serves as a member of the Global Procurement Leadership team and contributes to broader procurement strategy, operating model evolution, and capability development initiatives.
Duties and Responsibilities
Strategic Category Leadership
Develop and execute category management strategies across the Technology/IT spend portfolio (7-10 subcategories across approximately $200-250M including multi-year roadmaps aligned to business priorities, savings objectives, supplier management, risk mitigation, and operational requirements.
Partner and engage with senior stakeholders, including C-suite, to align procurement strategies with enterprise objectives, transformation initiatives, and functional priorities.
Provide market intelligence, supplier insights, and category expertise to support strategic decision-making, long-term planning activities, evolving business and Technology priorities, and alignment of category strategies with key stakeholders.
Support and contribute to enterprise digitalization initiatives and evolving Technology strategies, including alignment to broader AI-related priorities where applicable.
Supplier & Commercial Management
Lead strategic sourcing activities, supplier selection decisions, contracting activities, and complex commercial negotiations across the assigned Technology categories.
Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships, governance models, and risk mitigation approaches to support cost optimization, service quality, scalability, operational resilience, and broader risk management objectives.
Oversee contracting, supplier governance, and commercial management activities in partnership with Legal, Finance, Security, Privacy, Operations, and business stakeholders.
Support adherence to procurement governance standards, enterprise policies, and sourcing controls across the Technology procurement portfolio.
Financial & Business Value Delivery
Own category savings targets and identify opportunities for demand management, vendor consolidation, commercial optimization, process improvement, and broader procurement value creation.
Monitor supplier performance, category spend trends, contractual commitments, and market conditions to proactively identify risks and optimization opportunities.
Support budgeting, forecasting, and spend management activities related to the Technology procurement portfolio.
Leadership & Capability Development
Lead, develop, and mentor a globally distributed procurement team while fostering a collaborative, customer-focused, and high-performance environment.
Support capability development, knowledge sharing, and implementation of procurement best practices across category management and supplier management activities.
Coach and mentor procurement talent to support organizational capability growth and future procurement leadership development.
Qualifications - Experience
Minimum:
10+ years of progressive procurement, sourcing, or category management experience within complex global organizations.
5 years' experience supporting Technology/IT procurement categories, including software, infrastructure, cloud, hardware, telecommunications, cybersecurity, and/or IT services.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing category strategies across large and complex global spend portfolios.
Experience leading strategic supplier negotiations and managing executive-level supplier relationships.
Experience partnering with senior business and Technology stakeholders in a matrixed global environment.
Experience leading geographically distributed teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong commercial, analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred:
Experience supporting procurement transformation, operating model redesign, or global centralization initiatives. Experience within multinational, technology, services, or BPO environments.
Familiarity with procurement technologies, source-to-contract processes, and supplier governance frameworks.
**Some global travel may be required (20-30%)

jobs.text:
Join the Rest Revolution
The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.
So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.
More than a decade ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.
We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.
The Opportunity
Hatch is looking for a Mobile Engineering Director to own mobile engineering across our entire product portfolio consisting of 4 teams: Adult, Kids, Foundations, and Growth. You'll manage our mobile engineering managers, set architecture and technical direction across teams, foster a culture of product-focused engineering, and make sure the org has the resourcing, escalation paths, and cross-team coordination it needs to ship. Engineering Managers own day-to-day delivery, and you own the accountability, direction, and connective tissue that keeps mobile engineering coherent across a broad and growing product line.
What You'll Do
Within 1 month:
Take over management of the mobile engineering managers, and start building the relationships and 1:1 cadence to support them
Establish yourself as the owner of the weekly Mobile Strategy meeting
Get oriented across all four teams - Adult, Kids, Foundations, and Growth - and understand current resourcing, roadmap, and delivery status in each team
Understand existing AI strategy and opportunities on the mobile team
Begin building relationships with Product and Design partners across the pillars, and start to foster a product engineering mindset across the team
Within 3 months:
Own resourcing, escalation, and overall direction for mobile delivery and architecture
Take team-level accountability for cross-platform (iOS and Android) strategy, and for individual mobile delivery across the org
Oversee direction for software quality in partnership with QA
Start shaping architecture governance and the architectural review process, including how staff/principal technical leverage is applied across teams
Own hiring pipeline direction, including interviewing and hiring decisions for open mobile roles
Bring a mobile capacity view into roadmap planning
Begin to set direction for AI adoption and tooling efficiency across the mobile org
Establish strong working relationships and operating rhythms with Product and Design partners across the pillars, and build a product engineering culture across the team
After 6 months:
Lead architecture governance and the ADR process end to end, including calling the bets that affect roadmap or resourcing
Set Mobile Health direction and strategy
Define the approach to AI adoption and tooling efficiency across the mobile org
Own staff development and feedback across the mobile org, including promotion decisions and escalations, and actively develop current and future engineering leads
Champion recognition and culture for the mobile team, and build project management / product-engineering capability across teams
As capacity allows, pick up select mobile IC work off the critical path to stay current
Establish a robust cross-functional operating model for Mobile: how the organization plans, prioritizes, and coordinates with Product, Design, Analytics, and other key stakeholders
What You'll Bring
The Essentials
Substantial experience leading mobile engineering organizations, including managing engineering managers
A track record of setting technical direction and architecture governance across multiple concurrent product lines or teams
Comfort operating through delegation - you set direction and hold accountability without needing to be hands-on in every workstream
Strong cross-functional communication skills, including experience representing engineering to Product and Design partners, as well as executive stakeholders
Experience building hiring pipelines and developing engineering leads
The Mindset We Love
A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity and competing priorities across a broad remit
A product engineering mindset: we’re building out the best possible experience for our users, and we expect engineers to play an active role from ideation through implementation
Collaborative spirit: you make everyone around you better
Clear communication: you can explain complex, cross-team tradeoffs simply
Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch
We’re a certified Great Place to Work
We help people sleep better. Our products make a real, meaningful difference in our customers’ lives
Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds, and you’ll work with leadership that truly values every contribution
We’re backed by world-class investors (and growing fast)
We’re a remote-friendly work environment. We practice what we preach to give our employees better balance and more flexibility
The Perks & Benefits That Matter
100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees (80% for dependents, including domestic partners)
Meaningful equity. You’re an owner here
401(k) match with no vesting schedule
16 weeks of fully paid parental leave
16 free therapy sessions (for you and one other adult in your life)
Financial support for family planning
Remote office and monthly internet reimbursement
Friends and family discounts on Hatch products
Exclusive discounts on travel, entertainment, and top retail brands
About Hatch
Hatch was founded in 2014 by entrepreneurs (and parents themselves) Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss. Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Hatch creates tech that helps you and your family get better sleep.
Hatch Sleep Clock is a contactless sleep tracker that provides actionable insights, personalized recommendations, and bedtime routines based on your unique sleep habits and preferences
Restore 3 helps you regulate your nervous system and tune into your circadian rhythm with unwind routines, science-backed sleep audio, and ambient lights
Hatch Baby helps parents soothe their little ones and create healthy sleep habits with expert sleep support, gentle sounds, and calming lights
Hatch Go includes ten soothing sounds in one portable package
We’re an equal opportunity employer and committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
Ready to Help the World Sleep Better?
We’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join us in making great sleep a reality for all.
E-Verify
Hatch participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.
Privacy Notice
By submitting a job application at Hatch, you agree to our privacy notice, located here

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Parallax Innovations is a civic communications lab building modern persuasion infrastructure for the movement to improve American democracy and elections.
We support organizations and campaigns advancing nonpartisan democracy reforms through our narrative intelligence platform. We combine technology, data, and services to help our partners reach, engage, and persuade voters in our fast-evolving information ecosystem. We enable partners with strategic guidance and hands-on production and editing support to build strong vertical-video operations across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Our products make it easier for campaigns to mobilize supporters as creators, equipping them with tools that draw on our intelligence and predictive capabilities to improve content before it ships. And our data assets – including an enriched voter file with audience-specific insights – help campaigns deploy and amplify the right content to the specific voters they need to reach.
Our primary focus is solving the Primary Problem—a system of party primaries that excludes millions of voters and rewards elected leaders for answering to a narrow partisan electorate. We help advance open primaries that give voters more voice and choice and leaders stronger incentives to represent their communities.
Parallax is incubated by Unite America, and is based in Denver.
As Chief Technology Officer, you will own the ongoing development and improvement of Parallax's primary competitive advantage: a narrative intelligence platform that learns what persuades Americans on reform issues, and how. You own everything engineering, AI, data, privacy & compliance, infrastructure, security, with strong influence over adjacent workflows. You also serve as an organizational leader, driving strategy and organization prioritization.
We approach persuasion like infrastructure: a lasting capability that helps the movement learn, improve and win across campaigns and election cycles. Our ambition is to build a closed-loop learning system that gets smarter every time we speak. Its AI core will connect the content we create with engagement data, audience research and experiments to learn which messages, messengers and formats work with which voters—and feed those lessons back into how we create, target and distribute the next communication.
Over each election cycle, Parallax will support a number of reform campaigns, many of them ballot initiatives. Each campaign has to reach different audiences: progressives, conservatives, independents, and the large group of Americans who are disengaged or simply worn out by politics. Our product lowers the barrier for supporters to become compelling content creators, and our platform provides guidance on frames, formats, messengers and messages are likely to work.
This is an executive role requiring technical depth and a hands-on approach to using modern engineering tools, as well as broader organizational leadership skills. You’ll craft the product vision, lead the contract engineers in developing the platform, and be the decision-maker about architecture, models, data and resources. You’ll also champion the technical vision, progress, and investment requirements to executive leadership, the Board, and potential investors. You will inherit a contract data and engineering team, and from there you will determine how the team develops, including budget development and hiring.
You will serve as a senior executive responsible for the technical integration of Parallax’s data, products, and services. Alongside the Chief of Staff and VP of Product & Partnerships, you will develop and drive organizational strategy, translate priorities into work plans and budgets, and align the team around measurable results. Ideal candidates for this role will have the judgment and management ability to assume broader organizational leadership as Parallax grows.
This role reports to the President, and is based in Denver. Relocations welcome. Exceptional candidates based elsewhere will be considered if they can commit to periodic trips to Denver.
These will be your accountabilities:
Own the development of Parallax’s core technology and competitive advantage.
Set platform strategy and capabilities roadmap: what it should measure, what its learning agenda will be, what inputs it expands to include, and how it learns and improves quarter over quarter.
Define the scoring framework: how content engagement and persuasion are quantified for Parallax, how they are weighted, and how scores connect to real outcomes.
Extend our intelligence platform beyond transcript-analysis so that it evaluates videos, including visuals, presenters, format and production choices.
Make the model decisions: which commercial and open models to use and route between, whether fine-tuning or custom components are worth it, and the tradeoffs in cost, speed and accuracy.
Build the data loop so that performance data from platforms, partners, audience surveys and experiments flows back into the platform cleanly and in an accretive fashion.
Oversee the development of dashboards and reporting that can explain what the platform is accomplishing, for internal and partner audiences.
Ensure the platform adheres to data compliance laws and a set of AI ethics guidelines which will need to be fully articulated (e.g. no deceptive or synthetic content).
Prove that it works, explain its limits.
Design and run the platform validation agenda: back-test against historical content, compare predictions with actual results, and check findings against survey and experimental (including RCT) evidence.
Build the evals and guardrails that let the platform learn within defined limits, so its outputs can be trusted and explained.
Report clearly to leadership, funders and partners on what the intelligence platform can tell us today, how confident we are, and what it cannot yet do.
Turn intelligence into decisions.
Translate platform findings into clear, weekly guidance the creative team uses on frame, format, messenger and audience.
Work with the Creative studio and Partners team to support mapping the message-by-audience grid across active campaigns: what has been tested, what is working, and where the gaps are.
Help package Parallax's intelligence effectively so that partner organizations and campaign teams can use it to make more persuasive content themselves.
Shape our technology ecosystem, build the team as needed.
As the platform expands, expand your influence and help shape the roadmap for Parallax's other internal tools and products so they effectively interoperate with the core, working closely with the people who build and deploy them.
Take over the current contractor-based data and engineering squad; decide what to keep, build or buy. Own team development, budget, and hiring, in collaboration with leadership.
Build alongside the team with the latest AI tools, and set the standard for how Parallax uses AI responsibly.
Help the President and leadership team set Parallax's strategy, and work closely with the Chief of Staff and the VP of Product & Partnerships on org-wide initiatives.
What success looks like:
First 60 days: you’ve facilitated a shared platform vision that is in sharp focus, pulled together a leadership-approved roadmap and clear technical ownership. An initial intelligence platform scoring framework should be in place to enable the creative team to run strong week-to-week experiments, learn from results, and make each round of communications smarter.
First six months: a working feedback loop connecting content, audience and outcome data; initial scoring and predictive capabilities tested against results; and initial integrations with the partner voter file and Partner Portal. The team should be using findings to improve communications, with clear measures of progress and priorities for what comes next.

jobs.title: Director of Product Engineering
jobs.text:
Hometrack is seeking an accomplished Director of Product Engineering, to lead our efforts in building innovative mission critical products to power property decision making in the UK financial services industry. We offer a competitive salary, fantastic benefits, and flexible, hybrid working.
Hometrack’s market-leading property data sets, valuation models, and risk insights are delivered via our suite of B2B SaaS applications for mortgage lenders, brokers, and more. We’ve led the market for over twenty years!
Our services are mission-critical to the UK’s top banks, automating their mortgage offers. They’re used daily by home builders, mortgage brokers, local councils, and more to make informed property purchasing decisions. We have an exciting strategy to serve an even wider section of the market, with innovative products and services.
The Director of Product Engineering will provide senior technology leadership for Hometrack’s key product lines, owning the technical strategy, delivery oversight, and evolution, providing a highly utilised and relied upon set of capabilities for clients.
This role will lead an established set of teams as they evolve and support our existing capabilities to scale and meet developing client needs. The Director of Product Engineering will collaborate closely with Product peers and wider business stakeholders to shape the long‑term roadmap, ensure robust technical foundations, and guide our continued growth.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership
Own the technology strategy ensuring alignment with our wider platform and technology strategy.
Partner with key stakeholders in product, commercial and delivery to define and evolve a clear, credible roadmap covering near‑term delivery and longer‑term technical direction.
Provide domain leadership and technical challenge
Delivery & Execution
Provide senior oversight of existing product engineering teams, ensuring delivery remains on track as the products evolve and new products are introduced.
Ensure strong engineering fundamentals, including resilience, scalability, security, and operational readiness, appropriate for an institution supporting banks and other major lenders.
Support the evolution of a highly utilised set of capabilities as they scale to meet future client needs.
Technology & Architecture
Guide architectural decisions in partnership with technical peers (Principal/Staff Engineers).
Act as a key contributor in setting our technology direction
People & Leadership
Lead and develop engineers and engineering managers (software and data).
Set clear expectations, provide coaching, and build a culture of ownership, learning, and delivery.
What We’re Looking For
Essential Experience
Senior technology leadership experience (Head of/Director or equivalent) preferably within or adjacent to financial services.
Demonstrable experience owning and evolving complex platforms, preferably in a high availability environment.
Proven ability to partner effectively with Product leadership to shape and deliver long‑term strategy.
Strong fundamental background in software engineering (.Net/AWS/Azure)
Beneficial Experience
Experience of evolving team working practices towards increasingly agentic SDLCs
Experience managing and leading data engineering teams
Leadership & Behaviours
Pragmatic and outcome‑focused, with sound judgement to balance speed, risk, and long‑term value.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and guiding teams through an evolving domain.
Clear communicator who can explain complex concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences.
Role‑model for Hometrack’s Behaviours and expectations around ownership, delivery, and collaboration.

Our services are mission-critical to the UK’s top banks, automating their mortgage offers. jobs.title: Product Management Director - Credit Card
jobs.text:
Why USAA?
At USAA, our mission is to empower our members to achieve financial security through highly competitive products, exceptional service and trusted advice. We seek to be the #1 choice for the military community and their families.
Embrace a fulfilling career at USAA, where our core values – honesty, integrity, loyalty and service – define how we treat each other and our members. Be part of what truly makes us special and impactful.
We are proud to support active-duty military spouses. USAA roles may offer remote or hybrid flexibility for active-duty military spouses consistent with applicable policy and business needs.
The Opportunity
As a dedicated Product Management Director - Credit Card you will formulate product/sales strategy recommendations based on analysis of profitability, competitiveness and sales performance for the product life cycle. Compile, analyze and interpret data to make strategic and tactical recommendations or decisions pertaining to sales/product performance. Responsible for defining the business questions and providing insights to improve business performance. Support the maintenance of existing products and/or may lead in the development and launch of less complex, new products with channel partners.
What you'll do:
Leverage internal and external data and member information to support formulation of product strategy and enhance competitive intelligence.
Develop product dashboards and metrics recommendations in support of analyzing and evaluating strategic performance.
Partner with Marketing to define go-to-market and value proposition strategy of the product/feature.
Develop recommendations to launch new products and the evaluation and decision to buy/build or ally.
Act as product SME on features and services and collaborates with business partners to provide recommendations.
Analyze and evaluates product performance metrics to form recommendations regarding market opportunities and product enhancements.
Lead efforts to expand or change existing product features.
Contribute to decisions regarding product pricing and profitability.
Identify and evaluates potential providers for alliance relationships.
Provide support regarding all aspects of Product Life Cycle.
Approve and provides support in developing, editing and distributing product communications.
Coordinate with relevant control partners (to include Legal, Compliance, and Risk Management) to ensure product offerings are designed, implemented and managed in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.
Contribute to the overall strategy of the business and collaborates with alliance to develop product strategy.
Interpret performance results to inform product or sales forecast and planning.
Ensure risks associated with business activities are effectively identified, measured, monitored, and controlled in accordance with risk and compliance policies and procedures.
What you have:
Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, or Statistics; OR 4 years of relevant education and/or experience.
8 years of relevant industry experience in Actuary, Underwriting, Marketing or Sales/Service or Finance/Accounting Operations or Financial Services.
3 years of product management, or similar strategic management experience (similar experience includes direct support in managing product performance).
2 years of Data Visualization experience (i.e.Tableau).
Knowledge of relevant laws and regulations (i.e.FDIC, CFPB, OCC).
Expert experience in creating product briefings and presenting to executive leadership.
Experienced in market research to create product roadmap, make product decisions and iterate rapidly.
Knowledge of applicable product related regulations, and risk and compliance requirements.
Knowledge of federal laws, rules, and regulations to include: TILA/REG Z, SCRA/MLA (given our demographic), Reg B, FCRA, UDAAP.
What sets you apart:
Strong quantitative foundation — statistical/econometric modeling, elasticity modeling, financial or credit analysis, and forecasting — applied with rigor but always in service of a clear, decision-ready recommendation.
Exceptional communication and storytelling ability — a demonstrated track record of distilling highly complex analysis into simple visuals and narratives that resonate with senior leadership, governance/approval bodies, and non-technical partners.
Demonstrated informal leadership — able to set direction, build consensus, and influence outcomes across marketing, digital, legal, compliance, finance, and credit risk partners without formal authority over those teams.
Demonstrated ability to independently translate an ambiguous, forward-looking vision into a concrete, sequenced roadmap — including a structured test-and-learn agenda — with minimal established precedent or playbook to draw from. Comfortable setting strategic direction with a high degree of autonomy and ownership.
High intellectual curiosity and comfort operating in ambiguity, balancing rigorous quantitative rigor with pragmatic, business-ready judgment.
Compensation range: The salary range for this position is: $143,320 - $273,930.
USAA does not provide visa sponsorship for this role. Please do not apply for this role if at any time (now or in the future) you will need immigration support (i.e., H-1B, TN, STEM OPT Training Plans, etc.).
Compensation: USAA has an effective process for assessing market data and establishing ranges to ensure we remain competitive. You are paid within the salary range based on your experience and market data of the position. The actual salary for this role may vary by location.
Employees may be eligible for pay incentives based on overall corporate and individual performance and at the discretion of the USAA Board of Directors.
The above description reflects the details considered necessary to describe the principal functions of the job and should not be construed as a detailed description of all the work requirements that may be performed in the job.
Benefits: At USAA our employees enjoy best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellness. These benefits include comprehensive medical, dental and vision plans, 401(k), pension, life insurance, parental benefits, adoption assistance, paid time off program with paid holidays plus 16 paid volunteer hours, and various wellness programs. Additionally, our career path planning and continuing education assists employees with their professional goals.
For more details on our outstanding benefits, visit our benefits page on USAAjobs.com.
Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis, this posting will remain open until the position is filled. Thus, interested candidates are encouraged to apply the same day they view this posting.
USAA is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Head of Data & Data Products
jobs.text:
WME is looking for a Head of Data & Data Products to build the next generation of our data capability.
WME sits at the center of entertainment, representing leading artists, creators, athletes, brands, and intellectual property around the world. Every day, our teams generate and work with an extraordinary amount of information about relationships, opportunities, deals, audiences, markets, and outcomes.
We believe that data can become a meaningful competitive advantage for WME — not simply by producing more reports, but by making our collective knowledge easier to access, understand, and act on.
This role will lead that evolution.
You will own WME's data product strategy, self-service analytics, shared business definitions, domain intelligence, and the business roadmap for predictive and decision-support capabilities. You will also help us rethink how the third-party data we license can become a reusable capability across our products and businesses.
The goal is straightforward: turn WME's data into products and intelligence that help our people make better decisions, identify opportunities, serve clients, and grow the business.
What You'll Do:
Build WME's Data Product Strategy
Define and lead a data product roadmap tied to real business decisions and opportunities.
Turn important datasets into trusted, reusable products rather than inputs to individual reports.
Identify where recurring analytical needs should become self-service capabilities and where expert analysis remains the better answer.
Define the users, business meaning, quality expectations, access requirements, and success measures for major data products.
Measure adoption and business impact, and continuously improve what we build.
Make Trusted Data Easier to Use
Modernize WME's self-service analytics and reporting capabilities.
Make common business questions easier to answer without requiring an analyst for every request.
Give users the context they need to understand what a metric means, where it came from, how current it is, and when it should be used.
Establish shared definitions for critical business concepts and improve consistency across teams and systems.
Reduce duplicated and bespoke reporting through reusable datasets, metrics, and analytical products.
Turn Data Into Intelligence
Identify where WME's proprietary data can reveal opportunities, patterns, and insights that aren't visible through external market data alone.
Build domain intelligence capabilities that combine deep understanding of our businesses with strong analytical judgment.
Own the business roadmap for capabilities such as matching, predictive pricing, demand forecasting, relationship intelligence, recommendations, opportunity detection, and anomaly detection.
Determine when sophisticated modeling is warranted — and when a simpler analytical approach will produce a better result.
Define success in business terms such as revenue, conversion, pricing, productivity, targeting, and client outcomes.
Make More of Our External Data
WME licenses valuable data across entertainment, audiences, media, touring, brands, and other markets.
You will:
Develop the product strategy for making those sources more reusable across WME.
Partner with research, engineering, procurement, and business teams to identify the sources that create the most value.
Help move external data from isolated reports into reusable datasets and capabilities.
Measure utilization and value to inform which sources we retain, expand, replace, or retire.
Explore opportunities to combine proprietary and external data in ways that create differentiated capabilities for WME and our clients.
Build the Function
Build and lead a focused team with strong analytical, business, and product judgment.
Develop domain expertise around the areas where WME has the greatest opportunity to create value from data.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Research, Operations, Cybersecurity, and business leaders across WME.
Establish clear standards for data quality, definitions, governance, measurement, and responsible use.
Create leverage through strong systems, shared capabilities, automation, and partnerships rather than simply adding headcount.
How You'll Work
This is not a traditional reporting leadership role.
You will spend significant time understanding how WME's businesses work, how decisions get made, and where better information could change an outcome.
You'll move between strategy and execution: defining a multi-year direction while helping teams solve practical problems today.
You'll work closely with our Product and Engineering organization. Engineering owns the technical data platform, including data engineering, pipelines, APIs, infrastructure, and production ML. You will own the business and product side of the data strategy: what we should build, why it matters, how it should be understood, and whether it is creating value.
You'll also partner with specialist teams across WME, including Finance and WME Insights, rather than trying to centralize every form of analysis into one organization.
What We're Looking For
Significant experience leading a data, analytics, data product, or applied intelligence function.
A track record of turning data into products or capabilities that people actually use.
Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish an interesting analytical problem from a valuable business problem.
Experience building self-service analytics or data products without sacrificing context, quality, or governance.
Strong analytical fluency and comfort challenging assumptions, evaluating evidence, and communicating uncertainty.
Experience partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science/ML, and senior business leaders.
Technical fluency across modern data platforms, warehouses/lakes, APIs, BI, data quality, metadata, access controls, and predictive modeling concepts.
Experience working with third-party data providers and finding ways to reuse licensed data across products and workflows.
Strong executive communication skills and the ability to translate complex analytical or technical ideas into clear business decisions.
Comfort operating in a complex organization where valuable knowledge is distributed across people, systems, and teams.
Experience in media, entertainment, sports, marketplaces, talent businesses, financial data, recommendation systems, or client-facing data products is a plus.
The Mindset We're Looking For
Data is a product. A dataset creates value when people can find it, understand it, trust it, and use it repeatedly.
Start with the decision. The goal isn't more sophisticated analysis. It's better decisions and better outcomes.
Be ambitious and practical. You can see the path toward predictive intelligence while still improving what people need today.
Stay curious about the business. You want to understand how agents and business teams actually work, not just the data they produce.
Build for leverage. You look for reusable capabilities, automation, and strong partnerships before solving a problem with additional headcount.
Measure what matters. Success is adoption, better decisions, commercial impact, and client outcomes — not the number of dashboards, models, or datasets produced.
What Success Looks Like
Over time, you'll help WME move from a world where data is often something people request to one where trusted information and intelligence are available where decisions happen.
Common questions become self-service. Important business concepts have shared definitions. Proprietary and third-party data can be reused across products and workflows. Predictive capabilities move out of experiments and into everyday work. Our specialist teams spend more time on high-value thinking and less time servicing repeatable requests.
Most importantly, WME gets better at using what it collectively knows to identify opportunities and advocate for our clients.
Per local requirements and in the interest of transparency, the rate shown below reflects the prevalent current hiring range for this position. Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. The company strives to provide locally competitive rewards packages, which include base rate along with, as applicable, short- and long-term incentives, growth and developmental opportunities, and robust benefits, such as health care, retirement, vacation and other paid time off, and additional offerings.
Hiring Rate Minimum:
$195,000 annually (minimum will not fall below the applicable state/local minimum salary thresholds)
Hiring Rate Maximum:
$260,000 annuallyWME is an equal opportunity employer and encourages applications from qualified and eligible candidates regardless of sex, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, or religion or belief.

jobs.text:
About Us
Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.
Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

jobs.title: Director, Data Strategy & Analytics
jobs.text:
Director of Data Strategy & Analytics
Job Location: US, Remote. Candidate must reside and work within the US.
Job Overview:
Lexia's data assets are central to how we grow and how we demonstrate impact. We are seeking a Director of Data Strategy & Analytics to lead the team that turns those assets into insight and action across the business, in alignment with our vision.
Reporting to the VP, Strategic Planning & Business Enablement, the Director will lead Lexia's internal business analytics function, directly managing a team of analysts and combining human analyst work with AI-enabled, self-service capabilities to maximize the use and business impact of our engineered data assets. The Director will be the primary analytics partner to Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and the Lexia executive team, and will own strategy and governance for our BI and analytics systems.
Reporting to this role is the leader of the Data Engineering team, responsible for data infrastructure and architecture. The Director of Data Strategy & Analytics will provide strategic leadership across both analytics and data engineering to ensure our data ecosystem enables business insights while maintaining the integrity, security, and confidentiality of enterprise data assets.
Job Responsibilities:
Team Leadership & Development
Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for data and analytics that aligns with the organization's mission, vision, and strategy, leveraging data to optimize decision-making, increase operational efficiency, and maximize impact.
Manage, mentor, and develop a team of analysts, providing regular feedback and fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.
Own project management and prioritization for all business analytics work, including analyst and AI-enabled analytics projects, and oversee review and QA to ensure data products meet high standards for quality/accuracy, user-centricity, and action-oriented data storytelling.
Support the Director of Analytics Engineering and foster a culture of continuous learning and development across the Data Strategy & Analytics team, promoting collaboration, innovation, and excellence.
Business Analytics & Insights
Drive analyst efforts to mine revenue, operational, and customer data and turn them into insightful KPIs, models, and dashboards that help our teams pursue revenue optimization and operational efficiency.
Partner with stakeholder teams across the organization to identify opportunities for leveraging data to drive innovation and improve operational efficiency.
Self-Service & AI-Enabled Analytics
Develop and maintain a scalable suite of self-service dashboards, AI agents, and conversational interfaces that enable non-technical staff to ask and answer questions of our data directly.
Establish enablement frameworks for self-service analytics that drive adoption, empower users, and provide guardrails to ensure effective and appropriate use.
In partnership with Analytics Engineering, oversee the integration of AI capabilities into analytics tools and workflows to scale self-service and operational efficiency.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Serve as the main point of contact and key data partner for Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and senior leadership, ensuring the alignment of analytics efforts with business needs and priorities.
Serve as the main point of contact for Cambium and Veritas analytics requests and collaborations, delegating to and partnering with the Director of Analytics Engineering as appropriate.
Translate business needs into clear downstream data requirements and metric definitions, partnering with the Director of Analytics Engineering to ensure the right data warehouse marts and Tableau Cloud data sources are provisioned, and providing input into data architecture, integration, and AI infrastructure decisions.
Analytics Systems, Tools & Governance
Own Tableau/BI system strategy and governance, in collaboration with other analyst teams across the organization.
Lead vendor and tool procurement and management for analytics systems and team tools, in consultation with the Director of Analytics Engineering.
Chair Lexia's cross-functional data governance group, collaborating closely with Legal, IT, and data leads to establish and maintain data and AI governance policies, procedures, and controls, and own policy compliance and appropriate sensitive data usage across DS&A-owned systems, staff, and products.
Stay abreast of emerging trends and technologies in advanced analytics, AI, and data management, and provide strategic recommendations for business innovation and responsible use.
Job Requirements:
Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, economics, business, computer science, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
10+ years of experience in analytics, data strategy, or a related field, with a proven track record of delivering data-driven solutions that drive business impact.
5+ years of experience managing, coaching, or leading data analysts or analytics teams.
Exceptional leadership and management skills, with experience leading high-performing teams in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Excellent quantitative and analytical skills with experience in data visualization, statistical modeling/machine learning, and go-to-market domain analyses (e.g., campaign attribution, price sensitivity, account scoring, retention/churn analysis).
Professional proficiency in analytics and BI tools that align with our tech stack (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Python or R), and working knowledge of data engineering and cloud data platforms (e.g., Dbt, Redshift, AWS) sufficient to partner effectively with Analytics Engineering.
Experience owning BI platform strategy and governance, and managing analytics vendor and tool relationships.
Expertise in data management, including metric definition, data governance, and data quality management.
Demonstrated experience building or implementing AI-assisted analytics workflows, such as AI agents, natural language query interfaces, or LLM-driven analytics, with a deep understanding of the data privacy, security protocols, and ethical governance required to deploy them, including hallucination guardrails.
Familiarity with sales and customer data platforms (e.g., Salesforce) and experience within a SaaS B2B or B2G organization preferred.
Excellent communication, data storytelling, and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into clear, actionable recommendations for executive and non-technical audiences.
Strategic mindset and the ability to manage challenging priorities across multiple stakeholders.
To learn more about our organization and the exciting work we do, visit .
Remote First Work Environment
Our Remote First approach gives employees the flexibility and trust they need to effectively balance work with life. It creates a culture in which all employees are valued and where success is measured in results. It allows us to work collaboratively, inclusively and for greater positive impact, regardless of our individual locations.
If you will be working remotely, either occasionally or on a permanent basis, you must have a reliable internet connection through a cable or fiber-optic broadband service with minimum speeds of 10 Mbps download and 5 Mbps upload.
The successful candidate will be expected to actively participate in video-based interviews during the recruiting process and ongoing virtual meetings with their camera on, as part of their role. To maintain confidentiality and ensure a fair evaluation process, the use of note-taking tools, reference materials, or AI-powered tools (including generative AI, language models, or similar technologies) during interviews or other selection activities is prohibited unless prior written approval has been obtained from the People Experience team. If you require an exception for medical, accessibility, or other reasons, please contact your Talent Acquisition team member to discuss accommodations in advance.
As part of our Remote-First benefits, Cambium offers reimbursement to help cover the cost of setting up your home or remote office.
An Equal Opportunity Employer
We are dedicated to fostering a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, ideas, and experiences. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, age, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender, gender identity/expression, or sexual orientation), national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or genetic information (including family medical history).
We will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. You may request an accommodation during the recruiting process with your Talent Acquisition team member.
