jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Microsoft Product Partnership
jobs.text:
We seek a Director of Product Management to set and lead the product strategy for the Microsoft partnership across ServiceNow's full vertical stack, from data and AI through agents, governance, and industry-specific workflows. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope and executive-level influence. You are the senior product leader and definitive internal authority on how ServiceNow's platform aligns with Microsoft's product stack end-to-end.
The scope is intentionally broad and will shift as both companies' product stacks evolve. Rather than a fixed list of integration points, this role is defined by a mandate: wherever ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack meet, you are accountable for the product relationship. You'll partner with product marketing, business development, corporate development, and other functions to define and execute the engagement strategy, track execution milestones, and maximize value generated for ServiceNow, our customers, and Microsoft. You will serve as ServiceNow's senior product counterpart to Microsoft product leadership.
What you get to do in this role:
Set the strategy for and lead technical due diligence, roadmap alignment, and integration delivery across the Microsoft relationship, from qualification through activation-ready handoff to GTM, spanning whichever stack layers are active priorities at a given time, not a fixed set.
Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise view of where ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack intersect, so the organization always has one owner and one point of view on the relationship rather than fragmented, layer-by-layer ownership.
Drive dual-roadmap alignment: translate Microsoft's capability and platform changes into internal roadmap asks, and translate ServiceNow's platform roadmap into Microsoft-facing requirements.
Define and advocate ServiceNow's point of view on how Microsoft's stack complements (rather than overlaps with) our platform, and articulate that positioning clearly to internal and partner stakeholders.
Define success metrics and measure downstream customer-funnel signals (adoption, attach rate, win/loss) across the partnership in partnership with GPC and field, and use them to drive roadmap and investment decisions.
Own prioritization and resourcing recommendations across this broad scope, and decide, with leadership, where to go deep now versus defer. Communicate the rationale clearly.
Shape and recommend leadership-level decisions on deeper strategic engagement with Microsoft (investment, co-sell motions, joint roadmap commitments).
Track competitive and industry trends across the Microsoft ecosystem, and define the implications and response for partnership strategy.
Lead cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Platform, Product Marketing, and GTM BD across the many teams whose work touches the Microsoft relationship. Represent ServiceNow in executive and strategic customer and partner engagements where Microsoft-specific technical context is needed, without owning the deal.
To be successful in this role you have:
Demonstrated ability to operate across a wide, multi-layered product scope without needing it reduced to a fixed checklist, with comfort synthesizing a coherent strategy across data, AI, agents, governance, and application-layer partnership work.
15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS product management, with working knowledge of key SaaS growth drivers.
Track record of setting multi-year product strategy and influencing decisions at VP and C-level, internally and at partner or customer organizations.
Experience critically integrating AI into product decision-making, workflow design, or technical evaluation of partner solutions.
Experience leading product strategy for technology partnerships, including build-vs-partner analysis, technical due diligence, and integration architecture.
Experience owning business cases for partnership investment, including accountability for outcomes, combining analytical rigor with judgment under ambiguity.
Comfortable operating with dual accountability: influencing an internal roadmap you don't own and a partner roadmap you don't control, across an unusually broad set of stack layers.
Highly collaborative; able to drive alignment and decisions across many internal teams at the senior leadership level without direct authority over the people or teams involved.
Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to represent partnership rationale clearly to both technical and executive audiences, including translating across very different technical domains.

Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform and applications portfolio, and the associated competitive/partner landscape, is a plus.
Broad familiarity with Microsoft's AI, data, and agent product ecosystem is a strong plus. Depth in a few areas plus fluency across the rest is more valuable here than deep expertise in only one.
Hands-on product management experience with AI-powered or AI-enabled enterprise software is a strong plus.

Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. blocks.text: We seek a Director of Product Management to set and lead the product strategy for the Microsoft partnership across ServiceNow's full vertical stack, from data and AI through agents, governance, and industry-specific workflows. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope and executive-level influence. You are the senior product leader and definitive internal authority on how ServiceNow's platform aligns with Microsoft's product stack end-to-end.

The scope is intentionally broad and will shift as both companies' product stacks evolve. Rather than a fixed list of integration points, this role is defined by a mandate: wherever ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack meet, you are accountable for the product relationship. You'll partner with product marketing, business development, corporate development, and other functions to define and execute the engagement strategy, track execution milestones, and maximize value generated for ServiceNow, our customers, and Microsoft. You will serve as ServiceNow's senior product counterpart to Microsoft product leadership.

items: Set the strategy for and lead technical due diligence, roadmap alignment, and integration delivery across the Microsoft relationship, from qualification through activation-ready handoff to GTM, spanning whichever stack layers are active priorities at a given time, not a fixed set.

Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise view of where ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack intersect, so the organization always has one owner and one point of view on the relationship rather than fragmented, layer-by-layer ownership.
Drive dual-roadmap alignment: translate Microsoft's capability and platform changes into internal roadmap asks, and translate ServiceNow's platform roadmap into Microsoft-facing requirements.

Define and advocate ServiceNow's point of view on how Microsoft's stack complements (rather than overlaps with) our platform, and articulate that positioning clearly to internal and partner stakeholders.

Define success metrics and measure downstream customer-funnel signals (adoption, attach rate, win/loss) across the partnership in partnership with GPC and field, and use them to drive roadmap and investment decisions.
Own prioritization and resourcing recommendations across this broad scope, and decide, with leadership, where to go deep now versus defer. Communicate the rationale clearly.
Shape and recommend leadership-level decisions on deeper strategic engagement with Microsoft (investment, co-sell motions, joint roadmap commitments).
Track competitive and industry trends across the Microsoft ecosystem, and define the implications and response for partnership strategy.

Lead cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Platform, Product Marketing, and GTM BD across the many teams whose work touches the Microsoft relationship. Represent ServiceNow in executive and strategic customer and partner engagements where Microsoft-specific technical context is needed, without owning the deal.

jobs.title: Director, Salesforce Technology
jobs.text:
Please use Google Chrome or Mozilla Firefox when accessing Candidate Home.
By joining the American Red Cross you will touch millions of lives every year and experience the greatness of the human spirit at its best. Are you ready to be part of the world's largest humanitarian network?
Join us—Where your Career is a Force for Good!
Job Description:
WHY CHOOSE US?
Joining The American Red Cross is like nothing else – it’s as much something you feel as something you do. You become a vital part of the world’s largest humanitarian network. Joining a team of welcoming individuals who are exceptional, yet unassuming. Diverse, yet uncompromising in unity. You grow your career within a movement that matters, where success is measured in people helped, communities made whole, and individuals equipped to never stop changing lives and situations for the better.
When you choose to be a force for good, you’ll have mentors who empower your growth along a purposeful career path. You align your life’s work with an ongoing mission that’s bigger than all of us. As you care for others, you’re cared for with competitive compensation and benefits. You join a community that respects who you are away from work as much as what you do while at work.
WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW ABOUT THE JOB:
The American Red Cross seeks an experienced Director, Salesforce Technology to lead the engineering organization supporting RC Care, its mission-critical client case management and financial assistance platform for disaster relief services. Built on Salesforce Agentforce Service and Experience Cloud, RC Care enables the Red Cross volunteer workforce to provide timely, scalable assistance to clients in need 24/7.
This leader will work closely with Product Management, Service Design, Solution Architecture, business stakeholders, and enterprise technology partners to align engineering priorities with user needs and mission outcomes. The role leads a dedicated Agile, cross-functional product team organized into four pods and is responsible for building a high-performing engineering organization capable of delivering secure, scalable, and sustainable solutions.
This is a technical and people leadership role with accountability for engineering talent, delivery quality, platform reliability, operational sustainability, and the continued evolution of RC Care.
The work location for this exciting opportunity is virtual. The selected candidate will work 100% remotely from home and can be located anywhere in the United States but must work an east coast schedule.
WHERE YOUR CAREER IS A FORCE FOR GOOD (Key Responsibilities):
Talent and Engineering Leadership
Recruit, lead, coach, and develop Salesforce developers and test engineers, creating clear expectations and meaningful growth opportunities.
Build a high-performing engineering culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence.
Manage team capacity, resource allocation, performance, and staffing across product initiatives and operational priorities.
Product Delivery and Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner with Product Management, Service Design, Solution Architecture, business stakeholders, and enterprise teams to deliver solutions aligned with user needs and mission outcomes.
Lead engineering involvement across the full product lifecycle, including discovery, design, estimation, development, testing, deployment, monitoring, support, and continuous improvement.
Lead Agile and SAFe planning activities, including sprint execution, PI planning, prioritization, dependency management, and cross-team coordination to ensure successful delivery.
Promote disciplined Agile practices and ensure engineering commitments are realistic, transparent, and aligned with roadmap priorities, business value, and mission outcomes.
Technical Leadership and Platform Stewardship
Serve as the senior engineering leader for RC Care, establishing technical standards, engineering practices, and delivery expectations.
Provide technical coaching and oversight related to architecture, design patterns, Salesforce capabilities, integrations, security, scalability, and software engineering practices.
Partner with Solution Architecture to evaluate technical options and ensure solutions are secure, reliable, maintainable, scalable, and aligned with long-term platform strategy.
Guide modernization, technical debt reduction, and adoption of emerging Salesforce capabilities that support evolving business needs.
DevOps, Quality, and Operational Excellence
Advance CI/CD, automated testing, code review, quality gates, release management, environment management, observability, and deployment practices.
Define and monitor engineering and product health metrics related to delivery performance, reliability, defects, incidents, technical debt, and operational effectiveness.
Lead incident response, root-cause analysis, corrective actions, Salesforce release readiness, and continuous improvement of platform reliability.
Ensure required documentation, operational procedures, security controls, and on-call support practices are maintained for this mission-critical platform.
Vendor and Partner Management
Lead third-party technology partners and vendor teams, ensuring adherence to technical standards, security requirements, service expectations, and delivery commitments.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
Scope: Establish operating policies and procedures that affect departments and subordinate sections and work units. Interpret company-wide policies and procedures. Develop budgets, schedules, and performance standards.
Note: Qualified candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. The American Red Cross does not sponsor employment visas.
Direct applicants only; no agency or third-party candidate submissions.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED (required/minimum qualifications):
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience
Leadership & Delivery Skills
Minimum 5 years of IT leadership or management experience leading software engineering teams.
Demonstrated ability to build high-performing engineering organizations and develop technical talent.
Experience leading Agile development teams in complex, cross-functional environments.
Strong partnership skills with product management, architecture, design, business stakeholders, and enterprise technology teams.
Proven ability to balance delivery speed, quality, operational excellence, and long-term maintainability.
Technical Skills
10+ years of software engineering experience in enterprise environments, including experience supporting mission-critical business platforms.
5+ years leading Salesforce or enterprise application development teams.
Demonstrated experience providing technical leadership, coaching engineers, reviewing solution designs, and driving engineering excellence.
Experience establishing engineering standards, DevOps practices, operational support models, and software delivery processes.
Strong understanding of software architecture, application security, API and integration patterns, cloud platforms, and modern software engineering practices.
Salesforce platform experience, including Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), integrations, and platform security.
Travel: ~10% annual domestic travel to meetings/ conferences.
WHAT WILL GIVE YOU THE COMPETITIVE EDGE (Preferred Qualifications):
•Salesforce Data Cloud experience.
MuleSoft or enterprise integration experience.
Experience improving DevOps maturity within enterprise technology organizations.
SAFe experience, including Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and PI Planning.
Commitment to the non-profit sector and its values
Prior experience in nonprofit, humanitarian, or mission-driven organizations.
Ability to clearly articulate hands-on involvement in prior work.
Preferred Certifications:
Salesforce Platform Developer I Certification.
Salesforce Platform Developer II Certification.
Salesforce Application Architect Certification.
Salesforce System Architect Certification.
•Salesforce Certified Administrator.
Combination of candidate’s education and general experience satisfies requirements so long as the total years equate to description’s minimum education and general experience years combined (Certification cannot be substituted).
Physical Requirements are those present in normal office environment conditions. Operational flexibility is required to meet sudden and unpredictable needs. Ability to use a personal computer, applicable software, and office equipment for sustained periods of time. May include sitting for long periods of time, driving a vehicle, and working under challenging conditions.
+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
PAY INFORMATION:
The annual salary range for this position is $170K - $190K. We do not offer an annual bonus for this role. Note that American Red Cross salaries are aligned to the specific geographic location in which the work is primarily performed. Other factors that may be used to determine your actual salary may include your specific skills, how many years of experience you have and comparison to other employees already in this role. **We will review specific salary information at the time of phone screening based upon your location & experience.**
This job will be posted for a minimum of five business days and extended if the applicant pool needs to be expanded.
BENEFITS FOR YOU:
As a mission-based organization, we believe our team needs great support to do great work. Our comprehensive package includes:
•Medical, Dental Vision plans
Health Spending Accounts & Flexible Spending Accounts
PTO: Starting at 19 days a year; based on type of job and tenure
Holidays: 11 paid holidays comprised of six core holidays and five floating holidays
•401K with up to 6% match
•Paid Family Leave
•Employee Assistance
Disability and Insurance: Short + Long Term
•Service Awards and recognition
*LI-EH1
Apply now! Joining our team will provide you with the opportunity to
make your career a force for good!
The American Red Cross is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
​
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, San Diego Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act and any other applicable state and local laws.
AmeriCorps, the federal agency that brings people together through service, and its partners — the Peace Corps, AmeriCorps Alums, National Peace Corps Association, and the Service Year Alliance — launched Employers of National Service to connect national service alumni with opportunities in the workforce. American Red Cross is proud to be an EONSpartner and share our employment opportunities with the network of organizations.
Interested in Volunteering? Visitredcross.org/volunteertoday to learn more, including our most-needed volunteer positions.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
Overview
To drive innovation and operational excellence through technology that enables teams to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences. The Business Systems department delivers software to drive business process optimization through automation, intuitive workflows, and data governance. Our goal is to serve our internal customers (operators & support departments) with solutions that empower them to maximize their performance and enhance the customer journey.
Position Summary
The Senior Director, Data & Analytics leads the strategic direction, delivery, and operational maturity of RPM Living's Data & Analytics organization within Product & Engineering. This role partners directly with the SVP, Data & Analytics, to build and scale internal data engineering, analytics, and governance capabilities, reducing reliance on third-party contractors while establishing RPM Living as a data-driven, insight-led organization.
Responsibilities
• Serve as the senior operating leader for the Data & Analytics team, translating the SVP's vision into staffing plans, delivery roadmaps, and quarterly priorities.• Own end-to-end delivery of the Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold/semantic layers) in partnership with the Data Engineering Lead and Lead Data Architect.• Directly manage and develop a team spanning data engineering, analytics/BI, data governance, and QA, including performance management, career development, and org design.• Partner with business stakeholders across property operations, finance, and technology to prioritize analytics and reporting initiatives, including cross-platform data integrations and business processes.• Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across 30+ source integrations (Yardi, RealPage, UKG, Salesforce, and others).• Evaluate and drive adoption of AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude, CodeRabbit) to accelerate engineering velocity and analytics delivery.• Present roadmap progress, risks, and organizational health to senior executive leadership.• Manage vendor and contractor relationships, budgets, and resourcing decisions for the Data & Analytics function.• Define and enforce architectural and coding standards, working closely with the Lead Data Architect to ensure long-term platform scalability.
Education and Experience
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field. Experience may substitute for education.• Ten years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence, including Five+ years in a people-leadership role.• Five years’ experience with modern cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse/SQL, or equivalent) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).• Experience in multifamily, real estate, or another property-operations-driven industry is a plus but not required.
• Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical strategy for non-technical senior leadership.• Knowledge of data architecture patterns (medallion/lakehouse), data governance frameworks, and modern BI/semantic modeling practices.• Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing technical teams in a rebuild/turnaround environment.• Strong vendor management and contract negotiation skills, particularly related to managed services and staff augmentation.• Comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope typical of a growing, newly-formed department.• Working knowledge of AI-assisted development and analytics tooling and its application to team productivity.
Qualifications

jobs.title: Head of Data Science
jobs.text:
What do we do?
Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.
We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.
The role:
We are looking for a Head of Data Science to build Paddle's data science capability from the ground up. Our Merchant of Record model gives us a data position no PSP or billing provider has: subscription and pricing context alongside granular payment-outcome data, across thousands of software businesses. This role exists to turn that into economic value by putting machine learning and agentic systems into production.
The mandate is deliberately narrow and deliberately ambitious: data science at Paddle owns automated decisioning inside the product — traditional machine learning and agentic systems alike — not decision-support analytics.
We have a long list of candidate opportunities than we can fund, spanning payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance. We have a working hypothesis about which of these pays back first, and we'll share it — but part of the job in your first quarter is to pressure-test it, size the alternatives yourself, and tell us where to start.
This is a founding role, and for the first few quarters it is a building role more than a managing one. You'll be the only person in the function: doing the analysis, engineering the features, training and evaluating the models or agents, taking the first system live with our engineering teams — and then operating it, answerable for its uptime, its drift and its numbers. Once the first use cases are proving out, you'll hire and lead a hub-and-spoke team of data scientists and machine learning engineers embedded across our highest-value business areas. You'll report into the VP of Data and work in close partnership with Product, Payments, Engineering, Risk and Finance.
What you'll do:
Prioritise which opportunities have the biggest impact.. Build a value-based use-case backlog across payment performance and revenue recovery, sales and marketing operations, growth and monetisation intelligence, and risk, trust and compliance; size the leading candidates properly; and make the call on sequencing with the relevant Product, Risk, RevOps and Finance stakeholders. This gets refreshed quarterly.
Personally deliver the first system end to end: the analysis and back-test, the features, the model, policy or agent, the deployment, and the shadow and A/B tests that prove it works. Not a spec handed to someone else to build.
Operate what you deploy. Own monitoring, retraining, drift response, incident handling and rollback for live decisioning, alongside the engineering teams whose services call it — and set the expectation that the function runs its systems rather than shipping them.
Work across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and be honest about which a problem actually needs: a propensity or uplift model, a policy of rules, or an agent with tools, evals against golden answer sets and trace-level observability. Several of our strongest candidate use cases point each way.
Build and lead the team — hire senior data scientists embedded in value areas and machine learning engineers in the hub, and set the professional standards, shared methods and reusable components the function runs on.
Establish the production stack alongside Data Platform and Engineering: reproducible training data, code and artefacts; a model registry; inference services with real latency, availability and rollback requirements; historically accurate features where decisions need backdated reconstruction; eval harnesses and trace observability for agentic workflows; and monitoring for data quality, drift, model performance and economic outcomes. Start ad hoc where that's sufficient and platformise once the first use cases have shown what's actually needed.
Own value capture end to end. Shadow-test and A/B test every deployment against the incumbent strategy, translate metric movement into a financial number on a methodology co-signed by Finance, and publish a quarterly report on realised value.
Set the governance model for automated decisioning — proportionate risk assessment, clear ownership, latency and availability requirements, human escalation and rollback — working with Legal, Privacy, Compliance and Risk on GDPR, EU AI Act and payments obligations, and producing the evidence early enough to shape the design.
Define the boundaries and the working relationship with Product Science, Analytics Engineering, Data Platform and AI Enablement, so accountability for decision support versus automated decisioning stays unambiguous.
Deliver cross-functionally: embed in delivery groups with product owners, domain experts and platform engineers rather than handing models over the wall.
We'd love to hear from you if you:
Experienced leading data science or ML teams that own systems in production, with deployments that moved a commercial metric and kept running afterwards. Proofs of concept and dashboards are not what we're hiring for.
Hands-on now, not formerly. Your first quarters are spent writing SQL and Python, engineering features, evaluating models and agents, and doing the work that gets a system live — not reviewing someone else's.
Experienced across both traditional ML and agentic systems, and clear about how they differ in practice: propensity and uplift models, feature pipelines and drift on one side; tool and context design, prompt and retrieval iteration, evals against golden answer sets and trace observability on the other.
Practised at running live systems rather than just launching them — monitoring, retraining, incident response, rollback, and the on-call reality of a decision the business depends on.
Pragmatic about method: happy to argue for rules or heuristics where they capture most of the value, and to reserve models and agents for where they genuinely earn their keep.
Comfortable with an undefined starting point. There's a long list of candidate use cases and a strong internal hypothesis, but no fixed roadmap — you'll be expected to form your own view, back it with numbers, and defend it to an executive audience.
Strong on measurement — experimentation, uplift modelling, back-testing — and willing to hold your own work to a financial number that Finance will scrutinise.
Fluent in the engineering side of production ML and agents (training pipelines, model registries, inference services, feature stores, drift detection, trace observability) and able to hold your own with senior engineers on latency, availability, observability and rollback.
Able to hire, level and develop senior data scientists and ML engineers, and to set standards for a function that doesn't exist yet.
Credible with executives and commercial stakeholders: you can take a use case from business problem to value estimate to prioritisation decision, and say no to low-value work.
Experienced in payments, fintech, subscriptions, high-volume commercial operations or another regulated transactional domain — enough to get to a credible value estimate in a new area quickly.
Comfortable treating regulated ML as a design constraint rather than paperwork — model risk assessment, DPIAs, auditability, traceability of model and policy versions to production decision logic.
Everyone is welcome at Paddle
At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.
Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.
Why you’ll love working at Paddle
We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.
We live and breathe our values, which are:
Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”
Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”
Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”
We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.
We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.
Connecting at Paddle
We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.
We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.
Our Paddle hubs:
In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)
In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)
Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.
To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

jobs.title: Product Finance Director, AI Products & GPU Investment Strategy
jobs.text:
(GAQ427R229)
About the role
AI is the defining platform shift of our generation, and Databricks is right at the center of it. We are looking for a Product Finance leader to scale the fastest growing part of our business with both speed and financial rigor. You will be the primary finance partner to our AI Engineering and Product leaders, with a mandate that spans the full arc of the AI business: planning GPU supply and demand across clouds, shaping how we price AI products, and building the unit economics that will define the margins of this category for years to come.
The impact you will have
Plan the GPU supply and demand that powers the business
Establish a trusted, unified GPU demand plan across production inference, internal research, and new product bets so we invest ahead of growth without over-provisioning.
Drive capacity commitment and procurement strategies across major hyperscalers and emerging neoclouds, optimizing the mix of reserved, spot, and on-demand compute.
Own AI product economics and partner on pricing
Lead revenue and margin analytics across the AI product portfolio, turning raw consumption telemetry into a clear read on customer adoption, retention, and product profitability.
Model the end-to-end unit economics of AI products before they ship, partnering with Product and Pricing to design consumption structures that drive adoption while protecting gross margin targets.
Establish robust KPIs and operations to drive best-in-class execution
Partner with Engineering to define north star efficiency KPIs (e.g., GPU utilization, cost per token/query, serverless efficiency) and translate them into committed engineering roadmaps.
Run tight financial operations, from auditable multi-cloud cost allocation to automated reporting, giving product and engineering leaders real-time visibility into their economic goals.
Bring finance rigor to the biggest investment decisions
Design ROI and capital allocation frameworks to evaluate asymmetric bets—including frontier model research, internal compute clusters, and strategic partnerships.
Build, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of product finance analysts capable of operating at the intersection of deep technical infrastructure and commercial strategy
What we look for
Required
10+ years of experience in Strategic/Product Finance, complemented by foundational training in Investment Banking, Private Equity, or Management Consulting.
Deep fluency in consumption-based business models, public cloud infrastructure costs, unit cost analysis, and gross margin optimization.
A proven track record of partnering directly with senior Engineering and Product executives to influence technical roadmaps and commercial pricing.
Demonstrated ability to build scalable financial systems from scratch and distill massive, complex telemetry data into models and recommendations leaders act on.
Experience building, leading, and developing high-output finance teams in fast-moving environments.
Preferred
Direct experience operating in the AI and GPU economy, including familiarity with training/inference workloads, hyperscaler commitment structures, and neocloud economics.
Ownership of a multi-product P&L within a high-growth enterprise SaaS, PaaS, or data infrastructure company.
Hands-on proficiency with SQL, Python, or notebook environments to self-serve insights from raw usage data.
Pay Range Transparency
Databricks is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The pay range(s) for this role is listed below and represents the expected salary range for non-commissionable roles or on-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, depth of experience, relevant certifications and training, and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Databricks anticipates utilizing the full width of the range. The total compensation package for this position may also include eligibility for annual performance bonus, equity, and the benefits listed above. For more information regarding which range your location is in visit our page here.

About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. jobs.title: Chief Product and Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Who we are
Athos Commerce is the only all-in-one intelligent discovery platform that connects shoppers to the right products across whatever channel they are shopping: a brand's own site, marketplaces, social, comparison shopping engines, and AI platforms.
More than 2,700 brands, including Adidas, Burberry, Clarins, and Marks & Spencer, rely on our AI-powered search, merchandising, personalization, and product feed management to help shoppers find the right product faster, reduce manual work for merchandisers, and drive higher conversion and average order value.
Who You Are
You are a strategic, commercially minded product and technology executive who combines deep technical expertise with a strong understanding of customer needs and business outcomes. You have a proven ability to lead both Product and Engineering organizations, build scalable technology platforms, and translate market insights into successful products.
You are a hands-on leader who thrives in complex environments, makes thoughtful investment decisions, and balances innovation with operational excellence. You are comfortable leading organizational transformation, integrating technology platforms, and developing high-performing global teams.
You bring strong executive presence, sound technical judgment, and a collaborative leadership style. You enjoy engaging directly with customers and partners, challenging conventional approaches, and leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve customer experiences and organizational effectiveness.
What You'll Do?
As Chief Product and Technology Officer, reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the product and technology strategy for Athos Commerce, translating commercial objectives into a clear product direction, strategic investment decisions, and consistent execution. You will oversee Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Platform Operations, Product Design, Data, and Information Security while leading the next stage of integration across our established commerce platforms. Working closely with customers, agency partners, and executive leadership, you will drive product innovation, improve customer experiences, and ensure our technology remains secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective. This is a hands-on executive role where you will balance long-term strategic priorities with delivering meaningful improvements to customers across our platforms.
How You Will Succeed
Define Product and Technology Strategy: Establish a unified product and technology vision aligned with customer needs, market opportunities, and business growth objectives, including the strategic application of AI and emerging commerce channels.
Lead Product Strategy and Execution: Oversee customer discovery, product roadmaps, lifecycle management, and investment prioritization, using customer evidence, commercial potential, and engineering capacity to guide decisions.
Drive Platform Integration and Modernization: Lead the continued integration of Athos Commerce's established platforms while maintaining product delivery, improving technical architecture, and managing technical debt.
Improve Customer Experience and Self-Service: Make Athos products faster to implement and easier for merchants and agency partners to configure independently, reducing reliance on engineering resources and improving time to value.
Build a High-Performing Engineering Organization: Lead global engineering teams to deliver high-quality software improvements predictably while maintaining strong development practices, accountability, and execution.
Ensure Platform Reliability and Security: Oversee architecture, cloud infrastructure, platform operations, security, and compliance to maintain reliable, scalable, and cost-effective technology.
Strengthen Customer and Commercial Partnerships: Engage directly with merchants, agency partners, and prospects while partnering with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance on product positioning, pricing, launches, and strategic customer commitments.
Develop and Scale Global Leadership Teams: Recruit, mentor, and develop senior Product and Technology leaders, establish clear ownership and accountability, and foster a collaborative culture across distributed teams.
Drive AI Innovation and Adoption: Identify opportunities to bring AI and machine learning capabilities to market while embedding AI into Product and Engineering workflows to improve efficiency, quality, and customer outcomes.
Own Financial Planning and Technology Governance: Manage Product and Technology budgets, workforce planning, vendor decisions, technology investments, and risk management while communicating priorities, performance, and material risks to executive leadership and the board.
What We're Looking for
Significant senior leadership experience within a software or SaaS organization, with direct responsibility across both Product and Engineering functions.
Proven track record of developing and executing product and technology strategies that deliver measurable customer value and commercial results.
Direct experience building ecommerce search, product discovery, merchandising, or personalization products; marketing technology experience is a plus.
Strong technical judgment across software architecture, development practices, cloud infrastructure, platform reliability, scalability, and information security.
Experience leading complex platform integrations, technology modernization initiatives, or organizational transformation while maintaining ongoing product delivery.
Practical experience bringing AI and machine learning capabilities to market and integrating AI into Product and Engineering workflows.
Strong commercial understanding of SaaS business models, including recurring revenue, customer retention, margins, profitability, and cost to serve.
Demonstrated success building, scaling, and developing senior Product and Engineering leadership teams.
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple countries, regions, and time zones.
Ability to make and communicate complex tradeoffs between business growth, customer commitments, delivery capacity, and long-term platform sustainability.
Strong financial and operational management experience, including departmental budgets, workforce planning, and strategic technology investments.
Excellent executive communication skills, with the ability to engage customers, agency partners, technical teams, executive leadership, and board members.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate across commercial and technical functions to drive shared business objectives.
Benefits
Open PTO
Company-paid health, dental, and vision insurance
Medical and dependent care flexible spending accounts (FSA)
Company-paid Short Term and Long Term Disability coverage
Company-paid Life and AD&D coverage
Voluntary benefits, including critical illness, accident insurance, legal services, and pet insurance
401(k) plan with employer match
Flexible work environment. Work from one of our offices, hybrid, or remote.
Athos Commerce is an equal-opportunity employer and proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. We strongly believe that diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are essential in cultivating an inclusive culture and building an innovative, successful organization. All qualified applicants are considered for employment, without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. If you require accommodation during the application process, please don't hesitate to contact us.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Head of Product - Subscriptions
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
You are an experienced Product Leader—strategic, analytical, and customer-focused with strong problem solving skills and a commercial mindset.
You will own Membership Plans and the wider Subscriptions platform across multiple markets, shaping how we structure, price, and deliver value to our members as Tide scales. This role is central to defining the future of our subscription offering, ensuring it is flexible, competitive, and aligned to member needs.
Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will optimise the end-to-end subscription experience. This includes defining and refining membership tiers, benefits, and pricing models, while ensuring seamless lifecycle management—from sign-up and upgrades through to renewals, downgrades, and cancellations.
You will join the Member Engagement Marketing (MEM) product group, responsible for driving engagement, retention, and long-term member value. Membership Plans sit at the heart of this mission, ensuring members clearly understand and experience the value of their Tide membership. You will collaborate closely with Billing, Payments, Marketing, Data, Finance, Engineering, and Design to deliver a frictionless, transparent, and engaging subscription journey.
As Head of Product for Membership Plans, you will:
Own the strategy, vision, and roadmap for our global Membership Plans, delivering a high-quality, scalable member experience.
Define, evolve, and optimise subscription tiers, benefits, and pricing, using customer insight and data to drive impact.
Lead end-to-end product delivery, from discovery through execution, across the full subscription lifecycle.
Partner cross-functionally to deliver measurable business outcomes, aligned to company OKRs and growth priorities.
Champion best-in-class user experience, ensuring clarity, transparency, and consistency across all membership touchpoints.
Mentor and support Product Managers as the team scales.
Leverage qualitative and quantitative insights to improve retention and long-term member value.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
10+ years of product management experience, with proven ownership of subscription, membership, or product-led growth initiatives.
Strong analytical and commercial capability, with experience defining KPIs/OKRs and driving revenue- and retention-focused outcomes.
Excellent cross-functional leadership, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across technical and commercial teams.
A customer-first, outcome-driven mindset, focused on delivering meaningful, high-impact member experiences.
Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-scaling environments, translating complexity into clear priorities and execution plans.
Clear, confident communicator, able to articulate product vision and trade-offs to diverse audiences.
Experience building scalable, global products, with awareness of local market and regulatory considerations.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

At Avanade, the best deals aren't just sold — they're engineered. As an Associate Director, Industry Technology Strategist, you sit on the front lines of our growth, working shoulder to shoulder with clients and our most senior sellers to shape pursuits, sharpen our story, and turn ambition into signed business. This is a role for someone who loves being in the room where deals are made, who thinks like a strategist and acts like a closer, and who wants their fingerprints on how Avanade goes to market.
You won't be supporting the sale from the sidelines. You'll be driving it — translating client challenges into compelling solutions, guiding pursuit teams through complex opportunities, and serving as a trusted advisor clients actually want at the table.
Come join us
There is one in every group - the person who dreams big and has the motivation to bring their ideas to life, even as others might roll their eyes and prefer to play it safe. Are you that person?
Are you the one who isn’t afraid to break the mold and who gets passionate about the power of digital to transform organizations and ways of working? Because we are building teams of people like that to help our clients unlock the power they need now and own what is next. Together we do what matters.
What you’ll do
Lead from the front line of sales. Partner directly with clients and account leaders to scope, shape, and win high-value opportunities — bringing clarity, creativity, and momentum to every pursuit.
Be the connective tissue of the deal. Orchestrate the people, assets, and decisions that move a pursuit forward, ensuring pursuit teams have exactly what they need, exactly when they need it.
Shape how we sell. Design the playbooks, differentiators, and cross-sell motions that give our sellers an edge — and continuously raise the bar on how Avanade competes and wins.
Influence our offerings and go-to-market. Bring the voice of the client and the market back into the business, helping evolve our solutions, industry plays, and territory strategy so we stay ahead of where demand is heading.
Own the growth picture. Drive account planning, territory analysis, pipeline health, and revenue forecasting that leadership relies on to make the big calls.
Champion selling excellence. Embed best-in-class pursuit discipline (DEEPR) and enablement tools so every team operates at the top of its game.
Spot the next opportunity first. Anticipate shifting client and market needs and proactively reshape how we engage — staying one step ahead of expectations.
About you
Characteristics that can spell success for this role:
You love to work collaboratively with energy, drive and dedication to overcome obstacles to achieve your goals.
You take ownership and encourage others to make a positive impact.
You have superb interpersonal skills and can establish strong relationships.
You anticipate and neutralize obstacles and objections.
You are a skilful influencer of internal and external resources.
Enjoy your career
Some of the best things about working at Avanade:
Opportunity to work for Microsoft’s Global Alliance Partner of the Year (20 years in a row), with exceptional development and training (minimum 80 hours per year for training and paid certifications)
Real-time access to technical and skilled resources globally
Dedicated career advisor to encourage your growth
Engaged and helpful coworkers genuinely interested in you
A great place to work
As you bring your skills and abilities to Avanade, you’ll get distinctive experiences, limitless learning, and ambitious growth in return. As we continue to build our diverse and inclusive culture, we become even more innovative and creative, helping us better serve our clients and our communities. You’ll join a community of smart, supportive collaborators to lift, mentor, and guide you, but to also lean on your expertise. You get a company purpose-built for business-critical, leading-edge technology solutions, committed to improving the way humans work, interact, and live. It’s all here, so take a closer look!
We work hard to provide an inclusive, diverse culture with a deep sense of belonging for all our employees. Visit our Inclusion & Diversity page.
Create a future for our people that focuses on
• Expanding your thinking • Experimenting courageously • Learning and pivoting
Inspire greatness in our people by
• Empowering every voice • Encouraging boldness • Celebrating progress
Accelerate the impact of our people by
• Amazing the client • Prioritizing what matters • Acting as one
.
Skills and experiences
A genuine passion for solving complex client problems and a relentless, customer-first mindset.
A track record of leading complex pursuits or engagements to successful outcomes.
The presence and credibility to be seen as a leader — by clients, by sellers, and across the business.
Sharp analytical instincts: you read the data, find the signal, and turn it into action.
The ability to motivate and orchestrate teams — direct, indirect, onshore, and offshore.
A strong network you know how to mobilize, and the savvy to navigate complexity with ease.
Outstanding written and verbal communication — you can frame a strategy and tell a story that lands.
Strongly preferred: Experience shaping outsourcing / managed-services deals or other transformational engagements with significant offshore delivery, and a feel for leveraging global teams in a pursuit.
Compensation at Avanade varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Avanade provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.
We anticipate this job posting will be posted on 10/12/2026 and open for at least 10 days.
Avanade offers a market competitive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan, bonus opportunities, paid holidays, and paid time off. See more information on our benefits here:

jobs.title: Design Director
jobs.text:
Please note that we will never request payment or bank account information at any stage of the recruitment process. As we continue to grow our teams, we urge you to be cautious of fraudulent job postings or recruitment activities that misuse our company name and information. Please protect your personal information during any recruitment process. While Monks may contact potential candidates via LinkedIn, all applications must be submitted through our official website (monks.com/careers).
About the Role
Monks is seeking an experienced Design Director to provide creative leadership for an embedded team supporting one of our largest technology clients. Working in person alongside client stakeholders, this role will maintain creative continuity, uphold a high standard of craft and ensure work remains cohesive across teams, shifts and deliverables.
The ideal candidate has deep experience working within robust design systems and knows how to apply established standards without making the work feel mechanical. You will guide designers and motion creatives, resolve design questions quickly and help the team deliver polished editorial and marketing content at speed.
An interest in AI, emerging technology and new approaches to creative production is essential.
Work Location & Schedule
This role requires working onsite at our client's office in Menlo Park, CA, 4–5 days per week.
In This Role, You Will
Provide day-to-day creative leadership for the embedded design and motion team.
Maintain continuity and a consistent creative standard across locations, shifts and workstreams.
Translate established brand guidelines and design systems into clear, actionable direction.
Ensure work is visually cohesive, accurate and appropriately tailored to its audience and channel.
Review and guide digital, web, editorial, presentation, graphic and motion deliverables.
Partner closely with the Executive Producer to balance creative quality with timing, capacity and business priorities.
Work directly with client stakeholders to clarify creative direction, resolve feedback and keep work moving.
Provide clear, consolidated feedback that enables teams to execute efficiently.
Identify when existing components or templates can be used and when a new design solution is required.
Support the evolution of templates, component libraries and documentation as program needs develop.
Collaborate with technical writers to ensure design supports the clarity and integrity of complex subject matter.
Mentor designers and motion creatives, providing practical guidance and helping them operate with greater independence.
Partner with AI and creative technology specialists to explore responsible ways to improve workflows, consistency and production efficiency.
Maintain discretion when working with confidential and highly sensitive information.
Experience You Bring
8+ years of experience in design, art direction or creative direction within an agency, technology company or in-house creative organization.
Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary design teams and maintaining quality across high-volume or rapid-turn work.
Deep familiarity with established brand systems, component libraries, templates and scalable design frameworks.
Strong digital and web design experience, including responsive layouts and accessibility considerations.
Ability to assess work quickly, provide decisive direction and distinguish critical issues from subjective preferences.
Strong understanding of typography, hierarchy, composition, visual storytelling and motion principles.
Experience collaborating with production, editorial, product, legal and technical stakeholders.
Professional fluency in written and spoken English is required.
Excellent presentation, communication and feedback skills.
Interest in AI, emerging technology and production innovation.
Working Model
This is an in-person, client-facing role embedded with the client team. The Design Director will guide a distributed creative team operating across multiple global locations and shifts, with availability during core client working hours and flexibility around urgent priorities.
At Monks, we believe in fostering an environment where a diversity of perspectives can thrive. We proactively work to design hiring processes that promote equity and inclusion while mitigating bias. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage qualified applicants, from all backgrounds, who are excited to contribute to our mission.
This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.

#LI-ZZ1
What We Offer
Benefits
Excellent, full coverage medical, dental, and vision insurance - more about our coverage here!
Generous PTO and 15 company-wide holidays
401k with company contribution
Paid parental leave
Work-life balance with an emphasis on personal well-being
Career growth in a disruptor space & entrepreneurial opportunities within the Monks network
A globally diverse & inclusive culture with employee resource groups such as S4 Melanin, Pride.Monks, Cultura.Monks, and more!
Authentic commitment to DEI efforts and sustainable growth. (Why Sir Martin Sorrell signed The Climate Pledge here!)
This role is subject to our Return to Office (RTO) policy. If you reside within a commutable distance of one of our office locations, you will be expected to work from the office a set number of days per week. The specific details, including the number of required office days, will be in accordance with the company’s then-current RTO policy, which is subject to change from time to time.
Monks has provided a compensation range that represents its good faith estimate of what Monks may pay for the position at the time of posting. Monks may ultimately pay more or less than the posted compensation range. The salary offered to the selected candidate will be determined based on job-related factors, but not based on a candidate’s sex or any other protected status.
Salary Range:
$135,000—$145,000 USD
About Monks
Monks is the global, digital-first, data-driven, unitary operating brand of S4Capital plc, where our culture centers on how we show up for the work and for one another. That begins with the commitment to strive for mastery—taking deep pride in our craft and creating work that sets the bar. In everyday execution, we drive momentum by choosing bold action rather than waiting for certainty. Above all, our teams are stronger together, bringing diverse perspectives into a unified team that communicates with clarity, trust, and mutual respect.
This commitment to craft and innovation translates directly into widespread industry acclaim: Monks was named a Contender in The Forrester Wave™: Global Marketing Services and a leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Global Digital Marketing Agencies. It ranks among Cannes Lions' Top 10 Creative Companies (2022-25) and remains the only partner featured in AdExchanger’s Programmatic Power Players list every year (2020-24). Named Adweek’s first AI Agency of the Year (2023) and The One Show’s inaugural AI Pioneer Organization (2025), Monks was also awarded Business Intelligence Group’s 2026 Excellence in Artificial Intelligence Award in the Human-Machine Interaction Team category. Additionally, Monks.Flow earned AI-based Marketing Solution of the Year at the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards and a 2026 Global Generative AI Award in the Agentic Marketing Innovation category. Finally, Monks achieved a record-breaking number of FWAs and continues to hold the most of any partner.
We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management – Enterprise Data Platform
jobs.text:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.
Newsweek Recognizes Sedgwick as America’s Greatest Workplaces National Top Companies
Certified as a Great Place to Work®
Fortune Best Workplaces in Financial Services & Insurance
Director, Product Management – Enterprise Data Platform
Primary Purpose
The Director, Product Management - Data Systems leads product strategy for our enterprise data foundation, including the Snowflake-based platform and supporting data systems that power OmniAnalyst, OmniInsights, and our broader data product ecosystem. Reporting to the Vice President of Data Product Management, this role defines the capabilities, governance, and roadmap needed to deliver scalable, secure, and trusted data products across the enterprise.
As the product leader for the data platform, this individual serves as the primary intake and prioritization point for platform requests, aligns stakeholders across business and technology teams, and ensures the platform delivers business value while maintaining long-term scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.
Essential Responsibilities
Define Platform Capabilities
Defines the capabilities required of the enterprise data foundation, including governed data sharing, access controls, entity resolution, semantic models, shared definitions, and data quality standards.
Partners with Data Architecture and Data Engineering to design scalable, secure, and well-governed platform capabilities aligned with enterprise standards.
Champions modern data architecture practices, including data mesh and layered (medallion) architectures, to drive consistency and reusability across the enterprise.

jobs.title: Head of Data and AI
jobs.text:
Job Title: Head of Data and AI
Location: Thailand
Employment Type: Full-time
About the Company
Our client is a fast-growing technology company specializing in AI-driven enterprise solutions that deliver measurable business impact. The organization is expanding its capabilities across advanced analytics, Large Language Models (LLMs), and intelligent automation to support large-scale enterprise clients.
Role Overview
We are seeking a Head of Data and AI to lead the companys data and AI vision, strategy, and execution. This role combines technical leadership, AI research direction, data strategy, and enterprise solution delivery. The ideal candidate has a strong background in Data Science, proven experience with LLM implementation, and the leadership capability to build and scale high-performing Data and AI teams.
You will serve as the organizations data and AI authority, shaping the roadmap, guiding innovation, and ensuring successful deployment of scalable AI and data solutions at enterprise scale.
Key Responsibilities
Data & AI Strategy
Define and drive the company-wide Data and AI strategy and roadmap
Act as the internal and external Data & AI subject-matter expert
Identify new opportunities where data and AI can create business value
Team Leadership
Lead and mentor cross-functional teams across Data Engineering, Data Science, AI Engineering, and AI Research
Build a strong culture focused on innovation, experimentation, and delivery excellence
Oversee hiring, capability development, and team scaling initiatives
Solution Delivery
Guide end-to-end delivery of enterprise data and AI solutions, from concept to deployment
Ensure scalable, secure, and production-ready architectures
Collaborate with Solution Architects, Engineers, and Business Teams to translate data and AI into measurable business outcomes
AI Research & Innovation
Drive research initiatives in LLMs, Generative AI, and advanced ML techniques
Evaluate emerging AI technologies and integrate relevant advancements into company solutions
Establish best practices in AI model governance, evaluation, and lifecycle management
Qualifications
Strong background in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering
Proven hands-on experience implementing LLM-based solutions in production environments
At least 3 years of experience managing Data or AI teams
Demonstrated success delivering large-scale enterprise IT, data, or AI solutions
Solid understanding of data architecture, AI model lifecycle, MLOps, and data pipelines
Ability to balance research innovation with practical business delivery
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills
Preferred Qualifications
Experience working on enterprise-scale or mission-critical technology projects
Background in AI productization, data platforms, or AI platform development
Exposure to AI governance, responsible AI, and data governance frameworks
