jobs.title: Head of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Head of Software Engineering to lead the software engineering function behind advanced electro-optical products that protect people and critical assets around the world.
Reporting directly to the CTO, you’ll lead a growing team of over 10 software engineers, owning the function’s capability, standards and delivery from early concepts through to deployment and in-service improvement. You’ll translate technical direction, product priorities and customer requirements into clear engineering commitments, ensuring the team has the structure, resources and expertise to deliver as OpenWorks grows.
This is an opportunity for an established software leader with deep technical expertise and a proven track record of building high-performing teams and delivering complex products. You’ll have the authority to shape the function, strengthen engineering performance and make a direct contribution to our products and wider business success.
Who We Are
OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.
Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.
We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.
The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.
Security Vetting Information
OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.
Why You’ll Love Working With Us
Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.
Here’s what our benefits have to offer:
Rewarding Success - Competitive salary, starting from £90,000, plus a discretionary annual bonus of up to 25% of salary alongside a structured pay progression framework.
Enhanced Pension – Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.
More Time to Recharge – 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.
Breakfast & Lunch on Us – Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.
Health & Wellbeing – Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.
Sustainable Travel – Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.
Team Socials – Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.
Learning & Growth – A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.
What you’ll be doing:
Lead the Software Engineering function: Own the function’s performance and development, setting clear expectations and building a high-performing, collaborative and accountable culture.
Build capability for growth: Shape the team structure, plan future skills needs and develop capability through recruitment, coaching, succession planning and professional development.
Own engineering delivery: Translate product, customer and business priorities into achievable plans, taking accountability for resources, capacity and commitments across multiple projects.
Provide technical direction: Set architecture principles, engineering standards and development practices, applying deep software expertise to challenge decisions and resolve complex technical issues.
Lead the software lifecycle: Oversee the transition of emerging technologies into product development, owning the software contribution from concept through verification, release, deployment and in-service improvement.
Deliver integrated products: Work with Hardware & Systems, Intelligence & Autonomy, Product and Operations to ensure effective integration, production handover and long-term supportability.
Align teams and inform decisions: Resolve cross-functional barriers and give the CTO clear visibility of progress, risks, dependencies and capacity constraints, recommending trade-offs where wider business decisions are needed.
Drive engineering performance: Improve productivity and delivery practices, balancing pace with technical rigour and contributing as a senior leader to the wider Engineering organisation and business performance.
Apply expert technical knowledge: Bring deep software engineering expertise to evaluate complex problems, challenge technical assumptions and guide sound decisions across architecture, development and product integration.
What we’re looking for:
Essential
Proven software leadership: Significant experience leading and developing software teams within complex R&D and product development environments.
Technical credibility and qualifications: A strong software engineering background and C++ development experience, supported by a relevant degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Physics or a related technical discipline.
Embedded product experience: Experience delivering complex software on real-time embedded platforms, integrating with mechanical and electronic engineering.
Architecture and lifecycle expertise: Strong understanding of system design, hardware, operating systems and software interfaces, alongside code review, source control, testing, release management and configuration control.
People and delivery focus: A track record of developing high-performing teams, managing priorities and resources across multiple projects, and maintaining momentum as priorities change.
Desirable
Relevant product experience: Experience in electro-optical, autonomous, radar, surveillance or counter-UAS technologies, or regulated, safety-critical environments and defence standards.
Relevant technologies: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Linux hardware drivers, network configuration, TCP/IP, CMake, DevOps, Python, cyber security or video streaming.
Qualifications: A relevant master’s qualification, Chartered Engineer status or equivalent professional recognition.
Defence Standards: Experience in regulated, safety-critical or quality-focused environments, or knowledge of defence engineering standards.
You must have the right to work in the UK; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Occasional travel may be required.
More about us:
Vision
Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.
Mission
Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence
Values
Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest
Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done
Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility
We are one team: Look out for each other and the team
Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on
Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people
We Get It Done: Focus on what matters and work with energy to bring ideas to life

jobs.title: Head of Hardware & Systems Engineering
jobs.text:
The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Head of Hardware & Systems Engineering to turn advanced technology into robust, reliable and manufacturable products that protect people and critical assets around the world.
Reporting directly to the CTO, you’ll lead a growing team of over 10 engineers across Mechanical, Electronics and Systems, shaping capability, standards and delivery from early concepts through to manufacture. As a senior engineering leader, you will provide technical judgement and challenge, give the CTO clear visibility of priorities, progress, risks, dependencies and resource constraints, and contribute to the wider development and performance of OpenWorks.
This is an opportunity for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys technical complexity, develops talented people and brings clarity to competing priorities. You’ll have the scope to strengthen how we work and make a visible impact as OpenWorks grows.
Who We Are
OpenWorks is a rapidly growing business operating globally with a passion for exceptional engineering and building on a legacy of defence innovation in the North East of England.
Our products provide ultra-high performance, real-time detection, tracking, identification and targeting of dynamic aerial threats. They have been deployed internationally to protect high profile military and civilian assets, and contribute towards the defeat of nuisance, misguided and maliciously deployed drones during operations.
We are very proud to have supported a wide range of law enforcement and military operators, protecting many of the most high profile sites and individuals around the world.
The amazing things we do are only possible because of a dedicated and passionate team.
Security Vetting Information
OpenWorks Engineering operates within the defence sector. As part of our recruitment and onboarding processes, we collect information that may be required to support future security vetting and clearance requirements, should these become necessary during employment.
Why You’ll Love Working With Us
Join a high-energy, collaborative team where great ideas thrive, challenges are embraced, and people genuinely love what they do.
Here’s what our benefits have to offer:
Rewarding Success - Competitive salary, starting from £90,000, plus a discretionary annual bonus of up to 25% of salary alongside a structured pay progression framework.
Enhanced Pension – Up to 8% employer-matched contributions to help you plan for the future.
More Time to Recharge – 25 days’ holiday plus public holidays, long-service rewards, and the option to buy up to 5 extra days.
Breakfast & Lunch on Us – Enjoy team breakfasts and freshly prepared lunches every day courtesy of Chef Mark and his team.
Health & Wellbeing – Private healthcare and life assurance for added peace of mind.
Sustainable Travel – Salary sacrifice schemes, including EV car and Cycle to Work options.
Team Socials – Regular events, from quiz nights and football to board games and more.
Learning & Growth – A culture that empowers you to challenge, grow and make an impact, plus a £250 annual learning budget to invest in the development that matters most to you.
What you’ll be doing:
Lead the Hardware and Systems engineering function: Own the leadership and performance of Mechanical, Electronics and Systems Engineering, building a high-performing, collaborative and accountable culture.
Build capability for growth: Shape the team structure, identify future skills needs and develop capability through recruitment, coaching, succession planning and professional development.
Own engineering delivery: Translate product and business priorities into achievable plans, taking accountability for capacity, resources and commitments across multiple projects.
Provide technical leadership: Set engineering standards, provide credible challenge and act as an escalation point for complex decisions, ensuring technical risks, requirements and interfaces are effectively managed.
Lead the product lifecycle: Oversee the transition of emerging technologies into product development, leading delivery from concept through verification, new product introduction and in-service improvement.
Ensure production readiness: Embed manufacturability, testability, compliance and supportability throughout development, working with Production Engineering and Operations to enable effective production handover.
Align teams and inform decisions: Work closely with Software, Intelligence & Autonomy, Product and wider business leaders to align priorities and resolve barriers, giving the CTO clear visibility of progress, risks and required trade-offs.
Improve engineering performance: Drive productivity and effective ways of working, balancing pace and technical rigour while contributing to the wider engineering strategy and business performance.
Expert technical knowledge: Bring deep expertise in Systems, Mechanical or Electronics Engineering, with the breadth of understanding to challenge technical decisions across disciplines and resolve complex engineering problems.
What we’re looking for:
Essential
Proven engineering leadership: Significant experience leading and developing multidisciplinary teams in complex R&D and product development environments.
Technical credibility and qualifications: A strong Systems, Mechanical or Electronics background, supported by a relevant engineering degree or equivalent, with the confidence to challenge experienced engineers.
Full lifecycle delivery: A track record of taking products combining mechanical, electronics and software from concept through verification, new product introduction and manufacture.
Systems thinking: Strong judgement around requirements, integration, technical risks and trade-offs, with an understanding of configuration control and engineering change.
People and delivery focus: Experience managing performance, priorities and resources across multiple projects, building collaboration and maintaining momentum as priorities change.
Experience of growth and complexity: A proven track record of delivering in complex, fast-paced engineering environments, adapting to changing priorities as the business grows while maintaining focus on delivery.
Desirable
Relevant technology experience: Experience in electro-optical, autonomous, radar, surveillance or counter-UAS systems.
Defence Standards: Experience in regulated, safety-critical or quality-focused environments, or knowledge of defence engineering standards.
Qualifications: A relevant master’s qualification or Chartered Engineer status through IET, IMechE or an equivalent body.
You must have the right to work in the UK; we are unable to offer visa sponsorship. Occasional travel may be required.

Help protect the territory and airspace of NATO countries and their allies.
Mission
Be a world-leading provider of autonomous technology for Surveillance applications and Defence
Values
Be a Good Egg: Earn respect, have mutual trust and be honest
Do cool stuff: We develop cool tech with an awesome team, and we get stuff done
Be empowered: We are autonomous, reliable and take personal responsibility
We are one team: Look out for each other and the team
Things go wrong: Fail fast, learn and move on
Have fun: We’re doing amazing things with passionate people

jobs.title: Director, Technology Innovation COE
jobs.text:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
Job Details
JOB SUMMARY:
The Director of Technology Innovation Center of Excellence (CoE) is a strategic leadership role responsible for governing and advancing the evaluation, selection, and deployment of emerging technologies across the supply chain organization. This individual will own and continuously refine a structured stage gate process for vetting technology innovations — ensuring that investments are rigorous, aligned to business priorities, and positioned to deliver measurable supply chain value.
This leader will serve as the bridge between technology vendors, internal stakeholders, and executive decision-makers, championing a disciplined yet agile approach to innovation.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Stage Gate Process Ownership
Design, implement, and continuously improve a multi-stage gate framework for evaluating, piloting, and scaling supply chain technology innovations
Define clear criteria, scoring rubrics, and decision checkpoints for each gate (e.g., ideation, feasibility, pilot, scale, sunset)
Lead cross-functional gate review committees, facilitating structured go/no-go decisions with executive stakeholders
Maintain a transparent innovation pipeline dashboard, tracking all active and archived technology candidates
Technology Evaluation & Scouting
Proactively identify emerging technologies relevant to supply chain operations (e.g., AI/ML, robotics, IoT, digital twins, blockchain, autonomous systems)
Develop and maintain relationships with technology vendors, startup ecosystems, and industry research bodies (e.g., Gartner, Forrester, industry consortiums)
Conduct structured technology assessments including market analysis, vendor due diligence, and total cost of ownership modeling
Represent Cencora at industry forums, innovation councils, conferences, and strategic vendor engagements; maintain awareness of supply chain innovation trends and benchmark practices across industries.
Stakeholder Engagement & Governance
Partner with Supply Chain operations, IT, Finance, Legal, and Compliance to ensure holistic vetting of technology candidates
Build and manage a Technology Innovation Advisory Board comprising internal subject matter experts and external advisors
Develop executive-ready business cases and investment proposals for technologies advancing through the pipeline
Drive alignment between innovation initiatives and the broader supply chain strategic roadmap
Portfolio & Performance Management
Manage the innovation portfolio budget, ensuring appropriate resource allocation across stages of the gate process
Establish KPIs and success metrics for piloted and deployed technologies, measure realized benefits including cost savings, productivity improvements and service enhancements and reporting outcomes to senior leadership
Conduct post-implementation reviews to capture lessons learned and refine the vetting framework over time
Team Leadership & CoE Culture
Lead and mobilize a cross-functional network of internal stakeholders and subject matter experts, driving innovative outcomes through influence rather than direct authority
Build trust and credibility across Supply Chain, IT, Finance, Operations, and other functions by demonstrating deep expertise, active listening, and collaborative problem-solving
Create alignment around a shared innovation vision by engaging stakeholders early and often throughout the stage gate process
Design and facilitate working sessions, workshops, and forums that draw out subject matter expertise and foster co-ownership of technology evaluation decisions
Cultivate a culture of curiosity and structured experimentation across the stakeholder community, encouraging teams to surface and champion emerging technology ideas
QUALIFICATIONS:
Required
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Business, Information Systems, or a related field
10+ years of experience in supply chain operations, strategy, or technology — with at least 3–5 years in a leadership role
Demonstrated experience designing or managing a stage gate, innovation pipeline, or technology governance process
Strong understanding of supply chain operations across distribution, logistics, procurement, or inventory management
Proven ability to build executive-level presentations and facilitate senior leadership decision-making forums
Experience managing cross-functional programs from concept through implementation
Preferred
Master's degree (MBA, MS Supply Chain, or related)
Experience in pharmaceutical distribution, healthcare supply chain, or highly regulated industries
Familiarity with frameworks such as Stage-Gate®, Lean Startup, or Design Thinking
PMP, Agile, or related certifications
Experience working with or evaluating enterprise technology vendors (ERP, WMS, TMS, AI platforms)
What Cencora offers
We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit
Full time
Salary Range*
$119,100 - 186,560
*This Salary Range reflects a National Average for this job. The actual range may vary based on your locale. Ranges in Colorado/California/Washington/NewYork/Hawaii/Vermont/Minnesota/Massachusetts/Illinois State-specific locations may be up to 10% lower than the minimum salary range, and 12% higher than the maximum salary range.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Cencora is committed to providing equal employment opportunity without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or membership in any other class protected by federal, state or local law.
The company’s continued success depends on the full and effective utilization of qualified individuals. Therefore, harassment is prohibited and all matters related to recruiting, training, compensation, benefits, promotions and transfers comply with equal opportunity principles and are non-discriminatory.
Cencora is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities during the employment process which are consistent with legal requirements. If you wish to request an accommodation while seeking employment, please call 888.692.2272 or email . We will make accommodation determinations on a request-by-request basis. Messages and emails regarding anything other than accommodations requests will not be returned
.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Are you ready to shape the future of authentication? Join 1Kosmos and help lead the next wave in identity assurance and passwordless innovation.
1Kosmos is driving the future of identity security, empowering organizations to eliminate passwords and establish trust at every step of the identity lifecycle. As a vibrant team of innovators, we develop advanced authentication solutions trusted by some of the world’s leading brands. Join us as we create a passwordless world and set new standards for digital identity assurance.
Your Title: Senior Director of Engineering
Your Location: Hybrid – Edison, NJ HQ
You Report to: SVP of Engineering and Chief Architect
Compensation: $225,000 or more depending upon experience
At 1Kosmos, our leaders are active, builder-first contributors. We are looking for an engineering leader who stays close to the code—someone who enjoys diving into technical challenges, understanding system internals, and driving execution from the front lines through active participation in architectural design, code reviews, and hands-on problem-solving.
You possess an "always sleeveless" mindset: no task is too technical, no bug is too small, and no architecture is too complex for you to dive into. You will step into a cloud-agnostic microservices environment, gain deep context on what we’ve built, and actively drive execution, performance, security, and system evolution.
What You’ll Do:
- Lead from the Front: Manage, mentor, and elevate a mid-sized engineering team while remaining deeply technical and hands-on in code, system design, and infrastructure.
- Master Existing Architecture First: Take full ownership of existing architectures. Deeply understand the whybehind our current design decisions before making tactical shifts or introducing new paradigms.
- Build Real Agentic Systems: Work hands-on with our agentic stack (AWS Bedrock / Python / Node), going far beyond basic LLM prompts or chatbots. Open the hood to optimize agent workflows, orchestration, reliability, and security.
- Drive Performance & Security: Maintain a relentless focus on low latency, high throughput, platform resilience, and enterprise security across our cloud-agnostic microservices topology.
- Own Delivery & Reliability: Partner with product and QA leads to ensure clean, reliable, and zero-downtime deployments.
- Foster a Zero-Ego Culture: Build a collaborative environment where ownership is non-negotiable, and execution speaks louder than slides.
What you bring:
- 10+ years of software engineering experience with recent, hands-on engineering leadership (Director / VP level in high-growth B2B SaaS).
- Core Microservices Stack: Deep, practical experience in Node.js (90% of our stack) alongside Java or GoLang.
- Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on mastery of containerized, cloud-agnostic environments (Kubernetes, AWS).
- Applied Agentic Experience: Demonstrated experience building and operationalizing autonomous agents and agentic workflows (experience with AWS Bedrock is a huge plus).
- Security-First Mindset: Deep appreciation for platform security, identity management, compliance, and secure software development practices.
- Leadership Style: Proven track record of both building 0-to-1 systems and taking ownership of mature, inherited codebases.
Who thrives here:
Builders who love creating something from nothing and aren't afraid of rolling up their sleeves
Fast movers who navigate ambiguity with confidence and iterate at speed
Problem solvers who are energized by complex, evolving challenges
Collaborators who can influence without authority and build strong cross-functional relationships
Data enthusiasts who let evidence drive decisions, not opinions
Mission-driven professionals passionate about fighting fraud and protecting customers
What we offer:
Opportunity to build and lead a critical function at a high-growth Series B startup
Competitive salary and equity package
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Unlimited PTO Policy
Collaborative, fast-paced culture where your impact is immediate and visible

jobs.text:
This is a remote position.
A Crypto wallet security infrastructure provider are looking for a VP of Solutions Engineering
They develop the most secure wallet-as-a-service infrastructure in Web3 : an API-first wallet management system, ideal for applications and organizations seeking to provide secure access to all blockchains through a single integration). APIs and SDKs were designed for wallet programmability and efficient implementations, enabling fast deployments, smart automation flows, as well as granular sets of permissions and policies via secure authentication credentials. They are on the way to become the leading wallet infrastructure for the multi-trillion-dollar digital asset industry.
The company is SOC-2 certified, employs 30 people across 6 countries and has raised over $20M since creation with prestigious investors. Their solution is used and trusted by major international corporations.
As the VP of Solutions Engineering you will help financial institutions and enterprises adopt the company's platform with confidence and ease.
This high-impact role is both strategic and hands-on:
You’ll design integrations for complex legacy systems, guide clients through deployment, and offer end-to-end technical support.
You’ll pair deep technical expertise with strong client-facing skills, serving as an advisor to CTOs, architects, and engineering teams at banks, fintechs, and enterprises.
You’ll design tailored solutions, deliver technical proposals, and drive adoption via troubleshooting, clear docs, and tight collaboration with engineering, security, and product.
You’ll sit at the intersection of engineering and customer success, equally comfortable whiteboarding ideas, writing code examples, and jumping on late calls to help a customer.
MISSIONS
Guide financial institutions through safe and seamless onboarding to the company's platform.
Architect secure, scalable deployment pathways that fit into legacy and modern systems.
Provide hands-on support: troubleshoot, fix, and build solutions alongside client teams.
Collaborate with sales to design technical proposals, demos, and RFP responses.
Maintain and improve technical docs and developer guides to industry standards.
Gather client feedback, analyze competitors, and turn insights into product tweaks.
Represent the company at conferences, workshops, and meetings as a technical thought leader.
Profil
10+ years in solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, or enterprise integration, with leadership experience.
Proven track record helping financial institutions deploy mission-critical systems.
Proficient in TypeScript (or similar languages) with strong API experience (REST).
Deep knowledge of cloud-native systems (AWS essential; GCP/IBM/Thales a plus), microservices, and serverless architectures.
Skilled in troubleshooting technical issues and delivering under pressure.
Strong understanding of enterprise security compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS)
Excellent communicator, able to bridge technical and business threads with clients.
Excellent doc and demo skills; able to clarify matters for tech and non-tech teams.
Knowledge of blockchain, digital assets, and financial workflows strongly preferred.
Certifications (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect) a plus; multilingual fluency also valued.
Informations contractuelles
Contract : Permanent role (Hybrid remote) in Nigeria or South Africa. remote first, office optional
Salary: 160,000–240,000 USD.
Equity: 100-200 stock options (0.1-0.4%) vested over 4 years with a one-year cliff.
Work essentials: MacBook Pro, iPhone, AirPods, screens, headsets, AirPods.
Training and coursework in Crypto, Blockchain, Security, code, Coding languages and other topics are paid for on-demand to encourage personal and professional growth.
Benefits: healthcare and life insurance, retirement plan, sponsored transportation, gym, lunch card, home office equipment, and other perks.
Recruitment process :
Video call with COO/CTO (30mn).
Cognitive and personality tests (45mn).
Coding test in a language of your choice
Focus interview (30mn x 3) : Code Review - Architecture review -Pre-sales fundamentals - Culture check fit
Final interview with Management (30mn)

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Acquisition Intelligence
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
The Role
The Director of Product Management for ZX leads product strategy and delivery for Zeta’s customer acquisition business unit. This leader turns the needs of ZX’s clients and teams into a clear product vision, roadmap, and set of priorities, working closely with Product, Engineering, Data Cloud, and business unit leadership to bring them to market.
The role requires both ownership of ZX’s distinct needs and a commitment to building One Zeta. The Director will identify where Zeta’s core platform can serve acquisition use cases, adapt those capabilities to ZX workflows, and help turn successful solutions into reusable products across the company. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, technical fluency, commercial understanding, and the ability to lead through cross-functional partnerships.
Key Responsibilities
Own the ZX product vision and roadmap. Define a product strategy for customer acquisition that reflects client needs, business priorities, and Zeta’s broader platform direction. Set priorities, articulate tradeoffs, and measure the impact of what the team ships.
Connect the business unit with Product and Engineering. Serve as the product lead for ZX, translating business opportunities and operational needs into clear requirements and delivery plans. Partner with engineering and platform teams from discovery through launch, adoption, and iteration.
Build on Zeta’s core capabilities. Apply Zeta’s identity, data, AI, activation, and measurement capabilities to ZX use cases. Determine when an existing platform capability should be configured, extended, or developed into a new product experience.
Lead the email acquisition product experience. Bring strong command of email acquisition and ESP ecosystems to the role. Shape the products and integrations that support audience targeting, deliverability, campaign execution, optimization, and measurement at scale.
Scale solutions across One Zeta. Identify common needs across ZX and other business units. Champion shared components, consistent workflows, and reusable approaches that strengthen the platform and avoid duplicative development.
Understand customers and the acquisition workflow. Work with ZX leadership, client teams, Sales, and customers to understand how marketers identify prospects, plan and activate campaigns, optimize performance, and measure outcomes. Use those insights to shape product decisions.
Drive execution and adoption. Align stakeholders around scope, milestones, dependencies, and success measures. Partner with GTM and client-facing teams on launches, demonstrations, and enablement so new capabilities solve real problems and are used effectively.
Qualifications
Significant product management experience, including ownership of a roadmap and delivery across multiple teams.
Experience with advertising technology, customer acquisition, marketing technology, or a related data-driven product area.
Deep understanding of email as an acquisition channel, including ESP platforms and integrations, audience and identity resolution, deliverability, campaign orchestration, and performance measurement.
Ability to translate commercial and customer needs into scalable product decisions and clear requirements for engineering teams.
Strong understanding of how data, identity, activation, and measurement work together in a marketing workflow.
A track record of influencing teams across business units and central platform organizations without relying on direct authority.
Sound judgment about when to tailor a product to a business need and when to invest in a shared capability.
Clear communication with technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.
BENEFITS & PERKS
Unlimited PTO
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employee Equity
Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!
SALARY RANGE
The salary range for this role is $220,000 - $250,000, depending on location and experience.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

jobs.title: Head of Digital Product, CRO & UX
jobs.text:
About us
We’re the team behind digital retailer Very.
Our purpose, helping families get more out of life, powers everything we do.
And we want our people to get more out of life too! If you’re high-performing, ambitious and make the most of every opportunity, we want to hear from you. In return, you’ll enjoy heaps of flexibility, great perks and benefits, and the freedom to be yourself, keep learning and take your career wherever you want it to go.
If you love making a difference, you’ll love making it sparkle for millions of Very customers. ✨
About the role
We’re looking for a Head of Digital Product, CRO & UX to help shape the future of Very.
This is an opportunity to lead our digital product strategy, customer experience and experimentation across Web and App, with a clear goal: creating better experiences for our customers while delivering measurable improvements in conversion, customer value and satisfaction.
You’ll own the direction and performance of our digital product portfolio, looking across the whole customer journey, from discovering products and joining Very through to shopping and managing an ongoing relationship with us. You’ll turn our growth ambitions into clear priorities, investment decisions and outcomes.
It’s a broad leadership role covering Product, User Experience, Research and Experimentation. You’ll also help shape how we use AI and personalisation to create more relevant Web and App experiences, making sure promising ideas demonstrate real customer and commercial value before we scale them.
If you enjoy bringing together customer insight, product thinking and commercial judgement to make meaningful decisions, there’s plenty here to get excited about.
What you'll be doing:
You’ll set a clear direction for our digital experience and give teams the focus and autonomy to turn that strategy into measurable results.
You’ll:
Own our digital product and experience strategy, setting the vision across Web and App and aligning roadmaps and investment to our growth plans.
Drive commercial improvement, helping Product and Experimentation make a measurable contribution to conversion and growth.
Lead our CRO and experimentation strategy, setting the ambition for how we test, learn and optimise across our digital journeys.
Improve the journeys our customers use every day, from discovery and consideration through onboarding, checkout and account management.
Lead Product, UX, Research and Experimentation capability, creating high standards while helping teams use customer insight, data and experimentation to make better decisions.
Set priorities and investment choices, concentrating capacity and budget on the opportunities with the greatest potential customer and commercial value.
Bring teams together around change, working across Technology, Delivery and the wider business to remove dependencies and create shared ownership of outcomes.
Build for the future, developing our approach to AI, personalisation and App growth while strengthening internal capability and strategic partner relationships.
About you
This is a senior leadership role, so we’re looking for someone who can move comfortably between strategy, commercial outcomes, customer experience and people leadership.
You’ll bring:
Significant experience leading digital product portfolios, ideally within ecommerce, retail or another customer-facing business.
A track record of turning business strategy into product direction and measurable commercial results.
Experience leading multiple squads and developing Product Managers, senior specialists and discipline leaders.
Strong experience across UX and Research, using genuine customer understanding to influence important decisions.
A strong grasp of experimentation and measurement, including experience scaling experimentation to create customer and commercial value.
Commercial curiosity and the ability to think across conversion, profitability and long-term customer value, rather than optimising an individual metric in isolation.
Evidence of leading complex cross-functional change, influencing senior stakeholders and making clear decisions when there are competing priorities.
Some of our benefits
Flexible, hybrid working model
Inclusive culture and environment, check out our Glassdoor reviews
£10,000 flexible benefits allowance to suit your needs
30 days holiday + bank holidays
LinkedIn learning access
Bonus potential (performance and business-related)
Up to 25% discount on Very.co.uk
Matched pension up to 6%
More benefits can be found on our career site
How to apply
Please note that the talent acquisition team are managing this vacancy directly, and if successful in securing this role, you will be required to undertake a credit, CIFAS, Right to Work checks and if a specific requirement of your role a DBS (criminal records) check. Should your application progress we require you to let the team know if there is anything you need to disclose in relation to any of these checks prior to them being undertaken, including any unspent criminal convictions.
What happens next?
Our talent acquisition team will be in touch if you’re successful so keep an eye on your emails! We’ll arrange a short call to learn more about you, as well as answer any questions you have. If it feels like we’re a good match, we’ll share your CV with the hiring manager to review. Our interview process is tailored to each role and can be in-person or held remotely.
You can expect a two stage interview process for this position:
1st stage - A 30-45 minute video call with the hiring team to discuss your skills and relevant experience. This is a great opportunity to find out more about the role and to ask any questions you may have.
2nd stage - A one-hour formal face-to-face interview where you can expect a task and both competency/technical skills based questions.
As an inclusive employer please do let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments.
If you'd like to know more about our interviews, you can find out here.
Diversity, inclusion and equal opportunities
We’re building a culture of everyday inclusion, and welcome applications from anyone who believes they can do the job. We don’t discriminate based on age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.
We want our recruitment process to be accessible to everyone. If you need reasonable adjustments to apply, interview, or perform a role, let us know via talentacquisition@theverygroup.com. We’ll be happy to support you.
We’re proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer and have nine brilliant colleague networks - including DAWN (Disability Awareness at Very) and Think (Neurodiversity at Very) - that are helping us make Very an even more inclusive place to work.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
About the Role:
Grade Level (for internal use):
13
The Role: Director, Software Engineering
The Team:This role partners with global platform, architecture, governance, security, data mastering, and Databricks-aligned teams to ensure offshore delivery aligns with enterprise standards. The team collaborates with partner teams, offshore teams, and upstream/downstream stakeholders to drive data platform initiatives and foster engineering excellence.
Responsibilities and Impact:
Drive Data Pipeline Transition and Platform Delivery: Partner with the core Databricks team to plan and execute the transition of existing data pipelines to the target enterprise data platform, implementing repeatable engineering patterns for ingestion, transformation, testing, deployment, and monitoring across onboarded datasets.
Champion AI-Assisted Engineering: Lead the adoption of AI-powered development tools like Claude, GitHub CoPilot, and LLMs to increase engineering velocity, code quality, and operational effectiveness, while developing context engineering practices and reusable context packs.
Provide Technical Direction for Data Onboarding: Guide offshore teams in defining and operationalizing asset-agnostic onboarding patterns for a broad range of data assets, domains, and source systems, establishing reusable ingestion and processing patterns across batch and streaming use cases.
Support Data Mastering Platform Integration: Integrate platform pipelines and datasets with the enterprise data mastering platform, establishing data quality controls, reconciliation processes, and metadata alignment to support trusted mastered data.
Influence Semantic Modeling and Data Discoverability: Support practices to create consistent business definitions, reusable data concepts, and governed consumption patterns, partnering with business, architecture, data governance, and platform teams.
Drive Technical Influence and Engineering Excellence: Serve as a senior technical expert for offshore data platform engineering, influencing architectural decisions, providing technical guidance to engineers and partner teams, and contributing to design/code reviews for complex data platform initiatives.
What We’re Looking For:
Basic Required Qualifications:
An S&P Global employee at this level would typically have 10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, cloud data architecture, software engineering, or related engineering domains.
Demonstrated experience operating as a senior Individual Contributor, technical lead, principal engineer, staff engineer, distinguished engineer, architect, or equivalent role in complex data platform environments.
Strong hands-on experience with modern data engineering and pipeline development, including batch and/or streaming data workflows, and experience with Databricks-based data platforms and lakehouse-oriented architectures.
Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude, GitHub CoPilot, LLMs, or similar, and experience applying LLMs to engineering use cases like code generation and optimization.
We require all external candidates who reach the final stage of our interview process to attend at least one in-person interview, which is ordinarily at your nearest S&P Global office. This must be completed before we can proceed to an offer.
Additional Preferred Qualifications:
Familiarity with enterprise data cataloging, metadata management, business glossary, lineage, operational metadata platforms, or semantic data layers.
Experience with NeoXam DataHub or NeoXam-style mastering workflows, including consolidation, cleansing, enrichment, and trusted downstream distribution of mastered data.
Knowledge of semantic modeling for designing consistent business definitions, improving data discoverability, and supporting governed data consumption.
Strong Leadership skills: including coaching, empowering others to maximize their performance, and working to build consensus across groups with competing priorities.
Compensation/Benefits (US Applicants Only):
S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $110,000 to $225,000. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.
In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan. This role is not eligible for additional compensation such as an annual incentive bonus or sales commission plan. This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here. Include for roles that are bonus plan eligible, including sales commission plans.

At S&P Dow Jones Indices, we provide iconic and innovative index solutions backed by unparalleled expertise across the asset-class spectrum. By bringing transparency to the global capital markets, we empower investors everywhere to make decisions with conviction. We’re the largest global resource for index-based concepts, data and research, and home to iconic financial market indicators, such as the S&P 500® and the Dow Jones Industrial Average®. More assets are invested in products based upon our indices than any other index provider in the world. With over USD 7.4 trillion in passively managed assets linked to our indices and over USD 11.3 trillion benchmarked to our indices, our solutions are widely considered indispensable in tracking market performance, evaluating portfolios and developing investment strategies.
S&P Dow Jones Indices is a division of S&P Global (NYSE: SPGI). S&P Global is the world’s foremost provider of credit ratings, benchmarks, analytics and workflow solutions in the global capital, commodity and automotive markets. With every one of our offerings, we help many of the world’s leading organizations navigate the economic landscape so they can plan for tomorrow, today. For more information, visit .

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Integrity, Discovery, Partnership
Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

We take care of you, so you can take care of business. We care about our people. That’s why we provide everything you—and your career—need to thrive at S&P Global.
Our benefits include:
Health & Wellness: Health care coverage designed for the mind and body.

Invest in Your Future: Secure your financial future through competitive pay, retirement planning, a continuing education program with a company-matched student loan contribution, and financial wellness programs.
Family Friendly Perks: It’s not just about you. S&P Global has perks for your partners and little ones, too, with some best-in class benefits for families.

At S&P Global, we are committed to fostering a connected and engaged workplace where all individuals have access to opportunities based on their skills, experience, and contributions. jobs.title: Vice President of Engineering
jobs.text:
About Checkmate
Checkmate is a restaurant technology solution provider that has continually evolved over time. We started in 2017 by integrating 3rd party platforms to the POS systems of restaurants. At that time, there were multiple 3rd party platforms like GrubHub, UberEats, DoorDash, Postmates, Caviar, and even Amazon!
This was the photograph that started it all!
We have since then continually evolved to add multiple products to our portfolio, the primary ones being first party ordering solutions like web and app ordering, kiosks and catering. We have now recently moved into three new exciting products: Digital Menu Boards, Phone Ordering AI and Drive thru AI. We form a very core part of the restaurant technology ecosystem, and are continually adding more and more digital solutions for the restaurant brands to increase their sales.
Our revolutionary enterprise menu management system, Everyware, truly unlocks the potential of menus and how it can be customized for each individual digital channel. As you can see, this is a company that continually evolves and adapts and today we are powering digital ordering solutions for some of the largest brands in the world.
We have been called the "north star of vendors" as we truly believe that technology is just a method by which we service the customers, it does not form the entirety of it. Service is a big component of what we provide to our customers, which is inherently believed by every single team member here. We are doing a lot of exciting things, including application of AI in our products and systems, using experimentation at scale to determine what works for our clients and ML to analyze and productize the massive amount of data we have. Each individual here makes a difference and has a valuable contribution. Key traits here are ownership and drive. Join us if you think you have them.
About the Role
As a Vice President of Engineering, you will operate as a player/coach and join a collaborative team of VPs of Engineering reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO). In this role, you will lead globally distributed software engineering teams driving the execution, architectural integrity, and delivery of core product initiatives built on cloud-native architectures in AWS.
Drawing on your experience in high-growth SaaS and web-based startup environments, you will serve as a key technical leader across the organization, partnering closely with Product leadership, Data Analytics, and cross-functional teams to build high-performance, scalable software that drives business growth. You will also be at the forefront of modern engineering management, actively driving teams to adopt AI-driven development practices to increase velocity, code quality, and developer productivity.
Essential Job Functions
Global Engineering Leadership & Talent
Lead, mentor, and grow distributed software engineering teams located across global regions, with direct leadership experience overseeing development teams based in India.
Foster a high-performance, inclusive culture that excels across time zones, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and operational execution.
Champion and integrate modern AI-driven development tools and workflows (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated test generation, AI-assisted code reviews) to accelerate execution and upskill engineering talent.
Recruit, develop, and retain top talent, establishing clear career progression pathways and coaching engineering managers and technical leads.
Technical Strategy & Architectural Excellence
Drive architectural vision and technical design for your product domain, ensuring scalable, secure, and cost-efficient deployments natively on AWS.
Champion modern engineering best practices, including design standards, code reusability, automated testing, system performance, and technical debt remediation.
Partner with platform and infrastructure leaders to ensure software designs integrate smoothly into company-wide CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.
Process Development, Continuous Improvement & Team Metrics
Design, document, and own the engineering operating model for a team of engineers, including sprint and release cadence, planning and estimation, code review standards, branching and deployment practices, and definition-of-done criteria.
Establish lightweight, scalable processes that fit a remote, globally distributed team
Define, instrument, and report on team performance metrics. These cover delivery (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore service), quality (escaped defects, test coverage, incident volume), predictability (commitment accuracy, cycle time), and team health (engagement, on-call load, attrition).
Run a regular continuous improvement cycle, including retrospectives, post-incident reviews, and quarterly process assessments. Turn findings into prioritized, owned improvement initiatives with measurable outcomes.
Measure the impact of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, AI code review, automated test generation) on velocity, quality, and developer experience. Use the results to refine adoption practices and guidance.
Maintain a sustainable balance between feature delivery, technical debt remediation, and operational work through explicit capacity allocation and regular roadmap trade-off discussions with Product.
Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process
Work closely with Product Management, Data Analytics, and Customer Success teams to align technical roadmaps with business objectives, user experience goals, and feature releases.
Collaborate with peer VPs of Engineering under the CTO to establish consistent engineering standards, shared technical frameworks, and cross-team processes.
Manage strategic software vendor and third-party partner relationships (e.g., outsourced talent, specialized tools) to scale capability in a fast-moving SaaS environment.
Implement and continuously refine Agile processes to reduce friction, increase delivery velocity, and elevate product quality.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Ügyfelünk egy svájci mérnöki hátterű, világszerte elismert név a hídalkatrészek tervezésében és gyártásában. Ez a cég áll azon hídsaruk és dilatációs szerkezetek mögött, amelyek a világ legismertebb hidjaiban találhatók. A nyírteleki üzem ennek a globális gyártási hálózatnak egyik kulcsfontosságú szereplője, így a régióból való elköltözés nélkül is lehetőség nyílik magas színvonalú mérnöki és gyártási munkára, valódi nemzetközi környezetben. Ha stabil, szakmailag komoly, 60+ éves múltra visszatekintő, minden kontinensen jelenlévő munkáltatót keresel, ezt érdemes megfontolni.
Feladatok:
A mérnökség felépítése: szerepek, döntési jogok, prioritások, szakmai kontroll, helyettesítés és fejlesztés. Aktív részvétel az új mérnökök kiválasztásában és betanításában.
A gyártás-előkészítés technológiai megalapozása: gyárthatóság, műveleti sorrend, alapanyag, gép, készülék, tűrés és erőforrás meghatározása. A vezető legyen otthon a gyártástechnológiákban, és biztosítson műszakilag megalapozott, műhelyben használható dokumentációt.
3D CAD-képesség, modellezési és rajzolási standardok, PDM/PLM és dokumentumjóváhagyás bevezetése; ECR/ECO változáskezelés és az elavult verziók visszavonása.
Gyárthatósági felülvizsgálat a vágás, hajlítás, hegesztés, forgácsolás, szerelés és felületkezelés területén. Új és módosított termékek bevezetése: prototípus, kockázatelemzés, gyártási jóváhagyás és stabil gyártás.
Alvállalkozók műszaki támogatása: dokumentációátadás, technológiai egyeztetés és problémamegoldás. Képességeik, készülékeik és folyamataik értékelése a Supply Chain és Quality bevonásával.
A hegesztési tevékenység szakmai és vezetői felügyelete: utasítások, eljárásminősítések, személyi jogosultságok, nyomonkövethetőség és megfelelőség. Ideális esetben IWE/EWE képesítéssel a fő hegesztési felelősi feladatkört is vállalja.
A Lean Manager irányítása és a lean fejlesztések prioritásainak kijelölése: anyagáramlás, várakozás, átfutási idő, ciklusidő, kapacitás és költség. Gyártási eltérések gyökérokelemzése és tartós javító intézkedések a termeléssel együtt.
Technológiai és CAPEX-javaslatok: műszaki specifikáció, alternatívák, megtérülés, próbák, beüzemelés és gyártási átadás.
Mérnöki KPI-k, prioritások, erőforrás-, kompetencia- és költségtervek kezelése; kritikus tudás és helyettesítés biztosítása. Együttműködés a helyi társterületekkel és a Group Engineeringgel.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.
What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.
For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.
Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.
The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:
As a Director of Engineering reporting to the Chief Technology Officer in our Provider Domain, your purpose will be to own the technical strategy and delivery for the systems hundreds of thousands of independent businesses run on every day. You will:
Own end-to-end delivery across 4–5 cross-functional teams, leading through Engineering Managers and Staff+ Engineers in a deliberately flat structure with no layers in between.
Set the engineering standard for the domain — building the frameworks for architecture decisions, technical proposals and how teams work.
Lead our AI transformation of the engineering lifecycle, and define the measures that prove it worked.
Partner with Product to turn commercial strategy into engineering strategy, and back it with experimentation and data.
Build a team of exceptional density, coaching leaders who can operate autonomously.
Requirements
Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…
To think like a product owner, not a ticket-deliverer — you understand unit economics, funnels and growth mechanics, and the commercial impact of what your teams ship.
Experience personally establishing engineering rigor: architecture decision records, technical proposals and standardised ways of working that teams actually adopted.
Practical experience embedding AI tooling into the day-to-day engineering lifecycle — and a clear view on how to measure the impact and protect code quality.
To have led multiple squads through Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers in a high-growth scale-up or high-transaction marketplace or SaaS business, while staying close to the work.
At a minimum we require conversational level English language skills. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.
It will also help you to have…
Experience with two-sided marketplaces or booking platforms.
Exposure to growth engineering or growth experimentation.
B2B SaaS experience at scale.
Benefits
We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first.
Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in the country/region this role is advertised in.
Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.
How AI helps us find great people
Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role - but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application - it won't affect your chances in any way.
Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:
We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at , so we can best support you.
Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Fraud
jobs.text:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.
We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.
We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.
We're looking for a Director, Product Management for our Fraud team. In this pivotal role, you'll own and drive strategic initiatives shaping our end-to-end fraud detection architecture, advanced risk models, third-party data integrations, and consumer verification systems. The role is perfect for seasoned product leaders with 10+ years of experience who excel in fast-paced fintech environments, bring deep domain expertise in risk strategies, and master the balance between robust fraud prevention and seamless user conversion. You’ll be responsible for spearheading engineering scrum teams, resolving cross-functional trade-offs, and partnering closely with fraud management, information security, data, and operations to deliver impactful, high-integrity outcomes. Please note that this is a role in a hybrid capacity based in our downtown San Francisco office, with onsite work on Tuesdays and Thursdays.
What You’ll Do:
Drive product development for all of Upgrade’s fraud infrastructure including detection, models, third party data integration, and consumer verification measures.
Facilitate cross-functional decision making, driving key tradeoffs between conversion, fraud prevention, information security and operational considerations
Partner closely with Upgrade’s fraud management team to monitor and drive improvements on all relevant fraud KPIs
Act as product owner for scrum teams working to ship fraud platform enhancements
Evaluate and drive implementation of new third party data and software integrations
Work closely with the operations team to monitor, troubleshoot and solve issues.
What We Look For:
Significant expertise in fraud strategies, models, data sources and infrastructure in a Fintech environment preferred.
Proven track record in leadership, organizational conflict resolution, and data-driven decision-making.
10+ years of product management experience in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
Fluency with product development tools, SQL, web analytics and AB testing software.
Experience with third party APIs & solutions integration.
What We Offer You:
Competitive salary and stock option plan
100% paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
Flexible PTO
Opportunities for professional growth and development
Paid parental leave
Health & wellness initiatives
The compensation range of this position in San Francisco, CA is USD $220,000-$240,000 annually plus equity and benefits. Within this range, an individual's base pay will be dependent on a variety of factors, including without limitation, job-related knowledge, skills, education, and experience.
#BI-Hybrid #LI-Hybrid
For California residents: Upgrade's California Notice at Collection and Privacy Policy describes our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of the personal information of job applicants.
Environmental & Working Conditions
Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations. Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.
Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position. Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings. Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.
Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement.

jobs.title: Director - Geospatial Data Governance
jobs.text:
The Director, Geospatial Governance is accountable for the strategic leadership, governance, management, and continual improvement of QIC’s enterprise geospatial capability. The role leads the GIS team and serves as the business owner for the Esri Enterprise platform, including the Enterprise Geodatabase (SDE), ArcGIS Enterprise environment, geospatial services, standards, and governance frameworks.
The position ensures that geospatial information is managed as a trusted enterprise asset, supporting planning, design, development, construction, operations, asset management, and digital twin initiatives. The Director establishes and maintains geospatial governance, data stewardship, quality assurance, platform performance, security, and compliance while driving innovation and business value through geospatial technologies.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership
· Develop and execute the enterprise geospatial strategy and roadmap.
· Align GIS initiatives with corporate objectives, digital transformation programs, and business priorities.
· Promote geospatial information as a strategic enterprise asset.
· Lead the adoption of emerging geospatial technologies, automation, analytics, and digital twin capabilities.
· Provide executive-level advice on geospatial data, systems, and governance.
Geospatial Governance
· Establish and maintain enterprise GIS governance frameworks, policies, standards, and procedures.
· Define authoritative geospatial datasets and manage their lifecycle.
· Lead enterprise data stewardship and accountability frameworks.
· Establish decision rights for geospatial information management.
· Chair GIS governance and technical review forums.
· Ensure compliance with enterprise data management and information governance policies.
· Oversee schema governance and change control processes.
Enterprise GIS Platform Ownership
· Serve as the business owner for the Esri Enterprise environment.
· Lead governance and oversight of ArcGIS Enterprise, Portal for ArcGIS, ArcGIS Server, and Enterprise Geodatabases (SDE).
· Establish standards for service publishing, deployment, security, and lifecycle management.
· Oversee platform availability, performance, scalability, resilience, and disaster recovery.
· Lead upgrade planning, release management, and platform modernization initiatives.
· Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, and infrastructure standards.
Enterprise Geodatabase (SDE) Governance
· Govern the design, structure, and management of enterprise geodatabases.
