jobs.title: Vice President, Technology
jobs.text:
Pets deserve the best care. At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive. Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.
If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.
At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.
We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Vice President, Technology
The Vice President, Technology is a senior technology executive responsible for leading software engineering and enterprise technology, delivering the platforms, systems, and capabilities that power Vetsource's operations and enable the company's next phase of growth. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this leader oversees the technology platforms supporting pharmacy operations, supply chain, finance, workplace technology, and enterprise operations while driving modernization, automation, and AI adoption across the business.
A key responsibility of this role is the evolution of Vetsource's proprietary fulfillment and operational technology platforms into a strategic competitive advantage. This includes defining and executing the next generation fulfillment architecture leveraging AI, robotics, intelligent workflow orchestration, and automation to create a scalable competitive advantage for Vetsource.
This executive partners closely with leaders across the business to shape the technology strategy and roadmap to advance our mission to deliver personalized care for pets while improving operational speed, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
Beyond technology delivery, this leader will build high-performing teams, develop organizational capabilities, and drive transformation with a new operating model that accelerates innovation while maintaining operational excellence, security, and reliability.
This is a full-time, remote position. Preference is for candidates to reside within 2 hours of our operational hubs (Portland, OR; Harrisburg, PA; McDonough, GA; Northlake, TX).
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Technology Transformation & Leadership
Lead the enterprise Technology operating model, serving as a strategic partner to align architecture and investments with business objectives.
Drive platform modernization and strategic technical debt reduction while managing capital investments, budgets, and risk.
Establish common operating practices, governance, SLAs, and performance metrics for mission-critical services.
Software & Platform Engineering
Lead the engineering organization responsible for Vetsource's proprietary fulfillment, pharmacy, and enterprise platforms.
Deliver secure, scalable, AI-enabled platforms that accelerate innovation and business growth.
Build a high-performing engineering culture grounded in modern practices, including cloud-native architecture, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and API-first design.
Supply Chain & Fulfillment Technology
Lead the technology strategy and roadmap supporting pharmacy operations, warehouse technology, and replenishment planning.
Modernize and rearchitect proprietary fulfillment platforms for future scale, improving throughput, service levels, and cost efficiency.
Develop next-generation capabilities and workflows utilizing AI, robotics, and intelligent automation.
Finance Technology & Enterprise Platforms
Partner with Finance leadership to modernize operations through Oracle and enterprise platforms.
Ensure systems support speed, accuracy, scalability, and strong financial controls and compliance.
Provide technical leadership for Record-to-Report processes, enterprise integrations, and automation of financial reporting and reconciliation.
Associate Digital Experience
Lead workplace technology, identity management, and support functions, driving AI adoption to improve associate productivity and satisfaction.
Data, AI & Operational Intelligence
Lead cross-functional teams to improve data quality and accelerate AI adoption across supply chain, fulfillment, finance, and enterprise functions.
Reliability, Security & Operational Excellence
Ensure enterprise platforms are secure, reliable, and observable while driving a culture of service ownership and continuous improvement.
Leadership Expectations
Operate with urgency and accountability, taking ownership of outcomes over activities while driving organizational modernization.
Hire, develop, and retain high-performing technology professionals, providing actionable feedback and maintaining robust succession plans.
Build trusted partnerships across the business and foster a transparent, learning-oriented culture.
Balance technical and operational excellence with responsible risk management and continuous innovation.
Success Measures (Within first 24 months)
Modernize critical fulfillment and enterprise technology architectures to improve scalability, reliability, and delivery speed.
Accelerate the adoption of AI-driven operational workflows to improve efficiency.
Develop a high-performing leadership team with a strong succession pipeline.
Establish technology as a strategic, competitive advantage for Vetsource.
WHAT YOU BRING
Undergraduate degree
15+ years leading large-scale tech organizations across software engineering, enterprise platforms, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud environments, and business transformation
10+ years of experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud, including 5+ years managing supply chain, finance, and EPM modules
Experience implementing modern API-driven technology platforms and enterprise applications (CRM, Digital Marketing, ecommerce, HCM, ERP, and custom development)
Experience incorporating AI and agentic platforms with workflow and process orchestration
Ability to create and execute a clear technology strategy, possessing exceptional business acumen, analytical, and problem-solving skills
Able to articulate complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences, build consensus across all levels, and skillfully negotiate with internal customers and external vendors
Demonstrated ability to recruit, motivate, and retain a high-performing team rooted in transparency and accountability
A trusted, highly ethical team player who favors collaborative approaches with internal and external partners
A high-energy, low-ego executive who is comfortable with ambiguity, handles the unexpected with flexibility, and is passionate about reaching the goal
Preferred Experience and Qualifications:
Experience with Google Cloud or Amazon Web Services, alongside managing as-a-service, outsourced, and cloud-based solutions.
Proven ability to build strong vendor partnerships that ensure optimal performance and financial return
Demonstrated success driving digital and business transformation through technology innovation, coupled with strong change management skills for leading complex initiatives
Highly customer-service oriented with an entrepreneurial approach, demonstrating the ability and interest to pursue new business opportunities ​
WORKING CONDITIONS
Reliable, remote internet access is required
Sitting/standing at a desk working on a computer for long periods of time
Must be flexible for some travel, up to 15%
WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM VETSOURCE
In addition to an inclusive and welcoming culture, Vetsource also offers:
Competitive pay and benefits including medical, vision*, dental, and life insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pet insurance* and Virtual vet care
PTO, Holidays, Floating Holidays, and Volunteer Day
Retirement Savings Plan (401k/ RRSP) with employer matching program
Paid parental leave
Flexible scheduling and remote work where possible
The opportunity to join one of our Associate Resource Groups, and fun company events!
For Canadian based associates these specific benefits are not included*
OUR VALUES
Vetsource is proud to be part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a division of Mars Petcare—a family-owned organization rooted in the belief that pets make the world a better place. Our unified culture is built on a foundation of veterinary excellence and guided by a shared vision, inspiring everyone to create A Better World for Pets™ — a world where pets are healthy, happy, and welcome.
Today, Vetsource drives the future of pet health centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. These principles define how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve the veterinary community, ensuring a culture where every associate has the opportunity to thrive.
Pay range (US based applicants):$218,592 - $275,000(annualized) + annual bonus plan eligible
Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, certifications, relevant education and training, while also considering internal equity.
The statements in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed for this role, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Our pre-employment process includes a background check as a part of the hiring process, and will include a drug screen for pharmacy related roles. The background check will only be initiated after a conditional offer of employment has been made and will be subject to an individualized assessment, as required by law. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please email , or if you have general questions relating to this process. No agencies please. We are an equal opportunity employer.
Vetsource is an E-verify employer.
www.vetsource.com

jobs.title: VP, Information Technology
jobs.text:
At Adaptive, we’re Powering the Age of Immune Medicine. Our goal is to harness the power of the adaptive immune system to transform the way diseases are diagnosed and treated.
As an Adapter, you’ll have the opportunity to make a difference in people’s lives. With Adaptive, you’ll create a career highlight through collaboration with bright, curious colleagues working at the apex of innovation and application.
It’s time for your next chapter. Discover your story with Adaptive.
Position Overview
The Vice President, Information Technology is the senior leader responsible for defining and executing the enterprise IT strategy and ensuring the delivery of reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective technology capabilities that support Adaptive’s business objectives and long-term growth.
In partnership with the Senior Vice President, Technology and the executive leadership team, the Vice President establishes the vision, priorities, operating model, and multi-year roadmap for enterprise IT. This role has executive accountability for corporate infrastructure, enterprise applications, the Enterprise Data Warehouse and related data platforms, Modern Workplace, identity and access management, Service Desk operations, Business Relationship Management, IT governance, and business continuity.
The Vice President serves as a strategic advisor to business and functional leaders, anticipating organizational needs and translating business priorities into enterprise technology investments and capabilities. This leader is accountable for IT organizational performance, financial stewardship, operational resilience, risk management, regulatory readiness, employee technology experience, and measurable business outcomes.
Leaders at Adaptive demonstrate behaviors consistent with Adaptive’s Core Values and Leadership Principles. Critical functions of your role include helping establish individual team member goals, aligning those individual goals with broader team objectives, and ensuring those objectives drive the achievement of company goals. Providing thoughtful coaching and consistent feedback to your team members will drive performance excellence and accountability, as well as support your team members’ growth and development. Leaders at Adaptive create an environment of belonging, respect, and open and honest communication every day.
Key Responsibilities and Essential Functions
Enterprise IT Strategy and Executive Leadership
Define and own Adaptive’s enterprise IT strategy, operating model, and multi-year roadmap in alignment with company and Technology priorities.
Partner with the SVP, Technology, executive leadership team, and functional leaders to identify business needs, evaluate technology opportunities, and prioritize enterprise investments.
Serve as the company’s principal advisor on enterprise IT capabilities, operational resilience, technology lifecycle management, data platforms, and the employee technology experience.
Translate business strategy into scalable technology capabilities, transformation initiatives, investment plans, and measurable outcomes.
Establish enterprise IT priorities and communicate strategy, performance, risks, and investment needs to executive stakeholders.
Monitor emerging technologies, industry trends, and evolving business requirements to identify opportunities and manage enterprise technology risk.
Organizational Leadership and Operating Model
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing enterprise IT organization capable of supporting Adaptive’s current operations and future growth.
Establish an effective organizational structure with clear roles, decision rights, accountability, succession plans, and career development opportunities.
Lead and develop IT leaders and teams through clear expectations, regular coaching, performance management, and workforce planning.
Foster a culture of customer focus, operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
Define and maintain IT governance, policies, standards, controls, and operating procedures across the enterprise.
Establish appropriate sourcing and service-delivery models across internal teams, managed service providers, consultants, and technology vendors.
Infrastructure, Enterprise Systems, and Data Platforms
Own the strategy, architecture, implementation, operation, and lifecycle management of Adaptive’s corporate technology environment.
Provide executive oversight for networks, cloud platforms, identity and access management, endpoints, telecommunications, collaboration platforms, and workplace technology.
Establish the enterprise applications strategy and oversee platforms supporting functions such as Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Operations, and employee productivity.
Own the strategy, architecture, operation, and lifecycle management of the Enterprise Data Warehouse and related enterprise data platforms.
Ensure enterprise systems and data platforms are resilient, scalable, secure, supportable, integrated, and aligned with business requirements and enterprise architecture standards.
Partner with Data, Engineering, Security, and business leaders to establish standards for data architecture, integration, governance, quality, access, retention, lineage, and security.
Oversee the integration of enterprise applications and source systems into the Enterprise Data Warehouse, including data pipelines, monitoring, service levels, and operational support.
Ensure enterprise data platforms effectively support reporting, analytics, regulatory requirements, and strategic decision-making.
Guide technology selection, modernization, consolidation, and retirement decisions to reduce complexity and improve business value.
Establish lifecycle, capacity, availability, performance, and resilience plans for critical enterprise systems and data services.
Modern Workplace, Service Delivery, and Employee Experience
Own the Modern Workplace strategy, including endpoints, collaboration platforms, productivity tools, mobility, workplace technology, and employee technology adoption.
Establish the vision and service model for enterprise IT support and the end-to-end employee technology experience.
Provide executive oversight of Service Desk operations, including incident and request fulfillment, knowledge management, escalation, service performance, and continuous improvement.
Ensure consistent, responsive, and high-quality IT services across office-based, remote, and distributed teams.
Define service-level objectives, key performance indicators, experience measures, operational metrics, and executive reporting mechanisms.
Use performance data and employee feedback to improve service quality, reliability, productivity, adoption, and satisfaction.
Provide executive oversight of incident, problem, request, asset, knowledge, configuration, and change-management practices.
Ensure technology onboarding, offboarding, and other employee lifecycle services are secure, consistent, efficient, and scalable.
Business Relationship Management
Establish and lead a Business Relationship Management capability that connects business priorities with IT strategy, services, capabilities, and investments.
Develop trusted relationships with functional leaders to understand their objectives, demand, pain points, risks, and future capability needs.
Maintain business technology roadmaps and facilitate demand intake, prioritization, portfolio planning, and value realization.
Translate business needs into clear technology requirements, service improvements, and investment proposals.
Ensure business stakeholders receive clear communication regarding service performance, initiative status, technology risks, dependencies, and investment decisions.
Measure stakeholder satisfaction and the business value delivered through IT services and initiatives.
Promote adoption of enterprise technology capabilities and ensure business areas are prepared for technology-driven change.
Security, Risk, Compliance, and Business Continuity
Partner with Information Security, Privacy, Legal, and Compliance leaders to maintain secure IT operations and support regulatory and contractual obligations.
Ensure the effective implementation and operation of IT controls related to identity and access management, endpoint security, vulnerability remediation, patching, configuration, backups, and disaster recovery.
Establish clear accountability for technology risks and ensure material risks, control gaps, and remediation plans are communicated to appropriate executive stakeholders.
Oversee IT’s participation in audits, risk assessments, regulatory reviews, and customer assurance activities.
Maintain and regularly test IT business-continuity and disaster-recovery capabilities.
Provide executive leadership during significant technology incidents, coordinating response, communication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective action.
Portfolio, Financial, and Vendor Leadership
Own enterprise IT portfolio planning, prioritization, governance, and delivery.
Develop and manage the IT operating and capital budgets, multi-year investment plans, forecasts, and resource-allocation decisions.
Establish business cases and value measures for significant technology investments and ensure initiatives deliver intended outcomes.
Provide executive oversight of strategic vendors, managed service providers, contracts, renewals, licensing, and commercial negotiations.
Evaluate vendor performance, concentration risk, service quality, security posture, and long-term strategic fit.
Drive cost optimization, platform rationalization, and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate service, security, resilience, and compliance standards.
Cross-Functional Partnership and Transformation
Build trusted partnerships with Engineering, Data, Security, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and other business functions.
Lead the IT components of enterprise transformations, organizational changes, office expansions, and major business initiatives.
Partner with business leaders to improve processes, increase automation, strengthen data flows, and support effective technology adoption.
Provide leadership for the IT aspects of mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and integrations, including diligence, planning, execution, and stabilization.
Establish effective change-management and communication practices for enterprise technology initiatives.
Represent enterprise IT in executive planning, governance, and decision-making forums.
Other Responsibilities

Position Overview

The Vice President, Information Technology is the senior leader responsible for defining and executing the enterprise IT strategy and ensuring the delivery of reliable, secure, scalable, and cost-effective technology capabilities that support Adaptive’s business objectives and long-term growth.

In partnership with the Senior Vice President, Technology and the executive leadership team, the Vice President establishes the vision, priorities, operating model, and multi-year roadmap for enterprise IT. This role has executive accountability for corporate infrastructure, enterprise applications, the Enterprise Data Warehouse and related data platforms, Modern Workplace, identity and access management, Service Desk operations, Business Relationship Management, IT governance, and business continuity.

The Vice President serves as a strategic advisor to business and functional leaders, anticipating organizational needs and translating business priorities into enterprise technology investments and capabilities. This leader is accountable for IT organizational performance, financial stewardship, operational resilience, risk management, regulatory readiness, employee technology experience, and measurable business outcomes.

Leaders at Adaptive demonstrate behaviors consistent with Adaptive’s Core Values and Leadership Principles. Critical functions of your role include helping establish individual team member goals, aligning those individual goals with broader team objectives, and ensuring those objectives drive the achievement of company goals. Providing thoughtful coaching and consistent feedback to your team members will drive performance excellence and accountability, as well as support your team members’ growth and development. Leaders at Adaptive create an environment of belonging, respect, and open and honest communication every day.

jobs.title: Head of Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Hey, mabuhay! 👋
Thanks for dropping by. We know looking for the right job can feel like being stuck in EDSA traffic, so we’ll keep it moving and get straight to the point.
With over 8 million downloads and a powerful network of thousand of dedicated biker-partners, we are a leading ride-hailing platform operating across the Philippines. Our vision is to end poverty in the Philippines through revolutionary transportation solutions. We aim to provide our customers with convenient, reliable, and safe rides, impacting millions of lives positively every single day.
Now, we're looking for a Head of Engineering. You will lead our multi-team engineering organization across our customer and driver apps, backend platforms, and operations tools, while spearheading our transition to an AI-native organization.
Responsibilities:
Keep mission-critical services reliable. Build robust, highly available systems at scale, designed to self-heal and backed by tested failover and disaster recovery for critical workflows.
Lead incidents end to end. Take command when things break, coordinate across engineering, SRE, and Ops, drive rigorous RCAs, and put preventive measures in place so issues don't recur.
Build a healthy, high-performing org. Grow the engineering organization through hiring as well as career and skill development. Set a culture of ownership and align teams around clear goals and metrics.
Deliver the roadmap predictably. Work with Product to shape features and sharpen scope, ensuring solutions are scalable, well architected, and built as reusable platforms. Keep commitments predictable, rescue projects that drift, and make releases safe.
Set the technical bar. Quality-gate architecture and designs for scalability, security, and cost before they reach the CTO, and provide senior technical direction across squads.
Raise the bar on velocity and stability. Establish meaningful delivery and reliability metrics for our systems and teams, use them to spot bottlenecks, and remove what slows engineers down.
Lead the shift to AI-native engineering. Use AI to improve developer experience: remove friction and toil from how engineers build, review, ship, and operate, and drive measurable gains in speed, quality, and system health.
At Angkas, we believe in giving our people the trust and flexibility to work in a way that helps them and their teams perform at their best. Whether you’re working onsite, remotely, or in a hybrid setup, we provide the flexibility, you bring the drive. ⚡
Let’s get this show on the road!🚦

jobs.title: Director, Commercial Data
jobs.text:
Location: This position may be performed remotely, but requires the flexibility and willingness to travel as needed.
The Opportunity
At Praxis, we’re building the commercial capabilities to bring transformative therapies to patients with CNS disorders—and we’re looking for builders who dare for more.
As Director, Commercial Data, you will own the strategy and build the trusted, connected, and AI-ready data foundation that powers smarter decisions, accelerates execution, and enables our commercial organization to scale through launch and beyond.
You will work at the intersection of Commercial, Data & Analytics, and IT to turn business priorities into high-impact data solutions. You will challenge conventional approaches, establish clear data governance and accountability, and ensure our teams have access to reliable, actionable insights when they need them. With a builder’s mindset and a bias for action, you will identify opportunities to leverage analytics, automation, and AI to elevate customer engagement, strengthen commercial performance, and ultimately help us deliver more for patients.
Primary Responsibilities
Build and continuously advance a trusted commercial data environment across customer, product, payer, patient, engagement, and other critical commercial data domains.
Establish the business requirements, standards, ownership, and operating model needed to ensure commercial data is connected, well-defined, high quality, accessible, and ready to support analytics and AI.
Advance commercial data readiness to support emerging AI capabilities.
Partner with business, analytics, product, and technology teams to identify high-value opportunities, define the data and business context required, and develop reusable capabilities that scale across commercial functions rather than isolated solutions.
Establish and lead a commercial data governance framework that ensures data is trusted, consistent, and fit for purpose across reporting, analytics, automation, and AI. Define clear data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, common definitions, hierarchies, metrics, metadata, and business rules.
Proactively monitor data quality, resolve issues at their root cause, and establish accountability for maintaining trusted data as the business scales.
Partner across Commercial, Data & Analytics, and IT to identify and prioritize opportunities where data, analytics, automation, and AI can improve decision-making and commercial execution.
Translate business priorities into actionable capabilities, establish clear ownership and success measures, and collaborate with internal teams and external partners to drive adoption, measurable business impact, and scalable ways of working.
Qualifications and Key Success Factors
8+ years of relevant experience in commercial data, analytics, commercial operations, data strategy, or related roles within pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences organizations.
Experience supporting pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial operations, ideally including a product launch or significant commercial expansion.
Demonstrated ability to translate commercial priorities into a data strategy, capability roadmap, and investment recommendations, ideally in a launch or rapidly growing organization.
Experience establishing data governance, ownership, quality standards, and operating processes that improve trust in and use of data.
Practical understanding of AI and automation, with the ability to assess use cases, define business requirements, and evaluate value, feasibility, and responsible use.
Ability to partner effectively with IT, data engineering, analytics, and commercial systems teams, with sufficient technical fluency to guide business decisions and delivery priorities.
Strong communication and changing leadership skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders, managing external partners, and driving adoption in a fast-moving environment.
The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
Annualized Base Salary
$213,500—$243,000 USD
Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive. This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future? We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP. We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns. Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring. We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results. Let’s achieve the impossible together!
Company Overview
Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.
Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Attention: Job Scam Alert
Praxis has recently become aware of fraudulent job recruitment postings from individuals claiming to represent Praxis. These postings seek financial information in connection with fraudulent opportunities for employment. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or misrepresentation in connection with a Praxis job opportunity, please report it to
does not accept unsolicited submissions from recruitment agencies for open positions. We ask all recruitment agencies to refrain from contacting any Praxis employee regarding any position. All unsolicited resumes submitted by recruitment agencies to any Praxis employee in any form or method will be deemed to be the property of Praxis, and Praxis explicitly reserves the right to hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruitment agency.

Experience supporting pharmaceutical or biotechnology commercial operations, ideally including a product launch or significant commercial expansion.

Experience establishing data governance, ownership, quality standards, and operating processes that improve trust in and use of data.

Strong communication and changing leadership skills, with a track record of influencing stakeholders, managing external partners, and driving adoption in a fast-moving environment.

The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

jobs.title: Director of Product
jobs.text:
RTS is an enthusiast culture company that builds at the intersection of gaming, creators, and brands. From global live events to bespoke branded content, we exist to create meaningful connections between fans and the worlds they love. Our team brings deep expertise across partnership sales and marketing, talent management, event production, media, community building, and IP development.
About Evo
For more than 20 years, the Evolution Championship Series (Evo) has produced the largest and longest-running fighting game tournament conventions in the world. Our events are gathering points where players, fans, publishers, developers, creators, and brands come together to celebrate fighting games and the communities that love them.
Beyond our flagship live events, Evo continues to expand how we create, celebrate, and grow fighting game fandom around the world.
Role Overview
We’re looking for a Director of Product, Evo to lead the vision, development, and continued evolution of Evo’s live event and consumer products.
This person will define what we build, why we build it, and how Evo brings its tournaments, programming, and fan experiences to life around the world. You will own the end-to-end development of select Evo products, from tournament formats and on-site attractions to new events, specialty programming, and other major initiatives that will help shape Evo’s future.
You will take products from initial concept through launch, defining the audience, goals, scope, requirements, budget, and measures of success. You will work closely with Event Operations, Production, Broadcast, Marketing, Partnerships, and Business Development to ensure each product can be delivered successfully and remains true to Evo’s community and brand.
This is a senior leadership role within Evo. In addition to leading individual products, you will help shape Evo’s broader product portfolio, support decisions about global expansion and future growth, develop strong leaders and teams, and take on broader leadership responsibilities across the business when needed.
The right person combines product strategy, live event experience, audience empathy, and strong business judgment. They understand how to translate fighting game culture and broader gaming fandom into competitive and entertainment products that can grow without losing what makes Evo special.
At our size, this is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable moving between long-term product planning, experience design, documentation, budget decisions, team leadership, cross-functional coordination, and on-site execution.
Reporting Structure
You will report to Evo’s General Manager.
Key Responsibilities
Evo Product Strategy
Own the vision, priorities, plans, and measures of success for major Evo products, including live events, tournament experiences, on-site attractions, and specialty programming.
Write clear product and event briefs that define experience goals, spatial concepts, stage requirements, tournament parameters, and what each team is expected to deliver.
Make product tradeoffs across features, formats, and investments using audience data, player sentiment, endemic impact, business value, timing, complexity, and cost.
Define ticket types, experience packages, benefits, and attendee value in partnership with Event Operations, Marketing, Finance, and other relevant teams.
Work with the General Manager and company leadership to set product priorities and evaluate new formats, events, and markets.
Event & Consumer Experience Development
Lead the development of flagship event features and experiential zones, including museum exhibits, indie developer showcases, vendor villages, artist alleys, community meetups, and other on-site attractions.
Define tournament formats, exhibition formats, rulesets, and competition structures in partnership with tournament and event teams.
Lead the ideation and development of new events and specialty products, including exhibition programming and publisher partnered showcases, creating repeatable, scalable formats that can be adapted for Evo events in different markets.
Consider the full attendee and viewer journey, including how an experience works on-site, on broadcast, and across Evo’s content channels.
Publisher & Partner Experiences
Partner with Partnerships, Marketing, and Business Development to design industry leading experiences for Evo’s partners that fit within Evo’s broader product and consumer plans, including activations, show features, developer panels, content presentations, commercial segments, circuit qualifier integrations, and official circuit finals.
Define the structural guidelines for tournament activations, publisher-supported side events, and programming
Ensure partner integrations add something meaningful to the player, attendee, or viewer experience and feel right for Evo.
Join major publisher and partner conversations when product direction, tournament formats, or fan experiences are a central part of the opportunity.
Product Management & Processes
Create consistent ways of evaluating, prioritizing, planning, and documenting Evo products and experiences across our global events.
Monitor attendance, participation, capacity, show pacing, fan feedback, and other relevant measures during live events to assess product performance and identify changes that should be made during the event or in the future.
Lead post-event product reviews and turn community feedback, viewership data, surveys, and internal feedback into clear improvements for future events.
On-Site Creative Stewardship & Execution Support
Manage the creative integrity of the event on-site, ensuring all stage presentations, experiential feature builds, and brand moments match documented expectations and creative standards.
Partner closely with Event Production to resolve issues that affect the player, attendee, broadcast, or partner experience.
Support the selection and management of specialized experiential vendors, contractors, and other outside partners when needed.
Provide hands-on product direction during events and work with Event Operations, Production, and Broadcast to make changes when circumstances shift.
Participate on-site at major Evo events and other product launches as needed.
Budget Management
Develop and manage approved budgets for assigned products and programs, including prize pools, experiential builds, specialty programming, and early product development.
Review product costs, audience engagement, and results to help decide where Evo should invest in the future.
Evaluate the audience, cost, revenue potential, and operational needs of proposed products and experiences.
Leadership & Team Development
Serve as a senior member of Evo’s leadership team and help make decisions across Evo’s products, events, teams, and future plans.
Build strong working relationships across Evo and RTS and help teams align around shared priorities.
Lead, manage, and develop product team members as the function grows.
Set clear roles, goals, and expectations for team members and outside partners supporting assigned products.
Step in to lead major events, new products, and cross-functional projects when needed.
Qualifications
10+ years of experience across product management, live event development, experience design, or creative leadership, or related roles.
Experience taking complex live events, gaming, entertainment, or consumer products from initial concept through launch and continued improvement.
Experience developing tournaments, attendee experiences, programming, activations, or other large-scale fan-facing products.
Strong experience defining product goals, scope, requirements, budgets, and measures of success.
Ability to turn broad creative ideas into clear and practical briefs that production and operations teams can execute.
Experience working across Event Operations, Production, Broadcast, Marketing, Partnerships, Business Development, and other teams to deliver complex initiatives and resolve competing priorities.
Experience managing budgets, evaluating product performance, and making decisions based on audience, operational, and business results.
Experience leading teams and developing other leaders.
Strong communication, judgment, organization, and prioritization skills, with the ability to move between long-term planning and hands-on event execution.
Willingness to travel domestically and internationally for Evo events, planning meetings, and other major milestones.
Bonus Points
Background developing products or experiences across a global event portfolio.
Familiarity with designing products for players, attendees, viewers, publishers, and commercial partners.
Deep understanding of competitive gaming ecosystems, live event dynamics, and familiarity with the Fighting Game Community (FGC).
Ability to create repeatable event formats that can be adapted for different markets.
Established relationships with experiential agencies, creative vendors, production partners, or other specialized contractors.
Previous leadership within a growing entertainment, events, gaming, or consumer business.
Compensation
The salary for this role is $140,000 to $200,000, based on experience and qualifications.
Benefits
Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance
401k plan available for employee contributions
Flexible work schedule
Generous PTO and company-observed holidays
Remote-first culture

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics
jobs.text:
Pets deserve the best care. At Vetsource, we build the foundation for success, enabling those in the pet healthcare profession and industry to thrive. Our data-powered platform simplifies processes and streamlines systems, helping those we serve create tighter bonds with their customers. From prescription management and pet owner engagement to veterinary business performance data and insights, Vetsource provides comprehensive solutions that give our customers more time and flexibility, and help them foster strong relationships and positive experiences. In a rapidly evolving world, we’re constantly seeking new ways to help our customers chart a course for a better, brighter future for pets and those who care for them.
If you love pets, want to have an impact and join a fantastic organization, Vetsource could be the place for you.
At Vetsource, our teams, much like our customers, are represented through diverse perspectives, life experiences, unique strengths (and love for animals). We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace.
We are a team of real people looking for great people to join us, which is why applications are carefully and thoughtfully reviewed by our team. We know that when considering a new opportunity, it's common to weigh your qualifications against the listed job criteria. That said, even if you don’t meet 100% of the job requirements but feel you would be a good fit for the role, we still encourage you to apply!
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR
Sr. Director, Enterprise Data & Analytics
The Senior Director, Enterprise Data leads Vetsource's enterprise data organization and is accountable for making data a trusted, high-value business asset to drive product innovation and business performance. This role brings together data engineering, analytics, MLOps, AI engineering, and data services under a common strategy and operating model.
Working closely with business leaders, product, security, and technology teams, the Senior Director, Enterprise Data translates business priorities into governed data products, scalable platforms, meaningful insights, and AI capabilities. The role is responsible for measurable improvements in data quality, adoption, and business value for associates, customers, and industry partners.
This is a full-time, remote position.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Enterprise Data Strategy and Leadership
Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.
Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.
Data Engineering Platforms and Integration
Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.
Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.
Analytics and Data Products
Lead analytics and business intelligence teams that develop trusted metrics, analytical models, dashboards, and decision-support products for internal stakeholders and external customers.
Adopt a data product approach for priority business domains, with defined customers, accountable business and technology owners, quality expectations, service levels, documentation, and adoption measures.
Partner with business teams to define critical data domains and common metrics so teams can make decisions using consistent, well-understood information.
Ensure analytical work addresses a clear business decision or workflow and produces measurable value, not simply reports or dashboards.
AI Enablement and Adoption
Develop the data and platform foundations required for AI-powered products, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and generative AI use cases.
Partner with product, engineering, security, privacy, legal, and business leaders to evaluate and deliver AI use cases with appropriate controls for data access, quality, privacy, safety, traceability, and monitoring.
Enable associates and customers to access approved data and insights through governed conversational interfaces and AI assistants, while preserving metric consistency, permissions, and source traceability.
Establish practical standards for model and prompt lifecycle management, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, and MLOps or LLMOps where applicable.
Build data and AI literacy across the organization through education, reusable patterns, and close partnership with business teams.
Data Governance Trust and Risk
Create a federated governance model that assigns business and technology ownership for critical data and establishes clear decision rights and stewardship responsibilities.
Oversee the enterprise data catalog, business glossary, lineage, quality rules, access policies, retention practices, and issue-management processes.
Partner with security, privacy, compliance, and legal teams to ensure data and AI capabilities meet contractual, regulatory, ethical, and company requirements.
Build trust by making data quality and ownership transparent and by ensuring material data issues are prioritized, communicated, and resolved.
Business Partnership and Delivery
Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across the company, helping them frame business questions, understand data limitations, and use evidence to make better decisions.
Create a transparent intake and prioritization process that balances strategic initiatives, customer commitments, platform health, regulatory needs, and operational support.
Manage divisional objectives, service metrics, budgets, vendor relationships, and capacity plans; communicate progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to executive stakeholders.
Promote strong product management and engineering practices that improve delivery speed, quality, accountability, and customer experience.
Supervisory Responsibilities
Lead a multidisciplinary organization that may include managers and individual contributors across data engineering, integration, analytics, business intelligence, AI engineering, MLOps, and data product development.
Set clear goals and decision rights, manage performance, and hold leaders accountable for business outcomes, platform reliability, and delivery commitments.
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing teams; build succession plans and strengthen technical, product, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
Create an inclusive culture of ownership, curiosity, constructive challenge, continuous learning, and responsible innovation.
Delegate effectively, remove organizational blockers, and help teams make sound decisions close to the work.
WHAT YOU BRING
12+ years of progressive experience across data engineering, analytics, and data platforms
8+ years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams and leaders.
Proven track record in delivering production AI/ML capabilities, including assessing data readiness, enforcing AI governance (access controls, audit trails), and managing MLOps/LLMOps.
Demonstrated experience defining and executing an enterprise data strategy or broad data transformation with measurable business outcomes.
Strong and prior hands on data engineering background, including experience with modern cloud data platforms, data modeling, batch and near real time streaming platforms like Kafka, schema registries, APIs and integration patterns, testing, observability, and production operations.
Experience leading analytics and business intelligence capabilities, including governed metrics, semantic models, dashboards, experimentation, or advanced analytics.
Experience establishing data governance, catalog, lineage, quality, access, ownership, and stewardship practices in partnership with business leaders.
Strong business and financial acumen, including experience managing budgets, vendors, investment tradeoffs, and capacity planning.
Ability to communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to executive, business, customer, and technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, build alignment across functions, and convert ambiguous opportunities into focused plans and delivered results.
Preferred Experience and Qualifications:
Experience with cloud data and AI services, modern data warehouses or lakehouses, transformation and orchestration tools, event platforms, BI tools, and data catalogs.
Experience building data products or commercial data services for external customers and partners.
Experience in veterinary health, animal health, pharmacy, healthcare, ecommerce, or another regulated, data-intensive industry.
Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, statistics, information management, economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
WORKING CONDITIONS
Remote work environment with reliable internet access.
Extended periods working at a computer, with the ability to alternate between sitting and standing.
Travel up to 30 percent, including occasional international travel, based on business needs.
WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT FROM VETSOURCE
In addition to an inclusive and welcoming culture, Vetsource also offers:
Competitive pay and benefits including medical, vision*, dental, and life insurance
Employee Assistance Program
Pet insurance* and Virtual vet care
PTO, Holidays, Floating Holidays, and Volunteer Day
Retirement Savings Plan (401k/ RRSP) with employer matching program
Paid parental leave
Flexible scheduling and remote work where possible
The opportunity to join one of our Associate Resource Groups, and fun company events!
For Canadian based associates these specific benefits are not included*
OUR VALUES
Vetsource is proud to be part of Mars Science & Diagnostics, a division of Mars Petcare—a family-owned organization rooted in the belief that pets make the world a better place. Our unified culture is built on a foundation of veterinary excellence and guided by a shared vision, inspiring everyone to create A Better World for Pets™ — a world where pets are healthy, happy, and welcome.
Today, Vetsource drives the future of pet health centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency, and Freedom. These principles define how we work, how we treat one another, and how we serve the veterinary community, ensuring a culture where every associate has the opportunity to thrive.
Pay Range (US based applicants): $190,265 - $240,000 USD + Annual Bonus Plan Eligible
Pay Range (CAN based applicants): $185,000 - $240,000 CAD + Annual Bonus Plan Eligible
Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, certifications, relevant education and training, while also considering internal equity.
The statements in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed for this role, and are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, and skills required. Our pre-employment process includes a background check as a part of the hiring process, and will include a drug screen for pharmacy related roles. The background check will only be initiated after a conditional offer of employment has been made and will be subject to an individualized assessment, as required by law. In the United States, if you need a reasonable accommodation for the online application process due to a disability, please email , or if you have general questions relating to this process. No agencies please. We are an equal opportunity employer.
Vetsource is an E-verify employer.

This role brings together data engineering, analytics, MLOps, AI engineering, and data services under a common strategy and operating model.

Working closely with business leaders, product, security, and technology teams, the Senior Director, Enterprise Data translates business priorities into governed data products, scalable platforms, meaningful insights, and AI capabilities. The role is responsible for measurable improvements in data quality, adoption, and business value for associates, customers, and industry partners.
This is a full-time, remote position.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
Enterprise Data Strategy and Leadership

items: Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.

blocks.text: Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.
Data Engineering Platforms and Integration

items: Own and execute the enterprise data strategy in alignment with company priorities, product strategy, and technology roadmaps.
Lead the Data as a First Class Citizen initiative, establishing the operating model, standards, investment priorities, and measures required to treat data as a durable enterprise asset.
Partner with executive and business leaders to identify the highest-value data opportunities, clarify tradeoffs, and translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps with clear outcomes.

blocks.text: Define and report enterprise data health and value measures, including quality, timeliness, reliability, accessibility, adoption, and business impact.
Analytics and Data Products

items: Lead analytics and business intelligence teams that develop trusted metrics, analytical models, dashboards, and decision-support products for internal stakeholders and external customers.

Adopt a data product approach for priority business domains, with defined customers, accountable business and technology owners, quality expectations, service levels, documentation, and adoption measures.
Partner with business teams to define critical data domains and common metrics so teams can make decisions using consistent, well-understood information.
Ensure analytical work addresses a clear business decision or workflow and produces measurable value, not simply reports or dashboards.

blocks.text: AI Enablement and Adoption

items: Develop the data and platform foundations required for AI-powered products, predictive analytics, intelligent automation, and generative AI use cases.

Partner with product, engineering, security, privacy, legal, and business leaders to evaluate and deliver AI use cases with appropriate controls for data access, quality, privacy, safety, traceability, and monitoring.

Enable associates and customers to access approved data and insights through governed conversational interfaces and AI assistants, while preserving metric consistency, permissions, and source traceability.
Establish practical standards for model and prompt lifecycle management, evaluation, monitoring, human oversight, and MLOps or LLMOps where applicable.
Build data and AI literacy across the organization through education, reusable patterns, and close partnership with business teams.

blocks.text: Data Governance Trust and Risk

items: Create a federated governance model that assigns business and technology ownership for critical data and establishes clear decision rights and stewardship responsibilities.
Oversee the enterprise data catalog, business glossary, lineage, quality rules, access policies, retention practices, and issue-management processes.
Partner with security, privacy, compliance, and legal teams to ensure data and AI capabilities meet contractual, regulatory, ethical, and company requirements.
Build trust by making data quality and ownership transparent and by ensuring material data issues are prioritized, communicated, and resolved.

blocks.text: Business Partnership and Delivery

items: Serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across the company, helping them frame business questions, understand data limitations, and use evidence to make better decisions.
Create a transparent intake and prioritization process that balances strategic initiatives, customer commitments, platform health, regulatory needs, and operational support.
Manage divisional objectives, service metrics, budgets, vendor relationships, and capacity plans; communicate progress, dependencies, and risks clearly to executive stakeholders.

blocks.text: Promote strong product management and engineering practices that improve delivery speed, quality, accountability, and customer experience.
Supervisory Responsibilities

items: Lead a multidisciplinary organization that may include managers and individual contributors across data engineering, integration, analytics, business intelligence, AI engineering, MLOps, and data product development.
Set clear goals and decision rights, manage performance, and hold leaders accountable for business outcomes, platform reliability, and delivery commitments.
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain high-performing teams; build succession plans and strengthen technical, product, analytical, and leadership capabilities.
Create an inclusive culture of ownership, curiosity, constructive challenge, continuous learning, and responsible innovation.
Delegate effectively, remove organizational blockers, and help teams make sound decisions close to the work.

blocks.text: WHAT YOU BRING

items: 12+ years of progressive experience across data engineering, analytics, and data platforms
8+ years of leadership experience managing multidisciplinary teams and leaders.
Proven track record in delivering production AI/ML capabilities, including assessing data readiness, enforcing AI governance (access controls, audit trails), and managing MLOps/LLMOps.
Demonstrated experience defining and executing an enterprise data strategy or broad data transformation with measurable business outcomes.

Strong and prior hands on data engineering background, including experience with modern cloud data platforms, data modeling, batch and near real time streaming platforms like Kafka, schema registries, APIs and integration patterns, testing, observability, and production operations.
Experience leading analytics and business intelligence capabilities, including governed metrics, semantic models, dashboards, experimentation, or advanced analytics.
Experience establishing data governance, catalog, lineage, quality, access, ownership, and stewardship practices in partnership with business leaders.
Strong business and financial acumen, including experience managing budgets, vendors, investment tradeoffs, and capacity planning.
Ability to communicate complex technical and analytical topics clearly to executive, business, customer, and technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to lead through influence, build alignment across functions, and convert ambiguous opportunities into focused plans and delivered results.

blocks.text: Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

items: Experience with cloud data and AI services, modern data warehouses or lakehouses, transformation and orchestration tools, event platforms, BI tools, and data catalogs.
Experience building data products or commercial data services for external customers and partners.
Experience in veterinary health, animal health, pharmacy, healthcare, ecommerce, or another regulated, data-intensive industry.
Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, engineering, data science, mathematics, statistics, information management, economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

items: Remote work environment with reliable internet access.
Extended periods working at a computer, with the ability to alternate between sitting and standing.
Travel up to 30 percent, including occasional international travel, based on business needs.

jobs.title: Data Portfolio Head
jobs.text:
Job Description:
The Data Program is one of our customers strategic programs which has been recently established to help deliver our ambitious strategy by delivery of a business-wide data strategy and data transformation program. You will work with internal & customer colleagues to shape the strategic thinking, bring to life and deliver key strategic projects that will establish data and analytics capabilities across all parts of the customers business.
Your new role
Reporting to the Customer Delivery Manager this is a leadership role within the Data Program to help lead and deliver large scale data & analytics project outcomes across all business units of the company.
The successful candidate will have proven expertise in leading data, analytics, digital or similar transformation projects and business change. They will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of one or more projects in the data program with a focus on time, cost, quality and benefits.
Key Responsibilities include:
Project planning
· Supports the customer and project director in the development of a business case
· Determines the objectives and measures upon which the project will be evaluated at its completion, with a particular focus on benefits
· Creates a detailed work plan in the PPM (Portfolio Planning Management) tool which identifies and sequences the activities needed to successfully complete the project (including implementation into BAU so the anticipated project benefits will be delivered)
· Determines the resources (time, money, equipment, etc.) required to complete the project.
· Reviews the project schedule with senior management and all other staff that will be affected by the project activities; revises the schedule as required.
· Conducts Impact Assessments of projects scope across Privacy, AML/CTF, Security, Data Governance, Business Continuity Management
Project implementation
· Ensures the project meets sponsor expectations with respect to quality, budget, delivery timelines, and strategy.
· Adheres to the customers project management methodology.
· Oversee’s Project Execution & ensures all projects run according to the project plan.
· Documents information in PPM to ensure that all project information is appropriately documented and secured.
· Works effectively with project team members to execute the plan successfully.
· Works with external parties to ensure the delivery of quality outcomes whilst building a strong rapport and trust, and facilitating a positive experience in dealing with the Fund
· Applies effective change management methodologies and techniques in the successful implementation of projects.
· Monitors the progress of the project and make adjustments as necessary to ensure the successful completion of the project.
· Identifies, tracks, manages and mitigates risk on specific projects.
· Reviews the quality of the work completed with the project team on a regular basis to ensure that it meets the project standards.
Project reporting and control
· Ensures that all projects are delivered within the agreed cost parameters and that all changes to project budgets, time and scope occur in accordance with the accepted change management processes.
· Monitors and controls performance against planning, providing reports to Steering Committees, the Project Management Office, Project Governance Panel and the Fund management as required.
· Reports on project quality, project sponsor and project success metrics during regularly scheduled and ad hoc portfolio review meetings with the Heads & Directors from the Customer.
· Manages the costs within the project budgets.
· Manages scope creep through change orders, phased delivery or other methods to ensure projects deliver on timeline, scope, budget and strategy expectations.
· Highlights issues in a timely manner to management that may adversely affect the successful delivery of the project.
· Where project control is in jeopardy, creates contingency plans with appropriate input from key team members (including the PMO) and implements a revised project schedule, scope or budget in a timely manner.
Project communication
· Sets and manages project expectations.
· Establishes a communication schedule to update stakeholders on the progress of the project.
· Manages day-to-day project sponsor and stakeholder interactions.
· Uses sound judgment in all project communication and ensures that key stakeholders including the team, sponsor and management are apprised of project activities in a timely manner.
· Communicates progress, risks, expectations, timelines, milestones and other key project metrics to sponsors and team members.
· Assists and supports the development of project skills within the organization, through the provision of advice and coaching of staff, as required.
Project evaluation
· Evaluates all key project deliverables, as well as final product to ensure traceability of requirements, high quality and sponsor acceptance.
· Undertakes post implementation reviews and benefits realisation exercises as required.
What you'll need
· Significant experience as a senior project manager in a complex organization, preferably delivering enterprise-wide data, analytics, digital or similar transformation
· Experience delivering projects on any public clouds like Google etc.
· Strong experience working with (any) agile frameworks within cross-functional agile projects
· Proven ability to work to a structured delivery framework.
· Skillful application of well-designed change management and communication processes as they relate to instigating and delivering on programs of change.
· Significant experience in working under pressure, setting and manage conflicting priorities and meeting specified timeframes.
· Developed stakeholder relationship skills, including ability to initiate, maintain and develop relationships with staff from all levels of the customer Organisation.
· High level facilitation skills and capable management of group dynamics that lead to the effective facilitation, guidance and negotiation of successful outcomes.
· Ability to formulate reports and to provide well considered options for deliberation by management.
· Developed written and oral communication/ interpersonal skills with the ability to present ideas, perspectives and issues to senior management.
· Demonstrated ability and a willingness to highlight to management any project issues and variations.
· Demonstrated ability to collaborate and to be flexible and adaptable

jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Technology Operations & Platform Stability
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are looking for a senior technology leader to take full ownership of our regional production platform stability and operational excellence. This is a highly visible leadership position responsible for ensuring the performance, resilience, and continuous improvement of our mission-critical trading ecosystems.
This role goes beyond traditional operational management. We need someone who can think strategically, drive innovation, and act as a trusted business partner to senior stakeholders. You will lead a regional team, oversee complex technical environments, and champion the adoption of automation and AI-driven solutions to enhance system reliability and user experience.
What You Will Do
Lead and Develop Teams: Manage, mentor, and grow a regional operations team. Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. Identify and develop future leaders, reducing single points of failure through knowledge sharing and succession planning.
Ensure Platform Stability: Take end-to-end responsibility for the availability and resilience of production systems. Own the incident, problem, and crisis management processes, coordinating rapid resolution across multiple internal teams during high-pressure situations.
Drive Innovation: Spearhead the adoption of AI and automation tools to improve monitoring, root cause analysis, capacity planning, and overall operational efficiency. Move beyond reactive support to proactive prevention and optimization.
Build Strong Relationships: Act as the primary operational point of contact for business heads, product teams, and technology partners. Translate technical issues into business impact and maintain trust through clear, transparent communication during escalations.
Manage Risk and Compliance: Ensure all technology risks are identified, managed, and remediated. Lead engagements for audits and regulatory reviews, maintaining strict adherence to internal policies and enterprise risk standards.
What We Are Looking For
A proven track record of leading production support or platform operations teams in complex, high-volume, low-latency environments.
Deep technical understanding of distributed systems, including Linux/Unix environments, databases, networking, and infrastructure.
Strong experience with system integration protocols and client connectivity technologies.
A background in financial services or similarly regulated, fast-paced industries (preferred but not required).
Hands-on experience with scripting, automation, or software development is a strong plus.
Familiarity with cloud platforms, observability tools, and modern operational frameworks.
Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and influence at all organizational levels.
Strong crisis management and decision-making capabilities under pressure.
What Success Looks Like
In your first year, you will be recognized as the go-to technology leader for the region. You will have improved platform stability, reduced incident frequency, and implemented measurable automation gains. You will have built a strong, self-sufficient team and earned the trust of both business and technology stakeholders as an independent, strategic owner of a significant technology estate.
