jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
AmeriSave Mortgage Corp. has set the standard in online mortgage lending, with over $130 billion in funded loan volume. As one of the top rated, largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the nation, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication and excellence. We leverage cutting edge technology and data driven strategies to provide exceptional service to our customers.
Our employees are the driving force behind our success. We believe in the power of a dynamic and talented workforce and creating an environment where your contributions are not just recognized, they're celebrated. Your success is our success, and we are seeking skilled professionals who are ready to bring their A-game, exceed benchmarks, and enhance the overall excellence of AmeriSave, while also growing and advancing their careers.
At AmeriSave, we're one team with one shared dream: to be the best. Let's redefine excellence together!
What We’re Looking For:
AmeriSave is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to lead our Enterprise Technology & AI organization, software engineering, infrastructure, and security function responsible for our proprietary technology stack, including our Digital Mortgage platform and the systems that run our loan origination business end to end.
This is an executive role for a hands-on technology leader who has run large engineering organizations at scale, ideally within the mortgage industry or at a well-known lender, and who is equally credible discussing Azure architecture with a principal engineer, disaster recovery posture with an auditor, and technology strategy with the Board. You will own the reliability, security, scalability, and roadmap of the systems that power the company, while building and developing the engineering talent that maintains them.Seeking candidates with expertise and hands-on experience with Aloha software.
What You'll Do:
Engineering Organization Leadership:Lead a software engineering organization that designs, builds, and maintains AmeriSave's proprietary technology platforms, setting engineering standards, architecture direction, and delivery cadence across multiple product and platform teams.
Cloud & Database Infrastructure:Own the Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server database environments that run the company's proprietary systems, including architecture, cost management, performance tuning, and long-term platform strategy.
Reliability & Uptime:Hold accountability for system uptime and reliability in the high 99.99% range across production systems; drive the monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and engineering discipline required to sustain that bar at scale.
Information Security:Own the organization's information security posture and security infrastructure, partnering with Compliance and Risk to ensure systems, data, and customer information are protected against evolving threats, and that the company meets regulatory and investor security requirements.
AI Strategy:Set direction for the company's AI strategy and investment, overseeing in-house AI initiatives (including proprietary AI-powered platform capabilities, automation, and applied AI/ML use cases) and evaluating where AI can responsibly improve efficiency, customer experience, and decisioning.
Networking Infrastructure:Own enterprise networking architecture, including data center, cloud, and remote/hybrid workforce connectivity, ensuring performance, security, and scalability of the network as the business grows.
Disaster Recovery:Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning for all critical systems, including recovery time/point objectives, failover testing, and readiness, ensuring the business can withstand and recover from major disruptions.
Capacity Planning:Lead capacity planning across infrastructure and applications, forecasting growth and ensuring systems scale ahead of business demand without over-provisioning cost.
Development Resource Management:Build, develop, and retain engineering talent and leadership; manage development resourcing and prioritization across competing business and technology initiatives; establish career paths and a strong engineering culture.
Executive Partnership & Communication:Partner with the CEO, CIO/CISO, and executive leadership team to translate business strategy into a technology roadmap; represent Technology in Board and investor conversations, and communicate complex technical topics in terms executives and non-technical stakeholders can act on.
Budget Ownership:Manage the technology budget, including infrastructure spend, tooling, and headcount, balancing innovation investment against operating efficiency.
What You’ll Need:
Deep Industry Experience:15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5+ years in a senior executive technology role (CTO, VP Engineering, or similar), preferably within the mortgage industry, and preferably with a well-known mortgage lender or financial services company.
Scale of Engineering Leadership:Demonstrated experience leading a software engineering organization that builds and maintains proprietary systems, not a primarily vendor/SaaS-managed environment.
Cloud & Database Expertise:Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server environments at production scale, including architecture, performance, security, and cost management.
Reliability Track Record:Proven track record of sustaining system uptime in the high 99.99% range for business-critical, customer-facing systems.
Security Expertise:Strong background in information security management and security infrastructure, including familiarity with financial services regulatory and audit expectations.
AI Experience:Experience directing applied AI/ML initiatives within a production engineering organization, translating AI capability into real business and customer outcomes.
Networking Expertise:Solid grounding in enterprise networking infrastructure, including cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, and network security.
Disaster Recovery Expertise:Experience owning disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including failover testing and recovery objectives, for mission-critical systems.
Capacity Planning Expertise:Demonstrated skill in infrastructure and application capacity planning, forecasting scale needs ahead of business growth.
Talent & Resource Management:Strong people leadership skills, with experience building, developing, and retaining engineering talent and managing development resourcing across a large, multi-team organization.
Executive Communication:Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; comfortable presenting technology strategy, risk, and performance directly to the CEO, Board, and investors.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.
High-speed internet required for remote work, Cable or Fiber ONLY with the ability to connect via Ethernet. Minimum speeds: 70/30 Mbps (basic), 200-300/35-70 Mbps (shared), 500-1,000/100+ Mbps (heavy use).
**Please note that the compensation and benefit information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position only and is provided pursuant to applicable state and local laws on pay transparency. It is estimated based on what a successful applicant in the relevant state might be paid. **
Compensation:
The annual compensation for this position generally ranges from between $275,000-$350,000 based on experience and qualifications, plus executive bonus and long-term incentive eligibility.

blocks.text: AmeriSave Mortgage Corp. has set the standard in online mortgage lending, with over $130 billion in funded loan volume. As one of the top rated, largest privately owned online mortgage lenders in the nation, our mission is to deliver beneficial, responsible home lending solutions with unwavering integrity, dedication and excellence. We leverage cutting edge technology and data driven strategies to provide exceptional service to our customers.

Our employees are the driving force behind our success. We believe in the power of a dynamic and talented workforce and creating an environment where your contributions are not just recognized, they're celebrated. Your success is our success, and we are seeking skilled professionals who are ready to bring their A-game, exceed benchmarks, and enhance the overall excellence of AmeriSave, while also growing and advancing their careers.
At AmeriSave, we're one team with one shared dream: to be the best. Let's redefine excellence together!
What We’re Looking For:

AmeriSave is seeking a Chief Technology Officer to lead our Enterprise Technology & AI organization, software engineering, infrastructure, and security function responsible for our proprietary technology stack, including our Digital Mortgage platform and the systems that run our loan origination business end to end.

This is an executive role for a hands-on technology leader who has run large engineering organizations at scale, ideally within the mortgage industry or at a well-known lender, and who is equally credible discussing Azure architecture with a principal engineer, disaster recovery posture with an auditor, and technology strategy with the Board. You will own the reliability, security, scalability, and roadmap of the systems that power the company, while building and developing the engineering talent that maintains them.Seeking candidates with expertise and hands-on experience with Aloha software.
What You'll Do:

Engineering Organization Leadership:Lead a software engineering organization that designs, builds, and maintains AmeriSave's proprietary technology platforms, setting engineering standards, architecture direction, and delivery cadence across multiple product and platform teams.

Cloud & Database Infrastructure:Own the Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server database environments that run the company's proprietary systems, including architecture, cost management, performance tuning, and long-term platform strategy.

Reliability & Uptime:Hold accountability for system uptime and reliability in the high 99.99% range across production systems; drive the monitoring, incident response, root-cause analysis, and engineering discipline required to sustain that bar at scale.

Information Security:Own the organization's information security posture and security infrastructure, partnering with Compliance and Risk to ensure systems, data, and customer information are protected against evolving threats, and that the company meets regulatory and investor security requirements.

AI Strategy:Set direction for the company's AI strategy and investment, overseeing in-house AI initiatives (including proprietary AI-powered platform capabilities, automation, and applied AI/ML use cases) and evaluating where AI can responsibly improve efficiency, customer experience, and decisioning.

Networking Infrastructure:Own enterprise networking architecture, including data center, cloud, and remote/hybrid workforce connectivity, ensuring performance, security, and scalability of the network as the business grows.

Disaster Recovery:Own disaster recovery and business continuity planning for all critical systems, including recovery time/point objectives, failover testing, and readiness, ensuring the business can withstand and recover from major disruptions.
Capacity Planning:Lead capacity planning across infrastructure and applications, forecasting growth and ensuring systems scale ahead of business demand without over-provisioning cost.

Development Resource Management:Build, develop, and retain engineering talent and leadership; manage development resourcing and prioritization across competing business and technology initiatives; establish career paths and a strong engineering culture.

Executive Partnership & Communication:Partner with the CEO, CIO/CISO, and executive leadership team to translate business strategy into a technology roadmap; represent Technology in Board and investor conversations, and communicate complex technical topics in terms executives and non-technical stakeholders can act on.
Budget Ownership:Manage the technology budget, including infrastructure spend, tooling, and headcount, balancing innovation investment against operating efficiency.
What You’ll Need:

Deep Industry Experience:15+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5+ years in a senior executive technology role (CTO, VP Engineering, or similar), preferably within the mortgage industry, and preferably with a well-known mortgage lender or financial services company.
Scale of Engineering Leadership:Demonstrated experience leading a software engineering organization that builds and maintains proprietary systems, not a primarily vendor/SaaS-managed environment.

Cloud & Database Expertise:Deep, hands-on expertise with Azure cloud infrastructure and SQL Server environments at production scale, including architecture, performance, security, and cost management.
Reliability Track Record:Proven track record of sustaining system uptime in the high 99.99% range for business-critical, customer-facing systems.
Security Expertise:Strong background in information security management and security infrastructure, including familiarity with financial services regulatory and audit expectations.
AI Experience:Experience directing applied AI/ML initiatives within a production engineering organization, translating AI capability into real business and customer outcomes.
Networking Expertise:Solid grounding in enterprise networking infrastructure, including cloud networking, hybrid connectivity, and network security.
Disaster Recovery Expertise:Experience owning disaster recovery and business continuity planning, including failover testing and recovery objectives, for mission-critical systems.
Capacity Planning Expertise:Demonstrated skill in infrastructure and application capacity planning, forecasting scale needs ahead of business growth.

Talent & Resource Management:Strong people leadership skills, with experience building, developing, and retaining engineering talent and managing development resourcing across a large, multi-team organization.
Executive Communication:Exceptional executive presence and communication skills; comfortable presenting technology strategy, risk, and performance directly to the CEO, Board, and investors.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field required; Master's degree preferred.

High-speed internet required for remote work, Cable or Fiber ONLY with the ability to connect via Ethernet. Minimum speeds: 70/30 Mbps (basic), 200-300/35-70 Mbps (shared), 500-1,000/100+ Mbps (heavy use).

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Viseven Group is a leading global B2B MarTech service provider, empowering Pharma and LifeScience companies since 2009. Our mission is to drive digital transformation and excellence, offering comprehensive end-to-end software and digital marketing services tailored to the pharmaceutical industry. The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the top 100 Pharma and Life Science companies.
At Viseven, our rapidly growing team boasts over 700 highly skilled professionals, including experts in development, design, business analysis, project management, delivery, sales, marketing, and customer success.
With a global footprint in more than 30 countries across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC, and physical offices in Ukraine, Poland, Estonia, India, and the US, we are well-positioned to serve our diverse clientele.
Join us and become part of a pioneering team dedicated to shaping the future of digital transformation in Pharma and Life Sciences across more than 50 countries around the globe.
Role description: Viseven is looking for a Head of Product to own and drive the success of the entire products and services portfolio, create synergies across solutions, and increase overall portfolio value and profitability.
Responsibilities:
Define and lead product portfolio vision and strategy, ensuring alignment with company goals and a coherent value proposition.
Decide portfolio composition (invest/grow/maintain/change/sunset) to maximize market opportunity and business impact, ensuring products synergy and competitive advantage.
Continuously analyze market trends, competition, customer needs, stakeholder insights and synthesize it into product decisions and choices.
Identify and validate new product and business opportunities, including building business cases and managing new products before they are transferred to separate business lines.
Oversee product lifecycle (development, launch, evolution), balancing innovation and improvement.
Monitor and manage product performance (revenue, profitability, adoption, retention) and optimize accordingly.
Set cross-product priorities and allocate resources based on impact, ROI, and strategic fit, including the balance between building core and customer desired functionality.
Build and lead the product management function, including capabilities, standards, and best practices organization-wide, owning and building company-wide expertise related to products knowledge and product application.
Align and active cooperate with cross-functional stakeholders to drive go-to-market, customer acquisition and retention, adoption, and overall portfolio growth.
Hard skills required:
5+ years in product management with leadership of multi-product SaaS portfolios; MarTech/Pharma or regulated domain experience preferred.
Proven ownership of portfolio strategy and P&L, including product launches and scaling in international markets.
Strong strategic and analytical skills: portfolio decisions (invest/grow/sunset), business cases, pricing, ROI, SaaS metrics.
Deep product management expertise (discovery, roadmapping, prioritization, experimentation) across full product lifecycle.
Experience balancing innovation vs. optimization and core vs. customer-driven development.
Ability to build and scale product organizations, define standards, and develop product managers.
Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder alignment in a multinational environment.
Clear communication and data-driven, customer-centric, outcome-oriented mindset.
Soft skills required:
Both in-depth and agile mindset.
Strong leadership, planning, effective management of self and the team.
Advanced communication and presentation skills.
Great team player – optimistic, organized, flexible, helpful.
Wholistic, creative and critical thinking – ability to develop and create new ideas, systems, and relationships for the success of the company, analyze root causes and provide solutions.
What we provide:
We know our team members are key to achieving our goals, so we value and empower them to share their vision. We reward this passion with exceptional benefits, including:
Competitive Compensation: Regular performance-based salary and career development reviews.
Experienced Team: Join a passionate, experienced team in a friendly atmosphere.
Career Growth: Opportunities for professional and career advancement.
Paid Time Off: 18 business days per year (20 business days after 2 years of service).
Sick Leave:
Non-documented: 4 business days per year.
Documented: 20 business days per year.
Family Leave: 3 paid business days for marriage, childbirth, or bereavement.
Medical Insurance: Comprehensive coverage.
English Courses: Learning opportunities to improve your language skills.
Professional Development: Participation in forums and conferences.
Corporate Events: Regular team-building activities and events.
Work Environment: Enjoy a comfortable, fully equipped office and the possibility to work from home.

jobs.title: Regional Chief Technology Officer, NAMER West
jobs.text:
About Rimini Street, Inc.
Rimini Street, Inc. (Nasdaq: RMNI), a Russell 2000® Company, is a global leader in end-to-end third-party enterprise software support, managed services and Agentic AI ERP innovation solutions, dedicated to helping clients realize extraordinary business outcomes.
Our comprehensive portfolio of unified solutions help run, manage, support, customize, configure, connect, protect, monitor, and optimize enterprise application, database and technology software, enabling our clients to achieve better business outcomes, significantly reduce costs and reallocate resources towards strategic projects.
The Company has signed thousands of contracts with Fortune Global 100, Fortune 500, midmarket, public sector and government organizations who selected Rimini Street as their trusted, proven mission-critical enterprise software solutions provider and achieved better operational outcomes, realized billions of US dollars in savings and funded AI and other innovation investments.
We are actively seeking a Regional CTO, North America West. This is a remote position that will be based in the North America Pacific or Mountain time zone and will report to the SVP & GM of the Americas region.
Note to Applicants:
This is not a traditional internal CTO position typically housed within the internal IT office. The Regional Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role is entirely external-facing. It does not involve managing a team or staff. Instead, the position will collaborate closely with various teams across the company, including our global product management, professional services, marketing, cybersecurity, and other teams as needed.
The role focuses on advisory, relationship building, generating awareness, and identifying opportunities. It does not encompass project execution responsibilities.
Position Summary
The Regional Chief Technology Officer (CTO) will serve as the primary technical advisor and thought leader for our customers and prospects in their respective regions. This customer-facing role requires a deep understanding of enterprise architecture, ERP systems, and related technologies. Reporting to the Global Corporate CTO based in the US and the North America General Manager, the Regional CTO will play a crucial role in building credibility, generating awareness, and driving business growth through public speaking, content creation, and direct executive customer engagement.
Key Responsibilities:
Enterprise Architecture Guidance
Provide expert advice on IT enterprise architecture, best practices, and strategic road mapping for regional customers and prospects.
Engage in discussions on enterprise systems such as Oracle and SAP ERP, cloud infrastructure, databases, Java, cloud deployments, and data integration.
Assist in building credibility with executives to help the sales team and account management teams secure new business and strengthen relationships with existing customers.
Be a rainmaker that identifies opportunities and develops a status of a trusted advisor.
Understand and address technical sales objections and concerns from prospects
Public Speaking and Industry Engagement
Act as the regional public spokesperson, delivering presentations at industry events, conferences, social events, boardroom sessions, and roundtables.
Generate awareness through educational and insightful conversations in various formats.
Thought Leadership and Content Creation
Collaborate with the marketing team to produce webinars, articles, white papers, media interviews, and other thought leadership content.
Continuously create fresh and engaging educational pieces to drive traffic to our website and generate interest in our services.
Candidate Qualifications:
10+ years of Deep Technical Expertise and Advisory
Extensive experience advising C-level executives and providing enterprise architecture and ERP road map consultations.
In-depth knowledge of ERP modules, implementation, deployment, and functionality (e.g., Oracle E-Business Suite, SAP ECC, S/4HANA, etc.).
Familiarity with ERP on-premise and cloud deployment models, including IaaS and SaaS strategies.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts and solutions for ERP workloads.
Proficiency in relevant technologies such as Java, operating systems, storage, cloud technologies, data migration, integration, AI, and more.
5+ years of Public Speaking and Thought Leadership
Proven experience in public speaking, media engagements, and content publication.
Ability to articulate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
Experience creating thought leadership content and driving engagement through educational materials.
Interpersonal Skills and Regional Expertise
Strong communication skills, both in the local regional language and English.
Ability to travel regionally and internationally as needed.
Established relationships with CIO-level executives in the region.
Experience negotiating with ERP vendors is a plus.
Additional Qualifications
5+ Years of Previous experience as a CIO or similar role with a track record of successful ERP implementations and IT transformations.
Knowledge of SaaS solutions like SAP RISE, Oracle Fusion, Salesforce, and others.
5+ Years of working with cloud platforms (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) and workload migration methodologies.
Insight into industry trends, emerging technologies, and AI solutions related to ERP and enterprise data.
Personal Attributes
Articulate and poised, with strong public presentation skills.
Proactive, innovative, and visionary in approach.
Able to effectively respond to common objections and concerns related to third-party support services.
Must speak fluent English. Multiple additional spoken languages preferred.
Education
MS/MBA: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Management Information Systems or equivalent
Location
Remote - North America West or Mountain time zone, U.S.
Why Rimini Street?
Rimini Street Inc. is an affirmative action-equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable Federal, State, and Local Laws regarding recruitment and hiring.
Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, citizenship status, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable Federal, State, or Local laws. Rimini Street Inc. offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package to employees.
The general salary range for this type of role is 170k - 240k depending on skills and experience. The actual compensation offered will ultimately be based on several factors such as a candidate's location, and the level of applicable skills and professional experience. Rimini’s target pay for each position is available upon request during the applicant’s Interview process.
Benefits for US employees include:
Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
Disability insurance
Paid Parental Leave
401(k) program
Generous Paid time off (PTO)
We are looking for talented, passionate people to help us build our future at Rimini Street. We hire only the best, the most extraordinary professionals and provide compensation, bonuses, and benefits to match the skills of our top-performing team members. Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy growing together, and get excited about learning new skills? Are you looking for an opportunity to make a true impact as part of a team of extraordinary professionals? This is the place for you.
Our work is challenging and meaningful. We start and end each day with a sense of achievement and purpose guided by our core values, the Four Cs:
Company
We dream big and innovate boldly.
Colleagues
We work with extraordinary people who create a culture of mutual respect and collaboration.
Clients
We relentlessly pursue solutions that help clients achieve their goals. Our unmatched client care is rooted in our passion for exceptional service.
Community
We believe in leaving the world a better place than we found it. With the Rimini Street Foundation, we’ve made positive impacts in six continents for over 425 charities.
Accelerating Company Growth
Nasdaq-listed under ticker symbol RMNI since October 2017
Over 6,700+ signed contracts to date, including Fortune 500 and Global 100 companies
Over 2,000 team members in 22 countries
US and international recognition for industry leadership and philanthropic efforts. See all of our awards and recognitions here:
Rimini Street is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, gender or gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Vice President Product Development, Literacy
jobs.text:
We are seeking a dynamic, forward-thinking educational publishing executive to drive our Product Development efforts for K–12 Literacy, including Supplemental, Assessment, and Intervention solutions. In this role, you'll use your experience guiding development teams to manage our comprehensive literacy portfolio. What You’ll Do You will provide overall product development leadership for our Literacy portfolio, which includes K–12 Literacy, Supplemental, Assessment & Intervention. With support from the Senior Vice-President of Product Development, you’ll collaborate with Product Management/Marketing, Creative Design/UX, and Product Technology to develop innovative product models that meet the needs of today’s teachers and students. jobs.title: Director of Product Operations
jobs.text:
Join Revive Media to help advertisers across the country scale their localized Connected TV advertising. Our business is growing rapidly and we're in the midst of transforming from a services agency to a product-led business with our new native platform, Convoy. The platform is live with external partners and we're expanding its reach — this role will help us build the operational backbone that lets our product team scale as we grow.
We are a small, remote-first team of high-performing professionals with diverse backgrounds located across many time zones, including North America, Europe, and Asia. We prioritize asynchronous communication and documentation but come together as a team to solve hard problems.
The Role
You'll manage and develop our product team, partnering with lead product managers and executive leadership to translate product strategy into a sequenced roadmap and clear priorities for each squad. Lead product managers and leadership will identify strategic opportunities and set product direction; you'll translate that direction into team priorities, capacity decisions, and operating rhythms. Your squad-leading PMs will remain responsible for understanding their customers, validating solutions, and delivering measurable outcomes. You'll continuously improve how the product team plans, delivers, communicates, and handles support and escalations as the organization scales.
Responsibilities
People Leadership
Hire, coach, and develop the product management team against a clear leveling framework
Partner with product leadership and lead product managers to translate priorities into team capacity and ownership
Product Operations
Build and run the planning and delivery cadence that keeps the team's work aligned to company priorities and gives the rest of the organization reliable visibility into what's shipping and when
Establish consistent standards for specs, QA, definition of done, releases, and outcome tracking
Define and maintain a consistent approach to tracking expected and actual outcomes at the team and feature level, using those insights to improve future product decisions
Lead how production issues, escalations, and urgent requests are routed and resolved across product, engineering, and the teams that surface them
Continuously improve the systems the product team uses for planning, delivery, support, and communication, using better processes, tooling, and automation to reduce friction and coordination as the organization scales
Operate as a player-coach: step in hands-on where needed while building the team's judgment and capability
Cross-Functional Leadership
Partner with lead product managers to represent product in company-wide planning and communication
Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, GTM, customer success, and company leadership
What success looks like:
One year in, the product organization runs more predictably because of this person, and it shows up everywhere downstream: product managers, engineering, and the broader company all feel it.
Every squad and feature has a clear before-and-after: what outcome we expected, what actually happened, and product managers can point to their own impact using that data
Product managers on the team are growing, doing better work, and can see the difference their work makes
Production issues and escalations get resolved through a clear process instead of interrupting whoever happens to be closest, and product managers spend less time on it than they did a year ago
Releases require less last-minute coordination, and shared standards around specs, QA, and definition of done make delivery consistent across the team
The planning cadence gives the rest of the company reliable visibility into what's shipping and when, and other teams trust product's timelines more than they used to
As the team scales, its operating practices remain lightweight—providing greater clarity and consistency without slowing product managers down or pulling them away from customers and product work
Requirements
8+ years in product management or product operations, including 4+ yrs of experience directly managing a team of product managers
Experience building or improving how a product organization plans, delivers, and tracks outcomes, ideally at a fast-growing company
Comfortable owning a support or escalation process alongside planning work; this role is judged on how smoothly issues get handled, not only on whether the roadmap ships on time
A track record hiring, coaching, and leveling product managers
Strong analytical instincts; comfortable working directly with data and dashboards rather than only requesting them
Excellent cross-functional communication skills; able to represent product credibly with engineering, go-to-market, and company leadership
Experience in ad tech or complex B2B workflow products is a plus, not required
Benefits
Comprehensive healthcare including medical, vision & dental benefits covered at 100% for employees and 50% for dependents
We're fully remote and offer a remote working stipend
Flexible PTO — take what you need, when you need
Coffee or Tea Subscription
Monthly 3 day weekend
Revive Media provides the wage it reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for all remote roles and as otherwise required by applicable law. Total compensation including a quarterly bonus typically ranges from $190k - $205k. Actual compensation may vary within the listed range based on a wide array of factors, including, but not limited to, skill set, experience, and specific geographic location. The expected base pay for this role is $175k.
Revive Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We assess all qualified candidates on the basis of skill, experience and talent.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer, AI Systems & Multi-Agent Architecture
jobs.text:
Overview
We're looking for a Russian-speaking technology leader to define and scale AI architecture standards across a group of companies. As CTO, youll set the technical direction for the portfolio, ensuring multi-agent AI platforms are deployed reliably, securely, and in full compliance with industry standards.
Responsibilities
Define and maintain reference architecture for AI platforms and multi-agent orchestration.
Oversee data quality, governance, and traceability frameworks across subsidiaries.
Manage MLOps pipelines, observability, and GPU/cloud infrastructure.
Establish security, compliance, and ethical AI standards across the group.
Lead and mentor distributed engineering teams, building scalable and high-performance capabilities.
Collaborate with product and business leaders to align AI investments with group strategy.
Evaluate new technologies and vendors, guiding build-versus-buy decisions across the portfolio.
Requirements
8+ years in distributed systems, ML platform design, or large-scale AI deployments.
Hands-on expertise with cloud-native infrastructure, MLOps, and secure-by-design practices.
Experience leading technical audits and certifications in enterprise environments.
Proven success scaling engineering teams in diverse business contexts.
Fluency in English and Russian, with additional languages a plus.
Strong communication skills, able to bridge technical and executive-level discussions.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product Management
jobs.text:
About xCures
The best of medicine should belong to everyone. Nobody dreams of becoming good at being a patient. We have people to love, things we want to do, and plans we hope to keep. Illness already asks enough of us.
xCures® exists to give healthcare the capacity to care for everyone. Healthcare has more to give. Too much of its time, money, and talent goes into unnecessary work that keeps people waiting and drives up the cost of care. Freeing those resources can make excellent care possible for far more people.
xCures understands a patient’s history across the places they receive care and keeps that understanding current. It puts trusted information in the hands of the people who need it, when they need it, and uses that knowledge to take on more of the administrative work around care. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from.
Our ambition is to empower doctors to make better decisions, enable researchers to develop better treatments faster, and help healthcare organizations serve more people with fewer errors and lower costs. We work with diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth companies, health systems, payers, and consumer health platforms. We are a fully remote, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful.
We are building for the lives people want to live.
Here’s Where You’ll Make An Impact:
xCures is hiring a product leader who turns open questions into dated decisions. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer, you will own how xCures decides what to build and how it shows the build was worth it. You will lead the product management team across our customer segments.
Key Responsibilities:
Product strategy. Define and own the multi-year product strategy, and keep it tied to the company’s growth goals
Roadmap ownership. Own the product roadmap across our customer segments. Set direction, sequence the work, and carry the trade-offs
Decision making. Drive timely decisions on scope, sequencing, and trade-offs
Team leadership. Hire, develop, and lead a team of product managers. Set the performance bar and create a path for people to grow
Product operating model. Own and scale the process from discovery through launch, including requirements standards, prioritization, and launch readiness
Cross-functional execution. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to ship committed work on committed dates
Measurement and outcomes. Define the success metric for each launch before it ships, and report against it afterward
Portfolio lifecycle and expansion. Own the path from early concept to production, and decide what earns continued investment and what retires. Lead expansion into new markets and segments
Commercial partnership. Partner with Commercial and Product Marketing so customer problems reach the roadmap with evidence attached. Give Product Marketing what it needs to take a launch to market
Qualifications:
Required:
15+ years in product management, including 10+ years of experience managing product managers
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
Deep experience in health technology or clinical data platforms
A track record of shipping products that address customers’ pain points
Experience in a regulated environment, where HIPAA, PHI handling, traceability, and evidence requirements shape the design
Cross-functional influence: you align Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Product Marketing, and Medical Affairs without formal authority over any of them
Bonus Points:
Experience in diagnostics, specialty pharmacy, revenue cycle, or prior authorization and utilization management
Hands-on experience building with LLMs in production
Fluency with generative AI tools inside the product process itself: discovery, requirements, and documentation
Familiarity with healthcare interoperability standards such as FHIR, HL7, TEFCA, and NCPDP
Familiarity with CMS prior-authorization rulemaking
Experience scaling a product organization through rapid revenue growth and market expansions
Location
xCures operates in a distributed, remote-first environment, with occasional travel to company offsites or key meetings throughout the year. Candidates may be located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate must already have authorization to work in the United States. At this time, xCures does not offer sponsorship. All candidate information will be held in confidence and in accordance with EEOC guidelines.
Additional Considerations
We recognize that people bring a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the requirements listed in a job description. Diversity of experience and skills, combined with a shared passion for healthcare, is what drives us to innovate. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. xCures is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Benefits
Great work deserves great support. We believe our people are our greatest asset, and we’re committed to supporting them with a strong, competitive benefits package. Our goal is to be a place where people genuinely want to build their careers, and our benefits are designed to support our team in the ways that matter most.
Remote-First
Paid Time Off and 13 Company Holidays
Equity Package
Paid Parental Leave
Medical, Vision, and Dental
Employer HSA Contribution
Employer 401(k) Match
STD, LTD, Life Insurance and Critical Illness Plans
Employee Assistance Program
Adoption Assistance
Company Offsites
Monthly Internet Allowance
Professional Development Funds
And more!
Compensation
The anticipated salary range for this role is $235,000 to $265,000.
Agency Notice: xCures does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or other third-party recruiters. Any resumes submitted without a signed, active agreement with xCures will not be considered, and no fee will be paid in the event of a hire.

jobs.title: Director of Technology Operations
jobs.text:
Coinspaid Dev is the engineering brand behind the technology, infrastructure, and R&D expertise built within Coinspaid. With more than 120 engineersand over 11 years of industry experience, Coinspaid Dev brings together software engineering, infrastructure, security and R&D teams with experience building distributed systems and blockchain infrastructure operating across more than 20 blockchain networks.
Coinspaid Dev emerges as an independent engineering brand with a straightforward mission: to advance blockchain infrastructure engineering and contribute practical expertise back to the industry. The structure is new. The experience behind it is not.
Director of Technology Operations
We are building the next operating model for a ~150-person technology organization behind production-critical financial infrastructure.
We are looking for a Director of Technology Operations to lead that transformation.
This is not a traditional infrastructure or IT operations role. The mandate is to evolve Technology Operations from a primarily reactive model toward a scalable organization built around clear ownership, platform engineering, automation, self-service, operational excellence, resilience and measurable outcomes.
You will initially lead several established technology functions through their existing Heads and Leads, with approximately 25 people across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence. The mandate is broader than the initial team size: you will help shape the operating model of a ~150-person technology organization and build capabilities designed to scale significantly beyond today's structure.
Your responsibility will go beyond managing these teams. You will help shape how the broader technology organization operates: how production services are owned, how incidents and changes are managed, how engineers consume infrastructure capabilities, how operational risks are identified, and how recurring manual work is systematically eliminated.
A major part of the role is organizational transformation. We expect you to assess the current model, challenge it where necessary, define the target state, develop the leaders underneath you, and deliver measurable improvements rather than simply introduce new processes.
The goal is straightforward: as the company grows, Technology Operations should become more reliable, resilient and scalable while requiring less manual coordination, less operational toil and less executive intervention.
What you will do
Lead the transformation of Technology Operations across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence, moving the organization from reactive operations toward ownership, automation, self-service and measurable outcomes.
Define the Technology Operations strategy, target operating model, organizational structure, responsibilities, priorities and transformation roadmap.
Lead multiple established technology functions through Heads, Leads and other managers, creating clear accountability and developing leaders who can operate with increasing autonomy.
Lead the evolution of DevOps toward a Platform Engineering model that reduces operational toil, increases self-service and improves developer productivity while maintaining reliability and security.
Partner with Engineering to establish a "you build it, you own it" model, where product teams retain ownership of their services in production while Technology Operations provides the platform, standards, tooling and operational framework that enable them to operate reliably.
Develop Service Management toward Operational Excellence: strengthen service ownership, incident and problem management, introduce risk-based change governance, reduce unnecessary manual controls, and use operational data to eliminate systemic causes of failures.
Transform Corporate IT toward a secure, automated employee technology model, with strong identity and access lifecycle management, device management, governance and employee self-service.
Continuously assess the current organization, technology landscape and operating model, identify structural and operational gaps, and turn them into concrete improvement initiatives.
Improve the maturity, reliability, scalability and efficiency of technology operations supporting production-critical systems.
Define meaningful operational metrics and use them to identify systemic problems, measure transformation outcomes and drive improvements rather than simply report performance.
Own the Technology Operations contribution to digital operational resilience, including ICT business continuity, disaster recovery, backup and restoration, resilience testing, recovery objectives, crisis readiness, and remediation of findings from incidents and resilience exercises.
Partner with Security, Risk and Compliance to maintain an effective ICT risk management and control environment, including technology risk identification, critical service dependencies, ICT third-party risk, resilience testing, audit readiness and regulatory remediation.
Ensure operational and technology risks are identified early, understood, prioritized and addressed appropriately.
Support the company through audits, certifications, regulatory requirements and other controls relevant to financial and technology organizations.
Own and optimize budgets, technology vendors, infrastructure investments and external partnerships within the function.
Partner closely with Engineering, Security, Risk, Compliance, Product, Finance and other business functions.
Represent Technology Operations in cross-functional and executive discussions and communicate complex technology and operational topics clearly to different audiences.
Help prepare the technology organization for the next stage of the company's growth, including increasingly complex enterprise customers, new products and a larger engineering organization.
What we are looking for
Significant leadership experience in Technology Operations, IT Operations, Infrastructure & Operations, Platform/Production Operations, Platform Engineering or a comparable technology function.
Experience as a manager of managers, with responsibility for several teams or functions through Heads, Engineering Managers, Team Leads or equivalent leadership roles.
Previous experience as a Technology Director, VP/Head of Technology Operations, Platform/Infrastructure leader or in a comparable senior role within a product engineering organization is highly relevant.
Proven examples of significant organizational or technology transformation: changing operating models, building or restructuring functions, introducing new capabilities, increasing operational maturity, scaling teams or materially changing how technology organizations operate.
Experience leading or evolving DevOps, SRE or infrastructure capabilities toward Platform Engineering, including developer self-service, automation and reduction of operational toil.
Strong understanding of modern production ownership models and the relationship between Platform Engineering and product engineering teams.
Experience with production-critical systems where availability, reliability, security and operational failures have direct business impact.
Experience with IT and Service Management in modern product/engineering environments, including incident, problem and change management.
Experience transforming Corporate IT or employee technology environments, including identity/access lifecycle, endpoint/device management, automation, governance and employee self-service.
Practical experience with business continuity, disaster recovery and operational resilience in production-critical environments, including BIA, RTO/RPO, backup and restoration, resilience testing and remediation.
Experience working with Security, Risk and Compliance teams and managing technology and operational risks.
Exposure to audits, certifications, regulatory requirements and operational controls relevant to financial institutions or other regulated environments.
Working knowledge of regulatory frameworks relevant to technology operations in financial services, such as DORA, and the ability to translate regulatory requirements into pragmatic engineering and operational controls, is a plus.
Experience managing budgets, vendors, contracts and technology investments.
Ability to operate effectively when requirements, organizational boundaries or the final solution are not yet fully defined.
Track record of developing leaders and building teams that can operate without constant escalation or executive intervention.
Ability to move between strategic topics and operational problems: understand what requires executive attention, delegate what should be owned by your leaders, and personally step in when the situation requires it.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to work effectively with technical teams, senior business stakeholders and executive leadership.
Experience in fintech, payments, banking, financial infrastructure or another regulated and production-critical technology environment would be highly valuable.
How we think about this role
We are not looking for a traditional IT or infrastructure leader whose primary focus is maintaining existing systems and following established processes.
We need someone who is comfortable entering an environment where not everything has already been defined — and who sees that ambiguity as part of the mandate.
You should be able to understand how the organization actually operates today, distinguish symptoms from systemic problems, bring the right people together, make decisions with incomplete information, and turn those decisions into measurable organizational and technology improvements.
You will not be expected to solve every problem personally. A major part of your role will be to build strong Heads and Leads who can own their areas independently, while you focus on the most important organizational, strategic and cross-functional challenges.
At the same time, limited resources, legacy approaches or imperfect processes should be constraints to work with — not reasons why progress cannot happen.

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect to see measurable movement in addition to plans:
reduced recurring operational toil;
increasing developer and employee self-service;
stronger and clearer service ownership;
fewer repeated incidents and systemic operational failures;
more risk-based and automated change management;

stronger operational resilience and risk management;

Success means the organization requires less manual coordination and executive intervention while becoming more reliable, resilient, faster and more scalable.

Coinspaid Dev emerges as an independent engineering brand with a straightforward mission: to advance blockchain infrastructure engineering and contribute practical expertise back to the industry. The structure is new. The experience behind it is not.
Director of Technology Operations
We are building the next operating model for a ~150-person technology organization behind production-critical financial infrastructure.
We are looking for a Director of Technology Operations to lead that transformation.

This is not a traditional infrastructure or IT operations role. The mandate is to evolve Technology Operations from a primarily reactive model toward a scalable organization built around clear ownership, platform engineering, automation, self-service, operational excellence, resilience and measurable outcomes.

You will initially lead several established technology functions through their existing Heads and Leads, with approximately 25 people across Platform/DevOps, Corporate IT and Operational Excellence. The mandate is broader than the initial team size: you will help shape the operating model of a ~150-person technology organization and build capabilities designed to scale significantly beyond today's structure.

Your responsibility will go beyond managing these teams. You will help shape how the broader technology organization operates: how production services are owned, how incidents and changes are managed, how engineers consume infrastructure capabilities, how operational risks are identified, and how recurring manual work is systematically eliminated.

A major part of the role is organizational transformation. We expect you to assess the current model, challenge it where necessary, define the target state, develop the leaders underneath you, and deliver measurable improvements rather than simply introduce new processes.

The goal is straightforward: as the company grows, Technology Operations should become more reliable, resilient and scalable while requiring less manual coordination, less operational toil and less executive intervention.

Define the Technology Operations strategy, target operating model, organizational structure, responsibilities, priorities and transformation roadmap.
Lead multiple established technology functions through Heads, Leads and other managers, creating clear accountability and developing leaders who can operate with increasing autonomy.
Lead the evolution of DevOps toward a Platform Engineering model that reduces operational toil, increases self-service and improves developer productivity while maintaining reliability and security.

Partner with Engineering to establish a "you build it, you own it" model, where product teams retain ownership of their services in production while Technology Operations provides the platform, standards, tooling and operational framework that enable them to operate reliably.

jobs.title: VP, Product Management
jobs.text:
The VP, Product Management role will lead the product strategy for several of eMoney's foundational platform capabilities, including data aggregation, APIs, strategic integrations and the evolution of our platform for an AI-native future. This is a critical leadership role at the intersection of product, technology, data and AI. This role will lead a team responsible for products and capabilities that enable eMoney's platform to connect to financial data sources, enterprise customers, strategic partners and increasingly to AI applications and agents. A key priority will be helping eMoney determine how our platform should safely and strategically expose data and planning capabilities to AI agents, including emerging technologies such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), while protecting eMoney's differentiated planning intelligence and intellectual property. This role is an opportunity to shape a foundational component of eMoney's AI strategy and help establish the platform as a trusted source of financial data and planning intelligence within the emerging AI ecosystem.
Job Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Leadership
Bring deep product leadership experience across enterprise platforms, APIs, data products and integrations, combined with a strong understanding of emerging AI technologies and agentic architectures.
• Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for eMoney's Platform, Data, APIs and AI capabilities.
• Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing team of Product Managers and product leaders.
• Partner closely with executive leadership to identify opportunities to strengthen eMoney's platform differentiation and competitive position.
• Establish clear product metrics and accountability for business, customer and platform outcomes.
• This role will work with Technology Leadership to determine how these requirements are technically implemented, while maintaining Product accountability for what capabilities should be exposed and under what conditions.
Data Aggregation & Data Products
Lead product strategy for eMoney's data aggregation capabilities and related customer experiences.
• Partner with Technology and Data leadership to ensure the platform is increasingly prepared for AI-driven use cases.
• Identify opportunities to leverage eMoney's data foundation as a strategic differentiator.
AI Platform & Agentic AI
Define eMoney's product strategy for AI platform connectivity and agentic experiences.
• Establish the product strategy and requirements for MCP and other emerging AI connectivity standards.
• Ensure APIs evolve from traditional application integrations toward an architecture capable of supporting AI applications and agent integrations.
• Establish clear product requirements for authentication, authorization, entitlements, data access, auditability and enterprise governance.
• Define appropriate boundaries between customer-accessible data and eMoney's proprietary planning intelligence.
• Ensure AI connectivity supports eMoney's broader Always-On Planning strategy.
• Partner with AI Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Legal and Compliance leaders to establish appropriate AI governance.
Requirements
12+ years of progressive Product Management experience, with significant experience leading enterprise fintech products.
• Proven experience leading product organizations at the VP or equivalent senior leadership level.
• Deep experience with platform products, APIs, data products, and enterprise integrations.
• Experience defining product strategy for complex technology platforms used by large enterprise customers.
• Strong understanding of modern cloud architectures, APIs, data platforms and enterprise
integration patterns.
Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with CTO, Engineering and Architecture leaders.
• Experience translating complex technology capabilities into clear customer and business value.
AI / Emerging Technology Experience
Strong understanding of generative AI, AI platforms and emerging agentic architectures.
• Experience defining products or platforms that incorporate AI, intelligent workflows or AI agents.
• Understanding of AI tool/function calling, agent orchestration, APIs and emerging AI connectivity standards such as MCP.
• Ability to assess emerging technologies and translate them into practical product strategies.
• Understanding of the data, security, governance and intellectual-property implications of exposing enterprise capabilities to AI systems.
Skills
The role will be expected to operate effectively at both the strategic executive level and the detailed product-definition level.
• Strong executive communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills.
• Experience managing and developing senior Product leaders and building high-performing product organizations.
The salary range for this position is $227,000 - $282,000; commensurate salary to be determined based on skills, professional background and expertise. This position is also eligible, pursuant to applicable eMoney policies, for the annual bonus program, retirement contributions, health insurance, sick leave, parental leave and paid time off.
At eMoney, we’re powering what’s possible in financial planning. Our mission is to help people talk about money and make more informed financial decisions. Through our comprehensive financial planning solutions, we help advisors bring clarity to complex decisions and deliver more personalized guidance.
Today, eMoney supports more than 138,000 financial professionals who guide the financial lives of over 7 million end clients. That reach gives every member of our team the opportunity to contribute to work that makes a meaningful, lasting impact.
We’re equally committed to powering what’s possible for our people. We foster an inclusive, people-first culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and employees are supported in doing their best work.
eMoney is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Product
jobs.text:
Who We Are
For over 25 years, we have been dedicated to assisting organizations in delivering critical communications with precision, security, and efficiency through innovative technology, omnichannel communication, and a steadfast commitment to excellence. Serving more than 1,500 clients across a variety of industries, we develop communication solutions that empower businesses to progress.
What truly distinguishes us is our people. We are cultivating a culture that fosters growth, encourages contribution, and enables you to make a significant impact. Here, you are empowered to introduce new ideas, tackle meaningful challenges, and help shape the future of how organizations engage with their customers.
If you are seeking to elevate your career and join a team that is pioneering tech-enabled solutions, we would be delighted to meet you.
Doxim's Next Senior Vice President, Product.
The Senior Vice President, Product is the executive responsible for transforming Doxim's enterprise product strategy, portfolio, and product organization in anticipation of significant regulatory shifts and evolving consumer habits.
Reporting directly to the CEO, this leader guides Product Directors and Product Managers and partners with Executive Leadership to translate market change into focused investment, disciplined execution, stronger business performance, sustained customer value, and long-term growth.
This role can be performed remotely from the United States or Canada.
Responsibilities
Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing product organization, build succession plans and a culture of customer focus, accountability, evidence-based decisions, and continuous learning.
Partner with the CEO and Executive Leadership to define and communicate the enterprise product vision, strategy, multi-year roadmap, and execution plans.
Plan, coordinate, and direct product management activities to support company financial objectives, including Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR), one-time or service revenue, personnel costs, operating expenses, and EBITDA.
Own portfolio priorities and product investment tradeoffs, using customer, market, financial, operational, and product data to balance growth, retention, customer value, risk, technical sustainability, and delivery capacity.
Set and achieve product goals and KPIs and hold leaders accountable for financial, operational, customer, product, and team performance.
Establish a consistent product operating model, policies, standards, tools, and processes across discovery, prioritization, roadmap planning, lifecycle management, launch readiness, and performance review; lead related improvements and change management.
Partner with R&D, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Client Success, Finance, and other functions to align priorities, capacity, dependencies, and go-to-market execution.
Build trusted relationships with customers and market analysts, resolve product-related business issues, and ensure market and customer insights inform priorities.
Drive growth and commercialization strategies that improve adoption, retention, market position, and business results.
Communicate product decisions, results, progress, and risks clearly to the Board, Executive Leadership, product teams, customers, and other stakeholders.
Perform the following at an EXPERT level:
Core Skills
Analytical and critical thinking, sound judgment, and effective decision-making under uncertainty.
Clear executive, Board, customer, and organization-wide communication and presentations.
Strong planning and prioritization, with the adaptability and autonomy to lead in a fast-paced environment.
Business Acumen
Deep product management expertise and understanding of its interdependencies with R&D, Operations, go-to-market functions, Finance, Security, Privacy, and Compliance.
Strong financial and commercial judgment across budgeting, product investment, business cases, partner management, and workforce planning.
Ability to align enterprise priorities and translate product strategy into disciplined, accountable portfolio execution.
Leadership Acumen
Lead, motivate, coach, and develop large, multi-level teams and senior leaders.
Build productive relationships, manage conflict, and influence effectively across functions and levels.
Make clear, company-first enterprise tradeoffs while balancing a 6- to 18-month operating outlook with multi-year product direction.
Education & Certifications
Bachelor's degree in business, technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience; advanced degree preferred.
Working knowledge of HR practices and labor-law requirements applicable to leading a multi-jurisdictional organization.
System Knowledge
Advanced proficiency with executive reporting, product planning, portfolio management, analytics, customer research, and collaboration tools such as Jira, Confluence, Aha!, or similar platforms.
Strong understanding of software delivery, agile and product operating models, product lifecycle and go-to-market execution, and enterprise systems supporting financial, workforce, and performance reporting.
Recommended Years of Experience
15-18 years in product management, technology, customer communications, or a related domain, or equivalent relevant Doxim experience.
10-12 years managing people, including senior leaders and multi-functional teams, with demonstrated mastery leading multiple products or disciplines in customer communications, B2B SaaS, or a similarly complex technology organization.
Travel
10-50%, mostly across North America. Some international travel may be required.
Why Doxim?
Work Environment That Suits You: Our opportunities come in all shapes and sizes; from fully remote, to in-office, to hybrid; across North America, South Africa, and Europe.
Benefits That Fit: As of Day 1 of employment, our flexible benefit options have you covered from healthcare to employer-matched retirement savings and everything in between.
Growth That Excites: We are passionate about nurturing talent from within so this won’t be just a job – it will be a journey.
Time Off That Recharges: Take the breaks you deserve with our generous PTO policy designed to help you rest, reset, and return at your best.
Refer & Reap the Rewards: Love working at Doxim? When you refer talented people to join us, you’ll earn a bonus through our Employee Referral Program. Great people know great people!
Thank you for your interest in Doxim! Due to the volume of applications we receive, only selected candidates will be contacted.
Website -
Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity during your job search. Doxim will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment, or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied directly to one of our open roles. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video call or in-person interview, with a Doxim Talent Acquisition team member and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the hiring process. We will only reach out from @doxim.com email address; no other email addresses will be used. Remain vigilant and if you think you are a victim of an employment scam, please contact your local law enforcement agency.

Own portfolio priorities and product investment tradeoffs, using customer, market, financial, operational, and product data to balance growth, retention, customer value, risk, technical sustainability, and delivery capacity.
Set and achieve product goals and KPIs and hold leaders accountable for financial, operational, customer, product, and team performance.

Establish a consistent product operating model, policies, standards, tools, and processes across discovery, prioritization, roadmap planning, lifecycle management, launch readiness, and performance review; lead related improvements and change management.
Partner with R&D, Operations, Sales, Marketing, Client Success, Finance, and other functions to align priorities, capacity, dependencies, and go-to-market execution.
Build trusted relationships with customers and market analysts, resolve product-related business issues, and ensure market and customer insights inform priorities.
Drive growth and commercialization strategies that improve adoption, retention, market position, and business results.
Communicate product decisions, results, progress, and risks clearly to the Board, Executive Leadership, product teams, customers, and other stakeholders.

Core Skills

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Management, Growth & Commercialization
jobs.text:
About Us:
insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.
Job Description:
This senior leadership role will drive new revenue growth and commercialization across insightsoftware's product portfolio for the Office of the CFO. You will own the strategy and execution for launching new products and new revenue streams, including the monetization of AI-enabled capabilities, and drive them from concept to material annual recurring revenue. As the portfolio undergoes a major brand and platform transformation toward a unified, AI-native experience, this leader ensures that new capabilities convert to durable, profitable revenue.
This leader pairs deep product judgment with commercial rigor across pricing and packaging, go-to-market design, and disciplined launch execution. The ideal candidate is fluent in applying AI both to the products we ship and to the way the team works, has a track record of standing up new revenue streams, and reports performance to executive leadership and the board. They must exude an unrelenting passion for our customer experience, strong financial acumen, and an entrepreneurial spirit.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Ownership and accountability for the strategy, P&L, and commercialization plan for new products and new revenue streams across the portfolio.
Define monetization models, pricing, and packaging for new and AI-enabled capabilities, with explicit measures for genuinely monetized revenue.
Own the launch Go/No-Go gate and pricing validation, and the post-launch growth plan that scales adoption into revenue.
Build the business cases for new products, features, and inorganic opportunities, and lead build, buy, and partner decisions.
Set the standard for AI fluency across the team, using AI to compress cycle time across discovery, delivery, and go-to-market.
Work closely and collaboratively with marketing, sales, customer success, and services to execute acquisition, retention, and expansion strategies and meet revenue targets.
Maintain a competitive market overview to identify white spaces, pricing opportunities, and strategic threats.
Report new-revenue and commercialization performance to executive leadership and the board, including ARR, win rates, attach, and adoption.
Assess risks and dependencies across product, engineering, and go-to-market functions and provide guidance to Business Unit leadership.
KEY AREAS OF FOCUS:
NEW REVENUE STREAM LAUNCH
Identifies, validates, and launches new revenue streams, owning the offer, pricing, packaging, and the path from first dollar to scaled ARR.
Designs and runs the commercialization motion, including offer and SKU design, sales enablement, and adoption tracking, so new capabilities reliably convert to revenue.
Establishes the measures that separate genuinely monetized revenue from bundled or attributed revenue, and reports against them.
AI MONETIZATION AND AI-NATIVE PRODUCT
Builds the business case and operating model for monetizing AI-enabled capabilities, balancing customer value, willingness to pay, and cost to serve.
Shapes an AI-native product strategy, partnering with engineering and platform leaders on the data, evaluation, and governance foundations required to ship trustworthy AI.
Defines how AI value is measured and connects AI investment to adoption and revenue.
PRODUCT COMMERCIALIZATION AND GO-TO-MARKET
Owns pricing and packaging validation at launch and the cross-functional readiness required for a successful release.
Manages across channels to define and deliver product performance goals (for example revenue, attach, and customer experience).
Leverages enterprise platforms and capabilities to improve speed to market and drive development and ongoing support cost efficiencies.
PRODUCT STRATEGY, VISION, AND PLANNING
Pulls from market and competitive insights, customer needs, and business priorities to shape the portfolio's growth strategy and investment areas.
Aligns the strategy with cross-functional stakeholders to shape the roadmap and success measures.
Understands the product technical architecture and the economics of technical investments, for example buy vs. build and total cost of ownership.
TEAM LEADERSHIP
Build and lead a high-performing team across product management and product marketing, providing mentorship, guidance, and support.
Foster a culture of commercial rigor, innovation, and disciplined use of AI in everyday work.
Identify and develop talent, ensuring the team has the skills and resources needed to hit revenue objectives.
STAKEHOLDER COLLABORATION
Collaborate closely with executive leadership, engineering, marketing, sales, and customer success to ensure alignment on revenue objectives.
Act as a trusted advisor to Business Unit leadership and the board on commercialization and new revenue.
Qualifications
Experience owning direct P&L responsibility for a product line, business unit, or division within a B2B software company.
10+ years of experience in product management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role focused on growth, monetization, or commercialization.
Demonstrated success launching new products and new revenue streams and scaling them to material ARR, including subscription and usage-based or AI-enabled monetization.
Strong pricing and packaging expertise, with a track record of pricing decisions that improved attach, conversion, or margin.
Demonstrated AI fluency: has used AI to improve product and team outcomes, and has shipped or monetized AI-enabled capabilities.
Bachelor's degree in business, economics, or a related field. An MBA or similar advanced degree is preferred.
Excellent leadership, communication, and collaboration skills in a complex, matrixed, global software environment.
Analytical, data-driven mindset with strong financial acumen, attention to detail, and prioritization skills.
The salary range in United States of America for this position is 212,000.00 to 265,000.00 USD Annual.
For sales roles, this range includes the commission target. For non-sales roles, this is a base salary only range; additional bonus eligibility may apply.
Your specific offer within this range will be determined by your skills, experience, and qualifications.
We are committed to pay transparency and fair compensation practices. If you have questions about our compensation approach, please don't hesitate to ask during the interview process.
Additional Information
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Learn more about our high-energy, high-performance global team: Work With Us

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.
