jobs.title: Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations
jobs.text:
Career-defining. Life-changing.
At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career
About This Role:
The Senior Director, Global Infrastructure Technology & Operations will lead iRhythm’s enterprise infrastructure strategy, architecture, operations, and modernization across cloud, networking, data center and hardware, end-user computing, and security infrastructure. This role will ensure that iRhythm’s technology foundation is resilient, secure, compliant, and scalable enough to support 24/7 clinical operations, manufacturing, global commercial growth, and the company’s expanding data and AI capabilities. This senior leadership role combines executive leadership, hands-on technical depth, organizational development, financial stewardship, and close partnership with the Chief Data Officer and head of IT, CISO, Quality/Regulatory, Engineering, and business leaders. The role works hand in hand with the CISO: Security defines the requirements and provides oversight, while Infrastructure delivers and operates the platforms, controls, and services that enable the business.
What You Will Be Doing
Strategy & Leadership
Define and execute a multi-year enterprise infrastructure strategy and roadmap aligned to iRhythm’s business, clinical, data, and AI objectives.
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure organization across cloud, network, operations, end-user services, and managed service partners.
Establish infrastructure architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and operating models across business units and geographies.
Serve as the senior infrastructure advisor to executive leadership, translating strategy, risk, investment, and performance into business terms.
Cloud Infrastructure
Own the enterprise multi-cloud strategy across AWS, GCP, Azure, and Microsoft 365, including landing zones, account and project structure, identity integration, and guardrails.
Lead cloud platform engineering using Infrastructure as Code, automation, infrastructure CI/CD, and policy-as-code.
Drive FinOps practices, including cost visibility, optimization, reserved-capacity strategy, and chargeback/showback.
Enable modern data and AI platforms—including Snowflake, enterprise AI and search platforms, and ML/GPU workloads—with secure, scalable, well-governed infrastructure and private connectivity patterns.
Lead workload migration and modernization from on-premises environments to cloud where appropriate.
Networking & Connectivity
Own enterprise network architecture across corporate offices, clinical and IDTF sites, manufacturing facilities, data centers, and cloud environments, including LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, and load balancing.
Design secure hybrid and multi-cloud connectivity using Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, and transit architectures.
Implement network segmentation and isolation for manufacturing/OT and clinical environments in alignment with Zero Trust principles.
Ensure high availability, performance monitoring, and capacity planning for mission-critical clinical and patient-facing services.
Data Center, Hardware & End-User Computing
Oversee on-premises and colocation data centers, compute, storage, backup, and virtualization platforms, including lifecycle management and rationalization.
Own the hardware asset lifecycle, including procurement, standards, refresh cycles, and secure disposal.
Lead end-user computing across endpoints, MDM, collaboration tools, service desk, and conference room technology to deliver a secure and productive employee experience.
Support infrastructure for manufacturing sites and clinical operations, including device and equipment connectivity where applicable.
Security Infrastructure
Implement, operate, and maintain infrastructure security controls in alignment with the security strategy, policies, and standards set by the CISO.
Own the day-to-day engineering and operation of network and platform security technologies such as firewalls, WAF, proxies/SASE, NAC, and VPN, with the CISO’s team defining requirements, configuration standards, and monitoring.
Embed security by design across infrastructure through hardening baselines, secure configurations, and Infrastructure-as-Code guardrails.
Own timely vulnerability remediation and patching across infrastructure assets, meeting SLAs defined by the Security team.
Operate identity and directory infrastructure, including SSO, MFA, and directory services, in support of the CISO-led Zero Trust and identity roadmap.
Partner with the CISO’s organization during security incidents by providing infrastructure expertise, containment, remediation, logs, telemetry, and integrations needed for detection and response.
Compliance, Quality & Regulated Environments
Ensure infrastructure meets applicable regulatory and compliance obligations, including FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, and other international requirements.
Partner with the CISO, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain infrastructure controls and evidence for audits, with Security owning the control framework and this role owning control execution for infrastructure.
Support computer system validation (CSV/CSA) for GxP-relevant infrastructure, along with change control and audit readiness.
Lead infrastructure responses during internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
Protect patient health information through appropriate data residency, encryption, access controls, and logging.
Resilience, Operations & Service Management
Own business continuity and disaster recovery for infrastructure, with defined RTO/RPO targets for clinical and business-critical systems and regular DR testing.
Build observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using SRE principles, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services.
Mature ITSM processes for incident, problem, change, and configuration management using ITIL-aligned practices and tools such as ServiceNow.
Drive automation to reduce toil and improve reliability, speed, and consistency.
Vendor & Financial Management
Own the infrastructure budget across OpEx and CapEx, including forecasting, business cases, and cost optimization.
Manage strategic vendor, cloud provider, telecom, and managed service relationships, including contract negotiation and performance management.
Evaluate emerging technologies and make build, buy, or partner recommendations.
Technology Environment
Our environment spans enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, end-user computing, data, AI, and regulated clinical and manufacturing systems. Experience with every named technology is not required.
Cloud and platform: AWS, GCP, Azure, Microsoft 365, landing zones, Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, policy-as-code, containers, virtualization, and GPU infrastructure.
Netorking and connectivity: LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, load balancing, Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, transit architectures, NAC, firewalls, and WAF.
Data, AI, and analytics infrastructure: Snowflake, Databricks, enterprise AI and search platforms, ML/GPU workloads, private connectivity, and governed data products.
Security and identity: SSO, MFA, directory services, Zero Trust, endpoint management, vulnerability management, security telemetry, logging, and incident response integrations.
Operations and service management: observability, monitoring, SRE practices, SLOs, error budgets, backup and recovery, ServiceNow, ITIL, and disaster recovery testing.
Enterprise integrations and ecosystems: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Salesforce, QAD, Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and other business and clinical platforms.
Required Qualifications
15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, including 7+ years leading multi-disciplinary infrastructure teams at the director level or above.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven strength in ability to balance strategic vision with execution excellence, developing organizational capability while creating the capacity, accountability, and focus needed to consistently deliver on business and technology priorities.
Deep hands-on and architectural expertise in at least one major cloud platform, preferably AWS and/or GCP, with experience running multi-cloud and hybrid environments.
Strong background in enterprise networking and hands-on experience engineering and operating security infrastructure in partnership with a security organization.
Proven experience operating infrastructure in a regulated industry such as medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or financial services.
Working knowledge of FDA regulations, including 21 CFR Part 11 and 21 CFR Part 820, as well as frameworks such as HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.
Track record of leading large-scale transformation programs, including cloud migration, data center consolidation, network modernization, or comparable enterprise initiatives.
Experience owning budgets of meaningful scale and managing strategic technology, cloud, telecom, and managed service vendors.
Excellent executive communication and influencing skills and the ability to translate technical risk, resilience, and investment into business outcomes.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in a medical device, digital health, or connected-device company supporting 24/7 clinical services.
Experience supporting manufacturing or OT networks and familiarity with IEC 62443 or similar OT security practices.
Familiarity with infrastructure for data and AI platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, ML/GPU workloads, and enterprise AI tools.
Global infrastructure experience across the United States, United Kingdom/Europe, and Asia-Pacific, including data residency requirements.
Certifications such as AWS or GCP Professional Architect, CCIE/CCNP,
MBA or advanced degree.
Location:
Remote - US
Actual compensation may vary depending on job-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.
Estimated Pay Range
$222,000.00 - $288,000.00

Own the day-to-day engineering and operation of network and platform security technologies such as firewalls, WAF, proxies/SASE, NAC, and VPN, with the CISO’s team defining requirements, configuration standards, and monitoring.
Embed security by design across infrastructure through hardening baselines, secure configurations, and Infrastructure-as-Code guardrails.
Own timely vulnerability remediation and patching across infrastructure assets, meeting SLAs defined by the Security team.
Operate identity and directory infrastructure, including SSO, MFA, and directory services, in support of the CISO-led Zero Trust and identity roadmap.
Partner with the CISO’s organization during security incidents by providing infrastructure expertise, containment, remediation, logs, telemetry, and integrations needed for detection and response.

blocks.text: Compliance, Quality & Regulated Environments

items: Ensure infrastructure meets applicable regulatory and compliance obligations, including FDA QMSR (21 CFR Part 820), 21 CFR Part 11, HIPAA/HITECH, SOC 2, ISO 13485, ISO 27001, GDPR/UK GDPR, and other international requirements.

Partner with the CISO, Quality, and Regulatory teams to maintain infrastructure controls and evidence for audits, with Security owning the control framework and this role owning control execution for infrastructure.
Support computer system validation (CSV/CSA) for GxP-relevant infrastructure, along with change control and audit readiness.
Lead infrastructure responses during internal, customer, and regulatory audits.
Protect patient health information through appropriate data residency, encryption, access controls, and logging.

blocks.text: Resilience, Operations & Service Management

items: Own business continuity and disaster recovery for infrastructure, with defined RTO/RPO targets for clinical and business-critical systems and regular DR testing.
Build observability, monitoring, and alerting practices using SRE principles, SLOs, and error budgets for critical services.
Mature ITSM processes for incident, problem, change, and configuration management using ITIL-aligned practices and tools such as ServiceNow.
Drive automation to reduce toil and improve reliability, speed, and consistency.

blocks.text: Vendor & Financial Management

items: Own the infrastructure budget across OpEx and CapEx, including forecasting, business cases, and cost optimization.
Manage strategic vendor, cloud provider, telecom, and managed service relationships, including contract negotiation and performance management.
Evaluate emerging technologies and make build, buy, or partner recommendations.

blocks.text: Technology Environment

Our environment spans enterprise infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, end-user computing, data, AI, and regulated clinical and manufacturing systems. Experience with every named technology is not required.

items: Cloud and platform: AWS, GCP, Azure, Microsoft 365, landing zones, Terraform or similar Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, policy-as-code, containers, virtualization, and GPU infrastructure.
Netorking and connectivity: LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, Wi-Fi, SASE, DNS, load balancing, Direct Connect, Interconnect, private endpoints, VPN, transit architectures, NAC, firewalls, and WAF.
Data, AI, and analytics infrastructure: Snowflake, Databricks, enterprise AI and search platforms, ML/GPU workloads, private connectivity, and governed data products.
Security and identity: SSO, MFA, directory services, Zero Trust, endpoint management, vulnerability management, security telemetry, logging, and incident response integrations.
Operations and service management: observability, monitoring, SRE practices, SLOs, error budgets, backup and recovery, ServiceNow, ITIL, and disaster recovery testing.
Enterprise integrations and ecosystems: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Salesforce, QAD, Workday, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Teams, and other business and clinical platforms.

blocks.text: Required Qualifications

items: 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, including 7+ years leading multi-disciplinary infrastructure teams at the director level or above.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Proven strength in ability to balance strategic vision with execution excellence, developing organizational capability while creating the capacity, accountability, and focus needed to consistently deliver on business and technology priorities.
Deep hands-on and architectural expertise in at least one major cloud platform, preferably AWS and/or GCP, with experience running multi-cloud and hybrid environments.
Strong background in enterprise networking and hands-on experience engineering and operating security infrastructure in partnership with a security organization.
Proven experience operating infrastructure in a regulated industry such as medical devices, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare, or financial services.
Working knowledge of FDA regulations, including 21 CFR Part 11 and 21 CFR Part 820, as well as frameworks such as HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001, and NIST CSF.
Track record of leading large-scale transformation programs, including cloud migration, data center consolidation, network modernization, or comparable enterprise initiatives.
Experience owning budgets of meaningful scale and managing strategic technology, cloud, telecom, and managed service vendors.
Excellent executive communication and influencing skills and the ability to translate technical risk, resilience, and investment into business outcomes.

blocks.text: Preferred Qualifications

items: Experience in a medical device, digital health, or connected-device company supporting 24/7 clinical services.
Experience supporting manufacturing or OT networks and familiarity with IEC 62443 or similar OT security practices.
Familiarity with infrastructure for data and AI platforms, including Snowflake, Databricks, ML/GPU workloads, and enterprise AI tools.
Global infrastructure experience across the United States, United Kingdom/Europe, and Asia-Pacific, including data residency requirements.
Certifications such as AWS or GCP Professional Architect, CCIE/CCNP,
MBA or advanced degree.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Buscamos una persona para incorporarse como Vice President of Engineering y liderar la estrategia tecnológica, la organización de ingeniería y la evolución de nuestros productos digitales.
La posición tendrá un papel clave en la definición de la visión técnica, el escalado de los equipos y la construcción de una cultura de alto rendimiento, colaboración y mejora continua. Trabajarás estrechamente con Product, Business y otros equipos directivos en un entorno internacional y de rápido crecimiento.
Responsabilidades
Definir y ejecutar la estrategia de ingeniería en alineación con los objetivos de negocio y producto.
Liderar, desarrollar y hacer crecer equipos multidisciplinares de ingeniería, incluyendo Engineering Managers, Tech Leads y perfiles técnicos especializados.
Establecer una visión tecnológica clara, garantizando la escalabilidad, seguridad, fiabilidad y mantenibilidad de la plataforma.
Impulsar buenas prácticas de desarrollo de software, arquitectura, testing, observabilidad, DevOps y entrega continua.
Garantizar la calidad y previsibilidad de la entrega, mejorando los procesos de planificación, priorización y seguimiento de proyectos.
Colaborar con Product, Design, Data, Operations y el equipo directivo para convertir las necesidades de negocio en soluciones tecnológicas efectivas.
Participar en decisiones estratégicas relacionadas con arquitectura, tecnología, inversión, contratación y organización de equipos.
Promover una cultura de ownership, innovación, transparencia y excelencia técnica.
Identificar riesgos técnicos y operativos, definiendo planes de mitigación y mejora a medio y largo plazo.
Representar la función de ingeniería ante stakeholders internos, partners y otros interlocutores relevantes.
Requisitos
Experiencia sólida liderando organizaciones de ingeniería en posiciones como VP of Engineering, Head of Engineering, Engineering Director o similares.
Trayectoria demostrable en el desarrollo y escalado de productos digitales, plataformas SaaS o entornos tecnológicos complejos.
Experiencia gestionando equipos distribuidos y organizaciones en crecimiento.
Conocimientos profundos de arquitectura de software, desarrollo de producto, cloud computing, DevOps y prácticas modernas de ingeniería.
Capacidad para conectar la estrategia tecnológica con los objetivos comerciales y las necesidades de los clientes.
Experiencia contratando, desarrollando y reteniendo talento técnico.
Excelentes habilidades de liderazgo, comunicación y gestión de stakeholders.
Capacidad para tomar decisiones complejas, priorizar de forma efectiva y trabajar con autonomía.
Orientación a resultados, pensamiento estratégico y enfoque práctico para resolver problemas.
Inglés profesional fluido para trabajar en un entorno internacional. El español u otros idiomas serán valorados positivamente.
Qué encontrarás
Una posición estratégica con impacto directo en la evolución del producto y del negocio.
La oportunidad de construir y desarrollar una organización de ingeniería de alto nivel.
Un entorno internacional, colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.
Autonomía para definir procesos, equipos y prioridades tecnológicas.
Colaboración cercana con el equipo directivo y las principales áreas de la compañía.
Un proyecto con posibilidades reales de crecimiento profesional y transformación tecnológica.
Qué buscamos
Buscamos una persona líder, estratégica y cercana, capaz de combinar una sólida visión técnica con excelentes habilidades de gestión. Alguien que disfrute construyendo equipos, desarrollando talento y creando las condiciones necesarias para que la ingeniería genere un impacto sostenible en el negocio.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, KYX
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members across UK and India
Over $300 million raised in funding
Over 2,800 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind KYX (KYC and KYB). Our vision for KYX is a world where every genuine business, business owner, their team, and everyone connected to them, onboards to Tide in minutes, unlocks the products they need as they grow, and never has to think twice about their data, while we identify bad actors, stop them at the door, continuously review their activity and off-board them the moment they're found.
You will be accountable for engineering strategy, organisation and execution across three domains. Onboarding KYX covers identity and access for registration and login, due diligence policy execution and vendor orchestration across the onboarding journey, and the risk scoring and agentic AI that assesses new applicants. Continuous KYX covers ongoing due diligence through periodic and event-triggered reviews, and how business owners bring their own team members onto their account. Risk Scoring is the KYX Scoring & ML team whose models power decisions across both domains.
This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, member-facing conversion and applied AI. KYX Ops and KYX Policy set the rules you build for, Second Line of Defence sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise onboarding conversion and due diligence quality while driving the cost of KYX servicing per member down, and who can scale agentic solutions into workflows where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.
As Director of Engineering, KYX you will
Own the engineering strategy and organisation for KYX, from onboarding identity, access and due diligence through continuous monitoring to risk scoring, unifying leadership that today sits in separate Onboarding and Continuous KYX lines.
Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science and ML engineering, distributed across Hyderabad, Delhi, Sofia, Belgrade, Bucharest and Vilnius.
Own KYX Scoring & ML as a shared capability serving both onboarding and ongoing decisioning, including the model lifecycle end to end from development through backtesting and staged rollout to production monitoring.
Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, from onboarding risk scoring through to screening, review and verification, in line with Tide's agentic governance framework.
Work with KYX Ops, KYX Policy, Second Line of Defence and Product across the UK, EU and India, and with IAM on the still-to-be-sharpened boundary around login and access.
Deliver measurable outcomes: higher automated decisioning rates, better due diligence and screening quality, and a falling KYX cost per member.
Build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.
This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly and how well we onboard members, how confidently we scale into new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:
Experience leading engineering organisations in identity, onboarding, fraud, financial crime or another regulated decisioning domain.
Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes: conversion, due diligence quality, unit economics and workflow automation.
Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live.
Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with Ops, Policy and second line risk and compliance functions,
Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality.
Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and unify previously separate engineering lines behind one roadmap.
Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight, would be a bonus.
WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:
Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts
Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office
Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.
TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model thatsupports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.
Disclaimer
It has come to our attention that individuals or agencies are falsely claiming to represent Tide and are reaching out to candidates regarding job opportunities. Please be aware that:
Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.
If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at
safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.
Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.
Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Management - Patient Access Technology
jobs.text:

Job Title:PSD07K - Sr. Director, Product Management - PAS Technology
Brief Description:
We are seeking a Senior Director of Product Management to lead the definition of technology solutions that support UBC’s Patient Services offerings, specifically focusing on Patient Access, Adherence, and Affordability. In this role, you will define the why and what of new products and act as the strategic bridge between business stakeholders, operations and technology leadership, industry leaders, and clients, ensuring our products deliver measurable value to patients, clients, and care providers. You will lead the definition of the product vision, prioritization of the product backlog, and translating business needs into actionable requirements for the development teams. You will represent and/or oversee communications related to critical and strategic clients and work with internal teams and external clients to continue ongoing business, enhance and improve our product offerings, and grow UBC’s book of business.
Specific job duties:
Continuously monitor industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies to inform product strategy and maintain market relevance.
Inform and communicate the product vision, roadmap, and value proposition for UBC solutions supporting patient access, adherence, and affordability.
Own and manage the product backlog to ensure development efforts are aligned with strategic business goals, client needs, and patient-centric outcomes.
Collaborate with internal stakeholders (e.g., operations, project management, regulatory, development, quality) to gather, refine, and prioritize requirements.
Act as the primary liaison between business stakeholders and agile development teams, ensuring clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and feedback loops.
Engage regularly with clients and key stakeholders to deeply understand their needs, pain points, and priorities, ensuring the product backlog reflects real-world user requirements.
Collaborate with finance and pricing teams to understand product cost structures, pricing strategies, and profitability drivers, ensuring business viability informs product decisions.
Partner with marketing to develop and refine go-to-market strategies, ensuring product positioning, messaging, and launch plans are aligned with customer needs and business objectives.
Ensure project, scrum, and business teams are aware of new product enhancements and functionality.
Work closely with data and analytics teams to incorporate real-world evidence and insights that enhance patient engagement and retention.
Ensure compliance with industry standards, data security, and healthcare regulations, including HIPAA.
Contribute to business development activities including RFI and RFP responses, project pricing and estimation, client presentations, and strategic planning.
Monitor product performance, user feedback, industry trends, and competitor activity to drive continuous improvement and keep the product portfolio aligned with current market expectations.
Collaborate with project management and delivery leadership during program startup to ensure approved scope, product intent, client commitments, decision history, budget assumptions, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations are clearly transferred to the delivery organization.
Serve as an executive-facing productsolution leader in strategic client meetings, bid defenses, governance forums, quarterly business reviews, and portfolio-level client discussions where future functionality, scope, roadmap direction, or product investment may be discussed.
Ensure proposed client commitments are evaluated for scope, feasibility, regulatory impact, validation impact, budget requirements, resource needs, and delivery risk before commitments are finalized.
Sponsor business cases and technology/AI governance review materials that define product objectives, target users/stakeholders, expected value, costs, dependencies, risks, assumptions, success measures, and decision points.
Partner with architecture, engineering, information security, privacy, quality, compliance, and data governance stakeholders to ensure product direction aligns with enterprise standards and regulated-life-sciences operating requirements.
Establish relationships with Pharma clients to develop co-definition, co-development, idea exchange, and early adoption outside of traditional engagement during the RFP process.
Supervisory Responsibility:
May manage Product Business Analysts.
Desired Skills and Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Computer Science, Business, Healthcare Administration, or related field (Master’s preferred).
8+ years of experience as a Product Manager, preferably in healthcare, life sciences, or patient support services. Certification as a Product Owner (CSPO) or equivalent is a plus.
Familiarity with specialty pharmacy services, patient access programs, or affordability solutions (e.g., copay cards, patient assistance programs).
Ability to make difficult product decisions and prioritize features based on business value
Experience with backlog management and user story writing.
Excellent skills in translating complex business needs into clear product requirements and user stories.
Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
Ability to balance technical constraints, business priorities, and regulatory requirements.
Passionate about delivering high-quality software products
Customer-focused mindset
Collaborative team player
Resilient under pressure and adaptable to changing priorities and requirements
Excellent time management and organizational skills

jobs.title: Director, Technology Risk Management
jobs.text:
About Us
Finance of America helps homeowners 55+ access the equity they’ve built while staying in full control of their home and their financial future. Through a range of reverse mortgage solutions, we help customers shape the retirement they’ve earned while continuing to evolve how we serve and work together.
Joining Finance of America now means stepping into a period of momentum and growth, with teams actively shaping what comes next and opportunities to make an impact and grow your career.
To learn more about us, visit
Purpose of Role
Responsible for leading the identification, assessment, and proactive management of technology risk across the enterprise, ensuring alignment with defined risk appetite, regulatory expectations, and business objectives. Drives a forward-looking, data-driven risk management approach across cloud, cybersecurity, AI, and third-party ecosystems, while embedding risk management into day-to-day technology and product decision-making. Partners across the enterprise to strengthen control maturity, enable responsible innovation, and provide clear, actionable risk insights to senior leadership.
Key Responsibilities and Expectations
Technology Risk Strategy & Governance
Leads execution of the Technology Risk Management framework, aligned to industry standards (e.g., NIST CSF, FFIEC, SOX ITGC).
Translates regulatory expectations into pragmatic, delivery-aligned controls and practices across Technology and Product teams.
Drives definition, operationalization, and monitoring of technology risk appetite, tolerances, and KRIs.
Risk Identification, Assessment & Insights
Oversees enterprise-wide identification and assessment of technology risks across: Cloud and Infrastructure, Cybersecurity and data protection, AI and emerging technologies, and Third-party/vendor ecosystems.
Delivers data-driven risk insights and reporting, that clearly articulate risk posture, trends, and emerging risks to senior leadership.
Evolves risk reporting from static outputs to forward-looking, decision-enabling intelligence.
Control Environment & Regulatory Compliance
Drives continuous improvement of control maturity to meet regulatory expectations, including sustained SOX ITGC effectiveness.
Partners with Technology teams to design and implement scalable, automated controls.
Ensures timely and high-quality execution of regulatory exams, internal audits, and remediation commitments.
Issue & Remediation Management
Oversees end-to-end issue management lifecycle, including identification, prioritization, root cause analysis, and sustainable remediation.
Drives accountability for timely remediation of high-risk issues and reduction of aged items.
Ensures systemic fixes over point-in-time remediation.
Technology & Process Enablement
Leads adoption of automation and tooling to enhance risk identification, monitoring, and reporting
Evaluates and improve end-to-end technology processes to reduce risk, increase resilience, and enhance operational efficiency.
Promotes integration of risk management into SDLC, product development, and change management processes.
Emerging Risk & Innovation Oversight
Establishes governance and risk oversight for AI and emerging technologies, ensuring alignment with internal standards and evolving regulatory expectations.
Assesses risks associated with new technology initiatives and provide actionable guidance to enable safe adoption.
Stakeholder Engagement & Leadership
Serves as a trusted partner to Technology and Business leaders to proactively manage risk.
Leads engagement with Internal Audit, External Audit, and second line of defense functions.
Builds and develop a high-performing team, fostering a culture of ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Reports To
VP, Technology Risk Management
Direct Reports
(1-3) Direct: Technology Risk Management team members
Qualifications - Experience/Skills/Competencies
Minimum 10 years of experience in Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, IT Audit or related disciplines within financial services or regulated environments.
Proven experience operating in or alongside first line technology functions, with strong business partnership orientation.
Demonstrated success in evolving risk programs to strategic, insight-driven functions.
Deep understanding of technology risk domains, including: Cloud and infrastructure risk, Cybersecurity and data protection, Third-party/vendor risk, and AI/emerging technology risk.
Strong knowledge of regulatory frameworks (FFIEC, NIST CSF, SOX ITGC).
Ability to translate complex technical risks into clear, concise executive-level reporting.
Strong judgement, with the ability to balance risk management with business enablement.
Proven ability to lead and develop high-performing teams.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership and regulators.
Able to drive accountability, foster collaboration, and promote a culture of continuous improvement.
Qualifications - Education - Required
Bachelor's Degree
Qualifications - Education - Field(s)/Profession(s)
Relevant certifications (e.g., CISA, CRISC, CISSP).
Compensation
The base salary range for this position is ($150,000 - $200,000) inclusive of all geographical differences in the labor market. The base salary for the position will be determined based on factors such as the candidate’s work location, skills, education, and experience. In addition to those factors, we believe in the importance of pay equity and consider the internal equity of our current team members in determining any final offer. We offer a competitive benefits package including health, dental, vision, life insurance, paid time-off benefits, flexible spending account, 401(k) with employer match, and ESPP.
Additional Information
The application deadline for this job opportunity is 11/26/2026.
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, religion, creed, age, national origin, physical or mental disability, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Head / Vice President - Engineering
jobs.text:
This is a hands-on engineering leadership role with a growing startup and a young, energetic team of engineers. We're looking for a leader who can balance strategic thinking with technical execution, helping shape the company's technology direction while mentoring and growing the team. Engineering leaders with 812 years of industry experience will be highly desirable.
Primary Responsibilities:
Serve as a hands-on technical leader, overseeing the engineering function including architecture, design, development processes, and infrastructure while making individual contributions when needed.
Define and execute strategies to drive innovation, scale technology solutions, and uphold product quality and performance standards.
Monitor and improve key engineering metrics such as sprint velocity, delivery timelines, incident resolution, and defect rates to ensure team efficiency and alignment with business goals.
Collaborate with product, design, and other cross-functional teams to shape the product roadmap and ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery.
Own technical decision-making for major projects, ensuring the scalability, reliability, and security of the technology stack.
Foster a high-performance culture rooted in technical excellence, agility, and continuous learning.
Play a strategic role in company growth by contributing technical insight to long-term planning and business decisions.
Keep the engineering team aligned with evolving industry trends, introducing modern tools, frameworks, and best practices where relevant.
Support leadership development within the team by mentoring engineering managers and individual contributors.
Ideal Candidate Profile:
8 - 12 years of industry experience, with proven success in engineering leadership roles in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
Strong technical foundation with experience across software development, systems architecture, and cloud infrastructure.
Proven ability to build, lead, and scale high-performing engineering teams, particularly in startup or early-stage environments.
Deep knowledge of modern development practices and the full software development lifecycle.
Experience in designing and managing distributed systems and cloud-native solutions.
Strategic thinker with strong communication and collaboration skills; able to influence across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Passionate about fostering team growth, innovation, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: VP, Subscription Product
jobs.text:
iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.
ABOUT THE ROLE
iFIT is building its next generation subscription product, and VP, Subscription Product is the leader who sets its direction. You own the product vision, the differentiation thesis, and the AI and personalization philosophy.
You report to the Chief Subscription Officer. You partner with the CSO on where the vision product roadmap. You work as a peer with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Retention, Content, and Analytics leaders, who operate as first class members of the model.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN
Product vision and differentiation. Set and defend the product vision, the member experience vision, and the defensibility thesis. Make the final call on the AI and personalization philosophy.
Product prioritization/Roadmap. Set the quarterly percentage split across Core, Growth, and Partner work with the CSO investment lens and Engineering capacity reality. Set the platform and tech debt percentage, which Engineering defines and spends.
Product strategy. Decide product strategy across domains and review domain roadmaps, PRDs, and the single backlog (one queue, three lanes) for coherence.
Monetization innovation. Own the concept pipeline for new revenue ideas. Build the business case, make a clear recommendation, and drive the CSO to a decision on pricing, plans, packaging, and investment.
Innovation pipeline. Own future state concepts and the innovation pipeline, in consultation with Design, Engineering, and Analytics.
Product leadership. Lead and develop the Core Product Leader, Growth Product Leader, and Partner Product Leader. Hold each accountable for outcomes: engagement for Core, funnel for Growth, and partner experiences for Partner.
HOW YOU DECIDE
Decides - Product vision, member experience vision, AI and personalization philosophy, differentiation thesis, innovation pipeline, product strategy, and the quarterly capacity split.
Consulted on - Pricing, plans and packaging, investment decisions, domain roadmaps, retention strategy, content strategy, and acquisition strategy.
Informed on - Commercial partner negotiations, partner sales, paid acquisition, and brand and campaigns.
Does not own - The subscription P&L, pricing, or commercial deals, Architecture and delivery, The retention number, The experiment gate,
OPERATING RHYTHM
Quarterly planning: set the capacity split with the CSO and Engineering, with Analytics arriving with the insights agenda.
Ongoing: review domain roadmaps and resolve cross domain conflicts, then communicate decisions directly and in public.
Regular readouts to the CSO and executive team on product outcomes, bets, and tradeoffs.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
Substantial revenue and subscriber growth.
Best in class engagement and retention results.
Efficient marketing funnel driven by the product.
Building the #1 app in Fitness
Three domain leaders who own their slices and escalate only when they should.
WHAT YOU BRING
12 or more years in product, with 5 or more years leading product leaders at a consumer subscription, mobile, or connected fitness company.
Proven record of setting product vision and turning it into a prioritized portfolio with real tradeoffs.
Deep fluency in subscription economics: conversion, retention, LTV, CAC, and pricing and packaging.
Hands on experience shaping an AI and personalization strategy for consumers.
Comfort making direct decisions and holding the tiebreaker without losing partnership with Design, Engineering, and Marketing.
Experience running experimentation programs with an analytics gate.
Executive presence and the ability to present to the CEO and board.
NICE TO HAVE
Experience in fitness, health, wellness, or content driven products.
Experience with partner ecosystems, integrations, and platform products.
Experience scaling a product organization through a reorganization or operating model change.
DISCLAIMER
Compensation may vary based on the job level, your geographic work location, position incentive plan, and exemption status.
Although we currently may consider hiring in the states listed below, not all positions are available in all locations, and work in a particular state is not guaranteed. Current list of states where iFIT may consider hiring: AK, AL, AR, AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MN, MO, MS, NC, NH, NJ, NV, NY, OH, OK, OR, PA, RI, SC, SD, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, WY.
Subject to applicable state laws, your employment at iFIT is "at-will". At-will employment means that you and the company each have the right to terminate the employment relationship at any time for any cause or for no cause at all.
Pay Range:
$200,000—$225,000 USD

blocks.text: iFIT’s vision is to create the world's most holistic health and fitness platform, integrating all elements of health - physical fitness, mental health, nutrition and active recovery - into a seamless interactive experience. We develop proprietary software that learns and adjusts to the habits of each person as it delivers immersive content that guides them on their own individual fitness journey.
ABOUT THE ROLE

iFIT is building its next generation subscription product, and VP, Subscription Product is the leader who sets its direction. You own the product vision, the differentiation thesis, and the AI and personalization philosophy.

You report to the Chief Subscription Officer. You partner with the CSO on where the vision product roadmap. You work as a peer with Design, Engineering, Marketing, Retention, Content, and Analytics leaders, who operate as first class members of the model.
WHAT YOU WILL OWN

items: Product vision and differentiation. Set and defend the product vision, the member experience vision, and the defensibility thesis. Make the final call on the AI and personalization philosophy.

Product prioritization/Roadmap. Set the quarterly percentage split across Core, Growth, and Partner work with the CSO investment lens and Engineering capacity reality. Set the platform and tech debt percentage, which Engineering defines and spends.
Product strategy. Decide product strategy across domains and review domain roadmaps, PRDs, and the single backlog (one queue, three lanes) for coherence.

Monetization innovation. Own the concept pipeline for new revenue ideas. Build the business case, make a clear recommendation, and drive the CSO to a decision on pricing, plans, packaging, and investment.
Innovation pipeline. Own future state concepts and the innovation pipeline, in consultation with Design, Engineering, and Analytics.

Product leadership. Lead and develop the Core Product Leader, Growth Product Leader, and Partner Product Leader. Hold each accountable for outcomes: engagement for Core, funnel for Growth, and partner experiences for Partner.

blocks.text: HOW YOU DECIDE

items: Decides - Product vision, member experience vision, AI and personalization philosophy, differentiation thesis, innovation pipeline, product strategy, and the quarterly capacity split.
Consulted on - Pricing, plans and packaging, investment decisions, domain roadmaps, retention strategy, content strategy, and acquisition strategy.
Informed on - Commercial partner negotiations, partner sales, paid acquisition, and brand and campaigns.
Does not own - The subscription P&L, pricing, or commercial deals, Architecture and delivery, The retention number, The experiment gate,

blocks.text: OPERATING RHYTHM

items: Quarterly planning: set the capacity split with the CSO and Engineering, with Analytics arriving with the insights agenda.
Ongoing: review domain roadmaps and resolve cross domain conflicts, then communicate decisions directly and in public.
Regular readouts to the CSO and executive team on product outcomes, bets, and tradeoffs.

blocks.text: WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

items: Substantial revenue and subscriber growth.
Best in class engagement and retention results.
Efficient marketing funnel driven by the product.
Building the #1 app in Fitness
Three domain leaders who own their slices and escalate only when they should.

blocks.text: WHAT YOU BRING

items: 12 or more years in product, with 5 or more years leading product leaders at a consumer subscription, mobile, or connected fitness company.
Proven record of setting product vision and turning it into a prioritized portfolio with real tradeoffs.
Deep fluency in subscription economics: conversion, retention, LTV, CAC, and pricing and packaging.
Hands on experience shaping an AI and personalization strategy for consumers.
Comfort making direct decisions and holding the tiebreaker without losing partnership with Design, Engineering, and Marketing.
Experience running experimentation programs with an analytics gate.
Executive presence and the ability to present to the CEO and board.

blocks.text: NICE TO HAVE

items: Experience in fitness, health, wellness, or content driven products.
Experience with partner ecosystems, integrations, and platform products.
Experience scaling a product organization through a reorganization or operating model change.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that power every marketing, product and commercial decision across the business. We're looking for a Data Science leader who believes machine learning only creates value when it changes business decisions.
This is an opportunity to build and lead a commercially driven Data Science function that delivers measurable improvements in customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term business growth.
You'll lead a growing team of Data Scientists while partnering closely with Engineering, Analytics, Product and Commercial teams to ensure predictive models become trusted, production-ready products that drive measurable commercial outcomes. As we continue investing in first-party data, AI, machine learning and advanced marketing measurement, we're looking for an experienced Data Science leader to help shape the next phase of our commercial Data Science capability.
Responsibilties:
Commercial Data Science: Lead the strategy and delivery of predictive models that improve customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term commercial value. You'll shape capabilities including lifetime value modelling, propensity modelling, customer segmentation, forecasting and value-based bidding, ensuring every model is linked to measurable business outcomes.
Marketing Science & Decision Science: Partner with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to apply Data Science to real business problems. You'll help define how predictive analytics, experimentation and AI improve campaign performance, customer understanding and strategic decision making across platforms including Google and Meta.
Production Data Science: Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to ensure models become reliable, production-ready products rather than one-off analyses. You'll champion reproducible experimentation, scalable deployment, model monitoring, retraining strategies and continuous improvement throughout the model lifecycle.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while building trusted relationships across the business. You'll translate complex modelling into clear commercial recommendations, influence senior stakeholders through evidence, and help establish Data Science as a trusted driver of business strategy and commercial growth.
Innovation & Industry Leadership: Represent Forbes in strategic conversations with technology partners including Google and Meta while staying connected to advances in AI, machine learning and marketing science. You'll evaluate emerging technologies, bring new ideas into the organisation and help ensure our Data Science capability remains commercially relevant and technically leading.
Qualifications:
Experience leading commercial Data Science, Marketing Science or Decision Science teams.
Strong expertise in predictive analytics, customer analytics, machine learning and statistical modelling.
Experience applying Data Science to marketing performance, customer acquisition, lifetime value or value-based bidding.
Experience productionising machine learning solutions within modern cloud environments and working closely with Engineering and ML Ops teams.
Strong understanding of SQL, Python and modern machine learning frameworks.
Experience working with Google Ads, Meta or other major advertising platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and commercial audiences.
Experience building and developing high-performing Data Science teams.
Strong commercial judgement, balancing technical excellence with measurable business impact.
A pragmatic approach to AI, applying emerging technologies where they create genuine commercial value.
Nice to Have
Experience within affiliate marketing, digital publishing or lead-generation businesses.
Experience working in financial services, insurance or regulated industries.
Experience working directly with Google or Meta Data Science teams.
Experience with attribution modelling and marketing measurement.
Experience building optimisation algorithms for DSPs or advertising platforms.
Experience with causal inference, experimentation frameworks or incrementality testing.
Experience forecasting marketing or commercial performance.
Experience with Vertex AI or equivalent cloud-based machine learning platforms.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

jobs.title: Vice President of Product and Technology PMO
jobs.text:
Workiva is seeking an exceptional PMO executive to lead and evolve our Product & Technology Program Management Office as the company enters its next phase of growth, beyond $1B ARR. This leader will drive execution excellence across R&D, ensuring that our most critical product, platform, and enterprise initiatives are delivered with clarity, discipline, and confidence.
This role is for a strategic, influential leader who elevates how a product and technology organization plans, prioritizes, and delivers at scale. The VP of Product & Technology PMO will oversee the organization’s operating rhythm, bringing a proactive, business-driven approach to portfolio leadership and execution.
As a core member of the Product & Technology leadership team, you will partner closely with the SVP & Head of Technology, the Chief Product Officer, and senior leaders across Product, Technology, and UX to lead annual and quarterly planning, clarify priorities and trade-offs, and ensure disciplined execution across the product and technology portfolio. This role serves as the connective tissue across strategy, investment, and delivery, ensuring teams are aligned on the right work, sequenced appropriately, and held to clear delivery commitments with transparent timelines and outcomes.
What You'll Do
Strategic Leadership & Product & Technology Operating Model
Drive and partner with the P&T leaders to continuously mature the planning and delivery operating model, spanning multi-year strategic planning, annual investment decisions, quarterly execution cycles, and release delivery
Establish the PMO as a trusted strategic partner to Product, UX, and Technology leadership, proactively contributing to shaping priorities and decisions rather than coordinating execution after the fact
Drive prioritization and trade-off frameworks that balance customer value, business outcomes, capacity, and technical health
Partner with business and GTM leaders on large, cross-company initiatives to ensure technology execution aligns with commercial objectives, regulatory commitments, and customer impact
Bring commercial context into portfolio and execution discussions, proactively surfacing misalignment between strategy, investment, and expected business outcomes, and calling out high-risk areas early
Own the definition, communication, and ongoing management of delivery commitments for the Technology portfolio, ensuring predictable timelines and early visibility into risks and trade-offs
Elevate executive communication by translating complex delivery realities into clear, decision-oriented narratives for senior leadership
Portfolio, Planning & Execution Excellence
Design, implement, and govern a lightweight, outcome-driven portfolio management approach spanning software engineering, platform, security, and infrastructure initiatives
Lead portfolio-level planning, sequencing, and capacity alignment to ensure investments are clearly tied to strategic priorities and measurable outcomes
Establish and maintain portfolio-level delivery confidence through clear sequencing, dependency management, and accountability for committed milestones across teams
Provide executive-level visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, trade-offs, and resource allocation
Partner with leaders to evolve delivery practices and tooling aligned with modern SaaS and product operating models
Oversee critical cross-functional programs such as major product launches, platform modernization efforts, enterprise transformations, and M&A integrations
Hold Product and Technology leaders accountable to delivery commitments with confidence, judgment, empathy, and strong executive presence
Organizational Development, Talent & Enablement
Build, coach, and scale a high-performing PMO organization with a culture of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and constructive challenge
Develop program and technical program managers into strategic advisors who can influence priorities, manage complexity, and protect outcomes
Partner with Technology and Product leaders to strengthen operating discipline across the organization, including planning cadences, execution reviews, and decision forums
Define and evolve KPIs, OKRs, and metrics that measure delivery predictability, investment efficiency, and business impact
Own and evolve the PMO’s planning, portfolio, and delivery tooling, leveraging automation and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled capabilities, to improve planning, visibility, and execution at scale
Lead and evolve shared delivery standards and practices across Product and Engineering, including ownership of the Product Center of Excellence and SDLC frameworks, to improve consistency, quality, and execution outcomes at scale
What You'll Need
Minimum Qualifications
12+ years of experience in Program Management, Technical Operations, R&D Operations, or Product/Technology leadership with advanced degree within high-growth SaaS
5+ years leading a global or enterprise PMO, Technical Program Management, or equivalent strategic operations function
Experience implementing or evolving portfolio management, planning, or workforce visibility tooling in scaled environments
Strong technical fluency, with the ability to engage in high-level SaaS and platform architecture discussions, understand system trade-offs, and ask the right questions across business requirements, design, and execution
Deep understanding of modern product development and engineering delivery models, including Agile, Lean, and hybrid approaches.
Exceptional executive communication and influence skills, with the ability to partner credibly with Product, UX, Engineering, and executive leadership
A leadership style grounded in clarity, empathy, data-driven thinking, and the courage to challenge priorities when necessary to protect outcomes
Preferred Qualifications
MBA or advanced technical or business degree
Relevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent Agile credentials
Working Conditions & Travel Requirements
Up to 30% travel to meet with teams in other offices, customers, vendors, and/or suppliers, attend trade shows, etc
Reliable internet access for any period of time working remotely, not in a Workiva office
How You’ll Be Rewarded
✅ Salary range in the US: $247,400.00 - $345,000.00
✅ A discretionary bonus typically paid annually
✅ Restricted Stock Units granted at time of hire
✅ 401(k) match and comprehensive employee benefits package
The salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this job in the US. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and other relevant factors.
Why Join Workiva
Workiva is the platform designed to bring confidence, control, and a competitive edge to the world’s most complex organizations. Our AI-powered platform unifies finance, risk, and sustainability on a single, secure foundation—ensuring data is trusted, traceable, and ready to act on. With an unbroken path from source to output, leaders gain confidence in their numbers, visibility into current and emerging risks, and the ability to move with speed and precision in a constantly changing world.
At Workiva, you’ll bring technology to market that executives, boards, and regulators depend on. The work you do here helps organizations navigate uncertainty, maintain trust, and make decisions that stand up to scrutiny. If you’re energized by meaningful challenges, inspired by collaborative teams, and motivated to help organizations turn uncertainty into advantage, we’d love to meet you.
Employment decisions are made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other protected characteristic.
Workiva is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. To request assistance with the application process, please email .
Workiva employees are required to undergo comprehensive security and privacy training tailored to their roles, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards.
Workiva supports employees in working where they work best - either from an office or remotely from any location within their country of employment.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
About Deep Origin
Deep Origin is a biotech startup building an operating system for science that transforms how life science research is conducted. Led by Michael Antonov, co-founder of Oculus, and backed by Formic Ventures, we are redefining the infrastructure behind modern drug discovery. Our AI-driven platform enables scientists to accelerate discovery, reduce cost, and bring breakthrough innovations to life faster. As we scale, engineering excellence is a critical lever in advancing our mission to dramatically reduce disease and extend human healthspan.
Role Description
We are looking for an experienced Director of Product Management to lead product execution and help build and scale the product organization at Deep Origin.
This role is for a product leader who has built and scaled B2B SaaS products in a startup environment, taken products from 0 → 1 through product-market fit and meaningful commercial scale, and knows how to deeply understand customer problems before deciding what to build.
You will work closely with executive leadership, Product, Engineering, AI/ML, Science, Sales, Marketing, and Business Development to translate customer and market needs into clear product strategy, priorities, roadmaps, and execution.
This is not a role focused only on maintaining an existing roadmap. We are looking for someone who can challenge assumptions, identify the right customer problems to solve, bring structure to the product organization, and help turn strong technology into scalable products customers value and are willing to pay for.
Experience in biotech, life sciences, biology, chemistry, or drug discovery will be helpful. The most important requirement is a demonstrated record of building and scaling successful software products.
Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

jobs.title: UNPAID VOLUNTEER - Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
jobs.text:
UNPAID VOLUNTEER – Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Role Title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
Role Type: Unpaid Volunteer
Number of Positions: 1
Location: Home-based / Remote
Time Commitment: Approximately 20 hours per week, flexibly arranged
Reporting To: Director-General
THIS IS AN UNPAID VOLUNTEER ROLE.
About DTID
The Digital Technology Institute for Development (DTID) is an international non-profit institute advancing the responsible use of artificial intelligence, blockchain and emerging digital technologies to support sustainable development and policy implementation.
DTID brings together professionals, researchers, technology specialists and other stakeholders to generate research, develop practical solutions, strengthen partnerships and support informed decision-making at the intersection of technology, climate change and sustainable development.
The Role
DTID is seeking an experienced, innovative and technically accomplished Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to provide strategic and technical leadership across the organisation's emerging technology portfolio.
Reporting directly to the Director-General, the CTO will lead DTID's work across Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)/Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Data Science, Big Data Analysis, Data Modelling, Quantum Computing and technology standards.
The successful candidate will be responsible for defining DTID's technology strategy, overseeing technology research and development, leading technical teams and translating emerging technologies into practical solutions that support climate action, sustainable development and policy implementation.
The CTO will also oversee the development of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and technology applications; strengthen DTID's internal technical capabilities; develop strategic partnerships; and provide technical leadership across multidisciplinary projects.
Strong practical proficiency in blockchain development and programming is essential for this role. Experience developing artificial intelligence or machine-learning solutions is highly desirable.
This is a senior leadership position requiring strong technical expertise, strategic thinking, people leadership and the ability to communicate complex technology concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
The Chief Technology Officer will:
Define and lead DTID's technology strategy and roadmap across blockchain, artificial intelligence, IoT, data technologies, quantum computing and related emerging technologies.
Lead and manage DTID's emerging technology teams and standards-development activities, including recruitment, onboarding, mentoring and capability development.
Oversee the design, development, testing and deployment of Proof-of-Concepts, pilots and technology solutions.
Guide the application of DLT/Blockchain, AI, machine learning, data science, data modelling, IoT and other emerging technologies across DTID projects.
Ensure appropriate standards for the quality, reliability, security, scalability and documentation of DTID's technology products and solutions.
Monitor and evaluate the performance and impact of technology initiatives and recommend improvements where appropriate.
Provide technical leadership and guidance to Technology Officers and multidisciplinary project teams.
Identify and develop strategic technology partnerships with research institutions, technology organisations, governments, international organisations and other relevant stakeholders.
Monitor emerging technology trends and assess their potential application to climate action, sustainable development and public policy.
Represent DTID at relevant conferences, technical forums, stakeholder meetings and external engagements.
Contribute technical expertise to DTID research, publications, standards, proposals and institutional initiatives.
Collaborate with the Director-General and other senior leaders to ensure technology priorities support DTID's wider strategic objectives.
