jobs.title: VP Product Management
jobs.text:
VP Product Management
POSITION OVERVIEW
Speedcastis accelerating its expansion into high-growth markets, and the SIGMA platform sits at the center of that strategy. As Vice President of Product Management for SIGMA, you will serve as the de facto general manager of this business unit — owning full P&L accountability, defining the multi-year product roadmap, and driving end-to-end Go-To-Market execution across existing and emerging verticals.
This is a rare opportunity for a deeply technical, commercially minded leader to shape the future of a mission-critical platform deployed at the network edge. You will combine strong product instincts with edge computeexpertiseto evolve SIGMA from a managed connectivity layer into an intelligent, programmable edge ecosystem — unlocking new revenue streams forSpeedcastacross enterprise, energy, maritime, rail, and emerging markets including India and the Middle East.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
P&L Ownership & Business Leadership
Own the full P&L for the SIGMA platform, including revenue targets, margin performance, investment prioritization, and budget management
Serve as the internal executive champion for SIGMA,establishingaccountability frameworks and operating rhythms across product, engineering, sales, and delivery
Define and track KPIs that measure platform adoption, customer retention, revenue growth, and margin improvement
Product Strategy & Roadmap
Lead the development of a multi-year SIGMA product roadmap grounded in market requirements, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, andSpeedcast’sstrategic objectives
Drive the integration of edge compute capabilities into SIGMA’s architecture, enabling compute-at-the-edge use cases such as local data processing, AI inferencing, IoT aggregation, and application hosting in bandwidth-constrained or remote environments
Define and own the SIGMA portal strategy, ensuring a best-in-class operator and end-user experience for provisioning, monitoring, and managing edge services
Partner with the CTO and engineering leadership to translate product vision into delivery roadmaps, managing trade-offs between speed, scope, and technical debt
Go-To-Market Execution
Architect and lead Go-To-Market strategies for each SIGMA vertical, from value proposition definition through sales enablement, pricing, and launch execution
Collaborate closely with the Head of Sales, Business Development, and vertical leads to drive pipeline generation and close high-value enterprise deals
Develop compelling commercial narratives and competitive differentiation frameworks that equip sales teams to win against both legacy connectivity providers and pure-play edge compute vendors
Represent SIGMA at executive briefings, industry events, and strategic customer engagements
Partnerships & Ecosystem Development
Identify, structure, and manage strategic partnerships with resellers, co-sell partners, white-label operators, and technology integrators acrossSpeedcast’sportfolio (LEO/Starlink, GEO, LTE, SIGMA, and applications)
Lead commercial negotiations and partnership agreement structuring in close collaboration with legal, finance, and product teams
Manage and growSpeedcast’sstrategic relationships with key ecosystem partners including Sify and HCL Tech, andidentifynew partnerships to accelerate SIGMA adoption
Build an ecosystem strategy that extends SIGMA’s addressable market through third-party application integrations, ISV relationships, and platform APIs
Cross-Functional Leadership
Operate as a senior cross-functional leader, aligning product, sales, engineering, innovation, and finance around a coherent SIGMA growth strategy
Present strategy, roadmap, pipeline performance, and investment cases to the CPO and Board-level audiences, with clarity and commercial rigor
Mentor and develop product managers within the SIGMA organization, building a high-performance team culture
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required
15+ years of experience in technology product management, product strategy, or a closely related discipline, with a minimum of 5 years of focused experience in edge compute, distributed systems, or network-edge platforms
Demonstrated success owning P&L accountability for a software platform or technology product line, including revenue growth, margin management, and investment decision-making
Deep technical fluency in edge compute architectures — including containerized workloads, edge orchestration, IoT data pipelines, and low-latency application delivery — with the ability to engage credibly with engineering leadership and customer CTOs
Proventrack recorddesigning and executing Go-To-Market strategies across enterprise, industrial, or connectivity verticals, from strategy through sales enablement and commercial launch
Experience building and closing complex strategic partnerships with ICTs, system integrators, and IT consulting organizations
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills, withdemonstratedability to present complex strategy, business cases, and risk assessments to CPO and Board-level audiences
Strong commercial acumen, including experience structuring pricing, packaging, and partnership commercial terms
Ability to manage andallocatebudgets effectively and advocate for investment prioritization in a resource-constrained environment
Preferred
Experience inIT, or network-as-a-service environments
Prior experience scaling a product inexisting andemerging markets such as India or the Middle East
Background in SaaS platform business models, particularly those with usage-based or managed service components
MBA or equivalent advanced business education
Working at Speedcast:
At Speedcast, we want people that like adventure. Who are motivated by work that takes uncommon ingenuity and thinking outside the box. Who relish the idea of working in an industry undergoing massive transformation. If you want to be part of a global team responsible for connecting the world, then you’re in the right place.
We're always pushing forward, never standing still. When people rely on you and your team to stay connected, it brings everyone closer together. We’re united by the adrenaline of high-stakes projects and our love of getting the job done right. You will experiment, learn and grow here, right alongside us, every single day.
Find great opportunities to make an impact. We have a "one team, one dream" mentality. We work together to make great things happen. Working at Speedcast isn't just a job, it's a career that you can take to new levels.
Top reasons why people love working at Speedcast:
Our global presence– you get to work with clients and colleagues all over the world, in every continent
Talented teammates– your co-workers are the best and brightest in the industry
Industry leadership– be part of the latest advancements shaping the future of communications
Ability to develop skills– work across departments to gain new skills and valuable experience
Choose your environment– we have an environment to fit your temperament. Choose between a traditional desk job or work in the field.
Grow your career- Guide your career in the direction you want. Gain new titles and responsibilities through our internal promotion system.
Work on diverse projects– every day is different with our customers from a range of industries around the world
Speedcast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected characteristics. jobs.title: Senior Director, Development (Electrical Engineering)
jobs.text:
The Senior Director, Development requires strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills, ability to self-direct, strong background in data center design, engineering, controls, and operational requirements, with an emphasis on project/construction management. In this role, you will function as QTS’ point of contact for new client builds and implementations and liaise between the QTS Sales Team (Account Exec and Sales Engineer), the QTS Operations Team, the QTS Property Development Team, and the Customer. The PSCM will work closely with existing Development Construction Project Managers to ensure the customers’ needs are carried out to high levels of expectation.
The position will report into the QTS Property Development department and work closely with the CHO and CRO, depending on the origin of the project.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES, other duties may be assigned.
Manage the customer deployment project delivery for each sold deal within each QTS location
Coordinate with the QTS Property Development team, and supporting specialty consultants, to support customer’s design needs, pricing, customer approvals, & implementation of specific deployment scopes
Manage the delivery of these projects, this position aligns clients’ objectives, business processes, vendor management strategies, and cross-group collaboration efforts across the QTS organization
Drive effective client relationship management and efficient cost management, with the ultimate goal of delivering the project on time and on budget
Serve as a single contact for Federal sales support on potential secured deals
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
Bachelor’s Degree and/or professional licenses in Construction Management or Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or Architecture
Ten or more years of progressive responsibility in development of Mission Critical Facilities
Five or more years of responsibility of data center project construction with large-scale data centers or DC lease providers
Be able to travel up to 50% of the time
US Citizenship for this position is required by law due to federal customer contracts
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Experience managing multiple large, multi-faceted projects
Experience with Construction Health & Safety Knowledge
Experience with Customer Deployment Technologies and Equipment, RCDD a plus.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES
Strong Verbal and Written Communication Skills
Ability to independently manage deadlines and support staff
Ability to influence cross-discipline teams
Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing situations at a high growth company
TOTAL REWARDS
This role is also eligible for a competitive beneﬁts package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; ﬂexible spending and HSA accounts; paid holidays; paid time off; paid volunteer days; employee assistance program; tuition assistance; parental leave; military leave assistance; QTS scholarship for dependents; wellness program, and other company beneﬁts.
This position is Bonus eligible.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Data
jobs.text:
Who is Boulevard?
Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.
Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.
We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.
Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.
Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.
We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Data to build and lead the technical foundation that powers Boulevard's data ecosystem and products. This role is responsible for our data infrastructure, data governance, ML capabilities and the underlying systems that enable data-driven products and decision-making across the company.
Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll play a critical leadership role in establishing Boulevard's data platform as a strategic competitive advantage. Your work will shape how data is collected, processed, and leveraged across the company - driving insights, powering product innovation, and ensuring operational excellence. You will ensure that data is reliable, secure, performant, and accessible to support our growing customer base and internal teams. You'll lead a high-impact team of data engineers, with a mandate to grow and scale the organization. This is a foundational role where you'll architect and build systems that will support Boulevard's growth for years to come.
Domains of Ownership
Data Infrastructure & Platform Engineering - Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and infrastructure
Data Products - Partner with the insights team, product management and product engineering to power reporting dashboards, analytics features, and data-driven customer experiences
Data Governance & Quality - Establish frameworks for data integrity, lineage, and compliance
Data Security & Privacy - Ensure data protection, access controls, and regulatory compliance (including HIPAA)
ML/AI Platform Operations - Provide the foundation and standards for machine learning and AI capabilities
Real-time & Batch Processing - Design and optimize data processing systems for various use cases
Data Integration & APIs - Enable seamless data flow between systems and external partners
Key Projects & Initiatives
Modern Data Infrastructure: Continue building out scalable data infrastructure using tools like dbt, Airflow, and real-time streaming platforms
Customer Data Products: Collaborate with Product Management and Product Engineering to deliver customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features
Data Platform for Insights: Build robust data pipelines that enable the Data Insights team to deliver external benchmarking and internal business intelligence
Data Governance Framework: Establish comprehensive data quality monitoring, lineage tracking, and governance policies
Platform Self-Service: Build tools and frameworks that enable other teams to safely and efficiently work with data
Security & Compliance: Strengthen data protection, access controls, and ensure HIPAA compliance across all data systems
Performance Optimization: Continuously improve cost, speed, and reliability of data processing systems
ML/AI Infrastructure: Provide robust foundation for training, deployment, and monitoring of machine learning models and LLMs
What You'll Do Here
Technical Leadership: Define and execute the long-term technical strategy for Boulevard's data platform, ensuring scalability and reliability as we grow
Team Building: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data platform engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of excellence

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
Our mission
We're making Africa the first cashless continent.
In 2017, over half the population in Sub-Saharan Africa had no bank account. That's for good reason—the fees are too high, the closest branch can be miles away, and nobody takes cards. Without access to financial institutions, people are forced to keep their savings under the mattress. Small business owners rely on lenders who charge extortionate rates. Parents spend hours waiting in line to pay school fees in cash.
We're solving this by building financial services that just work: no account fees, instantly available, and accepted everywhere. In places where electricity, water and roads don't always work, you can still send money with Wave. In 2017, we launched a mobile app in Senegal for cash deposit, withdrawal, and peer-to-peer and business payments. Now, we have millions of users across 9 countries and are growing fast.
Our goal is to make Africa the first cashless continent and that's where you come in...
How you'll help us achieve it
We're looking for a CTO who wants to own engineering end to end: the systems, the people, and the standards for a company whose work changes lives.
Keep us fast as we get bigger: We deliberately favor fewer processes, simple designs, and deeply understood tools, because that's what lets a small team operate a system this important. Your job is to protect that as the headcount grows and ensure more ownership per engineer, and a clear view of where complexity is genuinely worth it.
Own reliability: Wave is the financial system for millions of people who have no alternative. You'll set the standards for uptime, incident response, and how carefully we change things that move money and you'll be accountable when we fall short.
Build and lead the leadership layer: You'll inherit 5 direct reports and an engineering organization of ~132 people including security, data and infrastructure. The CISO will also be reporting to you. You will be responsible for hiring, developing, and where necessary replacing engineering managers and directors. You'll be personally involved in senior hiring.
Set our vision on AI. We're already shipping AI in production as autonomous voice and digital agents handle over 10 million customer interactions a month across West Africa and we're building tooling so engineers can use coding agents safely inside a large Python monolith. You’ll help us be truly AI forward, not just a pragmatic adopter.
Support expansion. Wave is growing fast, and each new market brings new challenges and constraints. You’ll help us plan the right architecture and organisational structure to help us grow smoothly and consistently.
Represent engineering to the company. Wave is unusually transparent: everyone sees monthly update from our CEO. You'll write clearly about what engineering is doing and why, to an audience that includes engineers, non-engineers, our leadership team, and, when needed, our regulators.
Key details
Reports to: Drew Durbin, CEO.
Team: Around ~132 engineers across 5 teams (Payment, User-facing products, Internal, non-product teams and platform) plus 5 leaders. Engineering teams are co-led by a product manager and an engineering manager. Data science and analytics sits in the engineering organization; corporate IT does not for now.
Stack: Python 3 with mypy on the backend, GraphQL API layer, Postgres and Redis, Kotlin/Jetpack on Android (our main client), Swift/SwiftUI on iOS, TypeScript and React on the web. Infrastructure on GCP, managed with Kubernetes and Terraform. Most backend work happens in a large Python monolith, deployed across multi-country architecture. Current in-flight work includes agentic developer tooling, a large scale migration of our databases, and some refactoring of our monolith.
Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates must be based in one of our talent hub countries (Spain, UK, East Coast of USA, Canada, Kenya, Ghana) or in one of our operating markets in Africa including Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, or Burkina Faso. Expect to travel to our markets a minimum of twice per year to stay close to local realities, products, teams and of course our users. Wave covers all costs.
Compensation: Our salaries are competitive and are calculated using a transparent formula. For this role, depending on your level and location, we offer a salary of up to $356,500 USD, plus a generous equity package.
Wave provides a yearly $1,200 stipend to support coworking meetups with teammates.
Major benefits:
Subsidized health insurance for you and your dependents and retirement contributions (both vary from country to country).
6 months of fully paid parental leave and subsidized fertility assistance.
Flexible vacation, with most folks taking between 21-30 days exclusive of statutory holidays.
$10,000 annual charitable donation matching.
Process: The process runs up to 5 conversations, including 2 technical discussions. We want this to be a 2-way assessment: as much a chance for you to evaluate us as for us to get to know you. Along the way you'll meet our CEO, Head of People, Head of Product, both Engineering Directors, and a senior leader from one of our markets.
Requirements
You've managed an engineering organization of at least~100 people, including managers who manage others. You can describe how your own job changed as the org grew.
You have a software engineering background and are good at it. You can still read code and follow a technical argument to the end.
You've been accountable for a system where failure was expensive: money, safety, or regulated data.
You've hired senior engineering leaders, and you've moved someone out of a role that wasn't working. You can talk about both honestly.
You write well. Clear, short, and persuasive, for readers who aren't engineers.
You have an actual point of view on AI in engineering: something you've tried, changed, or abandoned, not a plan to look into it.
You believe in what we're building and can say why without being prompted.
You might be a good fit if you
Would rather run a great team than be the smartest engineer in the room, and don't feel a loss in that trade.
Are comfortable being the person who says the unwelcome thing in a meeting, and can do it without making it personal.
Change your mind in public when the evidence changes.
Prefer the simplest system that works to the most interesting one.
Care about what our users actually experience: how long a transfer takes on a bad network, what happens to a shop owner when a deposit fails and bring that up unprompted when discussing infrastructure.
Take responsibility for outcomes rather than processes, including when the outcome is bad.
Are drawn to a company that publishes its numbers internally every month, expects direct feedback in both directions, and would rather be embarrassingly honest than comfortable.
Our team
We have a rapidly growing in-country team in Senegal, Côte d'Ivoire, Mali, Burkina Faso, The Gambia, Uganda, Niger, Sierra Leone, and Cameroon plus remote team members spread across the world.
We're deeply passionate about our mission of bringing radically affordable financial services to the people who need them most.
We foster autonomy for our employees. You'll own your projects at every stage, from understanding the problem to monitoring your solution in production.
We raised the largest Series A in Africa in 2021. Our world-class investors, include Founders Fund, Sequoia Heritage, Stripe, Ribbit Capital, Y Combinator, and Partech Africa.
We are on Y Combinator's top companies by revenue.
How to apply
Fill out the form below, and upload a resume in English and a cover letter describing your interest in Wave and the role.
We review applications frequently and recommend that you apply to the role that most closely aligns with your skills, experience and career goals.
Wave is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: VP of Data Science
jobs.text:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
Our Data & Analytics organisation builds the products, platforms and intelligence that power every marketing, product and commercial decision across the business. We're looking for a Data Science leader who believes machine learning only creates value when it changes business decisions.
This is an opportunity to build and lead a commercially driven Data Science function that delivers measurable improvements in customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term business growth.
You'll lead a growing team of Data Scientists while partnering closely with Engineering, Analytics, Product and Commercial teams to ensure predictive models become trusted, production-ready products that drive measurable commercial outcomes. As we continue investing in first-party data, AI, machine learning and advanced marketing measurement, we're looking for an experienced Data Science leader to help shape the next phase of our commercial Data Science capability.
Responsibilties:
Commercial Data Science: Lead the strategy and delivery of predictive models that improve customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term commercial value. You'll shape capabilities including lifetime value modelling, propensity modelling, customer segmentation, forecasting and value-based bidding, ensuring every model is linked to measurable business outcomes.
Marketing Science & Decision Science: Partner with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to apply Data Science to real business problems. You'll help define how predictive analytics, experimentation and AI improve campaign performance, customer understanding and strategic decision making across platforms including Google and Meta.
Production Data Science: Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to ensure models become reliable, production-ready products rather than one-off analyses. You'll champion reproducible experimentation, scalable deployment, model monitoring, retraining strategies and continuous improvement throughout the model lifecycle.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while building trusted relationships across the business. You'll translate complex modelling into clear commercial recommendations, influence senior stakeholders through evidence, and help establish Data Science as a trusted driver of business strategy and commercial growth.
Innovation & Industry Leadership: Represent Forbes in strategic conversations with technology partners including Google and Meta while staying connected to advances in AI, machine learning and marketing science. You'll evaluate emerging technologies, bring new ideas into the organisation and help ensure our Data Science capability remains commercially relevant and technically leading.
Qualifications:
Experience leading commercial Data Science, Marketing Science or Decision Science teams.
Strong expertise in predictive analytics, customer analytics, machine learning and statistical modelling.
Experience applying Data Science to marketing performance, customer acquisition, lifetime value or value-based bidding.
Experience productionising machine learning solutions within modern cloud environments and working closely with Engineering and ML Ops teams.
Strong understanding of SQL, Python and modern machine learning frameworks.
Experience working with Google Ads, Meta or other major advertising platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and commercial audiences.
Experience building and developing high-performing Data Science teams.
Strong commercial judgement, balancing technical excellence with measurable business impact.
A pragmatic approach to AI, applying emerging technologies where they create genuine commercial value.
Nice to Have
Experience within affiliate marketing, digital publishing or lead-generation businesses.
Experience working in financial services, insurance or regulated industries.
Experience working directly with Google or Meta Data Science teams.
Experience with attribution modelling and marketing measurement.
Experience building optimisation algorithms for DSPs or advertising platforms.
Experience with causal inference, experimentation frameworks or incrementality testing.
Experience forecasting marketing or commercial performance.
Experience with Vertex AI or equivalent cloud-based machine learning platforms.
Forbes Advisor provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.
This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a commercially driven Data Science function that delivers measurable improvements in customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term business growth.

You'll lead a growing team of Data Scientists while partnering closely with Engineering, Analytics, Product and Commercial teams to ensure predictive models become trusted, production-ready products that drive measurable commercial outcomes. As we continue investing in first-party data, AI, machine learning and advanced marketing measurement, we're looking for an experienced Data Science leader to help shape the next phase of our commercial Data Science capability.
Responsibilties:

items: Commercial Data Science: Lead the strategy and delivery of predictive models that improve customer acquisition, marketing performance and long-term commercial value. You'll shape capabilities including lifetime value modelling, propensity modelling, customer segmentation, forecasting and value-based bidding, ensuring every model is linked to measurable business outcomes.

Marketing Science & Decision Science: Partner with Marketing, Product and Commercial teams to apply Data Science to real business problems. You'll help define how predictive analytics, experimentation and AI improve campaign performance, customer understanding and strategic decision making across platforms including Google and Meta.

Production Data Science: Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to ensure models become reliable, production-ready products rather than one-off analyses. You'll champion reproducible experimentation, scalable deployment, model monitoring, retraining strategies and continuous improvement throughout the model lifecycle.

Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while building trusted relationships across the business. You'll translate complex modelling into clear commercial recommendations, influence senior stakeholders through evidence, and help establish Data Science as a trusted driver of business strategy and commercial growth.

You'll evaluate emerging technologies, bring new ideas into the organisation and help ensure our Data Science capability remains commercially relevant and technically leading.

items: Experience leading commercial Data Science, Marketing Science or Decision Science teams.
Strong expertise in predictive analytics, customer analytics, machine learning and statistical modelling.
Experience applying Data Science to marketing performance, customer acquisition, lifetime value or value-based bidding.
Experience productionising machine learning solutions within modern cloud environments and working closely with Engineering and ML Ops teams.
Strong understanding of SQL, Python and modern machine learning frameworks.
Experience working with Google Ads, Meta or other major advertising platforms.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence both technical and commercial audiences.
Experience building and developing high-performing Data Science teams.
Strong commercial judgement, balancing technical excellence with measurable business impact.
A pragmatic approach to AI, applying emerging technologies where they create genuine commercial value.

blocks.text: Nice to Have

items: Experience within affiliate marketing, digital publishing or lead-generation businesses.
Experience working in financial services, insurance or regulated industries.
Experience working directly with Google or Meta Data Science teams.
Experience with attribution modelling and marketing measurement.
Experience building optimisation algorithms for DSPs or advertising platforms.
Experience with causal inference, experimentation frameworks or incrementality testing.
Experience forecasting marketing or commercial performance.
Experience with Vertex AI or equivalent cloud-based machine learning platforms.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering Operations
jobs.text:
Infleqtion is seeking a Director of Engineering Operations within the Quantum Sensing Solutions (QSS) group. This leader will own and continuously improve the engineering operating system that enables multidisciplinary teams to develop, control, review, release, and transition complex quantum technologies and products from concept through manufacturing. The role will initially serve QSS, while establishing practices, systems, and capabilities designed for broader enterprise adoption as the organization grows.
The Director will translate expectations for technical rigor into scalable processes, stage-appropriate governance, quality and configuration controls, engineering tools, laboratory operations, equipment strategies, and technical infrastructure. The Director will lead Quality, Configuration Management and Document Control, and Laboratory Operations, and will work across business areas, programs, engineering disciplines, sites, and corporate functions to create a consistent and usable environment for engineering execution.
The Director will have authority to establish mandatory engineering processes, approve process tailoring within delegated authority, govern major lifecycle gates, and pause reviews or releases when required evidence, configuration integrity, quality readiness, or compliance conditions have not been met. The QSS Chief Engineer remains the ultimate technical authority and may delegate technical authority to Program Chief Engineers or other qualified leaders. Engineering Operations will enable sound technical decisions and verify the integrity of the decision process without routinely substituting for program or discipline-level technical judgment.
The successful candidate will combine broad engineering leadership with practical experience building operating systems for complex hardware and firmware development. This leader must be comfortable applying lightweight controls to exploratory work, increasing rigor as designs mature, and directly engaging at major baseline, release, qualification, and manufacturing-transition points. The role requires a service mindset, independent judgment, and the ability to make compliance and rigor practical in a fast-moving advanced-development environment.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering Operating System and Lifecycle Governance
• Own the QSS engineering lifecycle from concept development through transition to manufacturing, including defined phases, maturity expectations, decision points, required evidence, and accountable roles.
• Establish, implement, and continuously improve mandatory engineering processes that are scalable across programs, products, business areas, technical disciplines, and maturity levels.
• Define and administer a stage-appropriate tailoring model that preserves speed during exploratory development while increasing control, traceability, and assurance as solutions mature.
• Translate practices demonstrated on high-value and high-risk programs into repeatable standards, templates, training, and reusable infrastructure for the broader QSS portfolio.
• Ensure QSS engineering processes remain compatible with enterprise operating models, contractual requirements, customer expectations, and future company-wide adoption.
Technical Gate Reviews and Release Governance
• Own and enforce the technical gate-review process, including review purpose, entrance and exit criteria, required participants, evidence packages, decisions, actions, and closure expectations.
• Provide direct governance at major lifecycle transitions, technical baseline events, product releases, qualification milestones, and manufacturing-transition decisions; delegate routine review and release activities based on product maturity and demonstrated organizational capability.
• Partner with the responsible Chief Engineer, Program Chief Engineer, Program Manager, and technical leads so technical adequacy and operational readiness are evaluated as complementary but distinct decisions.
Quality Management and AS9100 Readiness
• Lead the quality organization and establish an effective, service-oriented quality system supporting the delivery of advanced prototypes, qualification units, low-rate builds, and run-rate products.
• Lead QSS preparation for and maintenance of AS9100 certification, including process definition, deployment, training, internal audits, management review, corrective action, records, and continuous improvement.
• Ensure quality personnel provide practical support to engineering and manufacturing teams while retaining independent authority to identify, document, escalate, and stop work or release when quality or mission-assurance requirements are at risk.
• Maintain an independent quality escalation path to the QSS Chief Engineer and appropriate executive leadership.
Configuration Management, Document Control, and Technical Data
• Lead Configuration Management and Document Control as responsive service functions that enable teams to establish, maintain, and retrieve accurate technical baselines and records.
• Own configuration-management policy and implementation for hardware and firmware, with a roadmap to expand coverage as software and integrated product needs mature.
• Establish controlled processes for requirements, specifications, drawings, bills of material, firmware and software items, test evidence, calibration records, technical reports, customer deliverables, and other product-definition data.
• Ensure configuration and document-control practices integrate effectively with Quality, Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, program controls, and customer data requirements.
Engineering Tools, Digital Workflows, and Knowledge Management
• Serve as the engineering business-process owner for PLM, requirements management, design software, development issue tracking, and knowledge-management environments.
• Define common workflows, data models, integrations, access patterns, governance, and adoption expectations across QSS business areas and sites.
• Partner with IT as the technical system owner to implement reliable, secure, supportable, and usable engineering tools and integrations.
• Lead tool rationalization and roadmap development, balancing enterprise standardization with legitimate discipline, program, customer, and regulatory needs.
• Enable effective capture, reuse, and transfer of engineering knowledge, including standards, templates, libraries, design practices, review findings, and lessons learned.
Laboratories, Technical Facilities, and Equipment
• Lead laboratory operations across QSS and define the technical use, allocation, access, readiness, and evolution of shared engineering spaces, while Facilities retains responsibility for the physical space and building systems.
• Own the lifecycle management of engineering equipment, including requirements, acquisition, configuration, calibration, preventive maintenance, scheduling, utilization, readiness, and retirement.
• Develop coordinated laboratory, test, prototyping, and equipment roadmaps across business areas and geographic locations to reduce duplication, improve utilization, and enable future program and product needs.
• Own consolidated capital-equipment planning and budget governance across engineering and manufacturing, while Engineering Operations and Manufacturing retain operational ownership of their respective equipment.
• Partner with Facilities and EH&S to ensure laboratories, equipment, and technical work practices satisfy applicable safety, environmental, security, and operational requirements.
Engineering Technical Security and Export-Controlled Data
• Define engineering workflow, tool, access, collaboration, storage, transfer, and retention requirements for sensitive and export-controlled technical information.
• Partner with IT, Legal, Trade Compliance, Security, and program leadership to ensure engineering systems and working practices are compliant, auditable, and practical for day-to-day use.
• Ensure engineers understand and consistently apply requirements for handling controlled technical data across sites, programs, suppliers, partners, and customer interfaces.
• Identify and resolve conflicts between engineering usability, collaboration needs, contractual restrictions, cybersecurity controls, and export-control requirements.
Cross-Functional Leadership and Manufacturing Transition
• Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Program Management, and technical leadership to define and continuously improve engineering-release and manufacturing-transition criteria.
• Ensure major transition decisions consider product-definition maturity, configuration baselines, verification evidence, unresolved technical and quality risks, tooling and test readiness, material constraints, training, and post-transfer ownership.
• Work closely with Execution and Staffing Operations to identify emerging capability needs, critical operational gaps, and priorities for hiring, development, partnering, or outsourcing.
• Coordinate engineering operating practices across the United States, United Kingdom, and Australia, accounting for local regulatory, contractual, security, and operational needs while preserving common QSS expectations.
• Provide leadership with clear visibility into systemic engineering risks, process health, quality performance, configuration integrity, laboratory readiness, equipment constraints, release quality, rework, and improvement priorities.
Organizational Leadership
• Build, lead, develop, and retain a high-performing Engineering Operations organization, initially including Quality, Configuration Management and Document Control, and Laboratory Operations.
• Identify existing process and capability owners, clarify their authority and accountabilities, and integrate their work into a coherent QSS operating model.
• Establish a culture of service, technical rigor, independent judgment, accountability, pragmatic compliance, continuous improvement, and constructive cross-functional partnership.
• Develop leaders and subject-matter experts capable of scaling Engineering Operations practices across business areas, sites, and future enterprise applications.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering Productivity and Operations
jobs.text:
Are you ready to shape the future of data?
Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.
In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.
We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.
We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.
About the Role
We're looking for a Director of Engineering Productivity & Operations to lead how our engineering organisation builds, delivers and operates the Maia platform. You'll own the strategy and execution behind our engineering productivity agenda, including the evolution of our software development lifecycle towards an increasingly agentic model, alongside the operational disciplines that keep engineering efficient: metrics, reporting, cloud and tooling spend, and vendor management. Working closely with engineering leaders across the business and with Finance, you'll lead a team spanning developer experience, release engineering and CloudOps, and have real scope to shape the role and make it your own.
What you will be doing
Setting and leading the engineering productivity strategy, driving the move towards an agentic software delivery model across planning, coding, testing, review and deployment.
Owning the roadmap for shared engineering platforms and delivery capabilities, including CI/CD, release automation, observability and the developer experience.
Running the engineering operating rhythm and a trusted metrics framework, giving leadership clear visibility of delivery, quality, reliability and cost.
Leading engineering FinOps and cloud cost optimisation, working with your CloudOps analysts to build forecasting, accountability and sustainable savings.
Managing the engineering tooling portfolio end to end, including vendor evaluation, contract negotiation and renewals, in partnership with Finance, Procurement, Legal and Security.
What we are looking for
Significant engineering leadership experience in SaaS, cloud platform, DevOps, developer experience, SRE or engineering productivity organisations.
A practical understanding of AI-assisted and agentic software development, ideally having led a team that builds AI agents or tooling for engineers, or a genuine drive to learn it fast.
Experience running engineering operations, with a track record of measuring productivity through outcomes rather than activity.
Hands-on experience with cloud cost management, vendor and contract management, and technical procurement.
Excellent communication and sound commercial judgement, with the ability to influence engineering, finance and executive stakeholders.
At Matillion, we are committed to providing competitive salaries in line with market standards. Our estimated compensation range for this position is £141,200 to £211,800, but the final salary will be based on your relevant skills, experience and qualifications demonstrated in the hiring process.
More about Matillion
We operate a flexible working culture that promotes work-life balance, with benefits including:
Company Equity
30 days holiday + bank holiday
5 days paid volunteering leave
Private Health Insurance
Life Insurance
Pension
Access to mental health support
Your Safety
Matillion recruiters will only contact you from @matillion.com email addresses. We occasionally work with trusted recruiting partners; they will always tell you they are working on our behalf. We will never ask for money, fees, or bank details at any point in the hiring process. If something feels off, trust that instinct. Don't click any links. Go straight to to verify open roles or reach us at .
Want to know more?
Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential, not just experience. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch.
Cannot find anything suitable role right now? We still want to hear from you. Drop us a line at .
Find out more about life on #TeamGreen here.
Matillion is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all of our team. Matillion prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Matillion does not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading API
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Product Manager to develop and maintain our core API trading products. This includes managing internal and external stakeholders, developing product iteration plans, establishing and maintaining standards, translating user stories into an API specification, completing competitor analysis, and more.
What You’ll Be Doing
Gather business requirements and API feedback from both internal and external sources, such as feedback from institutional customers, and continuously improve the API product through effective iterative mechanisms.
Study the competitive landscape and industry trends, transforming this information into actionable API product iteration plans that align with the company's actual needs.
Utilize data analytics to create data-driven insights to understand client behaviour.
Cultivate and maintain robust relationships with customers and strategic partners, using their feedback to guide product enhancements and future development.
What We Look For In You
Demonstrates a strong interest in both the blockchain and finance industries.
Minimum 5 years of experience in Product Management or Engineering, preferably related to trading or technology platforms.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Mathematics, or Finance.
Proactive and self-driven, with a logical and data-driven mindset, strong team collaboration skills, and effective communication abilities.
Proficiency in English & Conversational Mandarin (preferred to cross functionally communicate with non-english speaking engineers).
Nice-To-Haves
Experience in crypto, blockchain, building businesses, fintech, and/or financial markets.
Experience in trading financial products, such as stocks, funds, forex, futures, options.
Knowledge in data analytical tools like Python and SQL.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

jobs.title: Vice President, Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
Experian Software Solutions (ESS), is the global product and engineering function delivering world-class software solutions and data through the Ascend Platform. Ascend brings together data, analytics, AI, decisioning, and fraud capabilities to help our clients accelerate digital transformation, improve risk management, detect and prevent fraud, and make faster, more informed customer and business decisions.
The Vice President, Platform Engineering is responsible for leading technology for Identity, Access & SSO, Portal & Design System, Observability, Metrics & Monitoring, and Billing & Metering. This executive oversees the development and evolution of shared platform architecture and horizontal services that Product Engineering and AI & Agentic Platform build on top of, ensuring platform capabilities are built once and consumed as a service across the business.
Reporting to the CTO, this VP will lead a global team of 100+ employees and will work across Experian's global business units to embed scalable, secure platform capabilities that accelerate product innovation, improve operational efficiency, and reduce duplicated engineering effort. The VP serves as the senior technology voice for shared platform capability, shaping enterprise platform strategy, and delivering measurable outcomes across one of the world's leading data and technology companies.
Develop and execute the technology strategy for Identity, Access & SSO, Portal & Design System, Observability, Metrics & Monitoring, and Billing & Metering, scaling platform adoption globally through cloud migration, workload modernization, and platform standardization to enable growth, resiliency, and operational efficiency.
Lead the identity and access strategy underpinning ESS Technology's customer-facing Identity Management capability, driving the development and governance of SSO, RBAC, and authentication infrastructure across products and platforms.
Partner with product, engineering, and regional leaders to prioritize technology investments and drive innovation, applying disciplined engineering standards to ensure platform investments are aligned to strategic business outcomes and deliver measurable ROI.
Lead enterprise platform modernization initiatives, evolving legacy environments into secure, scalable, cloud-native architectures that support long-term business growth, resilience, and cost optimization.
Establish enterprise platform engineering standards, design system and portal strategy, and developer-facing tooling that accelerate engineering productivity and enable scalable, reusable technology capabilities across the business.
Build and evolve the observability and billing infrastructure that other teams instrument against and rely on, including monitoring, tracing, metering, and monetization plumbing, while evaluating and scaling emerging platform technologies across the organization.
Partner with executive leaders across Technology, Product, Security, and regional organizations to align platform investments with growth priorities.
Shape enterprise platform strategy and technology governance by actively contributing to key leadership forums. Act as an ambassador for Experian's platform engineering capability, enhancing the company's profile and influence within the broader technology ecosystem.
Engage regularly with Operating Committee level leaders across the business, including regional Product senior leaders and regional CTOs across the US, UK, EMEA, APAC, and Latin America, requiring sustained senior stakeholder management across geographies and reporting lines.
10+ years leadership experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, identity and access management, or technology product management, including leading large-scale global technology organizations.
Proven track record building and scaling cloud platforms and shared technology capabilities at enterprise scale (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Strong ability to influence senior executives and secure stakeholder commitment, translating complex technical strategies into compelling business outcomes.
Demonstrated success mobilizing multiple business units, engineering teams, and P&L owners to drive adoption of shared platform capabilities and enterprise-wide transformation without direct authority.
Deep understanding of identity, access, observability, and platform technologies, with the strategic judgment to determine capabilities to build, buy, scale, or retire.
Experience operating in regulated industries, with governance accountability for platform engineering standards, identity and access architecture, and design system frameworks across regions and business units.
Location
This is a US based, Remote position with periodic travel.
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Comprehensive executive level total rewards package
Flexible time off including unlimited vacation, volunteer time off, and 12 paid holidays
Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K

jobs.title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
jobs.text:
Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
The opportunity
Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.
More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.
For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.
This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.
We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.
What you will build and lead
As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams.
Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:
access to care, search and booking;
patient messaging and teleconsultation;
the Patient Health Record and patient context;
the app homepage and daily health experience;
health content and prevention;
recommendations, reminders and care plans;
new patient services and subscription experiences;
conversational and AI-powered experiences.
The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.
Your mandate
You will:
Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.
Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.
Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.
Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.
Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.
Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.
Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.
Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.
Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.
Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.
What success looks like
In your first year, you will have:
established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;
raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;
helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;
strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;
developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;
helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.
What we are looking for
You are likely to bring:
Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..
Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.
A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.
Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.
Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.
Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.
A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.
Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.
The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.
A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.
Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.
Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.
A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.
Why Doctolib, why now?
Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.
The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.
You will join at a defining moment:
Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.
AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.
The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.
The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.
The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.
This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.
Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. If you have a disability, please let us know how we can make the recruitment process more accessible.
Information submitted through this application is processed by Doctolib for recruitment purposes. For more information about data processing and your rights, please refer to our privacy policies:
France
Germany
Italy
The Netherlands
For questions about data privacy, please contact hr.dataprivacy@doctolib.com.

jobs.title: Head of Finance Business Partnering, Operations & Technology
jobs.text:
ABOUT TIDE
At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
Tide facts:
Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
Over $300 million raised in funding
3,000 Tideans globally
Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg
ABOUT THE ROLE:
As Tide continues to grow across multiple markets, strong financial management is essential to helping us scale responsibly, profitably and sustainably. As our Head of FP&A, you will serve as a core strategic Finance Business Partner to multiple leadership teams.
In this high-impact, multi-faceted leadership role, you will shape workforce strategies, lead complex investment cases, and oversee key operational expense drivers—from fraud loss P&L and vendor contract structures to AI token costs and cross-functional capacity modeling.
You will bring data-backed financial discipline and strategic oversight to ensure Tide continues gaining operational leverage as we launch new products and expand internationally.
This is a highly visible global leadership role where you will partner closely with Directors, Product & Engineering leads, and the Finance SLT to tell the story behind our numbers and ensure Tide balances ambitious growth with sharp operational and financial discipline.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
This is a global role in which you will:
Partner with Leadership: Act as the key finance business partner to Product & Engineering, Member Ops, Risk & Fraud, and Enablement area leaders, shaping strategic, workforce, procurement, and investment decisions.
Drive Business Cases & Investment Funding: Design and build business cases for Member Ops investments and fraud/risk prevention tooling, managing them through the Finance SLT to sign-off and bridging BizOps to the CFO office.
Lead Capacity & Workforce Planning: Lead capacity modeling and workforce strategies, balancing trade-offs across stakeholders while aligning to finance and SLA targets.
Set Budgets & Target Efficiency: Set budget parameters and efficiency targets across operational teams, connecting Product & Engineering roadmaps directly with operational delivery.

We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.

Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

jobs.title: Vice President, Earned Media, Technology - Burson
jobs.text:
Who we are:
Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.
WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com
For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.
More about the role:
Technology is reshaping how we live, work and do business. For the companies driving that change, earning attention requires a clear point of view, credible proof and stories that connect innovation to what matters to people and stakeholders.
We’re looking for a Vice President, Earned Media — Technology who combines deep technology sector expertise, strong editorial judgment and creative thinking in order to help clients tell stories that shape their reputation and advance their business priorities.
Working across Burson’s U.S. Earned Media Practice and Technology teams, you’ll lead earned strategy and execution for leading technology clients. You’ll partner with client leads to help clients define what they want to be known for and determine what they need to do, say, create or demonstrate to earn that coverage and recognition.
You’ll bring Earned into the work from the beginning, partnering with account and client leaders, strategists, creatives and other specialists to shape ideas that breakthrough in the news cycle, develop narratives and identify opportunities to create news.
This role calls for someone who can translate complex technology into coverage that supports business and human impact, confidently.
What you'll do:
Lead earned media strategy. Translate clients’ business priorities and reputation goals into clear narratives, proactive storytelling opportunities and actionable earned programs. Define the audiences we need to reach, what we want them to understand, how to break through with the right earned outlets that can influence those perceptions.
Find and create the story. Work with clients to uncover the ideas, data, customer experiences and proof points that make their businesses newsworthy. Recommend what clients can do, say or create to give media a compelling reason to pay attention.
Make technology relevant. Connect technical capabilities and product innovation to broader stories about business transformation, competition, work and everyday life. Develop newsworthy narratives that resonate with business, technology and industry audiences.
Provide confident client counsel. Serve as a trusted day-to-day earned advisor, helping clients assess newsworthiness, sharpen their point of view and make informed decision. Help clients understand the evolving media ecosystem and bring sound judgment to sensitive issues, partnering with senior leaders and specialists as needed.
Drive hands-on media engagement. Develop and maintain relationships with national business and technology journalists, trade reporters, newsletter writers, podcasters and independent news creators. Lead pitching and substantive media conversations, securing coverage that advances the client’s narrative.
Integrate Earned from the start. Partner with account leads and colleagues across Strategy, Intelligence, Creative, Social and Digital to shape programs with a compelling earned story at their core.
Use intelligence to sharpen the work. Apply audience insights, media analysis, data and AI-powered tools to identify emerging conversations, narrative opportunities, white space, and timely opportunities. Bring editorial judgment to interpret those findings and translating them into recommendations.
Own Execution. Lead earned workstreams across launches, ongoing storytelling, company events and major industry moments. Set clear priorities, manage timelines and resources, and evaluate results against agreed audience, narrative and reputation objectives.
Develop people and grow the business. Coach junior colleagues on strategy, storytelling, pitching and client counsel. Contribute to new business proposals and presentations, identify opportunities to expand existing relationships, and partner with account leaders on scopes, staffing and budgets.
You’re our ideal candidate if you
Start with the business challenge. You ask what the client wants to achieve and what they want to be known for, then build an earned strategy that connects the two.
Think like an editor. You recognize a compelling story, understand why it matters now and know what evidence will make it credible. You can challenge an idea constructively and help make it stronger.
Understand technology deeply. You’re curious about how technology works, how companies compete and what innovation means for customers, industries and society. You can translate complexity into clear, accessible language.
Combine strategy with execution. You’re comfortable presenting a recommendation to a senior client, writing the pitch and speaking with a reporter.
Understand the modern media ecosystem. You understand the modern media ecosystem and the evolution across established newsrooms, trade media, newsletters, podcasts and news creators—and how to choose the right targets for a particular story to reach an audience.
Bring clarity and ownership. You offer a point of view, direct strategy, set realistic expectations and take responsibility for the quality of your team’s work.
Make the team better. You collaborate generously, give useful feedback and help colleagues build their judgment and confidence. You stay curious and open to learning.
Experience that contributes to success:
Approximately 10–12 years of relevant experience in technology earned media, media relations or communications, with substantial responsibility for earned strategy and execution. Agency experience is preferred.
Direct, hands-on experience in at least two of the following: AI, enterprise/B2B software, or early-stage companies.
A demonstrated ability to turn business objectives and complex technology topics into distinctive narratives and sustained earned media programs.
Strong relationships with business and technology media, alongside an understanding of relevant trade outlets, independent journalists, newsletter writers and news creators.
A track record of securing meaningful coverage through proactive story development, executive positioning, customer storytelling and data-driven ideas.
Experience leading earned workstreams within integrated B2B campaigns, including product launches, company-owned events and major technology industry events.
Experience counseling senior clients and preparing executives for media interviews and other high-visibility opportunities.
Exceptional writing, editing and presentation skills, with the ability to develop clear strategies, compelling pitches, executive messaging and briefing materials.
Experience managing teams and multiple client workstreams, contributing to new business and organic growth, and working within agreed scopes and budgets.
Experience using research, analytics and measurement to inform strategy, improve programs and demonstrate the contribution of earned media.
#LI-FB1
Burson is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package; click here for more details: https://mybenefits.wpp.com/public/welcome.
The base salary for this position at the time of this posting may range between:
$75,000—$180,000 USD
You belong at Burson:
Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.
At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.
