blocks.text: Who We Are

We’re Personified: a managed IT + cybersecurity services provider for campaigns, non-profits, and mission-aligned organizations. Our mission is to lead technology and security programs for our clients, enabling them to focus on their mission-critical work.

We act as an extension of our client teams — we handle all the responsibilities a traditional internal IT team would. We’re in our clients’ Slacks, we’re on a first-name basis with them (and their pets), we’re new hires’ first point of contact, and we’re the first stop for tech and cybersecurity issues. We aim to build trust, and we leverage this to keep the bad actors out.
Some of the biggest names in the progressive space have leaned on us as their trusted IT + cybersecurity partner. We are looking for top IT talent as we continue to scale our team.
About the Role

Personified is looking for a Senior Vice President of Technology to run the operational core of our technology organization: engineering, client support, cybersecurity, and IT operations. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who has run these functions inside a managed service provider before and knows exactly what breaks at scale: ticket queues, on-call rotations, security posture, tooling debt, and how to fix it without slowing the team down.

You'll report to the CTO and own execution across four functional leaders and the day-to-day delivery. You are the person who makes sure the trains run on time, the team is accountable, and our 97% client retention rate stays exactly where it is, or gets better.

This role exists because Personified is growing past the point where one person can run every function directly. We need someone who has done this before, who can walk into a room of client support engineers or a security incident and immediately know what questions to ask.

items: Client Support & Service Delivery — Ensure the team hits our response-time and resolution standards across every client tier. Own escalation paths, staffing models, and the systems (like our Halo ticketing platform) that keep support predictable and measurable.

Cybersecurity — Own the operational security posture across our client base: monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, and compliance readiness. Make sure security isn't a side conversation — it's built into how we operate.
IT Operations — Drive the shift from manual, reactive IT operations toward automation and repeatable processes. Reduce the operational load on the team while improving consistency for clients.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer - Digital Applications (London, GB)
jobs.text:
Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.
With more than 52,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.
About Atos Group
Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 54,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion, operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.
Role Purpose
The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) for the Digital Business Line (BL) is responsible for defining and delivering the technical vision and strategy, driving the transformation agenda which we have embarked on.
As the Technical leader, you will share client engagements, aligning the client’s needs with business objectives and technology execution.
This senior leadership role drives the transformation agenda, leads technical business development, shapes client engagements, and ensures the successful delivery of complex solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Transformation
- Shape and deliver the BL’s transformation vision, integrating product lifecycle management and AI into the operating model.
- Lead engagement with Global BL and Geo technology teams to ensure coordinated execution of the transformation strategy.
- Lead the evolution of engineering delivery from a traditional SDLC to a product/service-oriented capability model.
2. Technical Business Development
- Act as a senior technical advisor to strategic clients, shaping their thinking on Digital Applications services.
- Position the BL as a leader in AI-enabled SDLC services in partnership with Industry teams and customers.
- Provide technical leadership across bids and proposals, ensuring approaches align to modern software engineering and product delivery methods.
- Partner with the presales solutioning team to support business development activities, shaping solution approaches and integrating new service offers into the Digital portfolio.
3. Technology Strategy & Architecture
- Define and maintain the enterprise technology strategy for SDLC and AI platforms.
- Establish architectural standards and governance to ensure security, scalability, and consistency across solutions.
- Evaluate emerging technologies and trends, providing strategic recommendations aligned with policy and legislation.
4. Technical Leadership & Team Management
- Lead and develop high-performing engineering teams and associated technical functions.
- Promote a culture of technical excellence, continuous improvement, and cross-functional collaboration.
5. Delivery Assurance & Governance
- Oversee technical delivery across major programmes, ensuring alignment with architectural standards and quality expectations.
- Lead gated approval processes across solution design, implementation, and deployment.
Required Skills that we’d like you to bring
- Deep knowledge of AI and its application in transforming SDLC practices.
- Expert understanding of product lifecycle management and full-stack engineering.
- Influencing senior stakeholders, including C-suite and business line leadership.
- Eligibility for, or holding, UK Security Clearance (SC).
- Experience representing organisations at industry events, roundtables, and forums, and contributing to thought leadership.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with partners, suppliers, and SMEs to drive innovation and growth.
- A track record of fostering innovation through emerging technology
Additional Requirements
Candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain SC clearance.
Location: UK-based. Remote working is available, with national mobility required.
Benefits
25 days paid leave + National Holidays
Pension Scheme - contributions matched up to 10%
Private Medical Cover
Income Protection
Life Assurance
Flex Benefits Program
We are a care leaver friendly employer, if you require additional support with your application, please contact our recruiter or send an email to our dedicated email.
As a Disability Confident employer, we encourage applications from all applicants, especially, differently abled applicants. We aim to ensure that those who meet the minimum criteria for this position will be offered an interview. We are committed and willing to making reasonable adjustments to the application and assessment process to accommodate your needs.
If you would like to discuss this further, please contact us via our dedicated mailbox: or directly to the responsible recruiter Elvira Dupcheva on
Here at Atos, diversity and inclusion are embedded in our DNA. Read more about our commitment to a fair work environment for all.
Atos is a recognized leader in its industry across Environment, Social and Governance (ESG) criteria. Find out more on our CSR commitment.
Choose your future. Choose Atos.

jobs.title: VP of Product
jobs.text:
About Augintel: We exist to give child welfare leadership and staff a deeper understanding of the people they care for. By building SaaS software applications that apply cutting-edge artificial intelligence and natural language processing techniques, we help clinicians in social services, behavioral health and child welfare – government, private and nonprofit – unlock the value of their unstructured data to improve their understanding, save them time, and help them deliver better outcomes to the people and communities they serve.
Location: Remote (US). Ability to support customers across multiple time zones is required.
Reports To: CEO
Job Summary:
Over the last six years Augintel has built a new category in Child Welfare and has transformed how caseworkers and supervisors do their jobs. We’ve been first to market with an industry-defining product, enjoy exceptional customer retention, and continue to win new business. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need to strengthen both our strategic vision as well as our day-to-day execution.
The Chief Product Officer will be the executive responsible for aligning Augintel’s strategy and product direction and associated operating cadence and cross-functional execution.
This leader will help Augintel maintain the speed and customer intimacy of a founder-led company while building the clarity, accountability, prioritization discipline, and operating infrastructure required for sustainable growth.
At the product level, this leader will own the translation of Augintel’s vision into a cohesive 12–36 month product strategy and roadmap. They will ensure that new products and features do not simply ship, but land in the market with clear positioning, customer value, adoption plans, enablement, and measurable revenue impact.
At the operating level, this leader will build the company-wide rhythms that connect annual strategy to quarterly execution, commitments to operating plans, and customer commitments to product, engineering, and commercial capacity.
The right person is both strategic and hands-on. They can articulate a compelling multi-year product vision, but they also care deeply about roadmap discipline, prioritization, launch quality, customer feedback loops, commercial enablement, financial outcomes, and execution predictability.
The ideal candidate thrives in founder-led organizations transitioning from early-stage success to operational maturity. They excel at balancing customer commitments with long-term strategic investments and are energized by solving complex scaling challenges.
This is a role for a builder, operator, product strategist, and trusted CEO partner. This role is part of the executive team and reports to the CEO.
Responsibilities:
Enterprise Operating Rhythm & Execution
Translate annual strategic product objectives into measurable quarterly execution
Lead company-wide planning processes, including annual planning, quarterly business reviews, and operating reviews
Establish and maintain a consistent cadence of product and go-to-market execution and accountability across the organization
Monitor progress against company objectives and proactively identify execution risks
Product Strategy & Roadmap Leadership
Own Augintel’s product strategy in partnership with the CEO, Engineering, Revenue, Marketing and Customer Impact
Translate CEO vision and market insight into a cohesive 12–36 month product roadmap
Balance near-term customer commitments with long-term strategic product investments
Ensure roadmap decisions are grounded in customer value, commercial potential, technical feasibility, strategic importance, and time-to-market
Establish clear prioritization frameworks that guide what Augintel starts, stops, accelerates, or deprioritizes
Elevate product discovery, customer understanding, design discipline, experimentation, and product decision-making across the company
Represent Product at the executive and board level with clarity, structure, and strategic insight
Cross-Functional Leadership
Facilitate product alignment on priorities, trade-offs, and resource allocation
Drive resolution of cross-functional issues that impede execution
Foster a culture of transparency, constructive debate, and shared ownership
Strategic Portfolio Management
Partner with executive leadership to balance customer commitments, innovation initiatives, and operational investments
Establish frameworks for prioritization and governance
Ensure product investment decisions align with strategic objectives, customer value, and financial outcomes
Drive disciplined decision-making around what the organization starts, stops, accelerates, or deprioritizes
Growth & Commercial Excellence
Partner with Revenue, Marketing and Customer Success leaders to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the commercial engine
Partner with Customer Success Team to identify opportunities to accelerate time-to-value, improve expansion outcomes, and increase customer retention
Partner with Customer Success, Revenue and Marketing to ensure customer insights, adoption trends, and implementation learnings inform company strategy, product priorities, and operational improvements
Support enterprise deal strategy where cross-functional leadership is required
Organizational Scale & Effectiveness
Design and evolve product operating mechanisms appropriate for the company's stage of growth
Clarify product and roadmap related decision rights, ownership models, and escalation paths
Develop scalable product management processes that increase organizational effectiveness without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy
Metrics & Performance Management
Define and monitor the critical metrics that drive performance
Use data to identify emerging risks and opportunities
Ensure the organization focuses on outcomes rather than activity
CEO Partnership
Act as a trusted thought partner to the CEO
Drive follow-through on strategic product initiatives and board commitments
Prepare materials and insights related to product, roadmap and the market for executive and board discussions
Augintel is proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to a stronger workplace and a better product for our users. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to join us in transforming how human services agencies support children, families, and communities.

Job Summary
The Head of Engineering leads the organization's software engineering and technology development function, responsible for building, modernizing, scaling, and maintaining secure and reliable technology products and platforms.
Within Insurance & Investments, the role oversees engineering across insurance platforms, investment systems, customer-facing applications, APIs, enterprise integrations, digital channels, data-intensive applications, and technology modernization initiatives.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, LP
jobs.text:
As a leading financial services and healthcare technology company based on revenue, SS&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has 27,000+ employees in 35 countries. Some 20,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid-market firms, rely on SS&C for expertise, scale, and technology.
Job Description
Director of Product Management, LP
Job Summary
Intralinks, Inc. is seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Product Management to lead the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for our Limited Partner (LP) focused solutions. This role will be instrumental in defining and delivering innovative products that meet the evolving needs of our LP clients within the alternative investments industry.
Job Responsibilities
* **Product Strategy & Vision:** Define and champion the overall product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Intralinks' LP-focused product suite, aligning with company objectives and market opportunities.
* **Market & Customer Research:** Conduct thorough market research, competitive analysis, and customer interviews to identify key LP pain points, unmet needs, and emerging trends. Translate these insights into compelling product requirements and use cases.
* **Product Lifecycle Management:** Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and discovery through development, launch, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate closely with engineering, design, sales, marketing, and client success teams to ensure successful product development and go-to-market execution.
* **Roadmap Definition & Prioritization:** Develop and maintain a detailed product roadmap, prioritizing features and enhancements based on business value, customer impact, and technical feasibility.
* **Requirements Gathering & Specification:** Translate high-level business requirements into detailed product specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria for engineering teams.
* **Performance Monitoring & Analysis:** Define key performance indicators (KPIs) for LP products, monitor product usage and performance, and leverage data to inform future product decisions and iterations.
* **Stakeholder Communication:** Effectively communicate product strategy, progress, and outcomes to internal stakeholders, executive leadership, and external partners.
* **Team Leadership & Mentorship:** Potentially lead and mentor a team of product managers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Job Qualifications
* **Experience:** 10+ years of progressive experience in product management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role (e.g., Director, Senior Manager).
* **Industry Expertise:** Strong understanding of the alternative investments industry, particularly the workflows, challenges, and needs of Limited Partners (LPs). Experience with private equity, venture capital, real estate, or hedge fund operations is highly desirable.
* **Technical Acumen:** Solid understanding of software development methodologies (Agile/Scrum preferred) and the ability to effectively collaborate with engineering teams.
* **Strategic Thinking:** Proven ability to develop and execute comprehensive product strategies that drive business growth and customer satisfaction.
* **Analytical Skills:** Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
* **Communication & Presentation:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
* **Leadership & Influence:** Demonstrated leadership capabilities, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and inspire a shared vision.
* **Customer Focus:** A deep commitment to understanding and serving customer needs, with a track record of delivering user-centric products.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. MBA or relevant Master's degree is a plus.
Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services.
SS&C offers excellent benefits including health, dental, 401k plan, tuition and professional development reimbursement plan.
SS&C Technologies is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant for employment or employee on the basis of race, color, religious creed, gender, age, marital status, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by applicable discrimination laws.
Salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, job related knowledge, skills, abilities, business needs, and geographic regions.NY: Salary range for the position: 175,000 USD to 190,000 USD. Other States Salary range for the position: 175,000 USD to 190,000 USD.

jobs.title: Director Engineering
jobs.text:
Are you passionate about cutting edge technology?
Do you want an opportunity to lead an amazing team of managers and engineers?
Join our Akamai Platform IAM team!
The Platform IAM team is part of Akamai's Cloud Technology Group. We design and operate customer-facing platforms enabling customers to configure and control their delivery, security, and cloud assets. This team owns the IAM tool sets for Akamai's customers using the Akamai Control Center website and the Cloud Manager website. We ensure customers have what they need to configure users for quality, safety, and performance.
Partner with the best
As the Director of Engineering, you will be in a high-impact, global leadership role responsible for steering the engineering strategy, architecture, and execution of Akamai's IAM platform. This leader will scale a high-performing, globally distributed engineering organization to deliver massive-scale, feature-rich, and performant IAM systems.
As the Director of Engineering, you will be responsible for:
Managing mentoring, and growing a large, multidisciplinary global team of managers, software engineers, and architects
Driving the technical roadmap for the IAM platform, ensuring the platform is highly scalable, resilient, and optimized for global, low-latency AuthZ
Overseeing the end-to-end software development lifecycle to ensure all code meets our high standards for quality, safety and performance.
Partnering closely with other teams to translate business vision into concrete technical milestones,
Do what you love
To be successful in this role you will:
Have 15 years of relevant experience and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or its equivalent
Have extensive experience leading large, distributed software engineering teams with a track record of delivering innovative software products
Possess a deep understanding of the IAM ecosystem
Have exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a proven track record of aligning remote, global teams
About us
At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.
Our focus is simple:
Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.
At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.
Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.
FlexBase adapts to your job's needs
Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.
We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.
Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!
Compensation
Akamai is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. For US based candidates only - the base salary for this position ranges from $203,600 - $366,400/year; a candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, certifications and location. Compensation for candidates outside the US will vary. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Akamai provides industry-leading benefits including healthcare, 401K savings plan, company holidays, vacation (in the form of PTO), sick time, family friendly benefits including parental leave and an employee assistance program including a focus on mental and financial wellness; Eligibility requirements apply.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Solution Engineering and Support
jobs.text:
Who We Are
Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.
This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.
The Position
We are a rapidly growing healthcare technology company seeking a Director of Engineering to lead Solution Engineering and Customer Support Operations within our Customer Engineering organization. Reporting directly to the Head of Customer Engineering, you will own our technical engagement with customers before and after implementation: shaping the right solution during the sales cycle, and ensuring stable, high-quality support once customers are live on the Ascend platform. You will partner closely with the Director of Implementations, Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Platform Engineering, and you will build and lead a blended team of onshore employees and offshore contractor partners. Our platform ingests, validates, masters, and analyzes complex specialty pharmacy, hub, and payer data, turning it into actionable insights for biopharmaceutical manufacturers. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements of up to 25%.
Key Accountabilities
Leadership and Operations:
Build, lead, and develop a team of solution engineers, data engineers, and support engineers across onshore FTEs and offshore contractor partners, including hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development.
Define team charters, operating models, and clear handoffs with Implementations (pre-sales to kickoff, and go-live to support) so customers experience one continuous Customer Engineering team.
Establish and report on metrics for both functions, such as SLA attainment, ticket volume and aging, incident trends, estimate accuracy, and solution win rates.
Own capacity planning, contractor vendor relationships, and budget for the teams in scope.
Solution Engineering:
Serve as the technical lead in pre-sales: lead discovery, solution design, technical demos, and responses to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires.
Translate customer business requirements into solution designs that fit the standard Ascend offering, and identify where paid add-on services or custom extracts are needed.
Review SOWs and level-of-effort estimates for technical accuracy, scope, and delivery risk before they are signed.
Own the system architecture view for each customer engagement, covering data sources, ingestion, integrations, and outbound extracts.
Disposition product gaps surfaced during the sales cycle, routing them to Product with clear business context and customer impact.
Ensure a clean technical handoff to Implementations at kickoff, including documented scope, assumptions, and data source inventory.
Customer Support Operations:
Own post-go-live technical support for customers on the Ascend platform, including production support, issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution.
Lead KTLO and sustainment for existing Ascend customers, and drive ongoing optimization to reduce cost and effort.
Build and scale the Ascend support model as new and existing customers go live, including runbooks, coverage, escalation paths, and SLAs.
Partner with Infrastructure and Platform Engineering on environment health, monitoring, data pipeline reliability, and access management.
Manage intake, prioritization, and delivery of customer enhancement requests and ongoing reporting needs.
Identify recurring issues and partner with Product and Engineering on permanent fixes that reduce support load.
Act as the escalation point for critical incidents and data quality issues, communicating clearly with customer and internal stakeholders.
Who You Are
Skills/Knowledge:
Proven people leader who has built and scaled teams, including distributed teams with offshore contractor partners.
Strong hands-on background in data engineering and data platforms: ETL/ELT pipelines, SQL, data modeling, and data quality.
Experience with AWS data and infrastructure services (such as S3, Glue, Lambda, and Redshift or Snowflake) and orchestration tools such as Airflow.
Able to explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders and executives, and to represent Claritas Rx credibly in front of customers.
Experience defining SLAs, support processes, and ticketing workflows (such as Jira Service Management), and using metrics to run the function.
Entrepreneurial and resourceful: we need people who can find creative ways to make a big impact quickly and without much direction.
Requirements:
BS degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or another STEM related field
12+ years of experience in software or data engineering, including 5+ years leading engineering teams
Experience leading both a customer-facing technical team (solution engineering, sales engineering, or professional services) and a technical support or production operations team
Preferred Skills:
SaaS experience in a similar customer-facing role, such as solutions engineering or professional services, ideally at a growth stage or start-up company. Or a consulting background in client-facing technical delivery, such as technology, data, or life sciences consulting.
Understanding of the life sciences commercial data ecosystem, including specialty pharmacy, hub, distributor, and payer data.
Experience supporting customers through a platform migration or major version upgrade.
Experience working with PHI in a HIPAA-regulated data environment.
Join Us
We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.
We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.
In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $195,000 to $220,000 and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.
Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!
At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:
•All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
• We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
• We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
• Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.

jobs.title: Head of Technology and AI
jobs.text:
Head of Technology & AI
Reports to: Founder & CEO
Location: Remote within Canada, with travel for client and team meetings
Scope: Technology leadership across AEQ’s Financial Services and Innovate businesses
The opportunity
Aequilibrium (AEQ) is a Canadian technology company, listed among the Top 5 Digital Agencies, Fastest Growing Tech Companies, and Top Employers in British Columbia. AEQ is looking for a technology leader to help shape and drive our next stage of growth. You will be a strategic partner to the CEO and business leaders, a credible adviser to clients, and a leader who develops our technical teams.
AI is changing what clients need from professional services. We want to help them make sound choices, improve how work gets done, and bring valuable solutions into production. You will help define where AEQ should lead, build the capabilities behind that direction, and create opportunities with clients.
This is an active role with substantial client involvement. You will lead senior technology conversations, help originate and win engagements, work directly on selected client assignments, and remain accountable for the quality of the solutions we propose and deliver. You will bring particular credibility to our credit union work while helping AEQ grow in healthcare, government, and other sectors.
What you will own
Set direction and build the practice
Develop and execute AEQ’s technology and AI strategy, with a focused set of priorities, investments, and measurable outcomes.
Identify emerging client needs and turn them into advisory offerings, pilots and repeatable services.
Build a point of view on how AI changes software delivery and the value clients expect from a technology partner.
Decide, with our business leaders, where AEQ should build expertise, form partnerships, or pursue new markets.
Take ownership of progress: bring the right people together, resolve obstacles, and move priorities from discussion to delivery.
Create opportunities and lead clients
Build trusted relationships with senior client leaders and help them navigate complex technology and AI decisions.
Work with Sales and Delivery to develop opportunities, lead discovery, and shape proposals, architectures, estimates, and delivery plans.
Serve on selected client engagements as a principal architect, strategic adviser, or fractional technology leader.
Connect technology choices to business outcomes, commercial realities, implementation risk, and the client’s ability to sustain the solution.
Provide technical leadership from the first client conversation through delivery, especially when an engagement changes direction or encounters a difficult decision.
Make AI useful and responsible
Lead AEQ’s AI initiatives with a clear purpose, committed capacity, and a small number of valuable initiatives.
Work with clients and teams to identify uses of AI with a credible path from experiment to production.
Establish practical approaches to human review, privacy, security, quality and measurement.
Turn successful work into capabilities AEQ can demonstrate, deliver and support, not isolated experiments.
Develop our people
Coach senior technologists and help them grow as architects, client advisers and leaders.
Set clear expectations for technical ownership, decision-making and collaboration across teams.
Strengthen engineering and architecture practices using lessons from client delivery.
Help recruit people who add technical depth, sound judgment and initiative to AEQ.
What you bring
A demonstrated record of initiating, winning, and delivering technology consulting or professional services work. We will ask what you personally identified, built, and brought to a result.
Deep enough technical experience to earn the trust of architects and engineers, combined with the judgment to lead business conversations.
Experience advising senior clients, shaping complex proposals and making commitments that delivery teams can meet.
Practical understanding of modern software architecture, cloud, integration, data and AI—including where AI is useful and where it introduces risk.
Experience developing technical leaders and building capabilities that extend beyond your own contributions.
Commercial understanding of a services business: scope, pricing, staffing, utilization, partnerships and client outcomes.
Experience with credit unions, digital banking, or core modernization is a strong advantage. We also welcome leaders with relevant experience in healthcare, government, or other complex environments. Expertise in a particular vendor platform is not required.
How you will work at AEQ
You will report to the CEO and partner closely with the leaders of Financial Services sales, Delivery, and Innovate. You will lead our technology direction while giving senior technologists meaningful ownership in their areas of expertise.
We expect approximately half your time to involve clients and pursuits as the practice develops, including paid advisory work, solution leadership and strategic presales. We will set billable and commercial targets separately so the time required to build the practice is clear.
What success looks like after six months
AEQ has a focused technology and AI plan that the leadership team and technical leads are actively executing.
You have helped originate or advance meaningful client opportunities, with clear evidence of your contribution.
Major pursuits and engagements have credible technical leadership, sound estimates, and clear delivery ownership.
The AI pod has demonstrated a valuable capability and has a defined route to a client pilot or production use.
Clients seek AEQ’s advice on consequential technology decisions, and our technical leads have grown through your coaching and trust.
Why join AEQ
AEQ is at a point where a technology leader can shape what we become. You will work directly with our founder and business leaders, influence which opportunities we pursue, and help turn promising ideas into services clients use. Our work spans credit unions, healthcare, government and immersive technology, giving you room to build an AI practice with real client problems, experienced technologists and a clear path from strategy to delivery.
Compensation
This full-time executive role offers a base salary of CAD $160,000–$200,000, plus a performance bonus tied to agreed business growth, client, and leadership outcomes. The successful candidate will also be eligible for consideration for stock option grants under AEQ’s executive stock option plan, subject to the plan terms and grant approval. The package includes benefits and support for professional development.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director of Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
The Marmon Group LLC
As a part of the global industrial organization Marmon Holdings—which is backed by Berkshire Hathaway—you’ll be doing things that matter, leading at every level, and winning a better way. We’re committed to making a positive impact on the world, providing you with diverse learning and working opportunities, and fostering a culture where everyone’s empowered to be their best.
Marmon Metal Services Group is seeking a hands-on Director of Data and Analytics to lead our enterprise data strategy and deliver practical, scalable analytics solutions. You will oversee the integration of ERP and business applications with our data platform, partner with business and IT leaders to improve decision-making, and remain actively involved in architecture, development, governance, team leadership, and user adoption.
What You'll Be Doing:
Develop and execute the enterprise data and analytics strategy, roadmap, priorities, and success measures.
Lead the architecture, development, deployment, and support of scalable data platforms, models, pipelines, dashboards, and reporting solutions.
Advance Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure data services, SQL, and Epicor Grow as core analytics capabilities.
Integrate Epicor Kinetic and other enterprise applications to deliver reliable, consistent, and timely information.
Partner with executives and functional leaders to translate business needs into practical analytics solutions and measurable outcomes.
Establish pragmatic data governance, quality, security, stewardship, and documentation standards.
Lead and develop a small analytics and BI team while remaining actively involved in technical delivery and issue resolution.
Build data literacy and self-service capabilities through training, documentation, and user support.
Identify opportunities to automate reporting and responsibly apply advanced analytics and AI.
Travel:
Up to 25% travel to Marmon Metal Services locations for implementations, discovery, training, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement.
What Makes You a Great Fit:
Bachelor’s degree in data science, computer science, information systems, business analytics, engineering, or a related field; an advanced degree or equivalent practical experience is an asset.
8–10+ years of progressive experience in data analytics, business intelligence, data engineering, or enterprise data, including 3–5 years leading teams or major cross-functional initiatives.
Current hands-on expertise with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Azure data services, SQL, dimensional data modelling, semantic models, data pipelines, and enterprise reporting.
Proven ability to design, build, troubleshoot, and optimize production analytics solutions while guiding technical professionals.
Experience integrating ERP systems with enterprise analytics environments; Epicor Kinetic experience is strongly preferred.
Working knowledge of data governance, quality, security, privacy, master data, and enterprise architecture.
Strong business partnership, communication, change leadership, and prioritization skills, ideally gained in distribution, manufacturing, supply chain, finance, sales, or operations.
Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States for any employer. Sponsorship for work authorization (e.g., H-1B, green card, etc.) is not available.
Marmon Holdings is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law
Following receipt of a conditional offer of employment, candidates will be required to complete additional job-related screening processes as permitted or required by applicable law.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and all applicants will be considered for employment without attention to their membership in any protected class. If you require any reasonable accommodation to complete your application or any part of the recruiting process, please email your request to , and please be sure to include the title and the location of the position for which you are applying.

jobs.text:
Responsible for leading and managing the Delivery & Support team for the bank's most critical application - Core Banking.
Developing and executing the support strategy of technology by achieving objectives and goals. Responsibilities include guiding and mentoring the team and delivering high-quality support services.
The role delivers information technology solutions to meet business and functional requirements. Responsible for managing the SDLC of Change Management in Core Banking from business requirements to technical specifications, delivery, and post-implementation maintenance activities.
Accountable for supporting and managing the Core Banking system, which can impact the bank with financial losses, reputational issues, regulator warnings/penalties, and operational losses.
Responsible for leading the Core Production Support function within SLA, schedule, budget, and scope parameters, including testing and overseeing quality and compliance controls throughout the project life cycle.
The role delivers information technology solutions to meet business and functional requirements. Responsible for leading the Core Banking team within budget and scope parameters, including testing and overseeing quality and compliance controls.
Manage a diverse team of professionals, including offshore and outsourced personnel, responsible for application support across the bank.
Lead the application and integration team. As an essential member of the governance committee, oversee policy development, vendor selection, use case evaluation, and project approvals. Cultivate a culture of innovation to ensure the successful implementation and support of core banking technologies, establishing a robust, scalable, and resilient platform.
Effectively manage the "Run the Bank" team with responsibilities encompassing stability, monitoring and control, capacity management, and incident management of the bank's most critical applications.
Ensure the achievement of agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
Review and evaluate business requirements against existing and proposed systems, recommending an appropriate approach for providing solutions.
Analyze the impact of functional requirement changes on existing systems.
Direct and assist the development team in verifying the resolution of issues/functions developed by the team.
Actively participate in issue resolution activities by guiding and assisting the development team and building a strong functional relationship with them.
Understand business requirements from the bank and effectively convert them into Requirement Specifications and Functional Specifications.
Manage and maintain documentation describing custom configuration and parameterization of third-party provided solutions.
Provide technical guidance, information, and instruction to other IT staff requiring broader subject knowledge.
Program manage the implementation and modernization of large-scale core digital banking platforms.
Ensure the successful implementation of the PROGRAM DELIVERY’s strategy, responsibilities, services, and deliverables.
Monitor program reporting and assist the team in reporting to senior management and stakeholders.
Oversee project costs and ensure finances are well managed.
Provide and maintain a capacity planning and resource tracking service across the program.
Track financial reporting while ensuring that the program and projects adhere to the agreed budget.
Ensure cross-program dependencies are managed and the dependency log is accurately maintained.
Foster cohesion within the team and motivate members to produce quality work.
Provide project planning, milestone management, scope management, and resource forecasting.
Prepare regular status reports for engagement leadership.
Ensure awareness of and adherence to compliance/risk implications.
Seek regular updates from vendors, consultants, and the bank team on delivery progress.
Escalate slippages to stakeholders as necessary.
Proven experience in cross-border team management
Demonstrated ability to plan, execute, control, and close projects while managing multiple components with minimal supervision
Extensive experience managing large-scale core banking transformations
Expertise in overseeing the complete project lifecycle with teams ranging from 25 to 50 members
Proficient in project management methodologies such as AGILE or PRINCE2 for medium to large-sized projects
Strong skills in developing and maintaining project and program plans, including risk management, action tracking, issue resolution, and dependency mapping
Highly efficient in resource planning and task assignment
Knowledgeable in benefits realization, dependency mapping, and resource

jobs.title: Assistant Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
Hotel Name: M Social Sunnyvale
Location: Onsite – Sunnyvale, CA
Salary Range: $85,000.00 - $90,000.00
Join the Team at M Social Sunnyvale
At M Social Sunnyvale, we don’t just welcome guests—we create moments, spark connections, and bring energy to every interaction. Designed for the young at heart, M Social delivers a bold and vibrant hospitality experience.
About M Social Sunnyvale
As the first ground-up M Social in the U.S., this innovative property features 263 rooms, a dynamic courtyard, and the signature Beast & Butterflies social hub. Located in Silicon Valley, the hotel blends technology, design, and social connectivity to create a unique guest experience.
As part of Millennium Hotels & Resorts, a global hospitality leader with over 145 hotels across key destinations worldwide, our hotel is backed by a legacy of quality, consistency, and service excellence—driven by a passion for hospitality, an entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a progressive, solutions-oriented approach."
At Millennium, we are guided by our core values:
Passion for Hospitality – Delivering meaningful and memorable guest experiences
Entrepreneurial – Taking ownership and acting with agility
Innovation & Progressive – Continuously improving how we operate and serve
Solutions & Results Oriented – Staying adaptable and focused on results
These values shape how we work, how we lead, and how we create exceptional experiences for our guests and our teams.
About the Role:
As our Assistant Director of Engineering, you will support the Director of Engineering in overseeing the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and upkeep of the hotel’s building, equipment, systems, and facilities. You will play a key role in ensuring the property operates safely, efficiently, and consistently while maintaining the high standards expected at M Social Sunnyvale.
This role is ideal for an experienced engineering professional with strong leadership skills, technical knowledge, and a hands-on approach to hotel maintenance. You will work closely with Engineering, Housekeeping, Front Office, Food & Beverage, Security, and other hotel departments to quickly address maintenance needs and support an exceptional guest experience.
Your Impact – Engineering & Guest Experience
You will play a key role in maintaining a safe, comfortable, and well-functioning hotel environment for both guests and team members. Your leadership, technical expertise, and attention to detail will contribute to the reliability of hotel systems, preventative maintenance efforts, operational efficiency, and overall guest satisfaction.
What You'll Be Doing
Engineering Operations
Support the Director of Engineering in overseeing the daily operations of the Engineering Department
Assist with the maintenance and operation of the hotel’s building systems, equipment, and facilities
Conduct regular inspections of guest rooms, public areas, back-of-house areas, and mechanical spaces
Respond to maintenance requests and ensure work orders are completed accurately and in a timely manner
Prioritize urgent maintenance issues and coordinate appropriate response
Assist with troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other building systems
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, inspections, and equipment conditions
Support the Engineering Department in maintaining a clean, organized, and professional work environment
Preventative Maintenance
Assist in developing and maintaining preventative maintenance schedules for hotel equipment and systems
Ensure routine inspections and preventative maintenance tasks are completed according to established schedules
Identify potential equipment or facility issues before they impact guests or hotel operations
Monitor the condition and performance of mechanical equipment and building systems
Recommend repairs, replacements, or improvements when necessary
Assist with maintaining equipment manuals, maintenance records, and service documentation
Team Leadership & Development
Assist in supervising, training, and developing Engineering team members
Provide direction and support to Engineering staff during daily operations
Assign and prioritize work orders based on operational needs
Monitor the quality and completion of work performed by Engineering team members
Foster a collaborative, accountable, and service-focused department
Support scheduling and staffing needs within the Engineering Department
Lead by example and promote a positive team environment
Guest & Hotel Support
Respond promptly to guest and operational maintenance requests
Work closely with Front Office and other departments to address guest room and public area concerns
Communicate maintenance-related issues and updates to hotel leadership
Assist with resolving guest concerns related to room conditions, temperature, plumbing, electrical systems, and other facility issues
Support hotel operations during high-volume periods, emergencies, and special events
Maintain a strong focus on guest comfort, safety, and overall experience
Safety & Compliance
Ensure Engineering operations follow all applicable safety regulations, company policies, and hotel procedures
Conduct and document required safety inspections and maintenance checks
Identify and report potential safety hazards promptly
Support compliance with fire and life safety requirements
Assist with emergency response procedures and building-related emergencies
Ensure proper use, storage, and maintenance of tools, equipment, and chemicals
Maintain compliance with applicable environmental, health, and safety regulations
Coordinate with outside contractors and service providers when specialized repairs or inspections are required
Energy & Facility Management
Monitor hotel utility systems and identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency
Assist with monitoring HVAC, electrical, plumbing, lighting, water, and other building systems
Support initiatives designed to reduce energy consumption and operating costs
Help maintain efficient operation of hotel facilities while minimizing disruption to guests
Communicate equipment issues and recommended improvements to the Director of Engineering

jobs.title: Smart Mobility Hub - Tolling Technology Principal Director
jobs.text:
We Are:
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services - all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Over 500,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities. Visit us at www.accenture.com.
You Are:
A tolling technology leader with deep expertise in electronic toll collection, back-office and roadside systems, multi-lane free-flow (MLFF) technology, interoperability frameworks, and large-scale tolling modernization. You understand how to help agencies and infrastructure operators deploy, integrate, and evolve complex tolling technology platforms while balancing operational performance, financial objectives, customer expectations, regulatory requirements, and cybersecurity considerations. You have led significant technology portfolios, built executive relationships with agencies and vendors, developed market growth strategies, and created high-performing delivery organizations. You are a trusted advisor who can shape complex technology opportunities, mobilize multidisciplinary engineering and consulting teams, and translate tolling industry challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You combine deep technical credibility, commercial acumen, and delivery discipline with a passion for advancing safer, more efficient, and revenue-optimized tolling operations.
The Work:
Lead the growth and expansion of Accenture's Smart Mobility Hub tolling technology portfolio across North America, with a focus on back-office modernization, roadside systems, and interoperability platforms.
Develop and maintain executive relationships with tolling agencies, transportation authorities, state departments of transportation, concessionaires, and infrastructure operators.
Originate, qualify, shape, and support closure of strategic tolling technology opportunities, including back-office platform replacements, MLFF deployments, interoperability integrations, and end-to-end system modernizations.
Serve as an executive sponsor and delivery advisor for complex modernization programs, providing oversight of outcomes, governance, financial performance, risk, and client satisfaction.
Lead and grow Accenture’s customer service operations technology practice within the tolling portfolio, encompassing contact center platforms, CRM systems, self-service digital channels, workforce management tools, omnichannel customer engagement, and AI-powered service automation for tolling agencies and operators.
Shape technology offerings across tolling back-office modernization (CSC, violations, collections), roadside and MLFF systems, electronic payment and account management platforms, customer service operations technology, interoperability hubs, revenue assurance, cybersecurity, data analytics, and AI/ML enablement for tolling operations.
Build reusable Smart Mobility Hub technology assets, reference architectures, delivery methods, accelerators, tolling platform solution narratives, and industry credentials to accelerate client pursuits.
Collaborate across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, Song, and ecosystem partners to create integrated client solutions.
Lead industry thought leadership through client forums, conferences, associations, publications, and executive roundtables.
Recruit, mentor, and develop tolling technology practitioners — including systems architects, integration engineers, and platform specialists — while strengthening succession planning and technical industry capability.
Bring disciplined portfolio management, forecasting, and operational governance to pursuits and delivery programs.
Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirement
Here's What You Need:
A minimum of 12 years of experience in tolling technology, electronic toll collection, transportation systems integration, back-office platforms, roadside technology, or a closely related infrastructure technology field.
A minimum of 8 years of experience leading large-scale tolling technology modernization programs, systems integration delivery organizations, technology consulting engagements, or complex multi-vendor implementation programs.
Demonstrated experience managing executive client relationships and engaging with C-suite, agency, authority, or senior public-sector leaders.
Demonstrated experience shaping business opportunities, strategic pursuits, proposals, or market growth initiatives.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience
Bonus Points If:
You have leadership of major transportation technology portfolios or multi-program delivery organizations with P&L, forecasting, margin, or cash-flow accountability.
You have hands-on experience with electronic toll collection technology, commercial or operational back-office systems, MLFF/AET roadside deployments, transponder and license plate recognition systems, interoperability protocols (e.g., E-ZPass, ETAN), violations processing, collections workflow, or revenue assurance platforms.
You have experience with public-private partnerships, concessions, design-build, or multidisciplinary system integration programs.
You have experience applying AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, computer vision, cloud-native architectures, or enterprise platforms to improve tolling technology delivery, revenue optimization, or operational performance.
You have experience leading PMO transformation, ERP adoption, enterprise governance, organizational change, or workforce development.
You have active participation or leadership in IBTTA, ITS America, AASHTO, or related transportation industry organizations.
You have advanced degree or relevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent.
Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience. As required by local law, Accenture provides a reasonable range of compensation for roles that may be hired as set forth below.

items: Lead the growth and expansion of Accenture's Smart Mobility Hub tolling technology portfolio across North America, with a focus on back-office modernization, roadside systems, and interoperability platforms.
Develop and maintain executive relationships with tolling agencies, transportation authorities, state departments of transportation, concessionaires, and infrastructure operators.

Originate, qualify, shape, and support closure of strategic tolling technology opportunities, including back-office platform replacements, MLFF deployments, interoperability integrations, and end-to-end system modernizations.
Serve as an executive sponsor and delivery advisor for complex modernization programs, providing oversight of outcomes, governance, financial performance, risk, and client satisfaction.

Lead and grow Accenture’s customer service operations technology practice within the tolling portfolio, encompassing contact center platforms, CRM systems, self-service digital channels, workforce management tools, omnichannel customer engagement, and AI-powered service automation for tolling agencies and operators.

Shape technology offerings across tolling back-office modernization (CSC, violations, collections), roadside and MLFF systems, electronic payment and account management platforms, customer service operations technology, interoperability hubs, revenue assurance, cybersecurity, data analytics, and AI/ML enablement for tolling operations.

Build reusable Smart Mobility Hub technology assets, reference architectures, delivery methods, accelerators, tolling platform solution narratives, and industry credentials to accelerate client pursuits.
Collaborate across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X, Song, and ecosystem partners to create integrated client solutions.
Lead industry thought leadership through client forums, conferences, associations, publications, and executive roundtables.

Recruit, mentor, and develop tolling technology practitioners — including systems architects, integration engineers, and platform specialists — while strengthening succession planning and technical industry capability.
Bring disciplined portfolio management, forecasting, and operational governance to pursuits and delivery programs.

blocks.text: Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 0 to 100% depending on business need and client requirement
Here's What You Need:

items: A minimum of 12 years of experience in tolling technology, electronic toll collection, transportation systems integration, back-office platforms, roadside technology, or a closely related infrastructure technology field.

A minimum of 8 years of experience leading large-scale tolling technology modernization programs, systems integration delivery organizations, technology consulting engagements, or complex multi-vendor implementation programs.
Demonstrated experience managing executive client relationships and engaging with C-suite, agency, authority, or senior public-sector leaders.
Demonstrated experience shaping business opportunities, strategic pursuits, proposals, or market growth initiatives.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years' work experience). If Associate’s Degree, must have equivalent minimum 6-year work experience

blocks.text: Bonus Points If:

items: You have leadership of major transportation technology portfolios or multi-program delivery organizations with P&L, forecasting, margin, or cash-flow accountability.

You have hands-on experience with electronic toll collection technology, commercial or operational back-office systems, MLFF/AET roadside deployments, transponder and license plate recognition systems, interoperability protocols (e.g., E-ZPass, ETAN), violations processing, collections workflow, or revenue assurance platforms.
You have experience with public-private partnerships, concessions, design-build, or multidisciplinary system integration programs.

You have experience applying AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, computer vision, cloud-native architectures, or enterprise platforms to improve tolling technology delivery, revenue optimization, or operational performance.
You have experience leading PMO transformation, ERP adoption, enterprise governance, organizational change, or workforce development.
You have active participation or leadership in IBTTA, ITS America, AASHTO, or related transportation industry organizations.
You have advanced degree or relevant certifications such as PMP, PgMP, SAFe, or equivalent.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Developer Infrastructure
jobs.text:
About Fullscript
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.
This is your invitation.
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Role
We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to lead high-impact engineering teams and shape the future of Fullscript’s platform. You’ll drive technical vision, scalability, and innovation, ensuring our technology empowers practitioners to provide better patient care.
As a strategic and hands-on leader, you’ll guide engineering teams, managers, and cross-functional partners to deliver exceptional products and infrastructure. Your role is to enable teams to move quickly, solve complex technical challenges, and ensure our systems scale to meet growing demand.
This role bridges the gap between infrastructure teams and product engineering, focusing on developer productivity, system reliability, and scalability
What You'll Do
Define and execute the technical vision, architecture, and roadmap for multiple engineering teams.
Lead, mentor, and scale engineering teams, fostering a culture of collaboration, learning, and impact.
Ensure technical excellence by establishing best practices in engineering, security, and performance.
Support platform growth while maintaining system reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
Collaborate with executives to align engineering priorities with business objectives.
Champion strong engineering practices, including managing technical debt, observability, and long-term maintainability
Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, and continuous improvement, incorporating learnings from launches and retrospectives
What You Bring
Experience leading engineering teams that build customer-facing applications at scale
Strong track record in growing and mentoring technical leaders and senior engineers
Proven ability to drive collaboration across engineering, product, design, and data teams.
The ability to own team outcomes end-to-end, balancing delivery, quality, and long-term technical health
Broad technical fluency across your team’s domain, with the ability to engage in design discussions and guide technical decision-making
Strong execution skills - you can forecast, communicate progress, manage risk, and adapt plans as needed
What You Get
Ability to work Wherever You Work Well*
Flexible Paid Time Off program
Fullscript’s RRSP match program
Stock Options
Custom benefits package (medical, dental, vision) with HSA
Discount on Fullscript catalog of products for family & friends
Training budget and company-wide learning initiatives
Employee Wellness Programs (including no meeting Wednesday)
*Our Wherever You Work Well philosophy means Fullscript teammates get to pick their own office - whether that’s in-office, at home, or a bit of both 🐶🏡
Why Fullscript
Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.
What to Know Before You Apply
We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.
A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.
Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at .
All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.
We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.
Learn More

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Secure File Gateway and ICAP
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
Why This Role Matters
At OPSWAT, protecting the world’s critical infrastructure is not an abstract mission. It is real, urgent, and growing. Our ICAP product is a proven, high-impact solution that is trusted by customers who depend on us to secure their most critical systems. We are now ready to take ICAP to the next level.
This Director role is a rare opportunity to shape the future of ICAP, including the evolution toward a next-generation Proxy, while scaling commercial impact and deepening customer value. You will operate at the intersection of product strategy, engineering execution, and go-to-market success, with clear ownership and visible impact. If you are energized by building success, driving innovation, and owning outcomes, this role was designed for you.
What You Will Be Doing
As Director of AI Product Management, you will be the end-to-end owner of ICAP’s product strategy and growth trajectory.
You will:
Set and own the ICAP product vision and roadmap, including the strategic evolution into a Proxy-focused solution.
Translate market signals, customer needs, and competitive insights into clear product direction and prioritized investments.
Partner deeply with Engineering, ensuring fast, high-quality execution and scalable architecture.
Work closely with Sales, Sales Engineering, and Marketing to drive bookings, pipeline, and customer adoption.
Serve as a strong, visible product leader across regions, with a close partnership with our Vietnam-based teams.
Balance innovation with operational excellence, ensuring ICAP continues to deliver reliability, performance, and trust at scale.
Represent ICAP with confidence to customers, partners, and internal leadership.
What Success Looks Like
In your first 12–18 months, success will look like:
A clear, compelling ICAP roadmap aligned to market demand and customer value.
Measurable growth in bookings and pipeline tied directly to product strategy.
Strong, trust-based partnerships with Engineering and GTM teams.
Progress toward a Proxy-focused architecture that positions ICAP for long-term growth.
A product organization that moves with urgency, clarity, and accountability.
Who You Are
You are a product leader who blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
You bring:
Proven experience leading enterprise or security products at scale.
Deep hands on experience building with AI.
Strong understanding of proxy technologies, ICAP, networking, or adjacent security domains.
A track record of partnering effectively with Engineering to deliver complex products.
Commercial acumen and experience supporting bookings, pipeline, and customer conversations.
Comfort operating in a global, distributed environment, including close collaboration with teams in Vietnam.
Clear, confident communication and the ability to influence across functions.
A mindset rooted in ownership, urgency, and continuous improvement.
Director-level experience is preferred, but we value demonstrated leadership altitude, judgment, and impact above title alone.
Why OPSWAT?
OPSWAT is a fast-growing cybersecurity company with a strong culture of ownership and innovation. We build products that matter, support leaders who take initiative, and invest in those who want to grow.
In this role, you will:
Own a successful, revenue-generating product with a meaningful runway.
Shape the future of ICAP and Proxy innovation.
Work with smart, committed teams across the globe.
Have direct visibility and influence within Product leadership.
If you are looking for a role where your decisions matter, your leadership is visible, and your work protects what matters most, we would love to meet you.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.
