jobs.title: Director of Product Management — MetaDefender Cloud
jobs.text:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.
The Position
This is a hands-on, business-owner product leadership role, not a pure strategy or coordination seat. An experienced product manager reports to you, with full people responsibility, and dedicated cloud engineering teams partner with you daily. You operate like a general manager, fluent in packaging, pricing models, and metering, and conversant in NDR and GDR. You understand the whole business, from sales enablement and marketing through inbound and digital motion to field events and channel partners, and hold every investment to a strong ROI. You also carry the platform responsibility everything else depends on: performance, availability, migration, and cost. You bring an AI-first mindset, leveraging AI in the day-to-day work of the team to maximize efficiency and output.
Join a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader at the forefront of innovation. We protect the unseen — the infrastructure that powers our way of life. OPSWAT protects the world’s critical infrastructure across IT, OT, and ICS environments, trusted by more than 2,000 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide.
We are seeking an exceptional product leader to own the vision, strategy, and execution of MetaDefender Cloud, the verdict as an API. Enterprises, governments, and technology partners send it files and get back a decision they can trust (“is this file safe to admit?”) at any volume. This is business ownership of a trust-critical enterprise cloud: the commercial ladder from self-serve developer entry to a top tier for regulated buyers, and everything that makes it credible, from contractual SLAs, availability, and failover to compliance, cost efficiency, and a platform other OPSWAT services build on. You will grow the business through product-led motion, cloud marketplaces, distribution channels, and a Technology Partners program that makes joining our ecosystem a product action, not a sales project.
MetaDefender Cloud delivers OPSWAT’s prevention technologies (multiscanning, Deep CDR, and AI-driven analysis) as a cloud service, and is the shared platform behind a growing family of OPSWAT cloud offerings. This role owns that business end to end:
• The Prevention Ladder: one coherent tier ladder from self-serve developer entry to full enterprise, sold to one buyer who moves up as throughput and analysis depth grow.
• The Regulated Enterprise: the top of the ladder: dedicated capacity, the strictest SLAs, large-file support, and a strict data-privacy and data-handling posture for regulated industries.
• A Resilient, Compliant Cloud: reliability as a product, with availability targets, failover, recovery objectives, multi-region resilience, and certifications such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2 that make trust a reason to buy.
• The Platform Behind OPSWAT’s Cloud Services: one API and platform that web proxy and ICAP protection, MetaDefender Secure Storage, email security, MetaDefender for Salesforce, and the threat-hunting tier build on.
• Performance & Cost Efficiency: industry-leading speed to verdict, and a cost-per-scan discipline that protects margin as volume grows. You own the unit economics.
• Technology Partners & Developer Ecosystem: the program for engine partners who strengthen detection, integration partners who put our verdict where security teams work, and developers who build it into their own products.
• Marketplaces & Distribution: taking the product where buyers already purchase: cloud marketplaces such as AWS and Azure, distribution channels, and reseller partners, plus new offerings, such as MetaDefender Private for dedicated deployments, as the market demands.
What You Will be Doing
• Own the business: define and champion the vision, strategy, and roadmap for MetaDefender Cloud, and be accountable for growth, adoption, and commercial outcomes.
• Own reliability as a product: make contractual SLAs (latency, availability, and recovery objectives) the standard across every tier, and drive high availability, automatic failover, and multi-region resilience from roadmap to contract.
• Own compliance & regulation: maintain and extend our certifications (ISO 27001, SOC 2, and beyond) and the data-privacy and data-residency posture, so regulated buyers can say yes.
• Run the platform for its stakeholders: treat the OPSWAT services built on the cloud (web proxy and ICAP, secure storage, email, Salesforce, threat hunting) as first-class customers, balancing their needs with one coherent platform.
• Own pricing & packaging: design and maintain the prevention tier ladder, packaging, metering, and discount guidance, steward the one price book with your Aether counterpart, and monitor realization against list.
• Drive cost efficiency: own cost per scan and the margin story, and make efficiency a continuous, measured program.
• Lead the platform evolution: carry customers through major platform transitions, with migration paths that never ask them to break their integration, and retire legacy offerings cleanly.
• Grow marketplaces & distribution: list the product on the cloud marketplaces where buyers already purchase, grow channel and reseller partnerships, and build the no-touch motion behind them.
• Build the Technology Partners program: make joining the ecosystem a product action, with SDKs, API documentation, and automated onboarding and vetting, so every engine, integration, and developer partner adds detection, reach, or data.
• Champion product-led growth: the product sells the product. Own every self-serve and paid-conversion motion, including from the free community, plus the inbound and digital funnels and the upgrade path.
• Tailor the experience to the persona: know the cloud architect, platform engineer, and enterprise security leader in financial services, SaaS, and technology, and shape onboarding, console, and API experiences around their daily work.
• Enable the field & measure ROI: own sales enablement and the proof the field needs, show up at the anchor events that matter, work channel partners deliberately, and hold every motion to a strong ROI.
• Monitor the business: track the KPIs that matter (tier mix, NDR and GDR, realization, platform performance, unit cost) and use them to steer investment.
• Build and lead the team: lead, mentor, and grow the MetaDefender Cloud product team, small and senior today, and scale it as the business scales.
• Communicate with stakeholders: clearly articulate strategy, progress, and results to internal teams, executive leadership, and customers, fostering alignment and enthusiasm.
What We Need from You
• Product management experience: 5+ years in product management of cloud or SaaS products, ideally in cybersecurity or another trust-critical enterprise service. Experience leading product managers is a strong plus.
• Cloud-service operating depth: you have run a high-availability, multi-tenant cloud service as a product (SLA and SLO design, recovery objectives, failover, multi-region architecture) and are credible with SRE and platform engineering.
• Compliance & regulatory fluency: hands-on experience taking a cloud product through certifications such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, or PCI DSS, and shaping data-privacy and data-residency posture for regulated buyers.
• Business-owner fluency: demonstrated ability to run a product line as a business (packaging, pricing models, metering, unit economics), with fluency in NDR, GDR, and recurring-revenue metrics.
• Marketplace & channel experience: you have grown a product through cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, or equivalent), channel, or reseller partners, or built that motion from zero.
• Platform product thinking: experience evolving a shared platform that multiple products build on, balancing reuse with each consumer’s speed and autonomy.
• Product-led growth: experience with self-serve, developer-facing offerings: onboarding funnels, API-first products, and conversion into enterprise contracts.
• Persona-driven product craft: a track record of building experiences around sharply defined users, backed by research, usage data, and design partnership.
• AI-first ways of working: an AI-first mindset: you actively apply AI tools to your own and your team’s daily work to move faster and raise quality.
• Hands-on and technical: comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with R&D day to day, engaging credibly on APIs, cloud architecture, and trade-offs, and going deep in the product.
• Track record of delivery: proven experience managing products from concept through launch, with results in user adoption, revenue growth, or market penetration.
• Analytical & decisive: strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with a data-driven approach.
• Exceptional communicator: outstanding interpersonal and executive communication skills, enabling collaboration across cross-functional teams and credibility with customers and leadership.
• Travel: willingness to travel regularly to field events, customers, and R&D sites.
• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field; MBA is a plus.
• Ways of working: familiarity with Agile methodologies or similar frameworks.
Why You’ll Love Working Here
• Own the prevent half of a focused two-product strategy at a pre-IPO, global cybersecurity leader: a trust-critical cloud with executive attention.
• Reliability, compliance, and cost are the product here. Rare scope for a leader who wants to own an enterprise cloud end to end.
• Shape a platform: the cloud you run is the foundation a growing family of OPSWAT services builds on.
• Take a proven product into marketplaces, self-serve, and a partner ecosystem. The growth levers are yours to build.
• Work hands-on with world-class global R&D teams on a service that protects critical infrastructure.
• Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.
OPSWAT is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to providing an environment where equal employment opportunities are extended to all employees and applicants, free of discrimination and harassment of any type. All employment decisions are based on individual qualifications, job requirements, and business needs without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other category protected by federal, state, or local laws.
Recruiting Agencies: we do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party agencies for any of our open positions. To submit resumes for our jobs, there must be a recruiting contract approved by our legal team and endorsed by both parties. We are currently not accepting additional 3rd party agencies at this time.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
About the Role
The CTO will own technology for doit Holdings, our regulated investment platform in Malaysia. This is a build role. The platform does not exist yet, and it has to be built inside a technology risk framework that satisfies the Securities Commission's Guidelines on Technology Risk Management from the first line of code. The role runs from architecture and engineering execution through to the systems evidence the SC assesses at registration.
What you will be doing
Own architecture and major technical decisions for the platform, from onboarding and order routing through records, reporting and the partner interfaces.
Build and lead the engineering team, and set standards across reliability, security, performance, testing and code quality.
Implement the SC's technology risk requirements as engineering practice: change control and approvals, secure development, testing and acceptance, capacity and resilience.
Produce the systems evidence behind the readiness declaration a director and the Responsible Person must sign before the platform may operate.
Take the platform through the independent technology validation that gates registration, and close what it finds.
Own business continuity and disaster recovery, tested rather than documented.
Own cloud, vendor and outsourcing arrangements, where the board remains accountable for everything outsourced.
Location
This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.
Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.
Language
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
Interview Process
Our process is designed to move fast:
1. Online assessment or practical task
2. Technical interview
3. CEO / final round
For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Product Management, Consumer
jobs.text:
About Ethos
Ethos is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
About the Role
We're looking for an exceptional product leader to join our Consumer Product team as Director of Product Management. This team is responsible for building a delightful digital consumer experience — from onboarding users and helping them understand their families' needs, to purchasing the right insurance products to protect what matters most. As Director, you will own the strategy and execution of our core consumer product surface, leading a team of product managers and partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Data Science, and Marketing. The ideal candidate combines first-principles thinking, deep consumer empathy, and organizational leadership to drive both team excellence and meaningful business outcomes. You'll set the vision, build the team, and be accountable for results at scale. We're looking for an entrepreneurial product leader who is passionate about advocating on behalf of users, building and developing high-performing PM teams, and driving sustainable business growth — all while operating with a high degree of ownership in a product-first company.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Leadership & People Management
Lead, mentor, and grow a team of product managers, fostering a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement
Set clear goals and development plans for direct reports; conduct regular performance reviews and provide ongoing coaching
Partner with recruiting to grow the PM team as the business scales, identifying talent and building a strong hiring pipeline
Create clarity and alignment across the team on priorities, roadmap, and success metrics

jobs.title: Senior Director, Security Technology Specialist
jobs.text:
As a Lead Product Specialist you will use your knowledge and experience to work with customers to better understand their needs and challenges and map them to capabilities across our products and services. You’ll work closely with the Cloud Software Group (CSG) field teams and provide hands-on product expertise to a variety of customer segments, including many Fortune 100 & 500 customers, to deliver technical outcomes that help drive the successful adoption and expansion of our solutions. As a specialist, you’ll focus on new and advanced capabilities of our products as well as use cases to help support expanding the customer’s journey with CSG. As part of the Product Specialist team you’ll work with Account Technology Strategists, Account Executives, SolutionEnterprise Architects, Customer Success and Field CTOs to establish a shared vision with our customers and help them achieve their strategic goals.
Role Responsibility:
Deliver subject matter expert knowledge on designated specialist focus areas and establish yourself as a trusted advisor within the customer to accelerate time to value
Deliver complex, customized demonstrations and proof of value that highlight the outcomes that can be delivered
Navigate technical decision points, architecture, and technical strategy to aid in the adoption and expansion of products and services
Support a successful hands-on technical onboarding experience by managing readiness and assisting with the initial configuration to adopt new products and services
Build awareness of products and features and help remove barriers to adoption
Collaboration with cross-functional teams within the Cloud Software Group including Account Executives, Account Technical Specialists,, Demo Center team, Enablement, and Solution Architects
Collaborate with Product Management to provide bi-directional feedback to and from the PM team to influence product roadmap and provide valuable customer feedback
Help drive awareness into the field technical teams on product specialties including new technical capabilities, new tech previews, customer use cases, and success stories
Delivering value throughout the life of the subscription by supporting the accounts teams, driving deep solution awareness
Have good communication skills, consistently communicating status, next steps, risks, etc. to both internal and external stakeholders
Support emerging technical needs, working to uncover use cases and customer success stories to share with the field
Contribute to internal initiatives to deliver webinars, presentations, and the creation of reference architectures, Techzone guides, etc. to aid onboarding and adoption of new technologies within the field and our customer accounts
Basic Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in a technical domain, including but not limited to Computer Science, Engineering IT, or equivalent experience is required experience
8 + years in a high-tech customer-facing role (Professional Services, engineering, systems administrator, sales engineering, or consulting)
High level of specialized knowledge of Cloud Software Group products, including Citrix and NetScaler
Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Certifications are a plus
Ability to effectively deliver and implement technical projects across multiple simultaneous engagements in a customer-facing capacity
Excellent oral, written skills and presentation skills
An excellent customer service demeanor and able to engage with different levels of audiences
About Us:
Cloud Software Group is one of the world’s largest cloud solution providers, serving more than 100 million users around the globe. When you join Cloud Software Group, you are making a difference for real people, each of whom count on our suite of cloud-based products to get work done — from anywhere. Members of our team will tell you that we value passion for technology and the courage to take risks. Everyone is empowered to learn, dream, and build the future of work. We are on the brink of another Cambrian leap -- a moment of immense evolution and growth. And we need your expertise and experience to do it. Now is the perfect time to move your skills to the cloud.
Cloud Software Group is firmly committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and to compliance with all federal, state and local laws that prohibit employment discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, creed, sex or gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, ethnicity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, religion, genetic carrier status, disability, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions (including lactation status), marital status, military service, protected veteran status, political activity or affiliation, taking or requesting statutorily protected leave and other protected classifications.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Software Engineering
jobs.text:
Our Company
Explore how you can contribute at AmeriLife.
For over 50 years, AmeriLife has been a leader in the development, marketing and distribution of annuity, life and health insurance solutions for those planning for and living in retirement.
Associates get satisfaction from knowing they provide agents, marketers and carrier partners the support needed to succeed in a rapidly evolving industry.
Job Summary
This role leads a team or teams responsible for technology solutions that meet business needs and satisfy risk and operational requirements of the Tech organization. Identify and resolves complex technical, operational, risk management, and organizational challenges for an LOB or several Sub LOBs. Leverage emerging technologies and automation to improve business efficiencies, enhance speed-to-market of solution delivery, and support business and enterprise transformation and optimization. Has full management responsibilities for teammates: hiring, disciplinary, coaching, terminating, performance reviews.
In an Agile environment: Act as an Agile champion. Primarily responsible for delivering high quality working software and automating manual/reusable tasks. Leverage engineering practices to deliver business value. Responsible for oversight of software engineering and unit testing, and supporting integration and functional testing. Oversee warranty support and knowledge transfer to production support. Ensure developed code is in accordance with the acceptance criteria established by the Product Owner.
Job Description
Duties/Responsibilities
The following reflects duties for this job but does not restrict the tasks that may be assigned. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time for business reasons.
Direct the engineering and deployment of significant delivery projects in accordance with specified technical requirements, schedules and budgets, including Agile methodologies.
Oversee the planning, design, engineering, testing and deployment of application projects in conjunction with a variety of resources, which may include Waterfall or Agile approaches.
Develop departmental plans, including business, financial, production and/or organizational priorities based on IT and focuses on long-term operations planning and performance, and broader business objectives and priorities.
Apply an in-depth understanding of systems engineering and administration and a basic understanding of other IT disciplines in guiding and coaching team members.
Identify and resolve complex technical, operational, and organizational problems.
Impact results by supporting the funding of projects, products, services, and/or technologies.
Maintain appropriate Risk Profile through owning the first line of Risk defense, proactively identifying risks, and implementing the necessary mitigations where warranted. Partner effectively with 2nd line of defense, Auditor, and regulators to ensure Risk is identified and mitigated appropriately.
May play lead role or technical consultant role in large or complex projects or initiatives.
Has full management responsibilities for teammates: hiring, disciplinary, coaching, terminating, performance reviews.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Bachelor's degree and equivalent education and experience, which could include any combination of eight years of experience in IT software engineering, five years’ relevant business experience (i.e. making technical-related decisions on the business side), five years’ experience in ect management, and at least two years of management experience
Broad and in-depth knowledge of technology trends, competitive environment, regulatory requirements and trends, and IT strategies employed to continually meet the demands of clients and regulators
Ability to translate enterprise level strategic planning information into software and data management needs, create business plans, and turn them into effective business solutions
Executive level communications skills, including, strong negotiation/facilitation/presentation skills and experience negotiating with vendors for relevant products and services
Ability to solve unique and highly complex technical, operational, and organizational problems
Ability to lead and manage the performance of multiple teams against a set of financial and operational objectives
Experience managing projects with enterprise-wide implications from conception through implementation
Preferred Qualifications
Understanding of multiple approaches to Software Engineering
Full understanding of Agile methodology
Experience leading teams in an Agile organization, particularly those practicing DevSecOps, and/or are in transition from traditional waterfall approach to Agile approach
Banking or financial services experience
Compensation
Salary Range: $195,000 to $210,000
This role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus.
Salary offers will vary commensurate with experience, education, skills, and training
What AmeriLife Offers
A comprehensive benefits package that includes PTO, medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, disability insurance, and life insurance.
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and value diversity at all levels of the organization. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable federal, state, or local law. We are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable, and respectful workplace where all employees can thrive.
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Statement
We are committed to full compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and all applicable state and local disability laws. Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities throughout the application and employment process. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially. If you require assistance or accommodation during the application process, please contact us at .
Pay Transparency Statement
We are committed to pay transparency and equity, in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Compensation for this role will be determined based on skills, qualifications, experience, and market factors. Where required by law, the pay range for this position will be disclosed in the job posting or provided upon request. Additional compensation information, such as benefits, bonuses, and commissions, will be provided as required by law. We do not discriminate or retaliate against employees or applicants for inquiring about, discussing, or disclosing their pay or the pay of another employee or applicant, as protected under applicable law. Pay ranges are available upon request.
Background Screening Statement
Employment offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background screening, which may include employment verification, education verification, criminal history check, and other job-related inquiries, as permitted by law. All screenings are conducted in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, and information collected will be kept confidential. If any adverse decision is made based on the results, applicants will be notified and given an opportunity to respond.

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.text:
This role is part of our Prerender team, one of our largest brands atsaas.group.
Prerender is a dynamic rendering SaaS platform within thesaas.group portfolio. Since 2017, we've revolutionized SEO practices by enabling search engines to crawl JavaScript-heavy sites seamlessly while preserving user experience. Thousands of companies worldwide trust our platform, which serves over 2.7 billion unique pages to web crawlers and drives results for enterprises and growing businesses alike.
Profile Overview
Prerender has built a platform that thousands of companies trust to serve billions of pages to web crawlers. Now we're evolving into something bigger: the layer that makes the web legible to machines, both the search crawlers that have always mattered and the AI systems that increasingly decide what people find.
To get there, we need to transform how we build product. We're looking for a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to lead that transformation, shifting our engineering organization from infrastructure-optimization to a high-velocity, product-focused team that moves fast and ships features that matter.
This is a building role, not a caretaker role. You'll own the technology vision, set the engineering strategy, and have authority over the R&D budget, team, and technical direction. You'll embed AI-first engineering practices, make smart infrastructure tradeoffs, and build the improvement motion that makes delivery faster and keeps it that way.
You'll lead a small, senior engineering team — around seven engineers today — supported by shared platform and DevOps resources fromsaas.group's central team. There is no management layer between you and the engineers, which puts you close to the work and means the leadership has to come from you.
So we need someone hands-on enough to augment the team, not to manage it from a distance, and who can do that without losing hold of the strategy and the responsibilities only this role carries.
We need deep technical expertise, a strong infrastructure background, and a proven track record of transforming engineering teams at SaaS companies.
Your responsibilities
Technology Vision and Strategy:
Own the technology vision, roadmap, and engineering strategy for Prerender. Align engineering work with business objectives and customer value.
Lead adoption of AI-assisted development tooling to multiply team productivity; own the quality bar for what it produces.
Drive architecture and infrastructure decisions with a holistic view of TCO that includes maintenance burden and engineering opportunity cost, not just hosting spend.
Run a multi-region, Kubernetes-based render fleet efficiently: cost per render, reliability, and the operational hygiene that keeps both from drifting.
Represent Prerender's technical capabilities to customers, partners, and the broader market.
Maintain high standards of software quality, performance, security, and reliability.
Track shifts in technology and engineering practice, and bring the ones that change how we build into the team.
Security and Compliance:
Own security and compliance as a standing program. Prerender completes SOC 2 Type II and its ISO 27001 certification decision at the end of 2026; you inherit the year-two observation period, the surveillance audit, and the operational discipline that keeps both credible.
Keep the program legible to someone other than you: named owners, current vendor and auditor contacts, and no single point of failure.
Team Management and Growth:

jobs.title: Director of Product Management
jobs.text:
SWIVEL is seeking a talented individual to serve as Director of Product Management. This person is responsible for defining and executing product strategy, driving product performance, and leading a team of Product Managers and a Product Designer. This role owns the success of one or more product portfolios, balancing long-term strategic direction with hands-on product leadership and execution.
The Director is accountable for delivering customer value, revenue growth, market competitiveness, adoption, pricing and monetization strategies, and go-to-market readiness. The role leads a team of four to five individuals and may oversee supporting functions including Competitive Intelligence, Market Research, and Product Commercialization.
Working closely with Executive Leadership, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Operations, Legal, and Compliance, the Director ensures that product investments align with company objectives and market opportunities while driving measurable business outcomes.
Why you'll love this role:
As Director of Product Management, you will help shape the future of SWIVEL's product portfolio while leading a talented team of product professionals. You will influence company strategy, drive customer and commercial outcomes, and own products from concept through commercialization. This role is ideal for a product leader who enjoys balancing strategic vision with hands-on execution and believes product success is measured not only by what is built, but by the business and customer value it delivers.
Essential duties include the following:
Defines and owns the strategic direction, vision, and multi-year roadmap for assigned product portfolios.
Identifies market opportunities, competitive threats, customer needs, and emerging industry trends to inform investment decisions.
Partners with Director of Technical Product Management and Executive Leadership to align product strategy with company objectives, financial targets, and growth initiatives.
Establishes portfolio priorities and makes investment tradeoff decisions across competing opportunities.
Ensures product roadmaps are aligned with customer value, revenue growth, operational efficiency, and strategic objectives.
Owns product business outcomes, including revenue growth, adoption, retention, customer satisfaction, profitability, and market share.
Develops and refines pricing, packaging, monetization, and commercialization strategies.
Partners with Finance and Executive Leadership on business cases, product investments, and return-on-investment analysis.
Defines success metrics and regularly reviews portfolio performance to identify opportunities for growth and optimization.
Drives product lifecycle decisions, including product launches, modernization efforts, expansion opportunities, and retirement strategies.
Oversees go-to-market strategy and launch readiness for major product initiatives.
Partners closely with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and Operations to ensure successful product adoption and commercialization.
Ensures value propositions, positioning, messaging, and product enablement materials effectively communicate product differentiation.
Supports strategic customer engagements, executive briefings, and key client discussions.
Leads market research, competitive intelligence, and customer discovery efforts through direct and indirect resources.
Establishes processes to continuously monitor market trends, competitor activity, regulatory changes, and customer needs.
Incorporates customer feedback, industry insights, and market data into product planning and prioritization.
Maintains working knowledge of Credit Union and Financial Institution market dynamics, customer needs, buying motions, competitive offerings, regulatory considerations, emerging technologies, and industry trends to guide portfolio investment decisions and commercial strategy.
Leads, coaches, develops, and evaluates a team of Product Managers and a Product Designer.
Creates a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer outcomes, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
Establishes clear expectations, operating rhythms, and quality standards for the Product organization.
Identifies organizational capability gaps and develops succession and talent growth plans.
Serves as a mentor and coach to Product Managers, helping elevate product thinking, execution quality, and business acumen.
Remains actively involved in product discovery, prioritization, roadmap decisions, and strategic initiatives.
Reviews and challenges assumptions, business requirements, customer problems, and proposed solutions.
Guides teams in developing features, epics, business cases, and requirements that are aligned with business and customer objectives.
Supports complex initiatives requiring executive alignment, cross-functional coordination, or significant organizational change.
Removes organizational barriers and escalates issues that may impact execution or business outcomes.
Ensures product teams maintain strong backlog discipline, strategic alignment, and execution excellence.
Influences and aligns stakeholders across Engineering, Architecture, Finance, Compliance, Operations, Marketing, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success.
Communicates strategy, priorities, tradeoffs, risks, and performance updates to executive and cross-functional audiences.
Builds trusted partnerships across the organization to drive successful delivery and adoption of product initiatives.
Represents Product Management in executive planning, strategic reviews, and company-wide initiatives.
Serious candidates will possess the minimum qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field.
MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Minimum ten (10) years of Product Management experience, including ownership of product strategy, roadmaps, and measurable business outcomes.
Minimum five (5) years of people leadership experience managing Product Managers or equivalent product organizations.
Demonstrated success leading product portfolios with measurable revenue, adoption, customer satisfaction, and commercial outcomes.
Experience developing product strategies, pricing models, monetization approaches, commercialization plans, and go-to-market initiatives.
Experience conducting market analysis, competitive intelligence, customer research, and market validation activities.
Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive alignment across multiple business functions.
Strong analytical, financial, strategic thinking, prioritization, and decision-making skills.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and executive communication skills.
Minimum five (5) years of experience serving Credit Unions, Financial Institutions, Banks, Fintechs, or related financial services organizations.
Demonstrated understanding of the Credit Union and Financial Institution landscape, including customer needs, buying motions, competitive pressures, and industry trends.
Experience working directly with Credit Union or Financial Institution customers, partners, or executive stakeholders.
Experience delivering or managing products in one or more of the following areas: digital banking, Core Banking, loan payments and debt repayment, ACH, card processing, money movement, banking APIs and SDKs, white-label user experiences, or financial services SaaS solutions.
Broad working knowledge of payment technologies, digital banking ecosystems, and financial services product offerings. Deep technical subject matter expertise is not required.
Ability to travel locally and/or nationally.
SWIVEL offers*:
Competitive overall compensation package
Work/Life balance
Employee engagement activities and recognition awards
Years of Service awards
Career enhancement and growth opportunities
Leadership Academy and Mentor Program
Continuing education and career certifications
Variety of healthcare coverage options
Traditional and Roth 401(k) retirement plans
Lucrative Wellness Program
*Based upon employee eligibility
Additional Information:
SWIVEL is a Substance-Free Workplace and requires pre-employment drug testing.
Please note, SWIVEL does not hire tobacco users as allowed by law.
To learn more about SWIVEL, visit our website at . If interested, please click the appropriate apply button.

jobs.title: Head of Growth & Product
jobs.text:
Goodwall
Goodwall is a TIME100 award-winning social education app that believes learning should be as fun and easy as scrolling on TikTok. Goodwall exists to give every young person the opportunity to pursue a better future, regardless of where they come from or who they know. Our free social education app helps more than 4 million members develop skills, gain confidence and access opportunities that can transform their lives.
Goodwall is free for young people. Our programs are funded by Fortune 500 corporates, government and nonprofit partners, including Microsoft, HP, and the United Nations. The growth we create has to show up in real skills and opportunities, not just downloads, so we use everything in our arsenal, from game design to behavioural psychology, to create the most engaging learning experiences for the next generation.
As a B Corp scale-up backed by leading investors, Goodwall has been recognized as a World Economic Forum Global Innovator, TIME100 Top EdTech, and featured by FastCompany, Bloomberg, CNBC and Forbes. Our next chapter is to transform the lives of 10 million Goodwallers.
Your Role
You will lead Product, Growth and Marketing, working directly with our Co-Founder. You will lead and grow your own team, including an additional Product Manager and Growth Marketing Manager. Your closest partner will be our Head of Engineering, who also leads Data Science.
Your responsibility spans how members discover Goodwall, experience its value, keep coming back and bring their friends. You will set direction and stay close to execution. Every product experience, notification, piece of ad copy, ambassador referral journey and Gen Z creator strategy sits within your remit.
What you will do
Scale a product members love returning to. Own the product roadmap and run product growth experiments that improve activation, retention and referrals. Use onboarding, personalisation, social features, rewards and game design to make learning more engaging.
Accelerate member acquisition. Expand organic growth through ambassadors, referrals, creators and influencers, supported by disciplined paid marketing. Lead our expansion into target markets such as North America.
Bring Product and Growth together. Align both teams around shared priorities. Partner with Engineering and Data Science to turn member insights into improvements, from idea through launch and measurement.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution
jobs.text:
Trustmark’s mission is to improve wellbeing – for everyone. It is a mission grounded in a belief in equality and born from our caring culture. It is a culture we can only realize by building trust. Trust established by ensuring associates feel respected, valued and heard. At Trustmark, you’ll work collaboratively to transform lives and help people, communities and businesses thrive. Flourish in a culture of diversity and inclusion where appreciation, mutual respect and trust are constants, not just for our customers but for ourselves. At Trustmark, we have a commitment to welcoming people, no matter their background, identity or experience, to a workplace where they feel safe being their whole, authentic selves. A workplace made up of diverse, empowered individuals that allows ideas to thrive and enables us to bring the best to our colleagues, clients and communities.
About the role
Trustmark is looking for an Executive Director, Product Strategy and Execution. Please apply if you are qualified and would like to be considered for the role.
Responsible for driving new product development through deep market research, trend analysis, and customer insight to establish and sustain competitive advantage. Identifies emerging market opportunities and translates data-driven insights into a clear product vision and prioritized roadmap aligned with business strategy for group and individual products. . By leveraging continuous discovery and validation, ensures products solve meaningful customer problems while minimizing risk and accelerating time to market. Partners cross-functionally to align innovation efforts with long-term growth objectives and operational execution. Builds repeatable systems for market intelligence, feedback, and performance measurement to support ongoing optimization. Through disciplined governance and outcome-driven decision-making, enables scalable innovation and long-term health product portfolio success.
Key Accountabilities:
Product Development & Leadership
Ensures the health product portfolio is top tier in market; proactively identifies portfolio gaps and leads product prioritization and development to ensure the right offerings are available to sell.
Strong knowledge and insight into the voluntary benefits marketplace, building relationships throughout the voluntary market and deepening understanding of evolving trends.
Primary storyteller in supporting field partners, making sure products are effectively sold, understood, and communicated across teams and channels.
Leads all facets of the product development process including research, product design, sales strategy, market analysis, documentation of product requirements, cost benefit analysis and implementation.
Leads risk analysis on key issues including internal and external resources and capabilities needed to bring new products successfully to market.
Establishes and manages budgets, operational plans for products under development and management.
Leads development of health product claims strategy, including claims integration solutions, as well as ongoing customer experience opportunities.
Responsible for overall value-add/care delivery strategies relative to supplemental health products; manages relationships with external vendors and partners; responsible for RFP/finalist process in partner selection, leading overall process and collaborating internally to identify best options.
Owns product strategy from concept to market by leveraging deep market and competitive analysis to define, position, and champion new product offerings that strengthen the company’s product and business position
Product Execution
Collaboratively works with underwriting, sales and marketing teams to competitively position and build awareness of new products with producers.
Leads as the central point of expertise on product knowledge and market needs, enabling associates to successfully sell and administer the product.
Product Management
Accountable for ensuring all product line initiatives achieve targeted return on investment goals, being adaptive and nimble to drive expected results.
Coaches direct reports on how to maintain product health across the organization; ultimately responsible for success, prioritization, and driving initiatives with internal technology and project partners.
Develops and owns KPIs that measure the success of new product initiatives, providing actionable insights that enable data‑driven decisions and rapid course correction throughout the product lifecycle.
Ensures all products are compliant and timely action is taken to address regulatory changes.
Other duties as needed/assigned.
Minimum Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree.
7-10 years of experience in industry with some experience across product development, product management and implementation.
Experience developing or managing voluntary and/or group products.
Ability to lead/influence without direct oversight.
Proven ability to develop and revise strategy and tactics to propel business growth.
Ability to analyze and interpret challenging concepts and resolve complex issues.
Ability to inspire, lead, and coach both leaders and employees.
Experience working collaboratively across the organization to build consensus and synergies that support attainment of division goals, handle conflicts, negotiate, and promote team spirit.
Must be innovative and creative in looking for ways to improve current processes.
Integrity and strength of character.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Preferred:
Deep broker/market connections in voluntary benefits and adjacent markets.
Sales-related experience, including any client-facing roles – technology, partnerships, account executive/account management, or similar.
Expertise in leading research projects and synthesizing consumer insights.
The compensation range for this role is (based on the corporate location in Lake Forest, Illinois):
$136,933 - $204,463 per year
The final salary offer will be determined based on factors such as location, qualifications, experience, skill set, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for bonus. We understand that compensation is an important factor when considering a new opportunity, and we strive to provide a competitive salary within the market.
Brand: Trustmark
In addition to compensation, we offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: Health/dental/vision, life insurance, FSA and HSA, 401(k) plan, Employee Assistant Program, Back-up Care for Children, Adults and Elders and many health and wellness initiatives. We also offer a Wellness program that enables employees to participate in health initiatives to reduce their insurance premiums. For questions about compensation and benefits, please speak to the Recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview.
Trustmark is committed to leveraging the talent of a diverse workforce to create great opportunities for our people and our business. We are an equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

jobs.title: Product Head
jobs.text:
Senior product leader with strong experience in the fintech ecosystem, specializing in payments, card issuing, and digital wallets. Combines a deep technical understanding of payment infrastructures, APIs, and financial systems with a strong product vision and business mindset to build scalable financial solutions.
Proven ability to lead the end-to-end product lifecycle, from strategy and roadmap definition to execution and scaling. Experienced in working closely with engineering, compliance, and commercial teams to deliver innovative payment products that meet regulatory requirements while driving user adoption and revenue growth.
Strong background in payment rails, card programs (issuing and processing), wallet ecosystems, and fintech integrations, with the ability to translate complex technical capabilities into customer-centric financial products. Skilled at defining product strategy, managing cross-functional teams, and building high-impact fintech platforms in fast-paced environments.
Job Description:
Head of Product – Key Responsibilities
1. Product Strategy
Define and lead theoverall product strategyaligned with the company’s business objectives.
Build and maintain theproduct roadmapfor payments, card issuing, and digital wallet solutions.
Identifymarket opportunities and product gapswithin the fintech ecosystem.
Conductcompetitive and market benchmarkingto ensure the company’s products remain innovative and competitive.
Prioritize product initiatives based oncustomer needs, business impact, and technical feasibility.
2. Product Development & Execution (Hands-on)
Lead theend-to-end product lifecycle, from discovery and design to development, launch, and iteration.
Workhands-on with engineering teamsto define product requirements, technical specifications, and solution architecture.
Actively participate inproduct discovery, feature definition, and backlog prioritization.
Translate business needs intoclear technical requirements and product documentation.
Support teams in solvingcomplex product and technical challengesrelated to payments, card issuing, and wallet infrastructure.
3. Team Leadership
Lead and mentor theProduct Management team, including Product Managers and Product Owners.
Foster adata-driven and customer-centric product culture.
Work cross-functionally withEngineering, Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Commercial teamsto ensure effective product delivery.
4. Payments Ecosystem & Infrastructure
Define the strategy for integrations withpayment processors, card networks (Visa, Mastercard), sponsor banks, and fintech infrastructure providers.
Lead the development ofcard issuing platforms, wallet infrastructure, and payment capabilities.
Ensure product architecture supportsscalability, modularity, and API-first design.
5. Innovation & Technology Vision
Stay ahead ofemerging fintech trends and technologies, including real-time payments, open banking, tokenization, and embedded finance.
Promote the development ofscalable, modular fintech platformscapable of supporting international expansion.
Identify and drivenew capabilities and product innovationswithin the payments ecosystem.
Transnetwork is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: Head of Hardware Engineering - Combustion Systems - Remote
jobs.text:
About Roadrunner Venture Studios
Roadrunner Venture Studios is the nation's leading platform for founding breakthrough ventures in frontier technology. We partner with scientists, engineers, and entrepreneurs to turn deep technology into real companies. Our work spans energy, manufacturing, semiconductors, quantum computing, aerospace, advanced materials, artificial intelligence, and high performance computing.
About the Role
Roadrunner Venture Studios is recruiting a Head of Hardware Engineering for a portfolio company developing rainfall enhancement technology.
You will lead the deployment system from architecture and prototyping through operational qualification and production-scale manufacturing.
You will apply aerospace rigor to industrial hardware that must operate reliably in the field and support repeatable manufacturing at automotive scale. The work spans mechanical, thermal, combustion, fluid, structural, controls, and instrumentation systems.
This is a hands-on role. You will work with internal science and field teams and lead external engineering firms, fabricators, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.
This role includes significant equity.
This is an early-stage startup building something that has not been built before. Priorities will change quickly. If this working environment does not excite you, this role is probably not for you.
What You Will Do
Technical Leadership
System Architecture: Own requirements and architecture across mechanical, thermal, combustion, structural, fluid, gas-handling, controls, and instrumentation systems.
Hardware Development: Lead the system from early design through prototypes, integrated builds, field-ready hardware, and production planning.
Combustion and Thermal Systems: Lead the design and qualification of combustion hardware, fuel and gas handling, flow and pressure systems, and thermal management.
Qualification and Field Operations: Define verification methods and lead shop tests, integrated system tests, field qualification, troubleshooting, and failure reviews.
Manufacturing and External Partners
Turn engineering concepts into computer aided design models, drawings, bills of materials, supplier packages, build instructions, and acceptance criteria.
Lead design for manufacturing and assembly so prototypes can mature into reliable production hardware.
Manage engineering, procurement, and construction firms, fabricators, suppliers, contract manufacturers, and other external partners.
Use test data, field observations, supplier feedback, and failure analysis to drive design improvements and production readiness.
Business and Team Management
Outcome Ownership: Own the hardware schedule, budget, qualification timeline, technical quality, partner deliverables, and production plan.
Team Building: Recruit, mentor, and manage a small team of hardware engineers.
Work across science, field operations, business, and external partners to resolve technical risks and keep the hardware program moving.
Preferred Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or higher in mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, systems engineering, or a related field.
Experience leading complex hardware from concept through prototype builds, operational qualification, and production planning.
High proficiency with computer aided design software such as SolidWorks or NX and product lifecycle management systems.
Experience with engineering release processes, configuration control, drawings, bills of materials, and supplier documentation.
Experience with design for manufacturing and assembly for industrial, aerospace, automotive, robotics, energy, or other complex hardware.
Experience with combustion hardware, thermal systems, fluid systems, gas handling, pressure systems, large field equipment, or power systems.
Experience with test instrumentation, data acquisition, controls interfaces, inspection methods, qualification plans, and operational readiness reviews.
Experience managing engineering firms, fabrication shops, suppliers, contract manufacturers, or engineering, procurement, and construction partners.
Experience supporting field tests or deployments and making engineering decisions under changing operating conditions.
At least three years of experience leading hardware development and developing engineering talent.
Ability to move quickly, take broad ownership, and solve complex problems with limited resources in a startup environment.
Experience with computational fluid dynamics (CFD), especially for combustion, heat transfer, fluid flow, or gas-handling systems.
Experience taking hardware from prototype builds into first-article or low-rate production.
Experience with aerospace, defense, energy, automotive, robotics, or other high-reliability hardware programs.
Experience building a hardware engineering function at an early-stage company.
Location
This role is remote but may be based in the San Francisco Bay Area, California, or New Mexico if you would like to be near on of our hubs. The balance between in-person and remote work can be tailored to the candidate and team needs. Frequent travel is required.

jobs.title: VP, Data Science
jobs.text:
WHAT WE DO MATTERS:
At The Knot Worldwide, we champion celebration - and that starts with celebrating our people. Our employees are passionate dreamers, thoughtful doers, and lifelong learners who power meaningful moments for millions around the world. We’re united by authentic connection, shared purpose, and a deep commitment to the global community we serve. Here, flexibility and belonging go hand in hand with high performance. Driven by our core values, we believe the best ideas come from empowered teams: those who consistently collaborate with intention to design solutions, spark ideas, and drive impact. Our people are at the heart of our success.
ABOUT THE ROLE AND OUR TEAM:
The VP of Data Science & Analytics will lead experimentation, business intelligence, and advanced analytics across our global two-sided marketplace. This role is accountable for driving measurable business outcomes — including growth in couple engagement, marketplace liquidity, vendor ROI, and long-term customer value.
You will own the company’s experimentation strategy and enterprise BI function, ensuring executives and frontline teams alike have trusted, actionable insights. This role will partner closely with data engineering to build reliable, scalable end-to-end data pipelines that power experimentation, analytics, and executive reporting.
You will be the architect of our measurement engine — turning data into durable competitive advantage in a complex, two-sided marketplace. This is a highly visible leadership role reporting to the CPO and partnering across Product, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Sales.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Experimentation & Measurement
Define and scale experimentation strategy across a complex two-sided marketplace (couples and vendors).
Ensure rigorous A/B testing, incrementality measurement, and causal inference across growth, monetization, ranking, and lifecycle initiatives.
Build frameworks that account for cross-side marketplace effects and long-term LTV impact.
Establish clear accountability for experimentation outcomes tied to business performance.
Enterprise BI & Analytics
Own executive dashboards and enterprise reporting from Board-level metrics to team-level KPIs.
Develop and maintain a trusted metrics layer with clear governance and definitions.
Improve forecasting, driver trees, and performance diagnostics tied to CPAs, GMV, and marketplace health.
Enable scalable self-serve analytics capabilities across the organization.
Advanced Data Science
Lead applied data science across personalization, marketplace dynamics, pricing, segmentation, and lifecycle modeling.
Develop robust LTV and marketplace health models.
Partner with ML teams to ensure strong model evaluation and business impact measurement.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Partner closely with Data Engineering to design scalable experimentation infrastructure and data pipelines.
Influence architecture decisions without directly owning DE.
Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on data-driven growth strategy.
SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATES HAVE:
Experience
15+ years in Data Science, Analytics, or quantitative leadership roles.
Experience leading BI and analytics in a large, global organization.
Demonstrated success operating within a two-sided marketplace or platform business.
Proven experience owning experimentation strategy and delivering measurable business impact.
Experience partnering with C-suite and Board stakeholders.
Technical Expertise
Deep knowledge of experimental design, causal inference, and statistical modeling.
Experience building scalable experimentation and analytics ecosystems.
Strong fluency in SQL and modern data tools (e.g., Snowflake, Looker, Sigma, Tableau).
Strong understanding of marketplace unit economics and LTV modeling.
Leadership
Experience building and scaling high-performing Data Science and Analytics teams.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills in matrixed environments.
Ability to translate complex quantitative analysis into clear business insights.
WORK MODEL:
This role is fully remote and not tied to any specific office location. While there are no regular in-office requirements, we encourage our remote team members to gather intentionally for key company and team events to stay connected and engaged.
#executive-track
Starting pay is determined based on a combination of factors which may include location/market, education, experience, skills, and other qualifications of the successful candidate. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, commissions, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. We also offer benefits to eligible employees including medical, dental, retirement, and generous leave policies.
Annual salary range
$235,200—$336,000 USD
At The Knot Worldwide, we believe you are more than a resume and invite you to go for it, take the leap of faith, and apply for this job. Together, we have an incredible opportunity to make it even easier for our customers to plan life’s most meaningful moments and for our small business owners to grow and scale. We would love to have you with us on our journey.
WHAT WE LOVE ABOUT YOU:
Commit to our customers: You act as one team on behalf of our customers. You lead with head and heart, and build what matters for life's most meaningful moments.
Raise the bar: You define "great" and work backwards. You don't just accept how it's been done, but boldly define how it should be. You are unafraid to innovate, learn, and keep moving forward toward our shared vision.
Be all in: You believe in our mission and take ownership of your work. You debate openly to reach the best outcomes, speaking with clarity and care, embracing diverse perspectives, then commit fully.
Celebrate impact: You measure success by the outcomes you create. You hold yourself accountable to delivering value, while recognizing progress and the lessons learned along the way. You love to win, together.
WHAT YOU LOVE ABOUT US:
We believe in a wide range of holistic offerings to support our employees so that they can live our values day in and day out. From mental wellbeing, physical health and financial planning, to engaging perks and discounts, we are in the business of celebrating and supporting the Moments that Matter, both in and out of the office.. We offer flexible vacation, generous parental leave, and prioritize initiatives that support the growth, development, and happiness of our people.
Together@TKWW is our approach to hybrid work. It’s designed to support how we work best: combining the flexibility we value with meaningful opportunities to connect in person. Whether a role is Together@TKWW-eligible or not, we believe in purposeful moments to come together, build strong relationships, and drive bold ideas forward.
For Together@TKWW-eligible roles, this includes regular in-office time to foster collaboration and connection.
For roles not eligible for in-office expectations, we support connection through virtual collaboration and intentional gatherings.
To facilitate in-person collaboration, we have office spaces in Barcelona, Spain; Delhi, India; Galway, Ireland; London, England; New York, NY; and Washington, D.C.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
As the Director, Product Management, you will lead product strategy and execution for North America B2B cashflow capabilities. You will use market, customer, and data insights to develop and launch products, with a focus on financial services, data, and identity-related solutions.
You will report to the SVP of Product Management.
You'll have the opportunity to:
Define and execute the North America B2B cashflow product strategy and roadmap.
Lead new product launches using market intelligence, customer feedback, and opportunity size.
Use customer and stakeholder insights to identify needs and prioritize product opportunities.
Track the competitive landscape, evolving customer needs, and emerging data use cases, including identity data.
Partner with Sales and other teams on go-to-market plans, market feedback, and product adoption.
Identify data, partner, and integration opportunities that expand product capabilities and revenue.
Represent the product with clients and external audiences and contribute product thought leadership.
Collaborate across regional and global teams, business units, and partners to grow and protect the business.
Your background:
8+ years of product management experience.
Experience in financial services or data strategy.
Demonstrated people management experience.
Experience working with identity solutions, identity data, or adjacent domains is preferred.
Experience working with both existing and emerging data products.
Experience engaging senior stakeholders, including Director- and VP-level audiences.
Experience collaborating across Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, and other internal teams; comfortable engaging directly with the market and clients.
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. You will be also eligible for a variable pay opportunity.

Great compensation package and bonus plan
Core benefits including medical, dental, vision, and matching 401K

jobs.title: Head of Data Practitioner
jobs.text:
(This role can be based from anywhere in Europe on a fully remote basis)
Head of Data Practitioner
What we believe
Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.
Our role
We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.
Our approach
The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.
What we value
Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.
If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'll fit right in.
About the role
Crosslake is looking for a Head of Data to lead data engagements. In this role, you will work with private equity investors and portfolio company leadership teams to turn data opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
You will own senior client relationships on complex data engagements, building credibility with CDOs, CTOs and other executive stakeholders while leading the work from strategic diagnosis through to practical delivery.
The ideal candidate combines the breadth of a strong consulting leader with deep expertise in data strategy, data transformation and modern data platforms.
You will be expected to shape the problem, develop the data strategy, lead complex transformations, manage senior stakeholders, drive the storyline and own delivery, while credibly challenging clients and specialists on the substance of the work.
This is a role for someone who can move confidently between business, technology and data conversations, connecting strategic ambition to the data capabilities, operating-model changes, investment choices and delivery roadmap required to realise value.
Role responsibilities
Own client relationships on data engagements, establishing trusted partnerships with senior business and technology leaders and acting as a credible advisor to CDOs, CTOs and executive teams.
Lead the development of data strategies that align business priorities, value-creation opportunities, target data capabilities, technology choices, operating model and delivery roadmap.
Lead complex data transformations from diagnosis through to implementation planning, including data platform modernisation, data governance, data quality, data product and analytics initiatives.
Bring structure to ambiguous data challenges, defining the key questions, building the workplan, managing workstreams and keeping the team focused on the issues that matter most to the client.
Develop compelling executive-level narratives that synthesise analysis, client input and specialist perspectives into practical recommendations and clear decisions.
Translate effectively between commercial and technical audiences, ensuring recommendations reflect business priorities, data realities, architecture implications, delivery feasibility and execution risk.
Link data initiatives to value creation economics, including opportunity sizing, business cases, investment requirements, benefits, trade-offs and dependencies.
Challenge assumptions, pressure-test recommendations and identify where deeper expertise is needed across data engineering, architecture, governance, analytics, AI or transformation.
Drive engagements beyond analysis towards prioritised actions, accountable delivery plans and a pragmatic path from recommendation to execution.
What we’re looking for
Experience operating at a level comparable to a high-performing consulting Director, Associate Director or Senior Consultant, with a track record of leading complex data engagements and senior client relationships.

Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.
