jobs.title: Head of Technology - USA
jobs.text:
Head of Technology (USA) - Hybrid (Greater Los Angeles, CA)
About the Role
Reporting to the GM – Technology, the purpose of the Head of Technology is to run Eco Outdoor's technology operations and delivery day to day, so our systems, vendors and projects keep pace with a business growing quickly across the US, Australia, and New Zealand.
This role keeps our core platforms and partners (Salesforce, NetSuite, website and IT managed service providers) reliable and well supported, delivers technology projects on time and on budget, and builds a function that can scale shoulder-to-shoulder with the business. It also owns the technology in our offices and showrooms, and a repeatable model for fitting out new US locations.
The Head of Technology partners closely with the GM Technology as a genuine deputy, and with leaders across Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, People & Culture, Product, and Finance in both the US and Australia.
The role is onsite/hybrid and based in the greater Los Angeles, CA area. The working schedule is 10:00am – 6:00pm (Pacific Time), Monday to Friday. The later start is intended to give daily overlap with our Sydney team. The role includes occasional travel to Sydney and to our team in Semarang, Indonesia.
Key Outputs
Technology Operations and Managed Services
Keep our core business systems, Salesforce, NetSuite and our digital platforms, stable, secure and well supported across every region.
Own day-to-day IT service across Australia and the US, delivered through our IT managed services partners, so our people get fast, reliable support wherever they work.
Set and track service standards with each partner, with regular service reviews, so issues are resolved within SLAs and root causes are fixed rather than patched.
Lead the evaluation of whether our managed services partners are fit to support the business's future growth, and drive the changes needed where they aren't.
Workplace Technology
Make sure day-to-day physical technology works seamlessly across our offices and showrooms: AV, hardware and devices, office networking and wireless access points.
Own the hardware lifecycle, from procurement and setup through to maintenance and replacement.
Showroom and Site Buildouts
Partner with our Showroom Development and Construction Manager to support our physical growth across the US.
Build a repeatable, documented technology model for new showrooms and sites, covering network, AV and hardware standards, suppliers, budgets and timelines.
Make sure every new location opens technology-ready from day one, and refine the model with each build.
Delivery
Run the technology project register and delivery cadence: scope, priority, timelines, budgets and status reporting.
Make sure projects ship on time and to budget, with dependencies and risks surfaced early.
Translate business needs from Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Marketing, People & Culture, Product, and Finance into clear priorities, with structure and discipline around how new work is requested and signed off.
Vendors, Partners and Procurement
Own our relationships with technology vendors and agencies in Australia and the US, leading procurement and contract renewals and holding them to agreed outcomes.
Keep technology spend visible and within budget.
Leadership and Deputy to the GM Technology
Lead a distributed team across the US, Australia and Indonesia, spanning systems engineering, systems administration and website, with working rhythms that make the most of our overlapping hours.
Set clear priorities, coach and develop the team, and build a culture of ownership and follow-through.
Represent technology in operational decisions, and step in for the GM Technology when needed.
Be the senior, accountable, visible technology presence in our US business as it grows.
Security, Governance and Continuous Improvement
Own day-to-day security across our systems, devices and networks, working with our managed services partners on access management, patching, backups and incident response, and reporting on cyber risk to the GM Technology.
Maintain clear documentation and processes across our core systems.
Work with our architecture and data leads so operational work supports our AI and automation roadmap.
Skills and Experience
8+ years' experience in technology operations, IT or business systems, including at least 3 years leading teams.
Hands-on experience with Salesforce and/or NetSuite, whether in administration, integration or management.
A proven track record delivering technology projects with strong delivery discipline, whether Agile, waterfall or a mix.
Experience managing vendors, agencies and IT managed services providers, including negotiating contracts and scopes of work, and running a partner evaluation or transition.
Working knowledge of physical IT infrastructure (networking, wireless, AV and end-user hardware) and cyber security frameworks such as NIST or CIS.
Experience leading distributed teams across multiple time zones.
Enough technical depth to evaluate vendor proposals and have detailed conversations with engineers and architects, so the business gets long-term value.
A degree in IT, engineering or business, or equivalent work experience.
Strong understanding of change management when delivering technology to the business, with the ability to build buy-in from business stakeholders and sponsors.
Bonus: experience in a growing multi-region business, rolling out technology for new retail, showroom or office locations, or exposure to data platforms, AI and automation.
Please note that we require full permanent working rights for this position.
Behaviors
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical leaders, whilst being comfortable presenting at all-in company meetings.
A true collaborator who builds strong relationships across regions and functions.
A solution-focused mindset, with the judgement to make calls independently.
Organized and accountable: you follow through and don't let things drop.
A strong sense of curiosity, particularly about how AI and automation can change the way work gets done.
In return, we’ll give you…
Perks, benefits and the space to grow. We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package and plenty of opportunities for career growth and development. This includes:
Company laptop and company phone provided
20 days PTO
10 paid holidays (plus your birthday!)
Full health benefits after 60 days
401(k) plan with 4% max employer match
Paid parental leave, so we can look after you while you welcome a new human
A 50% off employee discount on Eco Outdoor products
A culture of unbelievable hospitality
Opportunities you need to grow, develop and craft a career you’re proud of within the global Eco Outdoor business
Opportunity to give back via our internal Social Housing and Sustainability teams.
Salary Range: $130,000 - $150,000
OK, you want to know what you’re getting yourself into? Let us introduce ourselves.
Established in 2001 by expert minds from the landscape design and construction industries, Eco Outdoor is an Australian-founded global brand with showrooms in Australia, New Zealand and North America. We’re constantly experimenting, innovating and pushing creative boundaries, delivering the highest-quality natural stone and architectural surfaces (and outdoor furniture collections) to the international architecture market.
We employ around 190 people across the globe, all of whom are dedicated to innovating, crafting and providing remarkable products and unbelievable hospitality to our clients and collaborators in the architecture and design space. We thrive on constant reinvention, regular development opportunities and a passionate culture grounded in connection and involvement.
We’re a tribe of collaborators, critical thinkers, problem-solvers and challenge-embracers, and we nurture our incredibly talented people to put their best foot forward every day. That starts with our core values – Be a Game Changer, Only Accept Awesome, Play as a Team, Be Curious, Get Fired up – which are deeply ingrained in our culture. Basically, we’re all about fostering an innovative, industry-leading, collaborative, creative, passionate team to reach their fullest potential. That’s good for humans and good for business.
If this sounds like your kind of gig…
We’d love to hear from you. If you need more information before you apply, check out our website, and Celebrating 25 Years | Eco Outdoor, LinkedIn or Instagram.
If you have questions those sites don’t answer, flick us a line at people@ecooutdoor.com.au unless you’re a recruitment agency, in which case: no, thanks. We’ve got this one covered.
Eco Outdoor provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: 2026 - VP, Engineering – HR Technology
jobs.text:
VP, Engineering – HR Technology (Enhanced to Emphasize HR Data Expertise)
The successful candidate is expected to:
Lead and build full‑stack, enterprise‑grade platforms using Python, Java, Spring Boot, ReactJS, and SQL/NoSQL databases, while remaining hands‑on with code.
Own and drive Low‑Level Design (LLD) and High‑Level Design (HLD) with deep understanding of distributed systems, data modeling, and integration patterns.
Architect and develop secure, compliant systems.
Design, build, and maintain scalable APIs that support internal and external consumers with high performance and reliability.
Drive non‑functional requirements including security, availability, scalability, resiliency, performance, and observability.
Lead engineering initiatives involving HR, people‑operations, and workforce‑analytics data, ensuring secure ingestion, modeling, governance, and integration of sensitive employee datasets across the firm's technology ecosystem.
Partner with HR, Talent, and People Analytics teams to translate workforce‑planning, compensation, performance‑management, and organizational‑design requirements into scalable technical solutions and data products.
Implement robust data‑quality, lineage, and privacy controls for HR data, ensuring compliance with regulatory, contractual, and internal governance standards.
Actively mentor, coach, and develop junior and mid‑level engineers, setting high engineering standards and fostering a strong engineering culture.
Partner with product, data, and HR stakeholders to translate investment and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Provide strong technical leadership and hands‑on guidance across the full software development lifecycle.

jobs.title: Associate Director of Data Science
jobs.text:
Office location: Cambridgeshire, UK – This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. However, applicants should be based (or be willing to relocate) within a comfortable commuting distance of our office to attend onsite as required.
Are you an experienced data scientist who loves building models that make a real impact, and is ready to lead and grow a talented team?
As Associate Director of Data Science at Jagex, you'll lead a team of data scientists, setting their direction and supporting their development, while continuing to build and own models yourself. Working closely with senior stakeholders across Player Support, Marketing, Analytics, and our Game Teams, you'll develop the algorithms and models that power our business and help shape the experience of millions of RuneScape players.
This is an exciting opportunity to combine hands-on delivery with team leadership, owning our MLOps practice and making sure the models we build are deployed, monitored, and maintained reliably once they're live.
What you'll be doing:
Lead a team of data scientists, setting direction, managing workload, and supporting their growth and development.
Build and own data science models that support teams across the business.
Lead the exploration of new business areas and data science models that can be embedded within the business, drawing on both industry developments and internal use cases.
Own the team's MLOps practice, including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retraining pipelines, working closely with Data Engineering.
Lead the delivery of data science initiatives from ideation through to production.
Act as the day-to-day point of contact for Player Support, Marketing, Analytics, and the Game Teams on all things data science.
Coach and mentor data scientists on both technical delivery and stakeholder management.
Stay current with the latest data science and MLOps tooling and practice, bringing that knowledge into the team.
What we're looking for:
Significant experience applying data science to complex commercial, product, or player-facing problems.
Strong practical knowledge of statistical methods, predictive modelling, and machine learning, including evaluating model performance.
Hands-on experience with MLOps in a production environment, including model deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retraining.
Experience leading or mentoring data scientists, with evidence of coaching and workload management.
A track record of taking analytical or modelling work from exploration through to live, adopted use.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience working directly with senior, non-technical stakeholders.
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical work into plain language for business audiences.
What we offer:
When you join Jagex you can look forward to a generous Perks & Benefits package including:
Private Healthcare, including Dental Plan.
Minimum 6% Pension contributions.
Employee Assistance Programme & onsite Counselling.
Life Insurance.
Discretionary annual performance bonus.
Enhanced family leave policies from day 1.
Flexible working hours.
25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more!
Inclusion & Accessibility Statement
We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.
If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you’re invited to interview.
About Jagex:
We are Jagex: The RuneScape Company- home to one of gaming’s most enduring success stories. We create deep, community-powered games with worlds that evolve, inspire, and endure. Our flagship MMORPG franchise, RuneScape has welcomed over 300 million player accounts, inspiring generations of players across PC and mobile for 25 years.
As we begin our 26th year, we are accelerating our strategy to expand RuneScape into a broader ecosystem of forever games and connected experiences, grounded in a renewed commitment to integrity and fair play. This includes the reduction of monetisation mechanics, as well as the launch of RuneScape: DragonWilds into Steam Early Access in 2025 representing a major step in building a multi-genre future for the RuneScape universe. We remain focused on building enduring worlds, empowering player-led innovation, and laying the foundations for the boldest era in RuneScape’s history. For more information, visit www.jagex.com.
Headquartered in Cambridge, United Kingdom, We are home to passionate creators, storytellers, engineers, and even a few dreamers, all united by a single mission- to shape the future of online worlds and empower players to make them their own. We’re looking for people to join us who share our ambitions & values - We foster an inclusive workplace built on trust, autonomy, and a shared passion for creating experiences which inspire our communities. Our values guide everything we do: We Embrace Fellowship by collaborating and sharing openly. We Hone our Craft by always learning and improving; We Honour our Vows by being honest and transparent; We are our Customers’ Heroes by striving to understand our team & player needs, and We Seize The Day by making the most of every opportunity.
Join us. The next era of RuneScape - and the next chapter of Jagex: The RuneScape Company - starts now.
We are committed to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from all backgrounds, and we recruit, develop, and promote based on merit and ability.
If you require any reasonable adjustments to support you during the recruitment process, please let us know when you’re invited to interview.

jobs.title: Head of Data & Analytics — Insurance & Investments
jobs.text:
Job Summary
The Head of Data & Analytics leads the organization's enterprise data, analytics, and business intelligence function, turning complex data into actionable insights for strategic, operational, financial, risk, customer, and investment decisions.
Within Insurance & Investments, the role typically covers analytics across underwriting, claims, pricing, customer behavior, fraud, risk, portfolio/investment performance, financial planning, regulatory reporting, and enterprise performance.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute the enterprise Data & Analytics strategy and roadmap.
Lead data governance, data management, data quality, and data stewardship.
Establish enterprise-wide analytics standards, frameworks, and KPIs.
Lead Business Intelligence (BI), advanced analytics, predictive analytics, and data science.
Develop dashboards, management reporting, executive insights, and decision-support tools.
Support insurance analytics covering:
Underwriting
Claims
Pricing
Customer analytics
Fraud detection
Loss/risk analysis
Support investment and asset-management analytics covering:
Portfolio performance
Investment risk
Market data
Asset allocation
Performance attribution
Client/investor analytics
Build and maintain data warehouses, data lakes, analytical platforms, and data pipelines.
Drive data integration across policy administration, claims, CRM, finance, investment, risk, and other enterprise systems.
Implement predictive models, AI/ML, and automation where appropriate.
Ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, availability, lineage, and accessibility.
Partner with IT/Data Engineering on cloud, architecture, APIs, platforms, and modernization.
Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, regulatory, and financial-services requirements.
Provide reliable data for financial, risk, actuarial, management, and regulatory reporting.
Lead data transformation and the adoption of self-service analytics.
Manage analytics/data teams, technology partners, vendors, budgets, and delivery priorities.
Present data-driven insights and recommendations to senior executives and business leaders.
Promote a strong data-driven decision-making culture across the organization.
Ideal Candidate Profile
12–18+ years of experience in data, analytics, BI, data science, information management, or technology.
5+ years in senior data/analytics leadership.
Experience as:
Head of Data & Analytics
Head of Analytics
Head of Data
Director of Data & Analytics
Director of Analytics
Data & Analytics Director
Chief Data Officer
Chief Analytics Officer
Strong background in Insurance, Investment Management, Asset Management, Wealth Management, Banking, or Financial Services.
Strong expertise in:
Data strategy
Data governance
Data architecture
Data management
Data quality
BI and reporting
Advanced/predictive analytics
Data science
AI/ML
Data platforms
Data integration
Data visualization
Experience leading enterprise-wide transformation and multidisciplinary teams.
Strong understanding of financial-services data, risk, regulatory, and reporting requirements.
Ability to work with C-suite executives, Finance, Risk, Actuarial, Investments, Operations, IT, and business leadership.

jobs.text:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
We’re looking for a strategic and experienced engineering leader to define the technical direction for Pinterest’s advertiser measurement and signal-quality ecosystem. In this role, you’ll lead managers and senior technical leaders across Interfaces, Ingestion, User Match, and Conversion Quality, driving multi-year investments in machine learning, data platforms, experimentation, privacy, and production reliability. You’ll partner closely with Product, Data Science, Ads Quality, Infrastructure, Privacy, Legal and Sales to translate complex advertiser and business challenges into scalable solutions—and build an inclusive, high-performing organization equipped to deliver measurable impact at scale.
What you’ll do:
Define technical strategy and investment priorities across Interfaces, Ingestion, User Match, and Conversion Quality.
Lead managers and senior technical leaders through a portfolio of multi-year ML and data-platform investments.
Partner with Product, Data Science, Ads Quality, Ads Infra, Core, Privacy, Legal, Sales, and Customer Operations.
Translate advertiser and business problems into scalable ML, data, and platform solutions.
Raise the bar for experimentation, causal measurement, model quality, reliability, privacy, and production operations.
Create mechanisms for cross-team design reviews, shared metrics, dependency management, and launch governance.
Communicate strategy, trade-offs, risks, and outcomes clearly to executives and cross-functional stakeholders.
Recruit, retain, and develop a high-performing, inclusive organization.
What we’re looking for:
Strong background ads measurement, identity, signals and large-scale data processing.
Experience leading an engineering organization through managers and senior technical leaders.
Demonstrated ability to define and execute technical strategy across multiple teams.
Experience operating systems with demanding scale, reliability, privacy, and data-quality requirements.
Track record of improving organizational execution, developing leaders, and creating distributed ownership.
Exceptional analytical thinking and ability to move from ambiguous business problems to measurable technical outcomes.
Strong executive communication and cross-functional influence.
Exceptional analytical thinking and ability to move from ambiguous business problems to measurable technical outcomes.
Strong executive communication and cross-functional influence.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as computer science, statistics, machine learning, or equivalent experience.
Nice-to-have experience:
Experience leading through major privacy, browser, platform, or signal-availability changes.
Ads optimization, or privacy-enhancing technologies.
Probabilistic matching, graph systems, anomaly detection, event-quality modeling, or confidence scoring.
ML platforms, real-time or streaming systems, large-scale experimentation, and model governance.
Experience applying AI or agentic systems to developer productivity, advertiser troubleshooting, or data-quality operations.

jobs.title: Head of Product, Applied AI
jobs.text:
About the company
Our client is a public-safety technology company providing real-time situational awareness to millions of consumers and enterprise organizations. Its mobile and enterprise products help people and teams understand incidents, share updates, and make informed decisions when safety matters.
The role / why it matters
As Head of Product, Applied AI, you will unify a growing portfolio across consumer, subscription, enterprise, and API products. This is a principal-level individual contributor role reporting directly to the Founder and CEO, where you will build AI-agent systems that expand product execution rather than manage a traditional team of product managers.
What you'll do
• Shape one coherent product strategy across consumer experiences, subscriptions, enterprise tools, and APIs.
• Own consumer product loops, including activation, retention, daily engagement, pricing, packaging, and upgrades.
• Define enterprise product direction, API packaging, and partner integrations for organizations that need situational awareness.
• Build and operate agent workflows for discovery synthesis, competitive research, product specifications, experiment design, forecasting, and launch documentation.
• Establish metrics and experimentation practices across conversion, retention, enterprise expansion, and revenue planning.
• Work directly with the Founder and CEO, customers, and cross-functional partners to prioritize and deliver product outcomes.
What we're looking for
• 5-12 years of product leadership experience with substantial hands-on ownership.
• Experience owning product direction end to end as a principal or lead product manager, founder, or similarly hands-on product builder.
• Consumer product experience across mobile, subscription, or product-led growth, with startup or small-company exposure.
• Experience building and operating AI-agent systems for product workflows, beyond using AI tools only for prompts.
• Strong metric architecture and experimentation skills across conversion, retention, revenue, and plan mix.
• The ability to speak with customers directly, understand complex needs, and turn them into clear product decisions.
Bonus points
• Experience with enterprise or API product packaging and pricing.
• Founder experience or product leadership at an AI-native company.
• Comfort challenging assumptions with customer evidence and metrics while working closely with a founder.
Compensation and benefits
The salary range is $265,000-$310,000 USD, with competitive equity.
Location / work model
This is a full-time, on-site role in New York City, five days per week. Visa transfers are supported.

jobs.title: Co-founder & CTO, AI for predictable drug discovery and development
jobs.text:
We're building AI to predict clinical trial and drug development outcomes, and quantify how much confidence those predictions deserve.
We're looking for a technical co-founder to join our biology and commercial founders. As Co-founder & CTO you take a built, already-used platform and lead its development, the research programme that measures and improves its predictions, and the first technical team. The aim is to spin the company out of DSV over the coming months.
THE OPPORTUNITY
Drug development involves decisions about targets, treatment approaches, delivery and patient populations. Each decision depends on evidence that may not transfer well to the setting that matters: treating people. A treatment working in mice, for example, does not tell us how much confidence to place in its chances in humans.
Around nine in ten drugs entering clinical trials never reach approval. The causes run from efficacy to safety to commercial choice, and the claim here is narrower than blaming that number on translation: the field still lacks a systematic way to measure how far a given experimental result should carry into a specific therapeutic decision.
We want to measure how reliably different kinds of biological evidence predict human outcomes. Our approach is to link the evidence available when a decision was made, the judgement made from it, and what happened next. Those records become the data from which we can learn which evidence predicts which outcomes, and under what conditions. That is difficult to test. Outcomes can take years to arrive, suitable labels are often missing, and a failed trial does not necessarily reveal which earlier assumption was wrong.
The platform is already running. It has produced a scientific result through work with the Allen Institute, described in a public preprint. You can also see the engine run.
There is no established dataset or method that settles the measurement question. Defining what to measure, building reliable evaluations and choosing appropriate methods are central to the role, and the next funding round will fund that programme.
Clinical trial outcome prediction is a central test: predicting a specific trial outcome and explaining the biological reasons, using evidence available before the result. An LLM may already know a historical outcome, so retrospective tests need safeguards against contamination as well as confirmation on prospective cases. This article sets out our approach.
The aim is to make therapeutic development more predictable, and use those predictions to change which treatments get developed and how.
Read more in our thesis.
THE ROLE
This is a deeply hands-on role. The founding team covers biology and commercial development. You will be responsible for the technology and the research needed to evaluate it. There is no engineering team yet: you will be building the system yourself and should expect to remain hands-on for at least the first year. You will:
Develop the platform. Take ownership of the existing system, set technical priorities and implement improvements.
Build the measurement programme. Define the prediction tasks, link evidence available at decision time to subsequent outcomes, and develop and compare modelling approaches. Test predictive performance and calibration, and identify where the system is reliable and where it is not.
Prevent misleading evaluations. Address leakage, label quality and contamination. Retrospective tests need particular care when an LLM may have encountered the outcome during training. We explain the issue in this article.
Hire the first technical team once funding is in place.
Support fundraising. Explain the technical approach, evidence, limitations and development plan to investors.
The modelling approach is open. You will choose methods based on the problem and the available data, whether those involve Bayesian or hierarchical inference, graph learning, calibration, classical statistics or a combination.
Location: Flexible, UK-based preferred · Commitment: Full-time from spin-out · Equity: Founder equity, with technical authority from day one.
WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR
We're building an AI company that works on drug development, not a drug company that uses AI. The hard part is measuring what the evidence justifies, and biology is where we point that. So the depth we're searching for is in AI and statistics.
You have led a team or a substantial technical programme at Google DeepMind, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta AI or a comparable frontier AI lab. Your own work is recognised, and your name opens doors with investors and people we want to hire. That credibility is part of why this role exists. You remain hands-on and will build the platform yourself.
You might know very little biology, and that's okay. The science is held by the founding team. What we look for is real curiosity about the biology and the drive to learn it quickly from the people who already know it.
You will be building the platform yourself. With the rest of the founding team you set what it is for and where it goes, and then you make it work.
These are essential:
You bring a recognised technical track record from a frontier AI lab and remain hands-on.
You hold your own in a room of researchers and a room of investors.
You lead from the front. This is a founding seat, not a board seat and not an advisory one.
You can go full-time from the spin-out.
HOW TO APPLY
Send a CV and a short note. In the note, tell us what you would measure first, and what you think we've got wrong about the mission above. Include links to work you have built or published. No separate cover letter is required.
One request, and we ask it of everyone. If your application reports a result (an accuracy, an improvement, a benchmark number), be precise about three things: what the baseline was, how the data was split, and how wide the interval around it is. A figure on its own tells us nothing.
If a founding seat isn't the right fit but the problem pulls at you, we're also open to advisory roles; say so in your note.

jobs.title: Head of Product Design
jobs.text:
HEAD OF PRODUCT DESIGN
Start Date: January 2027
Contract: Full Time/ Permanent
Salary: MPS/UPS + TLR
Are you a passionate and inspiring Product Design specialist, looking for an exciting leadership opportunity?
As our curriculum leader for Product Design, you will lead the area effectively in all aspects of teaching, learning and assessment, ensuring high levels of quality and student satisfaction, excellent outcomes and strong progression.
About Our School
Bitterne Park School is an 11-19 mixed, community school and Sixth Form and is set in eighteen acres of grounds overlooking the River Itchen and Riverside Park.
In September 2017, the school moved into its new building, which has allowed us to fully embrace the ethos and values that the school has been striving for. The bright and modern learning environment is centred around an atrium, which is at the heart of the school. Each of the classrooms is bright and spacious with fully interactive touch screen projection and improved IT. We are particularly proud of our Performing Arts facilities. We have drama studios, practice rooms, music rooms and a dance studio, in addition to the high specification theatre, dance studio and music facilities in the Sixth Form building.
The school also has a multi-sports hall, tennis courts, netball courts, basketball courts and an outdoor table tennis area as well as a full size, all weather, 3G pitch.
Bitterne Park School has a key role to play in the local community with many local groups using our facilities.
About the Product Design Department
The Product Design Department at Bitterne Park School is part of a wider DT and Art Faculty with individual Heads of Department supported by a Head of Faculty. Product Design is run at KS3 and KS4 and there is a real culture of high-quality work with students achieving well at GCSE. Product Design empowers students with the vital communication and technical skills needed to succeed in their chosen pathways and future careers.
We provide the tools, time, and creative space for students to independently investigate broad, topical themes with tailored support to meet every learner's needs. By analysing the historical context of a diverse range of designers, artists, cultures, and eras, our students learn to blend critical research with imaginative execution to develop their own unique design work. Students quickly engage with practical applications from Y7 to Y11 developing creative ideas then securing the practical hand tool skills with machine tool experiences in a range of core materials and processes. In year 7/8 we have a rotation with Food and Textiles and at Y9 students opt into this subject with many moving on to GCSE Product Design. We have a good cross over of PCs, desks and practical benches for students to work across theory and practical.
The department has a dedicated Dt technician and prep room and within the main DT rooms there are vacuum formers, 2 large laser cutters and 2 3D Printers along with a great range of excellent colleagues.
The Role
The Head of Product Design will:
Oversee the production of ambitious, inspiring and stimulating teaching and learning materials across courses in the curriculum area.
Ensure that all subject-related documentation such as schemes of work, assessment plans, assessments and mock examinations are high quality, fit for purpose and regularly updated.
Lead and promote inspirational and innovative teaching, learning and assessment across the curriculum.
Support and mentor colleagues where appropriate.
Promote enrichment opportunities, exhibitions and creative projects.
We hope you will review the role description, person specification and the ‘About Us’ booklet within our recruitment pack and will be excited about the prospect of joining us at team BPS. If you are willing to consider BPS as the next step in your career, please complete the application form and submit by the closing date – we look forward to meeting you.
Closing Date: 12th October 2026 – noon
Proposed Interview Date: TBA
Bitterne Park School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. The role is exempt from the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974 and is therefore subject to an Enhanced DBS and requires a children’s barred list check.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering - Distributed Systems, Serverless - Elasticsearch
jobs.text:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role
We are on the lookout for a Director of Software Engineering to lead our Elasticsearch Distributed Systems organisation which focuses on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering.
As Director of Software Engineering, you will be leading an organisation of approximately 40 engineers and managers to tackle the deep distributed systems challenges that allow Elasticsearch to excel at scale. Your customers are every Elasticsearch user and each solution team which builds upon Elasticsearch.
Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. We collaborate every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.
What You Will Be Doing
Develop and execute a long-term engineering strategy for Elasticsearch's distributed systems, aligning technical priorities with product direction and business objectives.
Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency, including foundational capabilities supporting Serverless Elasticsearch.
Lead the evolution of Elasticsearch's core distributed architecture, including cluster coordination, data allocation, indexing, replication and recovery.
Provide technical leadership and oversight for complex engineering initiatives and programs, helping engineering managers and technical leaders navigate architectural decisions and competing priorities.
Own engineering outcomes across your organisation, balancing technical complexity, customer impact, reliability, operational requirements and long-term maintainability.
Lead, mentor, hire and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, establishing high performance standards and building a strong pipeline of future leaders, fostering an inclusive culture of collaboration and technical excellence.
Take ownership of organisational planning, staffing and resource allocation, ensuring teams have the capabilities and support needed to deliver on strategic priorities.
Partner with Product Management, engineering leaders and other teams across Elastic to define priorities and deliver complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering organisations.
Act as a senior escalation point for critical technical and operational challenges, working closely with engineering, Support and SRE teams to drive effective resolution.
Communicate engineering strategy, organisational priorities and progress to senior executives, influencing decisions that have a significant impact on Elastic and its customers.
Run performance management with consistency (promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution) and working with your managers to do the same.
What You Bring
A proven track record of leading large-scale engineering organisations, including experience managing engineering managers and developing senior technical leaders.
Previous hands-on software engineering experience, with strong computer science fundamentals and substantial technical depth in distributed systems.
Extensive experience designing, building or operating complex, large-scale distributed systems, ideally involving database engines, distributed storage or large-scale data processing.
Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency, consistency, replication, fault tolerance, recovery and performance optimisation.

blocks.text: Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What is The Role

We are on the lookout for a Director of Software Engineering to lead our Elasticsearch Distributed Systems organisation which focuses on how Elasticsearch provides scale, performance, and resilience, especially in the context of our Serverless offering.

As Director of Software Engineering, you will be leading an organisation of approximately 40 engineers and managers to tackle the deep distributed systems challenges that allow Elasticsearch to excel at scale. Your customers are every Elasticsearch user and each solution team which builds upon Elasticsearch.

Our company is distributed by intention. We hire the best engineers we can find wherever they are, whoever they are. As a result, our team is diverse and distributed across continents. We collaborate every day over email, GitHub, Zoom, and Slack. The ability to lead a distributed team is critical.
What You Will Be Doing

items: Develop and execute a long-term engineering strategy for Elasticsearch's distributed systems, aligning technical priorities with product direction and business objectives.
Drive improvements in performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency, including foundational capabilities supporting Serverless Elasticsearch.
Lead the evolution of Elasticsearch's core distributed architecture, including cluster coordination, data allocation, indexing, replication and recovery.

Provide technical leadership and oversight for complex engineering initiatives and programs, helping engineering managers and technical leaders navigate architectural decisions and competing priorities.
Own engineering outcomes across your organisation, balancing technical complexity, customer impact, reliability, operational requirements and long-term maintainability.

Lead, mentor, hire and develop engineering managers and senior technical leaders, establishing high performance standards and building a strong pipeline of future leaders, fostering an inclusive culture of collaboration and technical excellence.
Take ownership of organisational planning, staffing and resource allocation, ensuring teams have the capabilities and support needed to deliver on strategic priorities.
Partner with Product Management, engineering leaders and other teams across Elastic to define priorities and deliver complex initiatives spanning multiple engineering organisations.
Act as a senior escalation point for critical technical and operational challenges, working closely with engineering, Support and SRE teams to drive effective resolution.
Communicate engineering strategy, organisational priorities and progress to senior executives, influencing decisions that have a significant impact on Elastic and its customers.
Run performance management with consistency (promotions, development plans, and managing underperformance through to resolution) and working with your managers to do the same.

jobs.title: Head Of Treasury Technology
jobs.text:
A Career with Point72’s Technology Team
As Point72 reimagines the future of investing, our Technology team is constantly evolving our firm’s IT infrastructure and engineering capabilities, positioning us at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We’re a team of experts who experiment and work to discover new ways to harness open-source solutions, modern cloud architectures, and sophisticated Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, while embracing enterprise agile methodologies. Our commitment to building and innovating in the AI space provides the framework intended to drive smarter decision making and enhance how we build and operate our platforms and applications.
As a member of Point72’s Technology team, we encourage and support your professional development from day one—helping you advance your technical skills, contribute innovative ideas, and satisfy your own intellectual curiosity—all while delivering real business impact for our multi-billion-dollar global business.
What you’ll do
In this role, you will be responsible for supporting Point72’s Treasury function with best-in-class technology solutions. You will align the business needs with technology delivery, provide guidance with strategic business architecture, and execute key business projects in line with business optimization needs. Specifically, you will:
Lead the technical product buildout to optimize the current application inventory stack while architecting a platform that scales to the firm’s future needs with regards to liquidity, margin and collateral, and key business stakeholder management
Develop software and analytics to further develop firmwide mandates such as liquidity risk, margin risk management, collateral management, and funding optimization
Manage and lead key stakeholder relationships, especially between Treasury management and Technology
Lead and grow a group of product specialists, analysts, quantitative strategists, and developers within Technology
Ensure alignment of financing, margin, and stock loan business requirements to broader firm technology architecture strategy
Provide thought leadership and product input on tooling solutions for margin and collateral optimization
Support business and Treasury on liquidity regulatory enquiries
Partner with cross function peers to create, administer, track, and close out project deliverables as they pertain to Treasury
Ensure resources are assigned to projects in line with business analysis and development groups, and monitor commitments in line with the project management team
Ensure teams understand business processes and gaps in capabilities, as well as appropriate data sources, interfaces, and process changes required to address the gaps
What’s required
Ability to lead a technical team, provide technical and functional guidance, and manage stakeholders needs
Ability to communicate complex technical and risk ideas to non-technical stakeholders.
Working knowledge of data science technologies including machine learning (ML) and ML frameworks
Working knowledge of cloud-ready architectures and technologies such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Microservice Architecture, Streaming, Serialization protocols, NoSQL, and in-memory databases.
Working knowledge of web architectures and technologies such as Python, Java, GraphQL, APIs, node, React, and Angular.
Experience using AI tools like Cursor or Claude Code, with the ability to build MCPs, Skills, and more.
Strong knowledge of treasury fundamentals across liquidity risk, margin modeling, collateral management, and stress testing, including related optimization models, reporting, and analytics
Working knowledge of stress event management, planning, and forecasting as it pertains to liquidity, as well as collateral stressing, substitution, and rehypothecation
Excellent understanding of financial products within capital markets business, as well as knowledge of capital metrics including RWA
Understanding of financial markets and associated operational support functions
Commitment to the highest ethical standards
We take care of our people
We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:
Fully-paid health care benefits
Generous parental and family leave policies
Volunteer opportunities
Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, people of color and the LGBT+ community
Mental and physical wellness programs
Tuition assistance
A 401(k) savings program with an employer match and more
About Point72
Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry’s brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people’s long-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72.com/.
The annual base salary range for this role is $300,000-$400,000 (USD), which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.

jobs.title: Director- Engineering. (Hospitality) SN7
jobs.text:
Job Description
The Cluster Director of Engineering is a key member of the cluster leadership team, responsible for
overseeing all engineering, maintenance, facilities management, technical services, and asset
protection functions across multiple hotels within the portfolio.
This role combines strategic leadership, technical expertise, and project management capabilities to
support hotels with different technical requirements. The Cluster Director of Engineering will play a
critical role throughout the pre-opening, opening, and operational phases, ensuring successful
project handovers, operational readiness, regulatory compliance, maintenance excellence, and longterm
asset preservation.
The successful candidate will lead engineering teams across the cluster, oversee technical operations
and capital projects, and work closely with ownership, consultants, and contractors to ensure the
hotels are delivered, maintained, and operated to the highest standards of safety, reliability,
efficiency, and sustainability.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead all engineering, maintenance, and facilities management operations across the hotel
cluster, ensuring safe, reliable, and efficient operation of all assets.
• Develop and execute engineering strategies that support hotel business objectives, brand
requirements, owner priorities, and long-term asset value enhancement.
• Lead the engineering transition from project delivery to hotel operations, including testing &
commissioning, inspections, snagging, defect management, and operational handover.
• Participate in design reviews and technical workshops to ensure projects are delivered in
accordance with operational requirements and engineering best practices.
• Review and validate engineering-related OS&E requirements, maintenance equipment,
workshop tools, spare parts inventories, and procurement plans to ensure operational
readiness and cost effectiveness.
• Prepare, manage, and control Engineering Pre-Opening Budgets (POB), ensuring all
engineering readiness activities are completed within approved budgets and timelines.
• Develop and implement preventative and predictive maintenance programmes for all
building systems, including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, fire & life safety systems, vertical
transportation, kitchen equipment, and utilities infrastructure.
• Oversee capital expenditure projects, asset lifecycle planning, refurbishment works, and
replacement programs across the cluster.
• Drive operational efficiencies through preventive maintenance, energy management
initiatives, contract optimization, and engineering best practices.
Champion sustainability, energy conservation, water management, and ESG initiatives across
all properties.
• Ensure full compliance with all regulatory, environmental, health & safety, and life safety
requirements.
• Establish emergency preparedness plans, crisis response procedures, and business continuity
measures for all hotels.
• Build, mentor, and develop high-performing engineering teams through coaching, training,
succession planning, and performance management.
• Establish strong working relationships with ownership, project teams, consultants,
contractors, and local authorities to ensure successful project delivery and ongoing asset
stewardship.

jobs.title: CTO - Dutch Flower Group
jobs.text:
Over Dutch Flower Group
Dutch Flower Group (DFG) is een internationale familie van meer dan 30 gespecialiseerde ondernemingen die gezamenlijk actief zijn binnen de internationale sierteeltketen. De bedrijven leveren bloemen, boeketten en planten via uiteenlopende afzetkanalen, waaronder groothandel, retail, tuincentra en online verkoopkanalen.
Binnen DFG worden lokaal ondernemerschap en een sterke eigen identiteit gecombineerd met de schaal, kennis en slagkracht van de groep. Digitalisering en datagedreven werken vormen een van de zes strategische groeipijlers richting 2030.
De uitdaging
Dutch Flower Group zoekt een Chief Technology Officer die richting geeft aan de volgende fase van digitalisering binnen de groep. De CTO krijgt de ruimte om de technologische koers richting 2030 mede vorm te geven en technologie, data en AI zichtbaar te verbinden aan de strategische en dagelijkse behoeften van de verschillende DFG-bedrijven.
De CTO opereert binnen een uitgesproken decentrale organisatie, waarin bedrijven verschillen in identiteit, marktpositie, cultuur en digitale volwassenheid. De opdracht is daarom niet gericht op centralisatie als doel op zich. De CTO bepaalt samen met de bedrijven waar samenwerking, standaardisatie en gezamenlijke investeringen aantoonbare waarde toevoegen.
Dit vraagt bovenal om een verbindende en situationeel sterke CTO die uiteenlopende stakeholders en belangen weet samen te brengen. Iemand die beweging creëert vanuit inhoud, relaties en vertrouwen, zonder voortdurend terug te vallen op hiërarchie, formeel mandaat of escalatie.
De rol
De CTO ontwikkelt en realiseert de meerjarige agenda voor IT, Digital & Data en vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete commerciële en operationele waarde.
Binnen de decentrale structuur van Dutch Flower Group bouwt de CTO bruggen tussen de bedrijven, de centrale organisatie en verschillende disciplines. De CTO versterkt de verbinding tussen IT en de business, stimuleert kennisdeling en samenwerking en geeft richting aan keuzes rond onder meer architectuur, ERP, cloud, applicaties, infrastructuur, cybersecurity, data en AI.
Daarnaast geeft de CTO leiding aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de IT-organisatie en zorgt ervoor dat prioriteiten aansluiten bij de behoeften van klanten en de verschillende DFG-bedrijven. Op het gebied van cybersecurity en continuïteit heeft de CTO een expliciet groepsbreed mandaat.
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden
Ontwikkelen en realiseren van de visie en meerjarige agenda voor IT, Digital & Data.
Vertalen van technologie, data en AI naar zichtbare commerciële en operationele waarde.
Verbinden van bedrijven, stakeholders en disciplines rond gezamenlijke technologische vraagstukken.
Richting geven aan keuzes rond architectuur, ERP, cloud, applicaties en infrastructuur.
Versterken van de samenwerking en kennisdeling tussen de verschillende DFG-bedrijven.
Doorontwikkelen van de IT-organisatie en multidisciplinaire teams.
Vergroten van de aansluiting tussen IT en de dagelijkse bedrijfspraktijk.
Vaststellen en bewaken van groepsbrede kaders voor cybersecurity en continuïteit.
Realiseren van veranderinitiatieven en investeringen met aantoonbaar resultaat.
Opbouwen van duurzame relaties met aandeelhouders, directies en IT-verantwoordelijken binnen de groep.

blocks.text: Over Dutch Flower Group

Dutch Flower Group (DFG) is een internationale familie van meer dan 30 gespecialiseerde ondernemingen die gezamenlijk actief zijn binnen de internationale sierteeltketen. De bedrijven leveren bloemen, boeketten en planten via uiteenlopende afzetkanalen, waaronder groothandel, retail, tuincentra en online verkoopkanalen.

Binnen DFG worden lokaal ondernemerschap en een sterke eigen identiteit gecombineerd met de schaal, kennis en slagkracht van de groep. Digitalisering en datagedreven werken vormen een van de zes strategische groeipijlers richting 2030.
De uitdaging

Dutch Flower Group zoekt een Chief Technology Officer die richting geeft aan de volgende fase van digitalisering binnen de groep. De CTO krijgt de ruimte om de technologische koers richting 2030 mede vorm te geven en technologie, data en AI zichtbaar te verbinden aan de strategische en dagelijkse behoeften van de verschillende DFG-bedrijven.

De CTO opereert binnen een uitgesproken decentrale organisatie, waarin bedrijven verschillen in identiteit, marktpositie, cultuur en digitale volwassenheid. De opdracht is daarom niet gericht op centralisatie als doel op zich. De CTO bepaalt samen met de bedrijven waar samenwerking, standaardisatie en gezamenlijke investeringen aantoonbare waarde toevoegen.

Dit vraagt bovenal om een verbindende en situationeel sterke CTO die uiteenlopende stakeholders en belangen weet samen te brengen. Iemand die beweging creëert vanuit inhoud, relaties en vertrouwen, zonder voortdurend terug te vallen op hiërarchie, formeel mandaat of escalatie.
De rol
De CTO ontwikkelt en realiseert de meerjarige agenda voor IT, Digital & Data en vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete commerciële en operationele waarde.

Binnen de decentrale structuur van Dutch Flower Group bouwt de CTO bruggen tussen de bedrijven, de centrale organisatie en verschillende disciplines. De CTO versterkt de verbinding tussen IT en de business, stimuleert kennisdeling en samenwerking en geeft richting aan keuzes rond onder meer architectuur, ERP, cloud, applicaties, infrastructuur, cybersecurity, data en AI.

Daarnaast geeft de CTO leiding aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de IT-organisatie en zorgt ervoor dat prioriteiten aansluiten bij de behoeften van klanten en de verschillende DFG-bedrijven. Op het gebied van cybersecurity en continuïteit heeft de CTO een expliciet groepsbreed mandaat.
Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

items: Ontwikkelen en realiseren van de visie en meerjarige agenda voor IT, Digital & Data.
Vertalen van technologie, data en AI naar zichtbare commerciële en operationele waarde.
Verbinden van bedrijven, stakeholders en disciplines rond gezamenlijke technologische vraagstukken.
Richting geven aan keuzes rond architectuur, ERP, cloud, applicaties en infrastructuur.
Versterken van de samenwerking en kennisdeling tussen de verschillende DFG-bedrijven.
Doorontwikkelen van de IT-organisatie en multidisciplinaire teams.
Vergroten van de aansluiting tussen IT en de dagelijkse bedrijfspraktijk.
Vaststellen en bewaken van groepsbrede kaders voor cybersecurity en continuïteit.
Realiseren van veranderinitiatieven en investeringen met aantoonbaar resultaat.
Opbouwen van duurzame relaties met aandeelhouders, directies en IT-verantwoordelijken binnen de groep.

jobs.title: Director of Solutions Engineering (4036)
jobs.text:
Enabling safe and rewarding digital lives for genuine people, everywhere
We make it our mission to ensure more genuine people have digital access to opportunities, and businesses have access to more genuine people. Our technology draws on diverse and reliable data to create a single point of truth for identity and address verification.
With over 30 years of experience behind us our team and technology are focused on enabling safe and rewarding digital lives for everyone. Regardless of age, location or background, genuine people everywhere should be able to digitally prove who they are and where they live.
About the team and role
Customer Engineering
At GBG, our Customer Engineering organization sits at the intersection of technology, customer value, and commercial growth. As we continue to accelerate our North American expansion, we are building a world-class Solutions Engineering function that plays a critical role in helping organizations solve complex identity verification, fraud prevention, and data intelligence challenges.
The North American Solutions Engineering team is a high-performing group of technical consultants, trusted advisors, and problem-solvers who partner closely with Sales, Product, and Customer Success to drive customer outcomes and revenue growth. This team is instrumental in positioning GBG as a strategic partner to some of the region's most innovative organizations.
We are operating with the pace and ambition of a growth company, with North America serving as a key contributor to GBG's long-term vision of becoming a £1B revenue business. The team has established a strong foundation of success—consistently delivering market-leading proof-of-concept outcomes, accelerating customer time-to-value, and transforming the way we demonstrate and communicate the value of our solutions. Most importantly, we have built a culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and continuous improvement. Team members celebrate collective success, support one another through challenges, and are deeply committed to customer impact.
Work Structure:
This is a remote position with a strong preference for candidates in the Atlanta metropolitan area. Travel for customer visits, team collaboration, and stakeholder meetings may be required (estimated up to 40%).
The Role - Director of Solutions Engineering
As Director of Solutions Engineering, you will lead, mentor, and scale a high-performing team of Solutions Engineers across North America, driving technical excellence throughout the customer lifecycle and enabling commercial success through strategic customer engagement. Partnering closely with Sales leadership, you will shape winning presales strategies, support complex enterprise opportunities, and ensure customers clearly understand the business value and impact of GBG's solutions.
This is a hands-on leadership role requiring a balance of strategic vision, operational leadership, and customer-facing engagement. You will develop and coach top technical talent, establish presales best practices, and help evolve the function through the thoughtful adoption of AI-enabled tools, methodologies, and processes.
The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of leading high-performing presales or solutions engineering teams, influencing executive stakeholders, and delivering results within fast-paced, growth-oriented technology organizations. Equally important is deep domain expertise within identity verification, fraud prevention, risk, financial services, payments, lending, banking, or adjacent regulated industries. Success in this role requires an understanding of the challenges these organizations face and the ability to position technical solutions that address complex business, operational, and regulatory needs.
What you will do
Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Solutions Engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous growth.
Drive the technical sales strategy across North America, guiding discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and customer evaluations.
Partner closely with Sales leadership to align presales activities with revenue objectives and accelerate business growth.
Establish and scale best-in-class presales methodologies, processes, and tools to improve consistency, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
Act as a trusted advisor and executive sponsor on strategic enterprise opportunities, helping customers solve complex identity, fraud, and data challenges.
Champion the adoption of AI-enabled practices and technologies to enhance team productivity, customer engagement, and technical differentiation.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Product and Engineering teams to translate customer and market insights into future product innovation.
Leverage data and performance metrics to optimize technical win rates, evaluation success, deal velocity, and overall business impact.
Attract, hire, and retain top Solutions Engineering talent while building a scalable organization capable of supporting continued growth.
Serve as a key member of the Customer Engineering leadership team, helping shape the vision, strategy, and future direction of the function.

jobs.text:

Job Location: Remote, United Kingdom
Job Location Type: Remote
Job Contract Type: Full time
Job Seniority Level:
Environmental Conditions: Office
Work Schedule: Standard (Mon-Fri)
Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)
Environmental Conditions

Job Description
Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Patient-Centered Research (PCR) group helps sponsors to integrate the patient voice in all relevant healthcare decisions, from development over regulatory to reimbursement and product launch. For that, PCR uses a unique combination of scientific fields, including health sciences, psychometrics, epidemiology, psychology, health economics and others. Our work has helped identify and clarify unmet clinical needs, assess burden of illness and evaluate patient outcomes, preference and/or adherence, while supporting promotional and labeling claims on a global scale.
The Senior Director of Qualitative Data Collection and Analysis (QDA) is primarily responsible for the collection, organization and analysis of qualitative data on PCR projects, including: moderation of interviews and focus groups, management of vendors for dedicated qualitative research services, oversight of qualitative research technologies (incl., AI-enabled solutions), and qualitative data analysis. As part of this remit the Senior Director will be responsible for leading the development, improvement and implementation of quality and compliance assurance processes. The aim of this exciting role is to build a best-in-class qualitative research center of excellence that supports our scientific solution teams with its methodological expertise.
This role is critical for our mission to provide a full suite of services and offerings to achieve patient focused drug development.
Essential Functions
Develop and implement annual QDA business plans, including identifying and implementing a best-in-class qualitative delivery model.
Monitor industry developments to ensure the team has access to best-in-class capabilities.
Collaborate with all PCR solution teams (i.e., clinical outcomes assessment, in-trial research, patient preferences, real-world experience and insights) to ensure the successful design and delivery of projects.
Manage staff, including interviewing and selection, job description preparation, professional development, goal setting, performance management and any other tasks associated with staff functions and management
Drive thought leadership to ensure continuous scientific improvement
Support opportunity management to optimize win rates, including leading the development of qualitative research strategies to meet client needs, and ensuring these are appropriately represented in proposals
Oversee the delivery of qualitative components of PCR studies, including qualitative data collection (incl., moderation), data management, and data analysis
Collaborate with external and internal vendors that support PCR with dedicated qualitative research services
Manage qualitative research technologies for data collection and analysis (incl., AI enablement)
Work with relevant internal stakeholders to develop, manage, improve and implement qualitative research standards and processes
Qualifications:
Education and Experience:
At least 12 years of qualitative research leadership in a relevant field with a track record of scientific outputs
PhD in relevant scientific discipline preferred
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
Deep and demonstrated understanding of patient centered research, including a demonstrated knowledge of GCP and awareness of working in a regulatory environment.
Ability to develop business strategies and plans.
Understanding of budgeting and forecasting with the ability to interpret data with attention to detail
Proven ability to lead a team to deliver high quality scientific deliverables
Demonstrated ability to delegate effectively
Strong interpersonal, organizational, communication and staff management skills and experience required
Ability to work in a cross functional team
Ability to communicate complex information and ideas so that others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences
Tact and sensitivity in matters relating to confidential material.
· Fluency in written and oral English

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Well, hello there 👋
Castify (Creators of Screencastify) is a leading technology company dedicated to improving communication and learning outcomes with video. We have established ourselves as a leader in the K-12 education sector in the United States and we are critical in helping scale a teacher and improve student outcomes. We are also actively expanding into new and exciting markets outside of K-12 including bringing our tested solution into companies and organizations. Castify is used by over 15M people today and is seeking a VP of Engineering to join our Squad!
About this role
What started as the simplest and most reliable screen recorder in the world, with millions of users, is now a multi-product, AI-first platform. Our near future is full of ambitious new goals, features, and products that will enable us to further improve how we provide service to our users and accelerate growth. ​
We prioritize fast iteration without compromising quality while maintaining attention to detail that creates the kind of seamless, high-quality experiences we’re known for. We’re looking for an experienced, strategic VP of Engineering to lead and scale our engineering organization as we continue building innovative products that impact millions of users worldwide.
This role will partner with Product and GTM teams to define and execute our technical vision, strengthen engineering operations, and help shape the future of video communication and AI-powered learning experiences.
What you'll do:
Lead a high-performing Engineering organization across multiple product areas and platforms.
Champion the adoption of AI-powered engineering tools and workflows to accelerate team velocity and output quality.
Partner with Product leadership to define technical strategy, roadmap priorities, and execution plans.
Drive engineering excellence by establishing scalable systems, development standards, and operational best practices.
Oversee the architecture, development, testing, deployment, and reliability of our products and infrastructure.
Shape and evolve our AI-first product strategy by enabling experimentation, rapid iteration, and scalable implementation.
Guide technical decision-making across frontend, backend, infrastructure, data, and platform initiatives.
Ensure strong execution across teams by removing blockers, clarifying priorities, and aligning engineering efforts to business outcomes.
Foster a strong engineering culture grounded in ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement.

jobs.text:
​​Looking for Philippines-based candidates
Job Role: Head of Product and Operations
Work Schedule: 9:00 am - 5:00 pm, Australian Business Hours
Compensation range: $3,000 AUD - $4,500 AUD / Monthly (before tax and deductions)
Who We Are: At Hunt St, we help Australian companies hire top remote talent in the Philippines. For this role, you will be formally employed through an Employer of Record (EOR) arrangement. We are not an outsourcing agency. All of our roles are 100% remote, so you’ll be able to work from home.
Who The Client Is: We’re a community-driven platform built to connect local businesses with fundraisers in a way that benefits everyone. By making it easy for merchants to share offers and for groups to raise funds, we create a simple, win-win model that drives growth, engagement, and impact without the usual barriers. Our mission is to keep commerce and community working hand in hand, making support effortless and rewarding.
Role Overview: We are not looking for a virtual assistant, general administrator or software developer.
We’re looking for a senior Product & Operations leader with previous experience working within a SaaS, marketplace, membership, subscription, fintech, loyalty/rewards, or comparable digital platform.
The successful candidate will take significant responsibility away from the Founder, owning the day-to-day operation of the platform and coordinating the technology, systems, and processes required for the company to scale.
This role requires someone who can identify problems, investigate root causes, determine effective solutions, and follow them through to completion with minimal direction.
Key Responsibilities:
Product Ownership
Own and maintain the company’s product roadmap.
Translate commercial requirements into clear development specifications.
Prioritise features, improvements and bugs.
Manage external developers and technology partners.
Challenge development estimates and timelines where appropriate.
Establish acceptance criteria for development.
Coordinate releases.
Maintain product and technical documentation.
QA & Technology Management
Take ownership of QA and regression testing.
Test development before production release.
Maintain bugs and issue registers.
Manage development priorities and delivery.
Understand web/mobile applications, APIs, databases, integrations and cloud infrastructure sufficiently to manage technical suppliers.
Coordinate security, backups, platform reliability and technical issues.
The successful candidate does not need to code, but must be technically confident enough to manage developers effectively.
Fundraiser Operations
Manage the operational process from:
Signed → Onboarding → Setup → Launch → Active
Including fundraiser accounts, pages, payment configuration, dashboards, reporting and support.
Merchant Operations
Manage:
Signed → Onboarding → Offer Setup → Approval → Live → Ongoing Management
Including merchant information, locations, offers, codes, terms and offer accuracy.
Member & Payment Operations
Oversee:
Registration → Payment → Fundraiser Allocation → Membership Activation → Usage → Renewal
Including Stripe/payment issues, failed payments, refunds, membership status and reconciliation.
Customer Support
Establish and manage support processes for:
Fundraisers
Merchants
Members
Build systems, FAQs, documentation and automation that reduce repetitive support requirements.
Data & Reporting
Build and maintain management reporting covering:
Fundraisers
Merchants
Members
Membership sales
Revenue
Fundraising distributions
Payments
Renewals
Customer support
Product development
Platform performance
Management should have a clear weekly view of the health of the business.
Automation & Scalability
A major part of this role is identifying manual processes and progressively automating them.
We want someone constantly asking:
“How can the company support 1,000 fundraisers and 100,000+ members without needing a huge operations team?"
