jobs.title: Director - Technology
jobs.text:
Role in One Breath
You'll join the Simple Machines UK leadership team as a senior technology and people leader with deep roots in software engineering. You'll help ensure the success and growth of our existing enterprise clients while opening new relationships, shaping propositions and solutions, and helping us win significant new work.
You'll provide senior technology leadership to our clients, lead major pursuits and develop our technology people, with genuine influence over what we build, what we take to market and where Simple Machines goes next in the UK and Europe.
Help lead the UK business. Grow our strategic accounts. Win new clients. Build an exceptional technology team.
What This Role Actually Involves
This is a hands-on technology leadership role. You'll be deep in the work, helping our teams and clients successfully deliver complex software engineering programmes, while leading across architecture, clients, growth and people. You'll influence as much as direct: selling ideas, building alignment and bringing clients, teams and other business units on the journey.
Engineering and delivery leadership
• Get close to our most complex software engineering engagements and help ensure they succeed
• Lead the engineering of modern software solutions, increasingly including AI-native and agentic applications and systems
• Work directly with engineers, technical leads and architects to solve difficult technical and delivery problems
• Review architecture and engineering approaches, challenge decisions and step in where senior technical leadership is needed
• Drive strong engineering practices and ensure emerging AI and agentic solutions are engineered with enterprise-grade rigour
• Own the technical quality of our work and ensure what we deliver is something we are proud to stand behind
Architecture and technical leadership
• Shape software, solution and enterprise architecture across major client programmes
• Make pragmatic architecture decisions balancing engineering quality, enterprise constraints and delivery
• Provide technical assurance across our portfolio while remaining close to the engineering
• Stay technically current and credible with our most senior engineers and architects
Clients, influence and strategic accounts
• Help ensure the continued success and growth of our strategic enterprise accounts
• Act as a trusted technology adviser to senior client stakeholders
• Sell ideas and approaches to clients and internal stakeholders, building alignment and bringing people with you
• Work across consulting, delivery, data and AI to shape joined-up solutions and propositions
• Lead difficult technology, architecture and stakeholder conversations when senior intervention is required
Go-to-market and growth
• Open new client relationships and lead early-stage technology conversations
• Turn client problems into compelling propositions, architectures and delivery approaches
• Personally shape proposals, pitches, RFPs and major pursuits
• Ensure what we sell is technically credible, commercially compelling and deliverable
• Work across Simple Machines to assemble the capabilities and support required to win and grow work
People leadership
• Lead, mentor and develop our UK technology team
• Develop senior engineers, technical leads, principal engineers and architects through real client work
• Set a high bar for engineering craft, architecture and technical leadership
• Help attract exceptional technical talent and build a high-performance, low-ego engineering culture

jobs.title: Director Product Management - Identity & Activation
jobs.text:
Samba is a media intelligence company. We know what the world is watching, reading, and thinking about — in real time, at scale, across every screen. Our data exists with the consent of over a billion people, organized into the most complete picture of consumer attention ever built. The biggest brands in the world use that picture to make smarter decisions. We think it’s the most interesting data asset on the planet, because it’s the most culturally relevant.
The role
We are looking for a Director Product Manager to advance our identity resolution capabilities and build future-proof identity and activation solutions. You will own product strategy and roadmap across both identity and activation, bring a clear point of view on where the market is heading, and turn that into products customers want to buy.
This is a senior role for someone who can operate at two altitudes. You set direction and vision, and you are also hands-on: close to customers, close to engineering, and comfortable making the calls on what gets built and in what order. You will play a meaningful part in expanding our client base, which means you understand the market, the buyers, and what it takes to win them.

jobs.title: VP Engineering and R&D - AI Startup
jobs.text:
Are you a technology leader who is not only passionate about AI but is also excited to be at the forefront of solving one of the most challenging problems that have plagued IT for years and could result in organizations becoming highly challenged or possibly extinct as digital transformation sweeps every sector?
Are you looking for a role with the opportunity to:
Execute core research in AI knowledge management that leads to patentable technologies?
Take an idea from research to a commercially successful cloud-based enterprise software product?
Build a solution that will have a meaningful impact on one-third of the US economy - both for-profit and not-for-profit organizations?
Are you seeking the potential to:
Be the first to bring a unique combination of AI and data management to the market?
Work with experienced, successful Silicon Valley entrepreneurs with 4X startup experience leading to IPO and acquisition exits?
Be mentored by a team of research advisors known in the industry as thought leaders?
Participate in a Silicon Valley-style equity opportunity within a venture with the potential for significant value creation?
Work with a company built around a remote model before COVID-19 made it a requirement?
Give back to your community through a 1-1-1 philanthropic model as pioneered by Marc Benioff’s Salesforce?
The Essentials:
Master or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Operation Research or other equivalent quantitative fields
Experience in AI with a demonstrated understanding of expert systems, knowledge management, and digital assistants
Experience managing a team of data scientists and AI researchers and engineers using Agile methodologies and tools
Previous startup experience with a proven track record of leading teams that drive innovation and deliver products in a fast-paced, high-energy environment
Excited to work with new technologies and approaches
Experience working within an SBIR NSF (Small Business Innovation Research - National Science Foundation) Program grant award model
Responsibilities:
Get to know our customer (or know them already) and use that empathy to inform shaping the product’s vision and requirements and building an exceptional product
Serve as a thought leader and technology strategy driver along with the CEO and Co-Founders to make decisions on the product technology architecture including building block components - with a preference for open source technologies
Build, build, build - especially in the early days, you will be rolling up your sleeves and writing code, from core platform to fixing bugs
Help form a top-performing team of talented and responsible software engineers, data scientists and product designers, and provide them the freedom to be creative and innovative
Lead product engineering including research and development of unique proprietary and patentable intellectual property that yields competitive advantages
Embody the company’s culture and mission by fostering a culture that is passionate about building awesome products that deliver measurable value and a customer experience that delights
Evangelize the company’s technology vision, roadmap and capabilities with customers, investors, employees, and other stakeholders
Stay current on technology advances in the field of AI - especially digital assistants, knowledge engineering, data-driven reasoning, expert systems - and in the field of data management - including column databases and other advanced decision analytics technologies
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
C-PLan.IT is an early stage startup on a mission to enable mid-market organizations to measure and maximize value from IT investments. We are building an AI Digital Assistant delivered as-a service in real time to support IT investment decision making and value optimization.
Unlike competitive solutions that focus on cost or asset management only C-Plan.IT specializes in IT investment management with a particular focus on digital transformation objectives.
The benefits of using C-Plan.IT increase as the platform’s membership grows toward the bold goal of becoming the world’s largest IT investment platform with $100B annual IT investments under management across 2000 organizations in the next 10 years.
Privately funded, we are a fully remote company with a 100% distributed team allowing us to hire the best people regardless of where they are located.

jobs.title: Strategic Technology Alliances Director
jobs.text:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.
What We Need
NetBrain is seeking a Strategic Technology Alliances Director to expand and activate our ecosystem of technology and consulting partners. This role focuses on identifying and evangelizing joint value between NetBrain and adjacent platforms—helping customers and partners understand how integrated solutions can deliver greater operational impact.
This is a customer-facing, individual contributor role that bridges product innovation and go-to-market execution. You will not be responsible for building integrations, but for ensuring the value of those integrations is clearly articulated, adopted, and scaled across the ecosystem.
The Impact You'll Make
NetBrain sits within a dense ecosystem of technologies used by the world’s largest enterprises. This role is critical in ensuring we don’t just integrate into that ecosystem—but actively shape and amplify the value created across it. Success is measured by the activation and adoption of joint solutions, not just the existence of partnerships.
What You'll Do
Identify and develop strategic alliances with software and hardware technology partners (e.g., ServiceNow, Dynatrace, ThousandEyes)
Drive thego-to-market activation of joint solutions, ensuring successful launch, positioning, and customer adoption
Partner with Product and R&D to stay aligned on integration priorities and translate them into compelling external narratives
Track and report on alliance success metrics including partner agreements, joint launches, and customer adoption
Collaborate with Marketing to support joint campaigns, webinars, and partner-facing content
Engage directly with customers and partners to position the future-state value of integrated solutions
Proactively identify new ecosystem opportunities and bring them forward for evaluation and activation
What You Bring
Experience working with or within enterprise technology ecosystems (networking, observability, ITSM, or adjacent domains)
Strong ability to understand technical concepts and translate them into business value
Background in a network vendor, SaaS company, or consulting/partner organization
Proven ability to influence without authority and drive cross-functional alignment
Highly proactive, self-directed, and results-oriented mindset
Excellent communication and relationship-building skills with both technical and business audiences
Willingness to travel within your territory as required.
Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.
Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.
What We Offer
Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.
For this role, the estimated base is $175,000 - $210,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.
The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.
NetBrain invites all interested and qualified candidates to apply for employment opportunities.
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.
If you have a disability that prevents or limits your ability to use or access the site, or if you require any other accommodation in the application process due to a disability, you may request a reasonable accommodation. To make a request, please contact our People Team at: and we will be happy to assist you.
In compliance with applicable laws, NetBrain conducts holistic, individual background reviews in support of all hiring decisions.
It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Director, Data Platform
jobs.text:
Credit Acceptance is proud to be an award-winning company recognized both locally and nationally across multiple workplace categories. Our world-class culture is shaped by dedicated team members who are driven to succeed as professionals individually and together as a team. Backed by a strong product, exceptional people, and a stable financial foundation, we’ve grown into a leading provider of used and new car financing across the country.
Our Engineering and Analytics Team Members utilize the latest technology to develop, monitor, and maintain complex practices that help optimize our success. Our Team Members value being challenged, are encouraged to express their ideas, and have the flexibility to enjoy work life balance. We build intrinsic value by partnering with all functions of our business to support their success and make strategic business decisions. We focus on professional development and continuous improvement while enjoying a casual work environment and Great Place to Work culture!
We're seeking a Director of Data Platform to provide technical and architectural leadership within the data engineering organization. In this role, you'll champion to build out modern data platform cross the data space that is critical to enable business growth with AI at scale at Credit Acceptance. As a director, you'll be responsible for leading the technical vision, strategy, architecture, and execution of modern data platform, collaborating both within the data team and outside to ensure successful deliveries in production, representing the data team in various technical forums across engineering to contribute the success at the ecosystem level. The ideal candidate brings 15+ years of engineering experience with significant depth in data technology, cloud, and AI. You'll serve as both a hands-on technical leader and a strategic advisor, helping to establish robust, scalable foundations that enable innovation across the organization.
Outcomes and Activities:
This position will work from home; occasional planned travel to an assigned Southfield, Michigan office location may be required. However, this position is permitted to work at a Southfield, Michigan office location if requested by the team member.
Develop and drive the long-term vision for enterprise data platforms and architecture, ensuring alignment with business growth and AI success
Formulate and implement data platform strategy across the data space including but not limited to big data, real time, transaction/operational, governance, that transform the way how we work with data in the era of AI
Oversee the architecture, design and development of scalable data platform that enable self-serve success with various use cases across the company by taking a platform and AI first approach
Ensure solid production success that meets business need and speed, establish strong finops discipline with timely and insightful info to continuously optimize our economics including forecast, runtime and “showback” to the business
Effectively communicate data technologies, strategies, roadmap and progress to executive leadership and stakeholders, ensuring alignment with the firm’s broader vision and goals.
Stay ahead of industry trends and emerging technologies, translating them into actionable initiatives to drive innovation and maintain the firm’s market leadership.
Build strong engineering organization and foster solid engineering discipline by leading with examples and mentoring team members
Collaborate both with the data team and cross engineering on technology and architecture strategy and decision
Exemplify technical innovation and contribute to critical system design, implementation and operation success
Formulate technology and architecture decision framework that embeds engineering discipline
Become an expert in the business process domain to better support the business and align technologies with the business outcomes
Work with the engineering leadership team to develop and execute on the company’s technical and business strategy
Conduct impact analysis to proactively identify impact of a change across multiple applications/systems
Perform technical due diligence and architectural assessments of third-party technologies and solutions.
Experiment and test ideas, validate assumptions against needs, reach conclusions and recommend solutions
Document standards, best practices, and engineering artifacts so others can easily understand, build and maintain best in class software systems
Debug the critical problems which arise in production and execute effective solutions within the application and across multiple applications/systems
Lead continuous learning and process improvement activities to improve design and overall engineering practices
Grow talent by participating in hiring and mentoring team members
Competencies: The following items detail how you will be successful in this role.
Customer Empathy: Customer Empathy is the ability to understand the perspectives, pain points, and experiences of customers. It involves actively putting oneself in the customer’s shoes, comprehending their needs and challenges, and using that understanding to provide a better, more customer-centric experience.
Engineering Excellence: Engineering Excellence is about bringing great craftsmanship and thought leadership to deliver an outstanding product that delights customers and solves for the business. This involves the pursuit and achievement of high standards, best practices, innovation, and superior solutions.
One Team: A One Team mindset refers to a collaborative approach across the organization, where individuals work together seamlessly, without boundaries, as a single, cohesive team. Shared goals, open communication and mutual support create a sense of collective purpose. This enables teams to navigate challenges and pursue shared objectives more effectively.
Owner’s Mindset: Owner’s Mindset involves adopting a set of behaviors that reflect a sense of responsibility, accountability, strategic thinking, and a proactive approach to managing your domain. As an owner, you understand the business and your domain(s) deeply and solve for the right outcome for the domain(s) and the business.
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or closely related field of study; or equivalent work experience
Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience or comparable depth of experience
Experience in the leadership role overseeing technical direction of data platform, technology and architecture
Expert knowledge of software engineering best practices with experience building modern data platform, product and solutions, especially in enabling AI success
Expert understanding and use of modern data technology end 2 end including but not limited to source system, data integration, data acquisition, data ingestion, data transformation, data aggregation, data governance, business intelligence, data warehouse, data lake, NoSQL, object storage, streaming etc.
Extensive experience with building and driving adoption of software engineering best practices
Strong understanding of AI, distributed systems, cloud computing, and microservices architectures
Demonstrated success in building strong engineering organization and attract/recruit/grow/retain talents
Demonstrated success in building mission-critical enterprise class data platform that delivers business impact
Demonstrated ability to work with business partners, cross functional team members and coach and mentor experienced team members
In-depth experience with building big data real time production system that delivers business success
Experienced in communicating and articulating technology subjects in the context of business and providing timely and clear communication
Well versed in delivery mechanisms such as Agile
Preferred:
Financial services or FinTech industry experience
Knowledge and Skills:
Architecture and Design: Ability to implement world class solutions that meet the needs of the business and customer, and help deliver growth and innovation.
Leadership: Be a thought leader and demonstrate leadership to mentor team members, influence change and drive for the business outcome
Ability to challenge the status quo and influence stakeholders to create innovative solutions
Be collaborative with other team members, seeking a diversity of thought to meet business outcomes
Ability to foster strong relationships across the organization
Bring a strong understanding of relevant and emerging technologies, provide input and coach team members and embed learning and innovation in the day-to-day
Strong experience and understanding of how to connect the work being done and how it drives business value
Ability to communicate complex technical information (both verbal and written) to all levels, including senior leadership
Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Target Compensation: A competitive base salary range from $208,761 – $347,935. This position is eligible for an annual variable bonus of cash and equity, between 20-60%. jobs.title: Director, Capacity Planning & Engineering
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox is looking for a Director of Capacity Planning & Engineering to lead the team responsible for translating platform demand into physical infrastructure reality — from supply-demand modeling and hardware procurement through data center deployment and FinOps. This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of infrastructure strategy, operational execution, and software engineering.
You will lead a team of approximately 20 people organized across four functional areas and will be responsible for scaling Roblox's infrastructure footprint as it continues to grow rapidly.
What You'll Own
Capacity Planning
Translate platform demand forecasts into hardware requirements
Own the supply-demand matching process end-to-end, working closely with Data Center, Hardware Engineering, and Supply Chain teams
Build and refine capacity models that give the business confidence in infrastructure availability months ahead
Deployment & Delivery
Oversee hardware lifecycle from procurement through physical installation and software provisioning.
Partner with platform and data center operations teams to bring new capacity online reliably and on schedule.
Own delivery execution for major milestones including new data center buildout (Q4).
Data Center Automation (Software Engineering)
Lead a software engineering sub-team that builds and maintains DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure Management) systems.
Drive automation for rack delivery, decommissioning, and capacity planning tooling.
Identify opportunities to scale automation coverage as Roblox's 25+ global data centers expand.
FinOps
Oversee cloud spend optimization and on-prem vs. cloud allocation decisions.
Grow and develop the FinOps function, which is lean today but increasing in strategic importance as cloud spend scales.
Partner with Finance to ensure infrastructure spend is visible, justified, and optimized.
You Have:
10+ years of experience in infrastructure, data center operations, or related fields, with at least 3 years in a director-level or senior leadership role.
Deep expertise in capacity planning and supply-demand analysis for large-scale infrastructure environments.
Hands-on familiarity with DCIM systems and data center automation — this role is lower in the stack than platform software (not Kubernetes/cloud-native).
Experience working across supply chain systems, hardware procurement, and deployment execution.
Proven ability to lead and scale cross-functional teams including software engineers, planners, and operations specialists.
Strong analytical and communication skills; comfortable translating complex infrastructure decisions for C-suite audiences.
Familiarity with AI/GPU infrastructure - Roblox is actively building GPU factory capacity aligned with NVIDIA's next-generation hardware roadmap.
Experience managing a FinOps function or cloud cost optimization at scale.
Background in hyperscale, colocation, or edge data center environments.
Exposure to liquid cooling infrastructure for high-density compute.
You Will
Own a critical piece of infrastructure for a platform used by hundreds of millions of people worldwide.
Scale the team to support ongoing growth and new product features.
Drive improvements in partnership with other engineering teams across Roblox
Create a culture and practice of production excellence, security, and cost-efficiency
Hire and develop senior engineers, managers, and leaders
You are:
Collaborative, low-ego environment where candid feedback is welcomed and acted on.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$399,420—$457,970 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).

Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Chef de l'ingénierie | Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
ABOUT VALPAY
Founded in 2022, ValPay is an all-in-one payment solution tailored to empower its partners' software platforms. Designed for ambitious business owners wanting to focus on growing their business rather than the logistics needed to run it, ValPay helps companies prevent fraud, gain access to real-time reporting, and accept both online and in-person payments. ValPay's PayFac-as-a-Service model gives its partners all the benefits of integrated payments while handling the heavy lifting.
ValPay is a subsidiary of Valsoft.
THE ROLE
As Head of Engineering, you will own the engineering organization at ValPay — how it is structured, how it delivers, and how good it gets. You will report to the CEO and work alongside product and go-to-market leadership to turn a talented, lean team into a predictable, high-performing engineering function.
This is a build role, not a caretaker role. ValPay's engineering team has grown quickly and now needs someone to put real operating discipline behind it: a delivery rhythm people can count on, a management layer that holds, and technical standards that let the platform scale with the business — without losing the speed and hands-on energy that got ValPay here.
We are hiring for trajectory. This role is scoped as Head of Engineering today, and it is designed as the potential path to Chief Technology Officer at ValPay. We would rather hire someone with the ceiling to grow into that seat and back them properly than hire the title and hope. What earns the step up is straightforward: a delivery organization that runs without heroics, a leadership bench you built, and a track record of technical judgment the CEO and the board can lean on.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Own engineering delivery end to end — planning, execution, release cadence, and quality — and make it predictable enough that the business can plan around it.
Build and lead the engineering management layer: hire, develop, and coach engineering managers, tech leads, and senior/staff engineers, and put a durable structure beneath you.
Partner with Product on roadmap feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Product sets the what; you own the how and the when.
Set and enforce technical standards across the platform — architecture, code quality, testing, observability, and documentation — so the system scales as GMV and merchant count grow.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for integrations with core payments partners (Adyen, Fiserv), working complex issues to resolution and feeding what you learn back into the platform.
Drive AI adoption inside engineering — in the SDLC, in developer productivity, and in the product where it measurably improves outcomes.
Own engineering operations and reliability: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and the SLAs a PCI DSS Level 1 payments platform has to hold.
Partner with security and compliance to keep PCI DSS certification and multi-jurisdiction obligations met as the platform expands.
Be a steady presence under pressure, and build the organizational muscle for the team to handle incidents increasingly without you.
WHAT YOU BRING
8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams, with at least some of that time managing managers or tech leads.
Proven experience building, structuring, and scaling technology organizations, ideally in high-growth environments.
Experience hiring and developing engineering leaders, and the appetite to keep doing it.
You can still apply hands-on technical depth, you review architecture, you can go deep in a design review or an incident, and engineers respect your judgment. You are not expected to write production code day to day.
Strong judgment on build-versus-buy, technical debt, and where to spend engineering capacity — and the ability to explain those calls in business terms to a non-technical executive team.
A track record of installing delivery process in a fast-moving team without killing its speed: planning cadence, release discipline, on-call, and the metrics to know whether it is working.
Demonstrable ambition and ceiling. You want the CTO seat eventually and you can show what you have been doing to get ready for it.
NICE TO HAVE
Payments, fintech, or other regulated/high-availability environments (PCI DSS, SOC 2, or similar).
Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed environment, or integrating engineering teams from acquisitions.
Experience with multi-tenant platform or API-first product architecture.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In the first six to twelve months:
A management layer is in place: engineering managers or tech leads owning their areas, with clear scope and accountability.
Engineering runs on a delivery rhythm the business can plan against — commitments are made and met, and slippage is visible early rather than at the deadline.
Delivery and reliability are measured, not felt — baseline metrics exist for throughput, lead time, change failure rate, and incident response, and they are trending the right way.
AI is in real use inside engineering, with live use cases rather than pilots.
On-call and incident response are defined and drilled, and incidents are increasingly resolved without you in the room.
Technical standards and architecture direction are written down, agreed, and actually followed.
WHY VALPAY
Founded in 2022, ValPay is already operating at scale: a PCI DSS Level 1 certified platform running across 40+ jurisdictions in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, serving vertical software platforms in dental, marine, property management, automotive, and more.
Growth runs on three engines, and all three run on the same platform:
Internal sales — converting existing Valsoft GMV to ValPay, a $15B+ opportunity across the current customer base plus every new Valsoft acquisition.
External ISV channel — signing ISVs outside the Valsoft portfolio, $25M–$50M in revenue, with $2B+ in deals already closed and now being converted into live, processing merchants.
M&A engine — acquiring payment gateway businesses, two closed so far, with the same conversion playbook applied to each newly acquired asset.
Embedded payments inside a portfolio of 150+ vertical software companies is distribution most payments companies spend years trying to build. ValPay already has it. What decides how fast these engines scale is the engineering organization behind them — which is the mandate of this role.
ValPay is backed by Valsoft, which buys and holds companies indefinitely rather than selling them. You build on a long horizon, not toward an exit.
For more information: https://www.valpay.com/
___________________________________________________________________________________________
À PROPOS DE VALPAY
Fondée en 2022, ValPay est une solution de paiement tout-en-un conçue pour outiller les plateformes logicielles de ses partenaires. Pensée pour les entrepreneurs ambitieux qui souhaitent se consacrer à la croissance de leur entreprise plutôt qu'à la logistique nécessaire à son exploitation, ValPay aide les entreprises à prévenir la fraude, à accéder à des rapports en temps réel et à accepter les paiements en ligne comme en personne. Le modèle de facilitation des paiements en tant que service (PayFac-as-a-Service) de ValPay procure à ses partenaires tous les avantages des paiements intégrés, tout en prenant en charge le gros du travail.
ValPay est une filiale de Valsoft.
LE POSTE
À titre de chef de l'ingénierie, vous prendrez en charge l'organisation d'ingénierie de ValPay : sa structure, sa capacité de livraison et son niveau d'excellence. Vous relèverez du chef de la direction et travaillerez aux côtés des responsables du produit et de la mise en marché afin de transformer une équipe talentueuse et restreinte en une fonction d'ingénierie prévisible et très performante.
Il s'agit d'un rôle de bâtisseur, et non de gestionnaire de statu quo. L'équipe d'ingénierie de ValPay a connu une croissance rapide et a maintenant besoin d'une personne capable d'y instaurer une véritable discipline opérationnelle : une cadence de livraison fiable, une couche de gestion solide et des normes techniques permettant à la plateforme d'évoluer au rythme de l'entreprise — sans perdre la rapidité et l'énergie concrète qui ont mené ValPay jusqu'ici.
Nous recrutons pour le potentiel. Ce poste est défini aujourd'hui comme celui de chef de l'ingénierie, et il est conçu comme la voie d'accès possible au poste de chef de la technologie (CTO) chez ValPay. Nous préférons embaucher une personne ayant la capacité de croître vers ce rôle et l'appuyer pleinement, plutôt que d'embaucher un titre en espérant que cela fonctionne. Les conditions de cette progression sont claires : une organisation de livraison qui fonctionne sans héroïsme, un banc de leaders que vous aurez bâti, et un jugement technique sur lequel la direction et le conseil peuvent s'appuyer.
CE QUE VOUS FEREZ
Assumer la livraison en ingénierie de bout en bout — planification, exécution, cadence de mise en production et qualité — et la rendre suffisamment prévisible pour que l'entreprise puisse planifier en conséquence.
Bâtir et diriger la couche de gestion en ingénierie : embaucher, développer et encadrer des gestionnaires de l'ingénierie, des chefs techniques et des ingénieurs seniors ou principaux, et mettre en place une structure durable sous votre responsabilité.
Collaborer avec le Produit sur la faisabilité, le séquencement et les compromis de la feuille de route. Le Produit définit le quoi; vous êtes responsable du comment et du quand.
Définir et faire respecter les normes techniques de la plateforme — architecture, qualité du code, tests, observabilité et documentation — afin que le système évolue avec la croissance du volume de paiements et du nombre de marchands.
Agir comme point d'escalade technique senior pour les intégrations avec les principaux partenaires de paiement (Adyen, Fiserv), en menant les enjeux complexes jusqu'à leur résolution et en réinjectant les apprentissages dans la plateforme.
Piloter l'adoption de l'IA au sein de l'ingénierie — dans le cycle de développement, dans la productivité des développeurs et dans le produit lorsque les bénéfices sont mesurables.
Assumer les opérations d'ingénierie et la fiabilité : garde, réponse aux incidents, post-mortems et niveaux de service qu'exige une plateforme de paiement certifiée PCI DSS de niveau 1.
Collaborer avec les équipes de sécurité et de conformité afin de maintenir la certification PCI DSS et les obligations multijuridictionnelles à mesure que la plateforme s'étend.
Demeurer une présence stable sous pression et développer la capacité organisationnelle permettant à l'équipe de gérer les incidents de plus en plus sans vous.
CE QUE VOUS APPORTEZ
Au moins 8 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, dont 4 ans ou plus à diriger des équipes d'ingénierie, incluant une période de gestion de gestionnaires ou de chefs techniques.
Expérience démontrée dans la création, la structuration et la mise à l'échelle d'organisations technologiques, idéalement dans des environnements à forte croissance.
Expérience d'embauche et de développement de leaders en ingénierie, et le désir de continuer à le faire.
Vous conservez une profondeur technique concrète et applicable : vous révisez l'architecture, vous pouvez approfondir une revue de conception ou un incident, et les ingénieurs respectent votre jugement. L'écriture de code en production au quotidien n'est pas attendue.
Un jugement solide sur les décisions de type « développer ou acheter », sur la dette technique et sur l'allocation de la capacité d'ingénierie — et la capacité d'expliquer ces choix en termes d'affaires à une équipe de direction non technique.
Un historique démontré d'implantation de processus de livraison dans une équipe qui avance vite, sans en freiner la rapidité : cadence de planification, discipline de mise en production, garde, et les indicateurs permettant d'en mesurer l'efficacité.
Une ambition et un potentiel démontrables. Vous visez éventuellement le poste de chef de la technologie et vous pouvez démontrer ce que vous faites pour vous y préparer.
ATOUTS RECHERCHÉS
Expérience dans les paiements, en technologie financière ou dans d'autres environnements réglementés à haute disponibilité (PCI DSS, SOC 2 ou équivalent).
Expérience dans un environnement à forte croissance ou détenu par un fonds d'investissement privé, ou en intégration d'équipes d'ingénierie issues d'acquisitions.
Expérience des architectures de plateforme multilocataire ou de produits axés sur les API.
CE À QUOI RESSEMBLE LA RÉUSSITE
Au cours des six à douze premiers mois :
Une couche de gestion est en place : des gestionnaires de l'ingénierie ou des chefs techniques responsables de leurs domaines, avec un périmètre et une imputabilité clairs.
L'ingénierie fonctionne selon une cadence de livraison sur laquelle l'entreprise peut planifier : les engagements sont pris et tenus, et les écarts sont visibles tôt plutôt qu'à l'échéance.
La livraison et la fiabilité sont mesurées, et non ressenties : des indicateurs de référence existent pour le débit, le délai de livraison, le taux d'échec des changements et la réponse aux incidents, et ils évoluent dans la bonne direction.
L'IA est utilisée concrètement au sein de l'ingénierie, avec des cas d'utilisation en production plutôt que des projets pilotes.
La garde et la réponse aux incidents sont définies et exercées, et les incidents se règlent de plus en plus sans votre présence.
Les normes techniques et l'orientation architecturale sont documentées, acceptées et réellement appliquées.
POURQUOI VALPAY
Fondée en 2022, ValPay fonctionne déjà à grande échelle : une plateforme certifiée PCI DSS de niveau 1, déployée dans plus de 40 territoires en Amérique du Nord, en Europe et en Asie-Pacifique, au service de plateformes logicielles verticales en dentisterie, en nautisme, en gestion immobilière, en automobile et ailleurs.
La croissance repose sur trois moteurs, qui s'appuient tous sur la même plateforme :
Ventes internes — convertir le volume de paiements (GMV) existant de Valsoft vers ValPay, une occasion de plus de 15 G$ dans la clientèle actuelle, à laquelle s'ajoute chaque nouvelle acquisition de Valsoft.
Canal des ISV externes — signer des ISV à l'extérieur du portefeuille de Valsoft, pour des revenus de 25 M$ à 50 M$, avec plus de 2 G$ d'ententes déjà conclues, maintenant converties en marchands actifs qui traitent des transactions.
Moteur d'acquisitions — acquérir des entreprises de passerelles de paiement : deux transactions conclues à ce jour, le même plan de conversion étant appliqué à chaque actif acquis.
Offrir des paiements intégrés au sein d'un portefeuille de plus de 150 sociétés de logiciels verticaux représente un réseau de distribution que la plupart des entreprises de paiement mettent des années à bâtir. ValPay le possède déjà. Ce qui déterminera la vitesse de ces trois moteurs, c'est l'organisation d'ingénierie qui les soutient — et c'est là le mandat de ce poste.
ValPay est soutenue par Valsoft, qui acquiert et conserve ses entreprises indéfiniment plutôt que de les revendre. Vous bâtissez sur un horizon long, et non en vue d'une sortie.
Pour en savoir plus : https://www.valpay.com/

blocks.text: ABOUT VALPAY

Founded in 2022, ValPay is an all-in-one payment solution tailored to empower its partners' software platforms. Designed for ambitious business owners wanting to focus on growing their business rather than the logistics needed to run it, ValPay helps companies prevent fraud, gain access to real-time reporting, and accept both online and in-person payments. ValPay's PayFac-as-a-Service model gives its partners all the benefits of integrated payments while handling the heavy lifting.
ValPay is a subsidiary of Valsoft.
THE ROLE

As Head of Engineering, you will own the engineering organization at ValPay — how it is structured, how it delivers, and how good it gets. You will report to the CEO and work alongside product and go-to-market leadership to turn a talented, lean team into a predictable, high-performing engineering function.

This is a build role, not a caretaker role. ValPay's engineering team has grown quickly and now needs someone to put real operating discipline behind it: a delivery rhythm people can count on, a management layer that holds, and technical standards that let the platform scale with the business — without losing the speed and hands-on energy that got ValPay here.

We are hiring for trajectory. This role is scoped as Head of Engineering today, and it is designed as the potential path to Chief Technology Officer at ValPay. We would rather hire someone with the ceiling to grow into that seat and back them properly than hire the title and hope. What earns the step up is straightforward: a delivery organization that runs without heroics, a leadership bench you built, and a track record of technical judgment the CEO and the board can lean on.
WHAT YOU'LL DO

items: Own engineering delivery end to end — planning, execution, release cadence, and quality — and make it predictable enough that the business can plan around it.
Build and lead the engineering management layer: hire, develop, and coach engineering managers, tech leads, and senior/staff engineers, and put a durable structure beneath you.
Partner with Product on roadmap feasibility, sequencing, and trade-offs. Product sets the what; you own the how and the when.
Set and enforce technical standards across the platform — architecture, code quality, testing, observability, and documentation — so the system scales as GMV and merchant count grow.
Serve as the senior technical escalation point for integrations with core payments partners (Adyen, Fiserv), working complex issues to resolution and feeding what you learn back into the platform.
Drive AI adoption inside engineering — in the SDLC, in developer productivity, and in the product where it measurably improves outcomes.
Own engineering operations and reliability: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and the SLAs a PCI DSS Level 1 payments platform has to hold.
Partner with security and compliance to keep PCI DSS certification and multi-jurisdiction obligations met as the platform expands.
Be a steady presence under pressure, and build the organizational muscle for the team to handle incidents increasingly without you.

blocks.text: WHAT YOU BRING

items: 8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years leading engineering teams, with at least some of that time managing managers or tech leads.
Proven experience building, structuring, and scaling technology organizations, ideally in high-growth environments.
Experience hiring and developing engineering leaders, and the appetite to keep doing it.

You can still apply hands-on technical depth, you review architecture, you can go deep in a design review or an incident, and engineers respect your judgment. You are not expected to write production code day to day.
Strong judgment on build-versus-buy, technical debt, and where to spend engineering capacity — and the ability to explain those calls in business terms to a non-technical executive team.
A track record of installing delivery process in a fast-moving team without killing its speed: planning cadence, release discipline, on-call, and the metrics to know whether it is working.
Demonstrable ambition and ceiling. You want the CTO seat eventually and you can show what you have been doing to get ready for it.

blocks.text: NICE TO HAVE
Payments, fintech, or other regulated/high-availability environments (PCI DSS, SOC 2, or similar).
Experience in a high-growth or private-equity-backed environment, or integrating engineering teams from acquisitions.
Experience with multi-tenant platform or API-first product architecture.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In the first six to twelve months:

items: A management layer is in place: engineering managers or tech leads owning their areas, with clear scope and accountability.
Engineering runs on a delivery rhythm the business can plan against — commitments are made and met, and slippage is visible early rather than at the deadline.
Delivery and reliability are measured, not felt — baseline metrics exist for throughput, lead time, change failure rate, and incident response, and they are trending the right way.
AI is in real use inside engineering, with live use cases rather than pilots.
On-call and incident response are defined and drilled, and incidents are increasingly resolved without you in the room.
Technical standards and architecture direction are written down, agreed, and actually followed.

blocks.text: WHY VALPAY

Founded in 2022, ValPay is already operating at scale: a PCI DSS Level 1 certified platform running across 40+ jurisdictions in North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific, serving vertical software platforms in dental, marine, property management, automotive, and more.
Growth runs on three engines, and all three run on the same platform:

items: Internal sales — converting existing Valsoft GMV to ValPay, a $15B+ opportunity across the current customer base plus every new Valsoft acquisition.
External ISV channel — signing ISVs outside the Valsoft portfolio, $25M–$50M in revenue, with $2B+ in deals already closed and now being converted into live, processing merchants.
M&A engine — acquiring payment gateway businesses, two closed so far, with the same conversion playbook applied to each newly acquired asset.

blocks.text: Embedded payments inside a portfolio of 150+ vertical software companies is distribution most payments companies spend years trying to build. ValPay already has it. What decides how fast these engines scale is the engineering organization behind them — which is the mandate of this role.
ValPay is backed by Valsoft, which buys and holds companies indefinitely rather than selling them. You build on a long horizon, not toward an exit.
For more information: https://www.valpay.com/

jobs.title: Director, Product Partnerships
jobs.text:
We're transforming the grocery industry
At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.
Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.
Instacart is a Flex First team
There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Why this role is on the menu
Instacart’s product and technology partnerships — spanning logistics, retail technology, and enterprise products — are a core lever for how we build and grow. But as our ambitions scale into new product areas and international markets, the function needs more than experienced deal-makers. It needs a senior leader who can set the multi-year vision, personally own the most consequential relationships, and shape how Instacart decides what to build versus buy versus partner. Without this person, we risk reactive partnership decisions, misalignment between partnerships and product strategy, and missed first-mover opportunities in markets where speed matters. We’re hiring a Director of Product Partnerships to lead the team and function at the highest level — influencing build-buy-partner tradeoffs with senior leadership, taking first-of-a-kind bets from 0 to 1, and making Instacart one of the most sought-after partners in grocery technology.
What you’ll cook up in your first year.
Instacart has a clear, credible multi-year partnership strategy across Logistics, Retail Technology, and Enterprise — one that leadership has bought into and that's actively shaping which product bets we pursue versus partner for.
At least one first-of-a-kind deal — in a new product area or international market — has gone from concept to signed to launched, with a playbook behind it that the team can repeat.
The partnerships team is operating at a higher level — Senior Managers and Managers have clearer ownership, stronger frameworks for deal evaluation and partner performance, and a leader who’s actively developing them for what comes next.
Product and Engineering leadership treat this person as a genuine strategic partner — not just a deal-closer — because they’ve visibly influenced roadmap decisions and brought external perspective into how we build.
Instacart’s most critical external partners — at the C-suite and executive level — have a named senior relationship owner who shows up with authority, earns trust, and surfaces the opportunities that matter most to the business.
The secret ingredients we’re looking for
Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)
15+ years of experience in business development, product partnerships, or strategic alliances in technology or closely adjacent industries, with end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder deals from sourcing through launch.
Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing partnerships teams, including managing managers and structuring a function for scale.
Proven track record of closing complex, non-standard technology or strategic partnership agreements — including first-of-a-kind deals — with C-suite or executive-level counterparts.
Experience serving as a true strategic partner to Product and Engineering: influencing roadmap and build-buy-partner decisions, not just executing alongside them.
Strong financial and analytical skills, including business case development to evaluate partnership economics and communicate ROI to senior leadership.
Comfortable operating without a roadmap — brings clarity and direction to a team even when the path forward isn’t obvious.
Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)
Experience with software and/or hardware partnerships across retail, grocery, in-store technology, e-commerce, loyalty, POS, or adjacent ecosystems.
Experience with international product partnerships, particularly in EMEA markets.
Background in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate development.
MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.
Why this role is on the menu

Instacart’s product and technology partnerships — spanning logistics, retail technology, and enterprise products — are a core lever for how we build and grow. But as our ambitions scale into new product areas and international markets, the function needs more than experienced deal-makers. It needs a senior leader who can set the multi-year vision, personally own the most consequential relationships, and shape how Instacart decides what to build versus buy versus partner. Without this person, we risk reactive partnership decisions, misalignment between partnerships and product strategy, and missed first-mover opportunities in markets where speed matters. We’re hiring a Director of Product Partnerships to lead the team and function at the highest level — influencing build-buy-partner tradeoffs with senior leadership, taking first-of-a-kind bets from 0 to 1, and making Instacart one of the most sought-after partners in grocery technology.
What you’ll cook up in your first year.

items: Instacart has a clear, credible multi-year partnership strategy across Logistics, Retail Technology, and Enterprise — one that leadership has bought into and that's actively shaping which product bets we pursue versus partner for.
At least one first-of-a-kind deal — in a new product area or international market — has gone from concept to signed to launched, with a playbook behind it that the team can repeat.

The partnerships team is operating at a higher level — Senior Managers and Managers have clearer ownership, stronger frameworks for deal evaluation and partner performance, and a leader who’s actively developing them for what comes next.

Product and Engineering leadership treat this person as a genuine strategic partner — not just a deal-closer — because they’ve visibly influenced roadmap decisions and brought external perspective into how we build.

Instacart’s most critical external partners — at the C-suite and executive level — have a named senior relationship owner who shows up with authority, earns trust, and surfaces the opportunities that matter most to the business.

blocks.text: The secret ingredients we’re looking for
Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

items: 15+ years of experience in business development, product partnerships, or strategic alliances in technology or closely adjacent industries, with end-to-end ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder deals from sourcing through launch.
Demonstrated experience building and leading high-performing partnerships teams, including managing managers and structuring a function for scale.
Proven track record of closing complex, non-standard technology or strategic partnership agreements — including first-of-a-kind deals — with C-suite or executive-level counterparts.
Experience serving as a true strategic partner to Product and Engineering: influencing roadmap and build-buy-partner decisions, not just executing alongside them.
Strong financial and analytical skills, including business case development to evaluate partnership economics and communicate ROI to senior leadership.
Comfortable operating without a roadmap — brings clarity and direction to a team even when the path forward isn’t obvious.

blocks.text: Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

items: Experience with software and/or hardware partnerships across retail, grocery, in-store technology, e-commerce, loyalty, POS, or adjacent ecosystems.
Experience with international product partnerships, particularly in EMEA markets.
Background in management consulting, investment banking, or corporate development.
MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.text:
Job Description | About the Role
The Product Manager ascertains what’s next for the product. Head of Product is a visionary who is also rich with applied experience. We’re looking for someone will work cross-functionally with engineering, growth, and marketing to bring unique value-based features to market across B2B2C.
This role moves at a fast pace while maintaining excellent quality and a positive working attitude to strategize the Fabulous product roadmap.
Expectations | Duties
Outreach and Data Accumulation
Connect with users: dig into user data, both qualitative and quantitative
Ascertains trends while being a champion for user-first experiences
Collaborate with researchers, data scientists, and business development teams to understand user needs and identify new product opportunities.
Immerse yourself in the psychology, pain points and behavior of users to develop strong intuition about solutions that will work for them.
Develop compelling roadmaps and metric targets that keep us on track towards our desired goals and continuously measure progress towards them.
Lead product ideation and prioritization within a key product area.
Evaluate ideas and lead product prioritization and releases
Have a consistent pipeline of fresh ideas that can help move the needle, through user research/feedback, driving brainstorms sessions, and doing competitive research
Ruthlessly prioritize these ideas in a robust, data-informed way, with an aim to have the most impact with limited resources – time, engineering resources, user volume, etc.
Leverage data to drive product development and experimentation.
Lead a cross-functional team through the product development cycle–UI/UX, engineering, QA, and data analysis.
Be the overall point-person to build compelling products and features for users.
Write design documents and web updates for new content/features/initiatives with input from curriculum, design & engineering partners.
Initiate data-driven experimentation and analysis on new products and features.
Requirements
Qualifications | Requirements
8+ years of relevant product management experience:
Experience in a prior startup or other high-ambiguity environment
Prior consumer-facing product development experience, ideally with mobile or subscription-based products
Prior experience with psychology-based products, gamification, or other user behavior-oriented apps
Additional PM skills we highly value:
Consumer user empathy & perspective
Driving strategy & big-picture thinking
Experience with data analysis, metrics, and goal-setting
Analytical dexterity a.k.a. critical problem solving
Scrappy–execution & outcome-focused
Curious and teachable
Benefits
About Us
An award-winning health, wellness, & coaching company that creates apps which fall the top ten internationally. Our science-based approach sits squarely in the tech-for-good lane, helping people live their best lives. Everyone who has joined this company is committed to using evidence-based research to find the absolute best ways to change lives for the better.
Our History
Three co-founders created the Fabulous app: Sami, Amine, and Taylor. Growing up in Tunisia, Sami and Amine were only 16 when they met. With their early iteration, they reached out to Taylor, an award-winning designer in Malaysia. Their vision was welcomed into an incubation lab for startups at Duke University led by world-renowned Behavioral Economics Professor Dan Ariely. Our Chief Storyteller Jaz co-founded the Introductory Psychology program at Stanford University.
Our Approach
We use a behavioral economics lens to help individuals find that 'on switch' inside them to achieve their fullest potential. What has emerged is a system that transforms tiny habits into profound long-term changes. A world in which people with ADHD thrive. A method for gratitude to reach through difficulty. A sanctuary to seek out your true purpose. A fountain of knowledge. A space for rest and self compassion.
Our Mission
Help every individual discover the wonderful person inside themselves by creating: beautiful, evidence-based, life-changing products.
Our Environment
The first thing that sets us apart is that we’re not a place at all. While we’re a remote company, it’s not unusual to feel you know your teammates better than those you’ve shared an office with in the past. Ours is a professionally nourishing environment that is flexible and fully remote. Team members enjoy in house challenges and Slack event and work across a variety of tools. Meetings are kept to a minimum and deep work is encouraged.
Our Awards
Apple Best Apps of 2018
Editor’s app choice in more than 30 countries
Winner of Google’s Material Design Award
Best App Finalist in Google Play Awards
Consistently ranking in the top ten Health & Fitness apps across platforms
Backed by Facebook Startup Lab and Microsoft Venture
Our Norms
Ownership: Be the CEO of your tasks. No one is watching over your shoulder. Be the proof.
Open Communication: Constructive ideas are always flying across time zones.
Deep Work: Disconnect. Find your flow. Become industrious. It’s about the work here.
Always Offer Context: Sharing rationale works wonders in asynchronous conversations.
Impeccable Agreement: Promise, then follow through. Everyone relies on everyone.
Egos are checked at the door. Those who join our workforce place themselves in service of our members.
Our Values
#collaboration #craftsmanship #feedback #respect #responsibility #simplicity #speed
Our Future
To this day, over 30 million people have started their journey to better themselves with our apps. We are creating a generation of change-makers, with the same drive to help others, each in their own way.
Our Invitation
At Fabulous, every team member is a sculptor in their own right. Together, we help millions of users step out of their block of stone and step into the fullest version of their life through behavioral science. Tell us what drives you; if you were to pick up your tools, what would you contribution look like?
Originally posted on Himalayas

jobs.title: Fractional Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – SaaS & AI/LLM
jobs.text:
About the Role
We are seeking a highly skilled and entrepreneurial Fractional CTO to join our team. This role is ideal for a hands-on technology leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and can take a product from concept to launch. You will be instrumental in shaping the technical direction of our next-generation SaaS platform, built with AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) at its core.
Key Responsibilities
Design and architect the product’s technical foundation.
Build and deliver the Minimum Viable Product (MVP).
Lead the integration and experimentation with AI/LLM technologies.
Drive rapid prototyping to move from idea, working product quickly.
Ensure scalability and robustness of the product architecture.
Collaborate with founders and stakeholders to align technical execution with business goals.
Qualifications & Skills
5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2–3 years in a senior leadership role (CTO, Lead Engineer, or equivalent).
Strong hands-on coding ability (preferably full-stack).
Deep knowledge of AI/ML frameworks and LLM integration.
Expertise in SaaS architecture and cloud infrastructure.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work in a lean, agile startup environment.
Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Interested candidates should submit their CV and a short cover letter here or send an email to [] with the subject line: Fractional Chief Technology Officer (CTO) Application – [Your Name]
About Nucleus Ventures
Nucleus Ventures is a leading entity in corporate innovation, venture building, and advisory services, with a track record of successful ventures, operational advisory missions, and startup incubators. Based in Beirut, Nucleus Ventures also operates in France, the UK, and Cyprus, serving the EMEA region. The company collaborates closely with clients, leveraging subject matter experts, startups, and entrepreneurs to drive growth and innovation through tailored strategies.

jobs.title: Director - Developer Platforms, Infra, Data Engineering and Platform
jobs.text:
We are looking for a Director - Developer Platforms, Infra, Data Engineering and Platform to lead and evolve the engineering platforms and infrastructure that power Carousell Group at scale.
This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who can operate across Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and Data Engineering and go deep in at least two of these areas.
You will help shape how our engineering organisation builds, operates and scales systems while driving the adoption of AI-native and agentic engineering practices across the organisation.
We are looking for someone who is comfortable operating at both strategic and technical depth. You should be able to engage with senior engineers on architecture and technical decisions while also leading managers and engineering organisations through complex, multi-year initiatives.
What You Will Do
Lead and evolve our platform, infrastructure and engineering capabilities to support highly scalable and reliable systems across Carousell Group.
Drive agentic engineering and AI adoption across engineering teams, leading from the front with hands-on experience applying AI to engineering workflows and software development.
Provide technical direction across Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and Data Engineering and make sound architecture decisions across these areas.
Lead the design and operation of highly scalable distributed systems with strong focus on reliability, performance, observability and operational excellence.
Partner with engineering leaders across the organisation to improve developer productivity, engineering velocity and system reliability.
Build and develop a strong engineering leadership layer and help principal and senior engineers grow their technical leadership.
Lead distributed engineering teams through managers and create an environment where senior technical talent can do their best work.
Drive engineering excellence across areas including service runtime, observability, scaling, service communication, data consistency, developer tooling, networking, security and infrastructure.
Own and influence significant infrastructure and platform investments including engineering efficiency and cloud cost optimisation.
Work closely with Product, Data, Engineering and executive stakeholders to shape technical strategy and influence business outcomes.
Operate effectively across multiple markets, teams and cultures within Carousell Group.
What Success Looks Like
In this role, success will mean:
Our engineering teams are increasingly AI-native and effective in using agentic engineering practices.
Our platform and infrastructure can scale reliably with the growth of the business.
Engineering teams have strong internal platforms, tooling and infrastructure that allow them to move faster without compromising reliability.
Senior technical talent is being developed into stronger technical and organisational leaders.
Platform and infrastructure investments are managed with a strong balance between engineering quality, reliability, developer productivity and cost.
You become a trusted technical partner to engineering and business leaders across Carousell Group.
What We're Looking For
Must Have
Significant experience leading large-scale engineering organisations in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure / SRE and/or Data Engineering.
Deep technical expertise in at least two of the three areas while having enough breadth across all three to effectively lead teams with deeper specialists.
Strong hands-on experience driving AI-native or agentic engineering adoption within an engineering organisation.
Strong distributed systems architecture and design expertise.
A track record of successfully building, scaling and operating high-scale platforms or systems.
Experience leading complex technical initiatives from architecture through execution and operations.
Strong technical judgement with the ability to engage credibly with Principal and Senior Engineers.
Good to Have
Experience mentoring and developing Principal / Senior Engineers and building strong technical leadership pipelines.
Experience owning cloud infrastructure or platform costs at significant scale.
Experience leading distributed engineering organisations of 15–30+ engineers through an EM layer.
Experience working in a multi-brand, multi-market or multi-business-unit organisation.
Experience working across different geographies and cultures.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder influence.
By proceeding with your application, you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.
About Carousell Group
Carousell Group is the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India).
As a team of passionate individuals working together to solve meaningful problems, there is so much more for you to discover in a career with Carousell. Our culture is made up of hiring, developing, and promoting people who embody our values of HEART, which is an acronym for Humility, Empathy, Accountability, Relentlessly resourceful and Teamwork. Together as an organisation, we make magic happen.

jobs.text:
Job Title: VP, Product Delivery & Growth - AI
Location: USA - Remote
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
