jobs.title: Managing Director - Data & AI (Montreal, Canada)
jobs.text:
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 400 projects and have grown to 175+ talented individuals across 7 office locations.
Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes. You can learn more about what we are passionate about at and on our you can find more useful information about our business and recruiting process.
Are You the Leader We're Looking For?
As a Managing Director at Unit8, success isn't just about closing deals — it's about becoming a cornerstone of how we grow and deliver in the Canadian market. You will own both sides of the equation: originating high-value client relationships and ensuring the work we deliver actually moves the needle for our clients. If you've built your career at the intersection of commercial impact and technical credibility, and you're ready to operate with real autonomy in an expert-led environment, this is the role.
What Success Looks Like in This Role
This is a senior leadership position for someone as comfortable originating a complex engagement as overseeing its delivery. You shape and close the deal, build relationships and trust, and you stay close enough to ensure the technical execution actually delivers value. You will succeed by:
Building and converting a pipeline of high-value opportunities in the Canadian market — primarily in financial services — through a network earned over years of credible work in data & AI
Selling from expertise: clients engage with you because you understand their problem because of your deep problem solving skills and experience not because you have a polished pitch
Staying embedded in delivery long enough to set the right pace, challenge client assumptions, and keep teams focused on the actual business problem
Bridging the gap between a senior data scientist and a C-suite conversation — translating technical constraints into strategic decisions and vice versa
Raising the delivery bar by knowing what good looks like and holding teams to that standard
What You'll Do
Leverage your existing network to source, shape, and close high-value engagements in Canada (new logos, not just expansions)
Translate complex business problems into concrete Data & AI solutions: identify where value can be created, make sure the team is building toward it, and hold the client accountable to realising it
Lead and shape complex, tech-enabled transformations — from early problem definition through to scaled delivery — ensuring the right technology choices serve the business outcome, not the other way around
Act as the senior point of contact for key clients throughout delivery, ensuring technical execution stays anchored to business value
Challenge clients when necessary — on scope, pace, and ambition
Work closely with our engineering and data science teams, providing business context, removing blockers and coaching them.

jobs.title: Senior Director of Engineering, AI Agents
jobs.text:
At Podium, we bring AI Employees to local businesses that turn every conversation into revenue. Trusted by 60,000+ businesses across Auto, Home Services, and Aesthetics, Podium captures and converts leads 24/7, driving both new business and repeat customers.
In under 24 months, we crossed $100M in AI Agent ARR, scaling 300% year-over-year. During this time, we’ve deployed 10,000 AI employees to empower real business outcomes for our customers. Podium is building what we believe will be the most impactful AI employee ecosystem for local business.
Podium has been recognized as the Best AI Implementation by Inc. Magazine, highlighted by OpenAI for building revenue-driving AI Agents, and awarded the #1 AI Agent for Business Operations by G2.
Our growth is fueled by hiring exceptional people, holding them to high standards, and creating opportunities for them to grow and make an impact. Our operating principles guide daily behavior and ensure we hire people who will thrive at Podium. If you're hungry for growth, aligned to our operating principles, and ready to get to work, you won't find a better place to learn and accelerate your career.
About the Role:
Podium built the AI Employee local businesses now depend on to answer every lead, book every appointment, and win the moments that used to slip through the cracks. It's not a chatbot bolted onto a CRM — it's an autonomous teammate that qualifies leads, holds real conversations, and closes the loop from first message to booked revenue, 24/7.
We're looking for a Senior Director of Engineering to take ownership of our AI Agents product and turn it from a fast-growing platform into the industry-defining agent infrastructure for local business. This is a hands-on leadership role — equal parts zero-to-one builder and scale-up operator. You'll architect and ship the systems that let our agents reason, act, and get better over time, while building the team and the org-level muscle to run these systems reliably at massive scale, across thousands of customer-facing workflows and business verticals.
What you will be doing:
Owning the technical architecture and roadmap for Podium's AI agent platform — the orchestration layer, tool-use frameworks, memory, and reasoning systems that power customer-facing agents across every industry vertical we serve
Leading and growing a team of engineers building and operating production agent systems, setting the technical bar and staying hands-on in design, code, and incident response where it matters most
Building and maturing our evaluation infrastructure — the offline and online eval harnesses, quality metrics, and feedback loops that let us ship agent improvements with confidence instead of guesswork
Driving the "0 to 1" build-out of new agent capabilities and workflows, then the "1 to scale" work of hardening those systems for reliability, latency, and cost as usage grows into the tens of millions of conversations
Partnering closely with Product to translate business outcomes (response time, conversion, show rate, revenue recovered) into agent capabilities and prioritized technical bets
Partnering with Infrastructure/Platform teams to ensure agent systems are observable, cost-efficient, and resilient at scale — this includes model routing, latency budgets, fallback behavior, and guardrails
Working directly with customers and customer-facing teams (Sales, CS, Support) to understand where agents succeed or fail in the field, and feeding that signal back into the roadmap
Establishing best practices for prompt/context engineering, agent testing, safety and guardrails, and responsible deployment of autonomous systems in live customer environments
Representing AI Agents engineering in leadership conversations — setting a clear technical narrative, calling out risk early, and making sound build-vs-buy and model-vs-vendor tradeoffs
What you should have:
10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in engineering leadership roles (Director, Head of Engineering, or equivalent scope as a hands-on lead)
Direct experience building and operating production LLM-powered or agentic systems — not just prototypes, but systems serving real users at real volume with real reliability requirements
Deep fluency in applied AI architecture: orchestration frameworks, tool-calling/function-calling patterns, RAG and context management, and the tradeoffs between latency, cost, and quality
A track record of building and scaling evaluation systems for non-deterministic software — you know how to measure agent quality, catch regressions, and make shipping decisions without waiting for perfect certainty
Experience leading both "0 to 1" builds and "1 to scale" hardening — you've stood up something from nothing and you've also kept something running under real production load
Strong instincts for working cross-functionally with Product, Infrastructure, and customer-facing teams, and the communication skills to align technical decisions with business outcomes
Genuine, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you and your team build
What we hope you have:
Experience building agent systems specifically for customer-facing, revenue-critical workflows (sales, support, scheduling, or similar)
Familiarity with voice AI, conversational AI, or real-time multimodal systems
Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or vertical software company, ideally one serving SMB customers
A point of view on the frontier of agentic AI — what's changing fast, what's overhyped, and where the real leverage is for a company like Podium
Why you'll love working here:
Podium is the best place to work to:
Join the leaders in AI agents — you'll be building on top of a product already trusted by 60,000+ businesses to run their AI Employee, with a real mandate and real usage to learn from
Unlock career-defining growth — this role owns a product area at the center of Podium's future, with the scope and visibility that comes with it
Build with world-class talent — join a team of engineers who ship fast, use AI tooling seriously, and care as much about outcomes as elegance
Make a real impact on local business — the agents you build directly help local businesses respond faster, convert more leads, and grow revenue without adding headcount
Podium is an equal opportunity employer. Podium provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital status or veteran status.

Partnering closely with Product to translate business outcomes (response time, conversion, show rate, revenue recovered) into agent capabilities and prioritized technical bets

Partnering with Infrastructure/Platform teams to ensure agent systems are observable, cost-efficient, and resilient at scale — this includes model routing, latency budgets, fallback behavior, and guardrails
Working directly with customers and customer-facing teams (Sales, CS, Support) to understand where agents succeed or fail in the field, and feeding that signal back into the roadmap
Establishing best practices for prompt/context engineering, agent testing, safety and guardrails, and responsible deployment of autonomous systems in live customer environments
Representing AI Agents engineering in leadership conversations — setting a clear technical narrative, calling out risk early, and making sound build-vs-buy and model-vs-vendor tradeoffs

blocks.text: What you should have:

items: 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time in engineering leadership roles (Director, Head of Engineering, or equivalent scope as a hands-on lead)
Direct experience building and operating production LLM-powered or agentic systems — not just prototypes, but systems serving real users at real volume with real reliability requirements
Deep fluency in applied AI architecture: orchestration frameworks, tool-calling/function-calling patterns, RAG and context management, and the tradeoffs between latency, cost, and quality

A track record of building and scaling evaluation systems for non-deterministic software — you know how to measure agent quality, catch regressions, and make shipping decisions without waiting for perfect certainty
Experience leading both "0 to 1" builds and "1 to scale" hardening — you've stood up something from nothing and you've also kept something running under real production load
Strong instincts for working cross-functionally with Product, Infrastructure, and customer-facing teams, and the communication skills to align technical decisions with business outcomes
Genuine, hands-on fluency with modern AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar) as part of how you and your team build

blocks.text: What we hope you have:

items: Experience building agent systems specifically for customer-facing, revenue-critical workflows (sales, support, scheduling, or similar)
Familiarity with voice AI, conversational AI, or real-time multimodal systems
Experience operating in a high-growth SaaS or vertical software company, ideally one serving SMB customers
A point of view on the frontier of agentic AI — what's changing fast, what's overhyped, and where the real leverage is for a company like Podium

Podium is the best place to work to:

items: Join the leaders in AI agents — you'll be building on top of a product already trusted by 60,000+ businesses to run their AI Employee, with a real mandate and real usage to learn from
Unlock career-defining growth — this role owns a product area at the center of Podium's future, with the scope and visibility that comes with it
Build with world-class talent — join a team of engineers who ship fast, use AI tooling seriously, and care as much about outcomes as elegance
Make a real impact on local business — the agents you build directly help local businesses respond faster, convert more leads, and grow revenue without adding headcount

jobs.title: Founding CTO (AI/ML / Data Product)
jobs.text:
Startup Wise Guys (SWG) is one of Europe’s most active B2B accelerators. In Founders Club, senior builders team up to validate real B2B problems and ship the first product version in 12 weeks, fully online.
If you’ve been the person deploying models for someone else’s roadmap, this is your chance to build your own AI-powered venture—from problem selection to productization.
This is a co-founder opportunity.
The goal is to help you become (or join) a founding team and launch a venture.
Tasks
Validate a B2B problem where AI creates measurable value (time, cost, risk)
Define MVP that’s product-first (not “cool model-first”)
Design the data approach (collection, labeling, evaluation, monitoring)
Ship a reliable prototype/MVP (APIs, pipelines, guardrails, feedback loops)
Craft investor-ready tech narrative (moat, data advantage, roadmap)
Requirements
7+ years in software engineering with strong AI/ML or data product exposure
Experience shipping to production (MLOps basics, monitoring, reliability)
Strong product instinct: clarity on what “good enough” looks like for an MVP
Founder mindset; you want ownership and upside, not a service role
~10–12h/week for 12 weeks
Benefits
12-week sprint to go from insight → MVP → iteration
Weekly accountability + execution cadence (~10–12h/week)
500+ mentors including B2B, product, GTM, fundraising specialists
440+ alumni startups / 40+ countries for learning + intros
CTO toolkit for AI ventures: scope, evaluation, deployment, “moat” story
Note: The cohort includes a participation ticket after acceptance to ensure commitment.
Apply if you’re ready to stop being the “AI builder for others” and ship your own company.

jobs.title: SVP, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy
jobs.text:
Job Title: SVP, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy
Location:Canada – Remote or Mississauga, ON – Hybrid
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work.
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
Position Summary:
Reporting directly to the Chief Product & Technology Officer (CPTO), the Senior Vice President, Product Management – Data Products & Strategy establishes and leads PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for Data as a Product. This executive leader is accountable for transforming PointClickCare’s unique data assets, ecosystem position, and network scale into differentiated products, strategic growth opportunities, and new sources of enterprise value.
The role owns the long-term strategy for customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace capabilities, data monetization, and data-enabled AI solutions while ensuring appropriate protection of intellectual property, privacy, and regulatory compliance. As a member of the senior Product Leadership Team, the SVP influences corporate strategy, investment priorities, ecosystem partnerships, and growth initiatives while leading a team of senior Product leaders responsible for PointClickCare’s data product portfolio.
Key Responsibilities:
Define and lead PointClickCare’s enterprise Data Products strategy, including establishing a multi-year vision for Data as a Product that aligns with corporate objectives, growth priorities, and evolving market opportunities.
Identify, evaluate, and champion new business models and growth opportunities enabled by PointClickCare’s data assets, network scale, interoperability capabilities, and ecosystem partnerships.
Serve as the executive sponsor for customer-facing data strategy and ensure alignment across Product, Engineering, AI, Corporate Strategy, Legal, Go-to-Market, and the Corporate Data Office.
Own the strategy, roadmap, performance, and long-term success of PointClickCare’s data products portfolio, including customer-facing data products, APIs, interoperability services, marketplace capabilities, and AI-enabled solutions.
Establish investment priorities, resource allocation decisions, portfolio success measures, and business outcomes that balance customer value, market opportunity, and financial performance.
Drive adoption, customer value realization, commercial performance, and scalable product growth through strong portfolio management and strategic execution.
Lead PointClickCare’s enterprise strategy for data monetization, marketplace growth, and ecosystem expansion.
Define customer access models, API strategies, pricing frameworks, packaging approaches, and commercial models that support sustainable growth while preserving trust and protecting intellectual property.
Identify new revenue opportunities, strategic partnerships, and ecosystem capabilities that strengthen PointClickCare’s competitive position and expand customer value.
Represent PointClickCare’s data strategy with executive stakeholders, customers, strategic partners, industry analysts, and industry organizations.
Lead executive-level discussions related to data products, healthcare interoperability, marketplace participation, data monetization, and AI-enabled customer solutions.
Build relationships that influence product direction, market positioning, and long-term growth opportunities across the healthcare technology landscape.
Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing product leadership organization through senior leaders, including VPs and Directors.
Establish succession planning, leadership development, talent strategies, and organizational capabilities that strengthen expertise in data products, APIs, ecosystem platforms, marketplace solutions, and monetization strategies.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, customer focus, and execution excellence.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Healthcare Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field.
15+ years of progressive leadership experience in product management, technology, data products, platform strategy, enterprise software, or related disciplines.
Demonstrated success defining and executing enterprise-level product, growth, or business strategies with measurable impact on organizational performance, customer outcomes, and financial results.
Proven experience leading large, complex product or technology organizations through multiple layers of leadership, including developing senior leaders and building organizational capability.
Track record of leading enterprise transformation initiatives requiring alignment across multiple functions, competing priorities, and significant organizational change.
Deep expertise in data products, APIs, interoperability, marketplace and ecosystem strategies, data monetization models, AI-enabled products, and the business dynamics of data-driven organizations.
Strong strategic, financial, and operational acumen, including ownership of portfolio-level investment decisions, business cases, risk management, and performance outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders, shape investment decisions, and represent organizational strategy with customers, partners, analysts, and other external stakeholders.
Experience leading marketplace, ecosystem, platform, or data monetization strategies is highly preferred.
Experience within healthcare technology, post-acute care, payer, provider, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
Experience engaging with industry analysts, strategic partners, customer advisory groups, or external industry bodies is preferred.
Ability to balance growth objectives, customer needs, regulatory requirements, and intellectual property protection in a complex business environment.
At PointClickCare, base salary is one of the many components that make up our total rewards package. This role offers a competitive base salary+ bonus + benefits, non-overtime eligible. Our salary ranges are determined by job and level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by job-related skills and knowledge, relevant experience including professional and lived experience, and/or work location. Your recruiter can share more information about our total rewards package during the hiring process.

Benefits starting from Day 1
Retirement Plan Matching (RRSP & 401K)
Flexible Paid Time Off
Lifestyle/Wellness Spending Account
Parental & Caregiver Leaves
Fertility & Adoption Support

Employee Recognition … and more!

jobs.title: Director of Data Governance
jobs.text:
The Director of Data Governance sits within Quality, Regulatory, and Compliance and leads the evolution of DeepHealth's data ecosystem into a unified, high-quality enterprise asset. The role owns strategic design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Data Governance Framework so data is accurate, secure, and ready for advanced analytics and AI initiatives.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Define and execute a Data Governance roadmap aligned with the Enterprise Information and Governance vision.
Review, maintain, and enforce the Data Management Policy and Data Governance Charter against current regulatory and business needs.
Facilitate decision-making on data standards and help resolve cross-functional data conflicts.
Implement Data Quality Management procedures and establish KPIs for data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
Define enterprise-wide data standards, including metadata management, data lineage, and master data management protocols.
Partner with IT and Security so data pipelines support AI applications while maintaining security boundaries.
Work with Security to define data classification levels and manage high-risk data access policies.
Ensure data practices adhere to applicable global privacy regulations and internal Enterprise Information and Governance mandates.
Align data governance priorities with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
Mentor and develop team members as the data governance capability grows.
Requirements
Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (required).
7 to 10 years of progressive experience in Data Management, Data Governance, or Information Architecture in healthcare, medical technology, or another highly regulated industry (required).
Strong experience with DAMA-DMBOK frameworks and data quality lifecycle management (required).
Deep understanding of data profiling tools, metadata management, and modern data stack concepts (required).
Experience with AI systems in production or product development contexts (required).
Excellent written and oral communication skills, including explaining complex concepts to diverse audiences (required).
High level of integrity and confidentiality (required).
Preferred: Master's degree or advanced relevant certifications.
Quality Standards
Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.
Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.
Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.
Follows all DeepHealth policies and procedures.
Follows data privacy, compliance, safety and confidentiality standards at all times.
Practices universal safety precautions.
Promotes good public relations on the phone and in person.
Adapts and is willing to learn new tasks, methods, and systems.
Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.
Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.
Travel
This position requires travel up to approximately 10%.
Working Environment
European Union. Remote-friendly or office-based role.
Physical Demands
The employee must be able to perform the essential duties and responsibilities of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Salary:
115,000.00-130,00.00 EURO
100,000.00-110,000.00 in France

Location: Saudi Arabia / Riyadh

nakhla.ai builds enterprise-grade, AI-enabled software solutions that help organizations automate operations, integrate business systems, and deploy intelligent agents securely at scale.

Role Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced, hands-on Head of Enterprise Solutions Engineering & Delivery to lead the design, implementation, deployment, and ongoing delivery of enterprise technology solutions.
This role combines solution architecture, customer implementation, platform engineering, technical program management, operational reliability, security, quality assurance, and delivery leadership.
The successful candidate will own the customer delivery lifecycle, starting with technical discovery and solution design and continuing through configuration, integration, testing, deployment, production readiness, and post-launch stabilization.
This is not a traditional project management or advisory position. The candidate must be technically strong, commercially aware, customer-facing, and capable of making practical architecture and delivery decisions.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise Solution Architecture
Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers and key stakeholders.
Understand customer business processes, operational requirements, existing systems, security constraints, and success criteria.
Translate business requirements into scalable technical architectures and implementation plans.
Design solutions involving enterprise applications, APIs, AI agents, workflow automation, identity management, data migration, and third-party integrations.
Define system boundaries, data flows, integration patterns, security controls, and deployment models.
Ensure customer requirements align with nakhla.ai’s long-term product and platform strategy.
Challenge unnecessary customization and identify opportunities to create reusable product capabilities.
Produce solution architecture documents, technical specifications, implementation blueprints, and acceptance criteria.
Customer Implementation and Delivery
Own enterprise implementation projects from initial kickoff through production launch.
Develop delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, resource requirements, and risk mitigation strategies.
Coordinate internal engineering teams, external partners, and customer stakeholders.
Manage project scope, priorities, timelines, risks, and customer expectations.
Configure enterprise applications, workflows, roles, permissions, approval processes, and business rules.
Oversee data migration, validation, reconciliation, and production transition activities.
Lead user acceptance testing, customer training, deployment readiness, and go-live planning.
Ensure implementation decisions, configurations, and technical dependencies are documented clearly.
Manage post-launch stabilization and transition customers into ongoing support and operations.
Platform Engineering and Integrations
Contribute directly to backend services, system integrations, APIs, and platform components when required.
Design and implement secure integrations with customer applications, financial systems, productivity platforms, identity providers, databases, and external services.
Work with APIs, webhooks, message queues, event-driven architectures, authentication protocols, service accounts, and secure credential management.
Support the architecture of multi-tenant enterprise systems and customer data isolation.
Contribute to platform capabilities related to authentication, authorization, usage tracking, billing, auditability, and observability.
Review technical designs and code to ensure maintainability, scalability, reliability, and security.
Establish reusable integration patterns, technical standards, implementation templates, and engineering best practices.
Enterprise Applications and Business Processes
Lead discovery, configuration, customization, migration, and integration activities for enterprise business systems.
Map customer processes across finance, procurement, sales, inventory, operations, human resources, and other business functions.
Configure workflows, approval processes, roles, permissions, reports, and operational controls.
Ensure data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation during migration from existing systems.
Identify where standard platform functionality should be used instead of unnecessary custom development.
Work closely with finance, operations, technology, and executive stakeholders to validate business logic and controls.
Ensure implemented solutions support customer governance, accountability, and operational requirements.
AI and Intelligent Automation
Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate intelligent agents and automation into enterprise processes.
Define safe and auditable agent actions, permissions, tools, approval requirements, and escalation paths.
Design human-in-the-loop workflows for sensitive, regulated, or high-impact operations.
Ensure AI-enabled capabilities comply with customer security, privacy, governance, and operational requirements.
Support the integration of AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, documents, APIs, and communication systems.
Evaluate AI use cases based on business value, operational feasibility, technical complexity, implementation risk, and scalability.
Establish monitoring, evaluation, testing, and quality controls for production AI systems.
Ensure AI capabilities remain explainable, traceable, controlled, and aligned with customer policies.
Security, Infrastructure, and Reliability
Define and enforce deployment, infrastructure, security, and operational standards.
Support cloud architecture, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, environment management, and release processes.
Establish appropriate separation between development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Implement or oversee monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, backups, and disaster recovery procedures.
Ensure secure secrets management, credential rotation, network controls, encryption, and access governance.
Contribute to incident response, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and production reliability improvements.
Ensure customer environments meet agreed security, availability, performance, and data protection requirements.
Support enterprise security reviews, technical due diligence, risk assessments, and compliance readiness activities.
Maintain operational documentation, recovery procedures, escalation paths, and production support standards.
Quality Assurance
Define quality standards, release gates, and acceptance criteria.
Establish automated testing practices for APIs, integrations, permissions, workflows, data processing, and critical user journeys.
Ensure testing covers customer data isolation, role-based access, authentication, authorization, billing, data integrity, and intelligent agent behavior.
Coordinate functional, integration, regression, security, performance, and user acceptance testing.
Prevent production releases without appropriate validation, documentation, rollback plans, monitoring, and approvals.
Track defects, production incidents, recurring failures, and quality trends across implementations.
Ensure lessons from customer deployments are incorporated into platform and delivery improvements.
Delivery Operations and Team Leadership
Build repeatable delivery processes, implementation methodologies, templates, checklists, and operational playbooks.
Define ownership, accountability, and handoff points across sales, product, engineering, implementation, and support.
Improve implementation speed, delivery predictability, solution quality, and customer satisfaction.
Mentor engineers, implementation specialists, solution architects, and technical project team members.
Support the hiring and development of the future solutions engineering and delivery organization.
Identify delivery bottlenecks and recommend organizational, operational, or technical improvements.
Provide clear reporting on project status, risks, dependencies, resource needs, and delivery performance.
Participate in customer proposals, technical presentations, solution demonstrations, commercial discussions, and statements of work.
Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, measurable, and aligned with available capabilities and resources.

jobs.text:
Summary of the position :
The Head of Engineering – Delivery, will be directly responsible for leading PMC’s India based delivery teams providing it’s software services & projects in to global customers.
The role requires strong technical leadership skills and able to navigate the complex project scenarios to drive best outcomes for PMC & customers. The role also emphasize on the deep technical knowhow, such as software development (across multiple programming stacks) and hold on SDLC using Cloud , Automation, DevOps & AI & ML practices.
This role will be primarily responsible for ensuring high quality & timeliness delivery of services for the Engineering team in India with focus on execution, governance of delivery and a continuous collaboration across all levels.
Leading a talented team of delivery managers, delivery leads and project managers you will ensure that through proactive planning, the team are set up to deliver current and future customer requirements across the range of Engineering propositions – Design & Architecture, Development, Test and Automation.
Key accountabilities:
As a leader you will be primary focused on
As Delivery leader, you are a hands-on, have strong technical foundation in SDLC and last 5+years as people leader able to manage directly and through others.
As a technically astute leader, your recognized subject matter expertise allows you regularly dive deep into key projects & services your teams provide.
Your focus is to provide strong technical and on-floor leadership & coaching to a talented team of project and dedicated service leaders, ensuring they are set up for success to deliver customer and team needs (total team size > 200-400).
As a Delivery leader, you shall be an Engineering face for PMC customers to drive higher standards of Agile Delivery , DevOps , Automation , AI/ML , Cloud and cutting edge technology conversations.
You will drive delivery performance and work closely with engineering excellence and operations team across all PMC’s Engineering Customers, working with your leadership team to ensure effective service set-up & transition, project governance & assurance, and customer satisfaction.
Be responsible to develop a strong high performance culture with engineers on the floor that focuses on sense of collective and individual ownership, high quality outcome and continuous learning
Contribute to and implement the strategic plan for engineering such as future proposition, technical initiative & learning in alignment with the company’s vision, objectives and future customer base.
Lead and drive a culture of innovation and collaboration across Engineering teams and wider PMC business units.
Lead on and act as the escalation for the resolution of customer specific service delivery issues in a timely way overseeing the design and implementation of specific ‘get well’ plans. Act as the senior ‘escalation’ for major service issues and customer champion for critical services.
Serve as a liaison between the engineering teams and senior management, providing regular updates on progress, challenges, and achievements to Engineering Director on our teams and our people.
Your role will collaborate with
Work with operations/resourcing & service design/pre-sales to ensure all new customer engagements are planned and successfully delivered.
Work with engineering excellence to ensure strong drive of the Continual Services Improvement Plan (CSIP) across the dedicated teams, covering contract understanding/compliance, service standards (productivity & quality) and customer Satisfaction reporting
You will also support in the driving of incremental new business and in the management of customer commercial performance.
Work with engineering excellence to drive best practices, enforce governance models, quality, standards, measurements (KPIs), ISO Compliance across engineering deliveries.
Work in partnership with the resourcing and planning team to effectively schedule and utilise the engineering talent for strong delivery performance. Work with the resource management team to map resources effectively to support optimal team performance and productivity.
Work with engineering governance to undertake periodic reviews to ensure that all processes drive strong efficiency and best practice, working with your leadership team to implement recommendations for improvement.
Work with senior stakeholders at BU level to effectively drive the change , communicate issues & implement improvement plan.
Work with Sales & Marketing teams by supporting them as required during internal & external customer meeting.
Skills and Experience| Essential:
You’ve at-least 15+ years of IT experience across various trends & cycles of Software Development and methodologies.
At least last 5+ years of experience in managing Software Delivery teams at scale of various application stacks & technologies.
You are obsessed with results, and effectively communicate objectives and how success will be measured to your teams and other stakeholders.
An inspirational leader and role model, with strong experience leading large & multiskilled engineering teams.
Proven experience and ability to provide a steer on how to apply engineering mindset to large number of delivery workstreams.
Experience in building and scaling service delivery teams (circa 200 to 400 member teams).
Passion for innovation and staying current with industry trends and emerging technologies.
Extensive experience in managing complex IT solutions delivery to the highest standard.
Commercially aware, with a good understanding of contractual requirements and obligations.
Experience in setting, improving and attaining service standards.
Customer credible and able to engage with customer stakeholders at all levels.

jobs.title: Director of Product Management, Advertiser Growth
jobs.text:
About Pinterest:
Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.
Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.
At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.
Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.
As the PM Director for Advertiser Growth, you will own product strategy for a major monetization lever and serve as a critical thought partner to our Business Platforms leadership. You will sit at the intersection of AI and monetization growth, defining the "AI era" for our core advertiser tools.
This role offers a unique combination of platform depth and tangible business impact. You won’t just be managing features; you will establish durable platform strategies that scale. Furthermore, this is a dedicated people leadership role where you will have the mandate to develop the next generation of product talent at Pinterest.
What you’ll do:
Product Led Growth: Drive the adoption, retention, and revenue impact of our suite of business-facing tools through intelligent product investments.
Platform Leadership: Establish a durable platform strategy for the Pinterest Business Assistant, encompassing various sub-agents while leading the advertising and merchant sub-agent efforts.
Cross-Functional Execution: Drive business outcomes by aligning priorities across Engineering, Data Science, TPM, Product Marketing, Sales, UX, and UXR teams to deliver best-in-class business tooling.
What we’re looking for:
Platform Product Strategy: Demonstrated experience developing and scaling platforms, with a strong ability to distinguish between high-level orchestration and specific feature development.
Business Tools Product Experience: Proven background in designing and managing sophisticated business-facing tools, account management consoles, or complex user journeys in an advertising or related environment.
People Leadership: A track record of building, managing, and growing high-performing teams, including experience in talent development and performance management.
AI/Agentic Fluency: Experience building AI-assistance functionality, specifically in a chatbot or agentic capability context.
Strategic & Operational Rigor: Ability to navigate ambiguity, influence across multiple stakeholders, and drive durable revenue growth through principled trade-offs.
Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, or equivalent experience
In-Office Requirement Statement:
We recognize that the ideal environment for work is situational and may differ across departments. What this looks like day-to-day can vary based on the needs of each organization or role.
This role will need to be in the office for in-person collaboration 1-2 times/quarter and therefore can be situated anywhere in the country.
Relocation Statement:
This position is not eligible for relocation assistance. Visit our PinFlex page to learn more about our working model.
#LI-REMOTE
#LI-REX
At Pinterest we believe the workplace should be equitable, inclusive, and inspiring for every employee. In an effort to provide greater transparency, we are sharing the base salary range for this position. The position is also eligible for equity. Final salary is based on a number of factors including location, travel, relevant prior experience, or particular skills and expertise.
Information regarding the culture at Pinterest and benefits available for this position can be found here.
US based applicants only
$228,911—$471,286 USD

jobs.title: Associate Director, CRM Analytics
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
This role is responsible for the measurement, reporting, and audience strategy of a Salesforce-powered CRM ecosystem, spanning lifecycle marketing programs across acquisition, retention, loyalty, off-lease, in-market owner, and vehicle-launch communications. The role also supports broader customer experience measurement initiatives across CRM and digital touchpoints, partnering with BI, media, CRM, and client teams to translate CRM performance data into insights and recommendations that inform campaign optimization and audience decisions.
The ideal candidate combines Salesforce Marketing Cloud reporting and analysis experience with strong statistical and testing capabilities, an understanding of digital measurement and customer journey analytics, and can present findings to senior client stakeholders in the language of business decisions.
CRM Measurement & Reporting
Own measurement and reporting for Mazda's CRM program across email and push channels.
Maintain the CRM measurement framework, including KPIs, customer journey stages, and attribution methodology, in alignment with agency and client stakeholder teams.
Build and maintain data visualizations that make CRM performance clear and actionable for stakeholders.
Develop reporting automation that streamlines recurring deliverables and improves reporting efficiency and consistency.
Deliver recurring performance reporting and ad hoc analysis to client CRM and CX stakeholders.
Partner with digital analytics teams to connect CRM engagement metrics with website behavior and customer journey outcomes.
Salesforce Ecosystem & Audience Analytics
Navigate Salesforce Marketing Cloud for reporting and analysis, including locating and working with Data Extensions to source campaign and audience data.
Build SQL-based reporting automation from Marketing Cloud data to support recurring measurement and audience analysis.
Support CDP-related measurement, including behavioral triggers, audience expansion, and activation reporting.
Lead customer segmentation, lifetime-value, and loyalty/defection (churn) analysis to inform audience prioritization.
Testing & Experimentation
Design and execute A/B and multivariate tests across CRM and digital programs, from hypothesis through readout.
Design and run holdout and incrementality tests, using control-group methodology to isolate CRM-driven lift.
Apply statistical methods, including regression, hypothesis testing, and forecasting, to validate performance drivers and forecast customer behavior.
Maintain the account's test-and-learn roadmap and translate results into optimization recommendations.
Business Intelligence & Stakeholder Reporting
Partner with BI and engineering teams on executive dashboards in Domo, Tableau, and Power BI serving stakeholders across agency and client teams.
Identify insights through analysis of CRM, customer, and website behavioral data, surfacing trends, opportunities, and performance drivers for stakeholders.
Translate analytical output into commercially framed recommendations for senior stakeholders.
Present findings in recurring client meetings and executive readouts.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Collaborate cross-functionally with CRM strategists, developers, and creative teams to inform campaign planning and optimization with data.
Partner with analytics, CRM, media, CX, and technology teams across agency and client organizations.
Guide analytical priorities and delivery standards across supporting analyst resources.
Partner with the Group Director, Customer Experience Measurement & Analytics, to support measurement initiatives across CRM, customer journeys, and digital experiences.
Required Qualifications
5-7+ years of experience in CRM analytics, marketing analytics, digital analytics, or customer analytics.
Experience navigating Salesforce Marketing Cloud for reporting and analysis, including working with Data Extensions.
Advanced SQL, including building automated reporting workflows; working proficiency in Python or R for statistical analysis.
Experience designing and executing A/B, multivariate, and holdout/incrementality tests and applying statistical methods (regression, hypothesis testing, forecasting).
Experience with customer segmentation, CLV, and churn/loyalty analysis.
Proficiency with BI platforms such as Domo, Tableau, or Power BI, including data visualization and reporting automation.
Familiarity with web analytics and customer journey measurement platforms such as Adobe Analytics, Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Google Analytics, or similar solutions.
Strong communication skills, including presenting analysis to senior client stakeholders.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in automotive or another complex customer-lifecycle business.
Familiarity with CDP measurement and activation reporting.
Experience with attribution modeling and paid media measurement.
Experience analyzing website, CRM, and customer journey data to support optimization recommendations.
Agency experience with executive client stakeholders.
What Success Looks Like
Within the first 12 months, this leader will:
Deliver reliable, decision-ready CRM measurement and reporting across all lifecycle programs.
Maintain a consistent test-and-learn cadence, including holdout and incrementality testing, with documented results feeding campaign optimization.
Help keep segmentation and audience logic accurate, current, and aligned to client campaign needs.
Serve as the day-to-day analytics point of contact trusted by client CRM stakeholders.
Help evolve the CRM program toward best-in-class measurement, testing, and audience intelligence practices.
Contribute to a more connected view of customer performance by integrating CRM and website engagement insights into ongoing reporting and optimization recommendations.

Individual compensation varies based on job-related factors, including location, business needs, level of responsibility, experience, and qualifications. We offer a competitive benefits package, click WPP Benefits for more details.

$70,000—$140,000 USD

That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office an average of four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

jobs.title: VP Product - Sidetrade Pay
jobs.text:
Are you a product leader who has turned payments into a revenue engine inside B2B software? Sidetrade is looking for a VP Product, to build and lead the development of our global payments business.
Reporting to the CPO, this is a newly created product leadership role at the centre of one of Sidetrade's biggest strategic bets. Hundreds of billions of dollars of B2B invoice value flow through Sidetrade platforms every year, and only a very small percentage is monetised through payment acceptance today. Your mandate is to change that: to take Sidetrade Pay from programme to product, and from product to a thriving payments business spanning our enterprise base on the Sidetrade platform and our SMB and mid-market base under the ezyCollect brand, across North America, the UK, Europe, and Australia and New Zealand.
About Sidetrade:
Sidetrade (Euronext Growth: ALBFR.PA) is an AI-native company dedicated to Order-to-Cash (O2C). Its platform combines O2C applications, autonomous AI agents, and Aimie IQ, an intelligent natural-language interface that helps multinationals accelerate their cash generation, all built on SAFE, the Sidetrade Agentic Framework for Enterprise. Sidetrade operates the world's largest proprietary O2C Data Lake, built on $9 trillion in B2B transactions and millions of buying companies. We use this data to train specialized AI models that monitor, analyze, decide, and act autonomously throughout the O2C cycle. Sidetrade supports companies in 85 countries with 450 employees across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.
We’re proud of our 38 nationalities, and these diverse perspectives drive our innovation, one-team culture, and customer-first mindset. Sidetrade has been positioned as a Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leadersince 2022. We value passion over perfection. So, if you’re eager to learn and bring great energy, we want to hear from you. Be you. Grow with us.

jobs.title: VP of Product, Foundation
jobs.text:
🚀 VP of Product, Foundation | United States | Remote | Pax8
Join Pax8 as our VP of Product, Foundation and shape the future of the world's leading cloud marketplace platform, driving the product strategy behind the commerce engine that powers thousands of managed service providers across the globe.
🌟 Why This Role?
This is a rare opportunity to own the product vision for Pax8's largest and most strategically important portfolio. Foundation sits at the heart of our marketplace, enabling everything from product discovery and purchasing to provisioning, billing, subscriptions, integrations, and partner growth.
As AI reshapes software development and customer experiences, you'll help define how a modern, intelligent commerce platform evolves. You'll influence how thousands of partners buy, sell, manage, and grow through technology while building capabilities that support both hypergrowth and enterprise-grade financial rigor.
You'll join at a pivotal moment where platform scale, artificial intelligence, automation, and operational excellence converge, giving you the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on both Pax8 and the wider technology ecosystem.
💜 Life at Pax8
At Pax8, business is personal. We're passionate about creating an environment where people can do their best work while continuously learning and growing. Guided by our values of Compassionate Candor, Seek to Understand, We Before Me, Do What You Say, Light Up Learning, and Driven by Passion, we foster a culture built on trust, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
You'll join a global organization that embraces emerging technologies, invests heavily in learning, and empowers individuals to challenge conventional thinking while delivering exceptional outcomes for our partners.
🎯 What You'll Be Responsible For
📈 Define the Future of Commerce at Pax8
Establish and execute the long-term product vision for Foundation, Pax8's core commerce platform.
Create a strategic roadmap that balances operational excellence, compliance, financial controls, scalability, and growth.
Guide investment decisions across marketplace capabilities, billing, subscriptions, ordering, provisioning, analytics, integrations, and partner experiences.
💡 Drive Growth Through Product Innovation
Create frictionless experiences that improve partner acquisition, engagement, retention, and expansion.
Shape product experiences that help partners discover, purchase, manage, and maximize technology investments.
Identify new opportunities to increase platform adoption through analytics, recommendations, APIs, ecosystem integrations, and intelligent automation.
🤝 Lead Through Partnership
Act as the strategic product counterpart to the VP of Engineering, jointly driving outcomes across the Foundation platform.
Partner closely with Architecture, Finance, Operations, Commercial Leadership, Design, and User Research to align priorities and deliver results.
Establish clear ownership boundaries across a complex product ecosystem to ensure teams move quickly and effectively.
🧠 Build for an AI-Powered Future
Develop a point of view on how AI and agent-assisted experiences will transform partner commerce.
Guide teams through new ways of working that leverage AI to accelerate discovery, validation, delivery, and decision making.
Help evolve product practices to remain effective as technology and customer expectations continue to change.
👥 Develop Exceptional Product Talent
Lead and inspire a high-performing product management organization.
Create an environment where strategic thinking, commercial acumen, technical depth, and customer empathy flourish.
Coach leaders and product managers to operate effectively across a broad and complex portfolio.
🌍 Your Impact
Foundation is the engine behind the Pax8 marketplace. Your leadership will directly influence partner satisfaction, operational excellence, financial integrity, and future growth.
You'll help create the platform that thousands of businesses rely on every day while ensuring Pax8 is positioned to scale sustainably, innovate rapidly, and remain the trusted marketplace for technology professionals worldwide.
✅ What Success Looks Like
We're searching for someone who combines strategic vision with an ability to execute in highly complex environments.
You bring:
Demonstrated success leading large-scale product organizations with executive-level scope.
Proven experience owning complex marketplace, commerce, platform, SaaS, or partner ecosystem products.
Deep understanding of commerce journeys including purchasing, subscriptions, provisioning, billing, invoicing, and partner operations.
Strong experience balancing growth initiatives alongside governance, compliance, operational control, and scalability requirements.
Ability to influence across executive stakeholders, engineering leaders, operational teams, and commercial functions.
Strong understanding of platform architecture concepts and product decision-making within complex technical environments.
Experience leveraging AI and emerging technologies to improve product strategy, delivery, prioritization, and organizational effectiveness.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to move seamlessly between executive strategy, technical discussions, and customer-focused outcomes.
A customer-first mindset grounded in real-world experience serving businesses, partners, marketplaces, or technology ecosystems.
Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity while maintaining strategic clarity and organizational alignment.
🛡️ Trust and Hiring
At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.
To protect our business, our teams, and our customers, we use a range of measures throughout the recruitment process to help confirm authenticity and prevent fraud. These safeguards are designed to be fair, respectful, and proportionate, and may evolve as risks change. By applying, you acknowledge that we take steps to verify identity and representation during hiring. If you're applying as your authentic self, you have nothing to worry about — we're excited to meet you.
We also use thoughtfully applied AI-enabled tools to support our hiring process. These tools may assist with tasks such as reviewing or prioritising applications, but hiring decisions are made by our people. More information is available in our Recruitment Privacy Notice. If you have questions about how we hire or would prefer not to have your application supported by these tools, you can opt out at any part of our process.
🌈 Inclusion Matters
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet 100% of the criteria. We're committed to diverse perspectives, inclusive hiring and sharing your transferrable skills. To fulfil this role, you must hold valid right to work in United States.
🎁 Benefits
Competitive executive compensation package based on skills, experience, and market location
Annual performance bonus opportunity
Equity participation through Pax8 stock programs
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible paid time off
Paid parental leave
Retirement savings plans with company contribution opportunities
Learning and development investment
LinkedIn Learning access
Wellbeing resources and coaching support
Remote-first flexibility
Employee recognition programs

jobs.title: Vice President of Data and Analytics
jobs.text:
Overview
To drive innovation and operational excellence through technology that enables teams to focus on delivering exceptional customer experiences. The Business Systems department delivers software to drive business process optimization through automation, intuitive workflows, and data governance. Our goal is to serve our internal customers (operators & support departments) with solutions that empower them to maximize their performance and enhance the customer journey.
Position Summary
The Vice President Data & Analytics leads the strategic direction, delivery, and operational maturity of RPM Living's Data & Analytics organization within Product & Engineering. This role partners directly with the SVP, Data & Analytics to build and scale internal data engineering, analytics, and governance capabilities, reducing reliance on third-party contractors while establishing RPM Living as a data-driven, insight-led organization.
Responsibilities
Serve as the senior operating leader for the Data & Analytics team, translating the SVP's vision into staffing plans, delivery roadmaps, and quarterly priorities.
Serve as a strategic partner and trusted advisor to executive leadership, influencing enterprise priorities and translating business strategy into actionable data, analytics, and technology initiatives.
Build and maintain strong relationships with C-suite executives and senior business leaders, effectively communicating complex data and technology concepts, surfacing business implications, and driving alignment on strategic decisions.
Own end-to-end delivery of the Microsoft Fabric medallion architecture (bronze/silver/gold/semantic layers) in partnership with the Data Engineering Lead and Lead Data Architect.
Directly manage and develop a team spanning data engineering, analytics/BI, data governance, and QA, including performance management, career development, and org design.
Partner with business stakeholders across property operations, finance, and technology to prioritize analytics and reporting initiatives, including cross platform data integrations and business processes.
Establish data governance, quality, and security standards across 30+ source integrations (Yardi, RealPage, UKG, Salesforce, and others).
Evaluate and drive adoption of AI-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude, CodeRabbit) to accelerate engineering velocity and analytics delivery.
Present roadmap progress, risks, and organizational health to senior executive leadership.
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, budgets, and resourcing decisions for the Data & Analytics function.
Define and enforce architectural and coding standards, working closely with the Lead Data Architect to ensure long-term platform scalability.
Education and Experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or related field. Experience may substitute for education.
Twelve years of progressive experience in data engineering, analytics, or business intelligence, including Five+ years in a people-leadership role.
Five year’s experience with modern cloud data platforms (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse/SQL, or equivalent) and BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
Experience in multifamily, real estate, or another property-operations-driven industry is a plus but not required.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical strategy for non-technical senior leadership.
Knowledge of data architecture patterns (medallion/lakehouse), data governance frameworks, and modern BI/semantic modeling practices.
Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing technical teams in a rebuild/turnaround environment.
Strong vendor management and contract negotiation skills, particularly related to managed services and staff augmentation.
Comfort operating with ambiguity and evolving scope typical of a growing, newly-formed department.Working knowledge of AI-assisted development and analytics tooling and its application to team productivity.
Qualifications
Physical Requirements:• May be required to sit for extended periods of time • May occasionally be required to lift or carry items such as files or office supplies weighing up to 15 pounds • Must be able to operate a computer, keyboard, mouse, and other office equipment • Must be able to read documents, computer screens, and data • Must be able to hear and understand verbal communications in person and over the phone or computer
Work Environment:• This is a remote role. The associate must have a dedicated workspace that is free from distraction and has reliable internet.• Overnight travel may be required quarterly for various business reasons.
Company Information
Join RPM Living and experience exceptional benefits designed to enhance your life.
Weekly pay for all associates working onsite at an apartment community
Comprehensive healthcare coverage available for all full-time, regular associates
Employer-paid employee assistance, mental health, and wellness programs
Ancillary benefits including critical illness, hospital indemnity, and accident insurance
401(k) with robust company match
Opportunities for professional development, career growth, and role-based learning plans
Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB) and multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERG)
Paid time off plus floating holidays and volunteer days
Discounted Perks (Costco membership, movie tickets, health & wellness, entertainment & travel discounts)
Employment with RPM Living is contingent upon successful completion of a background check as local and federal state requires. A valid driver’s license is preferred; candidates without a license will be provided a liability waiver.
RPM Living participates in E-Verify. For more information, see the E-Verify Participation Poster and the Right to Work Poster.
RPM Living is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: VP - Product Management, Digital Assets Proxy
jobs.text:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.
Broadridge is seeking a strategic, commercially minded, and execution-oriented VP, Product Management – Digital Assets Proxy to lead the strategy, development, delivery and ongoing management of Broadridge’s Digital Assets Proxy capabilities. This highly visible leadership role will define the product vision and roadmap for innovative, scalable, and compliant digital assets proxy solutions that address the evolving needs of institutional clients and support Broadridge’s long-term growth objectives.
The VP will operate at the intersection of product, technology, operations, commercial teams, legal, compliance, and risk. The successful candidate will combine deep product-management discipline with a strong understanding of digital asset market infrastructure, regulatory considerations, and the proxy ecosystem. They will translate market opportunity and client insight into differentiated product offerings, drive delivery from concept through launch, and continuously optimize the portfolio based on performance and market feedback.
What You’ll Do
Define and lead the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle management for Broadridge’s Digital Assets Proxy products and capabilities
Develop a clear point of view on the evolution of digital assets, tokenization, governance, and governance related market infrastructure, translating market developments into actionable product priorities
Identify and assess client needs, market opportunities, competitive dynamics, and regulatory developments to inform product strategy and investment decisions
Own the evaluation, prioritization, development, launch, and enhancement of digital asset proxy focused products and features aligned with client demand, strategic objectives, and operational readiness
Build compelling business cases, including market sizing, financial analysis, pricing, return-on-investment assessments, and commercialization plans. This can also include development of white papers and related thought pieces
Partner closely with engineering and technology teams to establish product requirements, guide execution, manage trade-offs, and deliver scalable, high-quality solutions
Collaborate with operations, legal, compliance, risk, and control functions to ensure products are operationally viable and aligned with applicable regulatory, risk, and governance requirements
Develop go-to-market strategies in partnership with sales, marketing, relationship-management, and client facing teams
Establish product performance measures and use adoption data, client feedback, commercial results, and market intelligence to improve product outcomes and portfolio performance
Serve as a senior thought partner and subject matter expert on digital assets proxy-related product strategy across Broadridge
Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and influence senior stakeholders across business, technology, and control functions
What We’re Looking For
Significant product-management experience, including a demonstrated record of leading complex products, platforms, or market-infrastructure capabilities from strategy through execution and commercialization
Strong knowledge of digital assets and related market infrastructure, including relevant experience with tokenized assets, blockchain-based products, custody, wallets, trading, settlement, staking, or adjacent capabilities
Experience developing products within a regulated financial services environment, ideally including exposure to SEC regulated businesses
Demonstrated understanding of proxy, corporate governance, issuer services, or related workflows is strongly preferred
Strong commercial acumen, with experience developing product strategies, business cases, pricing models, and go-to-market plans
Proven ability to lead through influence across technology, operations, legal, compliance, risk, sales, and other cross-functional stakeholders
Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, problem solving, communication, and decision making skills
Executive presence and the ability to communicate complex technical, regulatory, and commercial concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
A client focused, entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to navigate ambiguity in a rapidly evolving market
What Sets You Apart
Deep understanding of trends shaping the digital assets landscape and their implications for institutional and enterprise clients
Experience building and scaling product offerings in emerging, regulated, or rapidly changing markets
Ability to balance innovation with strong operational, regulatory, and risk discipline
A strong network and credibility within digital assets, capital markets, proxy, governance, or financial market infrastructure communities
A collaborative leadership style that aligns diverse stakeholders around a clear product vision and measurable business outcomes
Why Join Us
You will have the opportunity to shape the future of digital assets products within a dynamic and highly visible leadership role. You will work with cross-functional teams to bring new capabilities to market, solve complex industry challenges, and help define how digital asset solutions evolve in a changing financial and regulatory landscape.
Compensation Range: The salary range for this position is between $240,000 to $250,000
Bonus Eligibility: Bonus Eligible
Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.
Benefits Information: Please visit for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings.
We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.
Use of AI in Hiring
As part of the recruiting process, Broadridge may use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI)-based tools, to help review and evaluate applications. These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.
US applicants: Click here to view the EEOC "Know Your Rights" poster.
Disability Assistance
We recognize that ensuring our long-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. Broadridge provides equal employment opportunities to all associates and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, and pregnancy), marital status, national origin, ethnic origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, and other protected characteristics protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
If you need assistance or would like to request reasonable accommodations during the application and/or hiring process, please contact us at 888-237-7769 or by sending an email to .
