jobs.title: Director, Analytics
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
THE ROLE
Zeta Global is seeking a strategic, client-facing Director to join our ZX Data Science & Analytics team. This role is ideal for an experienced analytics leader who excels at transforming complex data into compelling narratives, influencing client strategy, and driving measurable business outcomes.
The Director will serve as a trusted analytics partner to clients and internal teams, bringing together marketing measurement, advanced analytics, media strategy, and data storytelling to make insights actionable. This individual will also help scale analytics best practices across clients and categories, strengthen partnerships with Sales and cross-functional teams, and contribute to the continued evolution of ZX Analytics solutions and measurement products.
This position reports to the VP of Data Science & Analytics.
RESPONSIBILITIES
Lead with Storytelling: Translate complex analytics and media performance into clear, persuasive narratives that connect insights to client business priorities and inspire action.
Shape Client Strategy: Develop analytics approaches aligned with client objectives, using insights to inform acquisition, retention, lifetime value, media, and optimization strategies. Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal partners.
Drive Measurement Excellence: Apply and advocate for best-in-class measurement methodologies, including Test/Holdout-based incrementality measurement. Help clients and internal teams understand the strengths, limitations, and business implications of different measurement approaches.
Scale Best Practices: Identify learnings across clients, campaigns, and categories and translate them into repeatable best practices, frameworks, and recommendations that improve the quality and consistency of analytics deliverables.
Team Leadership: manage and develop a team of analysts, including coaching, onboarding, workload prioritization, performance management, feedback, recognition, and career development. Mentor mid-level analysts in both technical and client-facing skills.
Lead Strategic Initiatives: Serve as analytics lead and subject matter expert for select strategic initiatives, helping define solutions, align stakeholders, and move work from concept through implementation.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner effectively with Sales, Client Services, Client Development, Operations, and other teams to solve client challenges, improve processes, and deliver high-quality analytics solutions with limited senior leadership intervention.
Innovate with AI: Support the development, application, and adoption of predictive and adaptive ML/AI solutions, helping translate model outputs into clear business recommendations and client value.
REQUIREMENTS
10+ years of professional experience in analytics, marketing measurement, data science, media analytics, or a related discipline, with demonstrated progression in responsibility and client impact.
Proven ability to translate complex analytics into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for client and business audiences.
Strong client-facing experience with excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to command an audience and serve as a model for effective client communication.
3+ years in analytics leadership roles, ideally with team management experience.
Demonstrated subject matter expertise in one or more analytics, measurement, media, or industry domains, with the ability to share knowledge and elevate the capabilities of others.
Working familiarity with Python, SQL, Tableau or comparable analytical and visualization tools, as well as experience working with predictive analytics and/or ML/AI models.
Ability to operate independently, make sound decisions in support of clients and the business, give and receive feedback effectively, and challenge existing approaches constructively.
Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred in Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, or related fields.
Experience in Retail, Financial Services, Telecom, or Travel verticals is a plus.
This is a remote role based out of the United States.
BENEFITS & PERKS
Flexible PTO
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employee Equity and Stock Purchase Plan
Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance
SALARY RANGE
The salary range for this role is $150,000-$165,000 depending on location and experience.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

jobs.title: Director of Product, Search and Curated Experiences
jobs.text:
About AlphaSense:
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
About the Team
AlphaSense's Product team stands at the forefront of innovation, developing AI-powered solutions that enable professionals to make smarter, faster, and more informed decisions. Our team, a diverse and global collective of operators, craftspeople, innovators, and visionaries, shares a passion for solving complex problems and delivering exceptional user experiences.
If you're passionate about creating industry-leading tools that shape the future of business intelligence, we'd love to meet you.
About the Role
We are seeking a senior, deeply technical product leader to own Search and Curated Experiences AlphaSense. Search is the front door to a corpus of hundreds of millions of business documents, and the relevance, ranking, document-type coverage, filtering, and performance you own sit underneath every product surface. Curated Experiences define how AlphaSense’s content, functionality, and intelligence show up in pre-built experiences that act as a launchpad for our customers’ research - everything from company profiles and industry profiles, to monitoring and beyond.
This is a leadership role, not a feature role. You will set the search strategy, own the metrics, and be the person the organization turns to drive impact with both Search and Curated Experiences. You will lead a small team, including a domain-expert for Curated Experiences. We expect you to own these programs end to end, with the judgment, drive, and initiative to take them all the way.
What You'll Do
Own both Search and Curated Experiences: Relevance, ranking, query understanding, document-type coverage, filters, latency, and reliability across every surface that depends on search are your ownership areas, alongside adoption and engagement of company profiles and future new curated experiences.
Define the strategy: Set and defend a roadmap that balances relevance quality, coverage, and performance against clear business priorities.
Build evaluation and measurement: Stand up the metrics, benchmarks, and experimentation needed to know whether search is getting better, and to prove it.
Collaborate across teams: Partner closely with Knowledge Graph, SuperAnalyst / AI, Engineering, and Design so that search and the experiences built on top of it move together.
Lead and grow a team: Manage and mentor the curated-experiences / domain-expert PM, set clear ownership, and raise the bar for the search org as it grows.
Execute and deliver: Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle - from strategy and experimentation through launch, post-launch analysis, and iteration.
Who You Are
Deeply Technical: You have built search and relevance systems at scale - e.g., a Google Search-caliber background or equivalent depth in ranking, retrieval, query understanding, and evaluation. You can reason fluently about representation, freshness, quality, and system-design tradeoffs.
Strong Ownership & Drive: You take programs end to end and operate autonomously. You set direction, make the calls, and are accountable for the outcome.
A People Leader: You can manage and grow PMs, set clear lines of ownership, and resolve ambiguity rather than create it.
Analytical & Data-Driven: You balance business goals with technical capability and let metrics, not opinion, settle questions of search quality.
Strong Customer Orientation: You understand how sophisticated users search and form conviction, and you use interviews, usability testing, and behavioral data to validate hypotheses.
Clear Communicator: You can align engineering, design, and product marketing around a roadmap and gain buy-in to drive high-impact work.
Domain Experience a Plus: Direct experience in financial services, capital markets, or with our core customers (financial services, corporate strategy, consulting) is a plus, but not required.
For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.
You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.
Base Compensation Range
$275,000—$290,000 USD
AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
Recruiting Scams and Fraud
We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:
AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.
If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Job Location: Remote Position (USA), Remote, US, US

Job Contract Type: Full-time
Job Seniority Level:
Job ID
REQ-10086116
Aug 21, 2026
USA
Summary
The Director, AI Foundations Engineer will drive the engineering strategy, delivery, and operational excellence for the organization’s agentic AI operating system, with responsibility spanning solution architecture, development, operations, and continuous improvement. This role will be central to enabling the transformation of existing processes, products, and services into agentic AI products and intelligent workflows by providing a scalable, secure, and high performing foundation. The ideal candidate will bring deep engineering leadership, systems thinking, and technical vision to guide the design and evolution of core agentic capabilities, establish engineering standards and operating models, and lead cross functional teams in delivering resilient and extensible AI services. Working closely with product leaders, business stakeholders, data and technology teams, and transformation leaders, this role will ensure the agentic systems accelerate innovation, support enterprise adoption, and delivers measurable business value through reliable and scalable execution.
This position can be based remotely anywhere in the U.S. Please note that this role would not provide relocation as a result. The expectation of working hours and travel (domestic and/or international) will be defined by the Hiring Manager.
There are 2 positions available.
About the Role
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the design and development and ongoing improvement of the organization's AI foundations that will enable use cases through a disciplined engineering approach
Define and implement an agentic AI foundational system, engineering standards, and development practices that promote scalability, reliability, repeatability, and continuous improvement
Partner with product, data, infrastructure, security, and business teams to align platform capabilities with enterprise needs and strategic priorities.
Oversee engineering teams in building reusable platform services, tools, and components that enable agentic AI products and workflows.
Drive modernization and integration efforts to connect existing systems and processes with AI capabilities.
Monitor agentic operations and user feedback to identify improvements, resolve issues, and support continuous optimization.
Establish effective operating models, support processes, and governance practices to ensure consistent delivery of AI capabilities
Communicate platform priorities, delivery progress, technical risks, and investment needs to senior leaders and cross functional stakeholders.
Essential Requirements:
Bachelor degree required and advanced degree preferred, ideally in business, engineering, computer science, data science, or a related field.
8 plus years of AI engineering experience, with a strong track record of leading product strategy, roadmap development, and delivery for complex digital, data, or AI enabled products.
Demonstrated experience in AI and data driven product environments, including translating business needs into scalable product solutions and partnering closely with technical teams to bring innovative products to market.
Strong cross functional leadership skills, with proven ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Innovation, Design, Data Science, Commercial, and other business teams to drive alignment and execution.
Experience managing and developing product managers or junior product leaders, including coaching, prioritization support, and fostering strong product management practices.
Excellent strategic, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to evaluate opportunities, make informed tradeoffs, and clearly communicate product vision, priorities, and outcomes to stakeholders.
Novartis Compensation Summary:
The salary for this position is expected to range between $194,600 and $361,400 per year.
The final salary offered isdeterminedbased on factors like, but not limited to, relevant skills and experience, and upon joining Novartis will be reviewed periodically. Novartis may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

jobs.title: Director, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.text:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human
Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.
This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.
Okta authenticates, authorizes and provisions millions of users a day. The service is hosted on Amazon Web Services (AWS) across multiple availability zones and geographically separated regions. The service is designed for high throughput, and 99.999 availability. We're looking for a technical leader to help us to continue to scale the service with great people and reliable, cost-effective and efficient infrastructure, processes and tooling.
As the Director of Site Reliability Engineering you will oversee the SRE organization focused on Okta platform, Databases, Edge networking, K8s platform, CI/CD, Observability, FinOps, and automation platform & tooling.
Job Duties and Responsibilities:
Build and lead a high-caliber India-based SRE organization supporting Okta’s production fleet.
Partner with global engineering, product, and infrastructure leaders to deliver resilient, scalable, and secure services.
Define and execute the India SRE strategy in alignment with global reliability goals.
Lead post-incident reviews, drive root-cause analysis, and ensure long-term corrective actions. Participate in incident management, on-call rotations, and blameless RCAs.
Implement automation and observability to reduce manual toil and improve operational efficiency. Drive adoption of modern infrastructure practices: infrastructure as code (Terraform), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and AI within Infrastructure org.
Hire, mentor, and develop top SRE talent across India; build a strong engineering culture centered on reliability and innovation.
Foster collaboration across time zones with U.S. and EMEA teams.
Promote continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and process improvement.
Maintain a deep knowledge of industry best practices, evolving trends, and technologies.
Manage service and business expectations and prioritize resource allocation.
Accelerate the velocity of SRE and product engineering by developing robust platforms, powerful tooling, and intuitive self-service capabilities.
Improve SDLC processes for Cloud infrastructure as a code, including the maturity of CI/CD pipelines, change and release management.
Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:
16+ years of experience in site reliability, infrastructure, or production engineering roles.
8+ years of experience in technical leadership & people management including managing managers. Strong expertise in automation, observability, performance optimization, and incident response.
Excellent leadership, communication, and cross-cultural collaboration skills—particularly in a global matrixed setup.
Experience building or scaling offshore SRE teams that partner with global counterparts.
4+ years of experience running the SRE org supporting a SaaS/Cloud service in a public Cloud, preferably AWS. Experience supporting a multi-Cloud environment will be a plus.
Strong expertise in cloud-native architectures, containerization (Kubernetes), IaC (Terraform), and CI/CD pipelines.
Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage large-scale programs
Effective verbal, written communication and interpersonal skills
Education and Training:
Computer Science Degree or related degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Head of Product & Engineering
jobs.text:
Solaris is Europe’s leading embedded finance platform, pioneering Banking-as-a-Service to bridge the gap between financial technology and licensed banking. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Berlin, Solaris enables fintechs, digital ecosystems, and multinationals to embed accounts, cards, lending, and payments directly into their own products, creating seamless financial experiences for their users. As a fully licensed German bank, Solaris combines the highest standards of IT security and regulatory resilience with a modular, highly scalable infrastructure.
Today, Solaris is driving the next evolution of financial services by transitioning into an AI-native banking platform, ensuring European businesses can deploy secure, adaptable financial products at scale.
Why join Solaris?
🚀 We are fundamentally redesigning banking processes around AI orchestration, standardized modular building blocks, and embedded regulatory compliance.
🎯 We combine tech and banking in dedicated hubs - driving the technology infrastructure out of Berlin and banking operations out of Frankfurt.
💡 Through our internal mobility, growth opportunities, and the Solaris Academy, we offer continuous learning tracks, AI ambassador mentorship, and upskilling to keep your skills ahead of the curve.
⚖️ We foster a workplace rooted in integrity, proactive risk management, and equality actively driving initiatives like DEI initiatives.
The Head of Product & Engineering is a dual-domain leadership role reporting directly to the Executive Director of Technology. In this position, you will be primarily responsible for driving our Product Foundations and Business Enablement initiatives. You will own both the product vision and engineering delivery for foundational capabilities - such as core APIs, developer tools, and internal automation platforms - that power our broader technology ecosystem and enable internal business units to scale efficiently.
Your Role
Dual-Domain Leadership (Product & Engineering)
Serve as the ultimate owner of both the what/why (Product Roadmap) and the how (Engineering Execution) for foundational technical products.
Lead, mentor, and scale teams composed of both Product Managers and Software Engineers, fostering a culture of high performance, accountability, and engineering excellence.
Product Foundation & Core APIs
Oversee the development and scaling of our most critical technical capabilities, including Authentication services, API proxies, Policy engines, Identity and Access Management (IAM), and Webhook architectures.
Ensure these foundational tech products reliably power the entirety of Solaris's external and internal-facing API suite, maintaining high availability, security, and low latency.
Developer Productivity & Experience (DevEx)
Lead the teams responsible for developer productivity, managing tools like Backstage and defining SRE capabilities.
Create a frictionless development environment that allows Solaris engineers to build, test, and deploy securely and autonomously.
Business Enablement & Internal Automation
Drive the internal automation platform to support and scale various business units across Solaris.
Oversee the integration of internal toolings, the implementation of complex workflow systems, and the creation of robust build-automation frameworks.
Identify manual bottlenecks in business processes and deploy technical solutions to automate them, enabling the company to scale efficiently without an increase in overhead.
We'd love to see
Depending on your level of experience, your responsibilities and scope of role will range. We don’t care much about fancy titles, but rather about real personal and professional development, as laid out in our learning framework. Let’s figure together out how you can contribute to our team.
Have proven experience as a senior engineering leader with hands-on architectural experience in distributed systems, microservices, and Core APIs.
Demonstrated success in product leadership, specifically managing internal platforms, developer tools, or highly technical API-as-a-Product offerings.
3+ years of experience leading product and engineering organisation.
Experience implementing and managing internal developer portals (like Spotify's Backstage) and a deep empathy for the developer journey.
Ability to translate complex technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders, and vice versa.
Have successfully scaled both technology platforms and the organizational structures that support them in a fast-paced, highly regulated environment.
Strong understanding of IAM, authentication flows (OAuth, OIDC), API gateways/proxies, webhook infrastructure, and SRE best practices.
Track record of designing workflow systems and automation frameworks that streamline business operations.
Comfortable working with AI tools, thinking critically about AI outputs, and contributing to a culture of responsible AI use. We expect you to demonstrate comfort with AI-assisted workflows and a willingness to continuously develop their AI capabilities as the technology evolves.
Benefits
Home office budget.
Learning & development budget of €1000 per year and a transparent growth framework to support your career goals.
Competitive salary and a variable remuneration program.
Monthly meal allowance.
Deutschland ticket subsidy.
28 vacation days, increasing by 2 days after 2 years and 3 days after 3 years with Solaris.
Opportunity to work abroad for up to 12 weeks per year.
While job ads usually paint an ideal picture of a candidate, studies show that most applicants meet an average of 60% of the criteria. Unfortunately, many promising candidates tend to apply only if they meet all the criteria. So if you think you have what it takes, but don't necessarily meet every single item in the job description, please contact us anyway. We'd love to talk with you and find out if you might be a good fit for us.
At Solaris, we are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment, where all Solarians feel valued, respected and supported. We are dedicated to building a diverse workforce that reflects the diversity of our communities. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of color, ethnicity, religion, sex, origin, disability, marital status, citizenship, or gender identity. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
If your application is successful, you will be required to complete pre-employment background checks through our screening provider Zinc. These include, but not limited to identity verification, educational records, references, a criminal record check, etc. The processing is based on Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. Please see below Privacy Information for Job Applicants for details, including recipients, retention, and your rights.
Information on data processing:

EN: https://www.solarisgroup.com/gdpr_notice_en

jobs.title: Director Engineering - Investment & Pension domain (m/f/d)
jobs.text:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.
Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.
For further development and expansion of our successful business, Raisin is looking for a highly motivated, driven, and experienced Director of Engineering to lead both strategically and operationally our Investment and Pension (IPP) teams (25+ engineers)
This embraces high-quality conceptual and delivery performance of the teams, the health of the IPP engineering organization and system landscape, an efficient and compliant development process, technical and business ownership of the Raisin’s IPP platform, and vendor relationships.
At Raisin, we work in a domain driven organization with a binary-star leadership model. In this model, every Director of Engineering has a Product partner (Head of Product/ Director of Product).
The Director Engineering (DE) leads both strategically and operationally across multiple cross-functional teams.
This embraces the six impact areas (in details below):
Delivery quality and speed
Domain ownership
Team and culture
Data strategy
Process and compliance
Your Responsibilities
Delivery quality and speed
The DE is:
accountable for fulfilling the agreed team commitments to their business-owners in time, scope, and budget
responsible for the performance of their teams
resolving impediments for their teams
nurturing a culture of accountability, pragmatism, and reusability
ensuring a strong delivery oriented collaboration between the different engineering teams
leading both complex technical and important business projects
leading internal software engineering projects and initiatives
Domain ownership
The DE:
drives long-term value creation for their domain
is fostering an environment of passion and fun for the business processes in their tribe
builds resilient domain expertise in their teams
has a deep understanding of the existing system landscape of their teams
collaborates closely with their Business Owner and other stakeholders
vendor management (evaluating, onboarding, and managing vendors)
Tech Strategy
The DE:
shapes the technical strategy for their teams according to the Raisin's business needs
collaborates closely with other Sr. Engineering Leads in shaping and implementing Raisin's Tech Strategy
actively initiates and contributes to strategic technical and architectural decisions
is always considering the strategic benefits and price of:
keeping an existing technical solution
introducing a new alternative (e.g framework, tech stack, tooling, process)
Team and Culture
The DE is:
fully responsible for the health, resilience high performance, and development of their teams
offering direct leadership of engineering leads and sometimes also tech leads as well
encouraging accountability, creativity, risk-taking, and ownership by delegating responsibility
attracting, hiring, and retaining top technical talent for Raisin from around the world
proactively mentoring and coaching individual team members
ensuring a strong delivery-oriented collaboration between the different engineering teams
organizing workshops/hackathons
representing the company in external tech events advancing Raisin’s tech brand recognition
shaping and driving knowledge transfer best practices
nurturing and protecting our culture of trust
initiating, owning and nurturing tech initiatives (like guilds, workshops, regular meetups)
recognizing high performance and rewarding accomplishments within their teams
Process and Compliance
The DE:
drives, improves, and applies existing Raisin standards and policies, regulation and data privacy
contributes to an optimal toolchain with a high level of automation
develops, establishes, and continually improves documentation standards for the engineering organization
develops guidelines and best practices to ensure a lean software development process across different product teams
is responsible for the KPI-based reporting for their teams
actively monitors, analyses, and drives initiatives to continuously reduce their teams' technical debt
Your Profile
You hold a university degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related fields or have equivalent practical experience

blocks.text: Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

For further development and expansion of our successful business, Raisin is looking for a highly motivated, driven, and experienced Director of Engineering to lead both strategically and operationally our Investment and Pension (IPP) teams (25+ engineers)

jobs.title: Vice President, Clinical Technology UM Portfolio Management
jobs.text:
Position Purpose:
Oversee the product development function, including formulating product vision and strategy, defining future product needs and enhancements, and driving the creation of profitable, highly engaging, easy-to-use products across all business units.
Lead enterprise UM portfolio strategy and governance, partnering with clinical technology vendors and product development partners to align roadmap priorities, enforce SLA accountability, and drive end-to-end delivery across prior authorization, concurrent review, and clinical correspondence workflows.
Drive deployment of AI-enabled and other Tech capabilities across the UM lifecycle, from intake through determination and correspondence, establishing operational effectiveness frameworks that measure productivity, accuracy, and throughput gains to enable scalable, compliant automation.
Own the enterprise ROI and KPI measurement framework for UM technology investments and strategic initiatives, delivering executive-ready reporting on financial performance, vendor outcomes, and AI impact to inform senior leadership decision-making.
Develop and oversee the model for managing product development strategy.
Develop and oversee product roadmap in alignment with company strategic goals, market trends, competitive landscape, client, and consumer needs.
Drive clinical, digital and data/analytics product innovation ensuring highly engaging products with high ease of use.
Partner with strategic business unit team leadership (Operations, Pharma sales, Provider Sales and Account Management) and portfolio management to plan and manage complex set of priorities and resources to meet dynamic business, client, and market needs.
Build an effective and efficient product organization, including product management, consumer engagement, strategic partnerships and innovation.
Drive efficiency within the RFP and client implementation processes.
Review market landscape, analyze usage of product offerings, and review business case and key metrics to ensure ROI.
Monitor and measure product competitiveness and support new business opportunities.
Manage, measure and monitor strategic partners.
Performs other duties as assigned.
Complies with all policies and standards.
Education/Experience:
Bachelor's Degree in related field or equivalent experience required.
8+ years of clinical technology experience
Deep understanding of the member journey.
Product development experience.
Pay Range: $188,900.00 - $359,800.00 per year
At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.
Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.
Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.
Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the LA County Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act

jobs.title: Director of Data, Analytics, and AI
jobs.text:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of data, analytics, and artificial intelligence in a business-critical environment? MEM Insurance is seeking a visionary Director of Data, Analytics & AI to lead our enterprise data strategy, analytics capabilities, and AI/ML practice. In this highly visible leadership role, you will partner with executive and operational leaders across the organization to transform business priorities into data-driven solutions that create measurable impact.
As the leader of MEM's data and AI function, you will establish the strategy, governance, platforms, and practices that enable trusted decision-making across the enterprise. You will oversee the development of scalable data foundations, advanced analytics capabilities, and responsible AI initiatives while ensuring compliance within a regulated insurance environment. This role offers the opportunity to influence enterprise strategy, drive innovation, build high-performing teams, and help define how data and AI will shape the future of MEM Insurance.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities Enterprise Strategy & Leadership
Own and continuously evolve MEM's enterprise data, analytics, and AI strategy to align with business priorities, organizational goals, and risk management requirements.
Partner with Product Management and business leaders to understand strategic objectives and translate them into actionable data, analytics, and AI roadmaps.
Establish the long-term vision for data platforms, analytics environments, and AI/ML infrastructure, including build, buy, and partner decisions.
Identify and evaluate emerging AI capabilities and prioritize investments based on business value, organizational readiness, and risk-adjusted returns.
Maintain executive-level engagement through transparent communication of portfolio outcomes, delivery progress, and risk considerations.
AI & Analytics Leadership
Lead the organization's AI/ML practice, ensuring solutions are reliable, scalable, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
Establish enterprise standards for model development, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retirement.
Guide the evaluation, piloting, and deployment of generative AI and emerging AI technologies while balancing innovation with responsible governance.
Promote enterprise adoption of AI-enabled tools and opportunities that improve effectiveness, efficiency, and decision-making.
Define and oversee operational practices for machine learning including model management, monitoring, observability, and lifecycle governance.
Data Foundation & Architecture
Direct enterprise data architecture and data platform strategies that support analytics, AI, and operational business needs.
Ensure data engineering practices deliver high-quality, trusted, well-documented, and scalable data assets.
Partner with technology and operational leaders to maintain a unified data ecosystem that supports future growth and innovation.
Champion user-centered design with a strong focus on the usability and accessibility of analytics and data products.
Governance, Risk & Responsible AI
Lead enterprise data governance efforts, including data quality, lineage, stewardship, access controls, retention practices, and business glossaries.
Oversee the AI governance framework including model inventories, risk classification, validation standards, monitoring, explainability, and fairness assessments.
Ensure data and AI initiatives comply with applicable insurance regulations, emerging AI requirements, and internal governance standards.
Partner with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and other stakeholders to translate regulatory expectations into practical operational controls.
Identify and proactively manage technical, operational, regulatory, and reputational risks associated with data and AI initiatives.
Business Partnership & Delivery
Partner with leaders across underwriting, claims, actuarial, safety and risk services, and other business functions to deliver analytics and AI solutions that improve business outcomes.
Foster strong cross-functional relationships to ensure alignment between business priorities and technology investments.
Drive measurable value through data-informed decision-making and enterprise analytics initiatives.
Team Leadership & Talent Development
Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team including product owners, data engineers, data scientists, analytics engineers, and business intelligence developers.
Create career development pathways, succession plans, and talent strategies that strengthen organizational capabilities.
Build a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
Develop future technical leaders through coaching, mentorship, and challenging growth opportunities.
Qualifications Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Management, or a closely related field required.
Equivalent combinations of education and relevant professional experience will be considered.
Licenses
Valid driver's license
Experience
Proven track record of successful leadership in data, analytics, and artificial intelligence initiatives.
3+ years of leadership experience, either through formal management responsibilities or significant leadership influence within complex initiatives.
Experience developing and executing enterprise data strategies and governance programs preferred.
Experience leading cross-functional teams and driving business transformation through data and analytics strongly preferred.
Experience operating within a regulated industry environment preferred.
Company Culture and Values At MEM Insurance, we are committed to our vision, mission, and values. We foster a culture of collaboration, integrity, and innovation. Our team is passionate about delivering exceptional service to our customers while supporting each other’s growth and success. We believe in accountability, continuous learning, and creating an environment where employees feel valued and empowered.
Diversity Statement MEM Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We believe that varied perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to serve our customers and communities.
Total Rewards Overview
Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision
Includes fertility benefits, fully paid preventative care, and adult orthodontia.
Annual Performance Based Bonus
• Employer-Paid Life and Disability Benefits:
Life Insurance (3x base salary), AD&D, Short and Long-term Disability.
Wellness and Recognition Program: Employer-paid incentives for employees and spouses.
Flexible Spending Account and Dependent Care options
Health Savings Account: Generous employer contribution.
• Time Away from Work:
Generous PTO, 11 Holidays + 4 Early Releases, 16 Hours Volunteer Time Off, 20 Days Paid Parental Leave, Marriage, Bereavement, and Jury Duty leave.
Employee Assistance Programs
401k Retirement Plan: Employer match and profit sharing.
Adoption Assistance and Tuition Assistance
Notice Regarding Use of Artificial Intelligence MEM may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to more efficiently facilitate and assist in decisions involving recruitment, hiring, promotion, renewal of employment, selection for training or apprenticeship, discharge, discipline, tenure, or the terms, privileges, or conditions of employment. Any such use of AI tools will comply with all applicable laws.

jobs.title: VP, Product
jobs.text:
Later is the world’s most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing’s most visible investments.
Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data—including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases—Later helps teams understand what will work before they launch.
By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don’t just look good—they deliver results. Learn more at .
VP, Product Management, Later Influence
Boston, MA; Chicago, Illinois, United States; Los Angeles, California, United States; New York, New York, United States; Remote; San Francisco, California, United States; Toronto, Ontario, Canada; Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada; Vancouver, Washington, United States
Later is the world's most intelligent influencer marketing company, built to give brands the confidence to create unforgettable campaigns. By combining real creator relationships, trusted intelligence, and expert guidance, Later removes fear and guesswork from one of marketing's most visible investments.
Built on a native, AI-powered platform and more than a decade of proprietary data, including billions of social interactions, impressions, and $2.4B+ in verified influencer-driven purchases, Later helps teams understand what wil work before they launch.
By combining trusted insight with expert guidance, Later removes guesswork from influencer marketing, enabling brands to choose the right creators, execute fully managed campaigns, and drive meaningful growth across awareness, engagement, and revenue. Trusted by leading enterprise brands including Nike, Wayfair, Unilever, and Southwest Airlines, Later bridges creativity and performance so campaigns don't just look good, they deliver results. Learn more at later.com.
About this position:
As VP of Product Management for Later Influence, our agency and brand-facing enterprise influencer marketing product, you'll shape and drive the strategy that helps brands and creators collaborate at scale with predictable, measurable business results. Later Influence combines AI, first-party data across campaigns, creators, and content, and workflow automation to deliver full-funnel campaigns from discovery to conversion. Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and leading Product Manager(s) directly, you'll build a high-impact product organization, shaping the roadmap and user experience while optimizing for growth, stickiness, and commercial impact. This is a pivotal, high-visibility role in scaling Later's creator economy proposition, with responsibility for transforming Later Influence into an AI-native Programmatic Influencer platform, and regular exposure to senior leadership.
What you'll be doing:
Strategy
Own the vision and strategy for Later Influence, connecting brands, creators, and commerce through AI, our proprietary data, and rich creator commerce signals.
Become an expert in the end-to-end execution of influencer campaigns, driving improvements that streamline planning and strategy, campaign kickoff and setup, creator discovery and vetting, campaign workflow and content collaboration, payments management, and reporting and insights.
Monitor, share, and translate insights from customer needs, creator economy news, social networks, commerce trends, and partnerships into a roadmap that drives measurable business outcomes, reduces human-in-the-loop hours to deliver a campaign, and improves the quality of the customer experience.
Partner with the CPO, cross-functionally with Engineering, and across stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, and Partnerships to align product strategy with company objectives and targets.
Define, monitor, and report progress toward key metrics that cascade throughout the product teams, including impacts to campaign delivery, creator earnings, and company revenue.
Serve as the product champion for how Later Influence uniquely delivers value, including our creator network of 20M+ and 200k high-affinity creators and over $1.5B in GMV.
Execution & Technical Leadership
Lead end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation, discovery, and MVP through scaling and ongoing optimization, delivering solutions that help brands find, engage, pay, and measure creators and campaigns at scale.
Deepen our AI capabilities and advance our product toward our AI Programmatic vision through strong partnership with our data and engineering teams.
Build and manage strong product processes, leveraging tools such as Linear for product backlog and delivery and Domo (or similar) for analytics and monitoring.
Prioritize features and investment based on expected outcomes and data, such as campaign performance, cohort-based churn, and revenue growth, while maintaining a consistent focus on ROI and product-market fit.
Ensure the platform's UX, workflow, automation, and analytics match the enterprise expectations of brand marketers, including campaign workflow automation, message automation, creator application and review, and payments.
Team & Collaboration
Build, lead, and mentor a high-performing product team (Product Managers, Product Ops, Design) focused on Later Influence, setting clear goals, career paths, and accountability.
Collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and our Creator Network team to ensure a cohesive go-to-market, onboarding, and renewals motion.
Work closely with peer product, design, and research leaders, including the SVP of Product, Creator, to share best practices, ensure product synergy across the ecosystem, and avoid silos.
Foster a culture of positivity, proactiveness, and ownership, ensuring the team is motivated, aligned, and accountable.
Thought Leadership & Market Insights
Stay ahead of influencer marketing, creator economy, social media platform, and commerce trends, including challenger insights, creator behaviors, and new social platforms.
Translate market and competitor insight into product differentiation and speed-to-market advantages.
Represent Later Influence externally, including with customers, analysts, partners, and PR, as the product leader who understands our value and can articulate it in the market.
What success looks like:
The platform makes meaningful progress toward Later's vision of a Programmatic Influencer Platform, becoming an increasingly differentiated enterprise offering.
A clear, compelling roadmap is in place, with defined milestones showing improved customer outcomes and strong alignment with leadership stakeholders.
Within the first 6-12 months, you've delivered measurable progress toward AI transformation of the program execution workflow and driven impact to primary product metrics.
The product team operates with elevated velocity, demonstrable expertise and customer insight, credibility, predictable delivery, clear prioritization, and measurable impact.

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
VP of Engineering
Counterpart believes in small businesses and is dedicated to helping them do more with less risk. By pairing leading insurance experts with cutting-edge technology, Counterpart empowers small business owners to grow with confidence. Exceptional underwriters, trusted insurance brokers, and prominent insurance carriers come together on the Counterpart platform to support small businesses by providing AI-driven management and professional liability underwriting and claims services. That’s where you come in…
Counterpart is building the first AI-native insurance company. We are redesigning how we operate from the ground up so that every person carries real context, real ownership, and real leverage, and the system carries the rest. As VP of Engineering, you will lead our flat-by-design engineering organization. Scaling our impact through better infrastructure, better context systems, and agents that compound every engineer's output. You will own the technical vision, engineering operations, and people strategy for the function, and you will represent Counterpart's technology strategy to the board.
As VP of Engineering, you will:
Evolve how our flat engineering organization scales with agents. Ensure and retain high talent density. Drive efficiency by leveraging AI. Set the forward-looking technical vision that supports the business.
Shape how Counterpart builds software in an AI-native world. Partner with the CEO, engineering leaders, and technical product managers to refine how we build, how we operate, and how we compound output.
Run Engineering as a function that allocates its people and agents across competing initiatives. Own the allocation decisions, engineering standards, delivery quality, and the mechanisms to ensure project teams maintain technical coherence while operating independently.
Own the infrastructure that enables AI-native engineering: developer experience, AI and data platforms, and system infrastructure.
Own hiring, performance management, compensation, and talent development for the engineering organization. Partner with the Head of People and the Chief of Staff to ensure Engineering's people model and operations fit the company's operating cadence.
Ensure our systems meet high standards for reliability, observability, and security, including compliance with SOC 2, HIPAA, and NYC Cybersecurity regulations.
Represent Counterpart's technology capabilities internally and externally, aligning with leadership, partners, and investors to communicate vision and execution.
YOU HAVE:
12+ years of engineering leadership, with experience leading engineering organizations through multiple company-stage transitions. You have operated at a scale that regularly required engagement with the board, investors, and executive leadership. You know what great engineering organizations look like at each stage and what structures break when the company outgrows them.
A strong point of view on what AI-native engineering looks like. Not just using AI tools. You have thought deeply about how AI changes the role of the engineer, the shape of the engineering org, and the economics of software delivery. You hold opinions on where the industry is going, and you can defend them. You also know where the hype outpaces reality.
Deep technical fluency to form strong opinions on system architecture, AI and data infrastructure, and deployment pipelines.
Customer empathy and product sense. You think about business and technology together, never one at the expense of the other. You constantly look for ways to enable the business through technology: building new capabilities while improving the systems underneath. You do not refactor for refactoring's sake, and you do not ship features on a foundation that cannot support them.
Experience leading fully distributed teams with high trust and high accountability.
Experience in regulated industries (insurance, fintech, healthcare, or similar) is a strong plus. You understand that compliance (SOC 2, HIPAA, state cybersecurity regulations) is a constraint you build into systems, not an afterthought you bolt on.
WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH:
Tanner Hackett, CEO
Tobias Schuler, Chief Underwriting Officer
Kelly North, VP of Revenue
Ali Fiedler, Head of People
Chris Shafer, Chief of Staff
Eric Marler, Head of Claims
Dave Lin, Head of Product
Ron Alexessen, Engineering Manager
Chad Nierenhausen, Engineering Manager
Jon Mendez, Engineering Manager
Newton Troung, Engineering Manager
Julian Prokay, Principal Engineer
Derrick Franco, Principal Engineer
Ben Nickerson, Technical Product Manager
Natalie Anderson, Technical Product Manager
Abhi Singh, Technical Product Manager
WHAT WE OFFER
Fully remote workplace
Unlimited Vacation: We offer flexible time off, allowing you to take time when you need it.
Work from Anywhere: Counterpart is a fully distributed company, meaning there is no office. We allow employees to work from wherever they do their best work, and invite the team to meet in person a couple times per year.
Stock Options
Health, Dental, and Vision Coverage
401(k) Retirement Plan
Parental Leave
Home Office Allowance: to set up your home office with the necessary equipment and accessories.
Wellness Stipend
Book stipend
Professional Development Reimbursement
No working birthdays: Take your birthday off, giving you the opportunity to relax, enjoy your special day, and spend time with loved ones.
Charitable Contribution Matching
We are committed to being a welcoming and inclusive workplace for everyone, and we are intentional about making sure people feel respected, supported and connected at work—regardless of who you are or where you come from. We value and celebrate our differences and we believe being open about who we are allows us to do the best work of our lives.
We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate against qualified applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual preference, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law, rule, or regulation.

jobs.title: VP Product — Lineup & FatTail
jobs.text:
Chartbeat Inc. is the parent company of Chartbeat, Tubular Labs, FatTail, and Lineup Systems. Together, we’re shaping the future of media strategy and revenue. Trusted by the world's top media brands, Chartbeat, Inc. combines analytics that power smarter audience strategies with revenue solutions that simplify ad operations and accelerate monetization.
Our mission is to help customers grow valuable media brands with their content. Join our diverse group of focused, hardworking professionals who are passionate about doing work that’s challenging and fun — and who strive to maintain a healthy work/life balance.
About the Role
Lineup and FatTail are the leading Order Management Systems (OMS) for media companies, and this role will own product vision and strategy across both. It's a high-touch, customer-facing product leadership role: you'll build close, lasting relationships with the customers and prospects who rely on our platforms, and turn what you learn from those relationships into a roadmap that drives real growth.
We're looking for a VP of Product with a genuine commercial mindset — someone who is energized by being in front of customers and prospects, not just building for them at a distance. You will be the primary product voice representing our vision and roadmap to the market: presenting directly to prospects and clients, building trust with the people who buy and use our products, and channeling what you hear back into product decisions that grow the business. You will also lead and grow a team of product managers, building the strength and depth of the product organization as it scales.
You'll have a key voice in shaping the direction of Chartbeat's broader, unified platform vision — helping define how we integrate Chartbeat and Tubular's content and audience analytics with Lineup and FatTail's order management systems to deliver innovative solutions that help media companies grow their business.
Key Responsibilities
10+ years in product management, including 5+ years in a senior product leadership role (VP, SVP, or equivalent) in B2B SaaS focused on the Media or Ad Tech industry.
Direct Ad Tech experience is required, ideally with an OMS or adjacent systems (e.g., Google Ad Manager, ad servers, DMPs/CDPs, or similar sell-side ad tech).
A track record of delivering innovative, differentiated products, including AI-driven features or workflows — you know how to identify where AI creates real customer value versus where it's a distraction.
A track record of commercial involvement, including presenting roadmap and vision directly to prospects and customers, and being trusted as a credible voice in high-stakes customer conversations.
Experience in enterprise or upper-mid-market B2B settings, ideally within media, publishing, or adjacent verticals, where building close customer relationships is central to the business.
People leadership experience, having built, managed, and grown teams of product managers.
Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Strategy & Roadmap Ownership
Define and evolve a long-term OMS strategy and roadmap establishing a clear vision across our two OMS products that strengthens competitive differentiation, drives customer growth and retention, and deepens platform adoption.
Prioritize ruthlessly across customer commitments, competitive differentiation, and platform/data unification to ensure we’re making the right investments to move the business forward.
Collaborate with product leaders across the business to define and deliver a unified platform vision that strengthens all four brands together.
Customer & Market Engagement
Serve as a primary product voice with prospects and clients — presenting vision and roadmap directly, and building close, lasting relationships with the people who buy and use our products.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success to improve win rates, adoption, and renewals — bringing product perspective into customer conversations and helping remove product-related obstacles
Grow a strong network across media and publishing that expands our credibility and reach in the industry.
Turn customer and market insight into clear, credible product decisions, balancing near-term needs with long-term platform investment.
Team Leadership & Talent Development
Lead and grow a team of product managers and leaders, setting a high bar for product craft, commercial fluency, and customer engagement.
Partner with the executive leadership on org design, hiring, and development plans to strengthen the product team as it grows.
Coach PMs into strong functional leaders who own outcomes across product strategy, roadmap creation and execution, client-facing communication, vision storytelling, and commercial support.
Cross-Functional & Platform Collaboration
Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and commercial teams to translate strategy into delivered and adopted products.
Champion platform thinking that unlocks cross-sell and deepens customer value across Chartbeat, Tubular, Lineup, and FatTail.
Represent OMS product strategy to the executive team and, where relevant, the Board — shaping investment decisions with clear business impact.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary range: $225,000-$275,000
Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
401K with company match (100% of the first 3% and 50% of the next 2%)
Fully Paid Parental Leave - 18 weeks for birthing parents, 12 weeks for non-birthing parents
Phone and internet stipend
Wellness, learning, and coworking reimbursements
Flexible work hours
Unlimited PTO
11 paid holidays and December holiday closure
Annual In-Person Event
Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Statement
At Chartbeat we strive to create and continually grow as a company where all employees are able to be their authentic selves. We are committed to recruiting, hiring, and retaining employees from different backgrounds, viewpoints, and experiences. Our strength is our diversity and we are dedicated to continuously reflect upon, and evolve our efforts to maintain a diverse, equitable and inclusive ecosystem.
Equal Opportunity Employment Statement
Chartbeat is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, age, or any other status protected by applicable national, federal, state, or local law.
Chartbeat's CCPA disclosure notice can be found here.

You will be the primary product voice representing our vision and roadmap to the market: presenting directly to prospects and clients, building trust with the people who buy and use our products, and channeling what you hear back into product decisions that grow the business. You will also lead and grow a team of product managers, building the strength and depth of the product organization as it scales.

You'll have a key voice in shaping the direction of Chartbeat's broader, unified platform vision — helping define how we integrate Chartbeat and Tubular's content and audience analytics with Lineup and FatTail's order management systems to deliver innovative solutions that help media companies grow their business.
Key Responsibilities
10+ years in product management, including 5+ years in a senior product leadership role (VP, SVP, or equivalent) in B2B SaaS focused on the Media or Ad Tech industry.
Direct Ad Tech experience is required, ideally with an OMS or adjacent systems (e.g., Google Ad Manager, ad servers, DMPs/CDPs, or similar sell-side ad tech).

A track record of delivering innovative, differentiated products, including AI-driven features or workflows — you know how to identify where AI creates real customer value versus where it's a distraction.
A track record of commercial involvement, including presenting roadmap and vision directly to prospects and customers, and being trusted as a credible voice in high-stakes customer conversations.
Experience in enterprise or upper-mid-market B2B settings, ideally within media, publishing, or adjacent verticals, where building close customer relationships is central to the business.
People leadership experience, having built, managed, and grown teams of product managers.
Day-to-Day Responsibilities
Strategy & Roadmap Ownership

items: Define and evolve a long-term OMS strategy and roadmap establishing a clear vision across our two OMS products that strengthens competitive differentiation, drives customer growth and retention, and deepens platform adoption.
Prioritize ruthlessly across customer commitments, competitive differentiation, and platform/data unification to ensure we’re making the right investments to move the business forward.
Collaborate with product leaders across the business to define and deliver a unified platform vision that strengthens all four brands together.

blocks.text: Customer & Market Engagement

items: Serve as a primary product voice with prospects and clients — presenting vision and roadmap directly, and building close, lasting relationships with the people who buy and use our products.
Partner with Sales and Customer Success to improve win rates, adoption, and renewals — bringing product perspective into customer conversations and helping remove product-related obstacles
Grow a strong network across media and publishing that expands our credibility and reach in the industry.
Turn customer and market insight into clear, credible product decisions, balancing near-term needs with long-term platform investment.

blocks.text: Team Leadership & Talent Development

items: Lead and grow a team of product managers and leaders, setting a high bar for product craft, commercial fluency, and customer engagement.
Partner with the executive leadership on org design, hiring, and development plans to strengthen the product team as it grows.
Coach PMs into strong functional leaders who own outcomes across product strategy, roadmap creation and execution, client-facing communication, vision storytelling, and commercial support.

blocks.text: Cross-Functional & Platform Collaboration

items: Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, and commercial teams to translate strategy into delivered and adopted products.
Champion platform thinking that unlocks cross-sell and deepens customer value across Chartbeat, Tubular, Lineup, and FatTail.
Represent OMS product strategy to the executive team and, where relevant, the Board — shaping investment decisions with clear business impact.

jobs.title: VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure
jobs.text:
Title: VP of Technology & AI Infrastructure
Department: Information Technology
Reports to: President
Location: Remote
About the Organization
Upwardly Global is a national workforce development organization that connects work-authorized, college-educated immigrants to skill-aligned professional employment across the United States. We address one of the country’s most significant economic inefficiencies: more than 2 million highly educated, work-authorized immigrants are underemployed, representing over $40 billion in annual forgone wages and untapped productivity for the American economy.
Our model works. Jobseekers enter our programs earning an average of $9,000 per year and are placed in roles averaging $67,000 per year. To date, we have supported an estimated 35,000 job placements, contributing billions in earnings to the U.S. economy.
Upwardly Global is data-driven, economically accountable, and built for scale. We are committed to leveraging AI to its fullest potential, driving operational efficiency, jobseeker readiness, and national economic impact. We operate nationally, partnering with leading employers, workforce agencies, and policymakers to ensure that global talent becomes American advantage.
About the Role
The VP of Technology is responsible for building and leading Upwardly Global’s technology strategy and infrastructure to support both internal operations and externally facing digital products. This includes staff-facing technology as well as the technical infrastructure that enables jobseeker and partner experiences.
This leader partners closely with the CEO, President and executive leadership to ensure technology is a strategic enabler of UpGlo’s mission, helping the organization transition towards an AI and product-first model while maintaining strong operational excellence, security, reliability, and scalable delivery practices. Upwardly Global will integrate AI into all aspects of the organization to drive operational excellence, improve jobseeker opportunities and outcomes, and this role will help lead these efforts.
The VP of Technology is expected to be both strategic and execution-oriented: setting direction, making tradeoffs clear, and delivering consistently across teams.
Key Responsibilities:
1. Technology Strategy & AI Infrastructure:
• Own UpGlo’s technology strategy across staff infrastructure and jobseeker/partner-facing products, ensuring both are secure, scalable, cost-effective, and aligned to mission outcomes.
• Build and maintain a multi-year technology roadmap covering staff infrastructure and IT operations, data systems and reporting, Salesforce/platform evolution, core digital products (jobseeker portal, online learning, partner tools), and integrations/interoperability across systems.
• Translate organizational strategy into a sequenced plan with clear timelines, dependencies, resource needs, and success measures.
• Provide clear tradeoffs and recommendations to Executive Leadership Team on what to prioritize, defer, or stop based on capacity and impact.
• Support sprint planning, release planning, and other Agile ceremonies.
2. Product & Engineering Partnership (Jobseeker + Partner Products):
Partner deeply with Product leadership to deliver a reliable, scalable technology foundation for UpGlo’s jobseeker and partner ecosystem.
Ensure strong cross-functional delivery across product/tech/programs, including planning, prioritization, technical feasibility, timelines, and adoption/change management.
Partnering with the Product Director, guide the technical approach to product delivery (architecture, build vs. buy, integration strategy, platform choices) and ensure consistent execution quality.
3. AI Enablement and Responsible Technology Innovation:
Partner with the Executive team, Product and Program leadership to identify and deliver AI-enabled capabilities that improve jobseeker outcomes and staff productivity.
With a cross-department steering committee, establish technical standards and governance for responsible AI use, including data privacy and consent, security controls and vendor risk assessment, quality assurance and bias considerations, and human oversight/escalation paths.
Build the technical foundation required for AI-readiness: data quality, integration, and scalable infrastructure to support AI features and experimentation.
4. IT Operations, Service Delivery and Training (Staff & Product Infrastructure):
Lead internal IT operations to ensure strong service delivery across the organization (helpdesk, devices, access control, onboarding/offboarding, troubleshooting).
Establish service standards (response times, escalation, documentation, internal communications) and continuously improve the staff technology experience.
Own vendor relationships and contracts across key systems and managed service providers.
Ensure all staff are trained to use our infrastructure and tools, including AI, to maximum effect. Delivery includes accountability to staff usage, ensuring technology is utilized with maximum efficiency and effectiveness.
5. IT Operations, Service Delivery and Training (Staff & Product Infrastructure):
Lead internal IT operations to ensure strong service delivery across the organization (helpdesk, devices, access control, onboarding/offboarding, troubleshooting).
Establish service standards (response times, escalation, documentation, internal communications) and continuously improve the staff technology experience.
Own vendor relationships and contracts across key systems and managed service providers.
Ensure all staff are trained to use our infrastructure and tools, including AI, to maximum effect. Delivery includes accountability to staff usage, ensuring technology is utilized with maximum efficiency and effectiveness.
6. Systems, Data, and Platform Leadership (Salesforce + Reporting)
Oversee Salesforce and related systems as the operational backbone for Programs, Development, and organizational reporting.
Strengthen system usability, adoption, and reliability through clear requirements gathering, prioritization, and iterative improvements.
Own data strategy in partnership with research and evaluation leadership: governance, quality, reporting, and dashboard reliability.
Ensure the organization has trusted reporting that supports program improvement, fundraising narratives, and leadership decision-making.
7. Project Delivery, Execution Discipline & Cross-Functional Leadership:
Implement and enforce a consistent project management framework across all technology work.
Lead cross-functional execution so teams experience IT and technology as reliable, transparent, and partnership-driven.
Build a culture of accountability and follow-through within the technology function and across stakeholders.
6. Security, Risk, and Compliance:
Own cybersecurity strategy and operational risk management.
Ensure appropriate controls for systems that handle sensitive data.
Maintain risk register and communicate risks and mitigations clearly to Executive Leadership Team and the Board as needed.
Ensure technology practices align with funder requirements, privacy expectations, and organizational policies.
7. Executive Partnership & Communication:
Serve as a proactive, consultative partner to the CEO, President and Executive Leadership Team- bringing clear updates, risks, and decision-ready recommendations.
Communicate in a structured way leadership can act on: what is on track, what is at risk, what decisions are needed, and what tradeoffs are recommended.
Drive follow-through on Executive Leadership Team decisions by documenting commitments, assigning owners, and reporting progress.
Success Measures:
A clear, sequenced technology roadmap that covers staff infrastructure and digital products, aligned to strategic priorities.
Strong Product-Tech partnership resulting in reliable delivery of jobseeker and partner-facing features and improvements.
AI capabilities delivered responsibly with governance, safety standards, and measurable impact.
Predictable project delivery with improved cross-functional satisfaction and fewer surprises.
Improved reliability, security posture, and risk management across systems and products.
Executive-level communication that is decision-oriented, clear, and consistent.
Qualifications:
10+ years of technology leadership experience spanning IT operations, systems leadership, and product/engineering delivery.
Experience building or leading technology strategy across both internal infrastructure and externally facing products/platforms with demonstrated experience in AI.
Strong program/project delivery discipline; proven ability to manage multiple priorities with constrained resources.
Experience with AI, data governance, enterprise systems, and CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred).
Deep comfort partnering with Product leaders on strategy, roadmaps, prioritization, and delivery.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical issues into clear decisions.
Commitment to our mission
Salary Range: 200K- 225K annually
Salary Disclaimer: The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Indeed salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Upwardly Global's total compensation package for employees. Benefits include paid time off policy, hybrid or remote work schedule, medical/dental/vision insurance, paid parental leave, short term disability insurance, life insurance and retirement plan with employer match.
Upwardly Global is deeply committed to building a workplace where inclusion is not only valued but prioritized. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment.
