jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Operations Planning
jobs.text:
S'more about the team
The Operations Data and Decisions Tribe at HelloFresh is responsible for driving operations planning by creating high quality, reusable data assets, data science models, and algorithmic solutions. Additionally, the tribe. This team has a direct impact on the customer experience and is constantly optimising for various Business KPIs. They build in-house products using modern technologies to handle a massive scale of transactions (>8.5 million active customers) and continuously improve the SDLC for fast flow and continuous delivery.
As a Director of Operations Planning Engineering, you will lead engineering teams (Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, & Analytics) and Staff Engineers across the mid-term planning domain, supporting their technical decision-making processes. Your responsibilities will include spearheading initiatives that traverse multiple teams and domains, such as those focused on network planning, demand planning, and production planning. Drawing upon your comprehensive understanding of the domain, you will own the planning architecture strategy and drive the long-term vision for how our planning systems should be integrated and scaled.
Lettuce share what this role will be responsible for
Lead an engineering squad comprising 10-15 engineers, managing Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers across Warsaw, Berlin, & USA.
Own the GenAI transformation — define and drive a concrete roadmap for becoming a genuinely AI-native engineering organisation: from AI-assisted development and automated incident response, to agentic workflows and LLM-powered tooling embedded in day-to-day operations.
Own the availability and reliability of HelloFresh's planning infrastructure — drive SRE practices, incident management, SLOs/SLIs, and on-call maturity across high-throughput systems serving multiple markets.
Set technical direction across Python, GoLang, PostgreSQL, Kafka, React, and React Native services on AWS, ensuring systems.
Partner with Product, Operations, Marketing, and Procurement providers to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage, coach, and develop Engineering Managers & Engineers — holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
Navigate organisational change with maturity, keeping teams focused and motivated through evolving priorities.
Sound a-peeling? Here's what we're looking for
AI proficiency and advocacy. Hands-on familiarity with AI technologies and a demonstrable track record of championing their adoption — whether through AI-assisted development workflows, LLM-powered tooling, or driving team-wide GenAI-native ways of working.
Deep Technical Expertise. Mastery of a broad range of technical skills relevant to Operations Planning — including planning systems, data science modeling, data engineering, database systems, distributed computing, and backend development frameworks. Hands-on familiarity with full stack application development.
Systems Thinking. The ability to understand complex systems holistically, recognising how components interact and impact each other, and leveraging this to design scalable, resilient solutions in a high-throughput environment where downtime means direct revenue loss.
Proven Leadership at Scale. 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years managing Engineering Managers — not just individual contributors. Demonstrated ability to lead distributed teams across multiple offices, building trust and maintaining high engineering standards without daily co-location.
Operational Excellence Mindset. Strong grounding in SRE practices — SLOs/SLIs, incident management, on-call culture, and observability tooling (Grafana or similar). Experience owning payments infrastructure in regulated, multi-market environments is a strong plus.
Cross-Functional Collaboration. Exceptional ability to work across engineering disciplines, Product, business stakeholders, and external service providers — fostering alignment towards common goals and translating business outcomes into engineering priorities.
Effective Communication Across Disciplines. Strong ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, from engineers to senior business stakeholders.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
Let’s cut to the cheese, this is why you'll love it here
Shape the future of food: Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.
Drive transformational change: Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.
Build a global brand: Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing: Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Health & Wellbeing: Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Flexibility & Work-Life: Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings. Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Career & Development: Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.
To meet these needs, we are pleased to provide Flexible Hybrid work. Flexible Hybrid is a people-first approach that is based on choice, trust, personalization, and empowers teams to choose when and how often they work from the office and work from home, in addition to team days and company days. This means a minimum of 2 days in office per week, with most teams in office between 2-3 days a week.
#LI-HYBRID
HelloFresh Canada uses AI-integrated technology to help us process and evaluate applications more efficiently. This includes tools that screen and assess candidate qualifications based on the requirements for this role. While these tools assist our workflow, all final selection decisions are made by our hiring team.
Toronto, ON Pay Range
$174,300—$184,300 CAD

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Global Payouts
jobs.text:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs.
If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.
THE WORK:
We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Ripple's cross-border payment offering that enables global institutions to bridge stablecoins and fiat instantly.
This person will lead the roadmap driving the next phase of growth for our flagship payouts products. They will use the power of digital assets and blockchain to bridge traditional financial infrastructure. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Sales and Account Management, Risk/Fraud, Finance, Compliance, and Legal to build payment experiences that are customer-first, resilient, and built to scale.
The ideal candidate has deep payments expertise and a strong curiosity about digital assets. You're a problem solver; you work best when you're driving early stage solutions to achieve next-level scale. You'll excel working in a fast-past environment, and you are adept at and handling cross-functional initiatives across geographies.
WHAT YOU’LL DO:
Product Strategy and Vision: Define and communicate a product vision, strategy and roadmap for our Global Payouts product.
Product Quality and Delivery: Partner with engineering to ensure clear requirements, strong acceptance criteria, and high-quality launches..
Payments Experience: Lead the end-to-end payments experience across Ripple payouts, crafting capabilities that balance customer experience, conversion, and regulatory controls.
Cross-functional Leadership: Lead high-impact initiatives and align collaborators across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Risk/Fraud, and Operations; remove blockers and drive decisions.
Collaborator Management and Influence: Deliver concise, committed communication to ensure alignment and drive outcomes.
WHAT YOU'LL BRING:
12-15 years of total professional experience in financial services, fintech, or the crypto industry, with at least 5-10 years in a core product management role.
A passion for payments and a deep curiosity about digital assets and blockchain.
Demonstrated track record of scaling and evangelizing successful products
Ability to translate complex topics into clear, concise language for different audiences.
Strong technical competence and understanding.
A knack for establishing relationships and driving alignment across teams with different priorities.
For positions that will be based in CA, the annual salary range for this position is below. Actual salaries may vary based on numerous factors including, among other things, an individual applicant’s experience and qualifications for the position. This range does not include equity or additional compensation, such as bonuses or commissions.
CA Annual Base Salary Range
$248,000—$300,000 USD
WHO WE ARE:
Do Your Best Work
The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in.
Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!
Take Control of Your Finances
Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
Employee giving match
Mobile phone stipend
Take Care of Yourself
R&R days so you can rest and recharge
Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events
Benefits listed above are for full-time employees.
Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.

jobs.title: VP, Platform Engineering
jobs.text:
Why We Stand Out
Seeking a career-defining opportunity where your leadership, strategic vision, and client expertise are recognized and rewarded? Kaufman Rossin might be just the place for you.
As one of the top accounting firms in the country, our foundation is “people first.” In the words of James Kaufman, “we prioritize our people, their development, and their well-being. Our values are translated into action every day.”
Kaufman Rossin is a privately owned, independent public accounting firm, which means we are not beholden to outside investors or private equity influence. This independence allows us to prioritize long-term client relationships, maintain objectivity in our advisory approach, and make strategic decisions that benefit our people and clients, not external stakeholders. Our structure fosters agility, entrepreneurial thinking, and a collaborative culture where leadership is accessible, and innovation is encouraged.
Celebrated as the Best Place to Work in South Florida over a dozen times, Kaufman Rossin has grown to over 700 employees, with offices spanning the tri-county area, including sister entities Kaufman Rossin Wealth and Kaufman Rossin Alternative Investment Services.
Think you have what it takes?
How You’ll Contribute
Kaufman Rossin is seeking a VP of Platform Engineering to join our growing Information Technology team. In this role, you will lead the strategy, delivery, and governance of KR’s Platform Engineering function, including AI application development, Salesforce CRM, Azure and AWS cloud infrastructure, Microsoft 365, automation and application integration, M Files document management, and our global delivery team in Bengaluru.
Platform Engineering Leadership & Strategy
Define the technical roadmap for cloud platforms, DevOps, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and AI assisted engineering tools
Build, develop, and retain a high performing global engineering team across South Florida and Bengaluru
Manage the Platform Engineering budget, including headcount, cloud costs, tools, and vendor contracts
Lead transformational initiatives while fostering professional development, accountability, and strong performance AI Applications (Internal & Client-Facing)
AI Applications
Establish the AI use case roadmap, model selection strategy, and governance framework
Oversee the development of Azure based AI applications, including retrieval augmented generation, document intelligence, conversational agents, and client solutions
Ensure responsible AI practices through content filtering, data isolation, audit logging, and appropriate governance controls
Salesforce CRM
Provide strategic oversight of Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, and Experience Cloud
Partner with Marketing leadership to support campaign management, client engagement, and relationship strategies
Ensure Salesforce solutions align with business objectives, integration standards, and user needs
Azure and AWS Cloud Infrastructure
Lead cloud infrastructure strategy across Azure and AWS, including architecture, governance, security, and cost management
Oversee the migration from AWS to Azure and the transition from Citrix to Azure Virtual Desktop
Provide leadership across the Microsoft technology ecosystem, including Microsoft 365, Azure DevOps, Entra ID, Purview, and Sentinel
Automation and Application Integration
Lead KR’s automation capabilities across Automation Anywhere, UiPath, Power Automate, Workato, and MuleSoft
Define build, buy, and platform strategies that improve efficiency, scalability, and return on investment
Establish standards for application integration, automation governance, and solution delivery
M Files Document Management
Lead the technical implementation and ongoing development of M Files, including architecture, configuration, and integration with Salesforce and Azure
Ensure the platform supports the document management, audit, security, and compliance requirements of a CPA firm
Vendor and Stakeholder Management
Manage strategic relationships with Microsoft, Salesforce, AI providers, automation platforms, and other technology partners
Lead vendor evaluations, requests for proposals, proof of concept assessments, and technology recommendations
Collaborate closely with Infrastructure, Security, Data Insights, PMO, Operations, and business leaders
Communicate complex technical strategies clearly to executive, client, business, and technical audiences

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
About LeafLink
LeafLink is the largest unified B2B cannabis platform, providing licensed cannabis businesses a suite of tools to manage their business more effectively, sell or order from their favorite brands and accelerate growth. We are one platform, one solution and we’re defining the way thousands of cannabis brands, distributors, and retailers streamline their operations. With thousands of brands and retailers across 30+ markets in North America, we are setting the industry standard for how cannabis businesses grow together. LeafLink processes more than $5 billion in wholesale cannabis orders annually.
Our team, backed by funding from leading VC's, including Founders Fund, Thrive Capital, Nosara Capital, and Lerer Hippeau is poised to define the cannabis supply chain through technology. LeafLink was named one of Inc. 5000’s ‘Top 5000 Fastest-Growing Private Companies’; one of Fast Company's 'Top 10 Most Innovative Companies in Enterprise for 2020', joining the ranks of Amazon, Slack, and VMWare; one of Built In NYC's 'Best Places to Work in 2021'; 2024 Fast Company’s Best WorkPlaces for Innovators for Banking, Finance, and Fintech category; 2024 Green Market Report Award for Best Fintech in cannabis - and we're just getting started!
The Role
LeafLink is seeking a Head of Engineering to lead our entire engineering organization. This role owns the technical vision, architecture, and health of every engineering function and is accountable for how well our teams turn strategy into shipped, reliable software. You'll report directly into executive leadership, partner closely with Product, and represent engineering at the leadership table.
As Head of Engineering, you are the senior-most technical leader responsible for building the org itself: hiring and developing engineering managers, setting standards for how we plan and execute, and making the calls on architecture, tooling, and headcount that determine whether we can keep moving fast without breaking things. You'll work with modern technologies and concepts such as containerized and serverless design patterns, Python, Kubernetes, AWS-managed and self-hosted services, third-party integrations, and event-driven and distributed architectures. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just a roadmap, but the operating model of an engineering org at a pivotal size, big enough to need real structure, small enough that one leader can still touch everything that matters.
Ideal candidates possess a strategic mind for solving unique challenges with fitting solutions, and a track record of building high-performing teams and the managers who run them. They should be personable, decisive, flexible, and communicative, with a strong desire to implement change, grow the org thoughtfully, and bring a genuine passion for their craft. This role comes with the opportunity to define engineering leadership at a fast-paced, dynamic, and quickly growing company.
What You'll Be Doing
Translate company, product, and technology objectives and goals into a 1 - 3-year engineering plan, operating model, organizational structure, and execution roadmap. Lead rebuild versus refactor decisions related to platform enhancement and integration across all of our platforms
Create the right engineering organizational structure and lead the engineering team. Recruit, develop, and retain top engineering talent and set the bar for how the engineering team operates day to day
Set engineering-wide standards for planning, estimation, and delivery, and hold teams accountable to them without turning process into bureaucracy
Establish engineering metrics, operating rhythms, and governance that provide executive visibility into execution. Own and manage the technical architecture, infrastructure, security and technical debt speed and long-term stability.
Improve engineering velocity while reducing technical debt and operational risk.
Partner with product and business stakeholders to translate customer requirements into engineering priorities, ensuring engineering capacity, sequencing, and constraints are represented in roadmap decisions and the team delivers features that have measurable customer impact and move adoption., ensuring
Manage the engineering budget: headcount planning, vendor and tooling spend, and cloud cost, with a clear view of TCO
Establish company-wide engineering practices for code quality, testing, CI/CD, and on-call/incident response as the team scales past the size where informal norms hold
Own SOC 2 and broader security/compliance posture across engineering, partnering with IT and any external auditors
Create long-term sustainable mechanisms such as feedback loops, retros, postmortems, and eng-wide metrics for continuous improvement across performance, scale, delivery and org health.
Build and protect engineering culture as headcount grows: the norms around ownership, blameless problem-solving, and technical excellence that are easy to lose past 80 people
Champion agentic AI, LLM-powered code generation, and multi-agent orchestration to reimagine how services are built and operated at scale, compressing delivery timelines and raising engineering velocity.
What You'll Bring to the Team
12+ years of experience in software engineering, with 7+ years leading engineering managers (not just ICs)
Experience in working in marketplaces or enterprise platforms and building and developing large-scale infrastructure or distributed systems. Experience in e-commerce, B2B SaaS, or marketplace businesses (and their mobile counterparts) a plus
Direct experience building an engineering org from the ground up or through a major scaling inflection point, you've made the "when do we add a second team" calls before
Strong track record setting technical vision and translating it into a roadmap that executive leadership and the board actually trust
Strong balance of technical depth, strategic thinking, and operational leadership. Extensive experience communicating engineering strategy, risk, and resourcing to non-technical executives and board members
Proven experience building and scaling engineering organizations in high-growth or mission-critical environments balancing execution versus management
Hands-on background (even if not day-to-day anymore) with modern cloud-native architecture: AWS-managed services (EKS, ECR, R53, SES, ElastiCache, RDS, etc.), infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible), and containers (Docker, Kubernetes)
Experience owning security and compliance programs, including SOC 2 controls and audit management
Strong experience with CI/CD tooling and practices (Jenkins, CircleCI, ArgoCD, Spinnaker, or similar) and a point of view on developer experience
Experience with API management and service-oriented, API-driven architectures, and the operational challenges they create at scale
Proven ability to manage budget, vendor relationships, and cost efficiency for an engineering org
A genuine passion for developing people, you measure your success by the managers and engineers who grow under you
LeafLink Perks & Benefits
Flexible PTO - you’re going to be working hard so enjoy time off with no cap!
A robust stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in LeafLink’s success
5 Days of Volunteer Time Off (VTO) - giving back is important to us and we want our employees to prioritize cultivating a better community
Competitive compensation and 401k
Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision)
Commuter Benefits through our Flexible Spending Account
LeafLink’s employee-centric culture has earned us a coveted spot on BuiltInNYC’s Best Places to Work for in 2021 list. Learn more about LeafLink’s history and the path to our First Billion in Wholesale Cannabis Orders here.
Base salary range
$240,000—$270,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior Director of Machine Learning Engineering
jobs.text:
The CVO Tribe
CVO owns two of HelloFresh's largest economic levers: benefit optimization and pricing. The tribe uses machine learning, personalization, and lifetime-value prediction to replace manual, rules-based decisioning with data-driven systems.
The engineering org is globally distributed across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, and includes Frontend, Backend, Data, and ML Engineering, working closely with embedded Data Scientists. The work spans a genuinely mixed engineering profile: ML-heavy systems for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, alongside backend and distributed-systems work powering pricing infrastructure and subscription products at scale.
As Senior Director, based in Berlin, you'll lead this full spectrum, setting technical strategy across ML, backend, and data disciplines and across time zones, without relying on daily co-location.
What you'll do
Lead an organization of 25-30 engineers, data scientists, and ML practitioners across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, through a layer of Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers reporting into you.
Own ML strategy for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, as well as backend and distributed-systems strategy for pricing and subscription infrastructure.
Drive the transformation of ways of working toward fully GenAI-native, cross-functional product teams, building on teams that already ship the majority of their code with AI assistance.
Own reliability and operational excellence across both ML and backend systems: observability from model output through to customer-facing delivery, SLOs/SLIs, incident management, and MLOps practices such as retraining, rollback, and experiment tracking.
Partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and adjacent engineering teams to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage and develop Engineering Managers and Data Science Leads across disciplines and geographies, holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.
What you'll bring
Range across ML and backend engineering. You don't need to be hands-on expert in both, but you need credibility in each: enough ML depth to set direction on production ML systems and partner effectively with Data Science, enough distributed-systems depth to be a trusted partner on pricing infrastructure and subscription products.
Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.
Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.
Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.
AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.
Commercial and pricing domain fluency, or strong aptitude to build it quickly, including benefit optimization, lifetime-value forecasting, and pricing elasticity.
Proven leadership at scale: 12+ years in software/ML engineering, with 5+ years managing Engineering Managers across more than one technical discipline and geography.
Operational excellence mindset, with strong grounding in SRE and MLOps practices for systems with direct financial impact.
Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.
What we offer
Global collaboration across HelloTech's hubs in Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto.
High-leverage, technically diverse work spanning ML, backend, data, and product engineering, with a direct line to business outcomes.
A genuinely AI-native environment with a mandate to scale that approach further.
Technical and engineering leadership in an autonomous, product-led setup, with end-to-end ownership from problem definition to production.
Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.
Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).
Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.
Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.
Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).
Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.
Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&D budget (remove for interns).
Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.

blocks.text: The CVO Tribe

CVO owns two of HelloFresh's largest economic levers: benefit optimization and pricing. The tribe uses machine learning, personalization, and lifetime-value prediction to replace manual, rules-based decisioning with data-driven systems.

The engineering org is globally distributed across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, and includes Frontend, Backend, Data, and ML Engineering, working closely with embedded Data Scientists. The work spans a genuinely mixed engineering profile: ML-heavy systems for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, alongside backend and distributed-systems work powering pricing infrastructure and subscription products at scale.
As Senior Director, based in Berlin, you'll lead this full spectrum, setting technical strategy across ML, backend, and data disciplines and across time zones, without relying on daily co-location.
What you'll do

items: Lead an organization of 25-30 engineers, data scientists, and ML practitioners across Berlin, Warsaw, NYC, Boulder, and Toronto, through a layer of Engineering Managers and Staff Engineers reporting into you.
Own ML strategy for benefit recommendation, personalization, and customer lifetime-value forecasting, as well as backend and distributed-systems strategy for pricing and subscription infrastructure.
Drive the transformation of ways of working toward fully GenAI-native, cross-functional product teams, building on teams that already ship the majority of their code with AI assistance.

Own reliability and operational excellence across both ML and backend systems: observability from model output through to customer-facing delivery, SLOs/SLIs, incident management, and MLOps practices such as retraining, rollback, and experiment tracking.
Partner with Product, Data Science, Marketing, Finance, and adjacent engineering teams to align engineering priorities with business outcomes.
Manage and develop Engineering Managers and Data Science Leads across disciplines and geographies, holding them accountable for team health, delivery, and engineering standards.

Proven leadership of globally distributed teams across multiple countries and time zones, without daily co-location. Comfortable with regular travel and bridging US and European hours.
Deep ML engineering expertise, including feature engineering, training/serving infrastructure, experimentation, and MLOps. Causal inference or uplift modeling experience is a plus.
Distributed systems and backend depth, including scaling backend services and data pipelines in revenue-sensitive, high-throughput environments. Subscription or billing experience is a plus.
AI-native leadership, with a track record of building or scaling AI-native engineering practices, not just adopting AI tools.

Strong cross-functional communication, translating ML, data, and backend concepts into business terms and vice versa.
Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.

jobs.title: Director UX, Growth
jobs.text:
Director of UX, Growth
Location: Toronto or New York
Team: UX, Growth Mega-Alliance
Level: Director (people leadership). For the right person there's a clear path to Senior Director as the alliance scales.
Reports to: Global VP of UX
About HelloFresh
Our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. We're the world's leading meal-kit provider and a global digital-native FMCG company, reaching more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of brands, from HelloFresh and Factor to Green Chef, EveryPlate, Chefs Plate, YouFoodz, Good Chop, and The Pets Table. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.
About the role
We're looking for a Director of UX to lead the Growth experience end to end, across the brands in our portfolio, with HelloFresh and Factor the biggest. This is the team that owns how people discover our brands, sign up, get to their first great box, and keep coming back. Most funnels are something people endure. We want ours to be something they remember. Your job is to turn each step into a moment worth having, so the journey feels effortless, true to each brand, and sticky enough that people want to stay, and to grow the business while you do it.
You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and lead a team of 6 UX designers and collaborate closely with content design and research strategy. You set the quality bar for the alliance and work shoulder to shoulder with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering across web and app, and across 16 markets. You care about the numbers and the experience, and you know the best growth work improves both at once.
This is a hands-on leadership role, and a build-and-scale one rather than a maintenance one. You are exceptional at craft and stay close enough to the work to lead with credibility. You're also a visionary: you bring our brands to life and express them clearly across every touchpoint, and you have a strong feel for content and how words shape an experience. You're happy in ambiguity, and you'd rather write the playbook than follow one.
What you'll own
A funnel worth remembering. You lead the experience across the full customer journey: acquisition and activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation of lapsed customers. You do more than reduce drop-off and smooth out onboarding. You make each step sticky and memorable, so people feel something at sign-up, come back because they want to, and tell a friend. You give lapsed customers a real reason to return.
Experimentation and evidence. You run a team that tests its way to the answer. You treat behavioral data as a primary design input, not just something to validate a decision after the fact. You set clear hypotheses, design experiments and A/B tests with statistical rigor alongside data science, read the results honestly, and balance quick wins with the changes that compound over time.
Strategy before screens. You decide which problems are worth solving and why, and you tie design choices to the business outcomes this role is measured on, like conversion, activation rate, and retention [confirm the exact KPIs for this role]. You set direction before design work begins.
Craft and quality. You define what excellent looks like for Growth and hold the bar. You set a high standard for craft yourself and raise it in others, and you build and evolve the systems and patterns that let the team ship consistent, high-quality work at speed across web and app.
Brand expression. You bring our portfolio of brands to life, from HelloFresh and Factor to the rest, and give each a clear, distinct voice and look in the experience. You know how to hold what makes a brand itself while keeping the funnel coherent across all of them. You have a strong understanding of content and how design and words work together to express who each brand is.
Make us AI-native. You lead a team that treats AI as an active part of how the work gets done, from insight synthesis to rapid prototyping to the path from design to code. You define the quality bar AI-assisted work has to meet, and you help rewrite how growth experiences get built in the AI era. You are a driving force in this transformation, not a passenger, and you help your team see the shift as opportunity rather than threat.
A team of generalists. You lead a team of UX Designers with a generalist profile that move across design, content, research and code. You attract, develop, and retain strong talent, coach through feedback and influence rather than authority, and build a place where people do the best work of their careers.
What you bring
10+ years in product design, including experience leading and growing teams in a consumer (B2C) or product-led environment with a track record of moving metrics like activation, conversion, retention, and reactivation.
Exceptional craft. You are a top-tier designer who sets and holds a high bar, and you stay hands-on enough to lead with credibility and a visionary eye for the brand. You can bring distinct brands to life and express them clearly and consistently across an experience.
High agency. You push for the right solution over the convenient one and make things happen without waiting for permission.
AI-native practice. You already use AI across the design workflow, for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design to code, and you have a clear point of view on scaling it responsibly at a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma and Claude is expected, and you can show your team what excellent AI-assisted work looks like.
Strong data fluency. You read behavioral data and experiment results well, know what they are and aren't telling you, and use them to sharpen design, not just defend it. You're comfortable partnering with data science on experimentation quality.
Command of experimentation: hypothesis design, A/B testing, and funnel analysis as a connected system rather than isolated moments.
A partnership mindset with Growth product, marketing, lifecycle/CRM, and engineering. You navigate constraints with engineers and shape research and synthesis with researchers.
People leadership experience: building teams, coaching designers, and setting a quality bar others rally around.
Nice to have
Experience shaping cross-channel communication strategy across app, email, push, and web, so the message a customer gets is consistent and well-timed wherever they meet us.
Experience with pricing, packaging, or monetization design.
A track record building 0-to-1 growth systems, or fixing broken acquisition and retention loops.
What success looks like
Your team consistently ships high-quality growth work at speed, and the metrics move.
You've hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and judgment.
Experience quality across the funnel is visibly higher, and customers feel it.
Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.
AI-native ways of working in your domain make the whole team faster without giving up craft.
Each brand feels distinctly itself in the experience, while the funnel stays coherent across all of them.
What we offer
Scale and impact. Shape experiences for millions of customers across our brands and 16 markets.
A craft-and-AI-first culture, championed from the top of the organization.
Real ownership of your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.
A defined leadership track and the chance to grow your scope as the alliance scales.
Global collaboration with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech.
Compensation & Financial Wellbeing
Enjoy amazing discounts: 75% off weekly HelloFresh/Chefs Plate meal kits plus 50% off weekly Factor meal boxes.
Benefit from health and dental coverage from day one, a Health Spending Account, unlimited Headspace access, and 25% off GoodLife fitness memberships.
Access wellness resources including fitness discounts and mental health support.
Receive generous vacation and PTO offerings.
Benefit from a parental leave top-up program designed to support expectant parents.
Grow with dedicated L&D initiatives and career support, aligning with our "Learning Never Stops" value.
How we work
We're moving UX to work AI-native, and we expect our leaders to help drive that shift. You'll report directly to the Global VP of UX and partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders in the region.
Equal opportunity
We believe that sharing a meal brings people of all identities, backgrounds, and cultures together, and we're committed to celebrating every dimension of diversity in the workplace. We're an equal-opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic. We provide reasonable accommodations to candidates at any stage of the process. If you need one, please let us know.
Please note that for this position employees are eligible to equity on top of the base pay.
Toronto, ON Pay Range
$143,850—$153,850 CAD

jobs.title: Director, Field Engineering (CPG & Retail)
jobs.text:
REQ ID: FEQ427R375
Mission:
As the Director of Field Engineering, you will be responsible for partnering with our enterprise Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) and Retail customers to democratize Data and AI within their organizations, leveraging Databricks solutions and expertise to address their most critical business challenges.
Reporting to the Tech GM of Field Engineering for Retail & Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), the Director, Field Engineering will lead a team of pre-sales Managers and Solutions Architects focused on acquiring new customers and expanding strategic relationships across the Retail and CPG industry. You will work closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and executive stakeholders to drive strategy and execution against our ambitious growth goals.
You will foster a culture of psychological safety while developing and scaling a high-performing team with expertise in enterprise software, data engineering, analytics, AI/ML, and cloud technologies. Your experience partnering with Sales will help drive complex enterprise opportunities while coaching managers and field engineering teams to deliver exceptional customer outcomes. You will guide your team through strategic engagements, communicate complex technical solutions in terms of business value, support enterprise sales cycles, and build trusted relationships with senior business and technology leaders across the Retail and CPG industry.
The impact you will have:
Hire and manage first-line Managers and a growing team of technical pre-sales
Solutions Architects.
Build a collaborative culture within a rapid-growth team. Embody and promote
Databricks' customer-obsessed, truth-seeking, diverse culture, and first principles
mindset.
Develop trusted, long-term executive relationships with customers while maintaining a
deep understanding of the Retail and CPG industry, including key business trends,
competitive dynamics, and digital transformation priorities.
Help customers accelerate their Data and AI strategies across areas such as customer
experience, merchandising, supply chain, demand forecasting, marketing, and
operations.
Promote a solution- and value-based Field Engineering organization.
Display an understanding of customer business priorities and revenue opportunities
across the assigned region and industry.
Serve as a thought leader for Databricks and within the Retail, CPG, Data, and AI
ecosystem.
What we look for:
At least 3 years of second-line leadership experience managing teams of 30+
individuals, with 10+ years of overall leadership experience.
Proven success leading high-growth enterprise software pre-sales organizations
within Retail, CPG, cloud, data, analytics, or AI.
Experience partnering with Retail and/or CPG customers on large-scale data,
analytics, AI, or digital transformation initiatives.
Ability to elevate executive engagement, with a track record of driving large strategic
transactions and expanding high-growth enterprise accounts.
Proven leadership ability to influence, develop, and empower teams to achieve
ambitious business objectives through collaboration.
Drive operational rigor to manage a high-growth business, establishing the right
operating cadence while ensuring visibility into customer priorities, escalations, and
product feedback.
Proven track record of delivering transformational customer outcomes and
measurable business value.
Track record of building strong customer relationships and cross-functional
partnerships across Sales, Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success.
Experience positioning technical solutions within complex enterprise environments
and helping customers realize long-term value and platform adoption with Databricks.
Strong operational leadership with experience implementing scalable processes that
improve the effectiveness and productivity of technical field organizations.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or
equivalent practical experience.
About Databricks
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
Benefits
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
Compliance
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

jobs.title: Director Engineering
jobs.text:
About the role
Chime is looking for a Director of Engineering to lead our AI & App Experience (AAX) organization — the team building the next generation of the Chime member experience. AAX owns Jade, Chime’s AI-powered financial assistant, our AI platform infrastructure as well as the core app experiences and shared design system.
In this role, you’ll own the multi-quarter strategy for AAX engineering, translating company priorities into scalable plans across these teams. You’ll build and lead a bench of TLM (tech leader managers) and senior technical staff, set the technical bar for how Chime builds AI-native, member-facing products, and partner with Product, Design, Data Science, and our Risk team to shape where AAX invests next.
This is a role for a leader who is equally comfortable setting long-range technical vision and staying close enough to the details to guide hard architectural calls — someone who has helped build or scale AI/LLM-powered consumer products and knows how to grow the engineering leaders around them.
In this role, you can expect to
In partnership with our product team you will own the multi-quarter strategy for AAX engineering, translating company and product priorities into our roadmap plans across consumer facing AI experiences, AI Platform, App Journey, and Design Systems.
Build, lead, and hire a high-caliber leadership bench of highly technical leaders/IC’s as well as building a team culture that exemplifies a builder mindset.
Partners with your team to set technical direction for the org, driving architectural alignment across our consumer facing AI experiences, AI Platform, App Journey, and Design System.
You will continue to drive our AI-native engineering culture: setting the bar for how LLM-powered features get shipped safely at scale.
Own engineering’s strategic role in product direction, partnering with Product, Design, Data Science, and Risk leadership to shape roadmaps, challenge assumptions, and integrate platform and member value into long-range plans
Represent AAX and engineering more broadly in cross-functional and executive forums, connecting the org’s work to company-wide strategy and outcomes
Cultivate a high-performing culture across the org, modeling Chime’s values and ensuring strong talent, performance, and career development practices on every team
Ensure the org maintains strong operational practices — on-call, monitoring, and incident response — for every service/experience the team owns
Contribute to overall engineering initiatives as a member of Chime’s engineering leadership team
To thrive in this role, you have
10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing managers or leading multi-team engineering organizations
A track record of building and scaling AI/LLM-powered consumer products, with the technical depth to guide future investments and technical direction.
Experience hiring, developing, and retaining engineering leaders (TLM’s and Staff+ ICs), and building leadership pipelines and succession plans
Strong technical fundamentals across relevant parts of the stack (e.g., React Native, Python or Ruby on Rails, GraphQL, distributed systems) and the judgment to know where to go deep
Demonstrated ability to translate company and product strategy into multi-quarter engineering plans, and to adapt org design as priorities and scale evolve
Excellent executive communication skills — you can craft a compelling narrative that connects org strategy to business outcomes for senior leaders and cross-functional partners
Experience partnering closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and Risk/Compliance functions in a regulated or high-trust environment (fintech experience a strong plus)
AI-native fluency and a genuine interest in AI-native ways of working, with a track record of fostering that practice across teams rather than treating it as someone else’s job
The desire to make a huge difference at a growing company, and the ability to motivate teams through delivery on aggressive schedules and goals

A little about us
At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.
We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.
We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.
We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.
Because if we don't—who will?

🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.
💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.
✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.
🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off
🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice
👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses
👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents
👪 Access to family planning reimbursement
💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress
We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.
Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. jobs.title: Head of Product, Core Banking Systems
jobs.text:
About the opportunity
N26 is looking for a Head of Product - Core Banking Systems to partner with our Engineering, Treasury, Risk, and Banking Operations teams. In this role, you will own the Core Banking Systems product roadmap and lead a team of product & business managers delivering foundational capabilities that power N26 — from rapid product configuration to balance sheet infrastructure and regulatory reporting.
You will work at the intersection of Core Banking architecture, financial data integrity, and compliance on one side, and real-world banking and product challenges on the other. Your mission is to transform Core Banking Systems from a cost center into a composable platform that enables product managers to configure and launch products in days, embeds compliance by design, and lays the foundation for growth beyond N26. You will be the connective tissue between technical platform excellence and business outcomes, ensuring that our core engine powers flawless banking across N26 and eventually external financial institutions.
In this role, you will:
Own and drive the Core Systems product roadmap across Product Enablement (lending, deposits, payments gateway) and Balance Sheet Infrastructure (financial data products, treasury, books & accounting), balancing near-term execution with long-term strategic horizons.
Partner closely with N26 Product Segments and functional stakeholders across Treasury, Credit Risk, Risk Controlling, Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting on priorities, planning cycles, and shared OKRs.
Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle for Core Banking initiatives — from self-service product enablement and third-party vendor in-housing through migration, platform scalability, and iteration.
Define and roll out core platform best practices across the organization — including product configuration standards (Product Factory), ledger data integrity, evaluation frameworks, and progressive rollout guardrails.
Contribute to N26's company-wide strategy to establish single sources of truth for financial data, eliminate core vendor dependencies, and reduce risk concentration across endpoints.
Support domain optimization by transitioning stable, non-core services to appropriate segment owners while maintaining operational excellence and zero material audit findings.
Manage and develop a team of Core Systems Product Managers, fostering a culture of operational rigor, precision, and platform enablement.
Act as a trusted advisor to other Product & Tech teams looking to integrate with core banking engines, sharing best practices and enabling rapid go-to-market execution.
Manage stakeholder communication across Product, Engineering, Finance, Treasury, Risk, Compliance, and senior leadership.
Define and track domain KPIs that measure product enablement speed, system uptime, compliance metrics, OPEX cost savings, and balance sheet data integrity.
What you need to be successful:
5-7+ years of product management experience, with a significant portion focused on core banking systems, ledger infrastructure, payments, or core platform products.
Proven experience partnering with Core Banking and Platform Engineering experts — you understand how transaction processing, ledgers, and accounting engines work and know how to build scalable platform products.
Strong technical literacy — you understand backend platform trade-offs, core endpoint dynamics, multi-currency ledgers, and data pipelines, allowing you to engage credibly with engineering teams.
Data-driven mindset — comfort working with complex financial datasets, defining meaningful operational and compliance KPIs, and making decisions grounded in evidence.
Financial services experience required — familiarity with regulatory requirements, audit standards, compliance considerations, and the operational realities of banking.
Agile practitioner — experience managing multiple mission-critical workstreams in fast-paced, high-availability environments.
Excellent communication skills — the ability to translate complex technical and financial concepts for non-technical audiences and align diverse stakeholders around a shared vision.
Strong translator between worlds — you can bridge the gap between Core Infrastructure experts and Product/Business stakeholders in both directions, ensuring mutual understanding and aligned priorities.

jobs.title: Head of Platform Product
jobs.text:
About Us
Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Product Leader to join our technology leadership team, reporting directly to the CTO. This role will manage and grow the Platform Product organization and extend product ownership across the CTO-line platform product portfolio, including infrastructure-facing product lines such as AI platform, compliance infrastructure, financial cloud, and developer tooling.
This is a rare opportunity to shape the product strategy of a global crypto exchange at a pivotal inflection point — transitioning from a high-growth crypto-native platform to a regulated, AI-native financial institution.
What You'll Own
1. Platform Product Organization Leadership
Directly manage and develop the Platform Product Group — a 15+ person team spanning compliance site building, payments & assets, CRM, user/security/reach, personalization, and AI product lines
Drive team health, OKR quality, and delivery rigor across 10+ sub-teams and 200+ active requirements
Build a high-performance product culture: elevate product thinking from requirement-taking to systems-level ownership; enforce outcome-based OKRs over go-live checklists
Recruit, develop, and retain senior product talent; proactively manage succession and capability gaps
2. CTO-Line Platform Product Strategy
Own the product vision and roadmap for CTO-line platform product lines, including:
AI Platform (OpenClaw, AI Gateway, AI Sub-Account, Skills Marketplace, AI Coding infrastructure)
Financial Cloud / Compliance Infrastructure (self-service compliance platform, multi-jurisdiction site building, regulatory data export)
Developer Experience & Internal Tooling (BDOT, CI/CD product layer, AI-native R&D workflow)
Data & Intelligence Platform (knowledge distillation, MCP integration, personalization engine)
Translate CTO-level technical strategy into concrete product roadmaps with measurable business outcomes
3. AI-Native Product Transformation
Lead the platform product team's transition to AI-native product development — 100% AI documentation coverage, AI-assisted requirement analysis, and measurable AI efficiency gains
Define and drive the killing feature strategy for the AI agent platform: identify the user acquisition hook that converts infrastructure investment into real user growth
Own the product strategy for intelligent customer service evolution — from reactive article-linking to proactive, fully automated resolution (>80% resolution rate target)
What We're Looking For
Must Have
10+ years of product management experience, with at least 5 years in a senior product leadership role managing multi-team product organizations (20+ PMs)
Proven track record building and shipping platform/infrastructure products — not just consumer-facing features; experience with developer platforms, internal tooling, or B2B SaaS is highly valued
Strong systems thinking: ability to define product architecture, module catalogs, and API contracts — not just user stories
Experience operating in a regulated or compliance-heavy environment (fintech, banking, crypto, or equivalent); understanding of how regulatory requirements translate into product constraints and opportunities
Demonstrated ability to drive OKR quality — moving teams from go-live metrics to outcome-based measurement
Fluency in Chinese (Mandarin) — required for internal communication with engineering teams and business stakeholders
Strongly Preferred
Experience with AI product strategy — agent platforms, LLM-powered products, or AI infrastructure products
Background in financial services technology or crypto/Web3
Experience managing product teams through organizational restructuring or rapid scaling
Familiarity with multi-jurisdiction compliance product challenges (KYC/KYB, AML, regulatory data reporting, multi-site architecture)
Track record of defining and launching platform "killing features" — not just maintaining existing product lines
Leadership Profile
End-to-end ownership mindset: bridges customer pain points, product design, system architecture, data governance, compliance, and business outcomes — not a handoff-oriented PM
Prioritization discipline: can narrow scope to the top 5 problems and communicate a clear, credible plan rather than attempting to map everything simultaneously
Honest communicator: acknowledges unknowns directly; gives specific, actionable feedback to senior engineers and PMs
Builder, not coordinator: avoids absorbing accountability for all cross-team AI products without authority; focuses on creating genuine new product value
Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

jobs.title: Lead Manager/Associate Director, Strategy & Analytics (Bangkok-based, Relocation Provided)
jobs.text:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get To Know Our Team:
Strategy & Analytics is a fast-growing and dynamic team within the Strategic Partnerships department of Agoda. Strategic Partnerships is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s non-accommodation partners and promote Agoda’s top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. The Strategy & Analytics team’s scope includes profitability optimization, target setting, KPI management, data analytics, and business strategy.
The Opportunity:
As Lead Manager / Associate Director – Strategy & Analytics, you will lead the data strategy and governance of one of Booking Holdings' most critical initiatives, defining how Agoda, Booking.com, and Priceline collectively measure, interpret, and act on business performance.
Within Booking Holdings, an enhanced and more connected B2B business is being built consolidating the businesses of Booking.com, Priceline and Agoda into a single global division (“New B2B Business”)
You will own a high-visibility, cross-brand program that goes far beyond data management. This initiative shapes how the company defines growth, evaluates profitability, and allocates resources across its portfolio of businesses, with the work you deliver directly informing decisions at the highest levels of the organization.
If you are energized by impact and ready to build something that truly matters, this role is for you.
What You’ll Do:
Lead the design and implementation of a unified data strategy and measurement framework across Agoda, Booking.com, and Priceline, establishing a single source of truth for how the New B2B Business defines, tracks, and acts on performance
Own the data harmonization roadmap from scoping through phased delivery, ensuring alignment on definitions, metrics, and data logic across three distinct brand organizations with differing systems and conventions
Analyze and translate complex data into actionable insights that drive business strategy and enable strategic decision-making
Build and develop a high-performing global team of analysts by setting strategic direction, establishing quality standards, and creating an environment where the team operates with clarity, accountability, and ambition
Collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional global teams across Analytics, Product, Tech, Finance, Legal, etc., to execute on strategic initiatives
Keep leadership informed and aligned by providing rigorous reporting and analysis on strategic initiatives, communicating progress, risks, and recommendations in a clear and structured manner to support data-driven decision-making at the Executive level
Required Qualifications:
7+ years of total professional experience in an analytically rigorous environment; prior experience at a top-tier management consulting firm with demonstrated progression and impact is strongly preferred
Proven experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder projects, owning timelines, deliverables, and executive reporting
A track record of independently structuring and solving complex, ambiguous problems
Strong data literacy and business numeracy, genuinely comfortable interrogating business metrics, evaluating data logic, and translating numbers into meaningful business insights
Prior experience managing and developing a team, with the ability to lead across geographies and functions
Exceptional Executive communication and presentation skills, able to distill complex, nuanced topics into clear, compelling, and actionable narratives
A high-ownership mindset, comfortable with ambiguity, energized by fast-moving environments, and fully accountable for outcomes
Preferred Qualifications:
Proficiency in SQL or data querying tools
Proficiency in Tableau or equivalent BI and visualization platforms
A degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative discipline; an MBA or advanced degree from a top-tier institution is a meaningful plus
Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click here to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.
Discover more about working at Agoda

We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. jobs.title: Head of Product Security
jobs.text:
Our Story
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com!
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces.
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife
The Team
Product Security sits within Information Security and works closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Platform and Risk. The function enables teams across Zopa to deliver change while managing Product Security risk and protecting the bank and its customers. As Head of Product Security, you'll lead the function through its next stage of maturity, setting the multi-year direction, scaling the operating model and helping Zopa respond to a security landscape increasingly shaped by cloud technology, automation and AI.
