jobs.title: Design Director, Brand
jobs.text:
About AlphaSense:
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
Location: New York or San Francisco preferred, open to remote within the US
About the Team:
The AlphaSense Brand Team is a creative powerhouse composed of great talent across copywriting, brand design, advertising & filmmaking. This team of creative technologists help drive the innovation, conceptual storytelling, execution & delivery of our brand and products each & every day. At our core, we're here as a partner to the broader business – which we do by identifying customer problems, understanding market needs, & inventing ways to deliver world class brand experiences.
About the Role:
As the Design Director on the AlphaSense Brand & Creative team, you own the strategic and conceptual pull-through of our brand — translating who AlphaSense is into ideas, design systems, and experiences that show up everywhere the company does. You set the creative vision and the standard of craft for the design discipline, and you're a leader-doer: you direct from inside the work, getting your hands on it when an idea demands it. This is a defining moment for the brand. As the market shifts from an information economy to a reasoning economy, it's racing toward a shortcut — assuming that wiring a model up to more tools and more sources adds up to intelligence. AlphaSense exists to prove otherwise: access isn't intelligence, and the question that matters isn't “Can it connect?” but “Can I trust it?” You'll be the one who makes that argument — connected isn't intelligent — look and feel as undeniable as the platform makes it true.
This role is equal parts vision and craft, leadership and making. You'll shape the creative direction for our most significant brand investments — campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — then build the team and systems that let that work scale without losing its edge. You'll mentor and grow the design team alongside the Design Manager, while partnering across PMM, Product, Web, and Comms, and directing agency and production partners, to align stakeholders behind brave ideas. Your north star: take the highest-stakes ideas in enterprise intelligence — trust, evidence, judgment under pressure — and make them clear, human, and impossible to ignore.
Who You Are
A Proven Creative Leader: 10+ years in brand and creative design, with a portfolio that shows range across campaigns, brand systems, and high-craft execution — and a track record of leading teams to do the best work of their careers.
A Leader-Doer: You set the vision and the bar, but you stay in the work. You direct from inside it and get hands-on when an idea needs your hand — not from a distance.
Ideas-First: You lead with concept. You can take an abstract, technical idea — like enterprise market intelligence — and find the visual metaphor that makes it land for a sophisticated audience.
A Builder of Teams & Culture: You've managed and mentored designers (including through other managers), shaped roles, grown careers, and cultivated a creative culture of transparency, connectedness, and inspiration.
A Systems Thinker: You think in systems and scale — building design languages and ways of working that keep the brand consistent as it grows while still leaving room to surprise.
A Trusted Cross-Functional Partner: You build deep relationships across PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms, influence senior stakeholders, and can win support and alignment for ambitious, high-stakes work.
Fluent in Complex & Enterprise Storytelling: You've made technical, B2B, or otherwise “dry” subject matter feel anything but boring, ideally for expert or executive audiences.
Strategically Grounded: You balance creative ambition with clarity, strategy, and business outcomes, and you thrive in a fast-moving environment with evolving priorities and a fair amount of ambiguity.
What You’ll Do:
Help Drive the Design Vision: Define and evolve the creative direction for the AlphaSense brand across campaigns, product storytelling, OOH, social, web, and events — ensuring a cohesive, elevated, unmistakably-AlphaSense expression at every touchpoint.
Lead Idea-Centric Work: Drive the strategic and conceptual pull-through of big ideas from brief through execution, setting the bar for craft and originality on our most visible, highest-stakes brand investments.
Hands-On: The team is lean, so using your own design thinking and execution to make the work when the moment calls for it is imperative — you direct from inside the work, not from a distance.
Build & Grow the Team: Lead, mentor, and develop the brand design team in partnership with the Design Manager — shaping roles, raising the craft bar, growing careers, and keeping morale and creative culture high.
Partner Across Functions: Build deep, productive relationships across creative functions (copy, art direction, production, film) as well as marketing functions (PMM, Product, Web/Growth, and Comms) and lead agency and production partners when the time calls for it — aligning stakeholders and securing support to move ambitious work forward.
Evolve the System: Develop and steward the AlphaSense design system and visual language so the brand scales with consistency while still leaving room to surprise.
Push Product Integration: Find innovative ways to bring the product into the brand story, demonstrating the full creative potential of the platform.
Develop Deep Product & Market Fluency: Build a thorough understanding of the AlphaSense platform, our customers, and the broader B2B enterprise landscape so the work reflects real product value, use cases, and buyer context — not just surface-level aesthetics.
For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.
You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.
Base Compensation Range
$160,000—$200,000 USD
AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.
In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.
Recruiting Scams and Fraud
We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:
AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.
If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering - Developer Experience & Platform (f/m/d)
jobs.text:
Head of Engineering - Developer Experience & Platform
Awin is seeking an exceptional engineering leader to shape the future of how our engineers build, ship, and operate software at scale. As Head of Engineering – Developer Experience & Platform, you will own the end-to-end developer experience strategy, drive the adoption of AI-native engineering practices, modernise our cloud platform, and lead the teams and tooling that enable Awin's engineering organisation to work at its best.
This is a high-impact leadership role at the intersection of engineering excellence, platform strategy, and AI innovation. You will define and deliver the developer experience (DevEx) vision for Awin, ensuring our engineers have the tools, environments, processes, and culture to be highly productive and deeply satisfied in their work. You will own our platform strategy on AWS, lead FinOps practices, and spearhead the organisation-wide rollout of AI-augmented and agentic development workflows.
You will act as a trusted internal champion for engineers – gathering data-driven insight, translating it into organisation-wide improvements, and working hand-in-hand with engineering leadership, product, and stakeholders to make change happen and allow our Product teams to deliver value to our customers at scale.
The right candidate has strong hands-on experience with modern AI-driven software development and building developer-centric cloud platforms at scale. This is a senior but hands-on role within the Engineering organisation, reporting to the Director of Engineering.
Key Tasks & Responsibilities
Developer Experience Strategy & Tooling
Own and evolve Awin's Developer Experience programme – defining the vision, strategy, and roadmap for DevEx improvement across the engineering organisation
Identify friction points, productivity blockers, and systemic inefficiencies through data, qualitative research, and direct engagement with engineering teams, other Heads of Engineering or Engineering Managers
Drive organisation-wide improvements to technology, tooling, and engineering processes, building consensus and alignment with key stakeholders across product, engineering, security, and operations.
Establish and track DevEx metrics and KPIs (e.g. DORA metrics, developer satisfaction scores), using them to demonstrate impact and guide investment decisions.
Own the developer tools portfolio and associated budgets – evaluating, procuring, and retiring tools to ensure engineers have best-in-class tooling without unnecessary cost or complexity.
Lead strategic assessment and rollout of new developer tooling, including CI/CD platforms, IDE capabilities, code quality and security tools.
AI-Native Development & Agentic Workflows
Lead Awin's AI engineering rollout – defining the strategy for AI-native software development, establishing standards, and scaling adoption across the engineering organisation.
Evaluate and implement AI-augmented development tools including AI coding assistants, agentic development environments, automated code review, test generation, and intelligent CI/CD pipelines.
Champion modern AI-native software development best practices and drive continuous evaluation of the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape.
Design and deliver enablement programmes – training, communities of practice, documentation, and hands-on workshops – to accelerate AI fluency and confidence across engineering teams.
Measure and report on the impact of AI adoption on developer productivity, code quality, and time-to-market.
Cloud Platform Optimisation
Lead the strategy and execution of cloud platform standardisation across Awin's AWS estate, establishing golden paths, reference architectures, and platform abstractions that improve developer experience and reduce cognitive load.
Drive cloud migration efforts, infrastructure modernisation initiatives, partnering with Product teams to improve reliability, scalability, observability, and security posture (including platform-wide Incident Management, SRE
Own AWS cost management and FinOps practices – establishing budgeting frameworks, implementing cost allocation and tagging strategies, identifying and acting on optimisation opportunities, and providing transparent reporting to leadership.
Build out internal developer platform capabilities to abstract cloud complexity and accelerate developer self-service.
Ensure cloud platform decisions are made with developer experience as a primary consideration alongside cost efficiency, security, and scalability.
Leadership & Organisational Impact
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team spanning developer experience, platform engineering, and tooling functions.
Act as a collaborative, influential engineering leader, shaping Awin's technical culture, engineering standards, and ways of working.
Contribute to the engineering leadership team, participating in strategic planning, headcount discussions, and broader organisational design.
Skills & Experience
Significant experience in and passion for software engineering, with hands-on coding background in one or more major languages (e.g. Java, TypeScript).
Strong understanding of AI-native software development – including AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot), agentic development workflows, and LLM-integrated toolchains.
Proven leadership experience in developer experience, platform engineering, developer productivity, or a related engineering leadership role within a mid-to-large scale technology organisation.
Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, engineering best practices, and what makes engineering teams highly productive.
Demonstrable experience leading and improving CI/CD practices, deployment pipelines, and developer tooling ecosystems.
Strong background in AWS – comfortable with infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), container platforms, serverless patterns, and cloud-native architectures.
Experience with FinOps or cloud cost management, including budgeting, tagging strategies, and cost optimisation at scale.
Track record of successfully delivering organisation-wide change programmes in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders.
Experience designing and using developer experience metrics frameworks (e.g. DORA, SPACE, DX Core 4) to measure and improve developer productivity.
Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and grow engineering teams in a fast-paced, distributed environment.
Strong commercial awareness – experience managing budgets, building business cases, and making tool and investment decisions with clear ROI thinking.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery; comfortable operating from vision through to execution.
Experience working in global, distributed engineering organisations across multiple time zones and cultures.
Our Offer
Flexi-Week: We prioritise your mental health and wellbeing by offering you a four-day Flexi-Week (with one lighter or completely disconnected day per week) at full pay, with no reduction to your annual holiday allowance.
Flexi-office: We offer an international culture and flexibility through our hybrid/remote working scheme which is designed to foster a culture of mutual trust and working flexibility.
Work Expense Contribution & Remote Working Furniture: You will receive a monthly allowance to cover part of your running costs, as well as a furniture package to support you in setting up a comfortable workspace when working from home.
Health and Wellbeing: With our support and access to various initiatives and sports offers, you can focus on your mental and physical wellbeing.
Development: We’ve built our extensive training suite, Awin Academy, to cover a wide range of skills that support your professional and personal growth, with trainings conveniently packaged to help your overall development.
Appreciation: Thank and reward colleagues by sending them a voucher through our peer-to-peer recognition programme.
We are hiring in multiple countries for this role. Additional benefits, including health and wellbeing offerings, will be discussed during the initial interview.
Established in 2000, Awin is proud of our dynamic, social and inclusive culture.
Like all businesses, we’ve had to adapt and nurture our culture in a virtual environment. Our virtual ‘Life @ Awin’ hub brings our colleagues from across the globe together for various social activities.
Diversity & Inclusion are paramount to us, and we proudly pursue and hire diverse team members. We champion uniqueness and authenticity; this is who we are at our core. Our network of affiliate partnerships are diverse and transparent, as are the employees powering our vision to build the world’s leading open partner ecosystem. We welcome all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. If you need support at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.
Awin is part of the Axel Springer group. Learn more at axelspringer.com/en/, and explore the Axel Springer Essentials here: axelspringer.com/en/inside/the-essentials-what-we-have-adapted-and-why
Apply now to begin the next stage of your career at a progressive company that supports both your professional and personal development.

jobs.title: Design System Director (x/f/m)
jobs.text:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!
We are looking for a Head of Design Systems to join the Brand and Design team at Doctolib.
Your mission will be to ensure every Doctolib product surface is built on a consistent, high-quality design foundation. You will own Oxygen, Doctolib's design system - much more than a component library. Oxygen is how we deliver our brand identity consistently throughout the product and the critical infrastructure that ensures design quality at scale across an AI-first development environment. With over 50 designers and engineers building across multiple markets and product surfaces, your work will directly shape the experience of more than 90 million patients and 400,000 healthcare professionals.
Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.
What you'll do
Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:
Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for Oxygen, connecting the dots across engineering, design, and brand teams. Translate system health into business impact and own the investment strategy for the teams, tools, and governance that support it.
Establish cross-functional governance across Design, Product, Engineering, and Brand teams, defining contribution models, change management processes, and the standards other teams are expected to follow.
Own design output quality across the product, ensuring that AI-generated interfaces are coherent, consistent, and on-brand at every touchpoint across the company.
Define and drive cross-organizational adoption, measuring adoption rate, component coverage, and contribution velocity, and connecting those metrics to product team speed and quality.
Manage and grow a team of designers, product people and engineers, setting career paths, a high bar for craft, and hiring for the roles the system needs next.
Who you are
Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.
You'll be a great fit if you:
Have 10+ years of experience in product design or design systems, with a proven track record of scaling a mature, complex system across multiple product teams or lines of business
Bring engineering fluency: you understand the technical architecture of a design system, how platform teams operate, and the latest best practices in AI-first software engineering as it relates to design systems
Have demonstrated senior stakeholder management skills, with the ability to negotiate priorities with leadership at Director level and above across large, distributed organizations, and drive change management at scale
Take a data-informed and outcome-oriented approach: you measure system health in real metrics (adoption rate, handoff defect rate, contribution velocity) and connect those numbers to product quality and business outcomes
Have experience in a regulated, enterprise, or healthcare-adjacent context where accessibility (WCAG), localization (i18n, RTL), and multi-market constraints are critical to design systems
Are fluent in English
It would be fantastic if you:
Have experience owning large-scale change management programs across cross-functional organizations
Speak additional European languages, such as French, German, or Italian
Life at Doctolib Tech
Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.
Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.
Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.
What we offer
A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib
28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)
Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz
Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)
The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more
Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth
Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club
A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode
Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit
For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
Relocation support in case of international mobility
Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training
Our interview process
Recruiter Interview
Portfolio Review
Design System Live Case
Behavioral Interview
At least one reference check
We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.
Job details
Permanent position
Full-time
Paris or Berlin
Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)
Start date: as soon as possible
We welcome everyone
At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.
The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.
To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.
Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

jobs.title: Head of Data & AI
jobs.text:
About Burq
Burq started with an ambitious mission: to turn the complex process of offering delivery into a simple, turnkey solution. It’s a big mission, and now we want you to join us in making it even bigger. 🚀
We’re proud to be recognized as one of Fast Company’s Best Workplaces for Innovators and a 2025 Inc. Magazine Power Partner, awards that highlight how we’re redefining the future of logistics while empowering our partners to grow.
Backed by leading Silicon Valley investors like Village Global, the fund whose investors include Bill Gates, Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg, Reid Hoffman, and Sara Blakely, we’ve built a world-class team across the globe.
We operate at scale but remain small enough for every person to have a massive impact. There’s a lot of important work ahead, and joining Burq means the opportunity to grow faster than ever while doing the most meaningful work of your career.
Here’s a quick overview of what you will be doing:
The Role
We're looking for a Head of Data & AI to build the intelligence that powers Burq.
You'll build a world-class data-and-ML platform: the systems that turn data into models which make every delivery decision smarter and agents that automate the work the industry still does by hand. You'll set the strategy, make the hard architecture and modeling calls, ship models into production that move the business, and build the team to do it at scale.
This is a player-coach role. You'll lead and grow the data and ML team while staying deeply hands-on — making architecture calls, reviewing engineering and modeling work, and ensuring the platform serves both product and business goals. You'll partner closely with the Head of Engineering, and with product and AI leadership on how intelligence shows up in the product.
What You'll Do
Data Platform
Own the full data platform — the warehouse, streaming and batch ingestion, the semantic layer, and BI infrastructure.
Define and enforce data governance — access management, quality standards, and a well-modeled, trustworthy "gold" layer.
Make the warehouse the source of truth for operational, product, and financial analytics.
Intelligence & Machine Learning
Build the models that power delivery intelligence — forecasting, prediction, optimization, matching/allocation, and reliability scoring that turn our data into better real-time decisions.
Stand up the ML systems that make this real and reliable: feature pipelines, training, serving, evaluation, and drift monitoring.
Design the learning loop — instrument decisions and outcomes so models continuously improve.
Drive the AI agent initiative to production, partnering with product and engineering on the surrounding workflows.
Team & Stakeholders
Manage and grow the data and ML team (starting from a small core) — hire data engineers, analytics engineers, and data scientists/ML engineers as the platform matures.
Establish a clear intake process for ad hoc data requests so the team works from a roadmap, not in reactive mode.
Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Finance on data-driven analyses and decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product Management (Card)
jobs.text:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
Affirm is building the next generation of consumer finance, and the Affirm Card sits at the center of that vision—blending debit, pay-over-time, and network-native experiences into a single product.
We’re looking for a Senior Director of Product to lead the Affirm Card and Card Platform—owning both the end-user experience, the business outcomes of every card product, and the underlying platform that powers card issuance, authorization, servicing, and partner integrations.
This is a pillar-level leadership role responsible for defining strategy, building a high-performing team, and delivering durable business outcomes across one of Affirm’s most strategic product areas.
What you’ll do
Own the Card domain end-to-end
Define and drive the multi-year vision for Affirm Card across consumer experience, growth, and economics, inclusive of new card products that complement the one we have in market today.
Lead the US direct to consumer card products (Affirm Cards, and in app virtual cards)
Oversee our Card Platform (authorization, ledgering, servicing, controls) which powers the D2C products both domestically and internationally, along with a number of merchant and partner integrations.
Translate company strategy into a coherent roadmap spanning multiple teams and systems
Build and scale a high-performing product organization
Manage and develop a team of PMs and PM leaders
Establish product standards, operating cadence, and decision frameworks
Build a durable org that delivers high-quality outcomes without direct involvement in every decision
Drive business outcomes at scale
Own GMV, engagement, unit economics, and credit outcomes for the Card domain
Shape investment strategy, tradeoffs, and resource allocation across multiple product areas
Partner with Finance and Credit to optimize profitability and risk
Lead platform strategy and execution
Drive platform capabilities that unlock velocity across Affirm (APIs, controls, servicing systems)
Partner deeply with Engineering to make cost vs. value tradeoffs at the system level
Ensure the Card Platform scales reliably across use cases, geographies, and partners
Operate as a cross-functional leader
Align senior stakeholders across Engineering, Design, Credit, Legal, Partnerships, and GTM
Build strong relationships with external partners (networks, processors, wallet providers)
Represent the Card domain in executive forums and company planning cycles
What we look for
Product leadership at scale
15+ years in product management, with experience leading multi-team product areas or platforms
Track record of owning large domains or business lines with meaningful financial impact
Org-building capability
Experience managing managers and building high-performing PM teams
Proven ability to create systems, processes, and culture that scale
Strategic and systems thinker
Ability to operate at portfolio-level altitude—connecting product decisions to company strategy
Strong judgment across second- and third-order tradeoffs, especially in complex systems
Platform + fintech depth
Experience in payments, cards, fintech, or adjacent infrastructure
Comfort working on both consumer-facing products and backend platforms
Execution and influence
Ability to drive alignment across senior stakeholders and functions
Strong product instincts paired with rigorous, data-driven decision-making
Why this role matters
Affirm Card is one of the fastest-growing parts of the business and a key driver of long-term differentiation. This role will shape:
How Affirm shows up every day in consumers’ wallets
How we blend debit, credit, and pay-over-time into one experience
The platform foundation that enables future financial products
Pay Grade - V
Equity Grade - 21
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)
USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $340,000 - $375,000
USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $305,000 - $340,000
#LI-Remote
Remote-first with flexibility built in
Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.
Benefits designed for you
Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:
Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.
We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.
For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.
By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Director, Product Management
jobs.text:
At Dragos, the mission is personal. The systems we protect deliver the water you drink, power your home, and keep the hospitals your community depends on running. Those critical infrastructure systems that power our civilization around the world are under attack every day by adversaries. When those systems fail, people are immediately at risk. We are the global leader in xOT cybersecurity, combining technology, threat intelligence, and expert services. The people here chose this work because they understand what is at stake. Here, you will find a remote-first mission-driven team across North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC built on authenticity, transparency, and trust. If safeguarding the systems that protect your family, friends, and community is the kind of work that matters to you, you are in the right place.
About the Role:
The Director of Product Management leads a portfolio of core OT cybersecurity products that protect critical infrastructure, where precision isn't a preference, it's a requirement. Reporting to the VP of Product, this role owns strategy and delivery across multiple product areas while building and developing a high-performing team of product managers.
This leader drives customer-centric roadmaps and translates vision into measurable outcomes that perform in the field. You will partner closely with Engineering, Sales, Customer Experience, Threat Intelligence, and Marketing to ensure Dragos delivers differentiated, high-impact products that solve critical customer problems globally. You will champion customer advocacy and ensure your team is deeply embedded in discovery, delivery, and ongoing iteration across the portfolio.
Experience building world-class cybersecurity products, including asset identification and discovery, threat detection, MDR, and XDR is required.
Additionally, the Director of Product Management will champion the integration of AI technologies to enhance cybersecurity outcomes, leveraging advanced analytics and automation to address emerging threats and drive innovation across the portfolio.
OT market experience is strongly preferred.
Responsibilities:
Own product strategy execution across all assigned areas of the Dragos Platform portfolio, with clear accountability for customer, business, and execution outcomes.
Own the product strategy and execution for capabilities that feed the Dragos Intelligence Fabric, spanning OT telemetry ingestion, adversary research, vulnerability intelligence, and asset data, ensuring these inputs continuously improve the quality, speed, and accuracy of insights surfaced across the Dragos Platform and services.
Lead, mentor, and develop a team of product managers; set a high bar for rigor, accountability, and craft while actively investing in individual growth.
Partner with customers, design partners, and internal stakeholders to identify high-value problems and deliver solutions with measurable impact.
Embed customer discovery and product validation throughout the entire product lifecycle.
Represent the voice of the customer in strategic planning sessions and cross-functional forums with credibility and precision.
Partner with Engineering leadership to prioritize delivery and drive high-quality, on-time execution.
Drive go-to-market readiness in collaboration with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Experience, including launches, POCs, and customer enablement.
Build a culture of outcome-driven product management where success is defined by customer and business results, rather than activity.
Monitor market trends, competitive intelligence, and regulatory developments within the OT cybersecurity market to inform strategy and prioritization.
Qualifications:
10+ years of enterprise-scale B2B cybersecurity product management or equivalent experience, including 4+ years in a people management role.
Enterprise software, cybersecurity or OT/ICS industry experience is required.
Experience owning or managing cybersecurity product areas spanning MDR/XDR, threat intelligence, and cloud/SaaS delivery.
Experience shipping AI- or ML-powered product capabilities, including working with data science teams to translate model outputs into user-facing features, is desired.
Experience in bringing new products to market for Global 2000 organizations and multiple geographies.
Proven ability to mentor and grow high-performing product managers.
Strong background in customer discovery, strategic prioritization, and cross-functional alignment.
Experience working with customers, Sales, Customer Experience, and User Experience to gather requirements and use cases to design and iterate on product capabilities.
Experience with customers in critical infrastructure sectors (e.g., electric, oil & gas, manufacturing) is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to define and track product KPIs, use data to drive prioritization decisions, and communicate outcomes in business terms.
Proven ability to communicate product strategy and outcomes to senior leadership and external stakeholders, including presenting roadmaps and business cases.
Willingness to travel (~15%) for customer meetings, conferences, or company events.
Compensation:
Salary: $275,000
Competitive Equity Package
Comprehensive Benefits Plan
#LI-LF1 #LI-REMOTE

All new hires must pass a background check as a condition of employment.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity
jobs.text:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.
An overview of this role
As Director, Engineering, Platform Operations & Productivity, you'll own three functions that all require hands-on technical depth, not just people management.
Platform Staff is a small, senior, AI-native team that moves to wherever the organization needs the most leverage, from standing up early scaffolding for an initiative, to taking on a high-impact customer request that doesn't fit any existing team's charter, to stepping directly into a production crisis until it's resolved.
This role is for a technical engineering director who has personally built distributed systems, not only managed people who did. You'll use clear metrics, strong operating rhythms, and direct technical judgment so these teams deliver predictable outcomes without relying on one-person heroics.
What you’ll do
Own outcomes for Git & Gitaly Operations, including hiring and developing the Manager, Git & Gitaly Operations, and holding the function to its reliability bar across Self-Managed, GitLab Dedicated, and SaaS.
Own outcomes for Nonlinear Productivity, also known as Friction Elimination, including hiring and developing the Manager, Nonlinear Productivity, and holding the function to measurable metric movement rather than activity.
Build and oversee Platform Staff directly as a small, senior team that uses AI-assisted tools as a standard part of its work.
Assess, case by case, what Platform Staff picks up, such as a new team that needs bootstrapping, a customer request too specific for any existing team's charter, or a crisis that needs someone in the room immediately.
Assess when Platform Staff should hand work off to a permanent team once it's stable.
Set the technical bar across all three functions by personally reviewing distributed systems designs, friction-elimination fixes, and crisis management plans with equal depth.
Build the operating rhythm and metrics that keep all three functions running predictably, so none of them relies on any one person working unsustainable hours.
Represent all three functions to peer engineering stakeholders, and step in front of customers directly when Platform Staff is engaged mid-crisis.
What you’ll bring
Working knowledge of GitLab's development workflows and platform capabilities so you can assess productivity friction, operational trade-offs, and team needs in context.
Hands-on experience designing and shipping distributed systems personally, not only through teams you've managed.
A track record running highly effective engineering operations, including production reliability and incident management, at meaningful scale.
A track record driving measurable engineering productivity improvements across more than one team or organization.
Experience with AI-assisted development tools, and sound judgment about when they help a small team do work that would otherwise require a larger team.
People management experience across multiple managers or functions at once.
Ability to context-switch effectively across genuinely different problem types, including infrastructure operations, developer productivity, and ad hoc crisis response, sometimes in the same week.
A track record making staffing decisions that keep a high-leverage team intentionally small, and building alignment around those decisions rather than growing the team by default.
About the team
We work across three connected platform and productivity functions. Through Git & Gitaly Operations, we are responsible for the production reliability of the infrastructure layer underneath GitLab's own version control system. Through Nonlinear Productivity, we drive measurable improvements to GitLab's software development lifecycle and code-generation workflows. Through Platform Staff, we provide focused senior engineering capacity for high-leverage work that needs direct ownership before it can be stabilized or handed off to a permanent team.
Collectively, we help GitLab improve the reliability, productivity, and responsiveness of the platform that powers how our customers and GitLab team members build software.
How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees
Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
Flexible Paid Time Off
Team Member Resource Groups
Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
Growth and Development Fund
Parental Leave
Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.
Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.
GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

jobs.title: Director, AI & Data Science
jobs.text:
About the job
Do you think like a management consultant, thrive in a startup environment, and can’t stop thinking about the intersection of data, technology, and marketing?
With over 2000 employees, offices on five continents, and world-class clients like Samsung, L’Oreal, and Mattel, Artefact is a consulting firm that transforms data into value and business impact. We’ve recently launched in the US with offices located in NYC and Los Angeles, and we want you to join us as an integral part of our founding team!
Who We Are
Founded and headquartered in Paris, Artefact is a next-generation consulting firm, specializing in data, analytics & AI consulting, dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organizations. We are proud to say that we help our clients grow their data and digital capabilities, and that we’re also growing in parallel.
We have 2000 employees across 36 offices who are focused on accelerating digital transformation. Our state-of-the-art data technologies, lean AI agile methodologies, and cohesive teams of the finest business consultants, data analysts, data scientists, data engineers, and digital experts are all dedicated to bringing extra value to every client. We design data-based solutions to meet our clients' specific needs, always conceived with a business-centric approach and delivered with tangible results. Our data-driven services are built upon the deep AI expertise we've acquired with our 1000+ client base around the globe.
Find out more at artefact.com.
What you will be doing
You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.
AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.
Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.
Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.
Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.
Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.
Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.
Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.
What we are looking for
The ideal candidate has a substantial Data Science and machine learning background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.
Expertise in generative AI/LLM engineering (context engineering, agent harnesses, RAG, and fine-tuning) and in classical machine learning modeling, with proven production deployments.
Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, engineering, statistics/mathematics, or a related field.
Hands-on command of core machine learning libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.), agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), and fine-tuning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).
Experience building fine-tuning pipelines end to end: training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment.
Solid grasp of AI system design: ML model lifecycle (MLOps), agents, tool use, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, and observability.
Deep experience with Google Gemini Enterprise / Vertex AI; basic working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock.
Experience leading and growing engineering teams, and supporting pre-sales: proposals, demos, and solution scoping with clients.
Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating across teams and with stakeholders.
Strong business acumen with an interest in business-facing work.
Adaptability and a start-up mentality to thrive in a dynamic environment.
Preferred:
Google Gemini Enterprise ecosystem (Vertex AI, Agent Builder) as the primary stack; basic knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock
Why Join Us
We are united by our values and strengthened by our hybrid expertise.
There is always a way: We're from the breed of does, of diggers, of makers. Because ideas are valuable only if executed.
Client trust is won on the field: Addressing client needs flows better hands on at their side.
If not used, it is useless: Our love for technology translates into a steep desire for adoption, true brilliance is about impact.
If not shared, our work is not done: Sharing knowledge is the best way to button up a mission, benefitting clients and colleagues.
We learn everyday: Tech is a land where everything moves at the speed of light, you better be ready to challenge yourself.
The estimated base compensation for this role starts at $200,000 (NYC location). Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, this role is eligible for competitive benefits.

You will lead a team of AI & machine learning engineers and managers, driving the design and delivery of production-grade AI solutions — from classical machine learning models to LLM-powered applications — and the pipelines that power them. You’ll bring senior technical judgment to architecture and model decisions, partner closely with clients and business stakeholders — including hands-on pre-sales work shaping proposals and solution designs — and define how context engineering, agent harnesses, and fine-tuning practices get embedded into every solution, while reporting into senior AI/technology leadership on strategy and priorities.

items: AI & ML Solution Architecture: Leading the design, build, and optimization of production AI systems — classical machine learning models, LLM applications, and agentic systems — ensuring scalability, reliability, and cost-efficient inference.

Context Engineering: Defining and standardizing context engineering practices — prompt and system design, RAG architectures, vector stores, memory management, and tool/function calling — so models receive the right information at the right time.

Harness Engineering: Directing the build of robust agent harnesses — orchestration layers, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and observability — that make LLM systems reliable, safe, and measurable in production.

Fine-Tuning Pipelines: Leading the design and operation of fine-tuning and model adaptation pipelines — training data curation, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, and deployment — to specialize models for client use cases.

Platform Stack: Architecting and deploying solutions on Google Gemini Enterprise and Vertex AI as the primary stack, applying working knowledge of Microsoft AI Foundry and AWS Bedrock where client contexts require.
Team Leadership: Managing, mentoring, and developing a team of AI & ML engineers; setting technical standards and fostering best practices and knowledge sharing.

Pre-Sales & Business Development: Supporting pre-sales activities — scoping engagements, building demos and proofs of concept, and presenting solution architectures to prospective clients alongside account teams.

Machine Learning Modeling: Overseeing the development of classical and modern ML models — predictive modeling, forecasting, recommendation, and deep learning — choosing the right technique for each business problem, LLM or not.
Contributing to AI Strategy: Partnering with senior leadership to shape GenAI architecture direction, tooling decisions, and platform roadmap within your area.

items: The ideal candidate has a substantial Data Science and machine learning background with 8+ years of experience, including at least 2–3 years working on LLM architecture, agentic design, and harness & context engineering.

Master’s degree (or higher) in computer science, engineering, statistics/mathematics, or a related field.
Hands-on command of core machine learning libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, etc.), agentic SDKs (LangGraph/LangChain, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK), and fine-tuning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow).

jobs.title: Head of Data
jobs.text:
Do you want to love what you do at work? Do you want to make a difference, an impact, transform peoples lives? Do you want to work with a team that believes in disrupting the normal, boring, and average?
If yes, then this is the job you're looking for ,webook.com is Saudi's #1 event ticketing and experience booking platforms in terms of technology, features, agility, revenue serving some of the largest mega events in the Kingdom surpassing over 2 billion sales.
Role Overview
Own webook’s data function end-to-end strategy, team, platform and delivery and be the single person accountable for data at webook. Turn our first-party data into trusted decisions today and a monetisable asset within two to three years, in a regulated environment (PDPL / GDPR / NCA ECC) where data we cannot trust or lawfully use is worthless. Build and lead the team, make the platform reliable, and set webook up to sell data and insight, not just tickets.
What You’ll Own
1. Data Strategy & Roadmap
Produce webook’s first documented data strategy and a phased, costed roadmap within 60 days of start, endorsed by the VP Architecture, Platform & AI and the CTO.
Define the target operating model for the data function engineering, analytics, governance and the sequence in which it is built.
Own the data platform direction. Lead the managed-vs-self-hosted decision and present a costed recommendation within 90 days, with a clear cost-control model.
Align every data initiative to a measurable business outcome; re-prioritise the roadmap quarterly as the economics move.
2. Team Leadership & Building the Function
Assess, develop and where needed strengthen the existing team; set a clear performance bar and build the capability to meet it.
Set quarterly OKRs for each direct report; hold fortnightly 1:1s with written notes; run a monthly team standup with a rolling 90-day delivery view shared with VP Architecture and the CTO.
Be a genuine people leader: develop talent and career paths, mentor, and build an engaged, high-performing team. Retention and engagement are explicit success measures, not afterthoughts.
3. Data Platform & Engineering
Be accountable for reliable, tested, observable pipelines client-facing dashboards accurate and current, with stale or broken data caught before a client ever sees it.
Own the platform direction across the modern data stack warehouse / lakehouse, transformation (dbt), orchestration, BI and serving — making pragmatic build/buy and managed/self-host calls across open-source (ClickHouse, Superset) and major managed platforms (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks).
Institute FinOps discipline: a clear monthly platform budget with alerting; own the platform budget and keep cost predictable and under control.
Establish infrastructure-as-code, data observability, and clear SLAs for data delivery.
4. Analytics, Insight & Data Products
Establish a single source of truth and a governed metrics / semantic layer; eliminate conflicting metric definitions across the business.
Raise the bar on analytical quality for internal decisions and for client-facing insight.
Build the muscle to ship data products: embedded client analytics, benchmarking, and insight services.
Partner with product and commercial to define webook’s first paid data / insight product within 12 months, with a credible commercial case.
5. Data Governance, Quality & Privacy
Ensure data handling meets PDPL, GDPR and NCA requirements classification, access control, residency, and cross-border transfer.
Stand up a data catalog and data-quality standards with named ownership across data domains.
Define the lawful-basis and controls framework required before any data product ships — webook’s “licence to monetise.”
Coordinate closely with the Director of InfoSec & Cybersecurity and the GDPR Delivery Lead on data privacy and security.
6. Data Monetisation & Commercial Partnership
Own the path from internal analytics → embedded client insight → productised data, sequenced so trust is earned at each step.
Work with commercial leadership to size, package and price data and insight products.
Build the reliability and governance foundations that make external monetisation possible — and defensible.
7. Stakeholder Management & Data Culture
Be the trusted data partner to the executive team; translate technical work and data risk into commercial language.
Drive data literacy and a “data as a business enabler” culture; remove silos and shift data out of being treated as an IT by-product.
Represent data credibly with clients where insight is part of webook’s offering.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Field Engineering, Healthcare
jobs.text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
About the role
We're hiring a Regional Director, Field Engineering to build and lead a high impact pre-sales Field Engineering team focused on SpaceXAI's healthcare vertical — supporting our fastest growing enterprise accounts across health systems, payers, and healthcare software companies. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering and is responsible for ensuring our technical pre-sales motion scales with quality, speed, and credibility.
As the Regional Director, Field Engineering, you’ll manage and develop Field Engineers who partner closely with AEs to run technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept tailored to Healthcare buyers. You’ll also stay close to customers and deals yourself, coaching in real time, unblocking complex evaluations, and ensuring Cursor is positioned as the best AI-native development platform for healthcare engineering organizations.
This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines technical fluency, strong people management, and excellent cross-functional judgment.
What you’ll do
Lead, coach, and scale a team of Field Engineers supporting enterprise opportunities
Partner closely with Sales leadership and AEs to drive high quality technical discovery, demos, and POCs
Establish best practices for evaluations, proof-of-concept execution, and technical deal strategy, accounting for healthcare-specific requirements (HIPAA, data governance, legacy systems integration)
Serve as an escalation point for complex customer evaluations and high-stakes enterprise deals in the healthcare space
Hire, onboard, and develop top-tier Field Engineering talent with healthcare or regulated-industry domain experience; set clear expectations and career paths
Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding customer and prospect insights back to Product and Engineering
Ensure tight handoffs with post-sales teams to support successful customer onboarding and adoption
Maintain deep knowledge of Cursor’s product, roadmap, and competitive landscape
You may be a fit if
You have 4+ years experience leading Field Engineers, Solutions Architects, or Pre-Sales teams in enterprise software, with meaningful exposure to healthcare, health tech, or another regulated industry
You have direct experience navigating healthcare buyer environments — health systems, payers, or healthcare software vendors — including compliance, security, and procurement dynamics specific to the space
You have proven your ability to partner effectively with Sales while maintaining technical integrity and customer trust
You are comfortable operating in customer-facing, high-pressure deal environments and guiding teams through complexity
You have strong communication skills and executive presence, and can engage developers, architects, CTOs, and healthcare IT leadership
You have a builder mindset: you thrive in fast-moving, startup environments and enjoy creating structure where little exists

jobs.title: Platform & Data Engineering Director
jobs.text:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.
We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.
We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.
Role
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will lead the design, build, and evolution of Visium's client-facing AI and Data platform capabilities. You are the technical authority and delivery lead for our most complex data & platform programs, the person who ensures that what we build is not only technically excellent but also adoptable, scalable, and genuinely transformative.
You will directly manage forward-deployed platform engineering teams, drive data & platform strategy across engagements, and act as a trusted technical advisor to senior client stakeholders. You bring hands-on depth in the modern data and AI platform stack, from infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD to cloud architecture and building data products, combined with the leadership presence and commercial instinct to grow accounts and inspire teams.
As a Platform & Data Engineering Director, you will work on
Architect and lead the delivery of complex AI and Data platform programs, spanning cloud infrastructure design, automation, CI/CD pipelines, data product design and data engineering, from initial scoping through to production deployment. Our focus is on Azure and AWS.
Define and drive platform engineering standards and best practices across engagements, ensuring repeatability, reliability, and long-term client value.
Build and maintain strong relationships with senior client stakeholders, including C-Level and VP Engineering personas, acting as a hands-on technical advisor who earns trust through delivery.
Lead and mentor a team of platform engineers and engagement managers, cultivating a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, and ownership.
Identify and develop new business opportunities within existing accounts, partnering with the commercial team to expand Visium's platform footprint.
Champion an inspiring, outward-facing engineering culture, one that attracts strong talent and energises clients with a clear and compelling vision for what great platform and data engineering looks like.

jobs.title: Tech Modernisation, Enterprise Architecture - Vice President
jobs.text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honouring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
Our Technology Advisory team provides independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and enhancing business performance. We leverage extensive expertise to deliver rapid and sustainable impact across:
Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Defining and planning target architectures and roadmaps aligned to business objectives and plans including Data, Application/Integration and Technical/ Infrastructure architecture
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Platform/systems/infrastructure assessments, re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management, interim leadership roles, and project turnaround.
Central to our expertise is the technology strategy, organisation, applications and infrastructure which underpins any successful end-to-end transformation. We are looking for someone who has experience in Enterprise Architecture and how to define and design target state solutions, transition strategies and roadmaps, capability needs and the associated risks. This should ideally be coupled with prior consulting experience.
At AlixPartners, you will work closely with our clients to address strategic, operational, and technological challenges. Your skill in bridging the gap between technology and business will be crucial for delivering measurable results and driving business value.
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
What you’ll need
Preferably you will have a mix of consulting and industry experience, with an ability to deliver small projects and/or working across multiple workstreams of larger projects.
Previous practical experience as an Enterprise Architect, with proven experience in designing enterprise-wide technology solutions working with business and technology teams
A good understanding of software delivery, infrastructure, operations and governance.
Experience conducting rapid digital diagnostics and maturity assessments to assess technological capabilities and identifying maturity gaps.
Ability to define pragmatic steps and roadmaps to drive business value.
Experience of architecting target states and complex solutions in a variety of environments, using different methodologies, frameworks, tools and software
You demonstrate a keen personal interest in Technology and remain up to date in the latest trends, tools and impacts of Technology on industry.
You are passionate about driving IT effectiveness and enabling clients to achieve their business objectives.
Excellent communication and presentation capabilities, comfortable speaking to senior non-technical clients.
Outstanding analytical and critical thinking skills along with strong financial literacy.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organisation.
The firm offers market-leading benefits that provide flexible options to support our employee’s needs including health benefits to help prioritise their physical and emotional well-being, time-off policies to help to recharge and financial/ retirement benefits that offer income protection and support long-term planning.
The benefit type and level differ per location.
AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.

AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do

Our Technology Advisory team provides independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and enhancing business performance. We leverage extensive expertise to deliver rapid and sustainable impact across:

items: Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Defining and planning target architectures and roadmaps aligned to business objectives and plans including Data, Application/Integration and Technical/ Infrastructure architecture
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Platform/systems/infrastructure assessments, re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management, interim leadership roles, and project turnaround.

blocks.text: Central to our expertise is the technology strategy, organisation, applications and infrastructure which underpins any successful end-to-end transformation. We are looking for someone who has experience in Enterprise Architecture and how to define and design target state solutions, transition strategies and roadmaps, capability needs and the associated risks. This should ideally be coupled with prior consulting experience.

At AlixPartners, you will work closely with our clients to address strategic, operational, and technological challenges. Your skill in bridging the gap between technology and business will be crucial for delivering measurable results and driving business value.
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
What you’ll need

items: Preferably you will have a mix of consulting and industry experience, with an ability to deliver small projects and/or working across multiple workstreams of larger projects.
Previous practical experience as an Enterprise Architect, with proven experience in designing enterprise-wide technology solutions working with business and technology teams
A good understanding of software delivery, infrastructure, operations and governance.
Experience conducting rapid digital diagnostics and maturity assessments to assess technological capabilities and identifying maturity gaps.
Ability to define pragmatic steps and roadmaps to drive business value.
Experience of architecting target states and complex solutions in a variety of environments, using different methodologies, frameworks, tools and software
You demonstrate a keen personal interest in Technology and remain up to date in the latest trends, tools and impacts of Technology on industry.
You are passionate about driving IT effectiveness and enabling clients to achieve their business objectives.
Excellent communication and presentation capabilities, comfortable speaking to senior non-technical clients.
Outstanding analytical and critical thinking skills along with strong financial literacy.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organisation.

The benefit type and level differ per location.
