jobs.title: Head of Product - Lending
jobs.text:
About us
N26 is Europe’s leading digital bank with a full German banking license. Headquartered in Berlin and operating across more than 20 markets, we are now entering our next stage of maturity. Our focus is on our growth engine while we strengthen robustness, scalability, and operational excellence. With new senior leaders joining to guide this phase, we are sharpening how we build, ship, and sustain products at scale.
As we continue to keep a strong product pulse. Our growth is driven by expanding into adjacent services like mobile connectivity and recently launching cards designed for kids. Our core strategy focuses on empowering customers to switch to N26 as their primary account. By embedding financial tools that are reliable and resilient, we ensure N26 is an essential part of everyday life. To lead this, we need a Director of Marketing [Paid] who understands how to communicate the value of a top-of-wallet banking experience.
About the role
With the financial sector facing significant digital transformation and heightened competition, N26 is seeking a focused leader to spearhead the expansion of our strategic Lending division.
As Head of Lending, you will assume management of the Lending vertical, supervising the end-to-end lifecycle of our retail lending products operations, which currently cover consumer loans, overdraft facilities, and installment products.
This product is critical to the banking business and the role empowers you to operate your own business vertical: designing the long-term Lending strategy & roadmap, driving product adoption and growth, and ensuring strong P&L performance in alignment with N26 Bank risk appetite and policies. You will build, nurture, spearhead a group of 4–6 direct reports, fostering a resilient and high-performing team that integrates seamlessly with the broader strategic ambitions of N26. Additionally, you will work closely with Engineering, Credit, Data Science, Design and senior management to identify new opportunities, optimise current portfolio performance and deliver with high standards and high velocity.
Based in Berlin or Barcelona.
Your impact
Drive Sustainable Product Growth: define and execute the long-term retail lending strategy to expand the customer base, unlock new opportunities, and sustainably increase product adoption.
Own the Roadmap and P&L: take full ownership of the consumer lending product roadmap, from defining product future direction, priorities and product timeline and features to ensuring the cross-functional team meets deliverables and deadlines. You will own the outcomes of the P&L and work closely with Credit Risk teams to shape and grow the lending portfolio.
Team Management and Leadership: architect and scale an efficient lending organization, design high-performing team structures, establish clear governance, and embed success metrics across all areas of responsibility.
Strengthen Cross-Functional Collaboration: become a connective tissue between Product, Credit Risk, Operations and Data Science, deeply understanding underlying credit risk models to ensure robust, compliant, and data-driven lending decisions.
Market Development and Acceleration: scale market penetration and portfolio growth by identifying systemic levers that expand customer adoption of N26 lending products.
What you bring
Strategic Product & Business Leadership: a proven track record in senior Product Management leadership, P&L ownership, demonstrating a balance of a strong product mindset and high-level business acumen. You are proficient in translating complex product strategies into scalable commercial success and measurable P&L growth.
Lending Domain Expertise: proven experience in banking, fintech, or the broader lending space (e.g., credit lines, BNPL, loans, mortgages etc).
Team Leadership: you possess proven ability to build, nurture and grow high performing teams and you can create an innovative environment where top-tier talent can thrive and deliver exceptional business results.
Data & P&L Fluency: you are deeply data-driven, possess a strong understanding of P&L management, and know how to use data to make sharp product decisions that move the needle for the business.
Stakeholder Management and Cross-functional Collaboration: you are comfortable working closely with different areas of the organization. Navigating between Product, Engineering, Credit Risk Management, Data Science and Operations, you can communicate effectively, manage expectations and balance human and operational resources.
What you can expect
We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.
We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.
Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

jobs.title: Head of Data Analytics and Insights
jobs.text:
Angkas is the Philippines' leading motorcycle ride-hailing platform. We move millions of Filipinos through traffic every day while building real livelihoods for our driver partners.
We're hiring a Head of Analytics to own the data function end-to-end. You'll lead a team, get your hands dirty with the data, and work directly with leadership to shape how we think about our business — not just report on it.
JOB DETAILS:
You'll be responsible for the analytics roadmap and making sure the team is working on what actually matters. That means driver incentive programs, supply-demand dynamics, pricing, retention, unit economics, and others. You'll build the team's skillset, set up the right processes, and make sure we're tracking the metrics that actually matter.
On a daily basis, expect a mix of strategic work (presenting to executives, aligning with product, operations and finance) and technical work (reviewing analyses, debugging logic, writing your own queries when needed). It's a lean setup—expect to work closely with people across levels.
You'll also own data governance—working with engineering on pipeline reliability, pushing for better documentation, and establishing data lineage so people actually trust the numbers.

jobs.title: Data Planning Director
jobs.text:
Who We Are
VML is a global creative company that combines brand experience, customer experience, and commerce to create connected brands that drive growth. Guided by a Human First philosophy, VML is known for its innovative work for brands and consistently ranks among the world’s leading creative companies, including the WARC Creative 100. VML’s global network spans 55+ markets with principal offices in Buenos Aires, Kansas City, London, New York, São Paulo, Shanghai and Singapore.
VML is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.
For more information, please visit www.vml.com and follow along on LinkedIn #WeAreVML.
Who we’re looking for:
VML is seeking a Data Planning Director to be a trusted partner to our clients, navigating their business, understanding their challenges and connecting across VML, as well as WPP at large, to ensure we are setup to deliver success with world-class services and solutions.
This role is part of an integrated Data & Analytics team across measurement & reporting, predictive modelling, data strategy solutions, covering media, CX, CRM and more. The focus is to act as the glue between clients, WPP teams on all things data. As such, you will need to organise, motivate and inspire to connect all (data and non-data) disciplines in delivering success for our clients. Gravitas and strong collaboration are essential.
What you’ll be doing:
Team direction and oversight
Direct a team of data, technology and business consultants, analysts and engineers, overseeing client briefs and managing team workload.
Direct and motivate the team to help them achieve their goals and deliver brilliant work for VML’s clients.
Data & Analytics leadership
Act as strategic partner and advisor, helping clients to leverage the power of data, martech, analytics and AI to achieve their goals and drive effectiveness and efficiency.
Develop proposals and methodologies for
Data Planning; encompassing data-driven journey design, targeting personalisation, test and learn
Analytics & Data Science solutions; encompassing customer analytics (e.g. customer segmentation, predictive modelling), digital analytics (e.g. journey analysis, web/app, media analysis), business intelligence (e.g. dashboard reporting) and AI (e.g. conversational BI)
Data & Analytics consulting; encompassing data, marketing technology, AI and operations (process, skills, culture, business change etc.). Includes data, AI, martech and adtech transformation roadmaps, measurement frameworks and associated operating model development.
Inspire our clients and all of VML with thought-leadership and best practice.
Work closely with our clients to help diagnose and solve their challenges, support their data & AI vision, and make it happen.
Drive client success and satisfaction in all you do.
Business Development
New business – be a data and analytics lead for pitches to deliver winning proposals and presentations.
New & Organic business – be relentless at bringing new ideas and opportunities to grow our existing clients and bring our data offer to clients who work with us in other disciplines.
What you’ll need:
Exceptional experience leading across data and analytics in a consulting/agency environment, setting up teams and operating models with clients
A belief in the value of data-driven marketing & AI to deliver exceptional results.
Experience of building relationships with clients from junior to C-suite and dealing with the different and complex personalities involved.
Someone who can unify groups from across a wide skill set and unify them behind a clear brief or goal and deliver excellent work for clients.
A candidate with the ability to engage people with their presentation skills but show excellent active listening to create clear actions which meet client needs.
A person with a love for data-driven marketing and is constantly following trends to develop impactful and significant work for our clients.
Significant experience at scoping, resourcing, and developing commercial proposals.
Knowledge of data and analytics technologies across the marketing and digital ecosystem including media, commerce, social and digital platforms, CRM & loyalty
Knowledge of analytics solutions and how AI can be leveraged in marketing to drive growth.
Must have knowledge (you need not be a deep practitioner in all these areas, but do need have a good appreciation across them):
Data strategy consulting – data landscape (1st, 2nd, 3rd party data), data management, governance, roadmap and use case development
Analytics & AI – segmentation, predictive modelling, measurement & reporting, AI marketing applications and product development
Marketing technologies – data cloud solutions, clean rooms, analytics and reporting tools, CDPs, CRM / marketing automation, AI technologies
Marketing operations – operating models, process design, governance, data culture and skills development, client enablement and business change
At VML, we are committed to fostering an all-inclusive work environment that is both rewarding and career-forward. Our Inclusion, Equity & Belonging initiatives, alongside the VML Foundation, reflect our dedication to giving back and making a positive impact in our communities and beyond. Our people are the heartbeat of our organization—creators, doers, innovators, makers, and thinkers—who drive not just marketing, but meaningful experiences that resonate in every action and interaction.
VML is a WPP Agency. For more information, please visit our website, and follow VML on our social channels via Instagram, LinkedIn, and X.

Who we are:
At VML, we are a beacon of innovation and growth in an ever-evolving world. Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.
Our global family now encompasses over 30,000 employees across 150+ offices in 64 markets, each contributing to a culture that values connection, belonging, and the power of differences. Our expertise spans the entire customer journey, offering deep insights in communications, commerce, consultancy, CRM, CX, data, production, and technology. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.text:
Talent 360 is seeking a highly technical and hands-on Head of Engineering to lead engineering excellence across all teams.
This role is responsible for solution architecture, code quality, engineering standards, and technical execution. This role is not focused on high-level strategy alone — it requires deep involvement in code, architecture decisions, and technical problem-solving on a daily basis.
Solution Architecture & System Design
Own and drive solution architecture across all projects and products
Design scalable, high-performance, and maintainable systems
Lead architecture decisions, including frameworks, integrations, and platforms
Conduct architecture reviews and enforce quality, scalability, and security standards
Define and enforce architectural patterns (Microservices, DDD, Event-Driven, CQRS)
Evaluate build vs. buy decisions with strong technical justification
Hands-On Coding & Code Review
Actively participate in code reviews across all engineering teams
Ensure high standards in code quality, performance, and maintainability
Enforce best practices, design patterns, and coding standards
Contribute directly to critical and complex implementations when needed
Identify and resolve technical debt and code quality issues proactively
Mentor engineers through structured and constructive code reviews
Engineering Standards & Best Practices
Define and enforce engineering standards across the organization, including:
Coding standards and style guides
API design and integration standards
Database design and performance optimization
Testing strategies (unit, integration, E2E)
Documentation practices
Establish quality gates for code, releases, and deployments
Drive adoption of automated code quality tools and best practices
Ensure consistency across Backend, Frontend, and Mobile teams
CI/CD & DevOps Excellence
Own and enhance CI/CD pipelines across all projects
Ensure fully automated build, test, and deployment processes
Drive DevOps best practices, including:
Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
Automated testing within pipelines
Blue-green and canary deployments
Environment and configuration management

jobs.text:
Why USA Clinics Group?
Founded by Harvard-trained physicians with a vision of offering patient-first care beyond the hospital settings, we’ve grown into the nation’s largest network of outpatient vein, fibroid, vascular, and prostate centers, with 170+ clinics across the country. Our mission is simple: deliver life-changing, minimally invasive care, close to home.
We’re building a culture where innovation, compassion, and accountability thrive. While proud of our growth, we’re even more excited about what’s ahead, and the team we’re building to get there. We look forward to meeting you!

jobs.title: Head of Product and Quality Assurance
jobs.text:
About the Role
EnrollHere is seeking a highly driven Head of Product & Quality to lead product execution, customer engagement, quality assurance, and delivery across our platform. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for ensuring we build the right products, deliver them quickly, and maintain the highest standards of quality and customer satisfaction.
This individual will serve as the bridge between customers, product, engineering, data, compliance, and executive leadership. They must be equally comfortable meeting with customers, writing requirements, testing features, prioritizing roadmaps, and holding teams accountable for execution.
Why this Role Matters
At EnrollHere, product quality and customer experience are competitive advantages. We are building technology that powers critical business operations for our customers. The right person in this role will directly influence product innovation, customer satisfaction, platform adoption, and company growth while helping ensure we continue to deliver at a pace that sets us apart from the market.
About the Culture
EnrollHere is not a slow-moving corporate environment.
We move fast. We make decisions. We execute. We are obsessed with delivering value to our customers and continuously improving our platform. We believe speed matters, accountability matters, customer engagement matters, and results matter.
The ideal candidate thrives in an entrepreneurial environment where priorities evolve, customer feedback drives innovation, and every team member is expected to take ownership.
This role is for someone who enjoys being in the trenches, solving problems, engaging with customers, and helping teams deliver exceptional outcomes.
Core Values:
Customer First
Ownership Mentality
High Accountability
Bias for Action
Continuous Improvement
Team Before Self
Relentless Execution
Attention to Detail
Strong Communication
Positive Energy and Engagement

jobs.title: Sr. Manager / Associate Director - Commercial Data Product (Pharma/ Life science
jobs.text:
Tiger Analytics is an advanced analytics consulting firm. We are the trusted analytics partner for several Fortune 1000 companies, enabling them to generate business value from data. Our consultants bring deep expertise in Data Science, Machine Learning and AI. Our business value and leadership has been recognized by various market research firms, including Forrester and Gartner.
We are seeking a Senior Manager / Associate Director with a strong Life Sciences background and hands-on commercial analytics experience to launch Commercial Data Product to support an upcoming pharma launch. This role will lead a small, dedicated pod to design and build a Snowflake-native, Power BI–aligned data product from the ground up. The position gives an opportunity to focus on data product ownership, metric design, and stakeholder alignment. The candidate should have strong experience and domain knowledge in gene therapy, with exposure to relevant processes, workflows, and industry applications.
Key Responsibilities
Partner with Life Sciences stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions
Own the end-to-end commercial data product for a kidney launch, from vision to execution.
Translate launch strategy into segmentation frameworks, KPIs, and data products used by commercial leadership.
Drive stakeholder alignment across Marketing, Sales, Market Access, and Analytics
Own and prioritize the product backlog, ensuring alignment with launch milestones. Partner with the engineering team to design Snowflake-native data models optimized for scalability and reuse.
Ensure strong Power BI semantic model understanding (measures, relationships, performance).
Enable self-service analytics through well-designed datasets—not dashboards alone.
Establish KPI governance, adoption tracking, and success metrics for the product.
Lead a small cross-functional pod (data engineers, analysts).
Operate in an agile delivery model with clear sprint outcomes and executive visibility.
Act as the primary interface between business stakeholders and the technical team.

jobs.title: Director of Product Design
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍London / UK Remote | 💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits ✨
⭐ Our Design team
We’re a team of 115+ Product Designers, User Researchers, and Brand Designers led by Chief Design Officer Vuokko Aro. We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone. Product Design is the largest discipline within the design organisation, with designers working in tight-knit squads alongside researchers, product managers, and engineers to solve real customer problems at scale.
We design for the “magic moments.” We’ve built a bank that feels deeply human, not just functional, shaping how millions of people experience money every day. Our product is our personality. We combine research, empathy, and craft to turn everyday interactions into memorable experiences.
Now, we’re entering our next phase of growth and looking for exceptional design leaders to help define not only Monzo’s future, but the future of banking itself. There’s significant opportunity to shape the product, influence the organisation, and leave a lasting mark on millions of customers.
🔎 About the role
We’re looking for a Director of Product Design to lead design across Payments, one of Monzo’s most important and fast-evolving multi-market business areas.
You’ll partner closely with senior leaders across Product and Engineering to shape strategy, set direction, and drive exceptional execution across your area. You’ll play a key role in influencing the direction of both the product and the broader customer experience.
You’ll lead and grow a team of Product Designers, helping them do the best work of their careers while strengthening design thinking, collaboration, and craft across Monzo. As a senior leader within the Design organisation, you’ll raise the quality bar and expand design’s impact, influence, and effectiveness across Monzo.
🔑 You’ll play a key role by...
Setting the strategic direction and design vision for your area, inspiring teams to think bigger and bolder, whilst aligning with Monzo goals and mission.
Partnering with the leadership team for your area to define priorities, shape roadmaps, and turn strategy into impactful execution.
Building and nurturing a high-performing design team - investing in their growth, wellbeing, and long-term success.
Maintaining an exceptional quality bar across all design work through clear feedback and coaching, helping designers and teams consistently deliver best-in-class experiences.
Creating an environment where feedback is open, craft is celebrated, and design quality continues to evolve across the organisation.
Acting as a champion for design at Monzo, influencing how design thinking shapes our products and culture.
🤩 We’d love to hear from you if...
You’ve led design strategy and vision across complex product areas, helping teams navigate ambiguity and deliver meaningful customer and business impact.
You’re comfortable operating at multiple altitudes, from defining long-term direction to driving high-quality execution.
You build strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Research and Commercial, and know how to influence senior stakeholders through clarity, insight, and craft.
You have a strong point of view on product design and consistently raise the bar for quality, systems thinking, and customer experience.
You’ve built and led high-performing design teams, creating environments where people can grow, do exceptional work, and have meaningful impact.
You know how to scale design influence across an organisation, shaping product direction, ways of working, and culture beyond your immediate team.
You’re energised by Monzo’s mission to make money work for everyone, and excited to help shape the next generation of payments experiences through thoughtful, magical and innovative design.
🙌 What’s in it for you
💰 £140,000 - £165,000 + Equity + Benefits
✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK
✅ We can sponsor your visa
📍 This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)
⏰ Flexible working hours and trust-based work culture
📚 £1,000 annual learning budget for books, training, and conferences
🏡 Full remote setup support, including equipment and workspace essentials
➕ Plus lots more!
This process should take around 4-5 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!
We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. You can read them here.
We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.
#LI-TR1
#LI-Remote
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Director Technology - Data Platforms
jobs.text:
Director Technology - Data Platforms
London, UK
We are looking for a senior data leader to join Simple Machines in London as part of our Global Data Practice leadership team.
This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role focused on helping shape the future direction of our data platform capability across the UK and Europe. The individual will play a key role in defining our propositions, strengthening our technical capability, and helping clients modernise their data ecosystems for an AI-native future.
The role requires someone equally comfortable operating at executive, architectural, commercial, and delivery levels. We are looking for a leader who understands where enterprise data platforms are heading over the next five years, not where they were five years ago.
Key Responsibilities:
- Part of the Global Data Practice leadership team
- Helping define and evolve Simple Machines’ data platform propositions, technical direction, and strategic positioning
- Advising enterprise clients on modern data platform strategy, architecture, operating models, and AI readiness
- Supporting organisations as they evolve from traditional centralised data platforms toward AI-native, real-time, and data product-oriented operating models
- Working closely with Engagement Managers and senior leadership across major strategic initiatives
- Leading architecture and technical direction for complex enterprise data platform and transformation programs
- Acting as a senior technical counterpart across strategic client engagements and partner relationships
- Pre-sales, proposal development, technical solution shaping, and executive stakeholder engagement
- Building trusted relationships with strategic technology partners and staying current with emerging platform capabilities and market direction
- Supporting recruitment, mentoring, capability uplift, and practice development across the broader engineering organisation
- Leading major client initiatives across data engineering, platform modernisation, AI enablement, and operational data systems
- Contributing to thought leadership, market positioning, and growth initiatives across
the UK and Europe

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
About the role,
the Head of engineering has both a strategic and a technical role inside the company. The strategic aspect includes setting goals for the team, hiring engineers, and prioritizing projects. The technical aspect is about getting actively involved in developing new products, identifying requirements, and setting timelines.
Before they can get this position, the head of engineering should have extensive experience as an engineer, they should have managed complex tech projects and know how to build products and features from scratch.
About the team,
Our technology/engineering is a group of 100+ talented people. Together with the Product teams, the gist of our role is to create innovative and scalable solutions to help Amartha grow its business.
Responsibilities
Oversee front-end and back-end development teams and their projects
Monitor reliability and performance of all internal systems to suggest improvements
Ensure compliance with relevant regulations
Manage software development projects by setting requirements, goals, and timelines
Design strategies for future development projects based on the company’s overall objectives and resources
Hire engineers and coordinate their training
Implement innovative technologies
Coordinate with stakeholders for new integrations and tools

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, Trading Infrastructure
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
You will have the opportunity to join a team responsible for designing the industry's leading Crypto trading system, including Spot, Margin, Perpetuals, Futures, Options, and various risk control models such as simple account, single-currency margin, multi-currency margin, and portfolio margin.
This system supports daily trading volumes of over ten billion USD for both retail and institutional clients.
What You’ll Be Doing
The plumbing of the exchange. Order management, matching, margin, risk engine, lending/borrowing — across both spot and derivatives. When you ship, millions of trades route through your work the same day.
Infrastructure that holds up where others can't operate. You'll work directly with Legal, Compliance, and local market teams — not to check boxes, but to design systems that clear the highest regulatory bar in finance. That bar is our moat.
Outlearning the competition. Talk to traders, take apart competing systems, and decide where we lead vs. fast-follow — across crypto and TradFi.
The instruments that show us the market first. Build the data and monitoring layer that gives us situational awareness of our own stack and the broader industry. If something's drifting, breaking, or shifting — you know before anyone else.
The 3–12 month direction. Decide what we build next, and when, based on product lifecycle, competitive landscape, and what our capacity actually is — not what makes the deck look good.
Shipping through. From spec to launch, you're the person who gets it out the door — pulling engineering, design, ops, and marketing into alignment without becoming the bottleneck.
The AI harness and agent architecture for your domain. Design and ship multi-step agent workflows — tool use, retrieval, evaluation, human-in-the-loop checkpoints — that power how Core Trading operates. Spec agents the way you spec products.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor's degree or above in mathematics, physics or computer science major.
5+ years experience in building sophisticated backend systems in either crypto or Traditional Finance industry.
AI native skillset that allow you to ship at 10x because you automate the work flow first.
Possess rigorous logical thinking, excellent teamwork, communication skills and be able to coordinate resources to solve problems and achieve goals between different departments.
You possess a strong interest in trading, blockchain and the financial industry.
You are proactive, enthusiastic and sensitive to customers' feedback from a product lens.
Fluent in English and Mandarin (to communicate with Mandarin speaking clients / cross-teams).
Nice-To-Haves
Trading experience in sophisticated institutions.
Excel in quantitative research with various mathematics tools.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

We are looking for Senior Product Managers to drive institutional client growth, manage market maker and VIP programs, and deliver credit and lending products for OKX's institutional client base — including hedge funds, trading firms, asset managers, and financial institutions.
Depending on background, the role may focus on: (a) Institutional client management — VIP programs, market maker programs, and fund/asset manager operations; (b) Institutional credit products — VIP Loan, Credit Line, Post-Trade Settlement; or (c) Growth strategy and cross-team initiatives — Driving quarterly growth plans in partnership with Core Trading, Retail, and Earn teams.
This is a strategic and hands-on role where you'll collaborate closely with engineering, risk, compliance, sales/BD, and relationship management teams to deliver secure, scalable, and client-centric solutions that power OKX's institutional offerings.
What You’ll Be Doing
Product Strategy and Delivery
Understand the institutional market landscape by analysing client needs, competitor offerings, and market trends. Identify differentiation opportunities in partnership with Sales/BD and Relationship Management teams.
Design and optimize VIP fee tier programs, market maker incentive structures, and institutional client retention strategies. Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle for assigned product lines (e.g. VIP Loan, Credit Line, Delayed Settlement, MM programs, or fund management tools).
Gather and prioritise product and client requirements using data-driven analysis. Manage the institutional client lifecycle: onboarding, activation, engagement, upsell, and retention — Translating client pain points into roadmap priorities with clear business impact.
Work closely with engineering, risk, and product teams to drive both technical and financial product requirements. Build and maintain products with end-to-end risk management and operational workflows.
Develop financial and non-financial metrics and KPIs to track progress and alignment to firm’s overall strategy and goals. Solicit both internal and external client feedback, understand the various challenges and opportunities and re-prioritise the roadmap iteratively to optimise results. Manage technical backlogs and prioritise new features vs technical debt to eliminate workflow friction.
Client Engagement and Growth
Develop strategic partnerships and maintain relationships with key institutional clients. Coordinate with RM/BD teams on client onboarding, tier management, and retention strategies.
Drive quarterly growth strategies in collaboration with Core Trading, Retail Growth, and Earn teams, including cross-sell initiatives, incentive program design, and institutional product bundling.
Build business cases for product and partnership investments with clear ROI frameworks. Quantify the revenue and AUM impact of product features to drive prioritisation decisions. Own the commercial logic of assigned institutional product lines.
What We Look For In You
Proven track record of managing all aspects of a successful product launch throughout its lifecycle. Adept at translating product strategy into detailed requirements and prototypes. Experience with institutional credit products (margin lending, secured financing, delayed settlement, or credit line structures) is preferred.
Proven experience engaging directly with institutional clients — Conducting business reviews, gathering requirements on-site, and translating client pain points into product roadmap priorities. Experience working with sales/BD/relationship management teams in a B2B institutional environment.
Ability to think logically, work in a team and communicate effectively. Strong written and verbal skills for producing high quality documents, plans, roadmaps and presentations with impact. Comfortable working across time zones and cultural contexts.
Understanding of institutional crypto market dynamics — Fee structures, market making, prime brokerage models, and custody solutions.
Deep understanding of crypto exchange products (spot, margin, futures, perpetual swaps, options) and institutional trading workflows. TradFi experience in FX, Equities, or Fixed Income covering trading and middle/back office is a strong plus.
Hands-on experience leveraging AI/LLM tools for product operations, e.g. building automated workflows, using AI for data analysis, or prototyping AI-powered features. We value PMs who actively use AI to multiply their output and embed it into business processes.
A Bachelor's degree in business, technology, finance or related discipline.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience building a zero-to-one product is a strong plus.

Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants

jobs.title: Regional Director, Field Engineering - Verticals
jobs.text:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.
SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.
About the role
We're hiring a Regional Director, Field Engineering to build and lead a high-impact pre-sales Field Engineering team within one of our key industry verticals: High Tech, Retail, Life Sciences, Financial Services, Public Sector, Aerospace, or Healthcare. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering and is responsible for ensuring our technical pre-sales motion scales with quality, speed, and credibility inside a specific vertical.
As the Regional Director, Field Engineering, you'll manage and develop Field Engineers who partner closely with AEs to run technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept with the largest and most complex accounts in your vertical. You'll also stay close to customers and deals yourself, coaching in real time, unblocking complex evaluations, and ensuring Cursor is positioned as the best AI-native development platform for your industry.
This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial leadership role for someone who combines deep vertical expertise, technical fluency, strong people management, and the drive to build something from scratch.
What you'll do
Lead, coach, and scale a team of Field Engineers supporting enterprise opportunities within your vertical
Partner closely with Sales leadership and AEs to drive high-quality technical discovery, demos, and POCs with strategic and Fortune 500 accounts
Own the 0-to-1 build-out of the vertical Field Engineering practice — including field events, industry-specific collateral, customer stories, and deep executive relationship building
Establish best practices for evaluations, proof-of-concept execution, and technical deal strategy tailored to the buyers, compliance requirements, and workflows of your vertical
Serve as an escalation point for complex customer evaluations and high-stakes enterprise deals
Hire, onboard, and develop top-tier Field Engineering talent with relevant vertical experience; set clear expectations and career paths
Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding vertical-specific customer and prospect insights back to Product and Engineering
Ensure tight handoffs with post-sales teams to support successful customer onboarding and adoption
Maintain deep knowledge of Cursor's product, roadmap, and competitive landscape
You may be a fit if
You have 3+ years leading Field Engineers, Solutions Architects, or Pre-Sales teams focused on a specific vertical or strategic/Fortune 500 accounts
You have demonstrated expertise selling to or supporting accounts in one or more of our target verticals (High Tech, Retail, Life Sciences, Finserv, Public Sector, Aerospace, Healthcare), and direct industry background is a strong plus
You have a proven track record selling to and engaging technical buyers, developers, architects, CTOs, and their equivalents in regulated or complex industries
You have a strong technical foundation and fluency in modern software development workflows, AI tooling, and developer productivity
You have an entrepreneurial drive, and are comfortable building from zero, creating enablement assets, running field events, and developing the vertical playbook without a template to follow
You have a proven ability to partner effectively with Sales while maintaining technical integrity and customer trust
You have strong communication skills and executive presence, able to engage across technical and business stakeholders at the largest accounts in your industry

jobs.title: Director, Product Management, Consumer Frontend
jobs.text:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
Roblox users expect and deserve a modern, standardized and coherent user experience across all platforms we support (mobile, desktop, console, VR, web, etc.). The role of Director of Product, Consumer Frontend is to up-level Roblox UI both directly, with a Core UI team, and, indirectly, through capabilities provided by our Design Systems team. Your goal is to measurably raise the quality of our UI/UX across all surfaces, and unlock greater UI/UX capabilities for the company from a centralized, platform position.
You’ll report to the Senior Director of Product for Apps. This role is based at HQ (no remote option open).
You will:
Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Consumer Frontend team which consists of Core UI and Luau architecture and Design System with tooling teams.
Be the leader for common UI paradigms in the Roblox Consumer Application, providing thought leadership on Roblox UI for both end users and Creators.
Invest heavily in relationship building and stakeholder management in order to drive UI standardization and design system adoption.
Help define what success looks like for your teams and measure their progress towards it.
Personally PM critical projects when required (hands on PM skills as well as management experience required).
Grow the PM skills of the team under you, hire when required, represent your team at external events with Creators.
Communicate updates, milestones, and priorities effectively to stakeholders across the organization.
Stay informed about industry trends and emerging technologies in user interface design and gaming to inform product decisions.
Research and deploy AI to drive efficiency and innovation at scale.
You have:
10+ years of Product Management experience with expertise in shipping high-quality consumer products across multiple platforms.
Experience defining, managing, or driving adoption of design systems, UI platforms or platform-wide UI changes.
Expertise in navigating platform product development where internal engineers/designers are your primary customers.
Deep experience in internal stakeholder management and alignment.
Experience leading cross-functional execution with various teams including engineering, data science, design, marketing, partnerships, legal, and policy, to conceptualize, develop, test, and launch impactful UI changes.
Experience running complex, platform-wide AB tests and managing resultant trade-off conversations.
The ability to clearly communicate roadmaps, priorities, experiments and decisions across a wide spectrum of audiences from partner teams to executive levels.
Strong design sensibilities and a history of strong product to design working relationships.
Demonstrated technical proficiency and effectiveness working closely with engineers. Experience with Luau, similar languages, and/or the React framework would be beneficial but are not required.
A passion for gaming and a deep understanding of game UI or multi-platform UI delivery would be beneficial but is not a requirement.
You are:
A Product leader with a history of delivering high quality UI/UX work either directly or through a design system.
Experienced, with 10+ years of product management experience or equivalent and a history of delivering across multiple platforms at scale.
Analytical, with experience running complex AB tests to conclusion.
Design-orientated with a passion for high quality user experiences.
An excellent communicator and documenter, with fantastic listening, verbal, and written communication skills. You’re at home understanding and communicating an overarching vision at the 30k-foot level and diving into technical specifications, individual tradeoffs, and priorities.
Entrepreneurial, having worked in a fast paced environment, with competing resources and priorities, through the product life cycle from planning, development, through to launch and continuing support. You love to get things done.
Organized, understanding that the best way to build something great is through the joint efforts of many people.
For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on this page.
Annual Salary Range
$383,120—$439,280 USD
Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

jobs.title: Head of Data & Analytics (AI Native)
jobs.text:
Who we are
Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state-of-the-art in-house Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.
We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.
The team you will be part of
Our Tech Team is the engine behind our digital capabilities—designing and building the platforms, tools, and systems that power our services across the eCommerce ecosystem. From automation to optimization to data integration, the team turns complex challenges into seamless solutions, enabling scale, speed, and smarter decision-making. With innovation at its core, Tech drives the digital backbone of our business and empowers every function to perform at its best.
Our Data & AI Vision
We are building an AI-native data platform that:
Unifies data across ecommerce, marketing, creators, and operations into a real-time, governed data foundation
Moves beyond dashboards to deliver proactive, predictive, and prescriptive insights
Enables AI-driven self-serve analytics for business users via natural language, copilots, and agents
Powers autonomous decision-making and optimization across pricing, campaigns, inventory, and content
Embeds machine learning and generative AI into core workflows (forecasting, recommendations, anomaly detection, content insights)
Acts as the intelligence backbone of our internal tech platforms
Our current stack includes Google BigQuery, StarRocks, Airflow, DBT, Cube.dev (semantic layer), Looker Studio, and Apache Superset—and we are evolving this into a modern AI + data platform with real-time, ML, and agentic capabilities.
Role Overview
We are looking for a hands-on Head of Data & Analytics to lead the transformation from a traditional BI and data platform into an AI-driven intelligence platform.
You will:
Own the end-to-end data, analytics, and AI strategy
Build a platform that shifts the company from reporting → insights → actions → autonomous optimization
Enable both internal teams and external clients with self-serve, AI-powered decision-making tools
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to embed intelligence into every workflow
This role requires someone who is equally comfortable:
Defining data + AI strategy at the leadership level
Designing modern data and ML architectures
Driving real business impact through insights and automation
Key Responsibilities
1. Data, Analytics & AI Strategy
Define and execute the roadmap for an AI-native data platform aligned with Intrepid’s product and business strategy
Evolve the organization from dashboarding → proactive insights → autonomous intelligence systems
Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities across ML, GenAI, and agentic workflows in ecommerce, marketing, and social commerce
Drive adoption of AI-powered self-serve analytics and copilots across business teams
2. Data Platform, Architecture & Governance
Own the design and evolution of the modern data stack, including:
Data warehouse/lakehouse (BigQuery, StarRocks)
Data pipelines (Airflow, DBT)
Semantic layer (Cube.dev)
BI tools (Looker Studio, Superset)
Extend the platform to support:
Real-time and streaming data use cases for social commerce
Vector databases, MCP, and LLM integration layers
Establish strong foundations for data governance, privacy, security, quality, lineage, and cataloging
Ensure platform scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency
3. AI, Machine Learning & Intelligent Systems
Lead the development and deployment of:
Anomaly detection and automated insight systems
Generative AI use cases (copilots, automated reporting, content insights)
Recommendation systems (product, pricing, targeting)
Predictive models (forecasting, ROAS optimization, churn, inventory planning)
Drive adoption of LLM-powered analytics (NL2SQL, conversational BI, insight generation)
Build foundations for agentic AI systems that can autonomously analyze, recommend, and act
4. Business Impact, Self-Serve & Team Leadership
Transition from pull-based dashboards → push-based, actionable insights
Enable business teams with:
Proactive alerts, recommendations, and decision support tools
Scenario simulation and planning capabilities
Build AI-powered self-serve analytics experiences, reducing dependency on central teams
Drive semantic layer adoption and metrics standardization across the organization
Define and track impact metrics (e.g., GMV uplift, marketing efficiency, cost reduction, automation rates)
Build and lead a high-performing data organization (Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Science, BI)
Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and AI-first thinking, partnering closely with tech and business functions

jobs.title: VP, Product Management (Platform & Growth)
jobs.text:
Death is our only foe.
Immortals was founded by Bryan Johnson and Kate Tolo to build a new standard for human health and longevity.
We’re building Autonomous Health: a system that uses measurement, scientific evidence, and personalization to help people understand their bodies and make better decisions about their health. What began with Bryan becoming the most measured person in history is becoming a platform for everyone.
Immortals brings together biomarkers, longevity medicine, nutrition, prescriptions, wearables, and personalized protocols in one place, turning health data into clear, actionable decisions.
We’re a small, ambitious team building what we believe will become the new operating system for human health. We move quickly, think from first principles, care deeply about the quality of our work, and hold ourselves to an unusually high standard.
Our mission is simple: help billions of people live healthier lives for longer, and ultimately, Don’t Die.
We are seeking a rare, hands-on leader who can operate at the intersection of high-scale systems and high-velocity commercial growth. As the VP of Product, you will lead the product and design vision for Immortals’ digital experiences, ensuring our technical foundation is modular and scalable while driving user acquisition and monetization.
A core mission for this role is creating a new, unified AI interaction experience that seamlessly ties together our commerce (supplements and meds), biomarker data, and our passionate community. This experience is designed to help deliver the best personalized solutions and recommendations to improve our users’ longevity and health. You aren't just a people manager; you are a "player-coach" who remains deeply hands-on in the product management process, leveraging AI assistance to drive 10x productivity and execution.

jobs.title: VP Product
jobs.text:
Hybrid remote/London office
About us:
We’re a fast growing AI startup on a mission to help midmarket businesses transform how work gets done.
We’ve built a factory for custom operations agents. The factory builds Virtual Agents: software workers with AI reasoning that complete complex workflows end-to-end, directly in customer tools. There’s no tech integration, process change or upfront cost. Onboarding is white-glove, takes a matter of days, and customers pay only for delivered value.
This makes Virtual Agents the lowest risk way to automate complex manual work. And it makes Unitary the first company delivering Fortune 500-grade AI deployment with the unit economics of software - enabling us to reach the midmarket at scale.
Today we’re focused on commercial insurance, marketplaces and primary healthcare. But the potential for Virtual Agents goes far beyond.
We closed $15M Series A funding in 2024, and we’re backed by some leading names in AI (Plural and Creandum). We’re working with world-class clients such as Substack, Trustpilot, Depop, Sony Interactive Entertainment and many more.
This is an exciting opportunity to join a well-funded startup at a crucial stage of growth, and to play a significant part in turning frontier AI technology into real world value.
About the role:
We’re seeking an experienced VP Product to lead Virtual Agents through its next stage of growth.
Reporting to the CEO and joining the executive team, you will own product strategy and execution across the Virtual Agents business. You'll define where we play and how we win, build out the product team, and partner closely with engineering, AI research, go-to-market and operations to scale the product from several million in ARR into a category-defining business.
This is a 1-N role: the product is delivering value and growing fast, but we’re at the very start of what Virtual Agents can do for midmarket businesses.
You will:
Own product strategy for Virtual Agents. Define the multi-year vision, decide where we invest, and translate that into a roadmap the company can execute against. Bring rigour and clarity to decisions that span product experience, tech differentiation, vertical expansion and commercial model
Build and lead the product function. Hire and develop an exceptional product team and set the standard for how product is practised at Unitary
Work across the business to execute successfully on your strategy - ensuring products are built right, sales and marketing teams are enabled, and delivery teams can scale smoothly
Own the end-to-end product experience, including the onboarding, human-in-the-loop and customer success workflows that are central to how Virtual Agents deliver value. At Unitary, the implementation and CS experience is a critical part of the product and differentiation
Develop deep expertise in our customers, domains and competitive landscape — particularly commercial insurance — and use it to make sharp prioritisation calls
Operate as a member of the executive team. Contribute to company strategy, support fundraising, and represent the product externally with customers, partners and investors.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.text:
At Zeta Global, we are building the next generation of AI-powered marketing ecosystems. The “Prospect Audiences” team within the data layer powers ingestion of behavioral, demographic & geographic identity signals and enables generation of smart audiences from the Zeta Data Cloud. These audiences are the cornerstone for improved audience targeting by Zeta’s customers and higher marketing ROI.
As Director, Engineering, your immediate responsibility will be to own the Third-Party Audiences product from an engineering, architecture & technology purview, guide the team to deliver on immediate roadmap work items and work with product and business stakeholders to shape the product itself. Over time, the role could evolve into broader participation in the complete data layer (consisting of 6 other teams) and additional ownership.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead the Prospect Audiences team, consisting of ~10 engineers, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence.
Guide the team to deliver roadmap work items on time, of high quality, within the boundaries of the organization processes and guidelines.
Collaborate with product and business teams to shape the future and long-range roadmap for the team
Collaborate with DevEx & AI Enablement teams to drive adoption of AI-native SDLC in the agentic software development paradigm, as applicable to the technologies used by the team.
Partner with architects to build a world-class data ingestion and processing architecture & be at the forefront of technological innovation and continue to challenge yourself to deliver better outcomes for the customers.
Recruit, mentor, and develop top talent within your team and the data layer in general.
Own the system end to end, including production deployments, monitoring, distributed tracing, defining SLOs and thresholds for alerting, and managing on-call support for production incidents.
Monitor cost profile of the owned systems, participate in cost optimization initiatives, and execute cost optimization projects to keep the overall cost footprint as lean as possible.
Own how the team ensures reliable, testable pipelines and datasets - quality checks, lineage/observability of critical tables, and clear contracts/SLAs (or handshakes) between data producers and downstream consumers (including when things break).
Qualifications:
10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time leading large-scale data systems and teams.
Deep domain expertise in batch & real-time data processing systems.
Understand applicability, pros & cons & effectiveness of data engineering design patterns & concepts such as Data Lakehouse, Data Table Format, Zero-Copy Data Sharing, Cleanroom, Real-Time vs Batch Data Processing, High throughput distributed system APIs
Possess experience working on data technologies equivalent to:
Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery
Iceberg, Hudi, Delta
EMR, Airflow, Spark
Aerospike, Scylla, DynamoDB
Strong understanding of cloud data architectures (AWS, Snowflake, etc.).
Track record of innovation and driving measurable outcomes, including AI-driven or data-driven product capabilities.
Exceptional communication skills
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

We invite you to explore this opportunity to be a part of the Zeta family……
Should you need any assistance or require further information, please do not hesitate to contact us.

jobs.text:
About AlixPartners
Expertise, execution excellence, and accountability – AlixPartners stands for delivering measurable results “when it really matters.” As a global consulting firm, we help our clients respond quickly and decisively to their most critical challenges. Our experienced consultants specialize in creating, protecting, and restoring enterprise value. In 2023, AlixPartners was recognized as the consulting firm with the strongest execution capabilities by “manager magazin” and the Scientific Association for Management and Consulting (WGMB). For more than 40 years, AlixPartners has supported clients worldwide, with approximately 4,000 employees across 27 offices globally.
TMT
Disruption and exponential growth, M&A, carve-outs and private equity investors, SaaS and cloud transformation, as well as challenges across the entire supply chain — these are just some of the forces shaping the TMT industry. Winners in this highly competitive environment aggressively adapt their business models, organizational structures, capabilities, and cost bases to evolving market conditions in order to capitalize on growth opportunities.
Our global team combines deep industry expertise with extensive transformation experience and a broad range of methodologies specifically tailored to the TMT and technology sectors. We have a proven track record of increasing enterprise value through a clear focus on profitability and growth.
As a member of our TMT team, you will work across all three sectors — Technology, Media, and Telecommunications — supporting both large corporations and private equity firms as well as their portfolio companies.
What We Offer
Impactful, hands-on, and pragmatic: at AlixPartners, your passion drives your career through high performance, initiative, and results. Working alongside highly experienced team members in small teams, you will collaborate directly with owners, board members, and senior management. Together, you will deliver actionable solutions to urgent business challenges, often in critical, high-stakes situations where rapid execution matters most.
Through our One-Firm approach, we offer cross-border opportunities for learning, as well as personal and professional development.
In addition, you can expect an attractive compensation package with comprehensive benefits and numerous initiatives through our Employee Resource Groups — feel free to ask us more about them.
Your Profile
Our goal is to deliver sustainable value creation for our clients. To achieve this, we are looking for top talent in the market:
7–15 years of relevant professional and consulting experience
Sector: TMT sector (telecommunications, media, high-tech & electronics, software and semiconductors)
Ideally, experience in large-scale, enterprise-wide transformation programs, performance improvement across the value chain, growth and margin optimization, M&A (Due diligence, ost-merger integration, carve-outs), AI transformation, as well as growth initiatives
Strong financial and analytical capabilities
Proven track record of delivering implementation-oriented, high-quality solutions across multiple workstreams, with the ability to take full ownership of different areas
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Strong analytical, problem-solving and hands-on mindset
Strong academic background; Master’s degree, PhD, or equivalent
Fluency in French and English; additional languages are a plus
Readiness to travel within a hybrid working model (remote, office, client site)
Valid passport, citizenship, and/or work authorization for France, with the ability to travel and work across the EU

jobs.title: Executive Director - Development (Del 1)
jobs.text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly skilled and visionary Executive Director - Development, with significant Theme Parks development experience. This leadership role is central to realizing our ambition to create world-class theme park experiences that captivate visitors and contribute to the overall vision of Qiddiya.
As the Executive Director Development, you will oversee the full project lifecycle from concept through design, construction, and launch. You will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams, vendors, and stakeholders to ensure that each theme park development adheres to the highest standards of innovation, quality, safety, and guest experience.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement comprehensive strategies for the successful delivery of theme park projects aligned with Qiddiya’s vision and goals.
Lead multidisciplinary teams in the planning, design, construction, and commissioning phases of theme park developments.
Manage project budgets, timelines, and resources, ensuring that projects are delivered on time and within budget.
Collaborate with master planners, architects, engineers, and creative teams to develop innovative and immersive theme park concepts.
Ensure adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices throughout all phases of development.
Engage with key stakeholders, including government entities, partners, and community representatives, to foster collaboration and support.
Drive continuous improvement efforts in project delivery methodologies, sustainability practices, and guest experience standards.
Provide regular updates and reports to senior leadership on project status, risks, and mitigation strategies.
Mentor and develop high-performing teams, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

jobs.title: Managing Director - Flagship Vertical Market Software Business
jobs.text:
Lead the Next Chapter of a Market-Leading Business
At Aspire Software, we acquire and build mission-critical software businesses for the long term. We are seeking a Managing Director to lead one of our flagship vertical market software businesses—a company with a strong market position, loyal customer base, and a long track record of success within the Aspire portfolio. This business is a cornerstone asset with meaningful scale and reputation in its market. It now stands at an exciting point in its evolution, with clear opportunities to expand its reach, enhance its product offering, and accelerate growth. This is a rare opportunity to take an already successful company and shape its next phase of expansion and innovation.
An Agentic MD
A truly agentic MD in the modern era is a leader who goes beyond adopting AI tools to fundamentally redesign how the business operates, competes, and creates value. This means building an organization where intelligent systems and human teams work together—automating routine decisions, augmenting complex ones, and enabling faster, data-driven execution across every function. An agentic MD embeds AI into the core of the product, leverages it to transform sales and marketing effectiveness, and drives operational efficiency through automation at scale. Just as importantly, they cultivate a culture of experimentation, accountability, and continuous learning—ensuring the organization is not only using AI but evolving with it. The outcome is a more adaptive, scalable, and intelligent business that can outperform traditional SaaS models.
The Role: Operator, Builder, Growth Leader
This is a full P&L MD role with end-to-end ownership of the business. You will define and lead the company’s next chapter, building on a strong foundation while unlocking new avenues for growth, innovation, and value creation. You will operate with high autonomy, supported by Aspire’s long-term investment model, operational expertise, and global network.
What You’ll Lead
Drive the Next Phase of Growth: Expand and scale repeatable, high-quality revenue streams, identify new opportunities across markets, segments, and channels, and strengthen and evolve the go-to-market strategy.
Shape the Future of the Product: Define and execute a compelling product vision and roadmap, enhance the platform through innovation, integrations, and AI-driven capabilities, and ensure continued alignment with evolving customer needs and industry trends.
Deepen Customer Value: Build on a strong customer foundation to further improve retention, satisfaction, and lifetime value, and strengthen the company’s position as a mission-critical partner to its clients.
Lead and Evolve the Organization: Partner with an established leadership team to drive alignment, performance, and execution, assess organizational strengths and identify opportunities to further elevate capabilities where needed, foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement, and attract and develop talent to support the company’s next phase of growth.
Own Performance and Outcomes: Lead the business with full accountability for revenue, EBITDA, and cash flow, drive operational excellence, scalability, and efficiency, and allocate resources effectively to support long-term growth.
Expand Strategic Opportunities: Evaluate and pursue M&A, partnerships, and adjacent growth opportunities, and position the business for continued leadership within its vertical.
Why This Opportunity Stands Out
A Flagship Asset: This is a high-quality, established business with scale, reputation, and a strong foundation—one of Aspire’s core platforms.
A Platform for Growth: With the fundamentals in place, the focus is on expansion, innovation, and acceleration—building on success, not starting from scratch.
True Ownership: You will run the business with full autonomy and accountability, empowered to make decisions and drive outcomes.
Long-Term Backing: Aspire’s buy-and-hold model means you can focus on building enduring value, not managing toward an exit.
A Proven Operating Model: You’ll have access to Aspire’s playbooks, capital, and network of experienced operators while maintaining independence in execution.
What Success Looks Like
Accelerated, sustainable revenue growth, continued strengthening of market leadership, a differentiated and forward-looking product strategy, high customer retention and satisfaction, a strong, aligned, and high-performing leadership team, and consistent expansion of profitability and enterprise value.
What You Bring
Experience as a CEO, Managing Director, or General Manager with full P&L ownership, a track record of scaling and growing established software or technology businesses, strong commercial instinct across sales, pricing, and go-to-market strategy, ability to lead across product, operations, and finance, a hands-on, ownership-driven leadership style, and comfort operating in a high-autonomy, performance-driven environment.
Why Aspire
Lead a flagship business with real scale and impact, operate with true ownership and autonomy, be backed by a company that builds for the long term, access a global ecosystem of software leaders and best practices, and shape the future of a business that already matters in its market.
#AspireSoftware
