jobs.title: Field Chief Technology Officer (Field CTO)
jobs.text:
MinIO is the data and memory foundation for enterprise AI. Built for the speed, scale, and economics that AI and analytics demand, AIStor and MemKV unify every layer of the data stack, from agentic and inference context memory to tables and objects across core, edge, and cloud. Trusted by 77% of the Fortune 100, MinIO is redefining how AI factories, intelligent applications, and autonomous agents secure, persist, and unlock the full value of their data.
We are seeking a highly technical, visionary, and customer-centric Field CTO to act as our premier technical ambassador. In this role, you will bridge the gap between MinIO’s engineering innovation and the strategic business needs of our largest, most complex enterprise customers.
As a Field CTO, you will engage in peer-to-peer conversations with enterprise C-suites (CIOs, CTOs, CDOs) and lead architectural discussions with principal engineers. A deep, hands-on understanding of modern AI architectures (LLMs, RAG, deep learning pipelines) and modern analytics data systems (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Trino, Spark) is mandatory. You will not only evangelize MinIO’s capabilities but also act as a trusted advisor, helping organizations architect their data infrastructure to support next-generation workloads. This role is Bay Area, CA based
What You Will Do
Executive Advisory & Evangelism: Act as a trusted technical advisor to C-level executives at Fortune 500 companies. Articulate the strategic value of high-performance object storage in the context of AI readiness and data democratization.
Architectural Leadership: Design and validate complex, large-scale architectures for enterprise customers. Guide them in integrating MinIO seamlessly into their AI/ML pipelines and modern data lakehouse ecosystems.
Industry Thought Leadership: Represent MinIO at major industry conferences, webinars, and meetups. Write technical whitepapers, reference architectures, and blog posts focusing on the intersection of object storage, generative AI, and modern analytics.
Pre-Sales & Post-Sales Strategic Support: Partner closely with enterprise sales and customer success teams on high-stakes deals. Unblock technical objections and provide strategic guidance during Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and large-scale deployments.
Product Strategy Feedback Loop: Serve as the "voice of the customer" to MinIO’s product and engineering teams. Distill market trends, customer pain points, and emerging AI/Analytics patterns into actionable product requirements.
Required Qualifications
10+ years of experience in technical leadership roles (e.g., Enterprise Architect, Chief Architect, VP of Engineering, or previous Field CTO).
Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing or evangelist capacity, successfully presenting to both highly technical audiences and C-level business executives.
AI & Machine Learning Architectures:
Deep architectural understanding of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs), including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflows and vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Qdrant, Pinecone).
Strong knowledge of AI/ML data pipelines and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ray, Hugging Face).
Understanding of hardware bottlenecks in AI, specifically the challenge of feeding data to GPUs (GPU data starvation) and how high-throughput storage solves this.
Modern Analytics & Data Systems:
Expertise in Open Table Formats (Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Delta Lake) and their integration with object storage.
Proficiency with modern query engines and compute frameworks (Trino, Presto, Apache Spark, Flink, StarRocks).
Solid grasp of the evolution from traditional data warehouses to modern Data Lakehouse architectures.
Infrastructure & Cloud-Native Tech:
Strong command of Kubernetes, containerization, and cloud-native orchestration.
Deep understanding of the AWS S3 API, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems design.
What We Offer
Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
401K with 3% Contribution
Pre-IPO Stock Options
At least 12 Public Holidays
Flexible Time Off
Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)
MinIO is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Director of Software Engineering (Canada)
jobs.text:
At Flosum, we are building the world's best software for the modern enterprise. Our team is passionate about crafting elegant, high-performance products that delight our customers and set a new bar for engineering excellence. We combine deep expertise in cloud-native development with a relentless focus on quality, speed, and innovation. Every line of code we ship is built to scale, built to last, and built to make a real difference for the businesses that rely on us.
We are a company where technologists lead, ideas win on merit, and shipping great software fast is a core value—not a slogan. If you believe world-class engineering teams are the ones that move quickly and build things right, you'll feel at home here.
About the Role
We are hiring a Director of Software Development to lead a team of 10 engineers building and scaling our Node.js and Salesforce-integrated products. This is a hands-on leadership role for a technical architect at heart who can compress delivery schedules, drive developer velocity, and own the performance of the overall solution. You will be the single point of accountability for turning our roadmap into shipped software—on time, at quality, and at scale.
What You'll Own
Lead, coach, and grow a team of 10 full-stack developers across Node.js services and Salesforce customizations.
Drive measurable improvements in developer velocity using DORA metrics: lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate, and MTTR.

jobs.title: Director, Product Design
jobs.text:
Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.
About The Role
Samsara’s mission is to improve industrial efficiency, safety, and quality at a massive scale, through the use of sensors and software. Our suite of IoT products and software platform brings the benefits of sensor data to traditional industries like transportation, food and beverage distribution, construction, state and local government, and K-12 education. We help our customers transport food, medicine, and other goods safely across the country, monitor deliveries for unsafe conditions, and help fleet managers improve the efficiency of their operations.
Samsara’s Product Design team is responsible for crafting user-friendly features, workflows, and interfaces that our customers use every day to run their operations. This involves talking to customers, working with engineers and product managers to understand problems, rapidly designing and iterating on mocks and user flows, and communicating ideas effectively to stakeholders. We also build design systems that underpin all our products to ensure a consistent and cohesive user experience.
We’re looking for an experienced product design director who will build out an already high-caliber group of designers and help shape the product experience for all our customers.
This is a remote position based in the United States or Canada. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
In this role, you will:
Lead, grow, coach and mentor a team of design managers
Engage with customers to deeply understand their operations and people
Ship high-quality designs based on these customer needs
Collaborate with partners to define opportunities and deliver a best-in-class experiences
Define and drive the product design strategy across product areas
Create and refine tools, systems and processes that improve team health and output
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team
Minimum requirements for the role:
4-6 years (or more) of product design management experience
Strong portfolio that showcases ability to lead teams that ship elegant solutions to complex problems
An ideal candidate also has:
Track record of shipping step-changes to the UX that drive customer and business impact
A history of hiring, growing and retaining great talent
Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners to ship high quality experiences
Experience identifying and instituting changes that improve employee experiences
Expertise in providing feedback that accelerates career growth and improves product quality
A desire to improve yourself, the team, and product experiences
The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.
The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.
Annual Base Salary
$235,600—$294,500 USD
Total Rewards
At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.
Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.
Flexible Working
At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.
Belonging at Samsara
At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.
Accommodations
Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
Our Commitment to Authenticity
We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.
Fraudulent Employment Offers
Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Developer Infrastructure
jobs.text:
About Fullscript
We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.
This is your invitation.
Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.
The Role
We’re looking for a Director of Engineering to lead high-impact engineering teams and shape the future of Fullscript’s platform. You’ll drive technical vision, scalability, and innovation, ensuring our technology empowers practitioners to provide better patient care.
As a strategic and hands-on leader, you’ll guide engineering teams, managers, and cross-functional partners to deliver exceptional products and infrastructure. Your role is to enable teams to move quickly, solve complex technical challenges, and ensure our systems scale to meet growing demand.
This role bridges the gap between infrastructure teams and product engineering, focusing on developer productivity, system reliability, and scalability

jobs.title: Product Manager / Director, AI Trading
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
About The Opportunity
OKX's Trading Products team owns the core trading experience across Spot, Margin, and Perpetual/Futures — spanning the full user journey from pre-trade decision-making, through order execution, to post-trade settlement and risk management. As our trading volumes and product complexity continue to grow globally, we are looking for a Trading Product Manager who can own and evolve both the user-facing trading experience and the underlying trading mechanics that power it.
This role sits at the intersection of product design and trading logic. You will work on how users discover, price, place, and manage trades (pre-trade / trade / post-trade), while also owning the correctness and soundness of the core mechanisms beneath the surface — margin models, funding rate formulas, liquidation logic, risk parameter design, and order/matching behavior. You will work closely with engineering, risk, quant, and design teams to ship trading features that are intuitive for users and rigorous under the hood.
What You’ll Be Doing
Start from users and the market to uncover real trading-experience needs — Continuously surface user pain points through user research, behavioral data, community feedback, and conversations with active traders, ensuring product direction is grounded in real signal rather than internal assumptions.
Benchmark against industry best practices to build best-in-class trading product competitiveness — Continuously track developments in crypto and traditional finance markets and the latest moves from leading products, translating external insight into concrete product opportunities that keep our trading experience and competitiveness ahead of the industry.
Build and continuously refine the end-to-end trading experience — Own the full journey across pre-trade (market data presentation, decision-support tools, leverage/margin setup, risk disclosures), trade (order flow, execution feedback, order book/depth interaction), and post-trade (position management, PnL display, settlement statements) — from defining requirements through to shipping the solution.
Drive efficient cross-team collaboration with mature program-management execution — Bring a complete product methodology, independently write rigorous PRDs, and lead alignment and coordination across engineering, risk, quant, design, and compliance. Own the full project lifecycle — from requirements definition and solution design, through development scheduling, to launch validation and post-launch review — ensuring every stage closes the loop with a clear outcome, without relying on others to drive progress.
Apply rigorous quantitative thinking to understand and reason about trading mechanics — Bring strong logical reasoning and quantitative analysis skills, with the ability to learn fast and quickly master core trading mechanisms such as margin, leverage, funding rates, and liquidation. Candidates with a deep understanding of trading systems are preferred.
What We Look For In You
We are open to two types of candidates for this role:
(a) Experienced Trading Practitioners
Prior hands-on experience in trading — either within crypto (exchange product, quant, trading desk) or in traditional finance (equities, futures, FX, derivatives) — with direct exposure to how trading products and mechanisms are designed and operated.
Solid understanding of core trading concepts: margin/leverage, order types, market microstructure, risk management, and P&L mechanics.
Comfortable reading and reasoning through trading formulas (e.g. mark price, funding rate, liquidation price) and translating them into clear product logic.
(b) High-Potential Talent
Strong quantitative/analytical foundation — a background in mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, with strong academic performance.
High self-drive and fast learning ability — demonstrated track record of picking up complex, technical domains quickly and independently, even without prior trading experience.
Genuine intellectual curiosity about financial markets and trading mechanics, with the rigor to work through formulas and edge cases rather than relying on surface-level understanding.
Common requirements for both profiles:
3+ years of product management experience (or equivalent hands-on experience in quant/trading roles for candidates from profile (a)).
Strong technical intuition — comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers, and reasoning through quantitative models. You don't need to be a developer, but you think with the rigor of one.
Excellent communication skills — able to write a precise, technically sound PRD, and to explain complex trading mechanics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
High agency and execution velocity — comfortable operating in ambiguity, moving from open question to shipped solution, and making decisions with incomplete information.
Genuine passion for crypto and trading — actively uses trading products, understands order types and market microstructure, and can explain how margin, leverage, or liquidation mechanics work. Ideally, you have skin in the game.
Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience with derivatives products (perpetual futures, options) either as a builder or an active trader.
Familiarity with risk parameter design (margin tiers, liquidation engines, insurance funds) at an exchange or financial institution.
Quantitative modeling experience (e.g. Python, SQL) sufficient to validate trading formulas or backtest mechanism changes.
Prior work in a high-growth crypto exchange, trading firm, or fintech company.
Fluency in English is preferred to better support communication with global product and business stakeholders.
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

Prior hands-on experience in trading — either within crypto (exchange product, quant, trading desk) or in traditional finance (equities, futures, FX, derivatives) — with direct exposure to how trading products and mechanisms are designed and operated.
Solid understanding of core trading concepts: margin/leverage, order types, market microstructure, risk management, and P&L mechanics.
Comfortable reading and reasoning through trading formulas (e.g. mark price, funding rate, liquidation price) and translating them into clear product logic.
(b) High-Potential Talent
Strong quantitative/analytical foundation — a background in mathematics, physics, statistics, engineering, or a related quantitative discipline, with strong academic performance.
High self-drive and fast learning ability — demonstrated track record of picking up complex, technical domains quickly and independently, even without prior trading experience.
Genuine intellectual curiosity about financial markets and trading mechanics, with the rigor to work through formulas and edge cases rather than relying on surface-level understanding.
Common requirements for both profiles:
3+ years of product management experience (or equivalent hands-on experience in quant/trading roles for candidates from profile (a)).

Strong technical intuition — comfortable discussing system architecture and data flows with engineers, and reasoning through quantitative models. You don't need to be a developer, but you think with the rigor of one.
Excellent communication skills — able to write a precise, technically sound PRD, and to explain complex trading mechanics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
High agency and execution velocity — comfortable operating in ambiguity, moving from open question to shipped solution, and making decisions with incomplete information.

Genuine passion for crypto and trading — actively uses trading products, understands order types and market microstructure, and can explain how margin, leverage, or liquidation mechanics work. Ideally, you have skin in the game.
Proficiency in Mandarin is required to communicate effectively with internal engineering and product stakeholders in the China-based R&D center.
Nice-To-Haves
Experience with derivatives products (perpetual futures, options) either as a builder or an active trader.
Familiarity with risk parameter design (margin tiers, liquidation engines, insurance funds) at an exchange or financial institution.
Quantitative modeling experience (e.g. Python, SQL) sufficient to validate trading formulas or backtest mechanism changes.
Prior work in a high-growth crypto exchange, trading firm, or fintech company.
Fluency in English is preferred to better support communication with global product and business stakeholders.

jobs.title: Associate Director for Data Analytics and Insights
jobs.text:
Angkas is the Philippines' leading motorcycle ride-hailing platform. We move millions of Filipinos through traffic every day while building real livelihoods for our driver partners.
We're hiring a Head of Analytics to own the data function end-to-end. You'll lead a team, get your hands dirty with the data, and work directly with leadership to shape how we think about our business — not just report on it.
JOB DETAILS:
You'll be responsible for the analytics roadmap and making sure the team is working on what actually matters. That means driver incentive programs, supply-demand dynamics, pricing, retention, unit economics, and others. You'll build the team's skillset, set up the right processes, and make sure we're tracking the metrics that actually matter.
On a daily basis, expect a mix of strategic work (presenting to executives, aligning with product, operations and finance) and technical work (reviewing analyses, debugging logic, writing your own queries when needed). It's a lean setup—expect to work closely with people across levels.
You'll also own data governance—working with engineering on pipeline reliability, pushing for better documentation, and establishing data lineage so people actually trust the numbers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Owner and Implementation Director - Enterprise Limit Management
jobs.text:
Senior Product Owner and Implementation Director – Enterprise Limit Management System (Senior Consultant)
Location: UAE
Contract: 1–2 Year Contract
Role Purpose
The Senior Product Owner and Implementation Director – Enterprise Limit Management System is accountable for the end-to-end conceptualization, design, build, and enterprise rollout of the Bank’s in-house Enterprise Limit Management System (ELMS), while providing program-level delivery leadership aligned to the Bank-wide Transformation Office practices.
This role combines deep product ownership for a complex, risk‑critical banking platform with senior transformation and program delivery accountability across business, risk, operations, and technology. The platform will serve as the strategic, centralized limit and exposure control system for the Bank, supporting corporate and institutional banking products across funded, non‑funded, contingent, treasury, trade finance, project finance, and structured finance portfolios.
The incumbent will lead the initiative from vision through implementation and stabilization, ensuring regulatory compliance, architectural soundness, operational resilience, and enterprise scalability, while managing scope, budget, governance, end to end delivery, vendors, and cross‑borders execution.
Key Accountabilities
1. Product Ownership & Strategic Platform Leadership
Own and drive the product vision, target architecture, roadmap, and delivery strategy for the Enterprise Limit Management System.
Lead the end‑to‑end design and implementation of centralized capabilities covering:
Facility-, borrower-, obligor-, subgroup-, and group‑level limits
Industry, sector, country, issuer, cross‑border, and group exposure aggregation
Large exposure, concentration, and regulatory threshold monitoring
Funded, non‑funded, committed, uncommitted, and contingent exposure logic
Credit Conversion Factor (CCF) treatment for off‑balance‑sheet exposures
Collateral linkage, allocation, earmarking, haircut application, substitution, and release
Margin lending and issuer risk calculations
Multicurrency limits, utilizations, and FX impact handling
Parent‑child hierarchies, sub‑limits, linked and shared limits
Pre‑deal and post‑deal validations
Breach detection, temporary excess, overrides, approvals, and escalation workflows
Define and govern complex business rules and credit workflows, including:
Cross‑border and transfer risk logic
Country-of-risk assignment methodologies
FI transaction approval and country workflows
FI sell‑down processing and exposure redistribution
PSRE calculation logic (CCF add‑on and Monte Carlo simulation based)
Project finance exposure treatment (sponsor, paymaster, ultimate paymaster, contractor structures)
Basel II / Supervisory Framework‑aligned exposure aggregation and large exposure control
Covenant monitoring and early warning indicators
Credit amendments, renewals, reviews, special assets, recoveries, and post‑sanction administration
Translate credit policies, regulatory requirements, and internal governance standards into implementable rules, workflows, calculations, and control mechanisms.
2. Program & Transformation Delivery Leadership
Provide end‑to‑end program delivery leadership for the ELMS initiative in line with Transformation Office governance standards.
Develop and maintain the Program Master Plan, defining:
Initiatives, milestones, dependencies, critical paths, and contingency actions
Resource allocation across business, technology, risk, and operations
Budget tracking and financial governance in partnership with Finance
Lead delivery across all phases: design, build, integration, testing, rollout, and stabilization.
Own and execute program governance, including:
Steering Committees, project forums, and working groups
Agenda setting, documentation, decision tracking, actions, and progress reporting
Manage cross‑border execution across all countries where the solution is deployed.
Ensure front‑to‑back transformation, coordinating Front, Middle, and Back Office participation to achieve true enterprise integration.
Provide disciplined risk, issue, dependency, and change management, ensuring transparency and timely escalation.
3. Technology, Architecture & Integration Leadership
Drive integration with:
Loan Origination and Credit Workflow systems
Core Banking platforms
Trade Finance and Treasury systems
Collateral Management platforms
Customer Master and exposure source systems
Ensure strong understanding of how:
Limits, utilizations, balances, contingent exposures, provisions, and recoveries
are sourced, reconciled, aggregated, and controlled across upstream systems.
Engage closely with Architecture and Engineering teams on:
APIs, integration patterns, and workflow orchestration
Rules engines, data models, and calculation engines
Real‑time or near‑real‑time processing and auditability
Ensure the platform is scalable, configurable, secure, auditable, and enterprise‑grade.
4. Stakeholder & Vendor Management
Has excellent presentation, senior stakeholders management track record and communication skills
Act as the single senior interface across Business, Risk, Credit, Operations, Technology, Architecture, Finance, and external vendors.
Manage vendor delivery, ensuring technical compliance, quality, timelines, and value realization.
Partner with business leaders to shape solutions aligned to strategic objectives and reference architectures.
Provide leadership in Agile and Hybrid delivery methodologies while ensuring delivery rigor.
5. Testing, Controls & Post‑Implementation Stability
Define and oversee testing strategies, including:
Complex exposure and aggregation scenarios
Collateral allocation logic
Workflow exceptions and regulatory edge cases
End‑to‑end integration testing and UAT
Ensure:
Full compliance with Change, Release, Incident, and Security management processes
Production stability and controlled post‑go‑live stabilization
6. Innovation & Advanced Analytics (Added Advantage)
Leverage AI / ML techniques for:
Limit utilization forecasting
Exposure analytics and stress signals
Early warning indicators
Anomaly detection and intelligent risk monitoring

jobs.title: CTO / Co-Founder - Hardware & Climate Technology (AWH)
jobs.text:
We are a climate-tech company building an integrated ecosystem of water solutions that generate, conserve, and optimize water for agriculture, industry, and environmental restoration in water-scarce regions. At the core of this ecosystem is our Atmospheric Water Harvesting (AWH) technology, which serves as the foundational platform enabling decentralized, energy-efficient water harvesting.
Our approach combines advanced engineering, thermodynamics, materials science, and system-level design to move beyond single products and toward scalable infrastructure solutions. As we expand the ecosystem over time, AWH remains the core technology, and the CTO / Co-Founder will lead its development from early-stage R&D through commercialization and real-world deployment.
Role Overview
As CTO / Co-Founder, you will own the technical vision, system architecture, and product development of our AWH technology from concept through prototype, pilot, and commercialization. You will work closely with the founders to define the technology roadmap, build and test systems, and lead R&D with a strong bias toward execution.
This is a hands-on role. You will be designing, building, testing, and iterating not delegating everything from day one.
Key Responsibilities
· Define and lead the technical vision and architecture of AWH systems
· Design and develop mechanical and thermal systems
· Take products from idea → prototype → pilot → commercial deployment
· Lead hands-on R&D, experimentation, testing, and performance optimization
· Drive system efficiency, reliability, and scalability
· Oversee prototyping, validation, and field testing
· Contribute to IP strategy, patent drafting, and technical documentation
· Build and later lead a technical team (engineers, researchers, technicians)
· Collaborate with partners, suppliers, and research institutions
· Support fundraising and investor discussions with deep technical insight

jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.text:
Rockstar is recruiting for a seed-stage company on a mission to transform primary care by empowering nurse practitioners (NPs) to own and operate their practices. The client is building a vertically integrated enablement platform for NP-led practices, providing software that reduces administrative overhead, improves cash flow, and gives clinicians leverage to operate sustainable businesses without corporate consolidation. The company is led by experienced entrepreneurs and Nurse Practitioners and is backed by top-tier venture firms.
About the Company
They are a well-funded seed-stage company led by experienced entrepreneurs and Nurse Practitioners, backed by Kairos HQ, Lerer Hippeau, and others. The team is building a vertically integrated enablement platform for NP-led practices: software that reduces administrative overhead, improves cash flow, and gives clinicians leverage to operate sustainable businesses without corporate consolidation.
They’ve already built the data foundation that connects to outpatient EHR and practice management systems and supports these workflows through services today. This role is about owning the technical vision that turns that foundation into scalable, self-serve products while building the team and systems to support long-term growth.
About the Role
As VP of Engineering, you’ll be the architect and primary builder of the company’s product engineering stack. You’ll lead a small but growing data and engineering team, setting technical direction while staying deeply hands-on. You’ll define the technical roadmap, build the systems that scale it, and develop the team that sustains it.
You’ll own the architecture that powers customer-facing products: data-intensive applications that surface complex healthcare and practice management data through clean, usable interfaces. You’ll work across the full stack, from backend systems and data pipelines through to the application surfaces that clinic staff interact with daily.
This role is part of the founding team and is ideal for someone who thinks in systems, builds with urgency, and enjoys turning messy real-world problems into well-structured software.
What You’ll Do
Drive the Technical Strategy. Own architectural decisions across the stack, from how data flows out of EHR and practice management systems through backend services and business logic to customer-facing applications. Make pragmatic decisions that balance speed with long-term scalability while establishing engineering standards and best practices.
Build Data-Intensive Products. Design and implement backend systems that transform complex healthcare data into products customers actually use. Build dashboards, workflows, and operational tools that make complex data intuitive and actionable.
Turn Services Into Software. Partner with operations and product teams to understand existing workflows and transform manual, service-driven processes into configurable, self-serve software solutions through automation and workflow abstractions.
Manage and Grow the Team. Define the structure of the engineering organization, lead hiring efforts, mentor engineers through architecture guidance and code reviews, and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, and technical excellence.
Own Quality & Reliability. Establish high standards for testing, debugging, observability, and production readiness while continuously improving system reliability and performance.
What We’re Looking For
8+ years of experience building production web applications with ownership over significant technical systems.
Strong backend and data engineering expertise with experience processing, transforming, and serving complex application data.
Experience building data-intensive customer-facing applications that present complex information in an intuitive way for non-technical users.
Proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with experience designing and building RESTful APIs.
Full-stack capabilities, with backend engineering as your primary strength.
Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data tooling.
Experience leading engineering teams across frontend and backend development, with a passion for mentoring and scaling organizations.
A product engineering mindset, always considering the end-user experience alongside technical implementation.
Nice to Haves
Experience working with healthcare, billing, or claims data.
Experience transforming internal tools or managed services into self-serve customer-facing products.
Experience building workflow automation or rule-based systems.
Compensation & Location
Salary: $250,000 - $325,000 USD + equity
Location: Hybrid, New York City

jobs.title: Director - City Technology Governance & PMO
jobs.text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced and strategic Director for City Technology Governance & PMO to lead and enhance the technology governance framework across the Qiddiya city development. The successful candidate will oversee the Project Management Office (PMO) related to technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company’s overall vision and strategic goals. This leadership role involves driving best practices in technology governance, risk management, and compliance while facilitating cross-functional collaboration among multiple stakeholders.
The Director will be responsible for establishing and strengthening IT governance policies, standards, and procedures; driving technology project delivery excellence; and managing the portfolio of technology projects with an emphasis on quality, timelines, and budgets. Operating at the intersection of technology and city planning, this role demands a visionary leader who can effectively manage complex technology programs and influence decision-making at senior levels to support the successful deployment of innovative technology solutions in line with Qiddiya’s unique vision.
Key Responsibilities
Develop, implement, and maintain robust technology governance frameworks tailored to city-scale smart infrastructure and digital services.
Lead the Technology PMO, overseeing project planning, execution, resource allocation, risk management, and performance tracking for all technology initiatives.
Ensure compliance with internal policies, industry standards, and regulatory requirements concerning technology deployments.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including IT, engineering, operations, and external partners to align technology projects with the broader city development objectives.
Advise senior leadership on governance and project management best practices, providing clear reports and recommendations for decision-making.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize project delivery processes and governance mechanisms.
Manage stakeholder communication and expectations to facilitate transparency and accountability throughout the project lifecycle.
Champion innovation by identifying emerging technologies and governance trends applicable to smart city environments.

jobs.text:
BlackStone eIT is seeking a strategic and results-driven Head of Product & Delivery to lead our product development and delivery teams. This leadership role will be responsible for overseeing the entire product lifecycle, from ideation to launch and ongoing improvement, while ensuring efficient delivery and high-quality outcomes. The successful candidate will align product strategy with business goals, foster collaboration across teams, and drive innovation to meet customer needs.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage the product and delivery teams, providing vision, motivation, and support.
Develop and execute product strategies that align with company objectives and market demands.
Oversee project delivery processes to ensure timely, high-quality product releases.
Collaborate with stakeholders to define product roadmaps, priorities, and success metrics.
Implement best practices in Agile and other delivery methodologies to optimize performance.
Establish and monitor KPIs to assess product and delivery team effectiveness.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance product quality and customer satisfaction.
Manage resource allocation and budgeting to maximize efficiency and outcomes.
Maintain strong communication across departments, fostering a collaborative and innovative culture.
- Programme delivery across all active workstreams: executive portal, data platform, governance, AI agents, crisis management systems
- Sprint execution: planning, backlog management, Definition of Done, mid-sprint check-ins, sprint reviews with live demos
- External vendor coordination: tracking classification vendor milestones against your integration needs; tracking agentic platform delivery against your data readiness timeline
- Stakeholder management: milestone reports to senior leadership, weekly status updates, requirements conversations with internal business owners
- Scope discipline: deciding what gets cut when time is at risk, deferring gracefully, tracking deferred work
- Resource management: contractor onboarding, work package definition, daily task allocation, quality review
- User acceptance testing: designing and facilitating UAT with non-technical end users and senior leadership
- Delivery risk management: identifying risks before they become blockers, maintaining a cleared backlog that proceeds when external dependencies are slow
- Office representation: authorized to represent the Data & AI Office at all levels when technical leadership is unavailable

jobs.title: Technology Modernization Director (Performance)
jobs.text:
At AlixPartners, we solve the most complex and critical challenges by moving quickly from analysis to action when it really matters; creating value that has a lasting impact on companies, their people, and the communities they serve. By understanding, respecting, and honoring the needs of our employees, clients, and communities, AlixPartners actively promotes an inclusive environment. We strongly believe in the value that diversity brings to our experiences and are committed to the perpetual enhancements of initiatives, policies, and practices. We hold ourselves accountable by providing the space for authenticity, growth, and equity for everyone.
AlixPartners has embraced a hybrid work model to provide flexibility and support our employees’ work-life integration. Our hybrid model combines a mix of in-person (at client site or AlixPartners office) and remote working. Travel is part of this position, but the frequency may vary based on client, team, and individual circumstances.
What you’ll do
We are seeking a Director with technical credibility, strong commercial instincts, and a track record of delivering transformation across Retail or Financial Services sectors. This role is ideal for individuals who blend industry and consulting experience, who can influence stakeholders at all levels, and build long-lasting trusted client relationships.
You will drive high‑impact engagements that sit at the intersection of business value, technology strategy, and execution – providing independent, senior-level expertise that enables executives to drive value from Technology and as a result to improve business performance. The depth of our colleagues’ experience enables us to exert a rapid and sustainable impact across:
Digital and Technology strategy development, operating model, capability and governance design.
Technology and Product strategy and innovation, assisting our clients with the strategy and execution.
Technology investment roadmaps and value creation plans.
Technology cost reduction, outsourcing and end to end Transformation.
Technology assessments leading to possible re-platforming, rationalization and consolidation activities.
Technology due diligence, carve-out, and merger integration planning and execution.
IT crisis management and project turnaround.
You will lead and/or co-lead our small, focused teams in delivering projects. They work closely with PMDs to ensure the successful delivery of all elements of client engagements and often collaboratively with the Directors across other areas of AlixPartners. They will sometimes work across a small number of projects at any given time bringing a flexible and adaptable approach to the following:
Lead large and high complexity projects from inception to completion, via small teams in a highly collaborative nature with the client.
Deliver advanced technical and consulting expertise in the following Technology areas:
Strategy, due diligence, general technology assessments, strategic architecture, operating model, cost modelling and cost reduction, turnaround of large scale “troubled” projects and company separation (carve-out) or integration (merger) projects.
Be recognized as a go-to person for specific technical/industry/functional knowledge. Continuously develop individual skills, capabilities, and knowledge.
Continuously improve and innovate internally and externally. Stay ahead of client, Firm, and market demands. Develop intellectual capital and compelling service offerings. Improve processes, create practical tools and build infrastructure
Develop business opportunities and build sustainable relationships and external networks. Maintain a market presence and support AlixPartners in the market.
Serve as an ambassador of the AlixPartners brand. Demonstrate a service mentality. Work diligently to anticipate client needs, develop and implement solutions, and exceed expectations.
This description is not designed to encompass a comprehensive listing of required activities, duties or responsibilities.
What you’ll need
MBA or Master’s degree an advantage, but valid experience in conjunction with a Bachelor’s degree is required.
Preferably you will have a mix of consulting and industry experience, with an ability to deliver small projects and/or working across multiple workstreams of larger projects.
Strong Retail or Financial Services sector experience.
Knowledge and practical experience within Technology or IT in at least 2 of the following areas: IT strategy, IT cost optimisation, software delivery, infrastructure and operations, architecture, governance, project management and target operating models.
Experience of implementing projects in a variety of environments, using different methodologies and frameworks.
You demonstrate a keen personal interest in Technology and Digital and remain up to date in the latest trends and potential impacts on industry.
You are passionate about driving IT effectiveness and enabling clients to achieve their business objectives.
Excellent communication and presentation capabilities and ability to communicate effectively at CXO and Senior levels.
Outstanding analytical and critical thinking skills along with strong financial literacy.
Fluency in English is essential; knowledge of an additional language would be advantageous.
You are confident when collaborating with clients and stakeholders, with the ability to build relationships, influence and provide advice to key decision makers.
Experience leading or contributing to business-led technology transformations, digital growth initiatives, or value creation programs.
Ability and willingness to travel across EMEA.
Willingness to work outside of normal business hours, and in particular as unique projects/needs arise.
Ability to work full time in an office and remote environment; physically able to sit/stand at a computer and work in front of a computer screen for significant portions of the workday.
Must become familiar with, and promote and abide by, our Core Values as defined by the AlixPartners’ Code of Conduct and foster an inclusive environment with people at all levels of an organization.
The firm offers a comprehensive benefits program including health, vision, dental, disability, tuition reimbursement, identity theft protection, and mental wellness support. Employees will also receive a generous paid leave policy.
AlixPartners is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.
#LI-AP2
#LI-Hybrid

jobs.title: Senior Director - Project Design - SDU - 20012794 - HS8
jobs.text:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a highly experienced Senior Director - Project Director Design to lead the design aspects of our Strategic Development Unit (SDU). This pivotal role requires a visionary leader who can oversee and manage the design process for large-scale projects, ensuring their successful delivery while maintaining alignment with Qiddiya’s overall strategic objectives and brand vision.
The Senior Director provides leadership in establishing and maintaining design and consultancy management framework, governance and operating model for QDC HQ team. Ensures the design processes are developed and rolled out to all Business units / sectors, supports delivery in BUs when required. Provides leadership for assigned HQ special projects accountable for meeting quality, time, budget and HSSE requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Establish/update design and project management framework for all delivery methods (including Self-Delivery, Delivery partner, CM, traditional etc.)
Develop / update policies, processes, procedures, manuals and templates for design and consultancy (including PMC) for all projects and delivery methods
Define governance process including detailed RACI matrix for all projects for Stages
Support / coordinate with HQ Operations Director and Project Director (Delivery) in establishing governance and operational model for the complete program lifecycle
Develop Design Strategy requirements and template to be applied for all projects and delivery methods.
Coordinate Technical / Peer review design management process and requirements with the Technical Director.
Develop/Update Health Safety Security and Environmental management requirements for the design phase including Design HSSE Reviews, co-ordinate with HSE and Security Managers.
Develop/Update Sustainability management requirements for the design phase. co-ordinate with Sustainability Managers.
Support MMC Director in establishing and overall MMC strategy and design integration process for all delivery models
Support Procurement Director in establishing design and consultancy requirements and standards for prequalification and RFP processes. Participate when required in consultant selection process.
Support HQ Executive director in presentations and submittal for business line, project and budget approvals.
Accountable for delivery of special/assigned HQ projects including all approvals, reporting, management of internal and external stakeholders, financial closure and handover.
Accountable for compliance of special/assigned HQ projects with all QDC policies, processes, procedures and requirements, ensuring that the project meets HSE, budget, schedule and quality standards and requirements.
Support Business units in project delivery with peer reviews, consultant selection and management (when required), project audits to ensure compliance with established processes, procedures and standards for design and consultancy (including PMC)
Coordinates input from Business units on the HQ management and governance framework processes and standards, updates documentation as part of the continuous improvement cycle.
Leads/support preparation of training materials required for the implementation of policies, processes and procedures, participates in training or presentations when required
Participates in QDC Mentoring and Capability Building programs.

jobs.title: VP of Automation Engineering
jobs.text:
About Huzzle
At Huzzle, we connect high-performing professionals with global companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include startups, digital agencies, and tech platforms in industries like SaaS, MarTech, FinTech, and EdTech. We match top talent to full-time remote roles where they’re hired directly into client teams and provided ongoing support by Huzzle.
About the Company
Our client is an operator-led, AI-powered revenue systems company building next-generation go-to-market (GTM) infrastructure for scaling businesses. They design automation-first revenue engines that transform real-time market signals into predictable pipeline growth.
With a deeply AI-native stack—including workflow automation, LLM-powered systems, and custom-built internal products—they support companies scaling from $1M to $100M+ ARR. Engineering is not a support function here—it is the company’s competitive advantage.
Role Type: Full-time
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Job Summary
We are hiring a VP of Automation Engineering to act as the foundational technical leader and strategic partner to the CEO. This is a hands-on executive role where you will architect and scale automation systems, build internal products, and lead a high-performing engineering team.
You will operate in an AI-first environment, where tools like Claude Code are part of daily development workflows—not optional add-ons.
Key Responsibilities
Automation Architecture & Infrastructure
Own and scale end-to-end automation systems using n8n and API integrations
Architect orchestration layers for complex, multi-client environments
Build resilient systems with monitoring, alerting, and self-healing capabilities
Integrate tools like Clay, CRMs, and outbound platforms into a unified infrastructure
Product Development
Build internal and client-facing products using Node.js, TypeScript, and modern frameworks
Own the full product lifecycle—from architecture to deployment
Develop scalable automation products and operational dashboards
Establish engineering standards, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation
AI Systems & Intelligence Layer
Design and deploy production-grade AI/LLM systems (Claude, OpenAI, etc.)
Use Claude Code as a core development accelerator across the team
Build intelligent pipelines for classification, enrichment, and decision-making
Optimize prompt engineering, evaluation systems, and reliability at scale
Leadership & Technical Strategy
Build, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering team
Define and execute the technical roadmap aligned with company growth
Partner directly with the CEO on product and engineering strategy
Lead sprint planning, prioritization, and delivery execution

jobs.title: AVP, Data Cloud Applications
jobs.text:
WHO WE ARE
Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com.
Overview
The AVP, Data Cloud Applications serves as the strategic and operational lead, responsible for ensuring the successful development, enhancement, and delivery of applications built from Zeta’s Data Cloud.
This role bridges client needs, product strategy, and application execution, ensuring that enhancements and net new applications are delivered with quality, speed, and clear business impact. The AVP will work cross-functionally across Zeta teams to translate client problems and industry opportunities into scalable application solutions while leading and mentoring a global Applications team.
The ideal candidate combines product leadership, technical fluency, client empathy, and operational rigor, with a strong ability to coach teams, prioritize effectively, and drive execution across complex initiatives.
This role requires a highly hands-on leader who operates as a player-coach, working closely with the team in the details of application development while providing strategic guidance and leadership. The AVP is expected to deeply understand how applications are built within the Data Cloud ecosystem to effectively guide the team, remove obstacles, and ensure high-quality delivery.
This role operates across both internal execution and external engagement, with approximately 60% focused on leading and working hands-on with internal teams to enhance and develop applications, and 40% dedicated to client-facing activities, including solutioning, demos, and incorporating client feedback into the application roadmap.
Key Responsibilities
Client Engagement & Problem Solving
Partner with the EVP, Data Cloud Applications in top-tier client discussions to identify application gaps, enhancements, and new solution opportunities.
Translate client challenges into actionable application development initiatives.
Coordinate communication across clients, the Applications team, and internal Zeta stakeholders to ensure alignment and progress.
Act as a trusted internal voice for client-driven innovation.
Application Roadmap Ownership
Oversee and ensure execution of the application roadmap across enhancements and net new applications.
Continuously prioritize initiatives based on business objectives, client demand, industry trends, and business impact vs. development effort
Review and finalize Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) to ensure completeness and clarity and validate new ideas through testing before roadmap inclusion.
Generate and evaluate new application concepts based on market opportunities.
Communicate roadmap timelines and launch plans with the Project Management team and the Product Ops team to ensure sufficient training, enablement, and marketing resources are available for each launch.
Execution & Delivery Leadership
Lead program reviews, track milestones, and proactively manage risks and dependencies.
Hold teams accountable for quality and timelines.
Remove blockers across Data Cloud teams and broader Zeta business units.
Serve as the final checkpoint ensuring robust delivery of applications and enhancements.
Coordinate alpha and beta testing cycles and support product readiness for launches, PR moments, and industry events
Team Leadership & Development
Lead the Data Cloud Application development team, including:
Business application leads
Design teams
Front-end UI teams
Coach, mentor, and guide team members to strengthen execution and ownership, fostering a culture of accountability, initiative, and high-quality delivery.
Ensure the team is structured and supported to deliver end-to-end application development successfully.
Vertical Strategy & First-to-Market Initiatives
Support the development of vertical-specific application strategies and solutions.
Work with the EVP to develop subject matter expertise across key industries.
Coordinate requirements across data, applications, activation, and go-to-market teams.
Incorporate client feedback and market signals into positioning and roadmap decisions.
Train internal teams on vertical-specific messaging and use cases.
Data Cloud & Cross-Organization Partnership
Maintain deep expertise in Zeta’s identity graph and signal ecosystem; serve as a key internal and external resource.
Support cross-functional issue resolution impacting applications.
Review application-related changes and product marketing materials.
Represent application priorities and roadmap in Customer Advisory Board discussions.
Qualifications
Experience
10+ years of experience in product management, applications development, or data-driven platforms.
Experience building or leading data, identity, martech, adtech, or SaaS platforms.
Proven ability to translate client needs into scalable product solutions.
Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, product, and design.
Skills
Strong understanding of identity graphs, data ecosystems, and signal-based marketing technologies.
Exceptional product strategy and roadmap management capabilities.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational execution.
Strong leadership and mentoring skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
Leadership Profile
Highly accountable and execution-oriented.
Comfortable operating in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities.
Strong problem solver with the ability to unblock teams and drive progress.
Naturally collaborative with the ability to influence across teams and functions.
BENEFITS & PERKS
Unlimited PTO
Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
Employee Equity
Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!
SALARY RANGE
The salary range for this role is $170,000 - $190,000, depending on location and experience.
PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA
Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.
We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. Learn more about our commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion here: https://zetaglobal.com/blog/a-look-into-zetas-ergs/
ZETA IN THE NEWS!
https://zetaglobal.com/press/?cat=press-releases

The AVP will work cross-functionally across Zeta teams to translate client problems and industry opportunities into scalable application solutions while leading and mentoring a global Applications team.

The ideal candidate combines product leadership, technical fluency, client empathy, and operational rigor, with a strong ability to coach teams, prioritize effectively, and drive execution across complex initiatives.

This role requires a highly hands-on leader who operates as a player-coach, working closely with the team in the details of application development while providing strategic guidance and leadership. The AVP is expected to deeply understand how applications are built within the Data Cloud ecosystem to effectively guide the team, remove obstacles, and ensure high-quality delivery.

This role operates across both internal execution and external engagement, with approximately 60% focused on leading and working hands-on with internal teams to enhance and develop applications, and 40% dedicated to client-facing activities, including solutioning, demos, and incorporating client feedback into the application roadmap.
Key Responsibilities
Client Engagement & Problem Solving

items: Partner with the EVP, Data Cloud Applications in top-tier client discussions to identify application gaps, enhancements, and new solution opportunities.
Translate client challenges into actionable application development initiatives.
Coordinate communication across clients, the Applications team, and internal Zeta stakeholders to ensure alignment and progress.
Act as a trusted internal voice for client-driven innovation.

blocks.text: Application Roadmap Ownership

items: Oversee and ensure execution of the application roadmap across enhancements and net new applications.
Continuously prioritize initiatives based on business objectives, client demand, industry trends, and business impact vs. development effort
Review and finalize Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) to ensure completeness and clarity and validate new ideas through testing before roadmap inclusion.
Generate and evaluate new application concepts based on market opportunities.

Communicate roadmap timelines and launch plans with the Project Management team and the Product Ops team to ensure sufficient training, enablement, and marketing resources are available for each launch.

blocks.text: Execution & Delivery Leadership

items: Lead program reviews, track milestones, and proactively manage risks and dependencies.
Hold teams accountable for quality and timelines.
Remove blockers across Data Cloud teams and broader Zeta business units.
Serve as the final checkpoint ensuring robust delivery of applications and enhancements.
Coordinate alpha and beta testing cycles and support product readiness for launches, PR moments, and industry events

blocks.text: Team Leadership & Development

items: Lead the Data Cloud Application development team, including:
Business application leads
Design teams
Front-end UI teams
Coach, mentor, and guide team members to strengthen execution and ownership, fostering a culture of accountability, initiative, and high-quality delivery.
Ensure the team is structured and supported to deliver end-to-end application development successfully.

blocks.text: Vertical Strategy & First-to-Market Initiatives

items: Support the development of vertical-specific application strategies and solutions.
Work with the EVP to develop subject matter expertise across key industries.
Coordinate requirements across data, applications, activation, and go-to-market teams.
Incorporate client feedback and market signals into positioning and roadmap decisions.
Train internal teams on vertical-specific messaging and use cases.

blocks.text: Data Cloud & Cross-Organization Partnership

items: Maintain deep expertise in Zeta’s identity graph and signal ecosystem; serve as a key internal and external resource.
Support cross-functional issue resolution impacting applications.
Review application-related changes and product marketing materials.
Represent application priorities and roadmap in Customer Advisory Board discussions.

items: 10+ years of experience in product management, applications development, or data-driven platforms.

jobs.title: Product Director, Flex (Borrowing)
jobs.text:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.
We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.
After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.
With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!
We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️
📍 London / UK | Salary dependent on experience + Stock Options + Benefits
Flex is one of Monzo’s fastest-growing and most commercially significant products. Four years ago, we reinvented the credit card experience—building something simpler, more transparent, and genuinely useful. Today, over a million customers use Flex.
We’re looking for a Product Director to lead Flex into its next phase of growth.
This is a high-impact, deeply commercial role at the intersection of product and credit. You’ll define how we scale borrowing responsibly, expand into new segments, and continue building products customers genuinely love.
You’ll work closely with Engineering, Credit, Data, Design, and senior leadership to identify new opportunities, optimise performance across complex segments, and deliver at pace.
What you’ll be working on…
Set the strategy for Flex
Set direction for one of Monzo’s most important revenue-driving products
Identify and unlock new commercial opportunities across customer segments
Navigate complex trade-offs between growth, risk, and customer outcomes
Drive commercial performance
Work closely with Credit teams to shape propositions across multiple risk segments and cohorts
Interrogate performance deeply — from unit economics to long-term profitability curves
Identify and drive new commercial opportunities
Champion the customer
Ensure Flex remains rooted in strong customer outcomes, not just revenue
Push for simple, transparent, and delightful experiences
Advocate for customer experience alongside commercial outcomes
Build and lead a high-performing team
Manage and develop a team of Product Managers
Deliver multiple high-impact initiatives through your direct reports
Raise the bar on product thinking and foster a culture of high standard and high velocity
🌟 What We’re Looking For
Commercial Thinking
Strong commercial instinct — you think in terms of trade-offs, economics, and outcomes
Comfortable operating in complex environments (e.g. multiple segments and cohorts with different commercials)
Able to engage deeply with Credit and Data partners
Experience in lending, credit cards, or adjacent borrowing products
Consumer Focus
You start with the customer never lose track of their needs
You’re willing to challenge revenue-driven decisions when they conflict with good customer outcomes
You have strong product taste and care deeply about experience quality
Execution & Leadership
Proven ability to deliver in fast-paced environments with multiple workstreams
Comfortable going deep in the detail while leading through others
Strong cross-functional leadership across technical, credit, and governance stakeholders
What’s in it for you:
💰Base salary dependent upon experience + Stock Options + Benefits
✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK
✅ We can sponsor visas
📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).
⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.
📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences
➕And much more, see our full list of benefits here
#LI-AC1
Equal opportunities for everyone
Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.
We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.
If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

jobs.title: Engineering Director, Frontend Business Lead
jobs.text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.
Who We Are
At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.
OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.
Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er.
OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.
What You’ll Be Doing
Business & Team Leadership Own the overall frontend team across core business verticals including Trading and Payment, covering hiring, development, and pipeline building. Partner effectively with Product, Backend, Security, and Compliance — driving cross-functional outcomes through technical judgment, not just execution.
Product Delivery & Technical Execution Lead technical design and delivery for core business features including trading system frontend experience, wallet and asset management, AI-powered trading products, payment gateway integrations, and KYC/AML frontend implementation. Stay deeply sensitive to business metrics and user experience, making sound trade-offs between speed and quality.
Product & Engineering Thinking in the AI Era Demonstrate deep understanding of how AI is reshaping product paradigms — changing user expectations, product form factors, and R&D efficiency. Integrate AI into product decisions and design, not merely as a productivity tool.
Technical Judgment & Standard-Setting Drive tech stack alignment and evolution. Proactively identify and address technical risk. Establish high engineering quality standards in complex crypto security contexts — private key security, frontend attack prevention, compliance auditing, and more.
Cross-Team Influence Build dual technical and business influence at the company level. Communicate technical value and business judgment clearly to engineers, product managers, and senior leadership alike. Participate in industry engagements to attract high-potential talent who are genuinely passionate about crypto.
What We Look For In You
Bachelor's degree or above in CS or related field; 10+ years of engineering experience including 5+ years managing technical teams; solid full-stack capabilities with frontend depth
Deep command of core frontend technologies (React/Vue internals, engineering toolchains, performance optimization, cross-platform solutions), with enough backend and API fluency to drive substantive technical discussions
Proven track record leading frontend for products with DAU 1M+ in high-concurrency, high-availability environments
Demonstrated experience driving cross-team collaboration and standard adoption through technical influence rather than organizational authority
Genuine understanding of and enthusiasm for crypto — familiar with CEX/DEX trading mechanics, Web3 wallet and signing mechanisms, and mainstream payment gateway ecosystems.
Deep understanding of how AI is reshaping product design; can integrate AI into product decisions rather than treating it purely as a development accelerator
Perks & Benefits
Competitive total compensation package
L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
Various team building programs and company events
Wellness and meal allowances
Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
More that we love to tell you along the process!
Notice:
All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.
Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.
